short_description: A hectic, fast-paced car combat game for up to four players. Drive your own customized car to outmaneuver and outgun your opponents. Quick reactions are essential as one wrong move can be the difference between winning and becoming a smoking wreck.

name: Death Stair
short_description: Missing the days of split screen multiplayer or wanting to play with actual in-person friends in the same room? Death Stair is a local multiplayer stair climbing game. Play locally with maximum three friends and race to the finish while the fourth, armed to the teeth with an arsenal of unconventional ammo types, does everything to stop...

name: Zaccaria Pinball
short_description: Play free and try tables in trial mode with Zaccaria Pinball, featuring 140+ tables, including 40+ officially licensed from Zaccaria was founded by three brothers: Marino, Franco, & Natale. Zaccaria was the world’s 3rd largest pinball manufacturer, next to Bally & Williams. Relive the golden age.

name: UBERMOSH:BLACK
short_description: UBERMOSH:BLACK is the second volume of the arcade series UBERMOSH. Cut bullets with your sword, shoot with heavy guns and splatter enemies with a rage fueled psionic wave.

name: SPATIAL SOUND CARD
short_description: The Spatial Sound Card (SSC) software is a binaural, virtual loudspeaker system for regular headphone applications. It provides virtual stereo or surround sound for any computer using regular headphones. It's highly recommended for gamers, movie enthusiasts, music lovers and 360/VR.

name: Ad Exitum
short_description: AD EXITUMExperience Ad Exitum, a horror survival jump scare indie game of Since Idea Games, which is developed with Unreal Engine 4

name: Nova Nukers!
short_description: Nova Nukers! is a multiplayer battle game for up to 4 players (online and local)! Explode your friends on colourful planets with a large variety of bombastic items!

name: Frozen Synapse 2
short_description: Frozen Synapse 2 is the sequel to the award-winning turn-based tactical game. Command your squads in a vast procedurally generated city: enter any building, perform any mission, execute any strategy.

name: Sorcery! Part 3
short_description: An epic open-world narrative adventure through a world of monsters, traps and magic. Explore two intermeshed worlds, past and present, and create your own unique story where every decision you make is remembered. Survive, and defeat the Seven Serpents - if you can!

name: Paintey
short_description: Paintey is a freeform do whatever you want painting simulator! You can paint everything from your face to the entire environment.

name: Tatsu
short_description: Japanese legend tells of a great battle between two mighty Dragon Lord armies, locked in combat on the peaks of Mount Hotaka, competing to win the hand of the Princess Kushinada, the last and most beautiful of eight sisters.

name: Tasty Planet: Back for Seconds
short_description: Control a tiny ball of grey goo with the ability to eat anything smaller than itself. The more it eats, the bigger it gets! Eat rats, dinosaurs, gladiators, samurai, pyramids, volcanoes... Everything! Soon you'll be eating the entire planet.

name: The Average Everyday Adventures of Samantha Browne
short_description: An interactive story about a painfully introverted college student who must find a way to make some oatmeal in the communal kitchen of her dorm. One simple task, can you help her complete it?

name: Smell Of Death
short_description: Smell of Death is a Horror FPS virtual reality game includes action and horror items. The game consists of two game modes including Story and Survival.In story mode you can explore the manor with teleport.You should find magazines and keys.

name: The Haunting of Billy Classic
short_description: It’s Halloween night and your girlfriend is missing! Play as Billy, fighting through the randomly generated halls of an old, haunted mansion. Fight zombies, ghosts, goblins, and more with over 120 unique weapons and more than 610,000 costume combinations!

name: Expeditions: Viking
short_description: Circa 790 AD. A small band of Norse warriors lands on the shores of England. History may have forgotten their names, but their actions live on. As the chieftain of your clan, let ambition guide your choices in the party-based RPG Expeditions: Viking. How will history remember you?

name: Tiny Knight
short_description: Tiny Knight is a single-player adventure platformer set in a fantastical world, where you set out on a hunt for a mysterious figure who destroyed your village.

name: Avorion
short_description: A procedural co-op space sandbox where players can build their own space ships out of dynamically scalable blocks. Fight epic space battles, explore, mine, trade, wage wars and build your own empire to save your galaxy from being torn apart by an unknown enemy.

name: Lost girl`s [diary]
short_description: A group of girls are having their vacation, alone. What would a group of girls do on a dark Christmas night? Of course, fortunetelling! Unfortunately for them, their boyfriends are not about to leave them alone and their sudden visit totally ruins their plans for fortune telling, turning it into a scary story contest.

name: Might and Magic: Heroes VII – Trial by Fire
short_description: Five years after the epic events of Might & Magic Heroes VII, lead the new Fortress faction to define the destiny of the Dwarves and shed light on some of the darkest chapters of their history.

name: Atomic Space Command
short_description: Manage your ship, build a fleet, and conquer the galaxy with your friends in Atomic Space Command’s solar arena!

name: Aselia the Eternal -The Spirit of Eternity Sword-
short_description: With his sister Kaori held hostage, Yuuto must fight as an Etranger, a warrior of power, and take up the sword to fight alongside the beautiful female Spirits who protect the land from an evil that threatens to consume it.

name: Seinarukana -The Spirit of Eternity Sword 2-
short_description: Thrown into another world, Setoki Nozomu must fight to bring his friends home, while at the same time struggling against the ancient god that sleeps inside him. So begins a journey that will shake the very foundation of the universe. The sequel to the visual novel RPG, Aselia the Eternal.

name: Watson's Watch
short_description: A story driven game where the player assumes the role of a detective thrust into the middle of a series of disappearances on his relaxing vacation. Not only is the city of Watson’s Watch shrouded in mystery but so is our fearless detective. Unravel the story while dialogue interactions lead to its conclusion

name: Void Raiders
short_description: Void Raiders is "radical" top down rogue-lite shmup, with permanent character progression, character centric gameplay and never ending carnage in randomly generated environments.

name: The Stargazers
short_description: The Stargazers squadron! Three pilots of the Allied Defense Force Signals, first to arrive in any new frontier, their mission? Venture deep into uncharted space and explore the hell out of it!

name: Battle Islands: Commanders
short_description: Take part in major WWII battles in Battle Islands: Commanders, from the sandy dunes of North Africa to the bitter cold of the Eastern Front! Master the art of war against real opponents from around the world and reap the spoils of war.

name: Settled
short_description: Made in Construct2, Settled is a story driven game with hints of exploration. As you progress, subtle changes appear. Memories and nightmares act as new areas, although still remaining in the confines of the house. When you reach the end, the conclusion may not be what you expected.

name: Airport Madness 3D
short_description: This is the seventh version of Airport Madness, offering players a 3-dimensional air traffic control experience from a control tower perspective.

name: Love Language Japanese
short_description: Enter your first year at Koto Gakuen and discover Japanese language through easy to learn lessons and compelling mini games. Meet new friends and unveil their story and maybe find love through your adventures.

name: Undead vs Plants
short_description: Undead vs. Plants is a cool ricochet shooter with 150 levels and simple rules for fun play. The bullets bounce off everywhere, but players should be careful to aim well and not use too many of the bullets. The game is easy to handle, but hard to master and it is a real brain training pastime fun.

name: Phantom Trigger
short_description: Phantom Trigger is a vivid hardcore slasher with elements of an RPG and a roguelike. Your world is made up of sick fantasies, you are a phantom. Accept it or stop your treatment.

name: Asher
short_description: A retro inspired, platforming RPG. Set in a young boys world of dreams and nightmares. Level up, master masks each with unique abilities, and take on challenging bosses. Using fast action, skill shots, and responsive player controls, Asher allows for a challenging and enjoyable game play experience.

name: Wizard of Legend
short_description: Wizard of Legend is a no-nonsense, action-packed take on wizardry that emphasizes precise movements and smart comboing of spells in a rogue-like dungeon crawler that features over a hundred unique spells and relics!

name: Stellar Monarch
short_description: Asymmetric space empire builder where you feel like the Emperor, not a logistics officer. No micromanagement, grand scale, fast paced, audiences, assassins, imperial court, disloyal admirals.

name: CitiesCorp Concept - Build Everything on Your Own
short_description: CitiesCorp Concept: Design buildings, manage economy and cope with traffic.A sandbox city building simulation.

name: Jalopy
short_description: Build, repair, refuel and drive a dilapidated old car on a grand journey through the territories of the former Eastern bloc. Explore Germany, CSFR, Hungary, Yugoslavia and Bulgaria

name: Blade Arcus from Shining: Battle Arena
short_description: In a world controlled by blade, magic, and fist, diverse warriors gather for battle! This is a 2D fighting game featuring characters from Shining Blade and Shining Hearts.

name: Operation KREEP
short_description: An extraterrestrial organism threatens deep space exploration missions! Only trained personnel working as a team can eliminate these infestations. But, the corporation financing the space endeavor has a private mail for you: Cold hard cash for the alien alive! Which side will you choose?

name: akeytsu Indie 2017
short_description: Disruptive, fast and easy Akeytsu provides a very simple access to create 3D animation. It offers the most intuitive and innovative character animation and rigging features for the game and Indie game creators.
genres: Web Publishing;Animation & Modeling;Design & Illustration;Software Training;Video Production;Education

name: ecotone
short_description: You are not a hero, You will not save the world, you may even not save yourself.

name: Mantis Burn Racing®
short_description: The race is on in Mantis Burn Racing, where fast-paced bumper-to-bumper racing combines with intuitive, tactile gameplay and stunning visuals in one of the best-looking and immersive top-down racers around.

name: Happy Critters
short_description: You can try but the God of all match 3 games will not let you rest with Happy Critters!!! Happy Critters is not your everyday Match-3 title. It is easy to learn, but quite difficult to master, because of its 120+ levels which range from easy to very difficult.

name: Bunker Punks
short_description: Bunker Punks is a fast paced rogue-light FPS set in a dystopian future. Run a group of revolutionaries and raid corporate strongholds for supplies, weapons and armor. Customize your bunker, train your gang and tear down the corporate government.

name: Trawl
short_description: Trawl is a first person experiential game of discovery and creativity. First you must figure out how to operate the various parts of the boat, manipulating the wheel, throttle and the net. Then, trawl the sea to recover discover what secrets are hidden in its depths and record your findings on your typewriter.

name: Silver Bullet: Prometheus
short_description: Infiltrate the military research lab consipiring with the devil and hunt down the demons! Kali, the legendary "Goddess of Death" in the South America Rovolution. She joined Neverlight, the counter-demon organization, after some kind of incident.

name: Sabres of Infinity
short_description: Wage a war of gunpowder and magic! As a gentleman-officer of the Royal Dragoons, will you sacrifice your fortune? Your honour? Your men? Your own life?

name: Guns of Infinity
short_description: As commander of a squadron of cavalry, what will you sacrifice to win the war of gunpowder and magic? Fight for power, riches, love, or glory!

name: Sophie's Curse
short_description: You got a job, which is to take care of an old man during the night in a recently purchased house; this house does not have electricity and you have to rely on some kind of hand crank generators to light the place up, but there is something in the darkness draining their power, don’t let it happen!

name: Onechanbara Z2: Chaos
short_description: Onechanbara Z2: Chaos is the latest entry in the Onechanbara series. Two sets of buxom vampire sisters battle through over a dozen stages of high-octane real-time swordplay. Fight off the invasion in gruesome detail, occasionally transforming into a demon for short bursts of added power and speed.

name: Doctor Watson - Treasure Island
short_description: Players will experience an exciting adventure as Dr. Watson at fantastic locations. The first part of this new 3D hidden object series takes players to the famous Treasure Island. In this adventure, players solve exciting puzzles and interact with a varied landscape and many locations.

name: Doctor Watson - The Riddle of the Catacombs
short_description: Dr. Watson experiences in the new part of the successful "3D Hidden Object" games exciting adventures at amazing destinations. NEW: The Gameplay of the famous Hidden Object Games will be ported to 3rd dimension.

name: Blaster Simulator
short_description: Allow your intent to destroy free play and become a blaster! With skill, you reach the required rate of destruction and you will win the fight against your competitors to get new jobs - only the best will get the most explosive contract of all times.

name: Highland Warriors
short_description: In the year of our lord 843, the first king of Scotland, Kenneth McAlpin, united the lands of the Picts and Scots to form the Kingdom of Alba. 400 years later Edward I, also known as the "Hammer of the Scots" engulfed the land in a great feud. It was not long before Edward I controlled most of Scotland.

name: New York Taxi Simulator
short_description: Start your career as a taxi driver in the city of New York and carry your customers safely and on time to their final destination.

name: New York Bus Simulator
short_description: Dense traffic, one way streets and a huge city are waiting for you! Sit down at the steering wheel and carry the residents of New York to their final destination.

name: Rail Cargo Simulator
short_description: As the head of a marshalling yard you are aiming, according to the single, specified tasks, at coordinating the goods traffic with the available shunting locomotives and by using the hump yards in the most efficient way.

name: Armed and Gelatinous: Couch Edition
short_description: Armed and Gelatinous: Couch Edition pits you against friends and family in fast-paced games of blob warfare in the far reaches of space. Absorb a variety of weapons, trading agility for firepower, dodging waves of bullets and deadly dash attacks!

name: One Last Crane
short_description: One Last Crane is a visual novel centered on Yuuki Murakami, a boy who has a brain tumor. After a long year of treatment without any positive results, Yuuki asks for his final wish: to return to his hometown and fulfill his promise to meet again with his childhood friend, Saki Nishimura...

name: Smash Up
short_description: Smash Up is the digital adaptation of the award-winning (and totally awesome) card game. Smash together two factions, and destroy your opponent with a wild and wacky combination of pirates, nerds, zombies, wizards and more!

name: Infinite Minigolf
short_description: Explore thousands of holes created by the community, set new world records, participate in multiplayer competitions, customize your character with unlockable clothes and accessories or create your own courses – the possibilities are endless in Infinite Mini Golf.

name: Grove - VR Browsing Experience
short_description: Browse the web in virtual reality! Choose from a set of backgrounds and open as many browser windows you want to surf the web. With unique window management, mouse free option and an ability to see your mouse and keyboard in VR. Try it out!

name: 7 Mages
short_description: The epic RPG 7 Mages in the tradition of the greatest classics of the genre takes you around the magical island of Roven.

name: Magi Trials
short_description: Do you have what it takes to join the Royal Academy of Magi in a new Highschool Romance story. After attempting a dark ritual which increases innate magical ability, but transforms your body.

name: Bunny Bounce
short_description: Can you help navigate Tomo through the pitfalls of work and maintain his sanity in the face of animal instincts, carnal lusts and girls clad in lingerie in this fun, tongue in cheek ecchi visual novel with multiple endings?

name: Zombie Training Simulator
short_description: Are you ready for the zombie apocalypse? We've done the research and want to make sure you're prepared. When the news reports the zombies are here and your friend gives you a call, "They're here. I need you," how will you respond? That's right, you'll say "On my way. We've got this thanks to ZTS!"

name: Space Pilgrim Episode IV: Sol
short_description: Locked away in the most secure prison in the galaxy, with little hope of escape, Gail Pilgrim faces the most difficult ordeals of her life. Her only hope lies in trusting those who she has come to regard as her friends.

name: Neighborhorde
short_description: Neighborhorde is a couch co-op shoot-em-up where you and your team of friends use toys as weapons and game-changing superpowers to try to survive the attacks of evil robots and zombie Abe Lincolns.

name: Skeet: VR Target Shooting
short_description: A VR target shooting simulator for the HTC Vive. Use one of three shotguns and shoot clay pigeons and other targets in Virtual Reality. Features Trap, Skeet, and Quickdraw modes.

name: AMOK
short_description: Protagonist of the game is investigating the disappearance of people. The investigation leads him into an old house, and then it becomes a party to the strange and dangerous events.

name: Diluvion: Resubmerged
short_description: Diluvion is a 3D deep sea, Jules Verne inspired, exploration game with RPG elements and thrilling submarine combat. As the Captain of your own vessel, you must grow and manage your crew as you search for the secrets of the past in a hauntingly beautiful flooded world.

name: Transport Fever
short_description: Transport Fever is a railroad-focused tycoon game. Players start in 1850 and build up a thriving transport company. As an emerging transport tycoon, the player constructs stations, airports, harbors and makes money by connecting areas requiring transport services. Build up your own Empire!

name: Blossom Tales: The Sleeping King
short_description: Explore a huge open game world in classic action-adventure fashion! Prove your worth by fighting through monster-infested dungeons to save the Kingdom of Blossom!

name: The Lonesome Fog
short_description: The Lonesome Fog is a living book that seeks to expand on the concept of storytelling and explores the plight of a young cub trapped in a cycle of fear, cowardice and uncertainty.

name: Splasher
short_description: Splasher is a fun and challenging 2D Platformer filled with humor and surprises. Armed with a paint cannon, you’ll face the dangers of the Inkorp mega-factory in order to save your companions, the Splashers, and put an end to the Machiavellian projects of the evil boss, Le Docteur.

name: Mindball Play
short_description: Mindball Play is a physics based racing game. Roll over the competition in multiplayer or have fun in single player with time trials and campaign chapters. Explore up to 13 tracks and race your way through them with either a keyboard, mouse, gamepad or Tobii Eye Tracker.

name: Glitchrunners
short_description: Chaotic, five player mayhem takes over in Glitchrunners – a local multiplayer experience like no other.

name: Night Blights
short_description: It's 11pm. Your parents are asleep and Teddy is guarding the end of the bed. Something's moving in the darkness. The wardrobe is creaking and there's laughter behind the door. Night Blights, cruel and mischievous monsters have invaded your home. Can you survive till morning and protect your family?

name: The Huntsman: Winter's Curse
short_description: The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse is a narrative-driven, interactive fantasy fiction game with a card based combat system set in the universe of Snow White and the Huntsman.

name: Grimsfield
short_description: Grimsfield is a short point & click story game. You take on the role of a deadbeat beatnik poet who lives in an absurdist market town somewhere in the north of England.

name: Bird of Light
short_description: Bird of Light is an action-strategy platformer with a twist. Place bridge tiles to create paths through levels in the sky, then run through avoiding obstacles in your path. Leap over vast chasms, collect loot, and discover new lands on your journey.

name: Farming Simulator 17
short_description: Take on the role of a modern farmer in Farming Simulator 17! Explore farming possibilities in a new North American environment. Drive over 250 farming vehicles and equipment from over 75 manufacturers, including new brands such as Challenger, Fendt, Valtra or Massey Ferguson.

name: Watch_Dogs® 2
short_description: Welcome to San Francisco. Play as Marcus, a brilliant young hacker, and join the most notorious hacker group, DedSec. Your objective: execute the biggest hack of history.

name: XLR
short_description: XLR is a multiplayer team based arena shooter. Party up into teams (with friends, or just join a random match), select a player class, then deploy to the arena for battle. Or practice your skills against enemies in singleplayer training mode. Choose from different player classes to even the odds.

name: Where the Water Tastes Like Wine
short_description: Where the Water Tastes Like Wine is a Narrative-Adventure game about traveling, sharing stories, and surviving manifest destiny.

name: APE OUT
short_description: APE OUT is a wildly intense and colorfully stylized smash ‘em up about primal escape, rhythmic violence, and frenetic jazz.

name: Destiny's Princess: A War Story, A Love Story
short_description: It's a game for girls designed with a dramatic storyline with an emphasis on an intriguing plot. You can fall in love with the well-known heroes of the Warring States Period!

name: My Secret Pets!
short_description: "My Secret Pets!" is a romance game where you can live a secret second life at home with your pets, which suddenly transformed into cute guys!

name: Pub Encounter
short_description: "Pub Encounter" is a romance game where you can fall in love with one of several middle-aged men.

name: The Men of Yoshiwara: Ohgiya
short_description: "The Men of Yoshiwara: Ohgiya" is a romance game for women, with the famous Yoshiwara pleasure districts as the setting -- but with the roles of men and women reversed!

name: Blink
short_description: Blink into a world of after-images, where you can walk on light. Solve puzzles by manipulating lights and blinking between worlds. Explore hand drawn landscapes while uncovering the secrets behind this strange power.

name: Zasa - An AI Story
short_description: Zasa is an extraordinary and challenging 3D Puzzle Game. Players are going to roleplay Zasa the Artificial Intelligence to finish the training missions from Dr.Mason by linking nodes in 3-dimensional space.

name: IKEA VR Experience
short_description: Explore and interact with an IKEA Kitchen in Virtual Reality! Walk around freely, open drawers and put your vegetable peelings in the waste sorting station. You can even enjoy the visual impact of different material finishes and experience things from a child’s point of view.

name: Redeemer: Enhanced Edition
short_description: REDEEMER is a intense Brawler where you will punch, hack and blast your way through enemies using fists, hammers, fire arms and even the environment.

name: Paper Train Traffic
short_description: Paper Train Traffic is here to test your mind and reflexes with increasingly complex challenges. From single railroads to multi railway nodes, your task is to supervise the ongoing train traffic of many different locations around the World.

name: Sluggy's Fruit Emporium
short_description: Aliens! Fruit! Tentacles! Space! Shop management!

name: VA-11 Hall-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action
short_description: VA-11 HALL-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action is a booze em' up about waifus, technology, and post-dystopia life.

name: Lost Cosmonaut
short_description: Rejoice comrades! For you have survived the crash landing! Become lost on a randomly generated planet in Lost Cosmonaut, an action platformer with roguelike elements.

name: Regeria Hope Episode 1
short_description: As Regeria Hope, clear your clients of their crimes, or watch them hang and amass power and wealth. It's up to you.

name: Dimensional Intersection
short_description: Dimensional Intersection is an interactive musical visualizer for virtual reality. Featuring music from artists such as Globular and MONS, it will take you to a new reality through surreal scenes filled with interactive real-time fractals, infinite tunnels and morphing 3D models.

name: Crystal Crisis
short_description: An all-star cast of heroes has gathered to test their mettle in this cute and chaotic new color-matching ONLINE combat game! Crystal Crisis is presented like a fighting game, but players attack by arranging falling crystals and clearing them from the screen. It’s the ultimate Online puzzle battle throwdown!

name: LostWinds
short_description: Wield the awesome powers of Enril the wind spirit to guide and protect young Toku through this unique platform adventure.

name: LostWinds 2: Winter of the Melodias
short_description: With amazing new abilities, re-visit a land full of wonder on a new adventure in LostWinds 2: Winter of the Melodias - sequel to the award-winning ‘LostWinds’.

name: Day of Infamy
short_description: Experience close-quarters battles in iconic WWII settings. Defend the line, storm the beach, torch the enemy, or use a radio to call in fire support. Day of Infamy is a teamwork-oriented shooter that will keep you on your toes and coming back for more with its diverse game modes and authentic arsenal.

name: The Next Door
short_description: Who looks out dreams? Who looks inside awakens?

name: Maria the Witch
short_description: Zaki&Mia stole all the mails and spread them all over the worlds ! Help Maria to bring them back to their owners !

name: Cat on a Diet
short_description: Swipe and prod to claw away at wooden blocks, unscrew bolts, control powerful magnets and explode highly volatile uranium – anything to reach those cookies!

name: Drift (Over) Drive
short_description: In DoD you take the role of a driver passionate about drifting, driving your car around the world on all kinds of environments and weather conditions, while taking on different challenges and avoiding all kinds of obstacles and hazards.

name: LYDIA: SWEET DREAMS
short_description: LYDIA: SWEET DREAMS is a fast paced, intense reflex game, which challenges players to survive and defeat waves of enemies in its vibrantly colorful world.

name: Brine
short_description: Stranded at an Island, the Vessel is broked, do whatever it takes to survive.

name: Bad Caterpillar
short_description: Bad Caterpillars and their swarms of insect hordes are invading. Get to your ship, man the lasers, and save the galaxy from caterpillars, scorpions, spiders, and a slew of other ill-tempered giant killer insects.

name: XCavalypse
short_description: Months after a zombie apocalypse, a displaced group of survivors have come to the task to take back the city in an unconventional way, not with machetes and shotguns, but with a fleet of excavators!

name: Blast Brawl 2
short_description: Fast-paced combat where any hit means DEATH! Deadly enemies and bosses to test your mettle! Champions with unique abilities and play styles!

name: Spectrubes
short_description: A new addictive puzzle game from the creators of Big Journey to Home, inspired both by the eighties and the modern games – we present Spectrubes!

name: Sparkle ZERO
short_description: Many organisms fight for resources and the opportunity to evolve. Be one of them, start from ZERO and become the best, the biggest and the most efficient of them all. Become the ultimate sparkle.

name: RePete
short_description: RePete is a pixel art puzzle platformer about time travel and self-cooperation. You play as Pete, a special guy that can loop back in time to help his past self solve problems, collect gems, and reach new heights.

name: Share
short_description: In the backyard of the civilization, left by destiny without any hope, you'll find this house on the hill. It will become your shelter and give you everything you need. But then, the owners of the hill will come. And you will pay for this shelter.

name: Mr Nibbles Forever
short_description: Endless runner, platformy goodness wrapped in the cutest package! Everyone's favourite hamsternaut is back! Escape the cage, avoid spiders, collect nibbles and rocket to the moon!

name: X-17
short_description: FPS/3rd Person Genre Shooter. Fight your way through an Alien Invasion not only on earth but on other planets.

name: Red Risk
short_description: Volunteers fight in a bloody contest for freedom and money. Play as one of three volunteers armed with their favorite weapons, survive waves of enemies and bosses. Red Risk will put you into a bloody tournament, will you survive?

name: Fibbage XL
short_description: NOTE: This game first appeared in The Jackbox Party Pack. It’s Fibbage XL – The Hilarious Bluffing Party Game in standalone form! Fool your friends with your lies, avoid theirs, and find the (usually outrageous) truth. “The mayor of Rabbit Hash, Kentucky is a ____.” Baby? Rabbit? Ham sandwich? Go!

name: Virtual Rogue
short_description: Virtual Rogue is a top-down action roguelike shooter set in a computer controlled by a cruel and merciless User. You play as a text document file named “Note” who, after being accidentally created by the User, is thrown into the Recycle Bin.

name: So Long Earth
short_description: So Long Earth is an action puzzle platformer designed to tell the story of Dominique Fayar, a french mafia member who found refuge in space after Earth's destruction.

name: Night light
short_description: Welcome In the destroyed world of the "Night Light", a polluted world has been changed by toxic bombs. Most of the people in the world have been infected by the Virus B1N3 and are mutated to Zombies. And you're on your own. Search food and other utensils. build to protect a Basic you in front of the Zombies.

name: Mystica: The Ninth Society
short_description: Explore unique locations, clear dark dungeons, slay powerful creatures, and uncover a world enriched with a fascinating lore and history. Go alone or party up for a more enjoyable experience. The story is yours to write in this open world, massively multilayer adventure.

name: WOLFLAME
short_description: Brought to you by the makers of GIGANTIC ARMY, Supercharged Robot VULKAISER, and SATAZIUS, WOLFLAME is a return to the form of glorious 2D vertical vertical shooters like Raiden, Raptor, and Twin Cobra.

name: Last Dream: World Unknown
short_description: Last Dream: World Unknown incorporates the best features of classic RPGs: replayability and complete immersion into a vast world, rich with detail.

name: AsteroidsHD
short_description: Engage in space-warfare with your friends and foes! Dodge and destroy asteroids while trying to stay alive in multiplayer! Replay value is endless with massive combinations of in-game ship upgrades, modifications, and customization. Destroy Asteroids and Aliens to gain the edge!

name: Hybrids Arena
short_description: Pick 2 animals from a giant list, and the game will use an algorithm to morph them together! Each hybrid has its own unique stats and perks, and you test them against your friends in a natural-selection kind of way. There are millions of possibilities.

name: Job Simulator
short_description: In a world where robots have replaced all human jobs, step into the "Job Simulator" to learn what it was like 'to job'.

name: Nefarious
short_description: Play as the villain in Nefarious! An action platformer where you globe hop between several kingdoms kidnapping princesses who alter gameplay in unique ways. Then thwart various heroes in reverse boss fights, recreated iconic battles where you control the boss.

name: Logic Missile
short_description: Logic Missile is an action puzzle based platformer where you and the missile must reach the central core. Launch the missile and setup the level properly so that you and the missile can exit the level. This game is extremely hard keep that in mind!

name: Bitardia Cards: Memes of 2ch
short_description: Card games and entered the world of Bitardia. Anons full of excitement and ready to destroy anyone who will sit down with them at the table!

name: GIBZ
short_description: Shoot, slice and surf on zombies by yourself or with friends. Fight overwhelming amounts of zombies and other monsters summoned by an evil wizard (ooOooOOOo spooky) in an early 1900s London.

name: IS Defense
short_description: „IS Defense” is a game set in politically-fictional 2020 – where the expansion of ISIS went out of hand. The player takes the role of NATO’s stationary machine-gun operator, deployed to defend the shores of Europe.

name: Escape: Close Call
short_description: Escape: Close Call is an adrenaline pumping driving game which rewards near crashes with style points, encouraging risk and thrill seeking. Escape enemy vehicles increasing in difficulty while completing missions, maneuvering through the landscape, and earning coins to upgrade your vehicle with weapons.

name: Maneki's Curse
short_description: In the realm of mortals, it is Gojun who reigns after killing the former god of war, Maneki. Now Maneki's soul is trapped in the Underworld--a rich labyrinth from which no soul can escape. But the former god of war's soul is unlike any other, and his vengeance has had a millennium to burn.

name: Hidden Object 6-in-1 bundle
short_description: Play six incredible hidden-object games full of mystery and unpredictable twists!

name: Bizarre Earthquake
short_description: Bizarre Earthquake is a third-person point & click adventure game. The story is about a seismologist and her assistant who try to uncover the mysteries behind a bizarre earthquake they encounter.

name: Bacteria
short_description: 'Bacteria' - A relaxing puzzle game based on the rules of the cellular automaton ‘Life’ devised by John Horton Conway in 1970.

name: Caravanserail
short_description: Caravanserail is an arcade-ish trading game. Buy, set a price, and sell. It sounds simple but it'll take you some skill to set the right price according to the market tendencies...

name: Little Walker
short_description: Journey your way high and low, far and wide, just for the heck of it. Meet weirdos along the way. Explode things. Explode them good. It's a super quirky semi-retro platform-adventure.

name: Overcooked
short_description: Overcooked is a chaotic couch co-op cooking game for one to four players. Working as a team, you and your fellow chefs must prepare, cook and serve up a variety of tasty orders before the baying customers storm out in a huff.

name: Square's Route
short_description: Square’s Route is the addictive new game of path finding and weed whacking.

name: Terror Lab
short_description: You have just awoken without knowing who or where you are. You can't remember anything but it is clear you are not alone.

name: Minimal
short_description: Unique logic game with simple controls and addictive gameplay. There is no story, no clutter - everything is simple, minimalistic. Whole game tries to keep you focused on one simple goal, which is solving current puzzle.

name: Mind Games
short_description: Mind games is a great set of extremely hard brain twisting puzzles! Warning: this game is for smarties! Only one out of ten people can solve the first puzzle!

name: Origin Of Destiny: Crimson Awakening
short_description: Sophie and Mike have been separated by an evil group and must now try and rejoin forces before taking on a great evil. But something more sinister is happening and may change the world forever!

name: Dead End Road
short_description: Dead End Road is an atmospheric driving game, with a low-fi aesthetic and procedurally generated elements. Complete your journey to seek the assistance of the old witch at Dead End Road; Get there before daybreak and perhaps, just perhaps, you can escape this nightmare.

name: Draw Rider
short_description: Draw Rider - a classic racing game, made in 2D. Your goal is to get to the finish line within a certain time. In the game you will find a huge variety of levels, the passage of which will open various options for character customization.

name: Rebirth of Island
short_description: Survive, adapt, and research in the New World, with its rules, dwellers, and their laws. Head the colonization of these locations and ensure the independence and security of your population.

name: Rabiez: Epidemic
short_description: Real-time combat in the zombie apocalypse! Guide your survivors through hordes of the infected to escape the epicentre of infection!

name: Elements II: Hearts of Light
short_description: The highly-anticipated sequel to Elements: Soul of Fire, here at last! A mysterious little girl. An insidious plot to resurrect a great evil. The legend of a faint and fading hope. And a band of young heroes desperate for answers.

name: GEO Master
short_description: GEO Master is a 3D geography game. This game has different learning modes. You have the opportunity to explore the globe, you can test your knowledge and then compare your score obtained during timed games on the whole planet or on the continent of your choice ! Learn, remember and enter friendly competitions !

name: Pinball HD Collection
short_description: Pinball HD Collection - This game will change your idea of Pinball. Each table - Wild West, The Deep, Jungle Style, Pirates, Red Planet, Snow, Da Vinci, Arcade, Tanks, Halloween and others - are masterpieces. You'll be stunned with the level of realism.

name: Lionessy Story
short_description: «Lionessy story» is a visual novel that tells a story of a lion cub living out his carefree days in a lion pride reigning over the great African savannah. But life in the wilderness is never easy, and after a terrible tragedy yanks him out of his pampered lifestyle, the young cub has to face the dangers of the real world where anything...

name: VirZOOM Arcade
short_description: VirZOOM Arcade is a collection of virtual reality sports for the VirZOOM bike controller. Your pedaling and leaning propel you through race tracks, battle grounds, and soaring skies. Play online live or against ghost players.

name: Puzzle Box
short_description: Puzzle Box is painting with creative gameplay! Create fantastic pixel art images, by dropping your colour paint blocks in the correct place across the levels.

name: Imhotep, Pyramid Builder
short_description: Do you like watching others do all the work?Cats do!In this unique game (AVX req'd) you plan, direct and oversee the construction of a Pyramid in Ancient Egypt.Organize agriculture, plan the village, direct the building and watch thousands of workers on screen, in real time.Build it, stone by stone!

name: Infinity Saga
short_description: You play as Tetra, a teenage boy living his days out as an college student. Tetra meets Autumn; a girl he first met on a social networking site and has grown fond of. Tetra is invited over to Autumn's house for the first time for a date night. However, the two find out that they are out of Autumn's favorite chips.

name: Sixtieth Kilometer
short_description: You're going to work by train, but strange things happens on the way: the train stops, the pink fog appears outside and the man who came off the train immediately dies. The main characters turned out to be locked in the train without any clues about what's happening...

name: Infinity Wings - Scout & Grunt
short_description: Infinity Wings - Scout & Grunt Take control of your chosen fighter (either Scout or Grunt) in this side scrolling shooter.

name: Semispheres
short_description: Semispheres is a meditative parallel puzzle game that places dual realities at the heart of its challenge. Its unique single-player split-screen mechanic challenges your brain by putting you in control of two characters at the same time.

name: Torgar's Quest
short_description: Travel into the Deepgold Mine to hunt for shards of the Mastery Crystal in this roguelike dungeon crawl, following the adventures of Torgar Splitbeard.

name: Planet in the Shadows
short_description: Inspired by the dungeon crawler genre, this short game blends traditional spelunking with base building mechanics. The player is stranded on a hostile planet, urged to build a base and defend it against the awfully aggressive forces of the hostile environment.

name: ASMR Universe
short_description: Autonomous sensory meridian response (ASMR) is defined as pleasurable tingling sensations in the head, scalp, back, or anywhere in the body in response to visual, auditory, tactile, olfactory, or cognitive stimuli.

name: Ball King Jam
short_description: Get ready for a high-energy twist on classic basketball! With wild power-ups, and unique mechanics, every match feels like an over-the-top arcade showdown. Dive into exciting game modes and brace yourself for absolute chaos - because sometimes, there’s more than one ball in play!

name: Overload
short_description: A new six-degree-of-freedom shooter with intuitive controls, amazing lighting and graphics. From the creators of Descent, Overload is the best zero-gravity robot-blasting combat ever.

name: Colony 42™
short_description: Alone, lost and forgotten. You tread the dusty ruins of a deserted, city-sized Nuclear Bunker in search of freedom...

name: Spells 'n' Stuff
short_description: Spells 'n' stuff is a magic arena FPS built exclusively for VR. Battle your opponents with spells fired from your trusty wand that never leaves your side. Propel yourself into battle with your wands flying ability, or POOF yourself around fast with magic potions!

name: Axes and Acres
short_description: Axes and Acres is a deep and engaging single-player strategy game designed to create exciting decisions every turn. The rules are easy to learn, but every turn can be played out in many different ways in order to farm, build and survive.

name: About Elise
short_description: Dive into this first person puzzle adventure and become Owen Scott to rescue your daughter Elise, who has been kidnapped by the organisation known as Kiminster Labs. By doing it, you will discover the big piece of the puzzle that is About Elise as a whole.

name: I, Hope
short_description: I, Hope is a beautiful coming of age adventure story about a young girl named Hope, whose town has been taken over by Cancer.

name: The Divergent Series: Allegiant VR
short_description: Venture into the world of The Divergent Series: Allegiant in this immersive 360° 3D VR experience featuring an all-star cast from the feature film

name: Phlyndir
short_description: Phlyndir is a hack-and-slash RPG set in the world of Phlyndir. You play as Calheit, an ordinary boy gifted with extra-ordinary talent tasked by the king to help an elite team save the world from an ancient evil.

name: Steno Arcade
short_description: Steno Arcade is a suite of arcade games designed to teach and drill steno fundamentals in an immersive, addictive, responsive, and interactive way.

name: The Bottom of the Well
short_description: Play as Alice who has just had an unsettingly life-like dream about the end of the world, and is retelling it to her friend. A single play-through might take as little as 20 minutes, but experiencing all the possible paths Alice can take through the ruins of her city will take you many hours.

name: Jesus Christ RPG Trilogy
short_description: A Role-Playing Game where you can play as Jesus Christ and the Apostles in turn-based battles

name: Rock Paper Scissors Champion
short_description: In this game, you must regain your Rock Paper Scissors Crown by defeating the three members of the Triple R Gang: Rocky, Randy and Ripley. They all have their own unique play styles. When you throw three identical moves in a row you unleash a combo!

name: Cellar
short_description: Short arcade game with handcrafted pixel art graphics. You play as Lily who traverses the dark corners of the basement under her house in search of her lost teddy bear. Inspired by some of the greatest fears from our childhood.

name: YEARN Tyrant's Conquest
short_description: Take control of tyrants in this party strategy game. Plan, flank and witness the fun chaos that is simultaneous turn based combat!

name: Zombie Parking
short_description: Computer indie-game in the genre of third-person shooter and survival horror.

name: Nanobots
short_description: Nanobots is a fast-paced casual game about destroying self-replicating nanotechnology robots. You have to reduce the standing population to zero in order to advance to the next level, as even one overlooked Nanobot can replicate itself and bring you back to square one in a matter of seconds.

name: ENGAGE
short_description: ENGAGE is a pioneering platform offering immersive virtual reality, mixed reality and metaverse solutions for enterprises and educational institutions.

name: Istrolid
short_description: In Istrolid you design your own unique spaceships from a large number of parts to fit your strategy and play style. With no set units or factions you are free to create a fleet where each ship has its own balanced strengths and weaknesses, from basic fighters and bombers to hulking battleships and speedy destroyers.

name: PataNoir
short_description: The Baron's daughter is missing, and you are the man to find her. No problem. With your inexhaustible arsenal of hard-boiled similes, there is nothing you can't handle.

name: Land it Rocket
short_description: Take control of a rocket and master the art of landing! Enjoy 28 handcrafted levels, two modes, and full controller support.

name: Gnomes Garden 2
short_description: Gnomes Garden 2 – the sequel to an exciting fantasy strategy game. Restore the magical gardens and defeat the troll queen!

name: Meld
short_description: Meld is a mind-bending puzzle game featuring 200+ levels and a build-in editor so you can create your own and play levels made by others!

name: Calcu-Late
short_description: Calcu-Late is a story about a boy named James that needs to participate in a godly Olympics tournament as a representative for the goddess of mathematics, Seshat. The tournament will grant the participant a wish that they stated before the tournament starts.

name: Verdict Guilty - 유죄 평결
short_description: Verdict Guilty is a 90's arcade-style fighting game with a cops vs robbers theme.

name: A grande bagunça espacial - The big space mess
short_description: Hello everyone! Welcome to the craziest adventure of your lives! The fearless Waldisglédson will face creatures from space and find allies on his journey!

name: Stormworm+
short_description: Stormworm+ is a Fast-Paced Reflex-Driven Arcade Game backed with colorful visuals and an original soundtrack! Inspired by the arcade games of old, collect, grow and aim for the top spot on the leaderboards!

name: A Little Lily Princess
short_description: Newly arrived at a boarding school in Victorian England, Sara Crewe uses her love of books and storytelling to build new relationships. But what happens to a fairy-tale princess when she loses everything?

name: Planar Conquest
short_description: Become an all-powerful Sorcerer Lord and lead one of 8 different races to the ultimate victory. Explore multiple planes of existence, raid dungeons, and conquer cities. Expand your armies, cast mighty spells, and summon godly creatures to do your bidding. Fight the enemies in D20 OGL battles.

name: Spunk and Moxie
short_description: Help Spunk and Moxie escape in this classic-style platformer with a fresh new twist; one-button input gives the player full control over sliding, jumping, and bouncing through 30 unique levels across 3 industrial themes: The Warehouse, Factory, and Laboratory.

name: Dino Eggs: Rebirth
short_description: DINO EGGS: REBIRTH is a celebration and expansion of the best-selling 1983 home computer game DINO EGGS (Apple ][, Commodore 64, IBM) -- in which Time Master Tim travels to prehistoric times to rescue the dinosaurs from extinction.

name: Grid Masters
short_description: Fight for victory in a 1v1 or 2v2 grid-based deathmatch in Grid Masters. Represent your favorite faction as one of five characters (with more to come), each with their own unique abilities. Toss massive bombs, rocket punch, or send explosive robot minions to take your enemies down!

name: Serafina's Crown
short_description: Serafina’s Crown is a visual novel with elements of fantasy, adventure and romance. You play as Odell Perin, the newly-appointed regent of Darzia as she tries to solve the murder of the queen and a host of other domestic and international crises.

name: Backstreets of the Mind
short_description: Sometimes we think that if we could change something from our past, our whole life would turn out differently.

name: Mini's Magic World
short_description: Mini's Magic World is an action platformer with a diverse cast of characters and levels to explore. Fight bosses, find hidden treasures, follow the rhythm of music, chase or be chased.

name: SPLIT BULLET
short_description: SPLIT BULLET is a game all about 'splitting up' a massive crowd of enemies—yes, those polygons—crawling towards you. Don't let 'em get you and survive as long as you can, by using your instincts and weapons.

name: Commands & Colors: The Great War
short_description: The Great War allow players to portray important engagements throughout WWI history. The battles focus on the historical deployment of forces and important terrain features of trench fighting in scale with the game system.

name: Hush Hush - Unlimited Survival Horror
short_description: Hush Hush is a scare jumper. You run and something tries to scare you.

name: The Crow's Eye
short_description: In an abandoned medical university, test your intellectual might as you unravel a 20-year-old mystery in this depraved first-person puzzle adventure, doing what it takes to escape your fate as a macabre scientist's human experiment. The ends justify the means in The Crow’s Eye.

name: Rush for gold: California
short_description: Feel the legendary 'Gold Fever' in sunny California!

name: Grand Pigeon's Duty
short_description: Pigeons organized resistance, which aims to attract people's attention to the problem of hunger and restore bakery companies for their bait.

name: There's Poop In My Soup
short_description: Created by solo developer Nikola Kostic - Have you ever wanted to poop on people but were too shy to just go for it? There's poop in my soup lets you do just that, poop in soups, poop on people, poop on poodles, poop anywhere you please, from the streets of New York to Paris to Beijing.

name: Chicken Invaders 2
short_description: Just when you thought it was safe to eat chicken again, the chickens have returned with an organized invasion to take over the entire solar system! Journey to each planet and fight your way through to save the world (again)!

name: Space Ranger ASK
short_description: Space Ranger ASK is a classic arcade shoot'em up game, featuring hundreds of levels with asteroid blasting, spacemen rescues, UFO destruction, astroid mining and Boss fights! The game includes a fully featured Mission Editor, so you can create and share your own missions, and play those created by other gamers.

name: Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom
short_description: A legendary series returns with a grand new adventure! Enjoy a colorful action-adventure game made alongside Ryuichi Nishizawa, creator of the original Wonder Boy in Monster World series.

name: Bloody Zombies
short_description: Fight across the ruins of London using carefully refined Free-Form Combat, taking down a terrifying variety of mutated zombies with an expanding special move-set. Created for 1-4 players, for online and offline play, Bloody Zombies is also enhanced with HTC Vive and Oculus Rift.

name: SAMOLIOTIK
short_description: SAMOLIOTIK is a stylish shoot-em-up with different enemies, bosses, colour palettes, power-ups, set in different eras. In this game you will fight Adolf Gutler,The Illuminati, and other creatures.

name: Fatal Fight
short_description: The legendary “two click” fighting technique returns! Get ready for even more explosive martial action with lavish, detailed graphics, stunning special effects, diverse enemies and environments.

name: Ariel
short_description: Intense survival experience based on a Sci-Fi, space terror script. Unravel the story of Ferdinand Ludec as he attempts to escape his fortune. Partially procedural world along with different endings to the story. Hunger, avoiding insanity and extreme weather will only be some of the threats to face.

name: REDCON
short_description: Command your own fortress in FTL-like real-time battles! Crush the enemy fortress with unrelenting bombardment or seize it with carefully executed invasion.

name: Ahnayro: The Dream World
short_description: Intense Puzzles Game - Explore the twisted and troubling world of Ahnayro, where your dreams are haunted by mysterious figures.

name: Tenrow
short_description: Tenrow is a logic puzzle game. Includes 50 levels.

name: Legend of Moros
short_description: Legend of Moros is a retro-style RPG that focuses on the quest of Roland and his friends as they try to return to their homeland. But while they have a straightforward goal, adventures don't often end up that way...

name: Jacob
short_description: Jacob: an evidence-based puzzle

name: Attack on Titan / A.O.T. Wings of Freedom
short_description: An international hit anime "Attack on Titan" has come to Steam®! Battle is joined between the man-eating Titans and Eren and his companions. Experience the illusion of being in the anime, and controlling the flow of the story. The story from the anime, with a few original twists, is yours to experience!

name: Daughter of Shadows: An SCP Breach Event
short_description: The player assumes the role of a dangerous and powerful girl known as SCP-029. After a facility wide power outage occurs, numerous SCPs breach containment and proceed to wreak havoc throughout the facility. SCP-029 must use her mind-controlling powers to survive and find a way to escape from the facility.

name: ! That Bastard Is Trying To Steal Our Gold !
short_description: Steal gold from the Lerpikon's dungeons! Get rich!

name: Book of Demons
short_description: Book of Demons is a Hack & Slash in which YOU decide the length of quests. Wield magic cards instead of weapons and slay the armies of darkness in the dungeons below the Old Cathedral. Save the terror-stricken Paperverse from the clutches of the Archdemon himself!

name: DAMAGE CONTROL
short_description: Control your squad of engineers and maintain your ship, and it's crew, until it reaches it's destination. Careful planning and timing will be required to tackle the dangers of deep space. Only your team stands between your sturdy ship and and certain doom. Take command!

name: Stealth Labyrinth
short_description: Stealth Labyrinth is a first-person shooter game based on stealth mechanics. In a sci-fi labyrinth, the player must proceed, room after room, finding the right way until the end, before the time is out and everything explodes and avoiding all guard robot.

name: Yon Paradox
short_description: Yon Paradox ​is a survival puzzle game where the hardest puzzle is yourself. Set in a cyber dimension, an antimatter-powered time machine broke, causing periodical time rewinds. You will have to solve riddles to repair the time machine, while avoiding your past alter-egos to not create paradoxes.

name: Insane Decay of Mind: The Labyrinth
short_description: Insane Decay of Mind: The Labyrinth is a first person horror game. You play the role of Katherine, a young girl lost in the eerie hallways of a building she believes to be her school.

name: Amigdala
short_description: Gherman,a middle-aged man who has abandoned all to find what lies behind the "Philadelphia experiment".11 years after the experiment,Gherman found a document that marked the coordinates of the project's military establishment.Certainly he didn't expect to find so much...

name: Capitalism Plus
short_description: Play the strategy game of money, power and wealth.

name: Seven Kingdoms: Ancient Adversaries
short_description: Conquer the world and build your empire! Lead one civilization to glory through sophisticated trade, diplomacy, espionage and conquest.

name: Campgrounds: The Endorus Expedition Collector's Edition
short_description: Help Addie lead an expedition!

name: BOOR
short_description: BOOR is a 2D puzzle-platformer game, where you play as a girl with the ability to multiply herself, stranded on Eden, a beautiful but strange world, full of challenging puzzles with platforming elements and a refreshing gameplay.

name: MAZE LORD
short_description: Become the part of the legend and save the stolen princess!

name: Overload Playable Teaser 3.0
short_description: A playable demo of the game Overload, a new six-degree-of-freedom shooter from the creators of Descent. Version 3.0 is from April 2018.

name: Bullet Force
short_description: Bullet Force is a multiplayer first-person shooter featuring weapon customization, satisfying gunplay, 20-player servers, multiple gamemodes, and more. Bullet Force also features a singleplayer mode with bots.

name: Aegis of Earth: Protonovus Assault
short_description: Aegis of Earth: Protonovus Assault is a frenetic and explosive new spin on action strategy gaming. Plan out and build up your defenses as hordes of hulking monstrosities bombard your heavily fortified city in an attempt to wipe you off the Earth for good!

name: Assault on Arnhem
short_description: Assault on Arnhem is an operational level wargame for between one and four players, based on the famous Operation Market Garden campaign in September 1944.

name: The Lab
short_description: Welcome to The Lab, a compilation of Valve’s room-scale VR experiments set in a pocket universe within Aperture Science. Fix a robot, defend a castle, adopt a mechanical dog, and more. Still not sold? It’s free!

name: Creepy Castle
short_description: A conspiracy is welling deep within the stone walls of an ancient castle.The keep’s master is leading its denizens to construct a revolutionary new device made to move the world forward onto a new path of evolution.

name: Ace of Seafood
short_description: In the seas of the distant future, humans have all but disappeared. In your current, newly-awakened state, you are no more than a piece of seafood. However, you have been blessed with the talent for leading your allies into battle. Do whatever it takes to become the Ace of Seafood.

name: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades
short_description: Do you like hot dogs? How about horseshoes? Hand grenades? (everyone likes hand grenades) Anyway, we've got all that, and guns. SO MANY GUNS. So if you like ordnance, meat, and far too many groan-worthy puns, this is the VR sandbox game for you.

name: Roadworks Simulator
short_description: You are responsible for the streets and roads in your city. With so many people in a city, there is always the need for new living space, which has to be opened up with roads.

name: Safety Driving Simulator: Car
short_description: Safety Driving Simulator: Car is a driving simulator engaging and enjoyable that teaches the basics of driving immersing the player in a detailed and realistic urban environment.

name: Safety Driving Simulator: Motorbike
short_description: Safety Driving Simulator: Motorbike is a driving simulator engaging and enjoyable that teaches the basics of driving immersing the player in a detailed and realistic urban environment.

name: Woeful Woebots
short_description: Your robot creations have turned against you! As their master you have to destroy every single one of them before they do something strikingly similar to you! Grab your guns from your super high-tech hips and blast your way through their filthy electronic meat!

name: Polyology
short_description: A colourful block pushing puzzle game with unique mechanics, a plethora of lovingly crafted levels and delightful soundtrack.

name: Table Top Racing: World Tour
short_description: ★★★ PINT-SIZED POWERED-UP RACING ★★★ Get behind the wheel of 12 ultra-cool, fully tune-able miniaturized racing cars and take on 20 race tracks and some devious opponents through a comprehensive 'Championship Mode' and a multitude of 'Special Events'.

name: The Spatials: Galactology
short_description: The Spatials are back with Galactology! Design, build and protect your colony station from the many enemies you will make while exploring the galaxy and exploding their homeworlds.

name: Mind Unleashed
short_description: Mind Unleashed is a first person Sci Fi shooter game specifically designed for Virtual Reality. You are a robot that is trying hard to survive in a secret military base, inside a rocky mountain. Rocks and futuristic stuff will surround you in this epic challenge where you'll need to survive as long as possible, fighting hordes of robotic...

name: GraveRun
short_description: GraveRun is a hurricane pixel Run’n’Gun, where you can kill zombies! Hundreds of zombies, thouthands of zombies! We have many different zombies - you can kill them all at once or kill most ugly ones first! Choose a suitable gun and upgrade it right in the battle - there's no "enough" for your firepower!

name: Cube Land Arena
short_description: The kingdom of Cubia call for your help, come to this vast kingdom where you will face strong enemies and hard challenges, you are the chosen to defend the cristals of life and finally bring peace to reign of Cubia.

name: Andarilho
short_description: You are a guy with a backpack, just try to stay alive!

name: Danmaku Unlimited 3
short_description: Take to the skies once again as the last defender of humanity against overwhelming odds! Lovingly built to be enjoyed by newcomers and genre veterans alike, Danmaku Unlimited 3 is a perfect medley of the best aspects of classic bullet hell shooters wrapped up in a modern and approachable package.

name: Ember Kaboom
short_description: Ember's a fox who loves adventure. Run, jump, and ride through 30+ colorful, fast-paced obstacle courses in a quest to get your missing soul back!

name: Kittypocalypse
short_description: Kittypocalypse is an in-depth, strategic tower defense game built exclusively for VR. Across a diverse range of environments, defeat the hordes of evil alien kitties and salvage what's left of your home planet

name: Battle Chasers: Nightwar
short_description: Battle Chasers: Nightwar is an RPG inspired by the classic console greats, featuring deep dungeon diving, turn-based combat presented in a classic JRPG format, and a rich story driven by exploration of the world.

name: Wincars Racer
short_description: An Arcade Online Racer With A Strategy Twist. Instant racing fun in the vein of arcade classics with modernized mechanics and special skills to use intelligently. No random power-ups mess!

name: Giant Cop: Justice Above All
short_description: Giant Missions, Giant Fun in pint sized Micro City.  You are the Giant Cop.  Use your size to your advantage to explore the open world, find hidden interactive objects and tower over the city uncovering a criminal plot that threatens Micro City.

name: Cubikolor
short_description: Armed only with your logic and your Kube, move through the 150 levels outwitting the traps in the System, an evil, scheming entity, to confront the machine and pass the test!

name: Khan: Absolute Power
short_description: The epic based classic online game Khan takes on where Genghis Khan reached the end of his expedition. The game takes place at small kingdom of Eurasia where Genghis Khan's brutal force was never able to conquer. You will re-visit the history and prepare the battles against the greatest conquer of history.

name: Drawn®: Dark Flight™ Collector's Edition
short_description: Help Iris light the beacons!

name: Candlelight
short_description: A world cast into darkness… but there is hope. After a mysterious entity extinguishes all the candles in the land, a lone surviving candle sets out on a most important adventure to bring light back to the land.

name: Rocket Shooter
short_description: Rocket Shooter - this team game first-person shooter. The main feature is a move with super speed and super jumps!

name: A Fold Apart
short_description: A puzzle game that explores the emotional rollercoaster of a long-distance relationship — in a world of folding paper! Flip, fold, unfold and rotate paper puzzles to help a couple navigate the complexities of living apart.

name: Gold Mining Simulator
short_description: Become a gold miner. Work hard, dig deep, explore the world, and you’ll become the wealthiest person in Alaska. Use a variety of specialist machines to find as much gold as you can.

name: Tropical Fish Shop 2
short_description: A diverse gameplay combines several genres of “Match 3”, “Hidden object”, “Sim”, and various mini-games.

name: Fenrisulfr Puzzle
short_description: Simple puzzle, brisk music, soft illustrations.

name: Meridian: Squad 22
short_description: Meridian: Squad 22 is a single-player science-fiction real-time strategy game with a focus on base building and advanced tactics. Every single choice, every tactical decision you make, shapes the outcome of your story.

name: Hollywood Hills Mansion
short_description: The Hollywood Hills Mansion is the perfect space to unwind and escape. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Los Angeles skyline and watch content from Facade TV (or your own side-loaded content) on our Entertainment On Demand system. Can be experienced with or without a VR headset!

name: Snakes on an Extradimensional Plane
short_description: Abstract HTC Vive game where you help adventurous space mice with tiny little jetpack escape the glowing snakes! Collect powerups for points and compete on the leaderboards!

name: Demetrios - The BIG Cynical Adventure
short_description: The Journey of an Idiot. 8 to 12 hours of fun!

name: ¡Zombies! : Faulty Towers
short_description: ¡Zombies! put you in the middle of the action as you try to escape the unstable zombie world. The only problem is, the zombies are everywhere, they appear to be very hungry and very still. There is a limited amount of time within which the player can escape. The price of admission is Zombie's heads.

name: CounterAttack: Uprising
short_description: CounterAttack: Uprising is a side scrolling space shooter (shmup). Team up or fight solo, 1 - 4 player local or up to 8 players online coop, unlock upgrades, use powerful ultimate abilities, enhance your ship the way you want, and save the Earth from annihilation.

name: Brute
short_description: Brute is a challenging arcade shooter with a vibrant, minimalist aesthetic. It's a game about planning, timing and discovery featuring an atmospheric soundtrack and sounds made from analog synthesizers.

name: C14 Dating
short_description: C-14 Dating is an otome dating sim that combines archaeology, friendships and love.

name: Whirligig Media Player
short_description: A versatile VR and desktop media player for watching 2D, 3D, and 360° videos with customizable playback, projection modes, and full stereoscopic support.

name: Trucker
short_description: Drive big trucks faster than ordinary cars, and be careful, coz you are not alone on the road.

name: War Birds: WW2 Air strike 1942
short_description: War Birds is a 2.5D World War 2 air combat game, with impressive 3D warplanes and beautiful 2D environments.

name: Secrets of Deep Earth Shrine
short_description: Dig your own path in this quirky strategy platformer. Use traps to defeat monsters, blow apart your environment, and collect treasure!

name: Highway Blossoms
short_description: A yuri visual novel about Amber, a girl who's trying her best to be alone on the road, until she stumbles upon a young hitchhiker and the journal of a prospector from long ago. Fully voiced in English.

name: Trillion: God of Destruction
short_description: An ancient god consumes your world. Now you must train and build relationships with each of your Overlords in this challenging raising sim/roguelike/SRPG hybrid. How many Overlords will you sacrifice to defeat an enemy with a trillion hit points?

name: Forging Glory
short_description: Forging Glory is a physics-based looter brawler with limitless player customization; letting you experience the glory of brutal gladiatorial combat in a futuristic, virtual world.

name: End Of The Mine
short_description: You are a miner on a distant planet excavating valuable resources. After a night of relaxing with your fellow miners, you awake to find them gone and the colony you call home deserted. With only your companion Camm-E to help, you must venture into the mines in search of your friends and answers.

name: Out of Ammo
short_description: Out of Ammo is an intense VR Tower Defense / FPS hybrid strategy game that will have you constructing defenses, calling in artillery, issuing orders, and taking direct control of your soldiers in order to survive a relentless enemy onslaught.

name: Nighttime Terror VR: Dessert Defender
short_description: Nighttime Terror: Dessert Defender is an expanded version of the award winning VR game. Fight your way through six unique levels and defend your desserts!

name: Catch a Falling Star
short_description: Catch a Falling Star is a casual and relaxing game where the aim is to catch falling stars and score points. A fun and relaxing game with beautiful graphics and soothing music - perfect for when you want to play something, but don't want to think too much.

name: WizardCraft
short_description: WizardCraft is a retro style RTS game featuring a multitude of game modes, including; missions, skirmish and battle modes as well as a fully-fledged editor allowing you to create your own maps.

name: Thorne - Death Merchants
short_description: Play as an infamous mercenary known as "The Crow" in a decayed and corrupt world, find your way out of chains and get paid for your contract, in this enthralling Action-RPG with high production values.

name: qrth-phyl
short_description: Arcade documentary of maze/dot/snake mechanic within changing dimensions, axis locks and the corruption of the system. Collect, grow, avoid your past, find new space, wake up…

name: Return Home
short_description: Return Home is an abstract horizontal shooter with dynamic levels and metaphorical explosions. The game is randomised and altered according to how well you play.

name: EEP Train Simulator Mission
short_description: Are you ready for a job in the railways industrie?EEP TS Mission is a true innovation. For the first time in the history of EEP, the world's most successful railway simulation , you have the opportunity to take on complex tasks in the railway industrie inmidst realistic scenarios.And there's plenty of work to do.

name: The Secret of Pineview Forest
short_description: The Secret of Pineview Forest is a free prequel to Pineview Drive - Rising Storm. Behind the abandoned house on Pineview Drive lies ominous Pineview Forest...

name: The Body VR: Journey Inside a Cell
short_description: The Body VR: Journey Inside a Cell is an educational virtual reality experience that takes the user inside the human body.

name: Cranks and Goggles
short_description: Cranks & Goggles is a top down racing game set in the roaring 20s. The game’s engine utilizes real physics in order to mimic the unstable (and quite dangerous) nature of the period’s automobiles.

name: Military Life: Tank Simulator
short_description: Have you ever dreamt of riding a tank? Now you have got the chance to do it. The times when this sort of simulation was highly complex and enormous complicated are over. This game differs completely from the others and captivates with its intuitive and easy to learn gameplay.

name: Caveblazers
short_description: Caveblazers is a challenging and brutal roguelike platformer. Journey into a mysterious cave, fighting orcs and goblins with an abundance of weapons and magical items! Make friends along the way, then watch in despair as they are crushed in to a bloody pulp under a troll's fist.

name: Midvinter
short_description: Midvinter is a cozy little point-and-click game, which invites you to explore Swedish folklore using puzzles and riddles as well as compelling music and voice over. In it, you as a player take on the role of gnome - the guardian of the farm - and get to interact with various dark and fantastical creatures.

name: One Clone Left
short_description: Team up with friends to fight hordes of zombies and mutants that roam post-apocalyptic earth. Need extra lives and allies to help you fight? Just clone yourself and your weapons! Protect your fabricator to become an unstoppable force, able to take on any mutant in your sights.

name: Spellstone
short_description: Spellstone is a fantasy card game with beautiful hand-drawn art and rich lore! Collect hundreds of striking cards to battle through a compelling story and unravel the mystery of the Void.

name: Dawn of the Robot Empire
short_description: Witness first hand the Dawn of the Robot Empire. Can you stop the invading robotic forces from another galaxy? Blast your way to victory in this retro sci-fi shooter. You'll need fast reflexes and an accurate aim to win.

name: Party Saboteurs: After Party
short_description: Party Saboteurs is a local multiplayer espionage party game for up to four players. Each player controls a spy who is trying to blend in an exclusive cocktail party to complete the missions. The catch? At the same time, they are all controlling snipers trying to identify and eliminate each other’s spies.

name: Ian's Eyes
short_description: First days at school are usually tough, but they can be even tougher if you’re helping a blind 8-year-old boy named Ian who doesn't know the terrifying dangers that lurk around in every hallway. You play as North, Ian’s lifelong canine companion. Can you help him escape alive?

name: Damsel
short_description: Cause distress in this challenging fast-paced action platformer. Experience a dark cartoon world come to life as frenetic gameplay meets comic book visuals and storytelling. Dash through beautiful arenas vanquishing vampires, rescuing hostages, disarming bombs, hacking servers and much more.

name: Koihime Enbu
short_description: Originally an arcade fighting game, Koihime Enbu features fast combat, tight controls, clean visuals, and 13 different playable characters!

name: Flowers -Le volume sur printemps-
short_description: Suoh Shirahane, a shy girl with a mysterious past, will begin her first year of high school at Saint Angraecum Academy, where she hopes to find a new beginning. She will navigate friendships and mysteries at her new school, and discovers that love can come in many forms.

name: Rising Islands
short_description: Rising Islands is an adventure game where you’ll have to combine fast-paced action with quick thinking. Jump, shift, grind, dash and wallrun through a fantastic world that is fraying at the edges. New challenges await around every corner.

name: The Cubicle.
short_description: The Cubicle is a short VR experience about your regular everyday job in an office, or is it?

name: UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late
short_description: Dramatic Stylish 2D Fighting Action 「UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late」 now on Steam!

name: Battle Chef Brigade Deluxe
short_description: Battle Chef Brigade pairs combo-based hunting and puzzle-based cooking in a hand drawn, fantasy adventure. Cook your way into the Brigade while subduing Victusia’s destructive monsters. Follow Mina and Thrash in the single-player campaign or challenge your friends in Local Multiplayer and Daily Cook-Offs.

name: The Rebel
short_description: The Rebel is all about having fun and enjoying nice graphics.

name: Realities
short_description: Explore what was out of reach before - travel to mesmerizing real world places and discover their stories!

name: Mad Bullets
short_description: Mad Bullets, the wackiest shooter is here to put your reflexes and laughing muscles to an intensive test. You can forget about boring stories, complicated controls and irritating tutorials, and jump right into a mind blowing, high-speed action.

name: Cube Blast Match
short_description: A casual color blast puzzler with a 3D twist - solve increasingly complex 3D match puzzles. There are also some aliens and explosions involved.

name: Laser Disco Defenders
short_description: A self-inflicted bullet hell that combines retro sci-fi with the sounds and sights of the disco era

name: Insane
short_description: !nsane is a nod to the cult game "Logical" from the good old Amiga days. It's all about balls and twist locks. You have to arrange the balls in the right order to pick the lock. What sounds simple enough quickly turns out to be a uniquely tricky game.

name: Asemblance
short_description: You wake to find yourself trapped inside an experimental machine... A machine built to simulate memories. You no longer recall why you entered, but an AI voice guides you. Trying to escape, you face memories from a past you may not want to remember.

name: The Fifth Expedition
short_description: Info: The game is not in active development anymoreGuide your team of explorers into the treacherous depths of an ancient machine.On a mission to restore the old mechanisms to life and to save your people on the surface, who rely on the age-old construct for food and shelter.

name: Parkitect
short_description: Parkitect is a business simulation game that charges you with the construction and management of theme parks! Bringing back the best of classic theme park games with many new features and content on top. Now supports online co-op with up to 8 players!

name: Frederic: Resurrection of Music Director's Cut
short_description: New version of cult game with new levels and exclusive Steam online multiplayer! Frederic Chopin – a long time deceased classical compositor – returns back from beyond the grave to fight intense musical duels.
