short_description: Fast paced archery game! You are trapped on a small island in the sky, delaying your inevitable death by rocks smashing into your head. - This game is not for the weak! - Be prepared for a thorough workout, where you have to duck, weave and move around a lot!

name: Magician's Gambit
short_description: Chess! Magic! VR! Play this age-old Game of Kings against the best strategic mind in the Kingdom - a master tactician and chess paragon unlike any other. Word is he has never been defeated... Will you rise to the challenge?

name: Phobia
short_description: Horror. Nightmare. Fear. Monsters. Madness. And again ... And again ....

name: The Seasons
short_description: So......What choice will you make?

name: RADtv
short_description: Shoot, eat, throw, slice, feed, hit, catch and more in RADtv, a hot-seat multiplayer VR party game. Get sweaty with your friends as you vie to come top of the leaderboard!

name: Wisdom of War
short_description: Wisdom of War is a real-time strategy game with unique style. Different from general real-time strategy game, the game only needs to operate a hero for various activities. This greatly reduces the demands for hands’ operation speed in traditional real-time strategy game so that players can focus on strategy application.

name: Yesterday
short_description: It's a 3D Puzzle Game talking about the philosophy of love and encounter from female's perspective. All we experienced in countless “yesterday” make us be ourselves today. Beautiful visual performance and intriguing music immerse players in this fantasy world soon, where dreams mix with reality, time and space interweave together.

name: Deadly Escape
short_description: Deadly Escape is a Survival Horror game made with pixel art graphics, inspired by survival horror games of the '90s.

name: Space Panic: Room Escape (VR)
short_description: Space Panic VR (Room Escape) is a VR Escape Room unlike any other you've seen before. Set in the future aboard a space station, the game will challenge players to solve multiple complex puzzles in order to escape.

name: Bullet VR
short_description: The year 2020. You are a real war hero, who has gone through a lot and seen a lot of bad things, but you has not seen anything like that. A huge threat has come to your favorite planet - the Earth.

name: L.A.P.D. 2195
short_description: A modern Multiplayer and Co-Op re-imagining of the classic game "Future Cop L.A.P.D.”, you are a rookie cop in the Mech-Assisted Security and Tactics (M.A.S.T.) unit of the Los Angeles Police Department in the year 2195.

name: Dash Dash Run!
short_description: Dash Dash Run! The frantic VR arcade runner that has you pumping those arms, performing to the crowd, and racing at crazy speeds across a wild selection of vibrant courses.

name: Twins of the Pasture
short_description: This is a story about twin sisters who live in the pasture. Their parents ran away leaving a huge debt. Two sisters have to pay back money in 120 days…

name: Swords and Sandals 2 Redux
short_description: The world's favourite gladiator game has returned, bigger and more action packed than ever. Swords and Sandals 2: Emperor's Reign, remastered with all new graphics, music and powerful new skills and awesome Arena Champions Pharoah King, John the Butcher and Ultra Flavlus

name: VR Battleship YAMATO
short_description: Full Scale Restoration of the Japanese battleship “Yamato” in VR. Battleship Yamato was constructed during the World War Ⅱ in 1941, and it was the biggest battleship ever built. Unfortunately, Yamato didn’t last through the war, and it sank to the bottom of the sea. Now, battleship Yamato is completely restored in full scale in VR.

name: DarkMaze
short_description: In the dark claustrophobic labyrinth, would you feel scared, depression and at a loss? Give you a flashlight, forward exploration; start your sixth sense, find the end point through the maze!

name: Ashes Cricket
short_description: Ashes Cricket is the officially licensed video game of cricket’s greatest rivalry. Bringing all the fast paced action, big hits and skill that you see in the greatest cricket competition on earth, you’ll be able to play in the men’s and women’s 2017/2018 Ashes tours.

name: LIBERTY VR
short_description: LIBERTY VR is an action adventure game, taking place in alternative version of American Revolution. Main protagonist is the American soldier who is fighting against evil created by ancient alien race.

name: ZHUST - THE ILLUSION SOUL
short_description: ZHUST - THE ILLUSION SOUL is third person Hack & Slash game with various combo and fast-paced attack moveset.

name: OfficeBots: Reality Bytes [VR]
short_description: OfficeBots: Reality Bytes is a little game with a big heart. Explore a wonderfully weird corporate office, listen to your robotic co-workers’ stories, and help to solve their problems. Ultimately your goal is to find a way to escape, but your journey to freedom will give you many opportunities to brighten up another's life.

name: CRAFT BATTLE SIMULATOR
short_description: CRAFT BATTLE SIMULATOR is an awesome multiplayer game. You have to control a ship with the crew and cannons going around destroying other ships. This game is tons of fun to play with friends or even alone as you can single handedly dismantle a fleet if you’re skilled enough.

name: Coregrounds
short_description: Welcome to the Coregrounds: a competitive RTS game with elements of MOBA and Tower Defense. Master your micro, expand your strategic diversity and become a champion of the Coregrounds in this indie free-to-play game with cross-platform multiplayer.

name: Harvest Life
short_description: Show your mettle as both an aspiring organic farmer and a part-time adventurer. And then you might be in for a romantic happy ending.

name: Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship
short_description: Discover the fascinating story of Mika, a girl known as a horse whisperer, as she tries to befriend the black stallion called Windstorm.

name: Slime-san: Blackbird's Kraken
short_description: The notorious Blackbird's kracked, I mean, cracked! He believes Slime-san stole his treasure and unleashed his giant Kraken upon him! Sound familiar? It is now up to Slime-san to escape the giant squid's jaws back out to freedom!

name: NitroRage
short_description: NitroRage - crazy multiplayer races with weapons. Destroy your competitors using the minigun, rocket launcher, flamethrower and other guns, or abuse of the machine with a RAM-style Derby. Drive using nitro boosts, jump with springboard on the roofs of buildings, and the demolition of funiture stores and offices, find on the map new...

name: Disco Time 80s VR
short_description: The 80s are back! Enter the Dancefloor and celebrate an 80s club party in VR.

name: Caliban Below
short_description: A short interactive story for room-scale VR: Become Caliban, the scion of a broken lineage struggling to understand your dark inheritance. Explore the ruins of the family estate, and the incredible realm below seeking clues to your past, and to the events that severed you from your family long ago.

name: Ashen
short_description: Ashen is an action RPG about a wanderer in search of a place to call home.

name: Happy Lab
short_description: Welcome to the "Happy Lab"! You are a new intern at the most advanced science facility. Your daily job would be to train our AI "Aurora". "Aurora" purpose is to create the most advanced armor and fix all glitches on the way if there are any.

name: Hero's Story
short_description: Fight monsters, look for treasures and defeat powerful bosses in this blend of first-person action and RPG! Save Teandria - an ancient kingdom on the verge of collapse, or let it be destroyed. This is your story!

name: Writers
short_description: Writers is a game where you play as a writer and try to be the first in typing random excerpts from the book. Fight against your friends or players around the world, make your way to the top and show them speed you are capable of. Become a member of Writer's club and master all language leagues!

name: DOOM VFR
short_description: DOOM® VFR brings the fast-paced, brutal gameplay fans of the series love to virtual reality. Play as a cybernetic survivor who is activated by the UAC to fight the demon invasion, maintain order, and prevent catastrophic failure at the Mars facility.

name: Mob Stadium
short_description: Mob Stadium holds the secret to escaping the end of all time. Traps, challenges, and a Grand Finale await your demise in this challenging shooter made for the HTC Vive.

name: OVERTURN
short_description: You’ve found yourself inside a futuristic laboratory with no memory of who you are or how you got there. You begin to wonder - are there others like me?Find your way out of the confines of the laboratory and unravel the story to understand what’s going on.

name: VeeR VR:VR Video and Movie Platform
short_description: Explore the newest premium VR 360/VR videos, photos, and interactive experiences that will WOW you on VeeR. Enjoy Cannes, Tribeca, Venice Film Festival featured films, immerse yourself in innovative animated experiences, and discover the world and beyond in HD.
genres: Web Publishing;Animation & Modeling;Design & Illustration;Software Training;Photo Editing;Audio Production;Accounting;Video Production;Utilities;Game Development;Education

name: Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True
short_description: Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True to Steam on end of June 2017. This new release contains the original concept and feel to its series, but also had been upgraded to be compatible on Window 7 and above OS, and optimized to fit 16:9 aspect ratio. In addition to system upgrade, the game utilizes the Steam achievement system.

name: Shots Fired
short_description: A murdered wife, a kidnapped daughter, and a stolen TV bring an assassin-turned-photojournalist back into the game. Use your cell phone to investigate and hunt your targets while exploring the Flat World universe. Avenge your wife, rescue your daughter, and most importantly...reclaim your TV!

name: Interplanetary: Enhanced Edition
short_description: In this turn-based strategic artillery game, players wage interplanetary wars by developing their home planets and firing massive barrages through the unpredictable gravity fields of the solar system.

name: Journey of the Sword
short_description: Embark on a journey in Japan inspired setting in this traditional JRPG.

name: Sanator: Scarlet Scarf
short_description: Scarlet Scarf is a visual novel inspired by the legend of Plague Maiden. Dive into the dark mysteries of a dying city with the fate of Sanator Richard Murdock in your hands. Perhaps it's not too late to stop the on-going calamity...

name: TublerVR
short_description: TublerVR is a game designed for virtual reality. It's up to you to help the tublers to grow and collect the rare blue mushroom. Activate bridges with a simple touch and allow the tublers a save passage. Save the tublers!

name: Machine World 2
short_description: Take control of a range of different machines and operate them in a unique environment. Each new game generates a new world, and it is yours to develop: Dig and build anything, anywhere! All machines have been carefully modelled down to small details.

name: Warbanners
short_description: Warbanners: the turn-based, tactical strategy game with role-playing elements that lets you manage a squad of mercenaries, and survive 42 campaign missions. Your goal? To earn a place among ancient legends!

name: After Solitary
short_description: The story of a man's life after solitary confinement.

name: Dinosaur Hunt First Blood
short_description: Dinosaur Hunt First Blood is a sequel to a first Dinosaur Hunt game and is a chaotic first person shooter that confronts heavily armed players with the most horrifying dino-humans.

name: ZONE OF THE ENDERS THE 2nd RUNNER : M∀RS / アヌビス ゾーン・オブ・エンダーズ : マーズ
short_description: ZONE OF THE ENDERS THE 2nd RUNNER - M∀RS Remastered in 4K and full VR. Enter Orbital Frame JEHUTY's cockpit and fly through Martian skies!

name: Code 7: A Story-Driven Hacking Adventure
short_description: Try to save humanity in this episodic and fully voiced hacker story. Guide your partner through a thrilling and emotional science fiction journey by hacking systems and extracting information. All from your keyboard.

name: Greece Defense TD
short_description: Greece Defense is an epic tower defense saga where you play as the general of the united Greek army and your duty is to protect your land from invasion of thousands of mythical creatures driven by mighty Titans who somehow managed to escape from Tartarus.

name: The Zero Dome
short_description: Float, build and shoot in VR in the zero gravity arena known as "The Zero Dome" . Mixing elements of arcade and survival games, The Zero Dome is a sandbox arcade game like no other, built from the ground up for VR.

name: Grimoire : Heralds of the Winged Exemplar (V2)
short_description: Cleveland Mark Blakemore's Magnum Opus! The ultimate classic style turn-based roleplaying game in the tradition of Wizardry, Might&Magic, Lands Of Lore and Eye of the Beholder! 600+ hours of play with hand-painted graphics and old skool goodness!

name: Golem Creation Kit
short_description: Race against the clock to defeat the angry mobs that want to burn you out. Grab virtually anything -- sand dunes, animals, buildings, mountaintops. Then throw everything in your cauldron and turn it into unstoppable engines of pixellated 16-bit terror!

name: Plumber 3D
short_description: You have to test your ability to assemble the water system in the right order and find the code to move to new challenges. Moving from level to level you have to fix more and more complicated and intricate schemes.

name: Yume Nikki
short_description: This is a game in which you traverse the extremely dark world inside a dream.

name: SlipDrive
short_description: Slipdrive is a simple, but fast paced game designed to provide a challenge and test your reflexes.

name: Weeping Skies
short_description: My father, Sherlock Stiles, had been withering before my very eyes. I had heard of an elixir that could restore the strength of his youth, but its cost was much too high. When I took the case of the disappearance of the wife of Puss in Boots, I planned to fetch a good sum from it.

name: Leap of Champions
short_description: Leap of Champions is a 3D Competitive and Cooperative First Person Shooter with awesome graphic, and a skill based gameplay. His strongpoints are a fluid gameplay with a solid graphic able to work well on outdated machines as well as on the most powerful ones.

name: HYPERNOVA: Escape from Hadea
short_description: HYPERNOVA: Escape from Hadea combines classic real-time strategy with tower defense in a vast open world, becoming something special in the process – the original RTDS! The world is colorful and charming, but make no mistake: this is a deep and diverse strategy game with old school sensibilities.

name: 侠客风云传前传(Tale of Wuxia:The Pre-Sequel)
short_description: Tale of Wuxia: The Pre-Sequel, the authentic sequel of Tale of Wuxia which surpasses the latter it in every way, is a CRPG developed by Fenghuang Game and Heluo Studio. This U3D-based game includes better story, funnier events and enhanced gameplay.

name: Time Gun / 时间枪
short_description: Time Gun is a first person puzzle-platform video game. Players control the "time status" of an object with a time gun. The goal of the game is to use the time gun to maneuver through the test chambers in order to complete the experiments.

name: AngerForce: Reloaded
short_description: AngerForce: Reloaded is an action-packed vertically scrolling shoot'em up game that pays homage to the classics of 90’s arcades. This high octane experience is set against the backdrop of a 19th century human world that has seen the outbreak of a robot rebellion.

name: Imperatum
short_description: Imperatum is an Action RPG set in a future Sci-Fi universe. You are an agent, thrown headfirst into your first mission trying to unravel the mystery of the veil that is consuming the galaxy. The game focuses on the core ARPG 'trinity' mechanics of fast-paced combat, character customization and tons of loot!

name: Psychic Isolation Episode 1
short_description: Your mother sent you off to your holiday with a warm goodbye ... But when you return, nothing in your house feels warm anymore

name: Wrath of Loki VR Adventure
short_description: Become Thor, the mighty God of Thunder. Dive into a beautiful fantasy world of Scandinavian legends, gods, and artifacts. Face the raging Loki, and help to prevent Ragnarok – the mythical end of days. Feel as though you’re a part of the legend!

name: Beyond the Invisible: Evening
short_description: At the edge of the forest lies a small Woodville town. One day the town became shrouded in mist and no one could pass through. Citizens began to disappear, one by one and fear gripped the town. Unravel the mystery of the Shadows and free the town from their dreadful fears!

name: Rogue Empire: Dungeon Crawler RPG
short_description: Explore randomly generated content and experience the thrill of a classic tactical turn-based rogue-like RPG! Choose from a diverse cast of characters, each with their own unique abilities and strengths. Get ready for an unforgettable journey of strategy, skill, and discovery.

name: Naklua VR
short_description: Naklua VR is a large puzzle game set in a spacious sky where you must navigate a multitude of levels, traps and dangerous paths. Naklua has used VR to it's advantage by making the experience as limitless as possible.

name: Run Jump Die Repeat
short_description: Run Jump Die Repeat is a single button platformer game. Press SPACE to run, bounce, jump, climb, and kill as you attempt to save the Cracker Princess and escape the evil Cron Rebels home planet.

name: Nurbits
short_description: Nurbits is a music puzzle game. You take on the role of a sound engineer responsible for producing music with a robot band. You must fix the wiring in each robot's brain before it can play the song. To do so, you hook up computer chips that send and receive signals the same way that neurons do.

name: Moon Landing VR
short_description: Ever want to casually explore our solar system from the comfort of your own home? Now you can in Moon Landing VR - Have Fun While Learning!

name: Aces High III
short_description: Aces High III offers world class modeling of World War II planes, vehicles, and boats in a combat setting with hundreds of other players pitting their skills in any given online arena.

name: Diesel Express VR
short_description: Diesel Express is a VR shooter game. As a Legionnaire of The Regiment, your duty is to make sure the trains, Dreadnoughts, arrive destinations safely. On the way, Dreadnought will be attacked by the bandits. You need to eliminate enemies which follow you by their Diesel Punk vehicles.

name: Deep Horizon
short_description: Deep Horizon is an underwater platformer that’s both relaxing and annoyingly clever in its puzzles and environments. With smooth controls, 360 degrees of freedom and 24 hand-crafted levels, each challenge is designed to charm and entertain.

name: TinkerQuarry
short_description: TinkerQuarry is an RPG about a girl trapped in an uncanny plane of existence called “The Dollhouse”.

name: Hentami: Vendetta
short_description: Hentami: Vendetta is Graphic Novella adventure of intimacy, violence and revenge.

name: VRTGO
short_description: VRTGO is a truly immersive and creative platform for artists to tell their stories and invite their fans around the world to experience live performances and music videos like never before.

name: Shephy
short_description: 1000 adorable sheep!The popular single-player card game Shephy, is now available on Steam.

name: Eskimo Bob: Starring Alfonzo
short_description: Eskimo Bob is an 8-bit puzzle-platformer with sixty-four levels of fish-collecting action. Originally developed for the NES, you can now enjoy this game on Steam!

name: A Rip In Time
short_description: Time travel in a new twisted way. The game’s antagonist will be pulling you through “Rips in Time”. The further you explore, the more intertwined the worlds become! Experience the early 1900’s and future all in one, thanks to the power of Unreal Engine 4.

name: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator
short_description: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator is a silly and super tough physics based shooter puzzler in which you attempt to help a drunken redneck hit targets without accidentally shooting himself with a ricochet.

name: Onirim - Solitaire Card Game
short_description: Wander through the chambers of dreams, hoping that chance will reveal the doors, or linger in each type of room. In either case, you will have to deal with the slithering Nightmares which haunt the hallways of the labyrinth.

name: No Longer Home
short_description: No Longer Home is a game about letting go of the life you've built due to circumstances beyond your control. Immerse yourself in the lives of Bo and Ao and learn about their dreams, frustrations and fears. Welcome the magic of the everyday and somewhat extraordinary.

name: My Memory of Us
short_description: My Memory of Us is a moving fairy tale about friendship and hope in the darkest moments of our times. Enter a hand-crafted, gorgeously animated 2D world full of adventure, exploration, stealth and puzzles. Meet the kids brought up in different worlds and help them survive during times of occupation.

name: Castle Defender
short_description: Castle defender is a fast-paced defending arcade-strategy game where you must use spells to stop various enemies that will come and try to destroy your castle.

name: ConcPerfect 2017
short_description: ConcPerfect 2017 is a skill-based 3D platformer, with some puzzle elements. Overcome a variety of obstacles with the use of a propulsion-inducing blast (conc grenade) and careful maneuvering.

name: Clash of Robots
short_description: CLASH OF ROBOTS is a real time multiplayer futuristic fighting game where mean metal machines with diverse personalities face off each other in a fight for domination. Are you ready for the ultimate fighting challenge?

name: Jumps VR
short_description: Enter a world of sky islands and jump your way to the finish, now in absurdly fast VR!

name: Booty Diver
short_description: Take a dive into the perilous depths of the ocean as you seek sunken treasure while battling creatures who guard their treasure as you manage your precious air supply.

name: The Spook Inspectors
short_description: You are an aspiring paranormal investigator eager to join the Spook Inspectors Paranormal Society.

name: Dunia: Masters
short_description: Fill the shoes of Masters Mason-Northwood a ‘genius scientist’ who, after a failed assassination attempt, is left wandering in the dark, reading books, finding notes and listening to audio logs about the North Wood and himself, while also trying to escape his own barren lab.

name: Halcyon 6: Starbase Commander (LIGHTSPEED EDITION)
short_description: A retro space strategy RPG with base building, deep tactical combat, crew management and emergent storytelling. Halcyon 6: Lightspeed Edition is a massively enhanced version of the Award Winning indie strategy RPG, Halcyon 6.

name: Star Renegades
short_description: Star Renegades is a dimension spanning rogue-lite strategy RPG. Outsmart uniquely generated adversaries, forge bonds between heroes and end the cycle!

name: Shalnor Legends: Sacred Lands
short_description: A Story-Rich RPG/Action-Adventure Game, made by one person over the course of three years. Step into the shoes of the young Elf Rynna, and explore the Sacred Lands. Venture into dangerous dungeons, explore caves and solve puzzles and become the champion of the Goddess Illeria.

name: Double Play: 2-Player VR Baseball
short_description: Double Play is a local two-player VR baseball game. As the batter, take your at-bats in the headset. Swing for the fences! As the pitcher, throw fastballs, curveballs, sinkers and more. Do whatever you can to make the batter miss!

name: Little Miss Lonely
short_description: Little Miss Lonely is a game about childhood, fear and the relationships. You play as nine year old Robin in this short, narrative driven side-scrolling game.

name: Debris Field
short_description: Fight your way through a series of unforgiving arenas, learning to use Newtonian movement to give yourself an edge over your enemies. Upgrade your ship and your weapons along the way with whatever you can find, but don't take too long, as the enemy will soon overwhelm you.

name: Collapsus
short_description: COLLAPSUS™ is a one-of-a-kind block-crunching puzzle game all about gravity manipulation and resource management! Join Leon the Chameleon as you twist, tilt, turn, & flip your device as you solve your way through endless, mind-bending puzzles!

name: NEON GALAXY
short_description: Neon Galaxy is a arcade style multiplayer twin stick shooter. There are modes for co-op play and pvp.

name: The Montana Chronicles: Montana's Croatoa
short_description: Building on classical maze crawlers, Montana's Croatoa is an attempt to break away from grid based movement in dungeon crawling puzzle based games. In real time the player must escape from the maze of enemies with limited sight.

name: Quantum Pilot
short_description: Predict, Adapt and Obliterate your Past Lives.

name: Tessa's Ark
short_description: A Sci-fi RPG set in a world where humans have shed the limitations of the corporeal body to inhabit existence as beings of pure thought. Solve puzzles to unlock the secrets of the digital reality.

name: Children of Apollo
short_description: Children of Apollo is an exciting twin-stick shooter in a short, arcade style format using a blend of classic and modern gameplay elements. After the Apollo missions humans send an expedition to explore Mars but things go terribly wrong.

name: The Labyrinth
short_description: A text-based dungeon crawler with a heavy emphasis on combat and looting. Features 16 playable classes and 40 enemy classes, each with an assortment of 9 unique abilities. Countless combinations of items, enemies, loot, and floors.

name: Curse of the Great Forest
short_description: In this indie action game, you are a huntsman for hire who finds himself facing down terrifying creatures born from an ancient and mysterious curse. With bow in hand, take on the night and defend yourself and your elderly host from zombies, demons, sorcerers, and all manner of evil beings.

name: Bump+Smack
short_description: Bump+Smack is an exciting casual game where you bump balls and smack the table to get the highest score. Keep the balls from falling below your board and bump them back up to the goals. Smack the table to give that extra "oomph" to get your balls into the goal.

name: Blockara
short_description: Blockara is a head-to-head action puzzle game where you, one of the best alchemists in the world, must compete in the World Alchemy Tournament for a chance to have your wish granted by the September Dragon! Fight your way to the top in Story Mode or hone your skills in the other game modes!

name: Humble Abode
short_description: In this atmospheric adventure your own home becomes the playground of a sadistic intruder. Can you find a way to avoid being a prisoner in your house, or will you even live long enough to try?

name: Echo Nine
short_description: Echo Nine is intended to be reminiscent of the old arcade classic space shooters like Galaga or Gaplus.

name: Oats Studios - Volume 1 Assets
short_description: If you are a fan of Oats Studios and want to support us, then please purchase the Oats Studios - Volume 1 Assets. Zygote DLC now available.

name: DC Wonder: Unlimited
short_description: This is a 1v1, 2D fighting game featuring the members of the DC Wonder pop band. Play with friends or take on the 8-stage tournament to unlock new characters and stages.

name: VR Guest
short_description: VR Guest is an experience in which you get to have dinner with Albert Einstein, Mozart, and Kleopatra. Enjoy watching them have a thoughtful dialog, and ask questions at the end!

name: Emily Wants to Play Too
short_description: No one believed the pizza guy. They kept the dolls. A sandwich delivery guy is on his way to Central Evidence. He is not ready for what he finds. Emily and the dolls are back with new friends, scares and more. Use stealth and strategy to survive their unique games in this survival horror.

name: Chromaestro
short_description: A musical puzzle game, starring Chromie the cat! Features music that is procedurally generated as you play!

name: CrazyCar
short_description: What is it? Four colours, four scenes, four cars. It's a game, it's an art.

name: Pond Wars
short_description: This pond ain't big enough for the both of us. Two toy boats go in. Only one comes out. Can you time your cannon fire perfectly to defeat your opponent?

name: Dark and Bright
short_description: This is a story about friendship, depression and the constant evaluation of life. Embark on the journey of your friends and learn about their dark and bright times in life - and yours, too.

name: Unimersiv
short_description: Unimersiv is the largest platform for VR educational experiences. Our app for the HTC Vive includes multiple field trips from the interior of the ISS to Ancient Rome that will let you learn using Virtual Reality.

name: Khufu's Delivery Service
short_description: Khufu's Delivery Service is an arcade puzzle game that challenges your skill and speed to maximize space with different shaped pieces. There are currently 4 game modes: Standard, Time-Attack, Pyramid, and Puzzle. Each focuses on a different gameplay aspect! Have fun!

name: HereAfter
short_description: Deep in an old forgotten laboratory, a failed experiment reboots from its sleep. With no memories, it now must explore the many different areas of the extensive complex with the help of an AI called MUSE. Will it find the light of redemption it longs for, or will it find a dark and terrible truth?

name: Flagsplosion
short_description: Flagsplosion is a flag identifying endless quizzer with over 650 current flags from around the world, over 100 Training levels, Practice Mode, and Endless Mode.

name: BFF or Die
short_description: Some people find it too hard, some too easy, and some juuuust right. Couch co-op puzzle-action game for 1-4 players. As time-traveling aliens you’re sent on a risky rescue mission to Earth! Use your gadgets collaboratively to survive as a team.

name: Mr Rabbit's Alphabet Forest Adventure
short_description: Mr Rabbit's Alphabet Adventure is an educational game for children designed to teach the alphabet. Children are leading Mr Rabbit through a maze. In order to proceed, they need to trace the letters. The quiz feature allows children to test their knowledge of writing and listening to letters sounds.

name: Brigand: Oaxaca
short_description: Brigand: Oaxaca is a highly difficult post-apocalyptic RPG/FPS set in Mexico. Emphasis is on challenge, a branching story with multiple endings, and total freedom of action (kill friendly characters, rob stores, jump across roofs, etc.).

name: Fragmentum
short_description: Fragmentum is an Experimental Real Time Strategy (RTS) game with customizable units and factions, dynamic units and complex 3D terrain. Units are built from voxel-like modules that determine their stats and abilities. Features multiplayer, Procedural maps, replays, and a simple single player campaign.

name: Hex Tunnel
short_description: Enter another dimension and master the elements to become a supreme being. With arcade, chaos and ultra modes in procedural stages ensures a unique experience.

name: Killbox
short_description: KillboxKillbox is an online game and interactive installation that critically explores the nature of drone warfare, its complexities and consequences. It is an experience which explores the use of technology to transform and extend political and military power, and the abstraction of killing through virtualisation.

name: ESCAPE Room: Reality
short_description: You wake up in a locked classroom with a few strangers and no memories of how you got there... With only your puzzle-solving skills to rely on, can you uncover the secrets and mysteries behind your captivity and escape? Put your skills to the test and escape if you can!!

name: Potentia
short_description: A multiplayer sci-fi arena shooter with a heavy emphasis on verticality, meant for playing with friends. It combines fast paced quake-style action with unique and skill based weapons, resulting in a competitive and enjoyable experience.

name: Mocove Arts VR
short_description: Explore the top thousand artworks from human history in Mocove Arts virtual museum.

name: Vickinachi
short_description: Experience the fun with vickinachi

name: Beached
short_description: Stranded on an uninhabited island. Completely removed from civilisation. How long will you survive? Step up and challenge your new environment. Do you have what it takes?

name: Mystika 3 : Awakening of the dragons
short_description: The world of Lumina is in danger. Thieves have stolen the four Elemental eggs ! I, queen of the darkness need your help to bring them back before the Awakening of the Dragons. A fantastic journey awaits you through 200 magic levels. Defeat your enemies with powerful spells, and find enough gold to restore Lumina.

name: Descent - Silence of Mind
short_description: Hypnosis, memories, delusions and a disturbing secret revolve around silence of mind.

name: Stick Nightmare
short_description: Stick Nightmare is a simple puzzle-platform game where you control yourself after having some drinks at a local bar.

name: ESport Manager
short_description: Would you like to try your hand as a manager of this e-sport? eSport Manager is a game based on the idea of e-sports competitions, especially the most popular - FPS AND MOBA.

name: Equivoque
short_description: A story-forward visual novelette about a young apprentice who is thrust into a conflict between two magicians; one a famous escape artist, and one a fraudulent medium.

name: Z-Aftershock
short_description: People lost their homes, family members, friends, pets, assets, and safety condition. It’s time for you to restore, resolve the conflicts, build a safe house, a museum and donate your rare items to it, and get promoted to higher rank in military.

name: Polygon Hero
short_description: Defend your city against the zombies before the infection spreads too far!

name: Watchlist
short_description: Accused of committing a crime affecting the nation's security, you are now tasked with tracking down various undesirables in order to redeem yourself in the eyes of the powers that be. Blast through procedurally generated levels and complete the Watchlist in this retro arcade shooter!

name: Zofia
short_description: Zofia is a first person RPG. Branded as a heretic and an outcast, you manage to escape the northern empire and take up work as a Seeker. Make your character with a light character creator. Utilize surface-based magic, grapplehooks, and a variety of weapons to stop a corruption called the blight.

name: The Mutational
short_description: Fight your way through the endless amount of enemies. Build all kinds of turrets, drones, traps and barricades to survive as long as possible. Unlock new perks and take that top position on the world leaderboard.

name: Sojourner
short_description: Simultaneously a love letter to and a parody of classic role-playing games, Sojourner is the retro RPG that the world has been craving. Sojourner gracefully features everything you loved from the 8-bit RPGs of your childhood and leaves behind everything you didn't.

name: Grabity
short_description: Dance the tango of death in Grabity, a fast-paced, physics-based arena brawler. Combat robots duke it out using Grab guns to turn nearby objects into lethal projectiles or makeshift shields in intense tactical throw-downs.

name: Lost Legends: The Pharaoh's Tomb
short_description: “None have disturbed my slumber and escaped alive!” A voice booms as you realize you're trapped in a tomb with an ancient Pharaoh; you need to escape! Escape VR partnered up with Escape Games Canada to create the ultimate VR escape room experience- Lost Legends: The Pharaoh’s Tomb.

name: Samsara
short_description: "Help Zee escape Samsara! Drop blocks of different shapes and properties into a realm of two mirrored dimensions, in this beautiful, reflective puzzle game with a twist…”

name: Vanguard Knights
short_description: Vanguard Knights is a high octane, 3D, arcade-style shooter. Engage waves of enemy squadrons, massive robotic bosses, and weave through obstacles in order to destroy the enemy and keep your squad alive.

name: The Mechanical Room VR
short_description: The Mechanical Room is a single player VR game that has 3 mini games which are called Archery, Shooting and Smash. Each game gets harder to play as you progress.

name: Delay
short_description: Inspired by Superhot, Delay is a fast-paced action platformer in which the player must manipulate time to cheat death and defeat their enemies.

name: Pyxel Knight
short_description: A pixel art co-op Metroidvania-Maker game! Jump, Slash and loot enemies to earn and find badges to power up your player.

name: Maggie's Apartment
short_description: Locked in her one-room apartment, Maggie Mallowne must uncover the mysterious celebrity conspiracies of the outside world by talking to her neighbors through her apartment walls

name: Loading Screen Simulator
short_description: A game about never-ending problem of loading screens. We've all experienced it while playing games, while downloading something, while installing an operating system ect. And now you can experience it once again in Loading Screen Simulator: Steam edition

name: Eternal Maze
short_description: ETERNAL MAZEFind the map, find the monoliths, avoid the dogs and survive to escape from the mazes! Inspired by crop circles, Eternal Maze is a puzzle adventure game about a farmer who is trapped in corn mazes.

name: Lumins and Shades
short_description: Lumins and Shades is a cute puzzle game about turning on lights and making memories.

name: Undertaker's
short_description: Inspired by the economy simulation games oft the mid 90s, Undertaker's let's you manage your very own funeral home.

name: The Siege and the Sandfox
short_description: A 2D stealth Metroidvania with parkour platforming. Explore the majestic palace and ancient prisons of a kingdom under siege. Don the mantle of the legendary Sandfox as you venture into the ruins below, and discover the true threat from a sand-borne evil.

name: Inflatality
short_description: The definitive derpy physics based fighter featuring adorable inflatable wavers beating the crap out of each other!

name: Puzzle Bloc Invasion
short_description: Old school shooter meets old school tile-matching. I grew up loving arcade shooters and tile-matching games. Puzzle Bloc Invasion combines the two. Completely revamped in 2024. Steam Deck (and portable PC) optimized.

name: RockShot
short_description: RockShot is a free-to-play dynamic third-person shooter combining traditional online shooter gameplay with innovative elements. Explore a massive arsenal of firearms or rock the battlefield with crazy melee weapons and deadly airstrikes!

name: Pocket Assault
short_description: In Pocket Assault you are pitted against infantry, snipers, jeeps, tanks, helicopters and drones. Hide behind protective barriers to stay alive while you aim and fire at enemy combatants. Some defeated opponents give you new weapons or additional health.

name: spaceBOUND
short_description: spaceBOUND is a brutally challenging puzzle-platformer, set in a zero-gravity environment. Stranded and bound by their oxygen tether, two astronauts must work together to make it out alive. Go in alone, or team up and face the unknown.

name: Prisoner
short_description: You are a Prisoner. In a strange place with many rooms. You hear a noise, as if something is moving around. Move from one room to another, avoid deadly traps and try to escape.

name: Chroma Blast
short_description: Chroma Blast is a fast paced twin stick shooter with many different styles of play where you fight through waves of enemies while constantly leveling up your ships colorful arsenal. Beat your friends and challenge yourself in the leaderboards, or seek out a true test of skill for those good enough to find it.

name: Return of the Obra Dinn
short_description: Lost at sea 1803 ~ The good ship Obra Dinn.

name: Spin the Beat
short_description: Jump-n-dodge couch-multiplayer arcade action to the beat of the music! A party game for 1 to 4 players.

name: Crushing Blow
short_description: An exciting and engrossing arcade, in which your goal is to destroy everything you see and not be overwhelmed. Crush! Saw! Throw! The game contains plethora of levels, each with its own unique goals, interesting situations and challenges of your reaction and decision making skills.

name: The First Time I Died
short_description: When Cristina Roque finds herself in a place where the walls whisper lies and something macabre is around every corner, she is forced to make decisions that shape the world around her. Information is more valuable than the finest jewel, and certain knowledge may postpone Cristina's inevitable demise...

name: Defend Your Kingdom
short_description: Fight legendary monsters, customizing your defensive strategy with different spells and equipments! Throw lightnings to your enemies, summon stone guardians, rise the mercenaries of darkness from the dead to fight on your side to save your Kingdom from the mystic shadow!

name: The Contractor
short_description: The world is in danger but who cares really? You’re just here to fulfill some contracts and hopefully get paid along the way! But who knows you might just care along the way and take down some targets that are causing some trouble…

name: Cave Escape
short_description: A green squid-thing and her friends brave an endless cave trying to escape from dangerous earth, fire, and an evil robot.

name: Cavern Crumblers
short_description: Grab your friends and stock up on grenades for this fast-paced single-screen local multiplayer shooter! Compete with each other in an environment filled with destructible terrain as you run, jump, and dodge your way through the destruction.

name: Darkest Wave
short_description: In the future retro of 3180, The government has created a program of self aware mechanized creatures and they have gone rouge. The story begins as Max Titan gets the call that he has to bail the world out yet again, Max pilots his custom Fighter car the X-50 to destroy the sentient bosses of this growing army of mechanized animals and...

name: Tiny Town VR
short_description: Create an original world and fill it with buildings, roads, vehicles and more. Give it life with posable characters. Tell a story with custom speech bubbles and in-game photo captures. Then, share with friends!

name: Zafehouse Diaries 2
short_description: Zafehouse Diaries 2 is a game of survival, exploration and relationships. Every hour, designate tasks for your handful of characters - each with their own skills, motivations and prejudices - and try to outlast the zombie apocalypse.

name: Your Smile Beyond Twilight:黄昏下的月台上
short_description: A story about forced smiles, coming to terms with the past, and love—but most of all, redemption.

name: DinoBlaster
short_description: Sidestep extinction as a dino in this arcade dodge-'em-up. This deluxe release features cutting-edge Brontoscan vector graphics.

name: Virtual Temple: Order of the Golden Dawn
short_description: Experience a magic fraternity initiation ritual first hand.

name: A Quick Death
short_description: A Quick Death is a 2-Player local multiplayer Western Shootout where timing, reflex, and psychology are the name of the game. Featuring over 20 unique stages and over a dozen different obstacles and modifiers, A Quick Death takes a classic video game mechanic and pushes it to its most extreme conclusion.

name: Project MALLOW
short_description: As MALLOW, launch yourself through over 100 levels of brutal and punishing puzzle platforming. Reach the end of each level to help MALLOW escape. But not everything is as it seems: earning stars will allow you and MALLOW to venture further into Paragon Confections’ factory, and uncover dangerous secrets…

name: Ben The Exorcist
short_description: Ben the Exorcist is horror/comedy game from first person perspective. The task of our titular Hero is to banish annoying ghosts from haunted house of Whiterspoon family so they could finally continue their boring life peacefully.

name: War Chariots: Royal Legion
short_description: Plunge into the world of the Middle Ages! Lead the royal legion of war chariots and reconquer your buildings from insidious invaders! Use magical runes to strengthen your buildings and weaken those of the enemy! Earn emeralds and improve fighting qualities of your troops.

name: Escape Room
short_description: You Wake Up. You noticed that you were trapped in a small room. A clock displayed on the wall has counted down. Let's escape from the room by solving some mystery.

name: Der einzig wahre Auserwählte
short_description: If you hate standard fantasy storys then you might love this one for it makes fun of all established fantasy cliches. This is more than just another RPG Maker game – it is a well written story, full of black humor with lots of different puzzles and quests that you have never seen before!

name: High clear VR
short_description: The High clear VR is Realistic graphic base Badminton VR Game. From Simple mini games and lively fights, you can easily enjoy a fun and enjoyable game without badminton knowing it. Enjoy playing badminton at home through Motion Control.

name: Rival Megagun
short_description: Rival Megagun is a competitive split-screen shoot 'em up where you transform into a giant boss ship and battle your rival head-to-head in local or online PVP.

name: Fisher Fans VR
short_description: 关于这款游戏： 首款单人即使奖励动作游戏《捕鱼发烧友》精彩来袭！还原经典捕鱼玩法，压分倍率、惊喜道具等多种设定让您身临其境，捕鱼爽翻天！ 源自真实鱼类精心刻画、华丽无比的游戏画面、创意无限的玩法设计，华丽爆金尽享奢华战斗！ 操作简单易上手、沉浸体验欢乐无限，辅以3D环绕杜比音效，让您身临其境捕鱼爽翻天！

name: Seven: Reboot
short_description: Seven: Reboot is a cryptic experimental puzzle game. It consists of a wide variety of puzzles of all difficulties. It’s a game about numbers and their meaning. Make notes, construct theories, communicate with other players and solve the mysteries of Seven!

name: Flash Point: Fire Rescue
short_description: Coordinate a squad of firefighters as they navigate the hazards of a structural fire in search of the survivors trapped inside. Flash Point: Fire Rescue is a turn-based strategy port of the acclaimed board game. A unique tactical firefighting experience to enjoy with your family and friends.

name: Xenoslaive Overdrive
short_description: Xenoslaive Overdrive is a fractal bullet shoot-em-up. Specially made for players to feel the thrill from various challenging aspects. Shoot! Survive all enemy bullets! Defeat their bosses, and save the world!

name: Catacombs 1: Demon War
short_description: Catacombs 1: Demon War is the first of a 3-chapter RPG/Adventure that puts you into the shoes of a brave young hero, building your strength to face long-buried secrets, deception and betrayal.

name: 旧手表 - Old Watch
short_description: This is an Visual Novel game. It's a story about time leap.

name: Darkest Hunters
short_description: Choose your hero, grab a weapon, learn new spells and… HUNT! Eliminate every nasty beast you meet, collect loot and find the rarest and the greatest equipment ever made. Remember, it’s the live of a Hunter you’ve become, only you are able to defeat the essence of evil.

name: Cyber Utopia
short_description: Cyber Utopia is a first-person shooter, made in a pastiche, old-school style in the setting of cyber punk. Actions unfold in the distant future, when the technology developed to such an extent that people began to turn into cyborgs.

name: Dialogue: A Writer's Story
short_description: Try out different conversation mechanics – Active, Exploratory or Written – in Dialogue: A Writer's Story. Play as the writer Lucille Hawthorne, exploring characters and events through a year in her life via mostly ordinary, and occasionally fantastical, conversations.

name: Shank n' Bake
short_description: Shank n' Bake is an exciting, twisted take on runner games. Set off to end humanity's healthy food movement by slashing and slamming your foes while avoiding your own untimely, violent death.

name: STATUS: INSANE
short_description: Escaping from a Mental Asylum Has Never Been This Much of.. Fun.

name: Isotiles - Isometric Puzzle Game
short_description: Isotiles is an isometric puzzle game played on a grid. The goal of the game is to turn all of the blue tiles red and then reach the exit tile. There are 50 levels to play through with increasing difficulty and added obstacles.

name: Exorcise The Demons
short_description: Play as an exorcist in the grip of mysterious demons. Your goal is simple: to defeat them! You will need your friends to guide you through the Book of Rituals. Together, it's up to you to communicate and cooperate to exorcise them ...

name: Blood Waves
short_description: Hardcore and bloody shooter where you will have to repel the attacks of the living dead using the destroying traps, defensive barricades and also weapon of close and long-range combat.

name: Super XYX
short_description: Super XYX is a new shmup from the creator of Fire Arrow X, Megatank, ZPF and a couple of others. Co-developed and published by Team Grybanser Fox.

name: Travel Riddles: Trip To Greece
short_description: Travel to Greece and unlock its secrets, through a series of challenging riddles and puzzles! Through more than 8 episodes and 200 levels, a collection of 96 unique artifacts from the ancient world to the modern day are yours to collect. Make use of power-ups to set the best score!

name: Football Game
short_description: You are Tommy, a local high school football hero in the town of East Bend. It’s game night for the Purchase County Turbines and your sweetheart is waiting in the bleachers. Join Tommy for a night you won’t forget...

name: History2048 - 3D puzzle number game
short_description: History 2048 is a familiar logic game, with beautiful graphics. Travel trough the evolution of mankind, meet with famous kings, warlords and adventurer.

name: Senalux
short_description: Senalux is a hex-based puzzle game about optics where you solve challenging puzzles with colorful lasers. Use the red, green and blue lasers, combine them to the right color and illuminate the target.

name: PowBall Renaissance
short_description: Brick breaking action with added twists. A must-have for your Breakout collection. Over 330 levels, level editor, permadeath, farming, resource management, various weapons, shop, sub-games. Play solo or 3-player local co-op.

name: Mr. Dubstep
short_description: Mr. Dubstep is a fun platformer with many colorful levels. The goal of the game is avoiding obstacles with various mechanics.

name: Dreamblaster
short_description: Think Asteroids on...blasteroids? It's an oldschool, multi-directional shooter with attitude!

name: 7 Pillars
short_description: Your choices matter! Will you accept assistance from an old man, no matter how odd the request may seem? Will you kill an enemy or let them live to receive a reward they promised? Will you perform the ulitmate betrayal and hurt the ones closest to you? You decide...

name: Pharmakon - Tactical Puzzle
short_description: Use your drone to lead tactical combat against elemental beasts infesting your faction. Assess the risks, coordinate attacks, optimize your equipment and become the agent who will put an end to the infestation!

name: RPS Runner
short_description: RPS Runner is a simple runner game where you have to choose the correct object from Rock, Paper or Scissors in order to defeat the on-coming objects.

name: Ziggurat 3D Chess
short_description: Ziggurat Three Dimensional Chess(TM), is a true three dimensional environment which combine the familiar movements of standard chess and exciting new moves never seen before. The rules of movement are easy to learn so beginners will be playing their first game in minutes.

name: Unearthing Process
short_description: Once upon a time, a young boy headed with his father, who was a professional miner, towards the depth of the Earth, to search for gems, such as diamonds, emeralds and gold. The young boy fell down in that moment, and his father was extremely astonished by the depth of the gap.

name: Ashes
short_description: Chaos and devastation devoured the last sparkles of life. Surviving is the main task.

name: STICK ENGINE
short_description: STICK ENGINE puts the tools in your hands to create insane stick shenanigans and share them with the world using the STEAM WORKSHOP.

name: Square x Square
short_description: Battle friends in 2D arenas with looping edges, random power-ups, and over a thousand loadout combinations

name: Ballway
short_description: Ballway is a casual physical puzzle with explosions. The player's goal is to keep the ball on the green platform, using explosive and other interactive blocks in order to pass the level.

name: Guts and Syringes
short_description: 2D game about something interesting...

name: A Snake's Tale
short_description: A Snake's Tale is a puzzle game about snakes in cramped places. Clear a path to get to the hole, eat some eggs along the way, and make sure to press all the buttons.

name: Akin Vol 2
short_description: Once again, you only have to draw one continuous line.

name: I Want Toilet!!!!!!
short_description: A 2d game with "Real" physics and contains many actions and decryption elements . You can have fun in fifteen interesting stages

name: Masked Forces: Zombie Survival
short_description: What will you do when the zombie apocalypse comes, are you ready to tackle it right now and stay face to face with all the horrors that will appear?

name: Panic in Puzzle World
short_description: Panic in Puzzle World is a whimsical action-packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Play as Tide and breathe fire, slash with your claws, bounce on bad guys and glide with your wings to put a stop to the robot menace taking over the land, block by block!

name: Dream Daddy: A Dad Dating Simulator
short_description: Dream Daddy: A Dad Dating Simulator is a game where you play as a Dad and your goal is to meet and romance other hot Dads. Are you ready? Hi ready, I'm Dad.

name: Grand Tactician: The Civil War (1861-1865)
short_description: Take command of the Union or the Confederacy. Prepare your nation for war, recruit and organize great armies and fleets under legendary commanders like Grant, Lee, Jackson or Farragut, plan cunning maneuvers on an epic campaign map and defeat your enemies in real-time battles!

name: qop
short_description: qop is a minimalistic puzzle which goal is to get the cube to finish using 4 directions in space.

name: YANKAI'S PEAK.
short_description: Pyramid-Pushing Puzzles.

name: RXE
short_description: (Update: RXE has been discontinued. See the Community Page for more information.) RXE is a game about building and programming robots. Design machines using a variety of parts and devices, and write code in a powerful visual programming language.

name: Labyrinth Escape
short_description: Labyrinth Escape is very challenging game, where your target is to find out of different labyrinths, avoiding bombs, mines and other scary stuff

name: The Eldritch Zookeeper
short_description: Manage a zoo of otherworldly eldritch monsters! Zoo visitors are invited to gaze into the abyss, it's fun for all the family! And all the family might end up devoured, this cursed zookeeper isn't entirely reliable. Add to your Wishlist, today!

name: Numberline 2
short_description: NumberLine 2 is the continuation of the popular (no.) puzzle. You must repeat the indicated image from the numbers. But it isn't so easy - you can create only blocks with a "1", but when you create it, the numbers on all adjacent blocks are incremented by 1.

name: Inferno Puzzle
short_description: Simple low poly puzzle game with challenging levels and darker theme

name: Dude Simulator
short_description: Dude Simulator is an open world sandbox game. This is a life simulator. The main objective is to enjoy what you are doing.

name: Masked Forces 2: Mystic Demons
short_description: Are you ready to explore the underworld and kill hundreds of monsters and demons in the process?

name: Unreal Estate
short_description: In Unreal Estate, the City Council has hired you to build the best cityscape, which you’ll do by drafting buildings to your hand. Rejected designs go to the Scrap Pile, but as demand for those buildings grows, you can reclaim them to score the most points. But be careful that the other architects don’t score them before you!

name: Simple Light Cycles
short_description: Simple Light Cycles is a sleek, fast-paced, hyper responsive, local multiplayer action game for 2-16 players. Outlast, trap, and attack your opponents, or construct a strategy all your own. Get some friends together and put your skills to the test!

name: Deltaplan Simulator
short_description: Deltaplan Simulator is an adventure game in which you need to perform a variety of tricks and tasks flying on a hang-glider.

name: Crazy Ball Adventures
short_description: Balancing the ball might sound easy but the reality is that Crazy Ball Adventures offers you multiple challenges so you will always have to face new and exciting levels.

name: Oik 3
short_description: Casual physics puzzle.

name: Final Prophet
short_description: Final Prophet is a 2d top down action adventure. Inspired by one of, if not the greatest game of all time The Legend Of Zelda NES. Your adventure takes place on the northern continent of Contrarious. The Darkness has emerged from the shadow and is now laying siege to the world.

name: welcome to heaven
short_description: Heaven... should feel better than this shouldn't it?

name: Telepathy Zero
short_description: Use your psychic abilities to compete against other test subjects and prove your psychic powers!

name: ThinkAhead
short_description: The concept of the game is to fill the board tiles using the knight chess piece. Levels start of simple, but become more complex leading up to the 10x10 board at the 60th level. Easy mode shows you the cells uoy can click on. It will help you to get uset to the gameplay.

name: Arena
short_description: Multiplayer deathmatch games with drones! Enjoy fast multiplayer action with your drone in Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch competitions in exotic arenas.

name: Freedom: A Time to Reckon
short_description: You assume the character of Carlos Romero, a former soldier in a Venezuelan village. One day the local guerrilla faction decides to loot and pillage your village, and kill anyone who tries to stand in their way.

name: Insectophobia : Episode 1
short_description: Insectophobia is an episodic platformer. It's the story of John and his struggle against monster insects.

name: EPONYMOUS
short_description: EPONYMOUS: In Which a Work Is Known by Its Reading is a short-form narrative about unreliable infrastructures.

name: Ping
short_description: Defend the center against a nonstop surge of dots by changing the color of the screen!

name: Escape The Pacific
short_description: Raw, real survival in the Pacific. Build a modular floating base. Master realistic sailing mechanics. Face challenging Pacific-like weather & seasons. Hunt, craft, build & navigate using Sun Dial, Sextant & Triangulation. Explore an endless island cluster-based world. Simulate real life scenarios!

name: Astro Duel 2
short_description: Astro Duel 2 is a sci-fi combat game combining top-down space dog fights with up-close platforming action. Whether versus or co-op, battle through space and on foot at the same time! Strike within the fully-destructible arenas or just nuke ‘em from orbit.

name: Aftermath Y2K
short_description: Inspired by such games as Castlevania and Ninja Gaiden; aftermath is a NES styled action platformer. However in Aftermath you play as a dog. You must run, jump, and dodge your way through 8 levels to recover your beloved owner. All the while also trying to fend off thugs, bandits, henchmen, and mutants.

name: Train Bandit
short_description: THE LAW!! Looks to be a showdown atop a train. This will be your last fight. Good luck, Train Bandit.

name: Dig Dog
short_description: An action roguelike digger. Dig to discover treasure, adventure and bones! Jump, dash, stomp and dig your way through a strange world inhabited by stranger creatures.

name: Simple RTS
short_description: A Simple Real-Time-Strategy Game Like in the good old days, with 20 types of units. The goal is simply to conquer all territories on the map, which is also your AI opponent's goal...

name: Tiger Hunt
short_description: Storm the continent of europe during WWII! You break out of normandy into artillery pounding action, menacing mines and a maelstrom of machine gun fire. Your maneuverable M-4 Sherman tank leads the hard-fought hunt for the enemy.

name: Panzer Killer
short_description: The highly appraised sequel to Tiger Hunt with over 50 new missions! Roll over a decimated Europe during WWII with your american armored division. Fight everything in the German arsenal including the most notorious and lethal tanks such as Tigers and Panthers. Battle through over 50 brand new missions in a fast paced arcade-style shooter.

name: Hooligan Vasja: Halloween
short_description: During the day he is a regular hooligan, but this night he has to save his house. He is strong and agile and his slingshot is his weapon of choice. He is Batma.., ehem, Vasja!

name: Solar Settlers
short_description: Solar Settlers is a card-driven space exploration strategy game set in the far future. Our sun is on the verge of collapse and so mankind has taken to the stars aboard colony ships to seek out a new home.

name: Geneticognito
short_description: An action stealth game where you navigate through increasingly perilous levels while trying not to be spotted. Even then, conflict is inevitable as you follow Rane through hectic boss fights during her escape from Sky Facility.

name: MX Bikes
short_description: MX Bikes is a realistic motocross simulator, based on a scratch built physics engine that accurately simulates motorcycle dynamics and setup options.

name: Tick Tick Pass
short_description: The ultimate trivia game, Tick Tick Pass is a list-filling game suitable for single players or parties alike, with hundreds of hours of content!

name: Ragdoll Kanojo
short_description: Have fun with your own virtual ragdoll girl! Customize clothes and style, pose! VR IS OPTIONAL! (But recommended) You can play on your monitor too!

name: NOKBAK
short_description: Nokbak is a first-person multiplayer arena shooter... with a twist! Built for 3 to 8 players, players don't shoot to kill, but rather find themselves frantically trying to knock each other off of an arena in the sky.

name: Micro Cosmic Worlds
short_description: Micro Cosmic Worlds is a discovery based journey into unseen worlds of the microcosmos. Using the power of virtual reality, you (the player) are transported deeper and deeper into the worlds of the infinitesimally small.

name: PHAT STACKS 2
short_description: Phat Stacks 2 is puzzle platformer, it features completely new gameplay with a new set of characters, the goal of Phat Stacks 2 is to collect and process crystals by knocking them into the right chutes for a payout. Each level gets harder and presents a new challenge as you progress

name: Horse Racing 2016
short_description: Horse Racing 2016 is most Fabulous and Entertaining Game for Everyone. If you want to feel real horse racing championship, show your desire and courage to play this game. This Game Uniqueness makes you play this game for hours, you will love to play this game again and again.

name: Krieg
short_description: Built from the ground up for VR, Krieg is a team-based fantasy multiplayer competitive game. Thrown into the middle of a war between The King's Army and The Ancients, only the strongest will survive. This war of epic mercenaries and guardians will decide the fate of the realm.

name: Paddle Battle
short_description: Paddle Battle is a fast-paced local multiplayer party game for up to 4 players! Out-shoot, dodge, defend, and race your opponents - to the death!

name: HOCKEY SPACE
short_description: Fast button-based low rule local multiplayer hockey game. I think it's fun with friends, but most things are.

name: Mahjong Masters: Temple of the Ten Gods
short_description: A mahjong quest to construct an ancient temple and invoke the Gods

name: Screaming Eagles
short_description: Screaming Eagles is a flight top-down shooter that exemplifies everything that all great shooters of reference would include. Flashy effects, millions of enemies, huge bosses, it’s a retro-inspired shooter fit for gamers of old and new.

name: Tense Reflection
short_description: Tense Reflection is an innovative puzzle / shooter. Solve puzzles in order to reload your ammo / change the color of your shots while enemies are constantly progressing. Better be quick !

name: F.E.X (Forced Evolution Experiment)
short_description: In F.E.X (Forced Evolution Experiment) you are a failed experiment in a facility where they manipulate human DNA in order to stop the aging process. You are able to grow old at will, but you can't reverse the process. Get out before your time runs out or you get caught.

name: tick-hunter
short_description: Tik-hunter - first-person game with elements of horror.

name: This Strange Realm Of Mine
short_description: This Strange Realm Of Mine is a First Person Shooter mixed with poetry and psychological horror. Graphic style is 3D mixed with pixel art.

name: Tallowmere 2: Curse of the Kittens
short_description: Lady Tallowmere's kittens have been acting strange. Still, the dungeon's rituals must be carried out. Despite the unusual circumstances, how many rooms can you clear?

name: Trigger Spree
short_description: Unrealistic FPS

name: Beast Mode: Night of the Werewolf Silver Bullet Edition
short_description: Beast Mode: Night of the Werewolf - Unleash your inner beast, rack up epic kills, and dominate the online leaderboards in this over-the-top Arcade Action spectacle!

name: Crimson Gray
short_description: John is a young man suffering from severe depression. As he loses his sense of purpose in life, he begins to see the world in unfocused gray. Just when he begins to lose all hope, John meets a girl... a very special girl.

name: Project 5: Sightseer
short_description: Open world multiplayer sandbox/RPG game. Explore, gather, build, research, and fight to protect what's yours -- by yourself or together with your friends.

name: Fly Simulator
short_description: You work as a waiter and lead an uphill battle for their clients. You pushing back the flies from the food, otherwise you'll never get anything. Maybe you are a hungry insect trying to increase their population? Choose the opposing side. The war is already underway.

name: BULLET PARTY
short_description: The party co-op shoot ’em up! Become the king of the night club! Go alone or group your friends! Shoot the party crashers down!

name: Merri Puzzle
short_description: Merri Puzzle is a physics based puzzle solving game, with a unique look and feel to it. The goal is simple, getting an object, often a ball to the end of a maze.

name: Elo Hell
short_description: Elo Hell is a one-of-a-kind game that employs a 3 part user experience: Play the narrative, play the minigames, climb in Echo Star. You ain't never played a game like this.

name: Exocomets
short_description: Exocomets is a basic yet difficult action game where you try to survive as long as possible against incoming waves of comets. One hit, and your ship is dead. Survive for as long as possible by collecting powerups and stars to beat every level!

name: Wonfourn
short_description: Wonfourn challenges you to fulfill your destiny by embarking on a grand adventure seeking fame, fortune and glory. The firstborn chosen child from each of the games 6 nations have come of age and must prove their worth in an epic quest of survival.

name: Beta Runner
short_description: Prepare yourself for the ultimate, "run till you die" game, which pits you against a maniacal programmer - a smart AI that intuitively adapts to your level of gameplay. Prove you're not just another one of his "guinea pigs" as he throws ever increasingly complex challenges at you. His goal is your frustration.

name: The Wolf's Bite
short_description: The Wolf's Bite is a one-versus-one choose-your-own-adventure game with an entrepreneur fairy tale twist. Inspired by stories such as "The Three Little Pigs" and "The Stinky Cheeseman and Other Fairly Stupid Tales", the game revolves around thwarting the other player while ensuring your business thrives.

name: SkiFy
short_description: SkiFy is a flight simulator where you can explore different biomes, collect objects and go through levels accompanied by relaxing music.

name: Better Off Tread
short_description: Better Off Tread is a nonstop arena combat game with up to twelve players squaring off against each other using a collection of unusual – and often comical – armored vehicles.

name: Mr. Triangle's Maze
short_description: Escape a sinister maze and take on the Maze Masters in this retro styled puzzle game!

name: Fantasya Final Definitiva REMAKE
short_description: Dois clássicos do RPG Maker que conquistaram os brasileiros a uma década atrás, agora reunidos em uma única compilação na Steam!

name: King Erik
short_description: In this Medieval 2D platformer game, you play as King Erik, a young man who has acquired the Scepter of Might and must fight his way through tricky passages and deadly contraptions to regain his kingdom from the clutches of his Uncle's Saxon armies!

name: PLANETS OF WAR
short_description: This is a Short Clicking Adventure Game in which you Save Earth from an Alien Invasion.

name: RadianVR
short_description: RadianVR is an old-school puzzle game with a twist. Colors are materials. Matching is based on rotation. Everything is realistic. With a wide range of special effects—such as locking, rainbow blocks and automatic flipping—the depth and difficulty increase as you play.

name: THE HOUCHI PLAY -THE 放置プレイ-
short_description: The aim of this game is to maneuver Taro Heibon and get close to the cos-play girls without being noticed. It's the right time to get close to them when they are facing away, so try to move closer before they face round. After passing all the stages, you can register the girls in your Gallery.

name: 电竞俱乐部/ESports Club
short_description: ESports Club is a sim game based on electronic sports industry, including most popular game types such as FPS and MOBA. What are you still waiting for? Start your esports career now!

name: ROMBY
short_description: In ROMBY you will earn points by placing 4 and even more figures of one color in a straight line. Earn more points and open all hidden girls. Trust me it won't be easy.

name: Sorcerer's Dream
short_description: Boy meets girl against a backdrop of magical battles in a dramatic visual novel!

name: Heat
short_description: Survive the wilderness, build a home, raise a family, and expand your territory. Gain power as President, deliver justice as Sheriff, fight for your tribe as Chief, or show some southern hospitality as Governor. Begin your new life in 19th century America.

name: APEX Tournament
short_description: Apex Tournament is the most fast-paced Team Death Match in VR. The primary method of movement is the Hyper Dash system, which turns your body into the controller - allowing movements at blazing speeds.

name: Fractus
short_description: Abstract arcade action!

name: RD's Adventure Mini Golf
short_description: RD's Adventure Mini Golf - Chip & Putt Edition is a game I developed for my Son. It comes packed with 3 x 18 hole courses, with additional courses to be added in future updates! The version you are about to purchase (I hope) or download if your already own the game is a complete redesign of the game.

name: Planet Protector VR
short_description: Defend your city from alien invaders in this colorful virtual reality game! Aim, shoot, and protect your planet for as long as you can!

name: Outpost L5
short_description: Battle wave after wave of invading aliens in the last Space Outpost protecting Earth. Outpost L5 is a Virtual Reality game that will take you back to Classic 8-Bit Arcades, but now in an immersive first person shooter. Alien Identity "It's Space Invaders in VR!"

name: SOLITAIRE ULTRA
short_description: The best Solitaire game on Steam! Get lost in space and time as you chill out to classic Solitaire gameplay, beautiful high-def visuals, awesome ambient soundtrack, and tons of unlockables.

name: UnderMine
short_description: An action-adventure roguelike with a bit of RPG tossed in. Adventure deep into the UnderMine and discover powerful relics, deadly enemies, hidden secrets, and a few friends to help along the way.

name: BOUNCED
short_description: BOUNCED, is a beautiful low-poly 3D Platforming game that is easy to play, but hard to master.

name: Chicken Daddy
short_description: You are a man in a chicken onesie. You have nothing except your new family of chicks who follow you everywhere you go. Think fast and defend your family against the hordes of giant worms of destruction!

name: Attrition: Tactical Fronts
short_description: Attrition: Tactical Fronts is a quick play, turn-based strategy game for 1-2 players. Matches can take as little as 5 minutes while offering strategic variety and depth.

name: Explomania
short_description: Explomania is a physically based game with untraditional gaming mechanics. You place property modifiers within the level to determine property, strength and direction of the action.

name: Alien Hallway 2
short_description: We're happy to present a new game in the Alien Shooter universe! Get prepared to unique tactical gameplay, lots of monster types and 8 fighter types allowing you create your own style of completing missions and defeating bosses.

name: Vostok Inc.
short_description: Do you love money? You’re the newly appointed CEO of Vostok Inc. As a greedy, space-capitalist your ultimate goal is to make as much as you can.

name: Hidden Animals: English - Spanish
short_description: Hidden Animals: English - Spanish is a relaxing hidden object game with the aim to teach you the Spanish names of animals featuring exclusive piano music. (You can use the program to study English as well if you are a Spaniard).

name: Automobile Tycoon
short_description: Car manufacturing company simulator. Turn-based, fast paced, covers 100 years of automotive history.

name: Epic Car Factory
short_description: Epic Car Factory puts you in the drivers seat of your very own car company. Build, market, hire, fire, and more in this fast paced business simulation. The failure and success of the company depends entirely on your decisions and how you react to the ever changing market place.

name: Pro Gamer Manager 2
short_description: Pro Gamer Manager 2 is an e-sport simulator game. Create, manage and compete with your own team of Pro Gamers. Conquer all obstacles and become the number one team in the world!

name: A2Be - A Science-Fiction Narrative
short_description: In the far future, the invention of instantaneous and waste-free transportation has brought a new age of utopia for humanity. Explore this brave vision of our destiny, and see its many wonders.

name: Shadow Bug
short_description: Leap, slash, splash! You are the overpowered ninja hero Shadow Bug! Save your home forest from the evil factory by slicing monsters to pieces.

name: Castaway Home Designer
short_description: People are calling this app the best game to design your own interiors in! Create beautiful, stylish interiors that show how creative you are! Youtubers can't stop streaming Castaway games, download and find out why!

name: In the Raven Shadow
short_description: In the Raven Shadow is in the best sense an old-fashioned adventure game for all sense-seeking people.

name: Claws of Furry
short_description: Punch and claw your way through forty fast paced levels of pure mayhem, while honing your Ninja Cat skills, in order to rescue your Master from the evil claws of an unknown enemy.

name: Eight-Minute Empire
short_description: Eight-Minute Empire is the super-quick area control game requiring tough decisions. It’s easy to learn and perfect for when you only have a few minutes. ⏱

name: Slash It Ultimate
short_description: Play the rhythm of a song through various game modes and compete with other players!

name: Red Wake Carnage
short_description: Red Wake Carnage is an intense action shooter that will take you on an epic journey of fighting the world’s most horrifying animals!

name: Circuit Warz
short_description: The hardest electronics game you will ever play, only good engineers need apply. Test your understanding of electronic circuits to save the planet in a desperate race against time. The laser protection system has been sabotaged…You have minutes to fix the circuits, repair the generator by solving the circuits correctly, fire the laser...

name: Dead of Night
short_description: Dead of Night is a 2D flipscreen adventure game inspired by such 8-bit classics as Spike in Transylvania, Bride of Frankenstein, Werewolves of London and the Dizzy series.

name: Kalzor: 2000
short_description: Shoot different types of spaceships while avoiding getting shot yourself. Kill 10 minutes at a time with this affordable colourful timewaster.

name: Fantasy Mosaics 15: Ancient Land
short_description: Enjoy new multi-color mosaic puzzles in prehistoric settings! Join the penguin family on a journey to an ancient land and discover the mysteries of the penguin ancestors! Enjoy this new collection of mosaic puzzles in a variety of colors while exploring the prehistoric landscape.

name: Bomb Defense
short_description: A completely different take on the tower defense genre. Combining it with the Puzzle genre, making for a difficult game. Buy traps, bombs, turrets and walls and place them in optimal positions to defend against enemies.

name: Medieval Steve
short_description: Steve - a magic pile of armour - is destined save the world. Use your abilities in this fast paced side-scroller, to help you crush your enemies, collect gems and upgrade your character, making you stronger, faster and unstoppable!

name: RICO
short_description: Two cops, one case and only 24 hours to bust the bad guys! Become a loose cannon police detective and face off with criminal gangs in this procedurally-generated action movie FPS. Join forces with a friend and take down those crooks, buddy-cop style!

name: Block Robot Mini Survival Game
short_description: In this action game you can try your survival and strategy skills as well.You available to choose different characters like ironman,  soldiers or many more. Enjoy the low-poly visual experience. Play together with your friends and share your victory!

name: Cosmonator
