short_description: NanoScape is a first person, action, space shooter inspired by Galaga and other classic wave based arcade games.

name: 沙漠飞车 Desert Racer
short_description: 《沙漠飞车》是全球首款AR+VR双人互动赛车类游戏，在游戏中玩家可以扮演车手驾驶赛车，也可扮演副驾驶攻击其他车辆。

name: Within Whispers: The Fall
short_description: Dive into the character of a young woman dealing with her brother's disappearance on the battleground. Trapped in the horrors of war, she can see and communicate with ghosts of dead soldiers. While struggling with this unusual 'gift', there is one ghost she is hoping not to meet.

name: True or False Universe
short_description: Challenge yourself to learn new and interesting things every day with the new free-to-play trivia game!

name: Ski Hard: Lorsbruck 1978
short_description: Minimalist retro skiing. Hard. Physics based. Occasionally infuriating.

name: Midnight Quest
short_description: Midnight Quest is an adventure style point and click game. You play as an assistant to a brilliant scientist who conducts experiments with time. Once in the laboratory, an accident occurred, but you can fix everything by solving fascinating puzzles.

name: Hippo Sports
short_description: Train with the clumsy hippo and push him to excel in fun activities! Whether it’s karate, jump rope or trampoline acrobatics – there’s something for everyone!

name: Guppy
short_description: Guppy is a 2D watercolor fish simulation. Hide in the shade of lilies and venture carefully into the open in search of food. Try not to get eaten.

name: A Writer And His Daughter
short_description: VR story exploration game. A young girl discovers a magical fairy tale world and has to decide which world she wants to stay in. Part one of a trilogy.

name: Dungeon Warfare 2
short_description: Become a dungeon lord to defend your dungeons with the deadliest of traps and insidious contraptions against greedy adventurers and wannabe heroes.

name: WackIt
short_description: WackIt is a wacky action packed VR whacking experience. The goal is simple, whack moles with your mallet. If you do a good enough job, you will progress to more difficult levels, and if you do a really good job, you will get the tools to whack like you've never whacked before.

name: DemonsTier
short_description: From the union of Riddled Corpse and Xenon Valkyrie comes Demonstier, an RPG roguelike with elements of action, adventure, & arcade. Enter the dungeons of king Thosgar & destroy the demonic beings present there .

name: Tooth and Claw
short_description: VR title for use with the HTC Vive. Player vs Player gameplay. Steam Achievements.

name: Through Blocks
short_description: You control two players by the same pressing. Your task is to adjust the situation to yourself so that you can perform all the necessary actions.

name: Screamer 2
short_description: Six winding, wildly dangerous tracks with varying levels of difficulty, terrain, driving conditions and configurations.Power to customize up to 20 high performance race cars means you can check yourself before you wreck yourself.Incredible physics for real-time jumping, turning, spinning, and twisting.

name: Deep Sky Derelicts
short_description: Deep Sky Derelicts is an original combination of turn-based strategy and RPG, enriched with tactical card combat and popular roguelike elements. Explore derelict alien ships, fight, loot and upgrade your gear, all in distinctive retro-futuristic comic book aesthetic style.

name: Neon the Ninja
short_description: NEON THE NINJA is a punk rock platformer where you hide in plain sight and bring swords to the gun fight. Slay each boss and take their power if you don’t smash your controller first! Are You Ninja Enough?

name: UKNON Jones & Guynelk - Awesome!
short_description: After a tragedy, UKNON Jones, Guynelk and Elsa LOVELUST decide to meet the doctor Gamma to save their friends. Explore this open world and find all the hidden G-atoms in the world to power the time machine from the doctor to hope to change things!

name: Scorn
short_description: Scorn is an atmospheric first-person horror adventure game set in a nightmarish universe of odd forms and somber tapestry.

name: Rise of the Third Power
short_description: Rise of the Third Power is a retro-themed, console-style roleplaying game, loosely based on the political climate of Europe in the late 1930's. The story takes place in the land of Rin during the height of the Age of Sail, following the events that would lead to the greatest war in human history.

name: Loot'N Shoot
short_description: In a world driven by automation, you jump into one of many warehouse robots that experience a malfunction and start fighting each other with everything they can find. The objective of this fast-paced game is to defeat all enemies in multiple themed warehouses before they can defeat you.

name: Watch Me Jump
short_description: An entirely different kind of basketball game. A narrative-driven journey told in four quarters.

name: Doki Doki Literature Club!
short_description: The Literature Club is full of cute girls! Will you write the way into their heart? This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

name: PAPER FIRE ROOKIE (Formerly Paperville Panic)
short_description: Winner Australian Video Game Developer Award 2019 VR Game of the Year. Voted by Kotaku reader poll as Australian Videogame of the Year 2018. Built exclusively for VR - fight fires, shoot water pistols, blast water shotguns, power water gattling guns, battle bosses and axe & smash your way through buildings.

name: Puzzle Dating
short_description: Hello! I'm a matchmaking game.

name: Metaverse Keeper / 元能失控
short_description: Metaverse Keeper is a dungeon crawler with roguelike elements where four heroes join forces to save the “Metaverse" – created when a cosmic event tangled space-time. Explore randomly-generated worlds, customize your weapons, and fight crazy monsters – in solo or co-op mode!

name: Slash/Dots.
short_description: Let's cut wood and hit balls against each other ! Simple refreshed puzzle game "Slash/Dots" !

name: Cliffstone Manor
short_description: Enter a mysterious manor full of surprises and intrigue. Cliffstone Manor pits you against an eccentric millionaire inventor who wants to try and recruit you for his mysterious “Enterprise”. Do you have what it takes to solve the puzzles and meet his challenge?

name: Chaos and the White Robot
short_description: [no description]

name: Battlemage Training
short_description: In Battlemage Training you are an aspiring Battlemage. Practice swinging your war wand with speed and precision.

name: sWORD MASTER
short_description: sWORDMASTER is a spelling game which aims to provide a good time to both the casual players and the ones that like to take on some challenges. Sit back and start spelling while listening to the calm music the game provides.

name: ONLY A
short_description: Inside a digital world where everything is digital, a touch to any letter can slash you into pieces. But there is a letter which doesn't hurt you.. that's letter "A".. thus Only A..

name: Unsettled
short_description: Unsettled is a short single-player first-person adventure game. Experience the most exciting journey of your life against the background of the beautiful landscapes of the northern mountains.

name: Millidor
short_description: Миллидор – глобальная клиентская онлайн стратегия в лучших традициях классического fantasy. Миллидор дает возможность стать правителем своего королевства. Суровым, деспотичным воякой или, наоборот, дипломатичным торговцем – выбор за вами!

name: Jake's Love Story
short_description: Everyday life comedy, where your choices matter.

name: Megaton: Total Destruction
short_description: Guilt free destruction of beautiful cities around the world! With an unique armory of insane explosive projectiles to choose from, destruction has never been so fun!

name: World War Z
short_description: World War Z is a heart-pounding coop third-person shooter for up to 4 players featuring massive swarms of hundreds of zombies, focused on fast-paced, gruesomely spectacular action.

name: Rex: Another Island
short_description: An open world adventure inspired by the classics. Get lost in a wide world of precarious platforming that will take you back to a simpler time...

name: A Plot Story
short_description: Learn how a girl Lily managed to frustrate the plans of mean Duchess and to save the Crown Prince.

name: Fell Seal: Arbiter's Mark
short_description: Fell Seal: Arbiter's Mark is a turn-based tactical RPG with a focus on storytelling and strategic battles. Unfold a mature story as you progress through hand-crafted scenarios, controlling your own group of Arbiters, with each character customizable from a wide selection of classes and abilities!

name: Human-powered spacecraft
short_description: A nostalgia-infused pixel clicker in a comedy wrapper.

name: Birdcakes
short_description: "Ptooey! Ptooey! Ptooey!” - That´s the glorious sound of bullets in this 2D shooter platformer! Step in a world of state-of-the-art Cupcakes weaponry! After a picnic went horribly wrong, Pancake the Cupcake desperately tries to fend off hungry flies away from his girlfriend Cherry!

name: Keyboard Killers
short_description: Keyboard Killers is a difficult reflex game in which you destroy meteors in order to save your starship and your friend dragon(^-^) . You must be very fast to able to complete the game. More then 500 apm on most challenging levels.

name: The Iron Oath
short_description: Command, endure, and prosper in The Iron Oath, a turn-based tactical RPG where the fate of your mercenary company rests on your decisions. Customize your roster, build your renown, and discover the secrets that await in the medieval fantasy realm of Caelum.

name: The market trader
short_description: This is a trading and city building strategy game. You control a trader who develop a village.You earn money by trading the produced products myself or others to other villages. For example crap,cloth,wood,milk,book,sword,shield,shell,gem Let's develop the economy with your hands.

name: Knife Club
short_description: Welcome to the club. Knife Club puts your reflexes and throwing skills to the test. With head to head online combat, it is the adrenaline pumping multiplayer experience the VR community has been waiting for.

name: Labyrinthian
short_description: A simple game with no puzzles, no traps, and no enemies. Just you and a maze. Can you find the treasure at the end?

name: Brindilyl Legends: The Story of Landon
short_description: Landon is about a 22 year old rebel, which also is society's only saviour. He thinks, because he's arrogant. He's out on a mission to hinder the communist regime based on Mars.

name: The Doorbreaker
short_description: The Doorbreaker is a story about one very patient person who has a long way to go in the obscurity. The game includes more than 26 different levels where you have to break doors with a random chance. This game requires you to be patient and tough, I warn you!

name: The New California
short_description: Tubiacanga, 1910. A Rio de Janeiro small city lives the most disgusting crime of it's history: the defunct's bones theft!

name: Argonus and the Gods of Stone
short_description: The creators of Shadowgate present Argonus and the Gods of Stone, an epic first-person adventure set in ancient Greece. Stranded on an uncharted isle, you must use your wits to unlock legendary mysteries, barter with gods and overcome an evil that threatens to bring the world to ruin...

name: Pixel Skater
short_description: Pixel Skater is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game with precise controls, a deep combo system, and an extraordinarily detailed level editor. Play, build, and compete online with your friends. Not a social butterfly? Enjoy an immersive story mode, challenges, and even puzzles!

name: The Legendary Player - Make Your Reputation - OPEN BETA
short_description: Imagine a world where you can create your own legend. The Legendary Player – Make Your Reputation it’s a 2D RPG Top-Side Down with reputation building system who allows the player build his own history.

name: Trivia Vault: Science & History Trivia 2
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault: Science & History 2 and bring your thinking hat. Answer all new science and history category trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: PEG
short_description: Blue eats blue. Red eats red. Until one of each remains. A puzzler that is deceptively simple but hard to master.

name: Feudal Alloy
short_description: Feudal Alloy is an epic action adventure with fish-controlled medieval robots! Explore an unusual medieval world with a fish-controlled robot, Attu. Improve your combat techniques and skills by smashing many kinds of mechanical creatures in a beautiful hand-drawn world.

name: Monopolka
short_description: Standard Monopoly Game

name: DYING: Reborn
short_description: DYING: Reborn is a first-person Room Escape puzzle game in which players must tackle all kinds of puzzles in a series of dark and eerie environments. Gameplay revolves around collecting, discovering and putting together pieces of a twisted story that will make your hair stand on end...

name: Rose and Lotus: Petals of Memories
short_description: [Rose and Lotus:Petals of Memories] is based on Korean traditional fairy tales 'Janghwa, Hongryeon'.The main character, Janghwa, awake from the cold floor without her memory.Find the truth behind the dark mansion and get out of it with your sister Hongryeon.

name: Timension
short_description: Timension is a puzzle game in which players are able to reverse time to 15 seconds ago to finish the mission impossible.

name: BANNERMEN
short_description: A singleplayer fast-paced classic RTS game in which you take on the role of a fallen lord on his journey back to become one of the mightiest in the medieval realm of Valtoria.

name: RideOp - Thrill Ride Simulator
short_description: RideOp puts you in control of some of the biggest and most thrilling theme park rides in the world. Give all your guests the most unforgettable experience! With full control of the ride's motion, you can offer a unique journey every ride. Now it's your turn to create thrilling experiences!

name: Endless Fables 2: Frozen Path
short_description: Pamela Cavendish returns for another adventure! The famous anthropologist ventures into the northern reaches of Europe to rescue a friend who went missing while following the trail of Norse gods. Is this mere coincidence or is there something more behind the legend of Loki and Hodur?

name: Pegasus Door
short_description: As professor Finn, you must eliminate all the waves of ennemies send to get you back to the organisation you created but left in a rush. Protect your armory from damages with the weapons at your disposal, buy new ones and upgrade them with the money you collect from your frags.

name: Mustdashe
short_description: You have sixty seconds to make everything look awesome! Unleash the force of facial hair with the fabled Stash Knuckles and rack up points to get highscores and unlock achievements.

name: Dummy Life
short_description: DUMMY LIFE is a science fiction hacking puzzle game. Play as CYPH3R, a test dummy specialized in hacking. Manipulate devices such as surveillance cameras, security doors, moving platforms, pressure plates, teleporters, laser traps and other robots to assist you in your escape.

name: Medieval Battle: Europe
short_description: Fight various battles across Europe throughout the medieval ages.

name: Civil War: 1864
short_description: Civil War: 1864 is the latest addition to our Civil War strategy series, bringing you the ferocious battles from 1864. Experience the American Civil War like never before with with over 40 missions; including 20 detailed historical battles.

name: Despotism 3k
short_description: Humanity is enslaved by an AI… which is awesome, because we’re on the right side of the conflict. Exploit puny humans to extract power and build your own empire!

name: Freshly fried shrimps seemed hot additionally named noth
short_description: A laughable 2D-RPG made with RPG Maker MV

name: MEMETYPER
short_description: MEMETYPER is a game in which you can check your typing skills. Learn about new memes or try to remember the old ones by typing their title to unlock description in meme encyclopedia. Have fun :)

name: Breath
short_description: The Breath is an experimental videogame for single player. Player act as a man, looking for something in the desert. Wandering, breathing, memory appeared, about her. He start imagine, and impatience won't let him rest. At the top of the dune, he saw a crystal tree. He can't tell. He is confused.

name: VirtuGO
short_description: VirtuGO is a classic puzzle game. Colored tiles come at you nonstop, and you must put them on your carrying platform and arrange them as best you can on a 5x5 grid.

name: MAGIX PC Check & Tuning 2018 Steam Edition
short_description: Tried and true on over 10 million PCs around the world. PC Check & Tuning increases your PC's performance and keeps software and drivers up-to-date.

name: Life is Feudal: MMO
short_description: Experience the hardcore reality of the Middle Ages. Master survival, engage in deep-rooted RPG elements, navigate a bustling economy, build communities, and employ diplomatic strategy to thrive in Abella's vast expanse.

name: Bees Knees
short_description: Take control of the state of the art, Robotically Assisted Pneumatic Horticultural All Environment Levitator (Often simply called R.A.P.H.A.E.L), the latest weapon deployed by the honey industry in the war on bugs.

name: Space Station Continuum
short_description: Space Station Continuum is a building & management sim inspired by the past, present, and future of humans in space.

name: Spooky Station
short_description: Welcome to Spooky Station! Prepare to be amazed and bewildered by our enigmas and puzzles, afraid of our deadly enemies and extremely challenging bosses. Tons of exciting stories and distinct fictional worlds await for you in this mysterious pack!

name: FROG X BIRD
short_description: Daring amphibian warriors take flight to prove themselves as TOP FROG OF THE ARENA.

name: Semblance
short_description: Semblance is an innovative platformer with deformable terrain, set in a beautiful minimalist world. It’s a game that asks, what if you could deform and reshape the world itself? Semblance takes the idea of a ‘platform’ in a platformer and turns it on its head.

name: Deserving Life
short_description: Deserving Life is a room-scale virtual reality escape game for the HTC Vive and was developed by students in the Media Technology and Design program at the Hagenberg Campus of the University of Applied Sciences Upper Austria. Can you find a way out of your misery?

name: 20 Minute Metropolis - The Action City Builder
short_description: Construct the infrastructure to rebuild civilization. Set up supply lines, mine skyscrapers for plastics, and find a place to process all the poop your people will generate. You have twenty minutes.

name: ONE™ Legacy
short_description: ONE™ Legacy is a science fiction action game with adventure elements. This is a first-person shooter with a deep plot and an open world.

name: Project Genesis
short_description: Explore galactic worlds and decide the future of deep space in Project Genesis, a fast-paced, multiplayer first-person shooter that features deep space combat in sci-fi battle craft. Fight as a conscious AI in sci-fi environments and navigate the complex forces competing for stellar domination.

name: Boratium Wars
short_description: Boratium Wars is a fast paced arcade style space shooter. Your skills are put to the test, as you attempt to collect Boratium from deep space, while avoiding enemies, mines, and more. Supports keyboard and mouse, as well as controller play. Tons of fun!

name: Music Racer 2000
short_description: Music Racer 2000 is a music-adapting racing/runner/action game in an aesthetic retrowave world where you use your music to race your unique cars!

name: SCP: Secret Laboratory
short_description: Deep within a secure underground facility, a sudden containment breach allows many of the secured anomalies to escape from their chambers. Assist the Foundation in re-securing the facility, help the Insurgency in their goal to capture it, or wreak havoc as an SCP in a frantic bid to escape.

name: Galacatraz: Eject Equip Escape
short_description: Escape Galacatraz, the universe's most secure detainment facility, in this side scrolling twin stick shooter! GAMEPAD REQUIRED!

name: KnightOut
short_description: KnightOut is a local party brawler for 1-4 players! Play with or against your friends in a frantic battle. Half the battle is won by building an epic castle with deadly weapons and traps. Charge into sword duels or keep your distance with long range weapons.

name: Planet Bash
short_description: Save the environment and get rid of those pesky humans, bash and destroy their buildings, replacing them with trees to bring peace back to Earth.

name: Jellyfish
short_description: A simulation game about the life story of a jellyfish. In this game, I will present the full life cycle of a jellyfish: from an egg to a hydra and finally, after a not very long journey it becomes an adult jellyfish. A work of interactive art to bring the most beautiful of sea creatures to your screen.

name: Silentium 2D
short_description: Silentium 2D is a fun, classy, arcade based game which puts you and a friend in a 1v1 arena. Inspired by various arcade games, Silentium 2D was a hobby project designed to let younger audiences get their hands on a keyboard and quickly learn the intuitive controls.

name: Nine Worlds - A Viking saga
short_description: Something is amiss in Midgard, the world of the humans. You have sensed it for a long time now and lately it has gotten worse. You have just been on a successful raid on distant shores and your ship is filled with loot of treasures and artifacts. On the open sea your ship gets caught in a terrible storm.

name: Microsoft Allegiance
short_description: Allegiance is a team-based multiplayer space combat sim that seamlessly combines first-person space combat with a top-down-view perspective, real time strategy, and real time tactics. Team commanders build bases, research technology, and coordinate players to execute a wide range of strategies.

name: 玄龙棋MysteryChess
short_description: This game is a new chess game.new plays,new rule,new framework .It's a game about eastern dragon against western dragon.Simulation of nature. A variety of elements.A variety of plays.Pay attention to strategy as well as to rely on luck.It Can bring extraordinary fun.

name: 岚零之风 - Wind Horizon
short_description: 这里是岚零岛，远离大陆的海中孤岛。在一次风暴过后，人们发现森林里的动物全都销声匿迹了。为了调查这种异象，洛零再一次前往森林。这次，他终于遭遇了造成异常的“犯人”，而除此以外，还有一位来头微妙的“外来者”现身了……

name: Shift Quantum - A Cyber Noir Puzzle Platformer
short_description: Shift Quantum is a brain-busting platformer using a unique mechanic called SHIFTING, a way to twist your environment and invert space around you. Bend your mind to reach the exit of each level and unveil the secrets of a strange program. Extend the experience, create and share your own levels.

name: Derora
short_description: Set in a beautiful world and designed solely for VR, Derora is a captivating puzzle game and competitive climbing experience. Throw, grab and hop your way through each layer of the mystical rainforest, creating your own path to get back to your nest.

name: Druid's Tale: Crystal Cave
short_description: RPG game with crafting elements. Become a Druid that is protecting your land from darkness. Make potions, poisons and even alcohol. Trade your products with neutral factions and fight the forces of evil. The game emphasizes new solutions that have not been applied anywhere else!

name: Beyond the Void
short_description: Beyond the Void is a new hybrid strategy game in space, with RTS and MOBA mechanics. It's F2P. Experience the thrill of being a Captain and lead epic space wars in 1 vs1. Design your own strategy and fleet to become the one who'll dominate the galaxy!

name: Ghostly Horizon
short_description: Ghostly Horizon is an intense 3rd-person spell-caster on round planets. You enjoy crazy battles with over 30 different spells, preferably together with your friends. Focus is placed on both player-skill and teamwork in this matchbased game with quick rounds. Can you top the Leaderboards?

name: Evil Genius 2: World Domination
short_description: A satirical spy-fi lair builder where YOU are the criminal mastermind! Construct your base, train your minions, defend your operations from the Forces of Justice, and achieve global domination!

name: DungeonGOGO
short_description: DungeonGOGO is a challenging precision platformer where you escape from a light prison and help rescue your friends from the secret chambers where they are being held.

name: Temple of Aluxes
short_description: Have you ever wanted to explore a lost temple? This is your chance. Find the treasures and escape the Temple of Aluxes by solving various puzzles and challenges.

name: Adventure Golf VR
short_description: A minigolf adventure for all ages! Discover dinosaurs, robots and a cranky mushroom!

name: Keyboard Sports - Saving QWERTY
short_description: You play as the young apprentice to Master QWERTY who takes you on a wild adventure across oceans, through temples and into dreams in the search for your inner key using the entire keyboard as your controller.

name: Dungeoneer
short_description: Dungeoneer is a pre-rendered first-person-perspective interactive cinematic story experience that sees you take on the role of a knight venturing into the dark depths of an unknown dungeon...!!

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Portal Power
short_description: Shredder and the Kraang have spread chaos and evil across dimensions, and it's up to the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles to stop them!

name: The Battle Of Mahjong
short_description: You can only find out the fun of playing “Mahjong” by yourself, I'm sure you'll addicted to it. Don’t hesitate, come and join “ THE BATTLE OF MAHJONG”!

name: ZoneDriver
short_description: Races in the stalkers' setting, developed by the efforts of two enthusiasts. Check your accuracy at the wheel of a flying bucket. The game does not try to be a substitute for your favorite entertainment, but it can give you several hours of fun if you give it a chance.

name: TFM: The First Men
short_description: An open-world colony sim based on stories of the first men. Infinite possibilities await your very own Adam and Eve as they embark on a generation-spanning adventure. How will you shape their future?

name: Immersive Poetry
short_description: Enjoy an interesting twist on classic poetry by solving puzzles and following the story of the Wilkins Family. From the islands of Finland to the snowy mountains of Russia, you’ll explore and experience beautiful maps based on real world locations.

name: Kingdom: The Far Reaches
short_description: A unique gameplay style based on using the right items in the right situations, or else...Lots of classic cartoon video footageYou’ll be surprised how easy it is to die in a fantasy world!

name: Royal Agents: Sweet Zombie
short_description: Royal Agents: Sweet Zombie is a turn-based squad game with unlikely agents trying to stop evil in time for tea. You control a team of three agents of the crown with different skills and backgrounds, tasked with the assignment to investigate and stop any evil-doings in a graveyard.

name: Placement
short_description: Placement is a minimalist logic puzzle game based on chess.

name: TangramsVR
short_description: TangramsVR is a virtual reality puzzle game designed for Oculus and HTC Vive. Players face puzzles of outlined objective shapes. Players must move the provided blocks to fit inside the objective.

name: Gunship Battle2 VR: Steam Edition
short_description: Take control of the most advanced gunship cockpit on the planet! Complete with episodic story, VR cut scenes and immersive gameplay, this game is not just another VR experience, but a full-fledged game. Indulge yourself in this action packed journey now!

name: Gurugedara
short_description: Guru Gedara is a leading platform for interacting with the teachers and students. Meet friends and attend classes in a virtual environment.

name: CometStriker DX
short_description: CometStriker DX is a fast-paced arcade-style shooter where you boost through danger and blast everything in your way!

name: Supersonic Tank Cats
short_description: Supersonic Tank Cats is a fast race-and-battle karts game featuring unconventional half-kitty and half-combat vehicles. Move in cartoony racetracks as you use hilarious weapons against your rivals to reach the goal before anyone else.

name: Amoreon NightClub
short_description: The Amoreon NightClub is a single player disco, where you can dance with virtual characters, challenge yourself to gain points by following the dance moves, select songs and add your own music. You can see your own VR body, use your hands and fingers with thumb sticks.

name: Kingdom Two Crowns
short_description: Gather coins, build defenses and reclaim your fallen Kingdom. Explore and uncover secrets, unlock new technologies and protect your crown versus waves of Greed monsters that come at night. Kingdom is a solo or co-op micro-strategy and tower defense game set in an atmospheric pixel world.

name: REBOUND ARENA
short_description: Enter The Arena in a fast-paced PvP game where skill and reflexes will reward you as you stomp your opponents into dust

name: Askutron Quiz Show
short_description: Askutron Quiz Show is a trivia game for up to 8 players that can be played with keyboard/mouse, gamepads or mobile devices. It features fully voiced questions both for official and user-generated questions.

name: Legendary Mahjong
short_description: Enjoy a new way to play Mahjong, with varied styles of challenged as you progress. Have the option to customize your game with the layout and tiles of your choice. Get set for a brilliant Mahjong Game with an accompanying campaign to get you well entertained.

name: Fate Crawler
short_description: Fate Crawler is a dynamic and colorful adventure featuring both classical and new Rogue-like elements. Choose your hero and lead his fate by changing various events into your favor. Combine unique abilities and artifacts to form individual play style for each run.

name: Pop Pop Boom Boom VR
short_description: You brought a bow to a bomb fight. Challenge: Survive.

name: El Tango de la Muerte
short_description: Do the tango to win the heart of your loved one! Each song in this casual RHYTHM game will unveil the story of Luciano and Martita. Influenced by games like OSU and Crypt of the Necrodancer, with a pinch of melodramatic humor, inspired by the best Latin American soap operas!

name: I_AM.exe
short_description: I_AM.exe is a first person action game with a focus on exploration. You wake up inside a vat on a strange place full of robots trying to kill you. Explore, solve puzzles and fight your way through different areas as you try to find a way out and understand what is going on and just who are you.

name: Ne no Kami - The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto Part 2
short_description: Kyoto is shrouded in silence. While the Ayakashi change course and prepare themselves for invasion, a sudden turn of events suddenly has Len drawing her sword against Shinonome. What brought upon this drastic course of events?

name: Phantom Jump
short_description: Phantom Jump is a skill based platformer with rhythm mechanics, built to turn you into a speedrunner.

name: Billiards
short_description: Realistic and very easy to play billiards simulation with five different games: 9-Ball, 8-Ball, Straight, 3-Balls and Snooker

name: TTV2
short_description: TTV2 is an arcade retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame, sequel to Trip to Vinelands.

name: EVIL STAR
short_description: EVIL STAR is a horizontal scroll strategy leisure arcade game, you just need to use the left and right button to control the spaceship! You need to operate your spaceship to avoid asteroids, collect energy balls. Steam clouds and leaderboards supported, compete with your friends now!

name: Ninja Goemon and Immortal Jewels
short_description: Goemon,originally the Iga ninja, and his fellow, Chutaro, the master rat, helped a certain woman on one day and got a red jewel. .. Goemon is going to sell this precious jewel which is told to bring luck, but people chasing a jewel an outcome ... they are rolled up in the plot.

name: Dungeons of the Fallen
short_description: Weave spells, grab epic loot and kill hordes of enemies in an epic tale of the rise of the Fallen King. Also make sure You won't get crushed by merciless bosses while you're at it.

name: Saint George | The Tree Of Secrets
short_description: Embark on a new breed of medieval-fantasy arcade plaformer and explore extensive worlds packed with loots, creatures and humongous boss

name: KROTRUVINK
short_description: This story is about a single person who was unsure of the nature of things and the physical integrity of things around him. Everyday this man went to his job and dreamed of a time in which, it seems, he didn't exist. But then one day after our protagonist took the bus to work, he got off on...a ship.

name: The Legend of Slime
short_description: Become the leader of slime, and play a match three puzzle game!

name: 2D Neon Cube
short_description: 2D Neon Cube - it's beautiful and not difficult to pass the game. Exciting obstacles and graphical effects. Move the main character to the portal and try not to die!

name: Yi and the Thousand Moons
short_description: Yi and the Thousand Moons is a short video game musical written and developed by David Su. Through the course of several original interactive songs, featuring a full cast and live band, the game weaves a story of the archer Yi's journey to save her village.

name: Modest Kind
short_description: Modest Kind is a Rogue-lite Initiation Adventure. Ever heard of Entropy, The Selfish Gene and Schrödinger's cat? This action-heavy, story-driven top-down dungeon crawler will put your knowledge to the test. Your Path to Enlightment begins now.

name: L.S.S
short_description: L.S.S is a fast paced survival first person shooter. Use weapons, traps and throwable's to defeat the infected!

name: Triplicata
short_description: Triplicata is a new game that takes place in the not-so-distant future, after Gelatin Monsters came to life from radiation, and took over the world! Test your skills in battle against hundreds of monsters simultaneously in this epic gladiator style game!

name: Epic Dumpster Bear: Dumpster Fire Redux
short_description: An evil corporation destroyed his forest, now it's his turn to take out the trash

name: GIF: The Game of Inevitable Frustration
short_description: GIF is a light-hearted 2D platformer with a semi-retro/cartoony vibe. The objective is simple - try not to get frustrated. Although you will inevitably get frustrated.

name: The Witch's Isle
short_description: An adventure game that takes place in a dream-like town on a solitary island.

name: Swarm Queen
short_description: Swarm Queen is a quick-to-learn but tactical and challenging tug-of-war strategy game about insectoid aliens trying to murder each other.

name: Rocka Feller
short_description: Rocka Feller - a striking new take on classic 'rocks and gems' action-puzzle gaming, in the vein of such yesteryear greats as Boulderdash and Repton. Dig for the diamonds, rubies, sapphires and emeralds; take care with the boulders and beware the cave critters.

name: Starzine
short_description: As the remote-controlled exoplanet survey and reconnaissance drone SR-19 descends into the atmosphere of planet Xenos, it runs into trouble — and gets a little help. Starzine delivers fast-paced, 3D paddle-and-ball arcade action updated for the 21st century.

name: Splat the Blob
short_description: Join Splat the Blob on a cute adventure of helping Wilbur the elephant. Unlock new skills and zones by tackling obstacles and climbing to the top of the world.

name: Dawn of a Soul
short_description: Dawn of a Soul is a mathematical puzzle game about creating perfectly balanced paths by building chains and combos.

name: Short Stories Collection of Class Tangerine
short_description: Short Stories Collection of Class Tangerine is a collection of five Visual Novels by indie-game team "Class Tangerine".

name: Champions of Aerial
short_description: Champions of Aerial is a battle arena fighting game with up to four players where the goal is to under a series of rounds, push the other players off the platform and be the only one remaining, to be the Champion.

name: Survival Simulator VR
short_description: A sand-box virtual reality survival game. See if you can survive stranded on an island with only the objects you can scavenge or craft from resources available on the island.

name: Fish's Trip
short_description: Fish's Trip is a spin off of the game Kabitis, where Flop fish, of that game, is the main protagonist of this.

name: Sliding Blocks
short_description: Sliding Blocks is a fun and classic addictive puzzle game. The goal is to unblock the orange block out of the board by sliding the other blocks out of the way, try to unblock it with the minimal moves. Sliding Blocks with 4 difficulties of puzzles ranging from Beginner to Master.

name: Edmonton Trolley Car
short_description: Players take an immersive VR historically accurate trolley car ride down 1915 Whyte Avenue, and then over the High Level Bridge. All the while receiving points for interacting with in-game characters, and for viewing historical Edmonton landmarks.

name: Starbear: Taxi
short_description: A fast-paced, VR-native title that really delivers. Race a spaceship taxi around Starbear’s tiny, futuristic city to deliver busy bear passengers to their desired destinations. Bears gotta be places too, you know?!

name: The Song of Saya
short_description: Bear witness to a love that will change the world, in this classic horror romance visual novel from acclaimed writer Urobuchi Gen.

name: ASCII Wars
short_description: Protect the servers. Locate the vulnerabilities. Exterminate the viruses. This fast paced strategy game lets you enter terminal commands from a VR interface to defeat the viruses before you become overrun.

name: My Factory 我的工厂
short_description: 末日之后，重建工厂。研发科技，加强武装。收集材料，生产发财。

name: THE LAST BLADE 2
short_description: This widely revered NEOGEO masterpiece is finally available on STEAM! Not only a perfect port of the original game, the STEAM version of THE LAST BLADE 2 will allow players from across the globe to fight against each other online / locally in epic battles in online Multiplayer Mode.

name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97 GLOBAL MATCH
short_description: KOF ’97 is the final entry in the Orochi Saga, the original storyline of the KOF series, which is still played by enthusiastic fans around the world. KOF ’97 makes a return with new features such as online matchmaking, a new gallery mode, and custom menu BGM settings!

name: Deadly Footprints
short_description: Deadly Footprints is a top-down 2d horror game about being chased through a maze by a deranged killer who is following your footprints in the snow. How can you escape the killer when every step you take brings him closer to you?

name: Project Mercury
short_description: Make your way on foot, on a hoverbike, up skyscrapers, and down bottomless pits, as you exterminate a threat of unknown origin!

name: Rocketboat - Pilot
short_description: Far beyond the reaches of the Milky Way, a great darkness is looming. A clandestine force using powerful social manipulation techniques is controlling the resources of star systems throughout the universe. Their only existential threat appears to be a rock band from the planet Earth.

name: Mafia is Alive
short_description: Mafia is Alive - team psychological turn-based role-playing game with a detective story.In the settlement of Rondonville, citizens are killed every night. Among the citizens there are dangerous criminals "the Mafia". The chaos begins.At the beginning of the game, players get a random role.

name: Hero Rush: Mad King
short_description: An exciting game in which you will need to capture enemy cities, strengthen their economy, study all sorts of science and magic that will help your army defeat your enemies.

name: Lost with Dinosaurs
short_description: Collect power up that help you reach all placed in order to collect mushrooms. Avoid dinosaurs that will steal them from you

name: Princess Serena ~Raid of Demon Legion~
short_description: The Kingdom of Brazia was attacked by the demon legion. At this time, An angel suddenly came to Serena and said, "This world is about to fall into the hands of the devil, and only the family of the Brazia who can save it. Please lend me your power." Serena agreed, and set foot on the journey to save the world.

name: Touch My Spinner
short_description: It's just a clicker idle game. Rotate your fidget spinners, earn coins, do upgrades, open chests, buy new spinners, earn more coins and buy more new spinners.

name: Number World Adventure
short_description: Move all tiles and merge similar Numbers when they touch. Brake chains, melt the ice and overcome other obstacles to join the pieces to fulfil tasks on your numerical puzzle adventure in the Number World! Play 120 levels in the quest mode or set the highest score in various Challenge modes.

name: Tricks and Treats
short_description: Clear plates and collect candies to complete matching puzzle levels in a spooky setting. Charge powerups to blast through various obstacles and collect silver and gold to decorate your spooky mansion.

name: March of Empires
short_description: Claim your title as Shogun, Highland King, Northern Tsar or Desert Sultan and join this genre-redefining strategy game where you will wage constant war for real territorial conquest! Fortify your castle, fuel a massive army, and enter the ultimate fight for realm domination!

name: Avem888 VR
short_description: This classic arcade style flying VR game takes you through a everchanging landscape of objects you should avoid.

name: Hunters Life
short_description: Hunters Life is a game where you have to go through different rooms. Each room has a finish point and to solve this you need to find clues and combine them to open up next room.The game is simple, it can be finished quickly depending on your mind skills.

name: SCHOOL SIMULATOR MULTIPLAYER
short_description: Make you feel good in the school! Try what would it be like if you could do anything in the school break. Crush! Don’t kid yourself. Break out from the roll of eager beaver! You don’t have to worry about thing, just do it!

name: Seclusion: Islesbury
short_description: Seclusion: Islesbury is a mystery/horror adventure game with a focus on creating an absorbing journey. In this journey, you will explore various locations with countless mysteries to solve while trying to stay out of the madness that surrounds the town.

name: EZ4u
short_description: 23 incredible levels - layers of artifact which absorbed Boris. He needs to go out. Ez

name: Indygo
short_description: Indygo is a narrative game with elements of point'n'click set in one room only - painting workshop. It tells the story of a painter who suffers from depression. Solve puzzles and make decisions that affect how the game ends. Indygo attempts to show how people with depression can feel.

name: Wrecking Towers
short_description: in this crazy game the idea is put the build of your enemy down.

name: Donut County
short_description: Donut County is a story-based physics puzzle game where you play as an ever-growing hole in the ground. Meet cute characters, steal their trash, and throw them in a hole.

name: Wattam
short_description: Wattam is a game about the joys of friendship and discovery, from the imagination of Keita Takahashi (creator of Katamari Damacy and Noby Noby Boy) and developer Funomena.

name: Super Bomberman R
short_description: Bomberman is back and stronger than ever! The 8 Bomberman heroes journey to space to face the Evil Emperor Buggler! Classic Battle Mode is back! Challenge players around the world in online battles!

name: 午餐13
short_description: The future of the world, the global food crisis has finally forced the human to challenge the moral bottom line, in order to infinitely reduce the cost of breeding, scientists and pigs to carry out gene recombination, to produce a costless flesh and blood labor machine, that trapped in pigs and people synthetic monster The soul of the out

name: Shooty Skies
short_description: The creators of Crossy Road present Shooty Skies! Shoot, dodge, duck, goose and weave. Take to the skies!

name: By Any Means Necessary
short_description: The 2D RPG where you can't use items in battle. Follow Captain Yusef and his team on their quest to find the source of the monster spawning portal in this turn-based RPG.

name: BlazBlue: Cross Tag Battle
short_description: THE COLLISION IS INEVITABLE! THE IMPACT WILL BE UNAVOIDABLE! Cross over between 4 different universes! Play as characters from the BlazBlue, Persona, Under Night In-Birth, and (for the first time ever in a fighting game), RWBY series!

name: Time Barbarian Extreme!!
short_description: Time Barbarian Extreme!!A fast-paced shooter, inspired by retro arcades of the past.A penguin from the future... a barbarian from the past... fighting for survival in a broken world... really messed up world... seriously look at the moon!Pew, pew, pew, nuff said.

name: Packet Queen #
short_description: Divide up quickly and precisely the packets flowing one after another. Aim to get a higher score by putting them together in poker-style hands! This is a competitive-type active solitaire game. Includes VS Mode where you can compete against other players over the Internet.

name: Paper Shakespeare: To Date Or Not To Date?
short_description: Welcome to Elsinore Academy, a proving ground for young royalty; where people from all over the globe come for higher learning, and the cheerleaders are literal witches. Are you ready to enroll? Maybe get with Othello? Eh? EH?

name: Beer, Babes and Dragons
short_description: This "snack-sized" RPG will introduce you to a brand new series... It will (most likely) be the best +- 4 hrs of your life! ;-)

name: NewTypes
short_description: Simulation game of virtual spacecraft. VR(Vive) version and non VR version are included.

name: iHUGU: I Hug You
short_description: One hug can change the world. Hug once every creature you meet. Don’t forget anyone.

name: connect - Virtual Home (3D or VR)
short_description: connect is your customizable, social, multifunctional virtual home. You can play games, chat, make video calls, listen to music, watch TV, read a newspaper, surf the net, or meet friends. connect is a free, data protected virtual world and a device-independent interface (2D/3D/VR/AR) for all digital content.

name: Planet Zoo
short_description: Build a world for wildlife in Planet Zoo. From the developers of Planet Coaster and Zoo Tycoon comes the ultimate zoo sim. Construct detailed habitats, manage your zoo, and meet authentic living animals who think, feel and explore the world you create around them.

name: 冒险之路(Adventure Road)
short_description: A global service, real-time combat Strategy Role-Playing online games(SRPG).

name: Parabolus
short_description: Parabolus is a 3D space shooter with rocks in it. Kinda like Asteroids, if it took place in a Tron maze and also had a squad of enemies waiting to pounce on you around each corner. Clever thinking and quick reflexes are needed to get through this amazing sci-fi adventure.

name: Keeplanet
short_description: KEEPLANET is an arcade time-killer, standing up for people from the tiny planet in the middle of nowhere. Play as a World Commander, develop the planet, keep your inhabitants alive and protect them from aliens, space debris or even meteor rain.

name: Codename: Phantom
short_description: Go undercover and step into the shoes of an elite agent in a tactical puzzle-shooter game.

name: Ben 10
short_description: Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max once again have their cross-country road trip in the Rust Bucket cut short by super villains and their evil, world-threatening plans. As Ben Tennyson, it’s up to you to save the world.

name: Jumphobia Classic
short_description: Are you ready for the ultimate puzzle platforming challenge? There is no jump button, instead you automatically jump when you run off a ledge! You are going to need both skill and intelligence if you hope to beat this game!

name: AstroShift
short_description: AstroShift is a unique free-roam 2D space shooter, where your ship's destruction isn't game over - you get flung into space, and you have to find and board a new ship before your air runs out, and YOU explode - you know, because science...

name: Blast
short_description: A modern shooter game. Featuring great graphics, nice effects and cool music.

name: Run, my little pixel
short_description: This is the runner-game divided into three layers. Here you must avoid barriers and cope with the enemies. You will come across many exciting levels and hardcore bosses. The game is made in the style of Flat.

name: Zeal
short_description: Zeal is a 3rd person Action RPG focusing on customizable character builds and competitive PvP/PvE without grinding.

name: NORMALIZATOR
short_description: This utility is designed to create textures used in computer games. Conventional photos or images you can easily convert to maps diffusemap, normalmap, specularmap, illuminationmap, heightmap, glossmap , metallmap, ambient occlusion map.

name: Hidden & Dangerous: Action Pack
short_description: The year is 1941. Your special forces team has been shot down deep inside enemy territory and it's now reliant on your cunning and tactical thinking to get them safely across the border. The odds are stacked against you. Have you got what it takes?

name: Hidden & Dangerous 2: Courage Under Fire
short_description: Hidden & Dangerous 2 is a first and third person tactical shooter that builds upon the tremendous success of Hidden & Dangerous. You lead a small squad of Allied soldiers deep behind enemy lines, to carry out secret missions during World War II.

name: Stickman Annihilation 2
short_description: Warning!Hardcore tricks with stickman!

name: Enoch: Underground
short_description: Enoch – Underground is a hardcore action-RPG. The player takes control of the awakened – one of the few survivors left in the city. Lost and forgotten, he finds himself in catacombs. Without goal and without memories he starts his way through the ruins striving to find his place in this hostile world.

name: Star Rangers VR - Free Demo
short_description: This free demo of Star Rangers VR is a short adventure set in orbit around the earth. The full Star Rangers game, to be released in five episodes (to start) has more missions, vehicles and adventures! Help us hit 30,000 demo users to kick off funded development.

name: Virtual Space
short_description: Virtual Space is aiming to become the next gen desktop application which allow you to have a coherent and natural virtual reality desktop experience with VR Goggles like Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.

name: Flat Worlds
short_description: Flat Worlds is a VR space transport game set in our very own Solar System. Setup transport networks of people and natural resources, guiding the path of human colonization around the Solar System's planets and moons. What will we find when there is no more room to grow?

name: ReThink | Evolved
short_description: You volunteered to participate in an AI research as part of an human control group. Solve over 50 different puzzles and use new gameplay mechanics and more player freedom to find creative ways to progress through the game's beautiful world.

name: Wooden Battles
short_description: Build a wooden fort, place your units, watch the mayhem!

name: Grav Blazer Squared
short_description: Grav Blazer is an arcade space shooter with a focus on fast paced action. Skill based firing mechanics, rotational controlled power attacks, increasing level difficulty, and endless procedurally generated levels are some of the features players will experience.

name: Algorithm
short_description: Scientists have worked on their creation for many years. Long and laborious work created artificial intelligence which, according to its creators, will have to move heaven and earth. This artificial intelligence is you.

name: ASTRAL
short_description: The future came. You'd think that means the apex of the progress and science, but no. After the epidemic spread all over the world in 2022, 95% of the whole population mutated into horrible creatures without any moral values or humanity and started hunting everything that moves. The planet became empty.

name: Clash Force
short_description: A bite-sized, 8-bit style run-and-gun inspired by Saturday morning cartoons of the 80s!

name: The Quarter Game
short_description: Fight your way to become the CEO of a company in this top down hack and slash game.

name: Cursed Deal
short_description: Forget all those other cooperative horror games. You never know who's going to win in this 4v1 game where teams and roles can change. The hunter can be the prey, and the prey can be the hunter. Complete the ritual and become a vampire or die as prey to cursed creatures.

name: Nemesis
short_description: Experience the excitement that we felt on discovering arcade wonders like Asteroids. A dose of nostalgia plus choice modern magic mixed with your VR kit, standing or room scale, modern capabilities and lovingly crafted eye popping fast game play.

name: Our End of the World
short_description: Filled with puzzles, the story between she and me at the end of the world. English Subtitle Released on 2018/11/22!

name: ERSATZ
short_description: ERSATZ is a speed focused Hardcore Action Platformer with a musical twist! Featuring an Original Electronic Soundtrack also by Paris Stalker, the game's creator, hear and feel the music build as you progress and hazards, obstacles, boss attacks & controller vibrations move to the ever present beat!

name: Sorcery Jokers All Ages Version
short_description: Fight to defend or tear down the new world order in Socery Jokers, a modern fantasy visual novel full of battles and action. Shift between multiple perspectives, wield impressive magic, and delve into a conflict between personal freedom and public order.

name: All Cows In
short_description: Push the cows in the stable and become Millionaire!

name: Pixel Killers - The Showdown
short_description: It's Friday night, invite your friends over, gather around a screen, fight each other over a suitcase full of money in "Deal gone bad, hold the cash", or just have a good old deathmatch in a game of "Waste 'em". Shared-screen local multiplayer for 2 to 4 players.

name: Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon
short_description: Take command of mighty Vikings, sly Persians or brutish Demons! Destroy your opponent’s base while defending your own in this action-packed side-scrolling RTS!

name: VRpatients
short_description: Step into VR/MR as a nurse or paramedic and experience safe, fun, and realistic healthcare scenarios—no prior experience needed!

name: Bang Bang Fruit 2
short_description: Just make a cake.

name: Ball 2D: Soccer Online
short_description: Ball 2D is an online multiplayer soccer game with 100% physics-based gameplay where you control one player.

name: MORDER
short_description: MORDER is a stealth-shooter game where you play either as a hired killer or a security agent. Be quick and sneaky, or deliver chaos and destroy the opposition, or maybe you will defend the innocent with your life. It's your choice.

name: Protoball
short_description: Protoball is a futuristic First Person Sports Shooter, a blend of basketball and soccer crossed with high tech futuristic style. Players athletically jump, slide, run, grind and dash around the arena trying to pass the Protoball through the opponents goal. This is the game you've been waiting for.

name: Star Wars: Imperial Assault - Legends of the Alliance
short_description: Legends of the Alliance is a companion app for the Star Wars: Imperial Assault board game, a scenario-based game of tactical combat. When you play with Legends of the Alliance, the app assumes the role of the Imperials, while you and your friends form a team of Rebel heroes fighting to bring down the Galactic Empire.

name: GUNHEAD
short_description: Gunhead is a fast paced strategic roguelike FPS where you take the role of a pirate mech with a gun for a head, looting derelict spaceships filled with monstrous drones made out of bone and steel. Sequel to the 2d roguelite Cryptark.

name: LongStory
short_description: In LongStory you can be and date who you choose. Play as the gender of your choice and date the cutie you like best! LongStory is is based on real stories - things that have happened, if not to us, to people we know and love. We hope it is funny, sad, perplexing and wonderful… Just like life.

name: Master Arena
short_description: Unleash your combat prowess in Master Arena: Immerse yourself in the pulse-pounding FPS action featuring dynamic movement, 9 powerful weapons, 24 unique arenas, and a strategic perk system. Engage your adversaries with finesse in tactical duels, evolving to claim the title of the ultimate champion.

name: Professional Farmer: Cattle and Crops
short_description: Professional Farmer: Cattle and Crops takes you out into the countryside and impresses with its depth and attention to detail! Experience how exciting the profession of a farmer can be. Work your fields with original machines or coordinate these tasks with your workers.

name: Castle Clicker : Idle City Tycoon
short_description: Castle Clicker is a more strategy focused clicking game that required you to think about how to manage your resources and build your city. If you're looking for a more in depth but still casual clicking game, this is for you!

name: Robots.io
short_description: Robots.io is a classic top-down MMO shooter. Choose the best weapons, improve your robot! Dominate! Fight with your friends anywhere, show them who is the king of the arena! Join the battle in the online game Robots.io! A variety of ammunition - all for your enjoyment!

name: Gunhouse
short_description: Load your guns! Rain death from above! Protect your valuable orphans! Defeat giant, improbable bosses! Gunhouse is part puzzle, part active tower defense, as you make big combos to launch a hail of bullets and special attacks at the enemies who want to consume your delicious orphan friends!

name: Edge Of Existence
short_description: Edge Of Existence. Is a throw back to the Classics of RTS where you can build up your base and build up your massive army. Ranging from Ground units , Air Units and Sea Units. We also take you on a story base RTS where a faction has a meaning to the map or why its in-game. We are a balance focus on PvP, PvE and Story/Campaign.

name: Bitcoin Collector
short_description: Bitcoin collector - a colorful game in which you have to dodge the traps and collect bitcoins, changing gravity at your discretion

name: The Chronicles of Nyanya
short_description: A sweet jRPG-style game about cats, brutal massacres, cuteness, racism and social issues, friendship, sinister thoughts, hilarity and Nazi furniture. It’s an epic attempt to blow your mind with adult themes hidden behind bright cartoon graphics.

name: Pro Cycling Manager 2018
short_description: Step into the shoes of sports manager and lead your pro cycling team through a challenge-packed 2018 season. Compete in over 200 races across 500 stages around the world, including famous Tours such as La Vuelta and the iconic Tour de France.

name: Generation Zero®
short_description: Generation Zero is a stealth-action shooter where you wage guerilla warfare against lethal mechanical enemies. Explore a vast open world map inspired by the Swedish Cold War era, take part in the resistance alone or with up to three friends in seamless co-op.

name: Bartender VR Simulator
short_description: Step behind the virtual bar and flair your way to the stars! Enter the exciting world of bartending and master the art of dazzling mixology in VR with the help of 6-time Bartending world champion Tomasz Malek.

name: Lumberjack VR
short_description: Experience the thrilling life of a Lumberjack in virtual reality with Lumberjack VR, an arcade action game for the HTC Vive. Fight your way through waves of logs, lumber and bombs with nothing but an axe in your hand.

name: Captain 13 Beyond the Hero
short_description: Captain 13 - Beyond the Hero is an endless arcade shooter set in multiple galaxies of the universe. You are Captain 13, the sole survivor of a voyager fleet sent with the mission of clearing asteroid clusters.

name: SACRALITH : The Archer`s Tale
short_description: SACRALITH: The Archer's Tale is a VR bow-and-arrow shooter. Help your AI companions as you pass various locations together toward the game's main goal: the magic stone called Sacralith that grants you power over dragons.

name: Water Pipeline
short_description: Water Pipeline is a strategic puzzle game. Objective of this game is simple, rotate the different pieces of pipe in order to get water and save the life. There is no time limit but you have limited moves for each round and you have to complete the pipeline before running out of moves.

name: Space Survivors I: The Reckoning
short_description: Hello Space Survivors, this is little shooter game. Which is now most about shooting zombies but pvp will hopefully follow. Please also read the long description.

name: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition
short_description: Return to the Forgotten Realms in this bestselling Dungeons & Dragons roleplaying game. Combines all the content of Neverwinter Nights Diamond Edition with all-new enhanced features. Includes 100+ hours of award-winning adventures and the tools to create your own!

name: VR Furballs - Demolition
short_description: Grab your slingshot, grab a Furball... AND DEMOLISH THEM ALL!!! In this challenging VR physics-based demolition puzzle game, you will have to toss, sling, smash, slam, shoot, and even headbutt adorable Furballs into their evil foes and their crazy constructions to demolish them all!

name: Durak!
short_description: Durak is a classical Russian card game. While it requires strategical thinking, cheating is also a viable strategy as long as you don't get caught. In the same spirit pay attention to your opponents or else you might get tricked and be left as the Durak! The game is best enjoyed with 1 to 5 friends.

name: Mercury Fallen
short_description: A sci-fi colony management sim with a focus on exploration, expansion, and survival. Rebuild your underground facility, manage colonists and robots, and uncover the mysteries of an alien world light-years from Earth. Dig deep, expand across the surface, and shape your new home.

name: Battle Buddies VR
short_description: Battle Buddies is a local co-op Tower defence and VR first person shooter in one.

name: Evolution of Ages: Settlements
short_description: Evolutiuon of Ages is a game of managing resources in the ruins of our world. Recruit characters and level their skills and equipment from the stone age until the space age, while trying your best to avoid the very thing that led to our destruction previously.

name: Maze Trials
short_description: Master an endless descent into massive, procedurally generated mazes. Use markers to find your way, collect coins, and race the clock to find the portal. Each exit only leads to a new labyrinth. It's a pure test of navigation and endurance—how deep can you go?

name: Inexplicable Geeks: Dawn of Just Us
short_description: Enter a world of ridiculously underpowered superheroes as you navigate a comic and pop culture convention celebrating their history. Gather stories, piece together history, and interact with the denizens of the super and the geek.

name: AMPLITUDE: A Visual Novel
short_description: Amplitude is a story-centric visual novel. You play as either Adam or Eve, a murder victim who made a dubious deal to seek revenge. With the help of your new vessel, Katy or Jon, will you uncover the mystery or will you take more than you bargained for?

name: Elisa: Seduce the Innkeeper
short_description: The player doesn't impersonate a simple man, but a powerful, rich and famous nobleman who seems to be able to obtain whatever he wishes for. But will this be enough this time?

name: TRYON
short_description: A mixture of a minesweeper and "remember the pictures". Remember as much information as possible, or act at random. Reach the finish line as quickly as possible in a variety of puzzles. And you can also make your own levels in the editor.

name: Grimrush
short_description: Grimrush is a top down action game in which you must face off a gauntlet of seven brutal boss fights. Utilize three characters and a large selection of active and passive abilities. Balance offense and defense to take down the bosses and maximize your score!

name: The Walking Vegetables
short_description: It’s the 1980’s and an evil alien race has invaded Earth, turning all vegetables into crawling, bawling, mauling abominations. You are about to join Department Radical, the grooviest police force on Earth. Are you a rad enough dude (or dame) to smite these ravenous creatures?

name: Thief Simulator
short_description: Become the best thief. Gather intel, steal things and sell them to buy hi-tech equipment. Do everything that a real thief does.

name: Keepsake
short_description: Keepsake was a labor of love developed 10 years ago by us as an independent studio. For its anniversary, we thought it would be great to see it live again on steam and gain a new following, as we feel that it is still relevant today.

name: Trident's Wake
short_description: Trident's Wake is an intense co-operative twin-stick shooter in an unforgiving sci-fi setting. Join up to three other players to take back humanity's last hope - the colony ship code-named Trident – from an unknown race of alien invaders!

name: Tenta Shooter
short_description: Here comes a shoot-em-up game with a unique theme, tentacles! Defeat gigantic monster girls using a powerful bullet counter system!

name: Magic Rampage
short_description: Exciting platformer that combines the RPG genre with fast-paced action gameplay.

name: BOX IT
short_description: A classic Arcade Puzzle Game from a different perspective with 300 puzzles to solve and full Workshop support.

name: Scarlett's Dungeon
short_description: Scarlett's Dungeon is a retro-inspired action RPG dungeon crawler with roguelite elements. Explore randomly generated dungeons, fight monsters, and collect loot in beautifully crafted pixel art reminiscent of the Game Boy Advance era. Test your skills as you dive deep into ever-changing challenges!

name: Project Ara - Crucible
short_description: Project Ara - Crucible is a bullet hell type shoot’em’up featuring procedural content generation in addition to light RPG elements. Help Lethe Zelmiya, the forgetful wizard on her epic quest to graduate from the Myrellian Academy of Magic.

name: OSES
short_description: OSES is a strategic post-apocalyptic shooter in which 3 characters fight by using different guns to survive the zombie hordes in various scenarios and game modes.

name: OctorSpace
short_description: A vertical space shooter that's about more than shooting. Uncover secrets, collect coins, pick upgrades, unlock weapons, ram through enemies in three campaigns. Then create your own levels and campaigns with the easy to use level creator.

name: Bottom of the 9th
short_description: Play the most exciting moment of baseball in this fast-paced dice and card game!

name: HAWKEN REBORN
short_description: Return to the world of high-octane mech combat in Hawken Reborn. Construct your ultimate war machine and shoot your way through hordes of enemies to uncover the mysteries of Ilall in this brand-new Free-to-Play PVE mech game.

name: Apocalypse: Legacy Edition
short_description: Apocalypse: Legacy Edition is a fast-paced single player shooter, updated to the last update (1.7), adding fixes, improvements and additional features. Including all the content that inspired the remaster, Apocalypse: 2.0 Edition! Available on Windows.

name: Infernales
short_description: Kill all the creatures of hell ...

name: FEMINAZI: 3000
short_description: Race your oppression away! Kill all men in the race of your life - the race for tolerance and equality.

name: Trivia Vault: Super Heroes Trivia 2
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault: Super Heroes Trivia 2 and bring your thinking hat. Answer all new super heroes category trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Marshmallow Melee
short_description: Marshmallow Melee is VR rogue-lite dungeon crawler with toy-sized warriors. Rally your troops and fight your way to the top of an ever-shuffling tower to defeat Steve, The Evil Wizard.

name: Death Coming/死神来了
short_description: 'Death Coming' is a non-linear puzzle game where you must harvest human souls ‘Final Destination’ style. However, pesky mortals are not your only problem, as the Agents of Light will do everything they can to stop you.

name: Foundation of Nightmares
short_description: After disaster strikes, you are left debilitated in the village of Quader. There, under the care of a warrior, magician, and healer, you manage to slowly recuperate. Meanwhile, yet another new enemy lurks in the shadows, and old acquaintances from Lorden make their own appearances.

name: Rhythm World - Master Project
short_description: 《Rhythm World - Master Project》is a music game combine with simulation system. Dive yourself into the music ocean! There are over 20 original music and there will be over a hundred music in the future update =w=. You can interact with R-chan in this game, the improvement of r-chan will help you get more score in rhythm game!

name: Moon VR Video Player
short_description: Moon VR is a VR video player for VR headsets and Windows PC. Fine-tuned for all VR headsets including Oculus Rift, Quest, Gear VR and HTC Vive, simply chill and enjoy!!

name: Antipole DX
short_description: Join our mysterious space outlaw, as he explores an “abandoned” spacecraft in hopes of finding his next meal ticket. Little does he know, the ship isn’t deserted like he thought, and now his only hope is to master the power of the mighty gravity-manipulating device: the Antipole.

name: Cube Racer
short_description: Cube Racer is a round based multiplayer racing game with cubes. Every round, all players race against each other to the finish line. Before every round, the players get to build one or more obstacles on the map. In the next round, all players have to pass all the obstacles, which have been built yet.

name: InGame.exe
short_description: It's year 2079. One of the best policemans have been fired and a strange floppy disk falls into his hands. When he tried to run it on his PC, he found himself in the digital world. In this world exists a virus, that intends to destroy everything around. Only the protagonist can stop the virus and get back home.

name: Boom Box Blue!
short_description: Boom Box Blue is a frenzied skill based physics game. This is what you get if you merge Tetris with physics and throw some bombs into the mix!

name: Cross Set Infinity
short_description: Sudoku-like novel number puzzle game with beautiful musics.

name: Waste Cleaner
short_description: Waste, what could be worse, but someone has to solve this problem? Use the liquid to flush out the debris, detect invisible obstacles, build up protrusions and get to inaccessible places. Find other possibilities for using fluid in a first-person logical game with fluid simulation.

name: Hakoniwa Explorer Plus
short_description: Get ready for a voxel art action game featuring an unprecedented level of freedom! A whole range of cute girl monsters are waiting to punch, kick, wrap you up, suck your blood, and eat you right up.

name: Strange Telephone
short_description: Strange Telephone is a 2D adventure game in which the player explores strange worlds created with merely 6 digits, and has multiple endings.

name: Suicide Adventures
short_description: Lost in the abyssal depths of limbo, you are a tortured soul who is trapped between life and death, stuck in a dungeon whose puzzles will test you as you strive to go into the afterlife.

name: Kofi Quest
short_description: Kofi Quest is a not-so-serious adventure that brings together mechanics from Action RPG and RTS games. You’ll control Kofi, a weak, lazy and unlucky videogame character that will be followed by a group of interesting (and pathetic) characters aiding him to live a great adventure.

name: The Cursed Tower
short_description: "The Cursed Tower" is a story-driven platformer game where you are a dutiful postal worker. Armed with only a letter opener and graceful jumping skills, you must embark on a quest and fulfill your duty. Along the way, you will encounter many dangers and uncover a dark secret. Do you have what it takes?

name: Galactic Shipwright
short_description: Build the best or the funniest ships to transfer passengers, destroy enemies or navigate minefields. Beat every level and compete with your friends on the game's leaderboard, and share your best creations on the workshop.

name: Aya's Journey
short_description: Guide Aya through a perilous journey in this haunting 2D sidescroller puzzle game. Overcome deadly obstacles, face inner demons, and unravel the secrets of her dark world. Will you help her escape the shadows?

name: World War Party: Game Of Trump
short_description: World War Party: Game of Trump is a deathmatch battle played by two teams of 4 players each (humans or bots). But the teams are not alone on the battlefield: PRESIDENT TRUMP drives around in his mighty ‘murican tank shooting lasers and talking nonsense.

name: Onager!
short_description: Do you like to destroy huts and castles ? Do you like to solve puzzles too ? Then this game is for you! Onager! is a physics based game filled with challenging puzzles in fully destructible environment, the goal is to destroy all blue monsters and their lairs using as few shots as possible to gain maximum score, but monsters can be...

name: Wunderdoktor
short_description: Step into the role of the Wunderdoktor, a traveling doctor whose daily work is to cure rare and exotic diseases. Explore a world full of quackery, ghosts and addictive potions.

name: Tiny Bubbles
short_description: Play with squishy clusters of soap bubbles in this mesmerizing physics puzzle game. Winner of over a dozen indie gaming awards!

name: Picture Builder
short_description: This is an artistic innovative puzzle. Build pixel pictures from blocks by stacking them on top of each other with partial overlap. (But for those who like to just relax, there are also modes of playing the classic mosaic.)

name: Wizard Hunter 2348
short_description: A high speed ambush tactics shooter, it's you (and maybe a friend) as foxes or wizards against an army of bumbling spellcasters and their demon reinforcements. Sneakily nip wizards in the ankles on foot, or get the jump on a whole room of them in a tiny machinegun-wielding tank.

name: Burgle Bros.
short_description: Burgle Bros. blends high-tension teamwork, stealth and brain-twisting puzzles.

name: Tayutama 2-you're the only one- ENG ver.
short_description: In a mountain town far away from Ashihara-cho, a brand new story about the coexistence between "Humans" and "Tayutais" is about to start.

name: Where They Cremate The Roadkill
short_description: Death is a dream

name: HELLMUT: The Badass from Hell
short_description: Hellmut: The Badass from Hell is a fast-paced bullet-storm dungeon crawler. Use absurd Transformations to defeat demonic hordes, challenge random bosses in random levels, equip powerful guns, loot valuable treasures, and basically murderize a shockingly large number of demons.

name: BACK TO THE EGG! Tower Defense
short_description: Classical tower defense game mixed with rpg elements - Filled with things to do and places to explore.

name: Ballz: Farm
short_description: Arkanoid game with farm style!

name: Stripper Anya™ 2 X-MiGuFighters
short_description: Tired of everyone getting offended about everything?!? 🙌 So are we! How about some Topless street fighting?! 😍 Your friends will judge you but we won't! #guiltypleasures This is a retro inspired 1 on 1 fighting game meant to be played lightheartedly with a comedic approach.

name: Sense of The Devil
short_description: Sense of The Devil is first person horror shooter that will take you on an epic journey of hunting the most horrifying creature!

name: Car Demolition Clicker
short_description: Ever dreamed of smashing your own car? Or maybe a car of your neighbour? Well... now you have a chance! Grab your weapon, call out your battle drones and start clicking the car into oblivion! Earn cash, upgrade your equipment and find more vehicles to destroy!

name: American Patriots: Boston Tea Party
short_description: Take Boston or die for freedom!

name: The Donnerwald Experiment
short_description: A mature dreampunk RPG with German folklore, demons galore, interactive combat mechanics and more!

name: Ancient Future
short_description: Ancient Future is a fast paced multiplayer brawler set in a pixelated cyberpunk dystopia. Choose from a huge set of weapons, items, and characters to make your perfect loadout, and fight your friends or play online!

name: Astroe
short_description: Multiplayer player 2D space battle. Collect gold, team up and take over the other team's satellites.

name: Wuxing Master 五行师(CCG)
short_description: "Wuxing Master 五行师(CCG)" is a multiplayer online Collectible Card Game(CCG) which is based on Chinese traditional myths. Its rules and numerical value have been honed for ten years. Now the game is available for Windows, Android and iOS, on each of which can you share the data.

name: 万视VR
short_description: wanshi VR video player is based on HTC Vive virtual reality device,it can play web and local video or live streaming,it contains normal/panorama/half panorama view mode,it can connect wanshi VR platform and play the video and live streaming resources on the platform,also play window pc local video file.

name: SpaceWalker
short_description: You are about to be part of the SpaceWalker team. Let’s explore the the multiple dimensions yet to be known, obtain the knowledge and power of the cosmos and save the universe!In Early Access, Solar System Explorer, you will steer a spacecraft to visit planets in the solar system,.

name: Echo Grotto
short_description: Echo Grotto is a virtual reality experience that lets you explore unique and intricate cave systems using a range of caving gear and tools!

name: Empress of Gold
short_description: 1336, Feudal Japan. The player takes on the role of a ninja, out for vengeance against a corrupt Nobel. Maybe the Empress of Gold can help restore balance, unless she's already captured.

name: The Trace
