name: Defrain
short_description: A simple arcade style space shooter.

name: まぜっこタワー
short_description: まぜっこタワーはプレイヤー自らダンジョンを作りながら冒険する、ローグライクゲームです。作り出したダンジョンを冒険し、 素材を集め、新たなダンジョンを作る・・・。こうして冒険を繰り返すことで、高難度のダンジョンを作成・攻略し、いずれは全100階からなるダンジョンの頂上を目指しましょう！日本のローグライクではお馴染みの合成システムもあります！武器や盾を合成して冒険を有利に進めましょう！

name: StrikeForce Kitty
short_description: Comedic puzzle-adventure with strong RPG influences. Take away costumes from the foxes, create the most mad combinations of clothes, explore the world, find secrets and save the princess from the clutches of the cunning king!

name: Super Meat Shooter
short_description: Retro first person shooter about love story with ocean of gore effects in an unusual world of strange dream with incredible creatures. 23 different levels, 12 types of enemies, 6 weapons and that's not all!

name: Ecopoiesis
short_description: Ecopoiesis is a top-down action game in which the player needs to protect the structures (and themselves) from enemies for a certain time on dozens of missions throughout the planet.

name: Purple Heart
short_description: Hardcore pixel indie platformer with puzzle elements and history. Can you get to the end?

name: Znkl - 177
short_description: You are a pilot of the spaceship "Znkl - 177". You need to deliver a capsule with important information to the cargo spaceship.

name: Kebab it Up!
short_description: Kebab it Up! is a fun and challenging game where you play as Sherban, chasing a runaway kebab through the streets of Bucharest. With challenging levels, a banger soundtrack, and a level editor for creating and playing community-made levels, it's perfect for curious adventurers who love a challenge.

name: Tronix Defender
short_description: Tronix Defender is a retro styled Tower Defence game where you must protect your CPU from hack-bots and trojans inside a digital world. The levels are partially randomised for maximised replay-ability and the game is enhanced by a killer Synthwave soundscape created by TimeSlave Recordings.

name: Neon Aileron
short_description: Neon Aileron is a shoot 'em up for people who are bad at shoot 'em ups. Enjoy the forgiving gameplay and 16-bit era graphics while shooting lots of enemies that spawn to the soundtrack!

name: The Finnish Virtual Art Gallery
short_description: The Finnish Virtual Art Gallery has a collection of famous Finnish paintings e.g Akseli Gallen-Kallela, Albert Edelfelt, Eero Järnefeld, Ferdinand von Wright, Fanny Churberg, Hugo Simberg and Helene Schjerfbeck.

name: Pixel Space Battles
short_description: Fly for a spaceship and destroy enemy alien ships to return to your homeplanet – Nibiru

name: Fidget Spinner In Space
short_description: Fly for a spinner in space, avoid asteroids and the UFO police, and collect heads of aliens flying in space

name: RoboVDino
short_description: Throw Garbage At Dinosaurs! RoboVDino is 1-5 player cooperative carnage!

name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2018
short_description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2018 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite professional basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

name: EcoQuest: Explore, Discover, Protect!
short_description: “Eco Quest: Explore, Discover, Protect!” thrusts players into the role of Kai, a spirited environmental crusader on a mission to reshape the world’s perspective on water and climate.

name: The Valley In My Mind
short_description: Explore several unique environments and fight to escape with your life! After awaking in a strange realm, you must uncover your hidden past and carve a path back home. Collect upgrade parts to craft the tools you need to make the cut, and choose an ancient power to aid you in your journey.

name: Overclocked
short_description: Overclocked is a free-flowing action game that blends combat and platforming to create a fluid and rhythmic experience. Take on the role of Amber, a glass-cannon vigilante, as you fight to uncover a plot that threatens to tear your home apart.

name: Soul Survival VR
short_description: Fight against evil sorcerers using your magical spells. It is your mission to locate and destroy the evil souls that live in the castle, which give the dark sorcerers their power. Do you have what it takes?

name: The redemption of pancakes
short_description: 鬼畜的模拟经营休闲的小游戏啦

name: Cross Pixels
short_description: Cross Pixels is a collection of Picross puzzles. Train your logic thinking and reveal the hidden picture.

name: Sockman
short_description: Sockman is a single-screen platformer inspired by classics like Rick Dangerous, Jet Set Willy, Manic Miner, Jumpman, Prince of Persia… A hardcore platformer, very difficult, even more than suck your own elbow.

name: Lovehammer 400 000: The Buttlerian Crusade
short_description: In this turn based roguelite/puzzle parody you assume the command of Astro Commando squad, assigning them to assault, assist and assassination missions. Use the vast assortment of unique gear & skills to assert your dominance over nefarious Order of the B.O.O.B. Astro Commandos, Assemble!

name: SMACKHEAD
short_description: Can you complete all the levels of SMACKHEAD to escape from this strange dream and grab the ultimate completion achievement?

name: Crazy Appliances 疯狂电器
short_description: CRAZY APPLIANCES is a fast paced top-down shooter game! The elect robots are insane, heroes! Fight your way by using various weapons and powerful items to defeat them in different dangerous situation!

name: Sunshine Manor
short_description: Sunshine Manor is an 8-bit blood-soaked Horror RPG that pits you as Ada. Dared to spend the night in the haunted Sunshine Manor she encounters ghosts, demons, blood-soaked horror and more in this prequel to 2016's Camp Sunshine.

name: Reflex
short_description: A simple puzzle game. Simple graphics and nice music. Try your mind in more than 70+ levels. They are waiting for you.

name: Viking Village
short_description: A fun minimalist RTS - build and defend your Viking Village from enemies like Knights, Pirates and Barbarians. Attack enemy villages on randomly generated islands. Play 1v1 multiplayer!

name: Perceptions of the Dead
short_description: Follow three stories set in a world where the dead linger, and things far worse wait beyond the veil.

name: Chambara
short_description: The award-winning couch-multiplayer stealth brawler comes to PC! Duel in a black and white world where foes can come from anywhere!

name: Spirit Animal Survival
short_description: SAS is an Open World Multiplayer PVP and CO-OP Survival Game. Set in a vast environment that features Building, Crafting, Taming, Riding, Flying and Exploring Wildlife, Dinos and Dragons as well as Horrific Creatures and Instances with the ability to Morph into Spirit Animals.

name: 贤者挽歌之马略卡协奏曲
short_description: Sage Elegy is a semi-rendering role-playing game in which the young girl and Alchemy perform daily. You will play as a young girl who entered the Alchemy Academy. In the stream of college life you find "What we are coveting is what we later spit.

name: Dragon Sinker
short_description: Join forces with elves and dwarves, and slay the evil dragon, Wyrmvarg in a retro-style fantasy RPG!

name: KARAKARA2
short_description: KARAKARA. It is the sound of aridity. It is the sound of dry asphalt and sandy winds. It is the sound of relentless sunshine, as well as the sound of a withering race.

name: Prehistorik
short_description: Eat and beat your way through 150 scenes of awesome nourishing fun and relive the "Prehistorik" epic in this incredible platform game. Armed with your Diner Club Anticus, an ancestor of the baseball bat, you start in pursuit of the hilarious Maxidocus and take on armies of hairy spiders...

name: Touhou Tenkuushou ~ Hidden Star in Four Seasons.
short_description: 桜を見ながら西瓜を割り、紅葉を見ながら鍋をつつく こんな季節に誰がした！ イレギュラーでシーズナルなシューティング幻想！

name: This Is Not A Jumping Game
short_description: This is a 2D platform game but not just a "jumping" game. Action, Puzzles, funny incidents. This is a game that makes you happy.

name: Tank of War-VR
short_description: This is a multiplayer tank combat VR game developed by Unreal4, which successfully helps the player get rid of dizziness and fatigue during playing. Using VR devices, the player will get unique virtual reality experience in “driving” a real tank to fight.

name: Temtem
short_description: Temtem is an online creature-collection adventure. Tame 165 unique creatures across 7 vibrant islands, battle other tamers, tackle mythical Lairs, chase Luma & Umbra variants, and breed your favorite Tems - with friends by your side! Dive into a colorful monster catching adventure, so Temtem up!

name: Ancient Treasure 法爾斯編年史：上古秘寶
short_description: Falsus Chronicle: Ancient Treasure is a dungeon exploring, Anime style action RPG with Roguelike elements. In this game, dungeon will randomly generate traps, monsters and loots. With our unique “Monster Gem” system, every different choice of classes, weapons, and skill sets effects characters raising multiple possibilities, to fulfil...

name: Quanect
short_description: The game has two realities, and in order to pass the level, you must move between them. Reality is not identical, objects and their position in different variations of the same room is different. You have to find a way out using these differences.

name: Apparition
short_description: First-person survival horror with ghosts and demons. Find yourself smack in the middle of a haunted forest in the dead of night. Talk to spirits through your Spirit Board. Capture evidence of the paranormal, but beware, fiercely aggressive demons are on the hunt.

name: A Sky Full of Stars 仰望夜空的星辰
short_description: The starry sky spreads far and wide overhead... This story full of love, comedy, and excitement follows our protagonist and his stargazing friends as they grow together. "A Sky Full of Stars" is a coming-of-age astronomy tale by the same team who brought you "If My Heart Had Wings".

name: Terminal Conflict
short_description: Touch the world with your fingertips! Your retro terminal awaits your command, for the balance of power, in this definitive Cold War strategy game. Here you belong; assert your leadership through turn based strategic tit-for-tat, on the brink of mutually assured destruction. Don't let it slip away!

name: Haxor
short_description: Retro pixels are back! Good old 80s/90s style is back! Enjoy a classic 2D platformer with old era graphics! 16x16 pixel sprites and ambient, flat chip tuned 8 bit music! Guide Kla, the last survivor from Haxor planet, through the world full of vicious creatures, deadly traps and giant bosses!

name: Rig or Skill: PC Brawl
short_description: Free to play, air hockey style arena humorously referring to internet culture. Attack your opponent’s computer by decreasing its FPS capability. Defend your own virtual PC. Climb the ranks online and compete in league seasons!

name: Pit of Evil
short_description: Barry and his friends Arlene and Nellie decide to visit the Pit of Evil, the place where they lost their friend Fynn. While spending the night in a tent, things take an unexpected turn. The group gets seperated, while Barry suffers the same fate as Fynn, falling into the Pit of Evil.

name: Wreckin' Ball Adventure
short_description: You are a ball - a Wreckin’ Ball - Roll, jump, swing and wreck your way to freedom! Wreckin’ Ball Adventure is a solo & local co-op (up to 4 players) platformer, with ball-shaped robots, physics-based puzzles, and 60 challenging levels!

name: INMATE: Survival
short_description: INMATE: Survival is an open world survival game, where you play the role of a prisoner sentenced to stay on a 4*4 km Island with many types of enemies both humans and animals.

name: The Survivors
short_description: The Survivors is the Arctic-Western Battle Royale where 100 gold hunters fight for their claim in the Yukon Gold Rush. Storm eyes set the pace for the players, and bandits protect valuable loot. Players can use scrap to upgrade the 19th century weaponry. Join the fight and stake your claim!

name: Yet Another Hentai Puzzle
short_description: Yet Another Hentai Puzzle game to keep you happy.

name: Technosphere - Collector's Edition
short_description: This is a story about a brave engineer who repaired the transmitters using a special drone called TECHNOSPHERE.

name: Walking Zombie: Shooter
short_description: The Walking Zombie is a stationary FPS with an online co-op mode in a world full of zombies to kill. Buy and upgrade your weapons, kill all enemies in 200 levels and destroy mighty boss monsters before they eat you alive!

name: Play Together: Party Games
short_description: Play with up to 8 players using phones as controllers! Play action minigames, strategy, drawing and other fun challenges with your friends, locally or online. No extra downloads needed! Turn any screen into a party with Play Together: Party Games!

name: Monarch of Greed - Act 1
short_description: In Labyrinth Mode, challenge 9 levels, with each one being more challenging than the last! In Story Mode, control various characters and make the right choices to avoid the multiple dead ends and find a way to get out of an abandoned orphanage.

name: Flip the Table
short_description: Flip the Table is a physics-based, ultimate stress relieving virtual reality game where your objective is to Flip the Table and break as much stuff as you can. After a long day or just for fun you can now destroy things without getting a huge bill!

name: Square Massacre
short_description: Square Massacre is a skill based, hardcore top-down shooter. No matter what you are going to do, you will lose. The question is how long you will last before the end.

name: Tale of Alamar
short_description: In a world where the Leylines of Magic and Planes of Existence converge, follow the adventures of Hiro as you face dangerous beasts, meet fantastical allies, sail the open ocean, and traverse dangerous dungeons filled with puzzles, traps, and hoards of treasure.

name: Rasty Pelican
short_description: Control Rasty the Pelican by flying and swimming around the beautiful Caribbean sea.

name: HeadSquare - Multiplayer VR Ball Game
short_description: Multiplayer Ball Game. Single player mode supported. Use your head as the controller and play alone or with up to six players online. Very immersive multiplayer fun.

name: Air Combat Arena
short_description: Air Combat Arena is an arcade-style flight combat game. In the game you can pilot various planes play against other players on various maps.

name: Orblitz
short_description: Orblitz is a casual game that is great for winding down or just passing time.

name: PlayClaw :: Overlays, Game Recording & Streaming
short_description: Use our cool in-game overlays to achieve the best gaming experience! Harnessing the power of your GPU, hardware accelerated H.264 codecs and the various overlays, you will have an advantage over your opponents and you can share your victories.

name: Speed Dating for Ghosts
short_description: Branching dialogue! Hard choices! A cemetery's worth of phantoms, wraiths, and poltergeists lookin' for love in all the blight places.

name: Stop Santa - Tower Defense
short_description: Take the War on Christmas all the way to the North Pole! Santa has gone crazy and enlisted an army of evil elves, zombie Santas, and sadistic penguins. It's now up to you and the remaining elves to Stop Santa in this holiday themed tower defense game!

name: Broken Minds
short_description: A psychological murder mystery set in 90s Japan.

name: Substance Designer 2018
short_description: Substance Designer is the industry's reference Material Creation and Scan Processing Tool. More than 95% of AAA game projects currently in development use Substance as well as the most prestigious visual effects and animation studios.

name: Totally Realistic Sledding VR
short_description: Totally Realistic Sledding is a fast and over-the-top sledding/skiing simulator for VR! Jump off high cliffs, slide off ramps beneath beautiful sunsets and have heart pounding close shaves with dangerous obstacles.

name: Duck Season PC
short_description: An experimental first person narrative sending you back to Summer 1988 and you have a one day rental of Duck Season. Dive into the mystery and work through the hidden secrets spilling out of the cursed cartridge. The full hit VR game playable on your traditional flat screen!

name: Indie Dev Story
short_description: Indie Dev Story - Quit your job to become an indie developer and make your first game!

name: Plague hunter
short_description: Plague hunter is an indie platformer game in the dark fantasy vein. In the game you’ll be using sword and gun to cut your way through hordes of zombies and other terrible monsters, avoiding deadly traps.

name: Space Panic Defense
short_description: A futuristic tower defense game with action and strategy!

name: Gadgeteer
short_description: Gadgeteer is a physics-based VR puzzle game where you build chain reaction machines to solve fun, intricate puzzles. Your machines will use gadgets to launch, bump, twist, and turn—creating chain reactions that may even end up tearing apart the fabric of space-time.

name: Box Looter 2018
short_description: A dumb joke game in which loot boxes are the loot. Poke fun at loot boxes while poking at loot boxes. Climb the mountain and find the loot box of unknown riches that the prophecy foretold! The 2,018th game in the wildly popular Box Looter series.

name: HARDCORE MECHA
short_description: HARDCORE MECHA is a 2D platformer action focusing on a better handling. The Campaign mode offers rich gameplay and seamless in-game cut-scenes for an immersive experience. Choose your favorite mecha, experience the fast-paced hardcore competitive battle of steel in Multiplayer!

name: Quadra
short_description: Get good and get fast with Quadra, a high-speed match-3 game that will test your reflexes. Don't be a square, play Quadra!

name: Bakery
short_description: Operating bakery Making various breads and cakes Manage and operate storefronts

name: Throw Anything
short_description: Get secret missions from Secret Delivery Agency (SDA) and save the world from zombie horde in the VR action game,Throw Anything!

name: Bounce Rescue!
short_description: Bounce Rescue! is an arcade- styled puzzle platformer, telling a story about a group of heroes, saving their friends. Made by a small indiedev studio Bitecore Ltd.

name: Chase Ace Sole Survivor
short_description: Chase Ace Sole Survivor is a top-down space shooter with survivors-like and roguelite elements, big juicy explosions and sweet fluid controls. Fight off aggressive alien invaders. Survive and rid The Planetary Shield of the alien infestation.

name: Cypher
short_description: Cypher is a first person puzzle game about cryptography.

name: The Unholy Society
short_description: The Unholy Society, a quirky 2D adventure game mixed with action elements, is inspired by '80s and '90s movies, comic books, as well as everything else that fits into the categories of "iconic" and "pop culture".

name: Outside
short_description: Outside - Is a first-person survival horror, Your main task is to survive at any cost or die at the hands of the maniac who lives in the region.

name: Bunny Mania 2
short_description: Bunny Mania around the world! Command lots of bunnies, and help them to reach the bunny house. Build bridges, drill holes, and collect vegetables Key features: - 4 game worlds, 60 levels - 10 tools, powerups and crates - elevators and traps - advanced hint system

name: Chronicles of Magic: Divided Kingdoms
short_description: Reconcile the twin kingdoms! As Gillian, explore two worlds and use the Magic Scrolls to discover the truth about a forgotten royal lineage.

name: Cloudpunk
short_description: A neon-noir story in a rain-drenched cyberpunk metropolis. It’s your first night on the job working for the Cloudpunk delivery service. Two rules: Don’t miss a delivery and don’t ask what’s in the package.

name: Rail Recon
short_description: Delve into the underground facility of Rail Recon, a Twin-stick Shooter with a Rail System. Navigate through its network of rails in search of its crystals, while maneuvering and fighting through the facility's defenses.

name: Spoxel
short_description: Explore, customize, and build across the world of Spoxel as you fight the otherworlders. Use runes to construct custom powerful or infuse weapons and armor with rare resources. Explore an infinite world while you build a base to establish a foothold of power to defend from your enemies!

name: Skript
short_description: The popular words board game playable in six different languages: English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Spanish.

name: A song in the void
short_description: Imagine a world where music is your last hope. Embark on an extraordinary journey across a strange planet and attempt to uncover its secrets. Discover the history of your people and take control of your destiny.

name: Chicken Farm 2K17
short_description: Chicken Farm is a management game with clicker aspects, where you buy chickens, catch the eggs, work at the market, sell your chickens and ultimately profit.

name: Rapid Tap
short_description: Enjoy a fun, grid tapping game that gets faster the more you play. See how long you can last tapping the flashing buttons. Now with a bunch of fun skins!

name: Nippon Marathon
short_description: Crazy, physics-driven, four-player marathon across Japan. Combining classic racers like Micro Machines and the insanity of TV's Takeshi's Castle, smash through offices and shopping malls and hurl fruit at your opponents in a party game unlike anything you've played before!

name: Prelude: Psychological Horror Game
short_description: This game is not for everyone, do you have what it takes to unravel the secrets behind this... thing? Are you ready to face the truth and question your own existence? You've been warned...

name: Portal Journey: Portarius
short_description: Open a portal and begin your journey! Teleport rocks, water and your spaceship. Immerse in handcrafted colorful worlds, solve puzzles and be the first at the center of the Earth.

name: Deep Space: Unknown Universe
short_description: Lost in deep space. Accompanied by Alice, the AI computer. Can you together find your way back to Earth?

name: Haunted Dream House
short_description: Haunted Dream House is a 3-D text based horror mystery. You find yourself in a familiar yet obscure house and must find your way... but it won't be easy, nor are you alone in this haunted dream house.

name: BAPTISM
short_description: BAPTISM is a short kinetic novel about a madman, a child, and a lake.

name: Achievement Lurker: Dad Jokes
short_description: Join Jordy, the #1 Dad on his quest to be the best dad in the land. Jordy the #1 Dad roams the vast landscape and meets interesting friends like Mihailovich & Sergej. Jordy the #1 Dad is fueled by pride and arousal, in his quest to learn all the Dad jokes in the world. Do you have what it takes to become the #1 Dad?

name: Keplerth
short_description: Welcome to Keplerth! Try to survive on a hostile alien planet in this 2D sandbox RPG, where you can choose to live alone or fight side by side with your friends in the online multiplayer mode. Survive, build, farm, fight, and explore your way to victory in this open-world adventure!

name: Voyage Senki VR 海洋传说 VR
short_description: Sailing in the blue ocean and exploring a new world is a dream in people's nature. Voyage Senki VR is a game of sailing, exploring and adventure. Start a great expedition and Create a new land with your genius and talent of construction, manufacture, and protection.

name: Pound of Flesh
short_description: There are others in the house. It's been a long time since they have eaten, and they each have their favorite "foods". To survive, you may have to offer them parts of yourself. Your teeth, your hair. I hope you weren't too "attached" to them. You won't be for long.

name: Cosmic Buddies Town
short_description: Part of an Animated Educational series for children between 1 to 7 years old – this time, we need to get straight to work helping the Cosmic Buddies build their town! Collect wood, food and other resources to turn a deserted island into your dream adventure land!

name: XL1-ClippingPoint
short_description: XL1 – Clipping Point is an online racing game created by XLGAMES, the renowned MMORPG ArcheAge developer led by Jake Song. As such, despite not being launched officially, in an effort to preserve the very first game developed by XLGAMES, XL1 will be available for free on Steam.

name: KungFu Town VR
short_description: KungFu Town VR is a simulation KungFu game based on character AI and character skeleton creation. In the game you can attack on other people by fist, pick up weapons, AI characters can be crushed, cut, beheaded and so on.

name: Asteroid Girl
short_description: Help the cute asteroid girl conquer the universe.

name: Hyper Knights: Battles
short_description: Spartans vs Persians, Ogres vs Chickens, Marines vs Archers. Create your own units, customize their AI and watch them fight!

name: Bravium
short_description: Bravium is an epic Hero Defense adventure RPG. Equip your heroes with mighty weapons and items, control powerful magic spells. And don't forget about the cabbages.

name: The adventure of Kroos
short_description: The adventures of Kroos is a magic style 2D horizontal action adventure game. Rich and interesting BOSS warfare, sophisticated design agencies, and plot scenarios closely linked to the puzzle design, in addition to testing the player's operation, but also to seriously consider the strategy of clearance.

name: Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn
short_description: Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn is a first person horror game heavily inspired by Swedish folklore and the Nordic mythology to create the nightmares that's been haunting Swedish children for many generations.

name: Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice VR Edition
short_description: The VR Edition of the critically acclaimed BAFTA award-winning Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice. From the makers of Heavenly Sword, Enslaved: Odyssey to the West, and DmC: Devil May Cry, comes a warrior’s brutal journey into myth and madness.

name: Gray Dawn
short_description: Embark on a terrifying adventure of a priest accused of murdering an altar boy. Gray Dawn is a psychological thriller infused with religious elements and combines story-driven quests with an artistic experience.

name: Doughlings: Arcade
short_description: Doughlings brings unique gameplay mechanics through its interesting characters and the world while combining together the best that all known Arkanoid games have to offer, polished with a modern look and design.

name: AcChen - Tile matching the Arcade way
short_description: AcChen is a simple to learn, arcade style find the matching tile game. Master the 60 different level and various bonus maps in the single player campaign. Unlock new levels by beating the clock or play in 'chill mode' without any pressure: no timer, no score just happy tile hunting.

name: DARKROOM
short_description: DARKROOM is a mystic novel. You wake up in complete darkness and you don’t know where you are or how you got there. Yet, there is someone else in this dark room.

name: Drive//Shaft
short_description: Drive//Shaft is an open-world, physics-based, multiplayer car racing game. Your mission is to be the first player to reach the mysterious glowing orb. First to ten wins. This is a great game if you have time to kill and want something silly and fun to play.

name: Zula Global
short_description: Zula is an intense free-to-play FPS in which you can play cooperatively with your teammates to overthrow the enemy side. You can enjoy new content weekly and receive gifts every day. Variety of maps and weapons from the real world so you can immerse yourself 100%.

name: Joggernauts
short_description: Jog! Jump! Switch! Coordinate the crazy conga line of alien athletes in this autorunner / puzzle platformer for 1-4 players.

name: Bankster
short_description: Embark on high-stakes heists in Bankster, a multiplayer strategy game. Outwit undercover feds, plan and execute heists, and escape with the loot. Customize vaults, face NPC police, and experience intense, tactical gameplay in dynamic environments. Beware—one of you might be a saboteur!

name: Harambe Kong
short_description: The arcade smash hit lands on Steam! In this pixelated remake of the Cincinnatti Zoo tragedy, you play as Harambe, the silverback gorilla. You must navigate through your cage to avoid kids, collect fruit and find easter eggs.

name: The Padre
short_description: The Padre is a retro stylised 3D horror adventure game tapping deep into the roots of classic horror games.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
short_description: In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach, play as Gregory, a young boy who’s been trapped overnight inside of Freddy Fazbear’s Mega Pizzaplex. With the help of Freddy himself, Gregory must uncover the secrets of the Pizzaplex, learn the truth, and survive until dawn.

name: Sinister Halloween
short_description: Experience Halloween Horror in PC or VR. You go out with your friends, trick or treating, entering haunted attractions, as you make your way to the big party, but this year's holiday of the afterlife brings something sinister.

name: Space Shaft
short_description: Space Shaft is a space simulator from the first person. Explore the asteroid belt. Collect the gas clouds to accumulate them into energy. Use this energy to accelerate and maneuver.

name: Operation Red Dragon
short_description: Operation Red Dragon is all that the humans have left to survive. You and your team fight against the undead so that you and your family can live without fear. The undead first appeared in a lab of Vladimir. He was experimenting with a parasite who could control the human brain. Everything went wrong!

name: D.F.R.: The Light
short_description: Unprepared and helpless, you are taken to a dark place where a mysterious light hunts you. In this relentlessly terrifying survival horror game, you must use your wits to stay alive long enough to extinguish the light, or perish trying. The light is crafty and observant, so this won't be an easy challenge.

name: Super Shoot Owl
short_description: Owly has been kidnapped by the treacherous Tala. Fight your way through hordes of evil llamas in a quest of liberation and vengeance.

name: Olson's Boxing Challenge
short_description: Olson's Boxing Challenge is a top down fighting game that features 7 different modes. Fight your friends, go H.A.M., and claim yourself the champion!

name: Flow Handcrafted
short_description: Flow is a math puzzle game with minimalist graphics and challenging levels. Connect numbers, place operators, and sharpen your mind in a relaxing setting.

name: Terra Tanks: Defenders of the Earth
short_description: A cloud hopping, alien blasting arcade experience that draws elements from classic shoot 'em ups and other iconic games of the 80's arcade era. Assume command of one of the five legendary Terra Tanks to defend the earth!

name: Disassembly 3D
short_description: Disassembly and destruction physics sandbox simulator. Detailed models of objects and vehicles and their internal parts. Disassemble objects successfully to unlock weapons mode and destruction. Fight evil mannequins with everything you got in physical combat!

name: Hero Plus
short_description: Hero Plus is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) based on a story written by three generations of Chinese novelists. It is free to play with cash shop items available, much like The Legend of Ares, Scions of Fate, Silkroad Online and many other MMORPG's.

name: Battle Ion
short_description: For generations your peaceful home planet Arcana has existed in harmony with its neighbors. Then the Krollarians attacked. Take command of the last remaining orbital battle station and fight back in this fast paced, space based, VR game!

name: Scions of Fate
short_description: Scion of Fate Online, one of the top MMORPG game in the history, now available on Steam.

name: Puzzle Blocks
short_description: Puzzle Blocks is a creative puzzle game with beautiful minimalistic presentation.

name: Project Cabin
short_description: Explore this mysterious cabin and solve how to escape from that place.

name: Space Rocks
short_description: Fly through your asteroid filled music library. Play the same music track in different ways with your own custom settings. The power to experience your music depending on your mood.

name: TERRACOTTA
short_description: Puzzle your way through 80+ hand-crafted levels in this uniquely challenging action-adventure game. Unleash world-shifting abilities, awaken ancient mechanisms, and defeat 8 brutal bosses - balancing cunning and force to rescue the cursed spirits of your fellow warriors.

name: State of War : Warmonger / 蓝色警戒 (Classic 2000)
short_description: Enjoy an unforgettable blast from the past with this classic real-time strategy experience. This all-inclusive bundle includes the original 22 missions from State of War (2000), and 16 additional missions from its sequel, State of War: Warmonger (2003).

name: Initiation
short_description: Lost for far too long, he’s drowning in his loneliness looking for a lean comfort by remaining close to the same rock. His feelings elude leaving him in oppressive despair. How to find the spark to lit the darkness? In which form will it come to you?

name: SchoolJump
short_description: You can take walks on the school freely by VR Controller. In addition, you can go up a school roof. Then, you can jump off school roof whenever you like.

name: Kitten Madness
short_description: Kitten Madness is an open world fast pace game where you race a kitten through various levels and game types. Kitten Madness starts out as a single player game where you control a cute kitten performing the playful actions of a kitten.

name: Crazy Cat
short_description: Crazy Cat is a simulation adventure game, the player plays a cat, shuttle in the jungle grass, adventure all the way! Green-based tone of the screen, allowing players to experience the fun back to nature!    The game is simple, but rich in content.

name: Sugy the Christmas elf
short_description: It is Christmas time and the snowmen are revolting! Christmas is near but the snowmen have kidnapped all reindeers. How can the presents reach the children nevertheless? Save Christmas!

name: The Love Boat
short_description: Join the Love Boat crew and relive the famous TV show! 🚢 ❤

name: VR Roller Coaster - Cave Depths
short_description: Experience the crazy Roller Coaster ride in Cave Depths. This 3D roller coaster will blow your mind with an exciting environment with more than 2 min ride. We have an interactive part in the experience, where you are choosing the direction where to go with head movement. Get ready for limitless Virtual Reality, powered by ARLOOPA.

name: Treasure Hunter Simulator
short_description: Dive into the exciting world of finding long forgotten treasures. Grab your metal detector and set off to explore the countryside. What today looks like a peaceful meadow might have been the scene of a fierce battle in the past, hiding now the valuable artefacts. Ready to dig in the past?

name: Trio Adventures
short_description: In a space travel, a accident makes Billy D. and your friends fall into this obcure planet. Now the adventures starts and only you can save tham.

name: The Flawless: Art's Tale
short_description: The Flawless: Art’s Tale is an action adventure game set in a brutal world of cats. Join our young hero, Art, and his droid sidekick for some epic hack 'n' shoot battles, an endearing cast of characters, an unforgettable coming of age story, and a gorgeous hand-drawn art style.

name: Super Mega Space Blaster Special Turbo
short_description: The definitive 'Turbo Edition' of the easy to play hard to master space blaster. Bringing more game modes, ships, challenges, upgradable power-ups and frantic retro space blasting fun than ever before. Alone or in co-op you’ll keep coming back to unlock ships, upgrade weapons and beat your high-score.

name: MY HERO ONE'S JUSTICE
short_description: Fight for your justice in MY HERO ONE'S JUSTICE! The popular manga and anime series clashes head-to-head and Quirk-to-Quirk in this 3D arena fighter.

name: STAND OUT VR : VR Battle Royale
short_description: Kill, build, drive, do parkour, fly, make friends, eat... Compete to be the last man alive on huge islands filled with deadly weapons and vehicles. Play the way you want, this is Battle Royale.

name: Beat the Blitz
short_description: Join Peyton Manning in Gatorade’s Beat the Blitz, a free-to-play VR experience. You’ll test your throwing skills on the field, travel inside the body to see how hydration impacts performance and more. See you on the field.

name: Cube Color
short_description: "Cube Color" - a game in which you need to repaint more territory in the color of your cube. Compete against computer or friends who will take over the earth.

name: RealFlight 8
short_description: RealFlight 8 is a flight simulator for model airplanes, helicopters, and drones. Fly more than 140 vehicles at 50+ flying sites in a huge open world. Test your skills in the challenges, and fly with your friends in online multiplayer games.

name: Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition
short_description: Expanded version of previously released Wild Romance including new UI, more features and additional never before seen in English content. Follow the adventures of Kazuma as he reconnects with four female friends who accidentally reveal that they are not mere humans.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel II
short_description: Civil war has broken out across Erebonia. After his narrow escape from Trista, Rean will take up his sword again on a journey with his Divine Knight, Valimar, in search of his friends from Class VII and a way to end the conflict before its price becomes far too dear...

name: Tevris
short_description: Classic tetromino game in VR. One of the most awaited puzzle classics to be played with motion controls. Cute blocks, vivid colors, high scores, MEGA-mode and more to come.

name: Solitaire
short_description: A collection of the most popular solitaire games, baKno-style.

name: Bridge to Another World: The Others Collector's Edition
short_description: Find the cure to save your brother from the Others.

name: Meme Dragons
short_description: In the year 4020 humanity discovered sleeping dragons on Mars. Being the great patrons we are, we hooked them up with some gene therapy and now they’re sentient! Fire. Everything’s on fire.

name: Airport Madness 3D: Volume 2
short_description: Our second volume of Airport Madness 3D compliments the first one with eight new airports, new aircraft, more gates, and sharper detail. Volume Two offers New York John F. Kennedy, Toronto Pearson, Miami, London City, San Francisco, Lukla Nepal, Hong Kong, and Chicago O'Hare.

name: Carnage in Space: Ignition
short_description: Use your fighting skill and superior agility to outmaneuver and dismantle foes in a fast-paced, vicious action-platformer! Fight your way through fierce battles and frantic platforming challenges! Earn your place as one of the galaxy's legends - if you can survive to the end!

name: Tom's Mansion
short_description: Escape or Die. Not in real life, of course. It's all just a simulation, in a mansion, with 20 minutes to escape.

name: Skydiving Simulator VR
short_description: Skydiving Simulator VR is a Virtual Reality parachuting experience in 4 different locations: Grassplains, Future City, Tropical Islands, and Snow Mountain. Perfect for casual gamers and sports seekers. Support for both HTC Vive and Oculus Rift.

name: ATV Simulator VR
short_description: Engage in a virtual reality ATV driving experience in a free-range outdoor environment. Explore a forest with jumps and scenery. SteamVR and Oculus support included.

name: Seek Not a Lighthouse
short_description: After they stopped receiving communications from the creature below, all hope was lost, with the final message warning the islanders to be aware of what, or who, was to come...

name: Cardinal Conclave
short_description: In Cardinal Conclave you play as Kip! Battle aliens and fly through the air as your planet's last hope for survival.

name: Savage Offroad
short_description: SAVAGE OFFROAD is a retro-inspired truck racing game set in a post apocalyptic future. It's part racing, part gladiatorial combat and ALL ACTION! Join a tribe of irradiated savages that FIGHT and RACE for the future!

name: Vikings On Trampolines
short_description: It's all about trampolines! Stay on the trampolines and push your opponents off to win. Brawl against your friends or work together to save the kingdom. Big bosses, big minigames and evil balloons..? Play solo or local multiplayer for up to 4 players! Accessible controls: Only one hand needed.

name: Monstrous
short_description: Monstrous is a melee combat oriented action adventure game featuring Gothic horror characters entangled in fragile alliances and settling rivalries; played in a free roaming city amidst industrial revolution.

name: Yanone: Letter Splatter
short_description: Yanone immerses you in a quirky environment where the fast-paced action requires you to be on your guard at all times.

name: External Visions
short_description: An artistic metroidvania with a classic NES era gameplay, taking the player through the life of an average man escaping his depression in a partly imaginary world he created around him. Fight more than 60 enemy types and 5 bosses, uncover more than 160 areas and unlock all powers and items.

name: Choice of Rebels: Uprising
short_description: Lead the revolt against a bloodthirsty empire! You grew up under the iron fist of the Hegemony. Now is your chance to end their blood-fueled magic, as you forge a ragtag outlaw band into a rebel army.

name: SpacePig
short_description: Journey to the moon as the whimsical SpacePig in this fun and entertaining cartoon-style game.

name: Brink of Extinction
short_description: Brink of Extinction is a challenging tower defense game set in the ruins of human civilization. Battle swarms of insects over 15 campaign levels and 8 continuous mode levels. At your disposal you have an arsenal of brutal weapons, ranging from machine gun turrets to plasma and rail turrets.

name: Rise of Legions
short_description: Rise of Legions has shut down. It was a strategy and deck building game with dynamic, tactical gameplay.

name: Zen Chess: Mate in One
short_description: Zen Chess: Mate in One is a minimalist chess puzzle game. Solve mate-in-one problems in a beautifully designed chess board.

name: Tico
short_description: Unique shapes of colored blocks drop from the top. Your task is to avoid letting the stacked blocks reach the top by arranging them in complete rows across the bottom.

name: The Z Axis: Continuum
short_description: Escape a bizarre world by rotating the universe. Use portals, physics, time, and clones as floors become walls, walls become ceilings, left becomes down, and right becomes up. You manipulate time and space at will, but do you have the mind to solve the warped reality that imprisons you?

name: Final Cut: Homage Collector's Edition
short_description: Will you heed the director’s final casting call?

name: Yatzy
short_description: Yatzy is the popular dice game played in a variety of ways all over the world.

name: Battle Runner
short_description: It's time to unleash your inner Warrior! Battle Runner is a casual runner with difficult, random, procedurally generated levels. You're the fighter, travelling to new lands seeking quests, fame and an adventure - time waits for no one so you'll have to run fast, and there will be many obstacles in your way.

name: The 111th Soul
short_description: Embark on a touching and creepy journey about sacrifice and how sometimes a person pays for the sins of another

name: Mystery Case Files: The Revenant's Hunt Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you stop the Revenant before it’s too late?

name: Bold Blade
short_description: Bold Blade, the bitesize pixel art action RPG where your sword keeps getting bigger! Pursuing the legend of a sword powerful enough to fell mountains, you journey to a remote island populated by demons.

name: SK8
short_description: SK8 is a physics-based hardcore 2D platformer with a punishing difficulty curve which encourages a careful approach. Roll your way to the top and become a true sk8r!

name: Prehistorik 2
short_description: classic platform game caveman's quest for food, humorous end of level bosses. collecting items (including food, diamonds, video games, etc.)

name: Thrushbriar Hall
short_description: A Victorian mansion with a dark secret, gathering more information will help you solve the mystery around the activity haunting this place. The mansion’s residents have captured you within its walls and it is up to you to figure out how to get out.

name: Katyusha
short_description: A Platform/RPG with Pixel Art graphics. Control Katyusha during World War II, as she is missing her beloved boyfriend who has left for the war. Experience real-life battles, a levelling system, crafting, meet historical soldiers and fight your enemies.

name: Bridge Trek
short_description: Face your fear of heights! Bridge Trek provides you with a safe environment to conquer your gephyrophobia or acrophobia in virtual reality. Build your way up from the pillow padded first bridge, to the perilous glass bridge in the sky!

name: Offensive Dimensions
short_description: Offensive Dimensions is a hardcore, dark themed, retro 2d action game. Currently is in early access phase. This game tests your 2d action gaming skill. You need to smash everything and make it to the next area before time is up. The demo version is available for downloading. Please try that first.

name: 7th Sector
short_description: Welcome to the 7th Sector, set in a mysterious cyberpunk world. Immerse yourself on this intricate path, solving different puzzles, facing its dangers and collecting scattered information to discover the story of this world.

name: VEHICLES FURY
short_description: VEHICLES FURY Game : is Sci Vi Vehicle Combat Simulation Online Multiplayer Game play with one of the wonderful cars available to your team and each car has points of strength and weakness and each vehicle composite weapon and control your cars by the W,S,A,D key and direct your weapon towards the enemy team through the mouse

name: Alma
short_description: Guide the dead soul "Alma" through the eight levels of the Aztec underworld to reach the god and goddess of death, so that her soul may find peace. In this beautiful, hand illustrated 2D platformer, each level of the game corresponds to one of the eight levels of the Aztec underworld, Mictlan.

name: Chocolate makes you happy
short_description: Casual colorful physical puzzle with sweets and explosions.

name: The Perfect Sniper
short_description: The Romano family has taken over the city. Corrupt politicians and police agencies do nothing to stop them. Become the morally ambiguous champion this city needs as a Sniper in Virtual Reality.

name: Season's Beatings
short_description: Season's Beatings is a fast and frantic one hit kill FPS best described as first person Hotline Miami. You'll need to memorize enemy patterns and placements, and execute a meticulously thought out plan to succeed! Or...y'know. Just dive in and shoot some fools with a tommy gun.

name: ARIS
short_description: Strategically clear your way of enemies to gather points, salvage killed enemies for extra points, all while avoiding and engaging in combat with other different types of enemies. Added effects and game mechanics make for challenging gameplay in a fast paced environment.

name: Stacker
short_description: Stacker is an arcade twin stick shooter, where your shots stick to the walls. Defeat waves of enemies with your skill.

name: TAOTH - The Adventures of the Herkulez
short_description: A mouse controlled vertical scroller/shooter (with bonus mazes)

name: Station 228
short_description: Help the guard Ramses get out of this damn station. You need to go home to your family. Your awaits an incredible journey.

name: Sakura no Mori † Dreamers
short_description: Who is the one hiding deeply in abyss? The Devil? The Killer? or—Yourself?

name: Wild Wolf
short_description: Wild Wolf is a survival-based game about a wolf's life struggle. You have to face the hunter by carrying the responsibility of the wolf.

name: Lawnmower Game 2: Drifter
short_description: Sequel to Lawnmower Game. Drive with more faster lawnmowers and game contains 3 gamemodes

name: Cycle 28
short_description: Cycle 28 is a classic arcade space combat game where you have six minutes to beat your high-score. Simple controls, powerful upgrades, and intense dogfights. Perfect for when you just need to switch off and shoot something. See you on the scoreboard!

name: All That Remains
short_description: All That Remains is a 90's inspired eerily atmospheric adventure narrative that lets you experience one man’s life as he comes to terms with his final moments on an abandoned Earth.

name: Barrimean Jungle
short_description: Barrimean Jungle is a first-person game, which we prepared with the most exotic spices. You play as John, who has traveled to different corners of the world more than once. Are you sure about this?

name: Spinning Around
short_description: Are you up for the challenge? Spinning around is an arcade game that will test your reflexes in the simplest form. Guide your spaceship through the gates,be fast!

name: Karate Krab
short_description: Karate Krab is a 2.5D action platformer about a crab who was abandoned by his cast, seeking revenge in the form of Karate!

name: Imperi
short_description: Use your wits and political skills to turn a tiny settlement into a Province that you become King over. Reflexes and cheat codes wont help here...just raw management skills and attention to detail.

name: CLIMB!
short_description: A 2D mountain climbing simulation taking place on some of the most dangerous mountains around the world with a touch of ridiculous hyper-violence!

name: While you are Downloading
short_description: A quick and action paced retro styled arcade shooter, or shoot 'em up (shmup) if you like. Perfect to play in short chunks, like when you are waiting for big games to download.

name: PixelJunk™ Monsters 2
short_description: PixelJunk™ Monsters is back with the simple, yet highly strategic real-time tower defense gameplay gameplay of the original title, now with updated graphics and brand new multiplayer modes!

name: Villages™
short_description: Villages™ is an Open-World Sandbox game that has rules to encourage People to make a complex society and economy.

name: Moon Bullet
short_description: Moon Bullet is a side-scrolling endless shooter with pixelated graphics and simple controls to kill zombies in a short and childish sci-fi thriller. Plus, greate tunes, ginger roots and good dose of RNG.

name: The Boogie Man
short_description: "You are the player, and must chase the Boogie Man. If you catch him, you win! And that's the happy ending, but if you don't..." This is the third title in the Strange Man series. Keith tours a castle with his wife, Helena. Sit back, and enjoy tonight's entertainment: A horrific display of murder.

name: DragonFangZ - The Rose & Dungeon of Time
short_description: Test your wits and courage against a dungeon packed with mystery, monsters and fangs where the rules of the rogue-like are not always obeyed!

name: Super Sportmatchen
short_description: Super Sportmatchen is a fun and fantastical retro party sports game for up to four players!

name: MyTD 我的塔防
short_description: [MYTD] is a tower defense strategy game, Unlike traditional tower defense.[MYTD] has added a lot of fresh play.[MYTD] is a pixel tower game strategy placed through games, with endless defense mode, character upgrades, defensive towers skills to choose, turret and changeful, one thousand kinds of style let you challenge without limit, the...

name: Just Jump
short_description: This is a very simple game,you can play it just with the SPACE button.But we should pay attention to that players must have enough endurance to finish the game in one time.If the players give up halfway, they will start again.

name: The Hanged Man
short_description: "You're a demon child. Someday, you'll be burning in hell for your sins.". This is the fourth and final title in the Strange Man series, developed by Uri Games. Will was running away from home with his mouse buddy Pop, until the two of them wandered into an abandoned building. What secrets lie hidden within?

name: Feed the Animals
short_description: Dear fellow Players, Please do not purchase the game anymore because it will become free anytime soon! If you have already purchased it, thanks a million. I do hope you liked it!

name: Eternal Dread
short_description: Welcome to the unforgiving world ruled by the four Elder Fiends. Mankind as a whole is facing an unprecedented crisis that could lead to their total extinction. Having exhausted brave men in a war against the fiends, they now have no choice but to recruit the help of women to fight for their losing cause.

name: The Six Dragons
short_description: Welcome to The Six Dragons Discover 256km2 of Open-World full of surprises, escape 1 billion dungeons, craft and enchant items

name: Townsmen VR
short_description: Townsmen VR uses the exciting possibilities of virtual reality to further enhance the classic city building game with entirely new gameplay experiences and interactive mechanics. It combines elements of a God-game simulation and a classic building game with the interactive possibilities of VR.

name: Illusion: A Tale of the Mind
short_description: Embark on a journey like no other that traverses the psyches of a faded father and a devious killer, as Emma fights to muster the courage to save her father from a wicked illusionist's mind.

name: Trigonometry
short_description: Trigonometry is a fun casual game, ​The rotating triangle in Trigonometry is the pivoting center of this exciting action game! Match colors to go further and try to beat your own score!

name: Combat Tested
short_description: In Combat Tested, you must escape from the lab where you are being held after being experimented on. Luckily, these experiments have left you with special powers that will aid you in your escape.

name: Moving Day
short_description: Meet Nyla. A 13 year old girl who is moving house. However the old house looks to have other ideas. Now work you way though your house to try an escape.

name: Motorbike Garage Mechanic Simulator
short_description: Become a professional bike mechanic and develop your business doing something you love. This comprehensive, technical simulation is all about choppers – the manliest motorcycles in the world. Exchange parts, service bikes and assemble them from scratch!

name: Dead Climb
short_description: Dead Climb is a casual ragdoll physics-based game about climbing after death. The player is thrown into mountain climbing limbo and has to use his dead limbs to reach the top. Zombietaining!

name: Retinopsy VR - Look
short_description: Retinopsy VR – Look app was primarily developed to help people, who have difficulties reading or watching content on regular computer screens, by utilizing virtual reality technology. In addition to this, it provides a wonderful, immersive cinema-like experience for everyone.

name: The Sinking City Remastered
short_description: Powered by Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City Remastered brings the eerie, atmospheric world of Oakmont back to life with enhanced gameplay and fully relit environments, perfect for both newcomers and returning players.

name: Diesel Railcar Simulator
short_description: Drive vintage diesel trains, shifting gears manually and trying to reach a perfect score. Create new routes, trains and timetables. Share your creations and download new content from the Workshop.

name: AWAY: The Survival Series
short_description: In this story-based adventure, play as a tiny sugar glider in your very own nature documentary. Glide among the trees, fight dangerous predators, and explore beautiful environments as you embark on a high-flying journey to save your family.

name: Last Anime boy: Saving loli
short_description: 2088 year. As it turned out, the future is not that bright. Nazi Muslims came to power. In the world, everything was banned: LGBT community, miniskirts, free parking, and most importantly banned ANIME.

name: Ascending Madness
short_description: Ascending Madness is a hardcore, psychedelic, twin-stick shooter adventure. Assassinate a renegade scientist who appears to have gone completely insane.

name: Hover X Souls: Git Gud Edition
short_description: Hover X Souls is a refresh of the infinite runner genre. You are X-17 a hover shield combat class robot. You have been tasked with going through training on this planet to become stronger, while helping develop outposts. Master the Hover Shield Combat system, and use it to travel the dark highway while providing protection to Outposts.

name: Slice of Sea
short_description: Slice of Sea is a peaceful adventure and puzzle game. You play as Seaweed, a sea creature clearly out of their element. Explore desolate world of dust, all hand-drawn on paper in unique art style. Collect items, solve puzzles and lead Seaweed back home to the sea.

name: Air Hockey
short_description: Online PvP Air Hockey with fast-paced gameplay! Overcome your opponent by using madskillz and powerful pickups.

name: Google Spotlight Stories: Piggy
short_description: A jogging pig meets a delicious cake. Will he give in to temptation? Not while you’re watching! Google Spotlight Stories presents Piggy VR, a new level of interaction between character and audience. Directed by Jan Pinkava & Mark Oftedal. Produced with Evil Eye Pictures.

name: Google Spotlight Stories: On Ice
short_description: “On Ice” tells the story of an over-the-top, sci-fi themed ice show and its star, who suddenly finds he has competition for the spotlight from an unlikely rival.

name: Super Dashmatch
short_description: Super Dashmatch is a one-screen Multiplayer Party Game, in which players control fighting orbs on a shape-shifting arena. Players have to dash their opponents out of the game to win. Super Dashmatch is a local and online multiplayer game for 2 to 4 players.

name: Skylight
short_description: Skylight is a turn-based tactics game of colossal space battles, with VR and non-VR versions. Command nimble squadrons of fighters, specialized frigates, and giant capital ships as you orchestrate your forces toward victory.

name: Gunlock
short_description: Gunlock is a fast paced score chasing action arcade platformer with over a dozen unlockable guns, several bosses, and many secrets. Perfect for playing in short 5-minute sessions, yet has enough content to entertain for several hours.

name: WRONGED
short_description: WRONGED combines adventure-puzzle gameplay and a low-poly, pixelated art style with an oppressive horror atmosphere. Use only household items and your own wits to escape a warped, claustrophobic nightmare world shrouded in darkness.

name: War Brokers
short_description: War Brokers is a fast paced, first person, 3D shooter focused on fun and tactical choices. Players start on an equal footing with access to all weapons and vehicles. A player's skill and tactical choices will win the day.

name: Socketeer
short_description: Strategically hack robots to control their combat abilities and use them to advance deeper into each space station stronghold in this charming sci-fi roguelike.

name: Age of Ascent
short_description: Age of Ascent: Arrival is a new space co-op and combat game featuring direct-piloting solo and co-op missions and real-time PvE and PvP battles set in stunning space scenes.

name: Arcade Tycoon ™ : Simulation Game
short_description: Build stunning Arcade Centre’s, purchase a range of arcades machines, manage troublesome staff in this colourful and humorous simulation management game. Inspired by Two Point Hospital, Let's Build A Zoo and Megaquarium.

name: Garenburg Woods
short_description: Garenburg Woods, a happy RPG where you must stay on trail. Everybody is sure to have a great time...

name: Naughty Elves
short_description: Naughty Elves is a Christmas themed 2D pixelart puzzle game. Your goal is to help Santa Claus to get back the presents from the naughty elves who want them all for themselves. Hit the elves with a snowball to knock them out and make them pay for their treason.

name: SUSHIDO VS ZOMBIES
short_description: NINJA×SUSHI×ZOMBI, a new spin on the classic Sushi Ninja Action genre. Throw sushi like ninja stars to protect your shop from the approaching zombies.

name: CRONEWORLD RPG ADVENTURE - 1
short_description: CRONEWORLD is a fantasy-story telling rpg indie game. It is a game about humans fighting wizards with flying robot 'CRONES'. It's world has Eastern culture, Western culture, science fiction and magics.

name: Slice the Ice
short_description: Just SLICE THE ICE in this adorable physics-heavy puzzle adventure.

name: Labyronia Elements
short_description: Five imaginative open worlds to explore. Five connecting stories, uniting the limits of fantasy and reality. Five elements to master. Which world will you enter first? Labyronia Elements restores the old school RPG magic, delivering a challenge and story for the ages.

name: Christmas Puzzle 2
short_description: Play through cool Match 3 levels, collect Santa’s coins and prepare your house for Christmas with beautiful ornaments and decorations!

name: Hollow Throne
short_description: The Galaxy is at it's peak, The Hollow Throne looks horrid, It's going to need heroic deeds, To change the fate that's coming...

name: Egress
short_description: Fight for one of the many characters on the streets of Insmouth with monsters, obsessed with other adventurers! Keep your mind and stay alive on this madness island!

name: You are a torpedo AI
short_description: Navigate a torpedo in environments filled with obstacles and DESTROY YOUR TARGET.

name: MAGIX Video Pro X9 Steam Edition
short_description: Enter the professional level of video editing with Video Pro X9 – Steam Edition. Whether you're working on a high-resolution 6K recording or professional 360-degree videos, the software delivers impressive results in broadcast quality.

name: The Dream Collector
short_description: Discover what happens to our abandoned dreams in "The Dream Collector," a VR film that follows the story of an old man and his dog, who collect broken dreams and try to fix them.

name: JumpBall 2
short_description: This time the Colorfull Ninjas must deliver a signed diploma to the JumpBall Ninjas Association.

name: Fight desserts
short_description: This is just another way of fighting life. Too many annoying things are full of life. But we can still eat a dessert to show our standpoint to life. Sweet food What a wonderful thing. It tempts us, Consumes our wallet, at the same time, Brings us happiness and weight gain. But you have a gun ...

name: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
short_description: As Lara Croft races to save the world from a Maya apocalypse, she must become the Tomb Raider she is destined to be.

name: Yissa Deep Realms
short_description: Hardcore action platformer with multiple endings that depend on your choices.

name: NEKO-NIN exHeart +PLUS Saiha
short_description: From developer Whirlpool comes the 2nd mini-sequel to NEKO-NIN exHeart featuring the sub-character, Saiha! Saiha tells our protagonist that a runaway ninja has sneaked their way into town. She doesn't know what their motives are, but it may involve him.

name: Ice Age Scrat's Nutty Adventure
short_description: Scrat’s on a brand new quest! Sabre-tooth squirrel Scrat is on a nutty quest! His prized possession is locked inside an ancient Scratazon Temple – and the only way to get it back is to retrieve four legendary Crystal Nuts, scattered across the land.

name: Nonograms Prophecy
short_description: Over 380 challenging puzzles in 3 different game modes! From beginners to experts! Solve tricky puzzles, approved by ancient gods! Develop your brain skills using logic and reasoning!

name: OVERVIEW (A Walk Through The Universe)
short_description: Overview is a mind-changing experience about our position in the Universe. With a narrative and an interactive mode, it features realistic imagery and accurate data to leave you in awe and wonder at the vastness of the Cosmos.

name: Puzzle Tactics
short_description: Puzzle Tactics is a turn-based and grid-based tactics game played in various small levels. You play as the blue team with the goal of defeating the red team's units before losing your own. Later levels are more difficult and introduce more unit types in battle.

name: ETHEREAL
short_description: A profound experience that carries players into an unknown and mysterious world surrounded by carefully designed puzzles...

name: Hyper Slasher
short_description: Become a melee master as you gloat on the corpses of friend and foe. Hack, slash and dash your way around a deadly arena. Choose a character - each with a specialized melee weapon, and get slicing and dicing your friends into bloody pixelized bits today!

name: Big Tower Tiny Square
short_description: No Princess, only Pineapple! Dodge bullets, leap lava pits, and wall-jump your way up the Big Tower in this precision platformer. Quick deaths, generous respawns, and a whole lot of jumping.

name: Astrohazard Solutions Ltd.
short_description: Astrohazard Solutions Ltd. is an interstellar and interspecies corporation dealing mainly with removing and redirecting asteroids and other cosmic junk that threatens their Clients.

name: Snail Trek - Chapter 1: Intershellar
short_description: Chapter 1 is now free! Relive 1980s nostalgia in this text parser driven graphic adventure game. You and your molluscan crew embark on an epic journey to find a new home world. In Chapter 1 - Intershellar, wake up from your long trip only to discover a saboteur has been at work.

name: Alice Mystery Garden
short_description: Join Alice, who has wandered into the wondrous land of Alice Mystery Garden, to overcome adversity in this VR action-puzzle game. Control Alice's movements while switching back and forth between a top-down player perspective and Alice's in-world perspective to collect scattered looking-glass fragments and clear each stage.

name: Echo
short_description: ”Echoes of the heart" can be heard the moment each other's paths intertwine. "Echo" is an action RPG with a perfectly sized storyline and a unique progression system. The story begins with Lin, a young, solo adventurer. Many secrets lie within a closed off forest. Can you hear that faint voice?

name: Battery Jam
short_description: Use the boombox to smash your opponents, capture their tiles and dominate the arena! Take on your friends in Battery Jam, a local multiplayer game of competitive territorial mayhem!

name: ASSAULT GUNNERS HD EDITION
short_description: You are in control of DAT, a Battle Mech Peace Keeping Force. You must save Earth’s Migrants and the Mars Colonies from the threat of the ANTS uprising. Who or what could be leading this threat against Mars, and the new planned perfect utopia for humanity?

name: Deadly Contact
short_description: A wave-based zombie survival game

name: Sacred Four
short_description: "Ziegwen" a godly sword on a chain which, once you release it, flies through the air like a flash of light to destroy evil. Master control of "Ziegwen" to fight monsters in this new style of VR action game!

name: The Turdler
short_description: Have you ever wanted to go back and re-live life as a toddler? Here is your chance to be The Turdler you always knew you could be in this crude VR title that throws you the reins of mass destruction.

name: Puzzle of Santa Girl VR
short_description: Solve Santa Girl's puzzles and Get the Gifts! There are 3 mini puzzle games(Catch the Santa Girl / Count the Santa Girls / Spot the Differences)!

name: VR Kanojo / VRカノジョ
short_description: This is Steam version."all characters in this game are 18+"We have a trial version here.

name: Nanairo Reincarnation
short_description: Join spirit detective Kagami Makoto and his demon familiars as they hunt down the wandering ghosts disrupting the peace of his small town.

name: Deadstep
short_description: You have a nightmare of being chased by a ghost for five days. You can't find a ghost with your eyes. You should avoid the ghost and find items needed for the exorcism. Pay attention to the traces of footprints, footsteps left by the ghost. Find the items and survive before the ghost finds you!

name: Vector Velocity
short_description: In Vector Velocity movement is the name of the game. Run, Jump, Slide, Climb, Grind, Skid, Zipline and ultimately race your way from point A to B as fast as you can.

name: WaveCrash!!
short_description: Head-to-head puzzle brawling action! Match blocks to send waves at your opponent! Dodge their waves or crash them head-on to survive. Unleash unique super attacks and explosive Hype Mode to tip the scales. It's a back-and-forth struggle for arcade puzzling dominance!

name: TINY METAL
short_description: Craft unique strategies and outmaneuver your foes in TINY METAL, a turn-based Japanese wargame! With new tactical options, you will command over 16 tactically diverse units, flank, assault, deploy heroes from orbital dropships, and focus the firepower of multiple units to even out otherwise disastrous odds.

name: Dog Fight Super Ultra Deluxe
short_description: Take to the skies in this fast paced, aerial combat game featuring blazing gameplay. Keep your home safe solo against a swarm of UFOs or compete against other players in online multiplayer modes.

name: Duel Jousting
short_description: Dragon Jousting in 2.5D. Become the best Dragon Jouster as you level up, progress through stages, and show your might in the arena!

name: The Same Crime
short_description: The Same Crime is a VR secret room escape game(first part) developed by Fuzhou immersed Network Technology Co. Ltd. Play games in an abandoned mental hospital from the first person perspective, find props, unlock the organs, and find useful clues to unravel the mysteries.

name: Dinosaurs A Prehistoric Adventure
short_description: Be the dinosaur! Experience the world of dinosaurs like never before! Dinosaurs A Prehistoric Adventure is an ARPG where you could play as 15 dinosaurs in a semi-open world environment.

name: DARKROOM 2
short_description: DARKROOM: Ray of Light is a sequel of DARKROOM. You managed to figure out where you are, and now you have to find out what to do next. Do you want to know the end of Timmy’s story?

name: After the Fall®
short_description: From the team that brought you Arizona Sunshine® comes an epic VR action FPS with intense co-op gameplay at its core. Team up with friends and take on a hostile VR world filled with ferocious undead--mutated and twisted by the relentless cold.

name: Dead Dungeon
short_description: Challenging 2D platformer in the best traditions of classic games, with an excellent chiptune soundtrack. The game will check your nerves for strength and bring a lot of emotions.

name: Cloud Chasers - Journey of Hope
short_description: In a dried up world, where death is your destiny, can you survive the struggle?

name: C64 & AMIGA Classix Remakes Sixpack 2
short_description: Get some of the classic games from the 80s and 90s back on your home PC - as a remake.

name: The Mammoth: A Cave Painting
short_description: Tell the 5 million year story of the mammoth in 5 minutes.

name: Tennis Arcade VR
short_description: Tennis Arcade VR is an arcade tennis game featuring many interesting game modes, realistic physics, global leaderboards and even a PvP mode where you can prove your tennis skills to the world!

name: Roller Coaster Egypt VR
short_description: Roller Coaster Egypt VR more than five minutes, with lots of excitement and speed. Enjoy the ride between pyramids, mummies and even spiders! Two rides included, day and night. Enjoy the night ride and have fun!

name: Forager
short_description: The highly popular and quirky "idle game that you want to actively keep playing". Explore, craft, gather & manage resources, find secrets and build your base out of nothing! Buy land to explore and expand!

name: Antimatter Drive
short_description: A PvP starship-building auto battler! Strategically craft, place, and synergize weapons to outsmart real opponents.

name: Black Future '88
short_description: Black Future ’88 is a Synth-Punk roguelike 2D action Shooter. Vertically climb an always evolving procedural tower to reach the top and kill its insane owner…before your heart explodes. Shoot, slash, dash and upgrade yourself to survive the endless waves of Homicidal AI, Traps & Colossal Wardens.

name: Chopper Battle New Horizon
short_description: Escape your opponents with avidly daring maneuvers and become a hunter, who knows no mercy! Embark on a mission that requires all your flying skills!

name: Sealer Assist
short_description: Sealer Assist is a Turn based RPG Deck-building game with a lot of different builds. The power of a Sealer is an earned weapon set that not everyone can use, take out on journey of one of said Sealers, beginning first in the Moon Elf Village.

name: Flight of the Athena
short_description: Flight of the Athena is a twin-stick shooter + roguelite; fight through the procedurally generated campaign to earn new craft, weapons and upgrades as you take on the enemy fleet to destroy their central command.

name: TACTICAL
short_description: TACTICAL is a challenging combination of puzzle and top-down shooter. You have one objective: eliminate all of the security robots. The catch is that you must not be discovered and only shots to the back will be effective.

name: Plox Neon
short_description: Use your wits to find the best way to clear areas of the map and trap monsters to earn points in this byte-sized arcade experience with action-packed puzzles and music to match!

name: Box Cats Puzzle
short_description: This is a puzzle game. A lot of cute cats want to enter a box, you need to help them~！

name: Bug Battle
short_description: Bug Battle Game is a simple top down shooter game. Players shoot at animated bugs that are spawned by a boss crawling on top of the screen. Once a specific amount of baby bugs are killed, the player is then able to damage the boss bug and level up.

name: The Apartment
short_description: The Apartment is a small psychological thriller. Interesting mix of first person detective adventure game, puzzle solving, psychological horror and FPS action, all tied together with dark and heavy story where lines between reality and nightmare have no meaning anymore.

name: Paradise Lost: FPS Cosmic Horror Game
short_description: An Spec Ops team was sent to a planet to investigate a disappearance of a research team. What lies beneath this god-forsaken planet?

name: Univers
short_description: Survival in space. Explore, repair and build in an ancient spaceship that lost its way many, many years ago...

name: Virtual Reality Girls
