Sit comfortably in your armchair, put on VR googles and transfer yourself to terrace located in the middle of big metropolis. Play around as choreographer, pick outfit, dance type and surrounding for the beautiful female dancer.

name: Subwar 2050
short_description: Includes the original Subwar 2050 and its expansion, The Plot Deepens.Pilot four types of submarine including deep-sea exploration vessels, reconnaissance subs, and highly maneuverable fighter submarines.

name: Project Fox Online
short_description: Project Fox Online is a third-person multiplayer shooter built around team-based tactics, stealth and action. Players improve their individual skills to rank up and compete in a variety of game modes within official tournaments for unique cosmetic gear and points.

name: Intergalactic traveler: The Omega Sector
short_description: A 2D game about solving labyrinths with puzzles and turn based combat, test your skills in the omega sector.

name: Save Your Nuts
short_description: Go nuts in this insane 1 to 8 players chaotic arena party game. Put your cooperation skills to the test over intense physics-based battles mixing competitive online games and casual offline modes..

name: One Night
short_description: A free-to-play retro style survival horror game that resembles classics from the Playstation 1 era.

name: VR Dunhuang
short_description: VR Dunhuang is developed with 8 grottoes，basically covering all dynasties in the Dunhuang Grottoes. By constantly upgrade VR Dunhuang and optimize the update, there will be gradually more than 700 caves of the Mogao Grottoes, more than 2000 statues, 45,000 square meters murals .

name: Space Time Shipyard
short_description: This space simulation game is currently not purchasable but is in active development.

name: Scientific project: Optic
short_description: Welcome to the thrilling world of 'Scientific project: Optic'! This immersive first-person puzzle game invites you on a journey through the realm of optical science, from its philosophical origins to modern understanding.

name: Shape of America: Episode One
short_description: Shape of America is a story-driven, non-linear, turn-based role-playing game about politics. The story is set the United States in the late 1990s, you are a young man who unwittingly finds himself tied up in all the important economic and political changes of the period.

name: TERRORHYTHM (TRRT) - Rhythm driven action beat 'em up!
short_description: TERRORHYTHM - the music powered beat 'em up game. Follow the rhythm of music to defeat the security systems that keep any sound from the society. Upload your own MP3 collection and battle through your favourite tracks!

name: Arcade Love / ゲーセンラブ。
short_description: Arcade Love. (a.k.a Ge-sen Love) contains unique Beat'-em-up and Shmup games of arcade style, which has been well-played at Arcades all over Japan.

name: CINERIS SOMNIA
short_description: "I hope that someday, you'll dream of me." -- CINERIS SOMNIA is a 3D adventure through a beautifully strange and mesmerizing world - and a young girl's cruel and forlorn dreams.

name: Sniper Elite VR
short_description: Grab your rifle, gaze down the scope and take aim in this stealth-action WW2 first-person shooter built exclusively for VR. With an explosive campaign, astonishing immersion, authentic weaponry, and signature gunplay from the award-winning Sniper Elite series

name: Ghoulboy - Dark Sword of Goblin
short_description: Ghoulboy is a retro-inspired action platformer. Explore a magical realm of dungeons, towns, treasures and devious monsters.

name: Football Nation VR Tournament 2018
short_description: Football Nation VR™, bringing virtual football to life. NEW 2018 Tournaments inspired by the World Cup. For the first time ever, you can physically feel the rush of playing in Football's biggest VR tournament as the vast stadium surrounds you; the virtual grass underfoot, the crowd cheering, the excitement and the undeniable patriotism...

name: Close Call Extreme
short_description: 80's arcade mood is back with Close Call Extreme. It’s endless. It’s challenging. It’s definitely addictive. Pass 10 cars, get extended time. Dare to close call to get more score. But remember; it’s not as easy as it sounds. So let's start... those... ENGINES!

name: Ripped Pants at Work
short_description: Ripped Pants at Work is a frantic stealth game about searching for new pants!

name: Noahmund
short_description: Dive into a new world and discover the mysteries of Synchrony. Fight with Motion Battle Chess, an original battle system that mixes strategy and real-time action. Connect to a deeply emotional story of love and war, accompanied by a touching soundtrack influenced by the classic JRPGs.

name: Song of Memories (Complete Scenario)
short_description: A next generation romantic adventure game with a story focused on songs and ultimate decision-making. In addition to a massive scenario that takes place in an academy, this game features over 40 hours worth of voices played by an all-star cast of voice actors.

name: Imperivm RTC - HD Edition "Great Battles of Rome"
short_description: Lead the battles that forged the greatest Empire of all time. Seven civilizations fighting for glory or freedom: Rome, Aegyptus, Britannia, Germania, Gallia, Hispania, and Carthago. Enjoy the fast-paced RTC “Real-Time Conquest” gameplay, an Old School RTS oriented to military conquest.

name: A Plague Tale: Innocence
short_description: Follow the grim tale of young Amicia and her little brother Hugo, in a heartrending journey through the darkest hours of history.

name: Dual Snake
short_description: Control a two-headed snake, as you overcome a series of challenges in this puzzle game.

name: National Rugby Manager
short_description: With the best match engine ever seen in a rugby manager, combined with the best rugby teams and players in the French Leagues at your fingertips, National Rugby Manager gives you the chance to lead your team to glory and conquer French rugby.

name: Abscond
short_description: Avoiding all obstacles and collect points before they are destroyed. Watch out for projectiles and enemies stalking you! Will you the #1 highscore on leaderboard against your friends?

short_description: Infinity Trip is a simple and addictive endless runner game. You control a little ship gliding through a beautiful exotic world, avoiding obstacles and collecting coins to unlock new cool spaceships.

name: Isle TD
short_description: Join this fantasy adventure with your friends! Defeat the enemies together and defend the island of Veldt. Craft Weapons to help you through the battles!

name: GyroShooter
short_description: Aim the targets approaching from all sides! The game looks like a shoot'em up but no, this new style game involves no shooting!

name: W4RR-i/o-RS
short_description: Semi-automatic micro-sandbox with a console interface. You decide the fates, but don't see anything actually going on. Imagine your purpose is just to simulate a human's decision making system, in a lack of information beyond the spreadsheet numbers.

name: Mysterious Realms RPG
short_description: Engage in unique Crystal-based combat you haven't seen before. Slay enemies, overcome events and empower your party to conquer the world of mystery.

name: NOLA is Burning
short_description: A blood-soaked interactive noir thriller! Rescue your lover from the mob before dawn; more likely, die trying. But in New Orleans, death is only the beginning.

name: Choice of the Rock Star
short_description: Rock your way to the top of the '80s charts in this interactive tale of music and mayhem! But beware, mischievous managers, fickle fans, and gossiping groupies stand between you and rock immortality.

name: Choice of the Ninja
short_description: In the high-stakes game of politics between two feudal lords, you are a ninja village's chosen warrior. Earn glory for your clan as you battle your enemies, becoming a master of magic, combat, and stealth.

name: Sounds of Music
short_description: Sounds of Music is a short and minimal puzzle game that harmonizes the sounds of music.

name: Prehistoric Hunt
short_description: Dive into intense dinosaur hunting adventures with your friends. Complete hunting contracts for Preton Corporation. Gather rewards, improve your equipment and become a master hunter. Are you the hunter or the hunted?

name: Cookies vs. Claus
short_description: Cookies vs. Claus is an action-packed battle game. With a range of characters to choose from, you can battle as your favorite cookie or take on a squad as a holiday character. Through both single and multiplayer, experience a unique asymmetric shooter that combines elements of FPS and battle arena games. THIS IS COOKIES VS. CLAUS!

name: Synther
short_description: Synther is an FPP simulation game with adventure-like, detective elements set in a futuristic, open world. The game is innovative and reminiscent of early 3D games and DOS applications.

name: Harry's Burgers
short_description: A RESTAURANT SIMULATOR THRILLER: Accompany Harry - the owner of a burger shop in a rundown English town - as he struggles to keep his family safe from a local serial killer. Sell enough burgers each day so Harry can afford to secure the house at night!

short_description: Welcome to the world of Lucky Night. Enjoy a brand new life in Virtual Reality. Lucky Night is a VR social platform. You can make more friends and play fantastic games by VR equipment and intuitive ways of interactive.

The library beams you into new world where Marius, the librarian, lives between a really disorganized magic library. It’s the first demo of the newly founded VR Studio “Granola Studios”.

name: Blood Harvest 2
short_description: A HARDCORE platform game with lots of enemies, blood and explosions!

short_description: The Covid vaccine has turned some of the population into monsters. Will you be able to stop the zombie apocalypse and create a new vaccine, or will you turn to the dark side in this first-person horror shooter with consequences for your choices.

short_description: DIY Simulator is teaching everyone how to build DIY (DO IT YOURSELF) objects like electric skateboards, drones, airplanes, electric bikes, power banks and many more. By having a day and night cycle, you need to sleep because if you get tired, you cannot work.

short_description: Written in the style of a children’s book, Mhakna Gramura and Fairy Bell is a Cinematic Novel about two children named Mhakna and Sebiarno that escape the wretched Mullbear Orphanage with the help of a Fairy named Bell, who promises eternal happiness as long as they agree to never grow up.

name: STAY
short_description: Award-winning, innovative puzzle-adventure. By communicating through your PC, you must help a kidnapped man escape captivity - in real-time. While you sleep, he is alone. When you return to your PC he has hope. Your encouragement and advice will be the difference between his salvation or despair.

name: CG the Seven Virus Knights
short_description: REMEMBER THE CLASSIC AGE OF RPGs ONCE AGAIN! Chinchilla Game the seven virus knights is a classic RPG game with great inspirations from the 16-bit RPGs games! Travel between worlds parodyed with humor and discover the mystery that is involved in the game.

short_description: A​ love story tainted with secrets, in the rhythm of Jay's songs and characters with unique personalities. ​Incarnate Lyla, a young high school student, as she lives her last year and meets Henry, the shy and rather unlikeable new boy.​ Lyla is intrigued by this very mysterious boy...

name: Harem Girl: Evie
short_description: Enjoy some sexy puzzle action in this relax-alot, 'one handed' puzzle game.

name: A Small Robot Story
short_description: A Small Robot Story is an adventure-platformer where you play as Rae, a small robot who activates and has no idea why. So you need to set out and find out what's up! With a heavy emphasis on story, A Small Robot Story will take you through forests, factories, caves, laboratories, and more.

name: Lamplight Station
short_description: Lost on massive space station, you’ll need to act fast to overcome radiation, cold, heat and the station's less-friendly inhabitants in order to survive.

name: The Dream Machine - The Definitive Edition
short_description: The Dream Machine is an award-winning point & click adventure game about exploring other people's dreams. It's built by hand using materials such as clay, cardboard and broccoli. The Definitive Edition expands game with new story elements, endings, environments, enhanced graphics & sound.

name: Twinstack
short_description: Twinstack is a puzzle game that challenges your multitasking skills. The goal of the game is to clear columns and balance the stack of blocks.

name: Rogue Buddies - Aztek Gold
short_description: Rogue Buddies is an action 2D shooting platformer and adventure quest, requiring you to swap between your 4 mercenaries (Maximus, Smoke, Alpha-Tech and Duster), who each have their unique special skills. Eliminate henchmens, collect gold, avoid the savage natives and get your revenge on the evil corporate bosses.

name: Hellbound
short_description: Classic First Person Shooter style game. Like the good old days. An action game focused on speed, gore, guns, and metal music. Inspired by the 90s’ classics with modern visuals and audio!

name: J.A.W.S
short_description: An RNG, dynamic and strategic FPS. Test your mettle against endless waves of super soldiers. How long can you last?

name: Refinish Network - Paintboss VR
short_description: Can you make it as a painter? Put your skills to the test and let your creativity flow inside this paint booth simulator. Featuring realistic spray gun behavior that simulates a real world spraying pattern. Choose from multiple vehicles, including a plane.

name: Outer Wilds
short_description: Named Game of the Year 2019 by Giant Bomb, Polygon, Eurogamer, and The Guardian, Outer Wilds is a critically-acclaimed and award-winning open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop.

short_description: A PVP tactical FPS about PLANNING & EXECUTION. Sound strategy and good teamwork are essential for victory because new PROCEDURALLY-GENERATED MAPS are delivered every week. You'll face a new tactical challenge every round.

name: Restaurant Tycoon

name: End Space
short_description: Jump in your Minos Starfighter and blast your enemies into space dust in virtual reality. Maintain law and order at the mysterious and beautiful edge of inhabited space as you complete increasingly difficult contracts for the United Trade Consortium.

name: Battle for the last chicken

name: God's Basement
short_description: God's Basement is a first-person, narrative-driven, single player horror game. Uncover the secrets of an afterlife shrouded in mystery, as an entity known as "The Operator" leads you deeper into the fringes of a seemingly eternal purgatory.

name: WWII英雄列伝 最強の虎　クルト・クニスペル
short_description: その男を超える者は歴史上二度と現れないであろう。 敵戦車撃破数公式記録168両、非公式を含めると190両を超える戦車を撃破したとされ、その驚異的な記録とは裏腹に謎に包まれた伝説の戦車エース、クルト・クニスペルの戦歴を追体験する歴史戦術SLG。

name: Re-bot VR

name: MEDICALHOLODECK®. Surgery, Anatomy, Medicine, Education, and DICOM Imaging in VR. For Medical Students, Nurses, Doctors and Surgeons.

name: Piggy Poggy Pog

name: Bomb Bots Arena
short_description: Send your Bomb Bots into online arenas or blast your friends off the couch locally in Bomb Bots Arena! Bomb Bots Arena is a pure multiplayer experience with every element of the game tailored to please competitive and casual gamers alike.

name: Escort Commander

name: Defenders of Tetsoidea Academy

Customize your Gunship’s abilities and appearance, choose the tower or trap that fits best, upgrade it in your own direction and leave nothing but a wasteland behind you.

name: Math Pixels
short_description: Engage in pixel strategy: calculate sums to colorize rows and columns. Dive into a minimalist challenge of precision and calculation.

name: Hexvade
short_description: Hexvade is a competitive, action-packed combination of the classic falling-block style arcade game and the timeless platformer genre. Fight your friends in this fast-paced and strategic game! Includes a boss-rush styled singleplayer mode, battle your way through 7 unique and challenging bosses!

name: Metal Quest
short_description: Metal Quest is a 16 bit Party and class Based RPG game, semi-turn-based combat, set in a Unique world where metal music replaces magic, and traditional fantasy weapons.

name: Deadly Cryptids
short_description: Deadly Cryptids... that physically intense VR action shooter that gets your heart racing. Explore a mysterious ruin that seems oddly out of place and full of danger. Use your body to take cover and survive action-packed combat scenes where speed and agility are crucial.

name: Pixel Noir
short_description: Untangle a gripping conspiracy in this noir-influenced mystery, laced with classic RPG elements. Navigate seedy streets to collect clues, upgrade skills and customize weapons. Brawl in turn-based combat with timed hits & combos, to reveal the dark truth that plagues the city’s core and your sanity.

name: Paper Dungeons Crawler
short_description: True classic 16 bits Roguelike with an unique magic system. Explore the mysterious Dungeons of Cyndaria and unearth an extensive lore. A plethora of creatures and magical items are waiting for you to step into ever-changing dungeons, with diverse biomes and challenges.

name: 忍者村大战2
short_description: Original weather systems, seven kinds of different weather conditions will get different bonuses and bonus. Test your strain capacity and operational strategy. Professional production team, studying endure operation characteristics of the characters, special seal system, the ninja can seal a hero for the cultivation of personality.

name: Amazeing Lemons
short_description: Find and retrieve all of your lemons before time runs out!

name: 鉄道運転士 Railroad operator
short_description: Let's operate a train that makes you feel the Showa era! Current Japanese train maneuvering is the lever type, but in the past trains were operated with a mas-con handle and a brake lever. Its operation seems to be complicated, but as you repeat playing, it will lead to the "fun" inherent in railroad games.

name: Jisei
short_description: A murder mystery visual novel. Use your psychic powers to track down a killer and prove your innocence!

name: Dummy!
short_description: Dummy! - An online quiz that will help to find out which of you is the smartest! Guess movies, games, music and more! In Dummy! everyone will find an interesting topic.

name: Plutocracy
short_description: The business simulator Plutocracy gives you the chance to become wealthy and powerful to take control over the world. Where policy, laws, officials and people are only the chess pieces how do you play your game?

name: 3D Hardcore Cube 2
short_description: 3D Hardcore Cube 2 - is a continuation of a fascinating game about clever cube that moves through dangerous obstacles to the portal. In the new part of the game was implemented completely new physics control character. Were added sounds to improve the atmosphere of the game.

name: Animals Memory
short_description: Animals Memory - is a card game that tests your memory. The objective of the game is tomatch cards with the same card picture.

name: IL-2 Sturmovik: Cliffs of Dover Blitz Edition
short_description: Scramble to intercept in your RAF Spitfire or Hurricane. Or join huge formations of German or Italian Fighters and Bombers as they roar across the Channel towards London. Decide the fate of Britain!

name: Gauntlet of IRE
short_description: A 35 part obstacle course that is deceptively simple and infuriatingly obvious in the most difficult way.

name: >Mars Taken
short_description: Mars Taken is a TPP Shooter with aliens on Mars. Explore red planet and follow a deep story. This is not a story about aliens...it is a story about life and love.

name: High School Simulator
short_description: Please enjoy high school life in Japan.[How to game]Operate with XBOX Controller or KeyboardkeyboardA : Left MoveD : Right MoveW: Front MoveS : Back MoveF: JumpG: Grab human / Pick up itemR: Crouch / AttackT: Action ButtonQ : DashE : VisionMouse L Click + Mouse Move: Camera MoveXbox Controller A: JumpB: Grab human / Pick up itemX: Crouch...

name: Rockfest
short_description: Build your own festival in Rockfest! Create your festival like you always wanted and build tents, takeaways, toilets, rides and more in order to satisfy the needs of your visitors. Play and upload music of real newcomer bands and entertain the crowd!

name: Meteors
short_description: Meteors is a casual arcade indie shooter.

name: Yashik
short_description: You play for an unusual character. You must pass challenging puzzles. How to? By creating your own platforms! Some platforms are bouncy, some can move. But you only get a few. Use them wisely, player.

name: Six Days of Snow
short_description: In a small inn located in the snowy Japanese mountains, an unlikely relationship blossoms between a once-popular poet and the daughter of the inn's proprietress.

name: Travel Mosaics 6: Christmas Around the World
short_description: “Travel Mosaics 6: Christmas Around the World” is an amazing brain-jogging for everybody who wants enter the spirit of Christmas, learn something new about Christmas traditions worldwide, or just spend a nice time!

name: My Life as a Maiden
short_description: Having been enrolled into an all-girls school by his mother due to severe bullying for his feminine appearance, a 17-year-old boy spends the remainder of his high school life dressed as a girl to avoid being found out. He quickly becomes popular with many of the girls, much to his surprise.

name: The Spy Who Shrunk Me
short_description: THE SPY WHO SHRUNK ME is a stealth game where you are a superspy armed with a shrink ray! Shrink enemies and feed them to paper shredders - or shrink yourself to get past enemies. Sneak in 1980's Moscow and sabotage operations in a stealth game unlike any other.

name: Firmament
short_description: Firmament is a new puzzle-adventure game by the legendary game studio behind the best-selling games Myst and Riven. Featuring deep storytelling and world-building, discover the story of this seemingly abandoned world as you explore and unlock the mysteries of 3 unique Realms… and beyond!

name: Zero Days VR
short_description: Based on the Oscar short-listed Participant Media documentary Zero Days, Scatter's Emmy Award-winning, immersive documentary Zero Days VR visualizes the story of Stuxnet in a new way: placing you inside the invisible world of computer viruses, experiencing the high stakes of cyber warfare at a human scale.

name: Aloha Play - 阿囉哈遊戲
short_description: Welcome to Aloha Play, a fun casual game! Play as a farmhand to catch runaway chickens with simple controls and a cozy vibe. Test your skills! New maps and exciting content are coming—stay tuned!🐔✨

name: Genesis - 创世争霸
short_description: Genesis is a controller exclusive next generation online-competitive MOBA. Utilizing Unreal 4 Engine, it boasts stunning graphics and smooth control. Genesis differentiates from classic MOBA games by opting for joystick control which is highly optimized （Mouse and keyboard control is not supported）.

name: Snowglobe
short_description: Lost and alone, you awaken in a barren place, an isolated temple before you. Inside, a way out... Inspired by the point and click games of the past, Snowglobe is a virtual reality take on a familiar concept.

name: Air Dash
short_description: Minimalist style, frantic time management and equipment management game of managing a Budget Airline Tycoon. Air Dash.

name: Aurora Trail
short_description: A new epic game where the perspective of the camera changes everything. Do not let your body parts get in the same view as a wall with the same color, or you’ll lose it! Puzzle your way through challenging and appealing surroundings and try to stay in one piece!

name: Frutakia 2
short_description: Frutakia is back and better than ever! 4K@120FPS.

name: Target speed
short_description: Endless first-person race, dodge obstacles and improve your record.

name: Raining Coins
short_description: It's raining gold coins! Come, play & catch them! (4K@120FPS)

name: Impale
short_description: What could be nicer than killing hordes of zombies?

name: CyberLink PowerDVD 17 Standard
short_description: PowerDVD is the must-have companion for PCs and home entertainment systems. It’s packed with unique movie, music and photo features indispensable for creating an unbeatably immersive sight & sound experience.

name: Shawy Adventures
short_description: Shawy Adventures is a Retro Action Platformer inspired on the early Game Boy games.

name: Truth: Disorder
short_description: Truth: Disorder is an exciting story about a guy named Thoru who once realizes that his whole life is a lie.

name: Sine Requie: Snake Eyes
short_description: Based on the multiple awarded tabletop role playing game Sine Requie, Snake Eyes is an investigative horror RPG with a strong strategic component. Travel between the Tuscan Mountains in an alternative version of 1954, in which the dead arise to eat the flesh of the living.

name: Vengeful Rites
short_description: Embark on an epic adventure designed exclusively for VR! Use your own hands to cast magic, fire bows and slice through your enemies on your quest to exact vengeance against the evil Dragore. Learn new spells and craft new gear to become the greatest Serafin Warrior of all time! Demo available.

name: Essence Defenders
short_description: The Void has come to devour the world - and only Essence can stop it. Command a fleet to protect remaining islands from Demons of the Void who come to deplete the Essence Source.

name: Stage 3: Azaria
short_description: Enter a Fantasy VR world in Stage 3 Azaria, an FPS where you control a powerful Archmage, who is the only survivor after a royal meeting that ended up in betrayal and mass murder. Use your power and blast your enemies as you protect Heorogan's castle from the siege of Eolica's army.

name: The World Next Door
short_description: An addictive mix of lightning-fast puzzle battles, powerful storytelling and immersive visual novel elements, The World Next Door follows Jun, a rebellious teen girl trapped in a parallel realm inhabited by magical creatures, who must find her way home before time runs out.

name: Rocket Blasters
short_description: Rocket Blasters is a fast paced, action packed shoot-em-up set during the invasion of the Dread Pizza Armada. Its hand-drawn art gives it a unique style. Blowing stuff up has never been so fun!

name: ONE PIECE World Seeker
short_description: Leave your compass behind and join Luffy as he embarks on a brand new action-packed adventure where you can experience the powers of the legendary Gum-Gum fruit to uncover hidden secrets on an original, never-before-seen island!

name: Battle Shapes
short_description: ​A top down geometric spaceship game that draws inspiration from Smash Bros and Asteroids - play with your friends, play with your enemies, play with yourself - it's the only kind of BS you need in your life

name: Factorybelts 2
short_description: Conveyers, grinders, welders, ... and a factory that combines them all: that's what's waiting for you in Factorybelts 2. Factorybelts is a puzzle game where you complete a factory to produce different products out of different resources.

name: LIV
short_description: All-in-one VR software for creators. Record mixed reality, transform into your favorite avatar, see chat inside your headset, and more.

name: True Mining Simulator
short_description: No more cubes

name: Arrowpoint
short_description: Test your skill in this arrow shooting, leaderboard focused on-rails shooter. Set out on horseback, fire at challenging targets, and battle a giant, flying, cyborg whale! Can you reach the top of the leaderboard?

name: Chinbu's Adventure
short_description: A collectathon action rpg where you play as a young dragon named Chinbu with the unique ability to control all elements.

name: Daddy's gone a-hunting
short_description: Daddy's gone a-hunting is a retro 16 bit game with cute explosions, fx-sounds and represents a story of a lazy prehistoric dad.Who was kicked out from home by his wife. And need to find a food for his kids..

name: Battle High 2 A+
short_description: The fast-paced fighting action of the Battle High series comes to Steam! Face-off in the tough halls of San Bruno High for the Elementally Advanced as 14 students (and 1 insidious faculty member) and discover the secret behind the mysterious illness stripping students of their powers!

name: Christmas Race
short_description: Help Santa pick up presents on the trail! The more gifts you collect, the higher your score!

name: Defend Your Buttress
short_description: Defend Your Buttress is a simple game. You defend your wall to your dying breath. Why? I don't know... Because the evil stick-man want to break your wall and kill you. For some reason.

name: Drake of the 99 Dragons
short_description: The 99 Dragons Clan has been murdered. Even worse, the ancient artifact they guard, stolen. With its power, one can trap the souls of the living and resurrect those who have crossed over.

name: Predator VR
short_description: Look for Predator VR exclusively in VR arcades. Predator VR drops you into the explosive action of the 1980’s blockbuster movie in the ultimate VR showdown between an overpowering Alien hunter and an elite soldier. Multiplayer, Soldier Campaign and Predator Rampage modes.

name: Sleep Tight
short_description: Sleep Tight is an adrenaline pumping arcade-style, twin-stick shooter with base-building elements and wrapped in blankets of nostalgia. Construct your strongest pillow fort during the day to defend your bedroom from endless hordes of monsters each night.

name: Power Supplied
short_description: Power Supplied is a multiplayer puzzle game, a one-to-four player game where four characters are controlled, each with different methods of traversing levels. Constantly changing routes will mean passing over the same ground many times to try and reach your freedom.

name: Hades' Star
short_description: A unique space strategy game where thousands of players participate in one shared galaxy.

name: One Against The Galaxy
short_description: Fast-paced shmup for those times when you only have a couple of minutes to blow things up and try to reach the high score.

name: Lonely Astronaut
short_description: Pilot the corpse of a long-abandoned astronaut floating in a cosmic graveyard in this one-button arcade game. In the process, you might find out something about the human condition. But probably not.

name: VR Ping Pong Paradise
short_description: You can play table tennis in outer space!! You feel refreshed! You can choose 6 play zones in this game. Sky Arena , On the raft , Under the cherry trees , Street basketball court , Seaside golf course , Outer space. You can enjoy ping pong in an unreal world.

name: CHOP
short_description: CHOP is a 2D party game with tons of gore and fast-paced action. Swords will fly, bodies will be chopped, friendships will break !

name: Fantasy Quest Solitaire
short_description: At the very last moment the Fairy Land was saved from the dark shadows. But now absolute chaos is threatening its peaceful denizens. King Feodor asks the magic Fairies for help. Are you ready to face this challenge? Play your cards right and solve many challenging quests.

name: DEPLOYMENT
short_description: Deployment is an intense competitive top-down shooter game. Infosoldiers, made of pure information, fight in an endless war between governments and megacorporations to rule over the digital systems that control the world. Deploy your troops from up to five different classes!

name: Puppet Kings
short_description: Puppet Kings is a modern take on the Breakout genre taking block-breaking to new levels of fun by introducing characters, boss rush as primary game mode and a roguelike twist.

name: RollerCoaster Legends
short_description: Transport yourself to the land of Greek mythology on a virtual reality RollerCoaster ride you'll never forget. Unlike any VR rollercoaster experience you have seen.

name: Good Morning
short_description: Good Morning is an open world sandbox game. Explore the world. Get a job. Grab a cup of coffee. Rob a bank. Rise to political power. Sell some drugs. Join a gang. Unleash hell fire upon the world. Or maybe go on an afternoon stroll through the park. The Choice is yours!

name: Curse of the Old Gods
short_description: A mystery adventure game set in a present-day Lovecraftian universe.

name: Born Tubi Wild
short_description: Control 4 different pigeons to track down unsuspecting pedestrians and present them with falling surprise from the skies.

name: Helix Brawl
short_description: Helix Brawl is a single-player beat em' up action game. Make your way enemy by enemy, beating up bosses and unlocking new powers as you go. Go all or nothing to finish each level, making your way from the underground lab to the CEO's penthouse, wrecking everyone in your wake!

name: Sky Road
short_description: Sky Road is a casual game for all ages. It does not take much effort. In a calm atmosphere, choose an emotion for yourself and take a ride along the celestial road, collecting coins. The further you pass the more reward.

name: Impossibox
short_description: In Impossibox work your way through 50, sometimes seemingly impossible, levels and show the world what you are made of! Collect the coins to clear the levels. Impossibox has everything a tough platformer needs to challenge your skill.

name: Talsaluq: Tower of Infinity
short_description: A maze-adventure game entailing multi-level trials to reach the peak of a 3,000 year-old tower.

name: Whirlpool
short_description: Whirlpool is about Roy, who finds himself suspiciously uncertain about a lot of things, including who he really is. And his adventure of finding out more about himself.

name: KARTOFELKA
short_description: Platform of medium complexity, where the main role is played by 'potato'.

name: Asylamba: Influence
short_description: Making your culture shine is often more effective than taking out weapons!

name: Kingdom Defense
short_description: In Kingdom Defense you have to be in the role of the commander of the defense of the kingdom. You will have to keep defense using three towers, soldiers, traps and a variety of improvements for them. For a successful level you need to hold out under the pressure of hostile troops, not allowing him to get to the territory of the kingdom.

name: In League
short_description: Tactical multiplayer shooter built from the ground up for VR. Team up with other players wielding a wide array of realistic guns, grenades and melee weapons in Hunt or Hostage mode. Winning takes strategy and teamwork as you fight through rich interactive environments.

name: Gym Empire - Gym Tycoon Sim Management
short_description: Build the gym of your dreams in the first ever gym tycoon simulation management game. Gym Empire is the sim where you become a gym tycoon. Build, manage, hire staff and create your Gym Empire how you want. Will you build a commercial gym or specialise in a certain field? The choice is yours.

name: Snail Trek - Chapter 2: A Snail Of Two Worlds
short_description: Relive 1980s nostalgia in this text parser driven graphic adventure game. You and your molluscan crew embark on an epic journey to find a new home world. In Chapter 2 - A Snail Of Two Worlds, you are stranded on an alien planet searching for food, water, and most of all... answers.

name: Traffic Cop
short_description: It's the 1950s in a city like no other. You're on duty as the local Traffic Cop smack dab in the middle of a busy intersection. Direct traffic, dodge flying food, & unlock bonus rounds to disintegrate aliens, and hunt birds!

name: OutBreak: The Escape
short_description: OutBreak: The Escape is a Fps Survival Horror game, You play as a Marshall as you try to save your family While trying to escape a viral outbreak that occurred overnight in your hometown. Can you save your family and escape the OutBreak?

name: LINCH
short_description: If you both like playing cards with your friends and cruelty and carnage, you are in the right place! Some can say these things cannot be combined, but we’ve done the work – and unleash our Frankenstein for you.

name: Super Bugman Extreme Ultra
short_description: A unique 2D platformer with puzzle elements where you can jump, pick stuff up, place it down, throw onions, and use special abilities on enemies. Play through the Story Mode, have fun in Creative Mode, tackle the Procedural generated Chaos levels, and even design your own levels in the level editor.

name: Dark Maze
short_description: Your task is to get out of the maze. For this, you need to find the key!

name: Next Hero
short_description: 'Next Hero' is a Roguelike-shooting action RPG that explores dungeons, acquires weapons and equipment, and kills monsters. Find a girlfriend kidnapped by the dragon and rebuild the destroyed village to become a hero in the village!

name: Noir Chronicles: City of Crime
short_description: Step into the shoes of Alfred Fox, a private eye with a knack for getting into trouble, and confront the danger looming over your old flame, Barbara Le Purr. Using your own intuition and wide investigation techniques you will follow the intrigue and face many, sometimes deadly, consequences.

name: Sensual VR
short_description: Can you escape with Mr. Purple? In this real sensual VR experience, made for ladies, you can experience the sensuality of All Shades. If you complete your task, be submissive and be gentle to Mr. Purple you can fly by luxe helicopter over the world and discover the most wonderful places in world.

name: TOKYO GHOUL:re [CALL to EXIST]
short_description: It may not be stylish, but... Live.Eat or be eaten. TOKYO GHOUL:re [CALL to EXIST] is a co-op survival action game that lets you experience the exciting world of Tokyo Ghoul and Tokyo Ghoul:re for yourself.

name: Robot Warriors
short_description: Slash and shoot everyone in your way in this hack and slash game. Kill a lot of enemies and find a way to the exit to complete missions.

name: Atelier Lydie & Suelle ~The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings~
short_description: "Lydie and Sue are twin sisters who live in the Kingdom of Adalet, and they aim to make their atelier the best atelier in the kingdom. One day, they discover a certain Mysterious Painting that will eventually become the very key to realizing their dream... A new Mysterious story to mark the 20th anniversary of the Atelier series!

name: Trianga's Project: Battle Splash 2.0
short_description: Full-Physics Water FPS/TPS, Class-based Action-packed Arena Shooter, Run & Gun with Rocket Jump, Single/Coop/Multiplayers, Survive Procedural Waves of Enemies, Lots of Game Modes, Endless Challenges and Replayability, with an Anime Beautiful Cast, and More...!

name: Solar Wind
short_description: Blast your way through a galaxy of planets in this fast paced, side scrolling shoot 'em up. Fight in deep space, fly through asteroid belts, and battle across moons as you take on the alien menace.

name: Welcome to Orochi Park
short_description: An interactive fiction adventure-strategy parody. Send agents on missions, build your base, research superweapons and buy units. Along the way, unlock occult mysteries. Plus romance Kelly from Mass Effect. You can play the demo for free. The full game releases late 2018.

name: THE BOX VR
short_description: The Box is a new arcade game of Virtual Reality that will test your reflexes, your coolness and your ability to strategy. An action game that challenges you to keep playing again and again.

name: Angelo Skate Away
short_description: Angelo Skate Away is a brand new game based on the successful TV show Angelo Rules!

name: Neon Seoul: Outrun
short_description: In a future where the AI we created have become our gods, a new breed of rebel has emerged - The OutRunners. Weaving through seas of automated vehicles, operating off the grid, these rebels risk their lives on hoverbikes built for insane speeds. Welcome to the future. Welcome to Neon Seoul.

name: Man of Honor
short_description: Man of Honor is a mafia themed top down shooter / character study where you control Emilio Gallo, an ex-mafioso, as he fights to get revenge on his former friends in the waning rust belt city of Ferrousburgh.

name: cityglitch
short_description: Fly across haunted cities, solve rooftop puzzles and light magical runes. Cityglitch is a shimmery pixel puzzler with simple movement and deep challenge.

name: Contraband Police
short_description: Take over the duties of a border guard inspector in a communist country of the 80's. Smuggling, corruption and forgery are the order of the day here. Be vigilant and earn the respect of your superiors.

name: M.A.X. 2: Mechanized Assault & Exploration
short_description: A level of complexity unseen in contemporary strategy gamesChoose either simultaneous or turn-based game mode to fit your personal preferencePlay as one of 8 human clans and use dozens upon dozens of land, sea and air units

name: 摩尼遊戯TOKOYO
short_description: Maniyugi TOKOYO is a Pixel-art shooting game inspired by Japanese Buddhist worldview. The player becomes a priest, goes on a journey round the Rokudo, aims at constant life while accumulating merit.

name: Archers
short_description: Hop into the world of archery and acrobatics. Play in modes of 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3. Create servers with your friends or play versus random players. Pick up different arrow types and use your abilities to eliminate your foes. Make precision longshots or get up close and personal with your enemies.

name: NVL
short_description: NVL - an amazing adventure game in the genre of RPG. An interesting combat turn-based system as in JRPG. Beautiful anime girls with pantsu.

name: Alive Hunter
short_description: Alive Hunter is a Indie Third Person shooter game with a Open World full of content and cinematic narrative.

name: Raymond's Obstacle Course
short_description: Raymond's Obstacle Course is a multi-stage 3D, first-person platformer. Your goal is to reach the end of each stage by successfully navigating across all obstacles.

name: Christmas Stories: A Christmas Carol Collector's Edition
short_description: Everyone deserves a second chance – even the stingiest of them all.

name: Desert Golfing
short_description: Golfing across an endless desert.

name: Pure Metal: Feature 1
short_description: Old school shooter fun. Can you save Pure Metal from the clutches of evil? Kill the hoards of enemies and rain righteous fury on the bosses and save the planet!

name: DoubleTap
short_description: Stylish pistol action for the movie hero/dapper spy/assassin with a dark past that you don't want to talk about/cool person in all of us.

name: Broadway: 1849
short_description: Fight your way to box office glory, while fending off the gangs of New York! Will you spur a revolution or keep order in a fractious city?

name: VR RHYTHM ACTION SEIYA
short_description: VR RHYTHM ACTION SEIYA is not your average rhythm game where you just keep beat with the song -- it's a virtual reality music game where you can actually play the melody.Punch the melody into existence by hitting the lyrics and stars flying at you to the beat of the music on your own personal grand stage!

name: KOLOBOK
short_description: Go through the epic path of Kolobok, prove to yourself and everyone that he is alive and can think.

name: Wolf & Rabbit
short_description: Our hero, an injured wolf boy, encountered a rabbit in red picking up flowers on his way escaping from a forest. The kind rabbit girl invited the wolf boy to her grandma's house for a treatment, yet... Standing in front of the house, the wolf boy felt... somehow, uneasy.

name: Vexius
short_description: Roll and dash through a grid-based 2.5D world while overcoming various obstacles and hazards. Feeling creative? Create your own levels with the editor and share them with the world!

name: EMERGENCY 3
short_description: Their lives are in your hands - can you take the pressure? In this re-release of the classic EMERGENCY 3 it's your job to save lifes! Command many different first responder units in an exciting mix of simulation and real-time strategy.

name: EMERGENCY 4 Deluxe
short_description: Coordinate firefighters, police, medical personnel and specialists in the classic EMERGENCY 4 Deluxe! Now with the previously untranslated bonus missions in English.

name: Donjon Defense
short_description: Donjon Defense is a game in the genre of tower defense. In this case, defense of the castle, consisting of... only one tower. Build walls, hire different warriors, resist attacks. Build a real fortress, hardened in countless assaults.

name: Aimtastic
short_description: Training game for FPS games. Helps you become a better aimer. Includes a lot of different practice scenarios, which is great for warmup or taking your aim to the next level.

name: On Board
short_description: 1 player arcade boat game.

name: Truberbrook / Trüberbrook
short_description: Enjoy an adventurous vacation to a 1960's parallel universe! A Sci-Fi-Mystery Adventure Game with handmade scenery.

name: Sable
short_description: Embark on an unique and unforgettable journey and guide Sable through her Gliding; a rite of passage that will take her across vast deserts and mesmerizing landscapes, capped by the remains of spaceships and ancient wonders.

name: Atomicrops
short_description: A twin-stick, bullet-hell, roguelite where you must cultivate and defend the last farm in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Farm mutated crops, upgrade your weapons, marry townsfolk, and kill every mutant creature that tries to invade your homestead! Yee-haw!

name: qop 2
short_description: qop 2 is a minimalistic puzzle which goal is to get the cube to finish using 4 directions in space.

name: Ship Ahoy Open BETA
short_description: Frag as many other pirates vessels as possible until the time limit is reached.

name: CITY BALLS VR
short_description: THE jump'n'run experience for VR! Beat the time by completing all games on the rooftops as fast as possible.

name: Zombie Crisis: Last One Standing
short_description: Zombie Crisis: Last One Standing is a LAN(local area network) Battle Royale genre game.

name: Schwerpunkt
short_description: Schwerpunkt is a World War 2 military simulation game. Take control of hundreds of units over a large frontline, making daring manoeuvres to push your enemy back. Fight in one of the scenarios given or make your own in the map maker.

name: Crafting Tycoon
short_description: THE ROAD DESIGN-CRAFTING-TYCOON GAME !!

name: Samurai of Hyuga Book 3
short_description: Life isn’t getting any easier for our favorite ronin! The journey continues in the land of silk and steel, where fantasy and reality clash and tough choices await you on every page. Get ready to prove why you’re the toughest ronin around.

name: Doom Roller
short_description: Doom Roller is a fast paced physics arcade game. Guide the ball through the level avoiding obstacles and the dreaded Orbs of Doom! Collect all the gems within time to proceed to the next level. There's an evil twist though... every time you collect a gem your time decreases by five seconds!

name: Broken Reality
short_description: A humorous adventure set in a 3D parody of the internet. Diverse puzzles, beautiful worlds, friends, experiences, upgrades and more, await those who 'log on'!

name: Mapas do Horizonte - Um jogo para conhecer BH
short_description: Neste jogo infanto-juvenil gratuito que reúne quebra-cabeças em formatos diversos e jogos de encontrar objetos, o jogador conhece um pouco mais sobre a história da capital mineira ao passar por diversos desafios junto da professora Clara, da motorista Suely e da turma de alunos!

name: Fadeholm
short_description: Endless exploration and adventure awaits those fearless enough to enter. Survival is only the beginning! Fadeholm is a procedural generated virtual reality (VR) survival dungeon crawler designed in the same vein as old school Nethack and Rogue.

name: GreenFlame
short_description: BlueFlame has brought never-ending Winter to the land. Use your custom GreenFlame and awesome powers to Bring Back Spring! #GFBBS

name: Oedipus Dating Sim
short_description: You shouldn't date your own mother... or should you? That is the dilemma Oedipus is facing in this Dating Sim. You can either change how the legend goes or end up facing the wrath of the fates. The choice is yours in this daring Dating Sim!

name: Football Story
short_description: Life in the neighborhood awaits! As a local pro team cheekily announces a match against best of the non pro, Rad and his future friends decide to thwart their confidence, while meeting all sorts of dorky situations one could ever imagine! Train, play and live in Football Story!

name: Endless Inside
short_description: Get ready to mix scares, puzzles, hidden secrets, exploration and survive modes around dusty and dark sites with three alternate endings into one disturbing night full of strange activity, creepy giggles under the floors and spooky songs coming from old objects arround a closed Arts University.

name: Life Game
short_description: Open World, first person life simulation

name: Hotel Transylvania 3: Monsters Overboard
short_description: Dracula, Mavis and their monster friends are marooned on the mysterious Lost Islands – and only you, in command of lovable little creatures, the Impa, can save them! Explore the islands, discover new Impa abilities, and rescue Frankenstein, Murray and Wayne from fearsome enemies. But hurry – the Drac-Pack’s lives are at stake!

name: Big Day
short_description: The Big Day has arrived. Blast your way through the apocalypse in this bloody pixel-art ARPG, riding through the ruins of the last days on Earth following a devastating zombie outbreak. Uncover the truth behind the crisis, find your missing daughter, and blow holes in every zombie who crosses your path!

name: Blitz Freak
short_description: Blitz Freak is an online multiplayer VR game optimized for e-Sports. Players can fly through the air with locomotion completely free of VR motion sickness, and knock out opponents with intuitive controls.

name: Limit of defense
short_description: Limit Of Defense combines the arcade game on the type "Tower Defense" military strategy. A simple and addictive time killer.

name: Dungeon's Barrage
short_description: Control an Arcana Magus through the dungeon and try to survive the waves as long as you can! Dungeon's Barrage is a shoot’em up with a feeling of retro games with a fast-paced combat in a closed dungeon filled with enemies.

name: Shadowcrawl: The Dark Pilgrimage
short_description: Set in a dynamic living world driven by Dark Gods and Occult Forces. Shadowcrawl is a classic roguelike with updated design principles and an emphasis on strategy. Worship Demons, conquer Gods and make dark pacts with unspeakable horrors as you crawl deeper into the shadows...

name: Sector 452
short_description: Sector 452 is a futuristic low poly shooter that takes place in the year 2058, you are an astronaut who was on a standard search mission that went horribly wrong. Fight your way through various planets, meeting friends and foes while looking for a way back home.

name: Flowing Lights
short_description: Flowing Lights is an Arcade Puzzle Shooter. Each fight is a puzzle. Attack and... Fail! ...Think back... try again! Got it? Improve with each try, there is always a smarter way to win!

name: The Grim Ending
short_description: The Grim Ending is a humerous classic Point and Click adventure game. Old school gameplay that comes with word commands, pixel art and a full talky storyline with moral decisions and several endings.

name: Elbub
short_description: You are a bubble, flying among other bubbles. Relax and go on a journey!

name: Australian trip
short_description: Take a bright and exciting adventure in Australia with dog Dingo. A fascinating and extraordinary puzzle game. Languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Latvian, Portuguese, French, Chinese

name: Live And Learn
short_description: Live, work and play in an animal-ruled alternate history where humans are just another species. Create your own character with intuitive full-body control and immerse yourself in a physics-driven sandbox where your real life the only tutorial needed.

name: Away
short_description: Away — is a short game telling about the hero's death experience, performed in a gloomy black and white style.

name: Raygun Gadabout
short_description: An exhilarating action-adventure game set in a vibrant retro-futuristic universe. Embark on daring interstellar journeys, uncovering new worlds, and battling formidable alien adversaries. Upgrade your ship and abilities as you explore the vastness of space to save the Galaxy from a hidden threat.

name: Disassembly Line
short_description: Remote control a robot into the evil robot factory to take on the artificial intelligence in combat. Upgrade your robot by collecting add-ons that give you awesome abilities. Play together with your friends to stand a chance!

name: Big NEON Tower VS Tiny Square
short_description: Ride the vaporwaves as you outrun nefarious neon nuisances in this 90s inspired precision platformer. No sprint, no double-jump, and no floaty controls! Just quick deaths and generous respawn points. Can you reach the top of the tower and rescue your Pineapple?

name: DMD Mars Mission
short_description: The Martian mining facility FK16 has been invaded by insects and mutated creatures and now the system reports that all human workers have been killed. It's up to you and your assistant Isabel to save the situation.

name: Captured King
short_description: Follow Bjorn the Red in his jurney to rescue King Ivar and his army, in this new RPG with Roguelike elements. Epic weapons, lots of different enemies , boss battles and diferents levels awaits you in Captured King.

name: Internet Simulator
short_description: Web-browser simulator from beautiful locations

name: Kill the Superweapon
short_description: 3D Twin-Stick Action game where bosses can roam from room to room in pursuit of the player. Samantha Kill is on a mission to take down Abaddon Inc. and their Bio-Mechanical Supersoldiers.

name: BloodLust 2: Nemesis
short_description: Bloodlust 2: Nemesis is a "Hack 'n Slash - Dungeon Crawling - Action RPG" experience that will allow players to explore the dark underworld of a forgotten society of Vampires and their disciplines, all while trying to solve the secrets to their bloodline's scientifically enhanced monstrous power.

name: Monobeno
short_description: This was a story about humans and monsters, disease and haunting, and the past and the future. It leads you to the unusual traditional Japanese culture.

name: E-Startup
short_description: E-Startup is a sandbox business simulation game in a low-poly universe. Build, buy resources to create products and complete contracts, invest in the stock market to become rich and popular!

name: RC Fun City
short_description: RC Fun City is a singleplayer simulation game about radio controlled vehicles.

name: The Plague
short_description: Prepare to fight alone against a horde of zombies from the graveyard to the streets in this suspenseful and horrifying zombie shooter, The Plague.

name: McRogue
short_description: It's man versus machine in this action roguelite from Snare Games. Explore procedural worlds, collect power-ups, and use McRogue's devastating robot fists to destroy all that stand in his way. But don't take too long about it - the robots only get stronger.

name: Krampus Quest
short_description: Krampus Quest is a back-to-basics retro-style action-platformer with a christmas theme. Fighting your way up the North Pole, absorbing souls, dodging traps and pitfalls, and upgrading abilities, to in the end battle Santa Claus himself.

name: Dragon Cliff
short_description: Dragon Cliff is a Semi-Idle RPG game with deep and complex itemization/skill systems to support endless character builds. Players are to collect adventurers, kill monsters, advance talent trees, enchant/reforge equipment, discover scrolls and finally assemble the most powerful adventure team!

name: Escape Room
short_description: Look for hints and disable the bomb. Now!! Your time is running short.

name: Osmorrow
short_description: An adventure set on the planet of Osmorrow, where the Ogre clan has run rampant. Your mission is to help restore peace and order to this world as you liberate Osmorrow from the Ogre oppression. Use high skilled melee and ranged combat along with swift and precise movement to quell the Ogre threat.

name: Taste of Power
short_description: Show your strategic talents in Taste of Power! It's a RTS set in an alternate medieval world, where Europe, Middle East, and China confront each other. Develop unique technologies and lead warriors into an epic battlefield – the victory is yours!

name: 裁決者 -The White Butcher-
short_description: 《裁決者》是款以極權島國為背景的冒險遊戲。遊戲中你將扮演調查局的副局長，並透過裁決案子替國家伸張正義。但在一次裁決中你意外地殺害了摯友「黃義雄」，使你首次對國家產生了疑惑。重重的危機，雨中，客廳等待著你的並不是虛無。而是屋外毫不知情的黃義雄獨生女「黃詠晴」......少女的笑容，開始了你的罪──

name: Drunkenpants
short_description: Drunkenpants is a game where ordinary heroes who got drunk in their underpants at home (Kalsarikänni) try to solve mundane problems with excessive violence. The game is an action based, fast-paced multiplayer battle game, where you compete in different game modes and try to beat your opponents.

name: Cursed Lands
short_description: Defeat the evil lurking in Castle Of N'Mar in this RPG/dating sim game. Recruit your team in any order you want, use the optional social talents to win the battles, play as male or female and fully customize your avatar. Five romance per gender, including the unique Naga Enok and Sylrissa!

name: Shenmue I & II
short_description: SEGA®’s most requested re-release of all time finally comes to a new generation. Shenmue delivers an epic story of revenge within a unique open world that is still unrivalled in depth and detail. Return to the epic saga that defined modern gaming. The saga begins…again.

name: Through the Ages
short_description: Legendary board game classic from award winning designer Vlaada Chvátil

name: The Ultimate Heist
short_description: Ever wanted to go on an adventure where you get to infiltrate some of the most High Security Vaults across the world? We have you covered, use the gadgets at your disposal to neutralize your foes!

name: AO International Tennis
short_description: AO International Tennis is the most authentic, community-focused tennis game ever. Make use of comprehensive PlayFace™, Stadium Creator, and other customisation features to put a photo-realistic version of yourself in your local tennis competition, up against the greats, including Rafael Nadal.

name: I Park on Earth
short_description: Choose a suitable vehicle, use the four directional keys, and drive it into the designated parking area. That's it.

name: Africa Hunting
short_description: You are playing for an African pirate and you need to destroy as many planes as possible off the coast of Africa, and also collect humanitarian cargo, and dodge of rockets

name: Ukrainian ball in search of gas
short_description: You play as a man turned into a ball and you need to steal all the gas from the forest at all costs.

name: Loot Box Quest
short_description: The spiritual successor to DLC Quest! Earn that sense of pride and accomplishment in the way that only repetitive clicking can deliver. It's a clicker game, so chill out, have a few chuckles, and watch numbers get bigger while the industry burns around us all.

name: Sprout
short_description: Embark on a casual, botanical-puzzle-adventure. Make friends, learn new skills, solve puzzles, and become the mighty oak that you were always meant to be.

name: Versus World
short_description: Welcome to Versus World! Shoot, stab, snipe, and 'splode your opponents to victory in this fast-paced multiplayer FPS. Here, the afterlife of a respawning immortal is seasoned by an up-down crouch.

name: TOMORROW DON'T COME - Puzzling Depression
short_description: TOMORROW DON'T COME is a contextual puzzle game about depression and how it feels to be stuck.

name: Grim Tales: The Wishes Collector's Edition
short_description: Be careful what you wish for... A deadly bargain has been made, and it's up to you to set things right before your nephew pays the terrible price!

name: League of Light: Silent Mountain Collector's Edition
short_description: Solve the mysteries of Stoneville and escape with your life!

name: Christmas Stories: Hans Christian Andersen's Tin Soldier Collector's Edition
short_description: The Rat King's wand has fallen into the hands of a vengeful baron. Team up with your new friend, the Tin Soldier, to stop him!

name: Botanica: Earthbound Collector's Edition
short_description: Play as both Ellie and Ian, two scientists stranded on Botanica. Can you save your friends and find your way home?

name: Shadow Wolf Mysteries: Bane of the Family Collector's Edition
short_description: Return to the De la Fer estate to help the count unravel the curse that has been passed down through his family!

name: Cadenza: The Kiss of Death Collector's Edition
short_description: Is your husband-to-be guilty of betrayal – or even worse?

name: Nevertales: Legends Collector's Edition
short_description: The love between you and your husband was strong enough to end a war... but is it strong enough to save the world?

name: Haunted Train: Frozen in Time Collector's Edition
short_description: Thieves have stolen Charon's most powerful artifact: watches that can stop time. Now only you stand in their way.

name: NeverBound
short_description: NeverBound is the gravity-shifting shooter that brings you mind-bending combat and puzzles in multi-gravity environments. You are as dangerous from below as you are from above. The rules have changed. High ground is relative.

name: Oddinary Highway
short_description: Oddinary Highway is a retrofuturistic shoot’em up with roguelite elements and ever-changing game mechanics. Set out on a dangerous journey through the hyperspace known as the “Oddinary Highway” to face Boss and his robo-mafia.

name: Occupy Mars: The Game
short_description: Survive and colonize Mars in a highly technical, open-world sandbox game. Build and upgrade your base, discover new regions, conduct mining operations, retrieve water, generate oxygen, grow crops, and fix broken parts.

name: Paw Patrol: On A Roll!
short_description: PAW Patrol is on a roll! No job is too big, no pup is too small! Join the entire PAW Patrol team—including Everest and Tracker—for 16 exciting rescue missions around Adventure Bay! Help each pup use their unique abilities to help their friends and save the day!

name: Musical Reflex
short_description: Musical Reflex is a game as its name suggests where you can test your musical reflex by having fun or trying to improve yourself and try to be the best in the ladder. The principle of the game is pretty simple, press the right keys at the right time all this enbiencer with a music chooses.

name: Bygone Worlds: Drama at the Odeion
short_description: The Odeion of Agrippa was one of the most significant venues ever built, home to many of the greatest performances in history. Climb up onto the stage and try to win the hearts of the people of Athens.

name: Nachzehrer
short_description: [h1]Nachzehrer[/h1]Your fear of being in the dark comes true in this short single player horror game. You find yourself stuck at a power plant at night, when suddenly the lights begin shutting off. However, attempting to turn them back on may cause you to meet your fears.

name: Kynseed
short_description: Embark on a lifetime of adventure in a beautiful world of creativity and intrigue. Raise a family, customise your farm, run a business, craft items, and battle some marvellously malevolent monsters.

name: RedSun RTS
short_description: Redsun RTS is a prime example of the genre classic RTS, unjustly forgotten today.

name: Action Rush
short_description: Simple racing game. Our goal is to reach the exit by coming from the top of simple obstacles in 10 different maps.

name: Captain Forever Trilogy
short_description: Millions of players worldwide have flown, built, and fought their way through Captain Forever. CF Trilogy brings Captains Forever, Successor, and Impostor to Steam with a beautiful new renderer, new modules, and a reimagined world written by acclaimed novelist Cassandra Khaw.

name: Poker Legends: Texas Hold'em Poker Tournaments
short_description: Poker Legends is a free-to-play multiplayer Texas Hold’em game where you bluff, bet, and strategize against real players. Compete in tournaments, complete challenges, unlock rewards, climb global leaderboards, and prove you’re the ultimate poker champion.

name: Ancient Warfare 3
short_description: Dive into a sandbox full of action and customization! Choose from different game modes like deathmatch, conquest, king of the hill, zombie survival and many more. Create your own scenarios and content in the easy to use in-game editors or use one of the 50k+ workshop items from other players...

name: .projekt
short_description: Minimalistic puzzler about silhouettes from creator of Evo Explores

name: Escape
short_description: You're on a camping trip with some friends. They go missing, you can hear something in the woods. What would you do? You must Escape by yourself with nothing other than your flashlight. You cannot bring your friends back but you can Escape.

name: WaywaY
short_description: WaywaY – A game that tests your skills in dealing with various obstacles while directing a circle (ring) along a path. Along this path you will encounter various and anomalies and bosses.

name: Planet Guardian VR
short_description: Planet Guardian VR is an action room-scale VR game in which you play to protect planets from incoming asteroids. To fulfill your mission you need to use your controllers as weapons to destroy the asteroids. Each level brings a new challenge, be it by the speed, matter or placement of the asteroids.

name: Ground Runner: Trials
short_description: Ground Runner: Trials fuses FPS action with intense vehicle combat to create an incredibly immersive VR experience like you’ve never seen. Strap into your hoverbike’s cockpit, then outfly and outgun your enemies to become the ultimate Ground Runner in the system.

name: City Eye
short_description: In the world of City Eye, you’ll become an operator of the Central Monitoring System, who will try to prevent the effects of every single transgression in the game. Use city maps to track dangerous areas and don’t let the suspects run away from the Police.

name: Dungeons & Vampires
short_description: Dungeons & Vampires- addictive step-by-step role-playing role-playing Roguelike-game with a gothic atmosphere, combining Dungeon Crawler and Clicker mechanics. Teach your hunters to vampires, clearing the way through dangerous procedurally-generated dungeons.

name: Bizarre Tale
short_description: Bizarre Tale is a fast focused game that requires agility, dexterity and fast decision making, in order to avoid obstacles and destroy waves of enemies that come in great numbers and in all directions.

name: Go All Out
short_description: Yandere-Chan, Teslakid, Cole Black, Breakbone and more crossover characters in one fighting game! Be the last man standing in this intense and action packed platform fighter.

name: Learn Japanese To Survive! Kanji Combat
short_description: Learn Japanese kanji in this interactive role-playing game! No experience needed – start reading and writing in Japanese!

name: Wanted Killer VR
short_description: Choose from a team of unique heroes and use their skills to fight your way through the ranks of the evil corporation that’s trying to wipe you out. Upgrade your arsenal and use bullet-time to take out your enemies in style. Fast-paced arcade action and one-of-a-kind gunplay – this is Wanted Killer VR!

name: Decay of Logos
short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of Decay Of Logos and unravel its mysteries. Explore old dungeons, battle unforgiving foes and journey through a vibrant interconnected fantasy realm with your mystical elk companion.

name: House of Evil
short_description: House of Evil - atmospheric survival horror with a first-person view, in which you can test your nerves for strength. The events take place in the mansion that exists in reality. The main character is an ordinary philistine, his wife is an exorcist, after an unusual telephone conversation, the protagonist can not call to the spouse, and...

name: Plug Me
short_description: Plug Me is a tricky puzzle platform where the timer is a physical object in the game world! You are able to walk on the green parts of this bar as a platform, but you must be careful not to fall off as the power is drained.

name: Christmas Puzzle 3
short_description: Help the Elf to prepare your town for Christmas with beautiful ornaments and decorations! Play through cool Match 3 levels, collect Santa’s coins and prepare the best Christmas fair ever!

name: RIDE 3
short_description: Experience the most complete racing ever with RIDE 3! Race on different tracks all over the world, put your favourite vehicles' speed to the test and have fun by customising them with the new Livery Editor.

name: Doodle God: Alchemy Jam
short_description: Short experimental puzzle game, based on Doodle God alchemy mechanics.

name: Gamma Blast
short_description: Blast your way through enemy waves. Strike at enemy formations prioritizing targets depending on the situation. Rip them to pieces using an arsenal of powerful and versatile weapons. Put your reflexes to the test dodging a fire storm of enemy projectiles. Destroy challenging Bosses to achieve victory.

name: Battle for Mountain Throne
short_description: Battle for Mountain Throne - virtual action game in world of fantasy

name: DEBUFF
short_description: Nine fantasy heroes await your leadership in single player campaign, multiplayer battles and raids and last but not least, killing football game! Gain experience to level up, assign skill points, purchase bonus buffs to fight DEBUFF. Oh, and don't forget to kill Hellga!

name: MGP Manager
short_description: Single player team management simulation centred around the motorcycle GP world championship. Choose one of 3 classes and try to improve your team by signing riders, staff and improving the bikes performance. Create your own custom rider & team roster using the game editor or use fictional names.

name: HJ: Sacrifice
short_description: Horror Jail, Professor Dr. Cherubs's little hell on earth. Your sole purpose in single player action-horror game to survive this horrible prison. But you are not alone.

name: The 13th Heir - Ragnarok Chapter 2
short_description: Kasei has no idea who he is or what he's doing but his old friend Uline seems to think he's destined to stop the demon king Irvein. from indie dev Samuel Swartout comes his debut game The 13th Heir

name: Souland
short_description: There are many nations in Souland, and you will be one of them. Can you beat all other nations?

name: 前程似锦 Excellent Expectations
short_description: Excellent Expectations is a puzzle adventure game , you would use search engines to discover a story from a stranger's phone .

name: Uizuno Blade VR
short_description: Uizuno Blade is an action Sci-Fi game designed for Virtual Reality. Fight with laser guns and energy swords against hostile soldiers and monsters. This version contains five levels of action and will be updated with more levels in the coming months.

name: MIMIC
short_description: Memorize the path as quickly as you can to reach the finish block in 100 unique levels and 10 different environments. Collect stars to unlock puzzles with increasing difficulty and added obstacles as you compete with other players on online leader boards. Create your own maps (NEW!)

name: AWAKEN：Gunpowder Adventurer Day.Dream
short_description: Awaken as an action RPG game has a wealth of levels and a variety of way to play. We hope that players who love this type of game can experience the core content of the game as well as the overall story of the game.

name: Flying Turkey
short_description: Welcome to Flying Turkey!!! In here, You must defend the platform and stop turkeys getting away. Have you ever try to use an ice cream to strike turkeys away? Or use a frog-glove to launch turkeys? There is a great variety of turkeys and weapons waiting for you to explore. Just have a blast!!!

name: Dizzy Dungeon
short_description: Move, rotate and fall. Move, rotate and fall. Get ready for dizziness, find to best strategy to conquer the dungeon.

name: Nightwolf: Survive the Megadome
short_description: Guns, cars, lasers, and explosions! Nightwolf is a synth-themed, cyber-powered vehicular combat game in which you enter this dystopian future’s most popular sports arena – the MEGADOME! Survive an onslaught by motorized enemies and dispatch them in style for the enjoyment of the crowd!

name: Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden
short_description: A tactical game combining the turn-based combat of XCOM with story, exploration, stealth, and strategy. Take control of a team of Mutants navigating a post-human Earth. Created by a team including former HITMAN leads and the designer of PAYDAY.

name: Your Toy
short_description: Your Toy is a 3D first person horror room escape game that features an advanced non-repeat puzzle system with challenging riddles, heart-pounding escape sequences and a mysterious narrative that dives deep into your darkest subconsciousness. Are you ready to enter your nightmares?

name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodhunt
short_description: Bloodhunt is a thrilling free-to-play battle royale game set in Prague consumed by a ruthless war between vampire factions. Use your supernatural powers, weapons, and wit to hunt your rivals and dominate the night!

name: Chineze
short_description: Chineze is the HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) quiz trainer, with the aim to improve your Chinese vocabulary. You'll have an opportunity to choose exact level of HSK. Every HSK level has a number of categories for easier learning process.

name: Mysterious insects
short_description: Gloria Horn, a middle-aged woman who never left the town where she was born and grew up, due to a sudden hearing loss, is forced to go to an operation in New York - America's largest megalopolis.

name: MUKTI
short_description: A narrative driven first-person thriller that bridges the past with the present.

name: Ender Story: Chapter 1
short_description: Ender Story: Chapter 1 is a turn-based RPG inspired by early Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest games. As a young border guard you must rush to defend your kingdom from an immediate threat. Travel fast, aid citizens and fight hard.

name: Gunman Tales
short_description: Gunman Tales is an old-school action adventure game for 1-4 players set in the wild west and inspired by the legendary game from Amiga Moonstone: A Hard Days Knight and Cabal

name: BYTEPATH
short_description: BYTEPATH is a replayable arcade shooter with a focus on build theorycrafting. Use a massive skill tree, many classes and ships to create your own builds and defeat an ever increasing amount of enemies.

name: Star Sweet
short_description: The goal is simple as a roasted cucumber. The gambling field is studded with jewels, you need to swipe the same diamonds in a row to clear the field.

name: Android John 2.1
short_description: Operating system AJ 1.0, created by students enthusiasts in 2070 showed stupendous results. Since the release of the first version of the operating system 5 years have passed. This product was noticed and was purchased by a larger company engaged in the development of military robotics.

name: Tile Typer
short_description: Tile Typer is a simple score chasing game. Bind your keys then press them as they come up. Can you beat your previous speeds? How long can you be accurate?

name: Don't Be Afraid
short_description: Don't Be Afraid is an adventure horror game, that allows you to personate a boy, kidnapped by a psychopath. You have to survive, escape and find out how you were kidnapped. Exploring the gigantic, mysterious house of your torturer, you will soon reveal many secrets, hidden inside it’s walls…

name: WEED
short_description: WEED - an unusual match3 game with beautiful anime graphics and interesting light casual gameplay. Move the lines! Play with match3 with a sexy anime girl. Line up and win!

name: Frontier Runner
short_description: In Frontier Runner video game you play a character role in the mid-22nd century who was selected to travel on one of the first exploration ships that left earth to find new homes to expand mankind faiths, and ideologies.

name: Cat Burglar: A Tail of Purrsuit
short_description: Cat Burglar is a short, light-hearted, stealth, puzzle platformer with a pet charity awareness campaign. Help Kat find her way into the Dogo Corps base to discover Major Bulls' master plan.

name: Dough
short_description: Would you like to know what the landscape will look like in the sky? In this animation, you will stand in the Floating Island,to see the water, waterfalls, huge flower trees... What do you think will happen in a miracle? Is it possible to witness the life of two "little Dough people" with our own eyes?

name: Futurejam
short_description: Live out your DJ fantasy in Futurejam a VR music rhythm game set in the cyberpunk future of 2049.

name: KAKUSANKIBOU / 扩散希望
short_description: Basically the story goes as visual novel form. Sometimes, the system switches into dot part, and you can control the character to continue the story.

name: Happy New Year Clicker
short_description: New Year's clicker with New Year's achievements!

name: INSPACE 2980
short_description: INSPACE 2980 is a stylish and dynamic SHMUP from the 16-bit era of games consoles and arcade machines. Take part in an exciting adventure and save the galaxy! Once again!

name: Tennis Elbow Manager 2
short_description: Become a tennis coach and manage up to 9 players: take care of training sessions, planning, sponsors, team members, and take control of them on the tennis court if you wish so! Will you be able to lead your players to the top of the world hierarchy?

name: Tennis Elbow 4
short_description: Created by and for tennis fans, Tennis Elbow 4 is the sequel of TE2013, and offers a tennis simulation with an easy and intuitive learning curve, but with exceptional gameplay depth.

name: Hammerting
short_description: Manage a Dwarven mining colony in the unexplored mountains of Mara. As conflict rages in the Overworld, you will need to craft, explore and fight as you provide the allies of your choice with the finest weapons and gear to assist them in the battle for glory.

name: Retro Miami
short_description: Retro Miami - it's an adrenaline thriller, full of primitive brutality, deadly gunshots and roofing fights.

name: Galaxy Race
short_description: Do you think that you have seen everything when it comes to virtual reality games? Check out the revolutionary technology of Galaxy Race and enter the world of galalactic fun!

name: Premonitions: The Merchants of Sol
short_description: Command a fleet of merchant ships in this story-driven strategy game.
