short_description: The blueprints are scattered and out of order! You must piece the worlds back together. Join Vector, a dot, the lowest form of geometry, in his adventure across the Shades of Blue as he battles a hierarchy of greater shapes. Wield the Architect's pen for puzzles and combat in the Land of Lines.

name: The Short Story of a Drifting Labyrinth
short_description: A fast paced 3D isometric action game which gives the player a choice between strategic, hack-n-slash, or mixed style gameplay. A newly entrapped resident of the Labyrinth, you must attempt to escape using the guidance of the long term captives.

name: Coaster
short_description: Experience the thrill and sensation of 4 unique roller coaster experiences. Feel the wind rush through your virtual hair as you ride some of the most enjoyable and immersive VR coasters on the market.

name: Freeman: Guerrilla Warfare
short_description: In the anarchic world of Freeman: Guerrilla Warfare, only the mightiest warlord rules. Start with a pistol and a few militias, you will set yourself on a wild and ambitious journey towards world domination. Enjoy the immersive combination of intense FPS and sandbox strategy.

name: Dream On The Moon
short_description: Dream on the moon is a ragdoll, physics Stick Man sandbox game with different dreams (game modes) on the moon. Play sports and combat against each other with swords, guns etc.

name: Ostalgie: The Berlin Wall
short_description: The confrontation between the East and the West is coming to an end, but not between East and West Germany. The old party leaders are still sitting in their offices, not changing anything and waiting for exclamations from Moscow. But their end is close – Gorbachev and Kohl have already decided...

name: Super Jet Juck
short_description: Super Jet Juck is a dynamic puzzle and adventure game. Join the soldiers Juck and Tom!

name: Nostradamus - The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
short_description: Play as Nostradamus and solve puzzles and riddles to thwart the plans of the Four Horseman of the Apocalypse.

name: MIAZMA or the Devil's Stone
short_description: MIAZMA is the second Jonathan Hunt adventure, sequel to award-winning FMV title Yoomurjak’s Ring. The agile NY journalist embarks on a new investigation after a curious meteorite. What is inside the devilish stone? Is it a huge gem, a magic formula or a devastating substance?

name: YOOMURJAK'S RING
short_description: Jonathan Hunt, a journalist from New York, arrives in the city of Eger in Hungary for a break. In the heritage of his great-grandfather, he found two letters dated back in 1898, about a time machine. Hunt wants to find out what happened to invention. But he soon realizes that someone isdesperately trying to stop him...

name: Steampunker
short_description: Discover Steamburg's developers new game ! Steampunker is an award-winning point and click adventure game involving a search for hidden objects. It's set in an astonishing steampunk world.

name: Muse Dash
short_description: Paradise of parkour & rhythm game ★★★ — Muse Dash!!

name: Rhythm Doctor
short_description: Save patients with your rhythm mastery! Rhythm Doctor is a rhythm game where you heal patients by defibrillating in time to their heartbeats. Learn each patient's unique heartbeat and defeat boss viruses trying to sabotage your rhythm, all set to heart-pumping, soul-soothing music.

name: Car Puzzler
short_description: Car Puzzler is a line puzzle game variation. Drag all cars to their destination in levels with varying game mechanics. Build and share your own levels. Beat others in leaderboards.

name: Heaven's Vault
short_description: An archaeologist uncovers a lost history in an ancient space Nebula. Award-winning narrative adventure game with hieroglyphic language puzzles, from the creators of 80 DAYS.

name: Nekomew's Potty Trouble
short_description: Nekomew’s Potty Trouble is a one player rhythmic videogame.You must help Nekomew get to the toilet before he pisses on himself! As you progress in the game the difficulty will rise and new monsters will appear trying to stop him.♫ Follow the music and you will make it! ♫

name: The Kremer Collection VR Museum
short_description: History and future of the power of art combined. The Kremer Museum is an innovative new museum concept that combines the newest VR technology with world-class Old Master paintings. The museum includes pieces by Rembrandt, Aelbert Cuyp, Frans Hals and many more Old Masters from the Dutch Golden Age.

name: Warhammer: Chaosbane
short_description: In a world ravaged by war and dominated by magic, you must rise up to face the Chaos hordes. Playing solo or with up to four players in local or online co-op, choose a hero from four character classes and prepare for epic battles wielding some of the most powerful artefacts of the Old World.

name: My Little Bomb
short_description: You are a scientist and engineer of the North Korean army and you need to grow your little nuclear bomb.

name: Achievement Lurker: We Give Up!
short_description: The land of Zyorzia is under attack and mutated from a Virus. The world is not the same as before as time and space itself has been disrupted, pathways have been constructed and visible to the humans. The dimensions have converged and the stars have aligned.

name: Last Man Sitting
short_description: A bunch of dudes sit in an office, all of them wearing black suits and white collared shirts. Everyone sits in the same lime green swivel chairs. For a video game, Last Man Sitting sounds really boring. Add shotguns and ragdoll physics, though, and you have a recipe for the only battle royale game left to make.

name: STARBO - The Story of Leo Cornell
short_description: STARBO tells you the story of a dead man's journey through a mysteriously blue world filled with strange messages and beings all trying to tell you a story, the story of Leo Cornell.

name: ASH OF WAR™
short_description: The story about an uneasy journey of one man. You will experience certain situations, those, that could have happened with our parents, children or even a neighbours on just any other war. Through the eyes of our hero you will see his struggle in a modern war, struggle with oneself.

name: Citystate
short_description: Create a 21st century micro-nation and experiment with economic and political ideals. Futuristic skyscrapers or spreading slums, the Nation relies on your economic and city planning skills.

name: Blasphemous
short_description: Blasphemous is a brutal action-platformer with skilled hack’n slash combat set in the nightmare world of Cvstodia. Explore, upgrade your abilities, and perform savage executions on the hordes of enemies that stand between you and your quest to break eternal damnation.

name: Scrap Attack VR
short_description: Enter the mysterious caves of Botanika, where the Boltheads are hell-bent on the destruction of the ancient Botanite Crystals. Your mission: Defend them at all costs, against unrelenting waves of frenzied robots. How far can you push yourself to protect the crystal from the robot onslaught?

name: Temple of Xiala
short_description: Temple of Xiala is a smart puzzle game where you control the gravity, and have to move boulders in slots to clear a path to the next level.

name: Shinrin-yoku: Forest Meditation and Relaxation
short_description: Welcome to Shinrin-yoku: Forest Meditation and Relaxation. In this VR experience, you will be transported to a northwestern forest, surrounded by trees, plants, insects and animals. Use the tools at your disposal, a stick and flashlight, to interact with the world around you, in day or night. Try it, it's free!

name: Island Time VR
short_description: If you’ve ever wondered what being stranded on an island might be like, this VR game is for you, buddy. Using the advice of a new friend, Carl the Crab, you’ve gotta find a way to keep yourself from starving and survive as long as possible.

name: Among the Dead
short_description: Among the Dead - is an episodic choice-based visual novel about life after the zombie apocalypse. You need to fight with zombies and make decisions which can affect the further story. This is the first episode.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 5
short_description: It’s the biggest Party Pack yet, including the return of the classic pop culture trivia mash-up YOU DON’T KNOW JACK: Full Stream; the game of hilarious hypotheticals Split the Room; the lyric-writing, robot rap battle Mad Verse City; the inventive drawing game Patently Stupid; and the outer space fling-fest Zeeple Dome.

name: HoloFist
short_description: Grab your HoloBuddies and thrown down in turn-based arena battles we like to refer to as "Fist-offs". Join our main girl Mindy as she kicks, fists and existentially drifts her way through the adventure of a lifetime to save the island of 'Fistopia' from the ravages of science itself.

name: VR Soccer '96
short_description: Feel the soccer once again!

name: Megadimension Neptunia VIIR
short_description: This enhanced version of 2016’s Megadimension Neptunia™ VII features smoother graphics courtesy of a new engine, a revamped battle system, and a whole new VR experience. Now, their dimensions and yours are connected!

name: Snail Trek - Chapter 4: The Final Fondue
short_description: Relive 1980s nostalgia in this text parser driven graphic adventure game. You and your molluscan crew embark on an epic journey to find a new home world. In Chapter 4 - The Final Fondue, the story concludes. Your entire civilization is heading towards its doom, and it's up to you to save the world.

name: Species: Artificial Life, Real Evolution
short_description: Play with evolution! Species: ALRE is a scientifically-grounded, emergent simulation of natural selection. Creatures evolve and speciate in response to in-game mutation and selection forces, allowing you to experience and tinker with evolution in real-time.

name: Football Heroes Turbo
short_description: Fight your way to the end zone using skill, strategy, and super moves to smash the competition. Collect and upgrade hundreds of unique players to build the ultimate football team. Get online and experience the most action-packed football game in the universe!

name: Rym 9000
short_description: Rym 9000 is a hyperkinetic shooter inspired by Akira, Neon Genesis Evangelion, and Guxt. A treasure-hunting journey to the Moon developed by Sonoshee and composed by Roex. A unique high-octane experience conceived to stimulate your senses and make your eyes and ears bleed!

name: MIGHTY GUNVOLT BURST
short_description: Enter a virtual world of cyber-landscapes and unravel the mystery behind its creation! "Mighty Gunvolt Burst" is a retro-style 2D side-scrolling action game with an authentic feel. Play as "Beck," "Gunvolt," or "Ekoro," and experience their new stories in this unique parallel universe.

name: Filthy Frank Kart
short_description: Join Filthy Frank and many other known characters from the Filthy Frank Show and race trought all the different places of the Omniverse while proving that you are the Filthiest kart racer that ever lived.

name: The Best Of MagiCats
short_description: The Best Of MagiCats is the first 2D Platformer made by its own community. Discover 100 outstanding levels made by brilliant creators all over the world.

name: Surgeon Simulator 2
short_description: It’s time to ‘scrub in’ in this physics-based surgery sim. Unearth the mysteries of the Bossa Labs Medical Facility and save Bob’s life.

name: Crab Champions
short_description: Claw your way across exotic islands combining fluid movement with fast paced combat to become a Crab Champion in this third person roguelike shooter.

name: YUMENIKKI -DREAM DIARY-
short_description: As long as I have dreams in my heart, I can never escape. I can never awaken from my dreams. Maybe if I follow the dream just past this doorway, then someday I can wake up again...

name: Project Winter
short_description: In Project Winter, survival is just the beginning. Work with your friends to escape the icy wilderness, but don’t get too comfortable. Traitors lurk among you, ready to lie, sabotage, & turn even the closest of friends against each other. And check out Project Winter 2.0: Cabin Fever coming Sept 18.

name: Fenix Box
short_description: This is a hardcore minimalist 2D platformer that tests how much of a hardcore gamer you are.

name: Pure Football 2018
short_description: Pure Football 2018 is an American Football Simulator where you play GM, Coach, and Player. Play through endless seasons as you master player contracts, assembling your coaching staff, free agency, and the draft. Lead your players come game time or use the advanced game simulation system.

name: The Master
short_description: Climb to the top to learn The Master's teachings. Extremely short game.

name: Powerless
short_description: An outbreak has turned mankind into walking zombies, will your guns be enough to purge them all or will you be powerless against the zombie horde?

name: They have HORNS
short_description: They have HORNS is a fast topdown shooter in which it is essential to listen to his intuition in order to stand as long as possible the enemy hordes. Easy to learn, but hard to master. The up to 4 player coop mode works very simple via plugn play.

name: Blood of Patriots
short_description: Now with Nancy Pelosi! Choose from 18 patriots (and tyrants) and fight your way through the tree of liberty. Are you the patriot that is going to save the republic?

name: The Cryptkeepers of Hallowford
short_description: Save Hallowford in this sequel to the Hero of Kendrickstone; fight monsters, uncover secrets, gather allies, and defeat the threat imperilling Hallowford!

name: Super Steampunk Pinball 2D
short_description: Super Steampunk Pinball 2D is an action-arcade game with a hi-bit steampunk aesthetic. Build up your steam power and go for the bonus stage!

name: SCARLET NEXUS
short_description: Choose between Yuito and Kasane, elite psionics each armed with a talent in psychokinesis and their own reason to fight. Complete both of their stories to unlock all the mysteries of a Brain Punk future caught between technology and psychic abilities.

name: Animals Memory: Dinosaurs
short_description: Animals Memory: Dinosaurs is a card game with pictures of different dinosaurs that will test your memory. The aim of the game is to find pairs of cards.

name: Puzzlement
short_description: a game about walking/jumping between plane surfaces to collect all red squares

name: Deadly Blue
short_description: Deadly blue is a journey through the world full of dangers, where you will fight against the evil creatures, overcome different obstacles on the way to your beloved.

name: ITTA
short_description: Test your limits in ITTA, a bullet-hell, boss-rush style adventure. Armed with her father’s revolver and guided by a strange ghostly cat, a displaced girl must battle her way through impossible trials in search of answers… and peace.

name: Spork: The Manic Utensil Storm
short_description: Without an ally The Spork must decide whether to take sides, or just get out of the city alive. A turn-based RPG with puzzle elements. Play through the game how you want, and side with who you want.

name: Fight or Flight
short_description: Battle Royale and Extraction that blends PvP and PvE, You are a operative that will drop into the infected region and attempt to recover artifacts and eradicate the infected.Each player is pitted against Zombies, Monsters and each other. Online or Single player for practice with bots!

name: Platform Golf
short_description: Platform Golf is a 2D physics based arcady golf game. It features a variety of levels with unique designs.

name: Lozenge
short_description: Click on any shape in the bottom of the screen to rotate it and then drag and drop it to the triangular slots until you complete a row, a diagonal or the central pattern. This game requires strategic thinking to plan the slots to be filled with future moves.

name: Dialing
short_description: Dialing is match-3 reinvented with a hint of never-ending difficult. The numbers are always increasing and so is the challenge.

name: 蜜汁女孩 Juice Girl
short_description: Something special to you as a gift. Click to playing the game and unlock all of the collections.

name: Rampage Ragdoll
short_description: Rampage Ragdoll is a ragdoll fight funny action game. Game Mode:Single Player Mode and Two Players Mode. Single Player Mode：Control the Player1 Ragdoll vs the AI Ragdoll. Two Players Mode: Player1 Ragdoll vs the Player2 Ragdoll. Control:Support keyboard and xbox controller.

name: Ling
short_description: Following the call of inner heart, the young man starts another journey of adventure. Faced with tough enemies and fierce fights, it is not certain whether the young man can reach the “final”. The only choice is moving forward with determination and clenched fists swinging great sword.

name: Controllers Battery Indicator
short_description: A simple and handy utility for monitoring the charge of Xbox controllers. In time will warn about the discharge of the battery. Doesn’t interfere with the gameplay. Doesn’t CPU load. Track battery capacity and predict long-term resource.

name: Chess Sudoku
short_description: Welcome! Are you ready for a new challenge, a new puzzle game? This is Chess inside a Sudoku! Well kind of... the rules of Chess aren't taken very seriously. But you do need some strategy like in Chess and you are solving a Sudoku, so the title isn't lying!

name: Piwall
short_description: Play a neon pinball machine in the arcade room and take a look at the released and upcoming JanduSoft games.

name: Midnightland
short_description: Explore, shoot, collect and kill in Midnightland™ a retro style B-movie horror amusement park that is constantly evolving.

name: MotoGP™18
short_description: Become the star of the 2018 MotoGP™! Compete as a professional rider and race against all the champions of the MotoGP™ on 19 official tracks. Enjoy an even more immersive gaming experience thanks to the new features introduced in the game.

name: Animals Memory: Birds
short_description: Animals Memory: Birds is a card game with pictures of different birds that will test your memory. The aim of the game is to find pairs of cards.

name: Soul Reaper: Unreap Commander
short_description: What would happen if Pikachu, Cloud, Diablo and the Grim Reaper went to bed together? Your guess is as good as mine, but I'd say it's pretty damn close to Soul Reaper: Unreap Commander.

name: Rise of Liberty
short_description: Rise of Liberty is a FPS single-player massive Revolutionary War battle simulator. Fire deafening cannons into the thick of the battle, stand in line formation and fire devastating volleys into the enemy. Gather your men for these monumental battles and defeat the enemy!

name: The Tower of Beatrice
short_description: An Adventure and Escape Room game about an unlucky thief who steals a book that can't keep its mouth shut.

name: Overduty VR: Battle Royale
short_description: Overduty VR: Battle Royale brings you into the thrill of a real battle royale experience. In this game you must rely on strategically maneuvering the big map, scouring for weapons and vehicles to claim the spot of victory, as the last fighter standing.

name: Choice of the Vampire
short_description: Slake your thirst, without becoming a Beast! Blessed with the blood-soaked gift of immortality, will you tend the flock of humanity—or twist it to your whims? When a brash young country butts heads with a brash young vampire, who will come out ahead?

name: Choice of the Vampire: The Fall of Memphis
short_description: Feast on the blood of a dying city: Memphis, 1873! Make your national debut in the Society, a conspiracy of vampires who convene in Memphis to elect a new "senator." The city burns with yellow fever, as the nascent Ku Klux Klan rises.

name: John Lazarus - Episode 1: Dead Man's Origin
short_description: Fight demons, creatures, and criminals while exploring vivid and surreal dream worlds. Discover the dark past of anti-hero John Lazarus in this first episode of a multi-part VR horror action-adventure.

name: F/A-18E Super Hornet
short_description: Welcome to the world of the most lethal, high performance multi-role strike-fighter ever designed - a plane so classified and so advanced that before today only the U.S Navy's elite pilots have ever flown it. Now it's your turn...

name: Blades of Orterra
short_description: Blades of Orterra is a Fantasy Open-World Multiplayer RPG created in Unreal Engine 4. Progress through the Kingdoms, defeat enemies, and explore the world of Orterra.

name: One Night On The Road
short_description: One Night On the Road is a quest in which You have to play as a character who has run out of fuel in the car. And now you have to find fuel in a small town. During the search, you can learn about the mysterious history of a resident of the city.

name: Idol Quest VR
short_description: Run, jump, swim, climb, and shoot in VR while evading dangerous animals and other perils in your quest for the lost idol!

name: M1 Tank Platoon
short_description: US Tank Platoons have four M1s. Four soldiers operate each. That's four tanks, sixteen men. And you control the whole shooting match.

name: Up and Down
short_description: This game is a puzzle with the unique gameplay and minimalist control using 2 buttons.

name: Serious Office
short_description: Fun multiplayer shooting game set in an office environment. Score by shooting at your colleagues, uhm opponents, and destroying the office. The last one on their chair claims victory. So, take out your opponents and shred the place to pieces! 5 players. 5 lifes. Eye to eye. Only one can survive.

name: CryPixels
short_description: A procedural pixel art generator allowing you to easily create hundreds of pixel art sprites for games or any other project, with an easy to use interface. Build your own generation grid, then start generating sprites using the different output settings.

name: Galactic Battles
short_description: Galactic Battles is a complex 2D top-down space shooter in which you have to fight with alien invaders.

name: Afraid Project
short_description: What you do in the game becomes reality!

name: Earl's Minecart Adventures
short_description: Blast with amazing speed through mines and caves. Break through wood, stone- and steel. Evade flowing lava, falling rocks and hazardous machinery. Race, jump, fly with amazing speed across rivers and ravines. Looping, doors, saws, fire, high voltage, rocks, traps and more.

name: Lux Ex - Legacy
short_description: Destroy bugs and glitches in your astral body to recover data from the source of the light of your soul.

name: Kamikazo VR
short_description: From the maker of Dreamflight and Black Moon. Kamikazo, the new crazy motorbike race.

name: Armada Skies
short_description: Buy weapons and ship upgrades. Fly through the skies, collect powerups and gun down wave after wave of enemies. Today, you own the skies!

name: Gay World
short_description: 2 Minigames - In 1 mode you play as a officer Gaypolice who must arrest all straight people. In 2 modes you play as a straight person, travelling to GAYLAG, where you need to squat on bottles.

name: A Walk Along the Wall
short_description: A challenging & Lovecraft-inspired boss-rush top-down twin-stick shooter. Bosses of great scale and challenge. A small yet potent arsenal. A wickedly unique soundtrack. Go forth and kick their teeth in.

name: FSX SpacePort
short_description: Spaceflight add-on for Microsoft Flight Simulator X

name: Outbreak in Space VR - Free
short_description: Simple, solid, old school, 3D, challenging, intense Virtual Reality game.

name: Sorcerer's Path
short_description: An adventure vertical shooter where straight is not the only direction!

name: PROJECT VELOCITY
short_description: PROJECT VELOCITY is a Bullet Hell and Endless Runner where the speed never stops rising, and the obstacles never stop coming. Fight and cruise your way through obstructions and bosses with ever-increasing difficulty!

name: hOSHIs Elektronauts
short_description: hOSHIs Elektronauts is a simple Multiplayer game that is played on a single keyboard on a single screen. Chase each other with glowing stripes of pixels. But avoid hitting the walls or the pixeltrails.

name: 永远消失的幻想乡 ～ The Disappearing of Gensokyo
short_description: "The Disappearing of Gensokyo" is a Touhou Project doujin game from MyACG Studio, a Chinese doujin game fan circle. We have re-imagined Touhou as an ARPG, creating this "Danmaku-Shooting-ARPG". We hope this game will be a good experience for those who are both new and knowledgeable of Touhou!

name: RICHCODE富豪密码
short_description: 《Rich code》is a multiplayer online and simulation investment game.Pick careers randomly and invest as you work. The goal is to achieve financial freedom of more than 100% and win.In the game you can invest in today's business hotspots, negotiate with your opponents, trade, fight, etc., or buy and sell stocks.

name: aMAZE Untouchable
short_description: aMAZE Untouchable is a straightforward and surprisingly-difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with calm soundtrack.

name: Yuzi Lims: anime runner
short_description: Endless runner in the anime style.

name: Abasralsa
short_description: Find out the story of a simple crazy Vlad who lies on his bed imagines a crazy journey.

name: 乱战机动队 Past Due
short_description: In the near sci-fiction world that we create, you can choose your favorite character, build up your own team, formulate different tactics, fight against opponent teams . Being able to choose from different clever tactics, super cool characters and skills. You will have a fantastic PVPshooting experience!

name: Witch Sword
short_description: Witch Sword is a story driven, indie RPG. The game takes place in a dark, medieval style fantasy world. The player will play as a swordsman and begin an adventure to unveil a conspiracy to overthrow an empire, and to take part in a deadly contest for a powerful ancient artifact.

name: My Beastly Lovers
short_description: Begin your mission of collecting magical items by taking over the hearts of monsters in this game that mixes dating simulator with adventure and RPG elements. Will you find the love of your life among monsters?

name: Smooth Operators 2
short_description: Smooth Operators is a classic Tycoon/Simulator game where you are the Building Architect, Hiring Manager, and Business Developer! Expand your building, Hire employees, and manage your own customer service company and lead it to financial success! But for gods sake - Keep your employees happy!

name: Flying Bacon:Ukrainian Air Force
short_description: Do not be a pig - launch a pig!

name: Dungeon Gambit Boy
short_description: Dungeon Gambit Boy is a constantly aggressive platform game, on which you’re a boy that lives in the caverns and must rescue the missing villagers within the long paths of the Blaite universe, wearing fancy clothing, a bow and his funny and defenseless fists.

name: Unveloped
short_description: Join Anton and Garlo as they travel across the land to stop Angor, a black fairy who develops really bad games.

name: Copierre
short_description: Take control of these heroes defending the kingdom by fighting against the endless waves of enemies!

name: Squirrel Sphere
short_description: Recreational Rodent Rolling feat Spherical Squrrels

name: Sit on bottle
short_description: "Sit on bottle" - is a game about ordinary factory worker, whose job it is to sit on horizontally laid bottles

name: Tears - 9, 10
short_description: Can you protect this girl until the end, when the world has turned their back on her?

name: ExtremeRetroArena
short_description: ExtremeRetroArena is a classic arcade style shoot 'em up where you must fly around and use spells to avoid contact with enemy spacecraft. The game uses a modernized and stylized version of classic arcade graphics and effects.

name: Clicker: Mining Simulator
short_description: In this game you will have an exciting immersion in the world of mining. You can earn the crypto currency and after selling it, follow the exchange rates, choose the currency that you like more and buy equipment to improve your farm.

name: 3DCoat Modding Tool
short_description: This basic edition of 3DCoat is designed for modding in-game items, such as weapon skins and more. Modify in-game 3D models with the power of tools available in 3DCoat and seamlessly integrate your creations back to the game! This is also your best way to get started with 3DCoat!

name: Omnibion War
short_description: Transform your high-tech space jet into a flying mech at the touch of a button as you blast your way through the galaxy in this frantic 3D shoot ‘em up. Take down thousands of Hellhounds one by one and prevent them from acquiring Omnibion, a dangerous ancient weapon.

name: Mouse (Sneaking)
short_description: In this runner game, you play as a mouse who has stolen cheese as much as you can.

name: Scary new year
short_description: In "Scary NEW YEAR" you try to escape after waking up in the Dark Hell. StoryYou were just celebrating the New Year with your friends and had a drink too many. Your memory of the day is fuzzy at best, only the strong flavour of your last drink lingers on. You wake up in the middle of nowhere.

name: FreeFlight
short_description: Casual game about flying in the air with interesting plane physics and low-poly design.

name: Mumps
short_description: «Mumps» — This is a game about a pig called a Mumps, which should collect all the acorns for itself for the winter. Feel like a pig and survive collecting acorns. Help the pig to pass all levels.

name: Criminal Bundle
short_description: Criminal Bundle is a first person shooter online multiplayer with low poly esthetic. Shoot other players while trying to open the safe or prevent criminals from run away with the money.

name: TOXIC PLUMBING
short_description: Game Plumbing "Toxic threat" is of the long-known genre of "plumber ", but you will be pleasantly surprised by the changes that bring variety to the gameplay. The game will be interesting for everyone from novices to pros.

name: Assembly Required
short_description: Create a perilous furniture maze, deviously designed to confuse and constrain your customers. With the aid of your loyal employees and truly devilish products, you will build the furniture empire of your dreams… and their nightmares!

name: Blush Blush
short_description: You are responsible somehow for a curse that befalls 12 unfortunate hawt dudes. Now you have to find them and break the curse with your love!!

name: MEGAMiX
short_description: MEGAMiX is a rhythm-action-platform game. Move to the beat to clear platforms, fight enemies, and save the world! Did we mention it's free-to-play?

name: Adventure Land - The Code MMORPG
short_description: Adventure Land is an experimental Indie MMORPG. ANYONE can Code not just one, but up to 4 characters! You can play manually, use the given default Javascript Code, or learn programming to do more! Going open-source at 10,000 installs!

name: Forgotten Places: Regained Castle
short_description: Unravel the secrets of an ancient castle!

name: Bomber League
short_description: A league of bombers, the last who survive win the great competition! A Battle Royal like you have never seen!

name: Game Server Toolbox
short_description: Game Server Toolbox is a utility that allows you to create and manage game servers. It has many features tailored to both basic and advanced users. It keeps server creation uniform across many games by using Server Profiles that are uploaded by the community for easy server creation.

name: KOEWOTAYORINI SP / 声之寄托SP
short_description: Escape by means of "Voice"! The second installment of the new feeling puzzle and escape game! You are being held in a room that you haven't been to before. The only thing you can do is using telephone to ask for hint from a cooperator.

name: Vulpine
short_description: Vulpine is a charming action exploration game where you venture through a living world as animals armed to the teeth. Enter a world reclaimed by nature with wildlife, discoveries, and mysteries abound. Encounter eccentric characters, fearsome monsters, and engage in heart pounding combat.

name: 审判者 The Inquisitor
short_description: "The Inquisitor" is a short RPG game with a complete storyline and combat system. A resurrected inquisitor from the graveyard receives the instructions of God and embark on the journey of judging the sinners.

name: Tren0
short_description: A pixel game that contains some puzzles. It tells a story about five strangers who were trapped on a mysterious train.

name: The Tavern of Magic
short_description: Welcome to the Tavern! Craft, buy or sell Magic Cards to form your perfect deck and conquer other mages in Duels. Crawl together through Dungeons and more.

name: Thirsty Bubble

short_description: A story-driven psychological horror RPG about a group of friends who unintentionally become bound together after encountering 7 curses from a school.

name: Math Tile

As your fighters increase in level, it will be up to you to decide how to forge their attributes and abilities. Build your story. Build your empire.

name: Keys
short_description: This is a story told in three parts, this is but the first act in the trilogy of a man and the threads of fate that bind him. Dim lighting, comedy, and simple puzzles add to the story's atmosphere.

name: Virtual Desktop Dashboard

name: Survivors of Borridor

It uniquely allows players to join using their smartphone browser and turn it into a controller for their character. You and your crew have crashed on one of the most dangerous and hostile habitable planets in the galaxy..

name: Lakeview Valley
short_description: Murder rpg set in the small town of Lakeview Valley. Become the most popular home-owner or succumb to your dark desires. The choice is yours.

name: Derpy pirates!
short_description: An adventure game like no other. Features Captain Bazaar and his crew on a big quest to save the world.

name: Horse Riding Deluxe
short_description: Explore a beautiful open world, full of horses and other animals. Or just enjoy the beautiful view while riding. In the world of Horse Riding Deluxe you and your horses have no limits. But train and care for your horses well because the various races will demand everything from you!

name: BRIGHTEST

name: Forgotten Hill Mementoes

name: Forgotten Sound 2: Destiny

name: Dragonview
short_description: Warrior! Open your Eyes! This is the future of Gaming! Look. Before you leap. This isn't some corny collection of cardboard dungeons and dragons. It's a brilliant new vision of RPG Action Adventure. With Real-time 16 Meg 3D Scrolling like you've never seen.

name: Food Monster and Animals Memory Match
short_description: Food Monster and Animals Memory Match game is a classic board game, which help you develop yout memory skills. Playing this matching game will help you improve your recognition while having fun.

name: Filthy Hands
short_description: Experience the multiplayer action of an armed robbery where a hostile intruder will do everything he can to steal the safe from a wealthy family. Play as a family of 3 or as a brutal home invader attempting to steal the family's hard earned savings.

name: Bitcoin Mining Empire Tycoon
short_description: Bitcoin, Blockchain, Cryptoeconomics, Mining, Hashrate... You might have already heard of it all somewhere, haven’t you? They appear more and more frequently in the News. Is it the beginning of cryptocurrency era? Will the global economy change?

name: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries
short_description: The year is 3015. The battlefields are dominated by war machines known as BattleMechs. Level entire cities and decimate the enemy in your BattleMech. Follow a quest for glory and revenge. Manage an expanding mercenary company. Fight alongside your friends with a four-player PvE co-op.

name: Gone Fireflies
short_description: A short story-driven experience about love, loss, and the choices we make.

name: bLogic Blox
short_description: bLogic Blox is an electronic sandbox where you can create anything your mind can dream up. Build circuit logic with switches, gates, lights, batteries, or just make cool 3D pixel art. Add input bits linked to your keyboard to make interactive objects that you can control. The only limitation is your imagination!

name: Treasure Stack
short_description: Catering to solo and multiplayer puzzle fans, Treasure Stack features a wide variety of modes, whether you're testing your skills in Challenge Mode, partying up with friends in 4-Player Local Versus, or taking on the rest of the world in Online Versus.

name: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic
short_description: Build a soviet republic from an impoverished country into a rich industrial superpower in a city builder with intricate production chains and a fully simulated global economy. Manage the lives of your citizens from education to work and party loyalty to criminal activity.

short_description: Buy and Sell in a 2D board game of chance and risk management. Up to 8 players Human (Local) or AI. Unlock Steam achievements!

name: SUPREMACY: WORLD WAR 3
short_description: This Long Term Strategy Game lets you take control of the armed forces of your nation. Become responsible for its military expansion, technological research and economic development. Form alliances and wage total war for global dominance on the battlefields of World War 3.

name: Little Adventurer III
short_description: This is a first-person casual game that focuses on going home after helping the little girl, and a few mini-games.

name: Massive Galaxy
short_description: Explore, trade and fight your way through Massive Galaxy, a point and click narrative adventure set in bustling cyberpunk cities, deserted wastelands and beautifully crafted space habitats

name: Dig and Shoot
short_description: It looks like a simple play, but there's a deeper story behind it.

name: Dark Flow
short_description: Three bandits kidnaped a girl, bring her to an abandoned building and wait for a ransom, they chose the right victim but chose the wrong place.

name: Cosmic Top Secret
short_description: Play the incredible true story of T and her quest to uncover the truth about her parents’ work for the Danish Intelligence during the Cold War.

name: Anime girl Or Bottle?
short_description: This is a logic game with 2 modes, in one you need to find and click on all anime girls before the time runs out, and in second mode you play for anime girl and you need to collect as many bottles as possible before the time runs out.

name: Clawface
short_description: Clawface is an intense, arcade-styled twin stick shooter where you play as an adorable robot equipped with crazy weapons and a giant claw to fight an endless wave of alien monsters!

name: VIRUS RUSH
short_description: Create a universal cure for all coronaviruses in a modern nano-laboratory! A modern view on the classic game! Colorful action and catchy mechanics are now in virtual reality!

name: Team Sonic Racing™
short_description: Team Sonic Racing combines the best elements of arcade and fast-paced competitive style racing as you face-off with friends in intense multiplayer racing.

name: Space Farm
short_description: Space Farm is following in the footsteps of amazing games like Stardew Valley, and any of the Harvest Moon franchise. We are setting out to bring this amazing genre into the next generation. In-depth Storyline, dynamic marketplace, reputation, items, and of course FARMING!

name: Neon Krieger Yamato
short_description: Relive the arcade era! Select from 8 unique characters and brawl your way to victory - solo or with a friend! A genre mashup of Japanese 90s gaming, it mixes stylish combos, sidescrolling action, and twitch combat puzzles, set in a pixel art cyberpunk world harkening to the days of 16 bit.

name: Titanic: Adventure Out Of Time
short_description: Intrigue and adventure await you on board the Titanic, the most famous ocean liner in history. As a British secret agent on a vital mission, it is up to you to change the course of history as you explore the world’s most luxurious ocean vessel in all its original splendour.

name: Scutter
short_description: Scutter is a VR arcade-style obstacle race for a hexapod robot. While exploring the planet Cryla, an alien virus rains down potentially ending your mission. Fire, Roll and Fly your way through action-packed maps of increasing difficulty to collect energy crystals and teleport Scutter back home. Free demo available!

name: The Real Laser Ball
short_description: A physics based, arcade, high score chaser with a progression system and a fetish for the 80’s. In The Real Laser Ball you’re a ball… with a laser.

name: Spring It!
short_description: A Physics puzzle game where you build tools to bounce, launch, push, and pull your toy robots to reach the end of production.

name: Luminescence
short_description: "Let's make a deal, if you can prove that urban legend is a lie, I won't bother you anymore." Rena is annoying student. She always show up wherever Ady is. Until one day, they make a deal. If Ady can prove that urban legend is a lie, she promise to leave Ady alone. Can Ady prove it ?

name: This Is the Police 2
short_description: Interpret the law as you see fit! Run the sheriff’s department, manage your cops, make tough decisions – and try to keep out of prison yourself – in this story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and turn-based tactical combat.

name: [東方二次] Senran Meisuishu Tactics / 戦乱命萃酒タクティクス
short_description: One day, a strange cup appeared in Gensokyo. A big fight will occur in search of it!

name: Crumple Zone
short_description: A tribute to arcade crash racing games of the 90s and 2000s. Turn off your brain, put the pedal to the metal and smash up some cars!

name: Emergency Call 112 – The Fire Fighting Simulation 2
short_description: Emergency Call 112 – The Fire Fighting Simulation 2 is the consequent further development of the successful first part, which lets every Firefighter Fan experience the way a professional fire brigade works.

name: OF MICE AND SAND -REVISED-
short_description: On a desert planet in the farthest reaches of space, mice await your command! Direct their mobile fortress, and seek the legendary city of gold!

name: WHAT THE GOLF?

name: ADONIS

name: Moe Jigsaw

name: Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story
short_description: Build a school for RPG heroes in a mix of simulation and role-play adventure. As Principal of a school for the warriors and mages of the future, you must build your Academy to train the best in the land. Place and upgrade facilities, form teams of the best students and send them out on epic quests!

name: Zombie Watch
short_description: Top-down open world single player / survival / RPG game with zombies and wildlife.

name: Admine

name: OVERWHELM
short_description: You're outnumbered, low on ammunition and the paranoia sets in. This is an action horror-world where enemies get power-ups and you don’t.

name: Hexologic
short_description: Immerse yourself in the beautiful world of Hexologic. Solve challenging, yet rewarding puzzles, listen to relaxing music, dive deep into the game’s atmosphere and fall in love in with Sudoku again!

name: Madness of the Architect
short_description: Madness of The Architect is a surreal horror/puzzle game inspired by older point-and-click adventure games such as Myst, Nine Doors and 999: Nine Hours. Players enter a world that seems to be going insane and must solve labyrinths of mind bending puzzles to escape the clutches of the Mad Architect!

name: Command: The Silent Service
short_description: Submarine warfare from post-WW2 to the present day! Lay mines, strike land targets with cruise and ballistic missiles, creep up to surface ships to take hull shots undetected, sniff sensitive electronic emissions, tap undersea communications cables, covertly deliver special-forces teams ashore, and of course hunt down anything on the sea...

name: Strategic Command Classic: Global Conflict
short_description: The Matrix version is the Gold Edition of the original and includes the the two DLCs "Assault on Communism" and "Assault on Democracy". Players will be able to wage World War II across the massive expanse of the entire planet.

short_description: Sacrifice Dungeon is an FPS that pays homage to the FPS of old. The game is built on Ray Casting technology, simple yet challenging. Fight your way through hordes of monsters while collecting items and increasing your high score. Find the source of evil that is causing great turmoil to the village of Riksbruk!

name: Myths of the World: Spirit Wolf Collector's Edition

short_description: Ativeil is a fun and interesting 3D puzzle game. Cubes, lasers, teddy bears... this game has them all. Can you figure it out ?

Currently available features are basic base building and mining with Researching new technology and discovering new flora and fauna coming soon. Play alone or coop with friends, its up to you.

short_description: Purgatory Fell is a psychological thriller set in 1955. Explore the declining mind of a man who cannot sleep. A progression of nightmares reveals hints about who you were, and what you are becoming.

Aliens from far away have arrived at Earth with the intent to wipe our species from existence using their deadliest most super-advanced weapon... Bricks! But not all aliens share the desire to destroy mankind, and this is where you come in.

name: The Alpha Device

name: Gleaner Heights
short_description: Experience the old-school charm of classic farming games with the suburban gothic atmosphere of certain 90's TV shows, along with contemporary game mechanics. Farming, crafting, combat, romantic relationships and mysterious events await!

name: Karloman and His Iced Muffins
short_description: In this game you play a bearded caver who is supposed to rescue trapped, ill- equipped treasure-seekers while finding the actual treasure for the local museum. The focus is on the interaction with the cave system itself, meaning you are most likely to be killed by the cave itself.

name: Loot Box Simulator 20!8
short_description: Strange simulator for a certain type of people who want to get NOTHING and PAIN. Game based on real events.

name: Eternal Man: Forest
short_description: An endless runner game with satirical commentary about society and undeserved achievements to give fulfillment to your nonexistent lives. Because we care.

name: Impossible Jumpy Quest
short_description: Immerse yourself in the colorful and simplistic world of "Impossible Jumpy Quest". In this Single-Player experience you will Jump'n Run through increasingly more challanging levels. Find your own way through each of it's unique logic based levels. A new adventure is waiting for you.

short_description: Cutie anime girl realizes her cool big bro is missing?? Cheese it up with Chizuru and SHOOT TO THE BEAT OF THE SONG in this top down bullet hell shooter! Absorb enemy bullets using your waveshines to utilize their bullets as your own! Show those cheeseheads that you're better!

In this comedy RPG adventure, step into the armor of Kusoge, accomplished user of the Candy Cane Greatsword style and one of the few who can properly wield peppermint...

Protagonist, his story and his opinion of what is happening, weaved with wide range of environment interaction possibilities. Burn, destroy, invent and make this work! Have a good time.

Can they learn to work together in time to make the weapon that saves us all?

name: Pale Lands VR

name: FARHOME

short_description: Nero Burning ROM burns, copies, rips, and protects your multimedia files from CDs, DVDs, and even Blu-ray Discs™* for the long term with unbeatable quality – and reliably blocks unwanted access thanks to the SecurDisc 4.0 technology.

name: Tick Tock: A Tale for Two
short_description: You and your friend are trapped in a mystical world. As time ebbs away you must solve increasingly complex puzzles to escape. Cooperation is key as neither of you have the full picture! Play on two devices, local or remotely, all you need is a voice connection.

name: oVRshot
short_description: Engage in epic battles! Choose unique special abilities, and dominate the competition. Customize your character with awesome cosmetics. Experience the ultimate VR archery game oVRshot now!

name: Space Chip

name: Impossible Runner
short_description: World's hardest game. Impossible Runner. Try to complete all 10 'Impossible' levels.

name: Ascent Spirit
short_description: Equipped with two improvised ice axes in Ascent Spirit, your only chance of survival is to reach the top of this sacred mountain and get back to your hot air balloon before the winds free it.

name: Voxel Baller
short_description: Challenge your breaking skills and tackle the obstacles in this frenzy action game! Voxel Baller invites you to rediscover the brick-beaking genre with 50 unique levels. Will you clear them all?

name: Valkyria Chronicles 4 Complete Edition
short_description: A Continent Engulfed in the Bitter Flames of War! Commander Claude Wallace and his childhood friends set out to fight in a desperate war, but bone-chilling blizzards, waves of imperial soldiers, and the godlike powers of the Valkyria stand between them and victory.

name: Epiphany!
short_description: Epiphany! is a logic puzzle game in which the goal is to find the hidden pattern for the sequence of gems.

name: Undead Horde

Maraud through the lands of the living, raze their villages and steal their treasures. Ultimately you'll take over the whole kingdom of the living!

name: Chocolate makes you happy 3

name: For Food Sake! VR
short_description: Action packed food sorting game that comes with a BOOM! Join the work force today, for food sake!!!

name: Home Architect - Design your floor plans in 3D - Ultimate Edition
short_description: The ULTIMATE Edition of Home Architect – Design your floor plans in 3D, the acknowledged architecture software, now available! Enjoy exclusive features and content to create and customize all your construction projects!

name: Primitive Shooter
short_description: Primitive Shooter - an interesting and exciting game, made in a minimalist style! Take on the role of the main character, shoot out from enemies, set new records and all this under pleasant music!

name: Feed Eve
short_description: Next-Gen VR Action-Shooter experience. Battle hordes of zombies in extremely realistic environments and varying exciting game modes.

name: Beer Ranger
short_description: Logic platformer in the Oldschool style. The dwarfs are on a quest to find as much beer as they can. Only smart mind and skillful hands will bring them to the desired goal. Will you manage to beat the most hardcore levels?

name: GOLFY GOLF
short_description: Golfy Golf is a charming new spin on the classic gentleman’s game. Play solo, against the computer, or against a friend. Across six worlds and 120 levels, you’ll pitch and putt your way past menacing enemies and fiendish environmental obstacles in pursuit of par.

name: Atomic Heist
short_description: Atomic Heist is a sci-fi roguelike twin-stick shooter. Control your combat ship and fight your way out of the overrun space station. The nuclear core you have to steal is leaking radiation, so you need to hurry and escape! Manage your ammo carefully and collect power-ups to enhance your ship.

name: Drumpf: Rise Up, Libertonia!
short_description: At the height of his power, God-Emperor Drumpf was violently dethroned by The Usurpers: dictators who helped overthrow the rightful rulers of the world. Can you rescue and re-unite the rightful rulers of Amerika?

name: Virtual Reality Neuron Tracer
short_description: The Virtual Reality Neuron Tracer is a tool for visualizing and reconstructing neurons from scanned 3D tissue in virtual reality. VRNT allows you to view and work with your data directly in 3D, providing more natural and intuitive interaction, and leading to faster insights and better understanding.

name: I Hate Heroes: Rocket Man
short_description: The first chapter in the VR Superhero platformer series I Hate Heroes! Play as a Rocket Man, a superhero trapped in the hell-prison of the greatest supervillain the world has ever known. Use your rocket thruster hands to zoom on the ground, grab massive air, avoid death, and collect keys to escape.

name: Shatter EVERYTHING (VR)
short_description: Shatter EVERYTHING is the first of its kind: gain intricate control of a powerful attack orb, and mercilessly demolish a sea of shattering shapes. Control time and use all the destructive weapons at your disposal to survive.

name: EV3 - Drag Racing
short_description: EV3 is built by real life drag racers. The fun of drag racing is driving, not just pushing buttons. In EV3 you actually drive the car using realistic variable gas pedal, steering, braking, realistic suspension and engine/torque response... It's all there.

name: Icky
short_description: Icky is a very addictive platform game where the main objective is to obtain as high a score as you can. You can level up your character thus upgrading your weapons as you go along. There are tons of different character unlocks to keep the game really exciting!

name: 1 Screen Platformer
short_description: This is a SHORT, 2D PLATFORMER with TIGHT CONTROLS about exploring a single level to get past a bunch of TRAPS. There is an EASY mode and a HARD mode depending on your skill level.

name: Gears of Eden
short_description: Gears of Eden is an indie space game set in the distant future featuring a story-driven adventure that includes open-world exploration, crafting and missions. Take control of a sentient machine and search for answers to your origin as you mine, craft, and explore!

name: Planet Cube: Edge
short_description: Planet Cube is being invaded! Prepare to run, gun, jump and dash your way through an underwater science complex, collecting fire-power to turn the tables on a mysterious aggressor. This is high-speed adventuring set in a hand-crafted pixel art world, filled with precision platforming and thrills.

name: Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles
short_description: Meet Lumote, the squishiest bioluminescent creature, in this beautiful 3D puzzle platformer. Take control of the world’s inhabitants on a quest into the Great Depths to seize control from the Mastermote.

name: Pandora: Chains of Chaos
short_description: A 17-year-old girl named Pandora has opened a box containing evils that could destroy the world. Kome Village, her home, is invaded by creatures spawned from the darkness and the legendary Titans. During the invasion, Pandora must battle countless enemies and demons, including her own inner turmoil.

name: Space Ball
short_description: Space Ball is a casual adventure game, In this game, you need to control the ball, through the spikes, jump over the magma, collect gold coins along the way, and finally reach the end.

name: Canek: Quest for Corn [Demo]
short_description: Canek: Quest for Corn is a single player action platform game (under development). Meet Canek, a legendary hero on an epic quest to save the Maya civilization from the curse that threatens its people.

name: Zahalia
short_description: Zahalia was a peaceful land until The Dark Wizard came and stole all the crystals. Defeat his group of monsters and reclaim the Crystals to save Zahalia from darkness.

name: Fallen ~Makina and the City of Ruins~
short_description: Fallen takes you on an adventure with Makina into the Ruins of Gardona. What fate awaits Makina and her friends on their travels as they descend further into the ruins? Find out in this JRPG classic!

name: Xploquest 2

name: Way Out
short_description: Way out is a VR game for sports.You shuttle in the square arrays to get a way out.To get scores to improve ourselves for better achievement.Get up. Let us get fit in VR world. Let’s enjoy moving and shooting in sky, snow, laboratory.

name: Mr Dirt Poor 吃土计划
short_description: 《Mr Dirt Poor》一款养成经营类游戏,本作中玩家是个刚刚辞职的游戏开发者,开发什么类型的你来决定,不过要学会观察市场,毕竟后期很激烈!

name: From Village to Empire
short_description: From Village to Empire is an indie turn based strategy game with a historical setting. Build cities, research technologies, and train units to discover new lands and conquer the world!

name: Desktop Cube-Man
short_description: This is a free multiplayer PC desktop game, you can simply place on the desktop or enter challenge mode. In challenge mode, you can just idle casually, or try to challenge higher difficulties with friends. You can gain experience through idle time and unlocks more behavior modes.

name: THE ARCHER: Dead Hunt
short_description: Become Garran of Abrivia, the professional monster killer for hire, the greatest archer in the world. This time. He was tasked to take back the Le Vol Castle from an unknown forces of dangerous mercenaries. Also begin his personal quest to discover the identity of them and their evil plans.

name: DYO
short_description: DYO is a mind-bending cooperative platformer for one or two players where you can hop between two halves of a split screen.

name: Mahjong Riichi Multiplayer
short_description: Japanese mahjong, also known as Riichi mahjong, is a 4 player tabletop game based on the chinese original mahjong. Compete against individuals from all over the world in the online multiplayer mode. Build sequences and tripplets within your hand and complete your hand faster than your opponents!

name: Finish Line Manager
short_description: Ever dreamed of owning and managing your own car racing team? Redline Ultimate Racing allows you to make your dreams come true! Take control of either a randomly generated racing universe or load your own custom-created universe into the game.

name: Psychiatrist Simulator
short_description: Have you ever wanted to be a psychiatrist? Now you can! Be a shrink for 14 days. Meet 14 patients with unique story of their lives. Diagnosis, treatment, chosen dialogues have impact on history of patients. The choice is yours.

name: Aplestia
short_description: Aplestia is a light-hearted, unepic, fun, cynical and adventurous rpg with turn-based combat! Fight monsters, bosses, get your loot and find secret rooms and epic equipment.

name: Masplado
short_description: a plataform game that mix original ideas with bootleg nes games from 90s-2000s, using mixed graphics (8bit,16 bit and more), many levels and much more!

name: Tale of Ronin

name: Bird Game

name: A Story of Distress
short_description: You and your brother set off to the big city of Aston in order to become successful merchants, but things go wrong when your brother gets murdered, filling your heart with pure rage. Take your vengeance on those who defied you. Use stealth to your advantage and try not to get consumed by rage.

name: Try To Fall Asleep
short_description: John Herrin survived a horrible accident, damaging his brain and memory. Through falling asleep, he can rediscover his unfortunate past in his dreams, but due to his brain damage he'll start to see visions and hallucinations, and falling asleep won't be as easy as it seems at first...

name: Essence of Illumination: The Beginning
short_description: In this first episode is a mystical immersive adventure that this relaxing, mesmerizing, and an exciting underwater experience as you explore an ancient world of a lost civilization with a Goddess who’s light and magic gives you the Power of Light to cleanse the dark matter that destroyed the civilization long ago.

name: Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders
short_description: A thrilling point-and-click adventure game where you play as Di Renjie, ancient China's most famous and gifted investigator, as he tracks a serial killer in the heart of the Tang Dynasty's capital city.

name: Beneath The Surface
short_description: A relaxing hiatus from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Sit in a remote corner of the world, drop a line, and see what bites.

short_description: A minimalist style, flying barrage game. The glutton played by the player is almost invincible when facing enemies. It can not only ignore the majority of attack,but also swallow the enemy's bullets to strengthen itself. But this does not mean that players can crush everything.

name: 7 Billion Humans
short_description: Automate swarms of office workers to solve puzzles inside your very own parallel computer made of people. A thrilling followup to the award winning Human Resource Machine. Now with more humans!

name: FIGHT KNIGHT
short_description: FIGHT KNIGHT is a first-person dungeon-brawler! Grid-based dungeon crawling meets action-packed real time enemy encounters. Fight your way through puzzles and enemies to save those trapped in the Tower's eternal night!

name: Heroes Of Hellas 4: Birth Of Legend
short_description: Be the hero Olympus needs and rise from its ashes today!

short_description: Iridescence is a Shoot 'Em Up with a color-changing mechanic, where you dodge and absorb many different colored bullets. It features a painted watercolor theme & features an inventive chaining system. Play through 5 main levels and 30 varied challenge levels!

short_description: Her small town transformed into a world of terror, crawling with zombies. An unprecedented tale of click-based action and suspense is about to begin.

short_description: A disgraced engineer unravels a terrifying deception in a retro-futuristic dystopia spanning the stars, fusing resource management, strategic card duels, and morally complex social dynamics against the clockwork cruelty of an authoritarian state clinging to power.

name: The Beast Inside
short_description: The Beast Inside is a unique, gripping twist on thriller and survival horror. Immerse in the story of long-buried secrets, personal tragedies, and madness. Play as two protagonists bounded by dark heritage. Combat the enemies, solve riddles and experience real terror in the 3D-scanned environment.

name: Sunburnt
short_description: Sunburnt is a multiplayer zombie survival game where guns WON’T help you! Zombie outbreaks have struck the country, and only a few humans have survived. Conventional weapons have little effect on the dead but they have a weakness… Light which gives them intensely painful sunburns!

name: ESPER
short_description: As one of a small number of citizens who have been endowed with the power to move objects with their minds, you have been enrolled by the government to undertake a series of tests to show that you are in control of your powers.

name: Joy Climb
short_description: You must move upwards. Higher! To the Top!!! But more often you fill fall down.

name: A Rite from the Stars

To achieve this goal, he will have to master three paths: Wisdom, Courage and Spirit. Each one featuring different mechanics, characters and story.

name: Survival Journals
short_description: Survive with your choices and fortify your safehouse in this text based adventure. The Horde's on it's way, will you be ready when it arrives?

name: Battleship Lonewolf 2
short_description: Become a commander of the space fleet and battle with other players in real time. Now, shall we begin?

name: WWⅡ英雄列伝 泥の中の虎　オットー・カリウス
short_description: 戦車150両以上を撃破した稀代のエース、オットー・カリウスの軍歴を描く、伝記的戦術SLG。 体が小さく体力もなかった少年は、幾多の困難を乗り越え歴史に残る大エースとなる。 ポーランドでの軍事訓練から、ルール包囲網で降伏するまでの軍歴を史実解説を交えて丁寧に描く。

name: Welcome to Wacken
short_description: A story in five parts, from Secret Location and Banger Films, Welcome to Wacken invites you to experience the festival through the eyes of the fans and truly feel why Wacken is the Mecca for metalheads everywhere.

name: Ukhar
short_description: Plunge yourself into sword and sorcery adventures, roll and slash through your enemies!

name: BattleCON: Online
short_description: In this deeply strategic, full-information battle card game, choose your fighter from a diverse roster of spell-slinging duelists, tag-teaming werewolves, time-traveling boxers, dimensional knights, and more!

name: King of the Dwarves: Underground City Builder
short_description: Build an epic kingdom inside a mountain in this underground city builder. Mine and build in a vast procedurally generated 3D world. Gather resources, research technology, train warriors and engineers, forge weapons, fight monsters and manage hundreds of units. Become the King of the Dwarves!

name: Super Jigsaw Puzzle
short_description: If you like to make puzzles, Super Jigsaw Puzzle is your game. Enjoy its comfortable and intuitive interface and its relaxing music that will allow you to concentrate on the difficult task of solving these beautiful photos that pose a real challenge for lovers of puzzles.

name: The Operational Art of War IV
short_description: The Operational Art of War IV is the new generation of operational wargames. With more flexibility than before and with a new array of exciting features, it will make you relive the most iconic battles from the dawn of the 20th Century to modern day, including the ones that never occurred!

name: The Woods
short_description: A nerve-wracking Psycho Game with breathtaking ambient elements and innovative gameplay. Lost in the hunting ground of a notorious killer, you need to fight for your life. Sneak, run, hide, fight or play his mad games - the choice is yours only!

name: Containment Initiative: PC Standalone
short_description: Shoot zombies, get money, upgrade your gear. Now featuring local split-screen co-op.

name: Levelhead: Platformer Maker
short_description: Deliver those goods, real good - or get turned into scrap trying! Precision platforming, genre-bending power-ups, a challenging campaign, and a galaxy full of jokes await you in Levelhead!

name: Boxing Apocalypse
short_description: You are the world’s best assassin, locked up on a space prison taken over by aliens beginning human testing, and waging war on mankind. For sport, aliens watch inmates battle to the death. Players must use their boxing skills to fight for freedom, the winner stays alive to see another day.

name: Afandas Survival

Already at the beginning you realize that surviving isn´t easy. To stay alive, you must search for equipment and provisions.

name: Adventures of Hendri

name: Balloon

name: Lost In 80s II

name: Point of No Return
short_description: Point of No Return is a parody experience disguised as an Early Access release. You are trapped inside a malfunctioning game to gaze in horror at the scariest thing of all: THE CURRENT YEAR! The video game industry has reached the point of no return...

name: Identity

name: Star-Pit Starship

name: Super Pillow Fight
short_description: Super Pillow Fight is an awesome new indie fighting game from Aoineko. It depicts the cataclysmic battles of the 1982 Women's Pillow Fight World Championship held in Boca Raton, Florida. Twenty of the fiercest pillow warriors from around the world gathered to find out who was strongest.

name: Asteroid Defender!
short_description: Defend humanity in this retro-inspired space shooter as you patrol the stars and blast killer asteroids from the sky. Keep power to the energy pylons while maintaining the defense shield protecting Earth to earn powerful upgrades for your ship. Do you have what it takes to protect our world?

name: UNDEAD FACTORY:Zombie Pandemic

name: Starship

name: ばるばろっさ! ～すすめ? 赤軍少女旅団～(全年齢版)

name: Future Ghost

name: Post-Apo Machines

name: Moe! Ninja Girls

name: Seeking Dawn: Free to Play Edition

name: 魔王村长和杂货店-Hero Village Simulator

name: Daily OVR
short_description: Daily OVR make you simply view and use your desktop apps in VR. You can adjust the position, size and transparency, bind desktop windows to controllers, HMD or the world, type with a VR keyboard, customize button settings, detect and display objects (ex: keyboard) by machine learning.

"The Cathedral" is the second chapter of the Allison's Diary horror saga. In the sacred cathedral of Sant'Andrea there is something frightening waiting to be discovered.

The gameplay blends classic Shoot 'em up mechanics with modern low poly graphics, particles, shaders, and a hardcore soundtrack. Annihilate an army of machines, and afterward, annihilate their bosses—go all the way to confirm that your battle paid off.

name: D.C. S#*!storm

name: Dead Sparrows

name: The Wastes
short_description: Enter The Wasteland. Return to fight for survival in this fast-paced, throwback first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world full of action, violence and cars. Play/create single-player or cooperative scenarios, or play a classic array of multiplayer modes.

name: Final Assault
short_description: Final Assault is a WWII themed Action Strategy Game that capitalizes on the full power of Virtual Reality. Command massive ground battles as the skies erupt in dynamic dog fights and bombing runs. Combat requires quick thinking and fast reflexes. Fight the battle, win the war!

name: My Sweet Waifu
short_description: My Sweet Waifu is a chatbot assistant virtual dating experience and visual novel. How the way you treat Her is will drive you to deep relationship and unexpected ending. Or Maybe your choice can guide you to something multiple endings?

name: Coffee Crawl
short_description: The world has fallen asleep, and you're among the few who are still awake. Choose your class, manage your resources, craft items, collect loot, work with other survivors, and survive to see the next dawn; in this unique blend of action RPG, survival, and roguelike.

You’ll need all your brain power to find the answers you need, as you race your friends and family to the truth!

Join Detective McQueen as he puzzles his way through 9 chilling cases, risking life and pixelated limb to solve the macabre mysteries that plague the poor town.

short_description: Why War? is a 2D shooter adventure game about two soldiers from different sides who don't understand why they are fighting each other, so instead they break all the rules and team up to stop the war. Will you be able to deploy the perfect strategy to capture enemy facilities?

It is based on an original story by Catalina Leon and presented through key moments over several days. Play as Greg who must decide whether lapses in his memory are just paranoia, or something more sinister.

name: Game of Stones

The Devoters are the particular service whose primary purpose is to preserve the safety of the country and the Pastor, leader of this post-apocalyptic community.

short_description: True Roguelike. Turn-based shooter. Permadeath. Tribute to the sci-fi classics of the Golden VHS era. Successor to DRL. Just you and your gun against hordes of horrors and monstrosities. Give them hell to the rhythm of heavy metal.

name: Archibald
short_description: The great warrior Archibald challenged Glass and now his mission is to walk to the Crystal City, defeating all the vassals of the king.

name: Gripper's Adventure

name: Dongo Adventure

name: Geography Quiz

short_description: Discover the secrets of the Sea Captain's curse, investigate the rumors of a dark ritual and a trapped soul. Reverse the curse and break the ritual to free the souls of the occupants.

name: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles
short_description: Experience an immersive and horrifying episodic single-player survival horror nightmare. Trapped alone in a desolate manor and hunted by monstrous foes, you will need to scrounge for supplies, manage your resources, solve puzzles and battle the undead to survive.

short_description: Breach of Contract Reloaded is the new Multiplayer FPS Game you've been wanting! With game modes Team Deathmatch, Free-For-All, and Bomb Defuse, and 6 maps. Be prepared, it's coming.

name: Samba Shooter
