name: Galaxy Ball Defender
short_description: Defend against drones by smashing them with space balls.

name: Snowball Saves Summer
short_description: Roll and fling Snowball through 30 levels across multiple worlds to bring the kidnapped Snow Queen back to the North Pole. Each level has three Golden Snowflakes that unlock special rewards and upgrades when collected. Defeat the boss of each world, rescue the queen, and save summer!

name: Nine-Slicer
short_description: Reduce your atlas sizes! Optimize large images for your UI by creating sliced versions. Nine-sliced images can be used in various game engines, including Unity. No more labor-intensive manual slicing work in Photoshop. Spend seconds on what would take several minutes to do manually.

short_description: With FPH SpedV, you will enjoy your Trucking Simulators more! You can create virtual Trucking Companys and work up with your Friends. We offer you a tool to manage your VTC in ETS 2 and ATS. This Programm will directly link into the Games and make it easy to monitor your drive.

name: Mr. Sweet
short_description: Mr. Sweet - this is the crazy adventure of the most unusual runner in the universe! Help him and his friends to become the best of the best and beat all known and unknown records! Check your agility on the most complicated tracks in different parts of the universe!

short_description: A text only dating simulator, created using BBC Basic for Windows!

short_description: Legendary Eleven is an ​epic arcade football game inspired by the golden age of football spanning the 70's to the 90's. Choose from 36 teams full of glorious haircuts, moustaches and legends in short shorts. Lead them to glory and win the World Cup!

short_description: Game inspired by SETI. Take the role of a scientist to find an extraterrestrial signal .Control massive Radio Antennas by using interactive control in your Observatory. Detect , download and decode unknown or story telling signals. Manage and Maintain an electrical system to improve your systems and make it more efficient.

short_description: Chase your friends in this heart-racing "Tag" based game. Use a grappling hook and bouncy physics to your advantage. Features proximity voice chat.

name: SOK MIN
short_description: SOK MIN is the smallest and the easiest levels of SOK puzzle. Now you may not need a guide to complete each level. Just try it!

You will follow Dnasack's team, infiltrating the capital of the White Union to crack its military network.

name: The story of Gods 七神物语

name: Undead & Beyond
short_description: Take control of Dr. Beyond in his quest to escape the facility! Use the products of your research to create an undead army and cause havoc in the complex while you aim to accomplish your objectives to reach the next area.

short_description: Prepare to get your knowledge tested by 15 wacky characters in a 1-on-1 quiz battle format; each with their own theme and unique personality. name: Mythgard
short_description: Welcome to Mythgard, a fantasy cyberpunk CCG of heroes, gods, and mythical beasts. Master the unique lane and mana systems in your rise to the top or enjoy team play with a friend. New players can use the code WelcomeChallenger to get 20 free packs and more to start their journey.

name: 9 Balls
short_description: "9 Balls" is a miniature game of billiards. The control is made by the mouse vutton and the spacebar. Use the mouse to aim and change the force of the impact and the spacebar to strike the cue on the ball.

name: My Car

name: Silverworld
short_description: In a world of trackless jungles, colossal beasts, and cruel pre-human civilizations, you must survive the past if you want to save the future! Face the savage inhabitants of Silverworld and build your own civilization—or plunder the past and return home unimaginably rich!

name: Quible Sphere

name: Mushroom Heroes
short_description: A puzzle platform adventure, with inspiration going all the way back to SNES and 8-bit classics. The game is inspired from ‘90s classics like Lost Vikings.

name: The Gauntlet
short_description: In The Gauntlet, you'll need to move fast and control your every move. Various obstacles stand in your way, and it's up to you to find the best way to get through them, taking advantage of your moves and your unique weapon that lets you freeze objects in place.

Go on a death riddled journey to sprawling alien environments and fight your way through hordes of enemies and epic boss battles. Take part in the revived Planetary Survey Program and help the Space Faction find a new home for humanity.

name: Good Boy!
short_description: The game "Good boy" is an arcade game. Your character is the dog "good boy". The objective of the game is to get to the owner what she has lost. A good boy will face complex obstacles: garbage cans, fire hydrants, lasers, smart missiles and much more.

name: Dictator's dreams
short_description: What dream does your dictator see?

name: Furious Drivers
short_description: Dynamic “car combat” game, where you destroy other players by cars using a variety of weapons.

name: Virtual Foosball
short_description: Virtual Foosball is a funny foosball simulation for Windows. It includes a singleplayer and a multiplayer modus. You can design you own foosballtable layouts and play on different difficulty levels.

name: ANOIX
short_description: In ANOIX you travel through 84 levels trying to protect the ball. Don't let the soundtrack hypnotize you.

name: Fortune-499
short_description: There is no future in the future.

name: Geometry Boxer
short_description: Beat the shapes outta your enemies using special powers, melee weapons, or the old fashioned fisticuffs way - solo or cooperatively - in this physics based, geometric, mob fighter.

name: Setup Developer Tool 2018

name: Qvabllock
short_description: «Qvabllock» — pixemalism game with elements of puzzle, with minimalistic gameplay. Collect all the colored squares to take the main green and go through all 30 levels.

name: Trivia Vault: Tennis Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Tennis Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer tennis trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

short_description: Enter the VRMMO world of the much-loved anime SWORD ART ONLINE! In Alfheim Online, a world of fairies and magic, you become the hero of the series, Kirito, and together with your wondrous friends try to conquer the floating land of Svart Alfheim.

name: The Sandbox of God: Remastered Edition

name: The Firlyn Stones *No More Updates*

name: Outlaws of the Old West
short_description: Outlaws of the Old West is a massively multiplayer survival MMO with a huge world, thousands of items and a modular building system. Survive the wild, build your own homestead, defeat villainous bandits and work with others to tame the Wild West.

name: Data Ball
short_description: In a distant corner of the universe exists an ancient supercomputer plagued by malfunctioning circuits and corrupted data. Take control of one of its spherical maintenance drones and command a range of abilities as you progress through ever-more challenging levels.

name: Ready or Not [archive]
short_description: Ready or Not is an intense, tactical, first-person shooter that depicts a modern-day world in which SWAT police units are called to defuse hostile and confronting situations.

name: Noonie
short_description: Noonie is a rogue-like action game where you navigate through randomly generated mazes while avoiding traps and enemies. Use problem solving skills to push the environment around in your favor. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

name: Colosso Crystal Skulls
short_description: Classic style 3D 1st person shooter by Campana Productions. Making games for twenty years and more. Colosso Crystal Skulls is the latest game in the Colosso Adventure series. Don't miss out on the action and the adventure. Nothing is better than a classic style game.

name: I Pay No Rent
short_description: Don't let your landlord overpower you with her incredible throwing power, dodge or block those shoes, bottles, and... wait what? bombs?... Try to block, or dodge all the 'things' your landlord ruthlessly thrown at you!

name: Camped Out!
short_description: Camped Out is a frenetic couch co-op game for friends and families where up to four players work together to set up camp before darkness falls.

name: Rocket Rush
short_description: Try, Die, Repeat. In this minimalistic hard platformer you will attempt to traverse a seemingly endless world filled with traps, fire and a bunch of other doo-dads designed and positioned specifically to upset you. Sounds fun, right?

name: Save her, from dreams
short_description: Enter the dream, save the one you love.

name: Asimov Laws
short_description: Asimov Laws is a brutal rouge lite survival game, set in the depressing Robopocalypse world. Survive the harsh condition in the 12 cities, Crush the robotic butlers, scavenge and survive, plan your days and route, grow stronger through genetic transition and head for the Ark.

name: Bing Bong XL
short_description: Bing Bong XL is a fast-paced, minimalist arcade score chaser with simple one-button controls. Dodge obstacles, collect points, and survive as long as possible in this addictive ‘just-one-more-round’ challenge. Perfect for quick sessions or while waiting in queue for another game!

name: Spirits of Metropolis: Legacy Edition
short_description: Blast gems under a starry sky in this unique take on the match-3 genre.

name: Exoder
short_description: Exoder is a frantic, fast paced, 2D, action platformer that will test your skills of reflex, resilience, patience and determination.

name: Jack and Sara: Educational game

name: Knockdown the Ball
short_description: Guide the ball and complete the levels

name: HOLY COW! Milking Simulator
short_description: Ever tried milking yourself while avoiding lawnmowers, butcher knives and sharks at the same time? Beat hundreds of levels and thousand of enemy waves in the endless journey to fill up the milk tank!

name: Wheelchair Simulator VR
short_description: Wheelchair Simulator VR is a comedic game about a serious issue. Try to traverse the city by pushing the wheels with your hands and learn the story of a person who does that every day.

name: Square Head Zombies 2 - FPS Game
short_description: New zombies need to be defeated in Square Head Zombies 2. Go to new places, find and destroy them all.

name: Honey, I Joined a Cult
short_description: It's time to start working towards that ultimate goal of enlightenment, faith and money…lots and lots of money! Become the ultimate tycoon - create, customise, and manage your own cult whilst listening to funky music. Welcome to Honey, I Joined a Cult!

name: Intelligence
short_description: Intelligence - a puzzle game in which you want to build the image so that the picture was like the original image. Move the puzzle tiles wisely to collect the correct order of the pieces of images

short_description: in this game, the player is a hacker, get the command, to return to the headquarters to perform the task, nowwe must separate from our present friends, what's going to be interesting on the way?

name: Final Match
short_description: Final Match is a simple card game, easy to learn, challenging and fast matches.

name: Trap welcome to Beryl Part 1
short_description: After receiving a disturbing letter from his brother, our protagonist decides to go looking for him at the hotel Beryl. He will soon discover the strangeness of the places, the objects, the paintings, the shadows and the terrifying models moving, speaking, living of their own will.

name: Windfall
short_description: Learn how to sail in virtual reality! Windfall is a realistic, physics based, sailing simulator aimed at newbie and expert sailor alike. Are you far from the sea or stuck at home during storms? Instead, enjoy sailing in any condition you'd like, any time!

name: Together
short_description: Can you survive being in a relationship? Together is a game about being with someone. Someone who is kind. Someone who makes you happy. Someone whose mental state requires a lot of your time and energy. Someone who you care about.

name: Whitevale Defender
short_description: Whitevale Defender is a 2D replayable tower defense. You'll be defending the castle of Whitevale over and over against hordes of war machines. Each play through you will be advancing your defensive and economic arsenal while also honing your tower placements until you can save Whitevale for good.

name: The Bomb Project
short_description: Bombs come falling from the sky, destroying the terrain around you. Face the chaos with the help of one of five agents and their special abilities. You must survive the bullet hell alone, or together with a friend's help... or nuisance.

name: Fightttris VR
short_description: Be fast, be smart, have fun. Fresh breath in classic puzzle. Battle with your friend or random opponent. Your aim is to be faster and smarter, to grab blocks and build lines, to find and activate bonuses. The slowest always lose.

name: NALOGI 2
short_description: NALOGI 2 - new satirical game in the genre of RPG. The emperor became emperor after the election. Again. For eternity. PAY TAXES!

name: ShellBlast: Legacy Edition
short_description: Described as a cross between Minesweeper and Picross, ShellBlast is an action packed puzzler where you travel the globe to defuse bombs before they explode.

name: greenTech+ Legacy Edition
short_description: Lead clouds of pollution into the cleansing centers, but be careful not to destroy the world by accident.

name: Sheep Game
short_description: Sheep Game is a couch based multiplayer game best played with two or more people. Go grab your friends and challenge them to some fast and frenzied sheep herding.

name: Realmstone
short_description: Action RPG inspired by games like Moonstone, Golden Axe, Magic: the Gathering and Master of Magic. Realmstone revolves around loot and levels, capturing cities, ridding the countryside of monsters and killing other players.

name: Aura of Worlds
short_description: Aura of Worlds is a chaotic, creative tactics rogue-lite platformer. Explore multiple dangerous worlds where you utilize creative abilities & wield the environment to your advantage. Blast, dash, grapple, fight, and charm your way through ever-changing labyrinths & outwit powerful guardians!

name: The Treehouse Man
short_description: A horrible corruption has forced the children of the forest into hiding. They confide in the Treehouse Man, but their prayers remain unanswered. Baptized into the group, you must take the hallowed boat on an odyssey to save your brothers and sisters before the silence kills them.

name: Siralim 3
short_description: Siralim 3 is a mechanically deep, monster taming RPG. Summon and customize over 700 different creatures to fight for you as you battle your way through randomly generated dungeons. Find rare treasure and use it to craft new items, empower your creatures, learn new spells, and much more.

name: Adventures in the Light & Dark
short_description: Adventures in the Light & Dark is a short novel that you read in VR, surrounded by atmospheric sound and scenery.

name: Super Heroes: Men in VR beta
short_description: Attacking enemies, using all kinds of skills to save human beings. such as Laser, magic ,gun, missile ,curse, bomb, bow .Be a HERO. You can move freely using HTC Vive (if you have enough space) and teleport yourself. Huge battle scenes, advanced game level design.

name: Semi-Sweet Tofu
short_description: Semi-Sweet Tofu is a 2D side scrolling platformer game where players have to eat fruit to survive along with using the color you change while eating the fruit to defeat the enemies you are faced with. Eat your way to solving unique color based puzzles while avoiding hazards like fire, piranhas, and more!

name: Guardian of Immortal Mountain(仙山守卫者)

name: Avalon Legends Solitaire 3
short_description: Join forces with the Elves to protect the wilds of Avalon!

name: Der Milchbauer
short_description: The dairy farmer is a simulation application that enables users to take responsibility for a farm in a playful way. The user is required to economize, feed the cows, purchase and sell them, manage milk production and more to keep the farm going until the user’s retirement.

name: FantasyDynasty: Le château DERETIC
short_description: C'est la panique au château , une armée de démon a débarquer a l’intérieur , vous êtes leur dernière chance de les repousser . Incarner un héros pour sauver le château et les habitants qui y demeurent . Gérer votre barre de vie restera votre problème principale .

name: Rabbit Valley Legend (兔子山谷传说)
short_description: A cute action VR game of snowball.

name: Daymare: 1998
short_description: DAYMARE: 1998 is a third-person survival horror game that recreates the mood of iconic titles from the '90s, with a fresh storyline. An incident that turns a small town into a deadly zone, three characters to play with and little time to find the truth, before its mutated citizens abruptly end your mission.

name: Arca's Path VR
short_description: Trapped in the enchanting simulated world of Arca, it is up to you to find a path through the labyrinth and break free.

name: Achievement Smiles
short_description: Sunny smile, is cheerful, charming, modest and sweet, but cunning foes do not give him rest. Again and again you have to pacify villains, saving from the conclusion of nice birds. You are waited by the sea of adventures and good mood. Contains easy 2500 achievements!

name: Kitten'd
short_description: Take care of cute kittens - lots and lots of cute kittens! Get points for keeping them happy and lose points for everything they destroy. Use points to upgrade your tools. Or just hang out and play with lots of cute kittens in the more relaxed sandbox mode.

name: Wild West Saga: Idle Tycoon Clicker
short_description: Wild West Saga is an idle game where you click to make money and build a business fortune! Hundreds of Towns to explore and Patent Cards to collect, dozens of Businesses to upgrade and Outlaws to hire. The end goal? To become the richest Pioneer in the Wild West! So, are you up for it?

name: Hyperspace Dogfights
short_description: Hyperspace Dogfights is a juicy jet-combat roguelite in which you blast, dodge and slice your way through masses of technologically inferior baddies. Your jet evolves differently on each run and becomes stronger and weirder by gathering some of the 300+ available items.

name: Prison Simulator
short_description: Get a taste of prison life! Become a prison guard and deal with dangerous convicts. Prison management, lots of daily activities. Will you become the best guard in history? Or maybe you'll turn into the worst scumbag this Prison has ever seen?

name: 江湖侠客行
short_description: 江湖侠客行是一款讲究见招拆招的武侠卡牌单机游戏，简单易上手，但要想通关却需要多多动脑，在游戏中，玩家将扮演一名初出茅庐的门派弟子，参与到江湖的各种事件中.

name: GM Forge - Virtual Tabletop
short_description: GM Forge is a Standalone Virtual Tabletop with competitive features, making it a good affordable alternative. When you buy a copy of GM Forge, your friends join you through their web browser without purchasing a copy.

name: Formula X
short_description: 3D racing game with battle elements, top-down camera style similar to genesis (mega drive) titles and super nintendo, lots of speed action in a frantic race!

name: ArcBall 2
short_description: ArcBall 2 - second part of "ArcBall" arcanoid game.This is simple and casual arcanoid-like game. Interesting levels and nice retro-graphics are waiting you!

name: Escape Code - Coding Adventure
short_description: Escape Code puts coding, technology and artificial intelligence into a fun but challenging environment. If you like escape rooms, this is the game for you.

name: A Walk in the Woods
short_description: A Walk in the Woods is a co-op multiplayer game where four players must roam a dark and dangerous forest in search of each other, avoid a terrifying creature, and reunite before the curse is complete.

name: Star Girls
short_description: Star girls is a dating sim with a bullet hell combat system and light RPG elements in it. The story is character driven with many different endings depending on your choices. You only have 60 days to make a Star girl fall in love with you or become cursed forever.

name: Cranes
short_description: Cranes is a 3D physics-puzzle game where you need to use cranes to move boxes to specific locations.

name: Kickshot
short_description: Kickshot is a first-person speedrunning game in which you utilize your tools, environment and movement abilities to complete the course as quickly as possible.

name: Survival Maze
short_description: Survival and exploration, where the player will have to find a way out of maze. Hero's vitality is limited, and on the way there are heterogeneous obstacles. To survive, you have to craft items from natural resources at hand, as well as plan your movements.

short_description: NeonVoid Runner is a infinite runner in which the player will test their reaction time in a fast virtual reality race placed in a futurist synthwave neon world.

name: Police Patrol
short_description: In Police Patrol your mission is to bust the bad guys fleeing away. You must be fast and furious while using your driving skills to catch up the criminal within a small time.

name: War Hunter
short_description: War Hunter is a first person shooter where you take control of the special agents and must fight your way through a cold and mean scenery and find the arms dealer Talib.

name: Knight Fighter
short_description: Knight Fighters is a 2D side-scroll platormer with fighting action. The Ancient Knight can attack with sword strikes, punches, kicks and even chain combos, both at the ground or the air. He can also jump to avoid obstacles. Be prepared!

name: Funny Yo
short_description: In this brilliant 2D side-scrolling platformer, you have to jump on the heads of enemies to render them harmless

name: Deadly Tropics
short_description: Zombie apocalypse on a tropical island. Deadly Tropics is a third person shooter with stealth elements. Kill as many zombies as you can and get out from the island.

name: MiniState
short_description: Wage war, trade, and build alliances to build the greatest nation the world will ever know.

name: Galaxy Champions TV
short_description: Galaxy Champions TV is a super intense top-down closed arena shooter game inspired by the classic arcade game Smash TV. Get powerful weapons and power-ups, kill huge amounts of enemies, level up, unlock upgrades and beat all the bosses to become the champion of the most violent TV show of all time!

name: Highscore Processing Unit
short_description: Highscore Processing Unit is here to revive this old time feeling of arcade games. Play fast, break your highscore, break all the highscores, and take the glory! From the ashes of the outmoded breakout genre, rises an entirely revamped gameplay. Feel free to insert a coin and take your chance...

name: Deadfall Tropics
short_description: Play as smuggler Hank Hudson in this 2D action platformer as he defies death at every turn to find his way off a deadly tropical island...

name: NavalArt
short_description: Design your own warships, equip them with a variety of armament, and bring them out to the ocean!

name: Märchen Forest: Mylne and the Forest Gift [Legacy ver.]
short_description: Freely roam a fully 3D-rendered mystical forest together with Mylne, a young girl employed at a magical apothecary shop!

name: Newt One
short_description: A nonviolent musical 3D Platformer The land of Groovy Hue was once bursting with music and color until the Great Slumber. Take control of Newt, a new tone in this musical land. Awakening this sleeping, silent world is Newt's rite of passage. Restore music, life, and color to the your world!

name: Lords of Strife
short_description: A rage platformer with intrigue, dark humor, and tragedy

name: The MISSING: J.J. Macfield and the Island of Memories
short_description: J.J. scours Memoria Island to find her best friend, who has gone missing during a camping trip. In order to save her best friend, she puts her own body and life on the line, reviving infinitely, as she presses forward. Why did she go missing? What is going on in this world?

name: Dungeon Crusher: Soul Hunters
short_description: A social multiplayer incremental idle rpg with clans, PvP arenas, a wonderful 3d fantasy world with a story/missions and much more.

name: Orb Labs, Inc.
short_description: In this room-scale VR action-puzzle stealth game, infiltrate a mysterious company's secret underground lab protected by deadly laser systems. Throw "orbs" to move, hide, defend, attack and survive!

name: Hipster Cafe
short_description: Ever wanted to design, build and manage a café on your very own home computer? Really? OK then... welcome to HIPSTER CAFÉ. Make stupid food, serve it on a skateboard, and impress your friends by drawing in your coffee.

short_description: RECOG The Game is truly challenging and strategically entertaining. Build and defend your industry from an enemy who knows you more than you know yourself. Plan each step wisely, for all decisions you make directly impact what’s to come. Be prepared, for you are now entering THE RECOG!

short_description: This VR ARPG makes you take up arms and choose your hero, class and your own build as you fight off hordes and titanic bosses and offers you infinite gameplay and endless customization. Upgrade your spells, buy armor and weapons, build your army and increase your hero stats to stop the underworld.

name: Joyo Kanji Quiz
short_description: Learn Japanese with a quiz that helps you review all Japanese characters that kids must learn when they go to school. From 1st grade all the way to secondary school, you can learn all 2,136 Joyo Kanji, their meanings and pronunciations.

name: The Lift
short_description: Max is a boorish teenager. The lack of money forces him to deliver pizza. One day the lift with him is stuck between the floors. Max falls into a trap and becomes a hostage of his past and future. To get to the next floor he must find a button from the panel in the lift

name: ILLUSION

name: Clan O'Conall and the Crown of the Stag
short_description: Master the powers of three Celtic Heroes in this hand-drawn action platformer! Solve challenging puzzles, slay unworldly demons, and cross beautiful landscapes by swapping instantly between characters. With an all-original Celtic soundtrack. You've never heard of it, so it must be mythical!

name: Z: Escape
short_description: Z: Escape is a dark themed runner-shooter platformer game. Z-87 awakens with no memory of who he was, or what he is. Destroying the bio pod in which he was trapped, Z notices the laboratory equipment all around the room. Something horrific has been done to him in this laboratory space station.

name: Alien Hominid Invasion
short_description: Old friends and bitter enemies await as you invade Earth alongside a Mothership full of alien friends! Blast, beam, and bite your way through an endless swarm of enemies as you and up to three of your fellow hominids cause mayhem with a huge arsenal of weapons, mutations, and acrobatic maneuvers.

name: Album Corvus
short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler/roguelike. Fight one-on-one in turn-based combat. Find gear that improves or completely changes your tactics. Delve procedurally generated dungeons where choices matter. Die, upgrade your characters, unlock new skills and experiment with perks to find the best build.

name: The Last DeadEnd
short_description: The Last DeadEnd is a game with elements of an adventure, shooter and horror. There is a mysterious atmosphere of a real old city, where the protagonist seeks answers to his questions and fights against the forces of evil.

name: The Bard's Tale Trilogy
short_description: The Bard's Tale Trilogy is a complete remaster of the iconic series that helped define the RPG genre. Featuring updated graphics and optional quality of life gameplay features, this is the ideal way to experience the dungeon crawling challenge that made the original games beloved classics.

name: Flapping Over It
short_description: You will not pass this game, as the failure will always haunt you.

name: Hive Quest
short_description: Guide your insect tribe on an unusual journey through a mythical woodland filled with ancient magic, strange creatures & hidden mysteries. Uncover the secrets of the Old Orchard, find and train your very own woodland sprite and lead your Hive to victory!

name: Reckless Driver
short_description: Forget about bustling traffic as you race your way through the streets of Seaview in Reckless Driver!

name: Rift Keeper

Turn right, collect points, and return them to the goal zone while dodging obstacles. An addictive ‘just-one-more-round’ challenge, perfect for quick sessions or while waiting in queue!

name: Pivot XL

name: GhostGame

name: WEscape
short_description: In WEscape, a group of up to four friends put their minds together to solve puzzles and escape dungeons. Test your communication and reasoning skills while having fun with your friends. It’s the essential experience of an escape room without the expense or hassle of actually going to one.

name: Rogue Agent
short_description: Rogue Agent is a turn-based strategy game, fast-paced, that pits the player against the computer on a secret service thriller around the world.

name: El Taco Diablo
short_description: Hardcore Competitive Stand-still Arena FPS. It’s all about your accuracy and speed, there is no hand-holding. Compete on a global leaderboard and earn the #1 spot by killing endless waves of demonic Tacos and UFO’s. Discover a game that looks simple on the surface but hides a surprising amount of depth.

name: Déjà Vu

For some reason, you have to take an adventure in an unfamiliar environment, facing dissimilated monsters beyond imagination. Through fighting, you will learn the secret behind this land.

name: HellStar Squadron

Then, before his eyes… a girl appears. In the silver-haired girl’s hand, a long sword that seems otherworldly.

name: City Builder
short_description: You're a government worker who is building a city one building at a time. Place parts of your building to build the tallest building ever created in this fun filled endless stacker!

name: HUMAN LIVE-HOW LONG CAN HUMAN BEINGS EXIST?人类能生存多久？挑战各种灾难，地球世界末日，冒险策略模拟经营游戏
short_description: How long can human beings live on Earth? Will the human being be destroyed when disaster strikes? A game from the future. Challenge more than 50 kinds of disasters that will destroy humanity in the future. Victims or survivors, destroy the world or save humanity?

name: A Perfect Day
short_description: Revisit and repeat the final moments of China's turn of the century in this narrative puzzle adventure. Play a 6th-grade student and greet classmates, explore secrets, play mini-4WD, or just wander around town. Make your choices to create a perfect day for everyone!

name: TheShooterGame
short_description: GamePlay: Survive as long as possible in the town filled with bad guys. Find guns and ammo in town.

name: Space Orb
short_description: The player controls the orb and has to navigate the different levels with a special gravity system. The levels gradually gets harder and as the player progresses more objects and obstacles is introduced to the player. The objective of the game is to collect space energy.

name: Cortex Protocol
short_description: Cortex protocol is a puzzle oriented VR game, where you have to clear interesting mazes shaped like Rubik’s Cubes. Learn to think outside of the box by rotating the maze in order to find the exit while avoiding deadly traps and solving puzzles. All in the name of science!

name: When They Arrived
short_description: Alan went hunting in his grandfather's country house. There was an invasion of the aliens. Cities are destroyed. You need to use survival skills and ingenuity to survive and save the planet. Build, explode, explore the world, develop your skills, try all ways to stop the aliens invasion."What would I do after the alien invasion?

name: Card Games Mega Collection
short_description: Features 150+ card game variations, including casino and family style games, plus 5 bonus games for kids.

name: WIN THE GAME: DO IT!
short_description: WIN THE GAME: DO IT! - is a hardcore game. Try to finish the game without spending your nerves.

name: Demon's Rise - War for the Deep
short_description: A turn-based, tactical RPG with 30 character classes and 50+ hours of gameplay.

name: Hungry Piggy vs Chicken
short_description: Hungry piggy vs Chicken: Yes! We are Hungry! We all love the delicious eggs! Hungry piggy vs Chicken features hours of gameplay, challenging puzzles, and lots of replay value. Each level requires logic and skill to resolve.

name: Vortex Rush
short_description: Pit yourself against the clock as you weave through the vortex avoiding obstacles and going as far as possible before your time expires. Vortex rush challenges you to go as fast as possible and stay alive doing it.

name: Bullet Hell ADVANCED
short_description: Early Access Game. An overarching turn based universal / solar system game featuring fleet to fleet combat engagements that also allow players to pilot a superfighter to inflict extra damage and call in fire missions on enemy ships. Roguelite dungeon crawler and 4 player multiplayer to be developed.

name: G.A.M.E.S
short_description: 4 Games. One Collection. One Deal Not to be Missed. G.A.M.E.S includes 4 indie games, 3 of them brand new to Steam and 1 of them, a classic pastime from a bygone era. You are hustler? No?! Well you are now!

name: Codename Ghost Hunt
short_description: Ghost Hunt is a Turn based PVP Action Strategy game, where player compete to prove the supremacy on the battlefield through Educated decisions they make.

name: RUSH
short_description: Are you ready for the ultimate thrill ride? Take a dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of wingsuit flying with RUSH! Soar down mountainsides at breakneck speeds. Weave through canyons, dodge outcrops, and plummet down sheer drops as you race towards the finish line.

name: Desert Child
short_description: You are a hungry, young hoverbike racer who needs to get off Earth before it E-X-P-L-O-D-E-S. Hunt bounties, throw races, and do whatever you can to get to Mars and win the Grand Prix.

name: Reality Blender
short_description: RealityBlender allows you to see your surroundings on a 2D overlay inside your VR headset! Use camera feeds and Chroma key to blend your surrounding environment into VR to create a mixed reality allowing you to enjoy the best of both worlds.

name: Piano Simulator
short_description: The Piano Simulator

name: Future Proof
short_description: Quirky, top-down puzzle adventure game. You’re trapped in a 12-minute time loop. Try to save yourself and a small town from destruction from a meteorite. Solve intuitive puzzles, interact with the people of the town, and discover the secrets of the town. Discover the 15 different endings!

name: Trivia Vault: Soccer Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Soccer Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer soccer trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value

name: Chocolate makes you happy 5
short_description: Casual colorful physical puzzle with sweets, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, reverse gravity, traps and explosions

name: Slab
short_description: Slab is an arcade game in which the main task is destroy slabs and bricks. The player controls a horizontally moving paddle to ricochet the ball against the slabs and destroy them. Slab has a very precision paddle! If you like classic childhood games, check it out!

name: Titty Crush
short_description: Titty Crush is a lighthearted Match 3 game with cute anime characters which doesn't take itself too serious.Meet the girls while experiencing the story or hunt for new highscores in the arcade modeand unlock some new outfits for our girls for future dates ;)

name: GameMaster: MAGUS
short_description: GameMaster: Magus is a unique RPG simulation, bringing you the ultimate role to play in RPG games: The Game Master

name: Rustler (Grand Theft Horse)
short_description: Become a medieval thug in a crazy open-world action game, full of pop-culture references. Complete insane quests, kill heroes, steal horses, fight guards, rob peasants, listen to some bard music, and much more! All packed in old-school gameplay style!

name: The Goatman
short_description: The Goatman is an Online CO-OP hunting game. It all began on February 23, 2019 with a call for help from the Greenfield village. It was alleged that a mysterious creature like a half goat and half demon attacked people and animals. Upon this call, a military research team set out.

name: Obscurity
short_description: Welcome to a dark but warm world! Obscurity is a small 2D game where the objective will be to deliver your little creature!

name: Cave Digger VR
short_description: Cave Digger VR is a virtual reality mining game in an alternative western setting. Gear up with numerous unique tools and explore the town and the depths of the mountain. Discover secrets, easter eggs and multiple endings!

name: Deadly Flare
short_description: A solar flare has struck and every living soul is turning into a rotting and aggressive ghoul.

name: Demon's Rise - Lords of Chaos
short_description: Turn-based, tactical RPG where players command a powerful band of warriors.

name: Sagittarius
short_description: Sagittarius is a classic side scrolling space shoot'em up in a modern take. In this epic space game it's up to you to save our solar system from destruction. Fly alone or with a friend in a local multiplayer co-op game.

name: The Indie Game Legend 3D
short_description: Blast vicious aliens, explore their mysterious labyrinth, and rescue indie game makers in this lighthearted NES inspired first-person action adventure!

name: Rhombus Legends
short_description: A unique spatial battle system for card games. Unite with friends for clan wars, explore the dungeons and search world map for Bosses. Magical power awaits you!

name: Draw a Stickman: EPIC 3
short_description: Your creativity will be maximized in the all-new Draw a Stickman: EPIC 3! Embark upon an exhilarating new adventure to defeat the Corruption: solve fun puzzles, outsmart crafty monsters, and discover an all-new world! So grab your freshly penciled Hero—it’s time to be EPIC!

name: RECOIL
short_description: This is a 2D shooting game. As the score increases, the difficulty becomes more and more difficult. Different enemies will have different attack methods. If you want to survive longer, keep moving and shoot.

name: The Worst Day Ever
short_description: Shoot dozens of clever weapons, avoid hundreds of enemy shells and explore the mysterious corners of a corporation dominated by demonic powers in this arcade Bullet Hell shooter. Will you manage to break through multiple levels of the dark office building and regain your freedom? Find out now!

name: Jungle Juggle
short_description: The mission has been assigned! Your strategy skills are required to open the way and protect the truck to safe passage! Fight your way out of jungle, desert, mountains, rain and blazing wind to reach the last resistance of the evil dictator!

name: Hypnospace Outlaw
short_description: Greetings Enforcer, and thank you for enlisting in the Hypnospace Patrol Department! As the world falls into its slumber, Hypnospace becomes a bustling global village. These virtual streets aren't going to police themselves!

name: Hentai PuZZles
short_description: This is a puzzle game in which you need to collect anime puzzle pictures

name: Odyssee
short_description: A old-fashion adventure through galaxies and times. Help Ody to find of all his robot-girlfriend's pieces among 16bit levels, solving platformer-style levels, with challenging enigmas and hard-core enemies.

name: Heart of the Woods
short_description: A fantasy yuri visual novel filled with magic, fairies, and a ghost girl. When Maddie and her best friend, Tara, journey to a remote forest village to investigate rumors of the supernatural, they find a whole lot more than they bargained for.

name: Please Be Happy
short_description: A comfy yuri VN about the foxgirl Miho and her quest to find the person who's most important to her. This emotional visual novel features two different heroines to choose from, and a story that will make you both laugh and cry!

name: SCARF
short_description: Strut your stuff in this procedurally generated rougelike fashion simulator. Craft clothing, win pieces from your rivals and challenge the best in the end-of season fashon showdown. Do you have what it takes to make the best lineup?

name: Go-Kart Racing
short_description: Go-Kart Racing provides racers with a thrilling go-kart experience. Compete against drivers out on the race track to prove that you are the fastest!

name: The Armclaw Experiment
short_description: Use your arm hooks to swing around a procedurally generated city in VR!

name: Gemstone Guardians
short_description: Gemstone Guardians is a tower defense game where selection and combinations are key. Similar to a game of poker, players are given a set of random towers each round and must make the best combinations to prevent the waves of enemies from reaching the end.

name: Ocean Wonder VR
short_description: Ocean Wonder VR is a Simulation VR Game. Collect different fish species and save the ocean from contamination. Make friends with mermaids and mysterious creatures in your undersea journey!

name: Tower Hunter: Erza's Trial
short_description: Tower Hunter: Erza’s Trial contains core elements of roguelite games, presented in a toon render style. The player explores a mysterious tower with Erza, vanquishes mutant monsters and defeats bosses to acquire a Hunter’s License and become the most powerful Battle Maiden.

name: Tank Operations: European Campaign
short_description: Tank Operation: European Campaign - is a turn-based, tactical war game with a dozen nerve-racking historical scenarios on the various battlefields of World War II. As an allied general you fight right on the frontline to defeat the Third Reich with all its destructive potential.

name: KurtzPel
short_description: "KurtzPel is an anime-styled, action battle game from a third-person perspective. Players can battle it out in both PvP and PvE mission-based battle modes with massive boss monsters. Players utilize Karmas (the method used to indicate weapon and class types) when charging into battle. Each character gets to use two types of Karmas.

name: VR-X Player Steam Edition
short_description: Welcome to the next generation of gaming: Download the free MAGIX VR-X PLAYER - Steam Edition and experience VR in a whole new and impressive way!

name: Director of Football
short_description: Football Director is a tough job. Team motivation, training, squad selection ¬ these are just a few of the things that have a direct effect on the result of the match. But the Director of Football does all this plus: take charge of sponsorship, stadium, balance sheets and making sure the team performs in the league.

name: The Flying Farm
short_description: Epic Journey to the moon, rescue the Baby Starling! Travel the world and help Barney the farmer to bring back the baby star to his parents in this captivating time management game. This won't be easy, as you'll travel in the sky, in the ocean or on a blazing hot volcano before reaching the Moon!

name: Fortissimo FA
short_description: 這是一款日本遊戲公司La'cryma製作的以“淚水”為主題的校園戀愛Galgame，表面是融合了“萌”和“燃”要素的青春愛情+熱血戰鬥的美少女遊戲，實際是催淚催奶帶五險一金的里番，更令人震精的是你玩到最後會發現更大的黑幕：神OP+神主題曲+神級BGM讓你燃到爆，音樂才是本體！

name: Fox Hime Zero
short_description: Yan, a student of natural history, encounters a cute and mysterious girl with fox ears while conducting routine scientific research at a remote observation cabin. This might be a "blessing" for the intrepid in the golden age of geographical discovery...

name: Have a N.I.C.E day!
short_description: Action racing game with 3 different car leagues. Easy gameplay: The more races you win, the more money you earn. Equip your car with new weapons and extras and start your battle.

name: Eternal Fantasy
short_description: Eternal Fantasy is a galgame with RPG elements. You'll embark on a journey, a journey so wonderful with all the girls and laughter, that you may almost forget what's lurking behind. It is developed by CIRCUS, which was also the developer of the 「D. C.」 series, and proudly presented by SakuraGame.

name: Pro 11 - Football Manager Game
short_description: Become the best football manager. Join Pro 11 and claim the championship!

name: Cowboy : Attack of Wild Animal
short_description: Cowboy : Attack of Wild animals is a third-person shooter to avoid wild animals attacking the owner. You can avoid a dangerous moment by rushing or get over a crisis by hunting animals with a gun. Do not stop and keep moving! Then you will survive in the wild.

name: I Am Your President
short_description: Play as a fictional US president in this satirical narrative strategy! Lead Democrats or Republicans to make America great again. Again.

name: Drone Striker
short_description: An all new futuristic VR shooting game! Classic arcade shooting recreated in VR! A dire apocalyptic world! Surrounded by mecha insectoids! You take the role of Chris, a member of the special unit force called the Drone Strikers who needs to use his combat abilities to save what is left of humanity.

name: Evergate
short_description: Evergate is a haunting 2D puzzle-platformer set in a stunning hand-drawn vision of the Afterlife with an original score recorded by a live orchestra. Navigate 85 challenging stages and unleash the extraordinary powers of the genre-defining 'Soulflame' to help a lost soul reincarnate on earth!

name: Aegis Legends
short_description: Aegis Legends is a PVE competitive tower defence game crossed with an action shooter. Play alone or with up to 3 others to achieve the highest survival mode scores or play one of the ever growing list of competitive mini games!

name: Last Regiment
short_description: Engage in epic simultaneous turn-based combat in this fusion of cards and turn-based strategy. Assemble your regiment, claim your territory, and lead your forces to triumph!

name: The Awesome Adventures of Captain Spirit
short_description: Have you ever dreamt of being a superhero? Meet Chris, a creative and imaginative 9 year old boy who escapes reality with fantastical adventures as his alter ego, the Awesome Captain Spirit! Captain Spirit is a free demo set in the Life is Strange universe. Contains links to Life is Strange 2

name: Power Tower
short_description: The Adventures of Dumpy is a 2D adventure platformer that takes you through fun and exciting worlds. Take control of your own character and complete challenges, unlock achievements, save an alien race from certain doom and meet the cyber love of your life.

name: Snakelike
short_description: Snakelike melds the simple mechanics of Snake with the depth and replayability of a Roguelike to create a unique strategic turn-based experience that’s easy to pick up, but tricky to master.

name: Vietnam War PuZZles
short_description: This is a logical game in which you need to collect puzzles on the Vietnamese theme. Be careful, do not catch flashback

name: PolyCity Stories - The Affair
short_description: The first short story from PolyCity. A point and click adventure delving into the dark and dirty polygonated corners of the City of angles... mostly right angles. The Affair follows a soft boiled/over easy private detective as he unpicks an organised crime syndicate operating across the city.

name: Block Smashers VR
short_description: Block Smashers is physics based VR puzzle game where you throw balls at structures to collect crystals. You collect crystals by either hitting them directly or taking out the supports holding them up. The goal is to get all the crystals on each level with as few throws as possible.

name: ❂ Hexaluga ❂ Weapon and Shield ☯
short_description: Help the Weapon of War get over all the obstacles and return to its master, the Father of War. How long will it take you?

name: Sim Racing Telemetry
short_description: Sim Racing Telemetry is the essential tool for the sim racing eSports community to quickly acquire, analyze and review detailed telemetry data from sim racing games.

name: Super Cubiform
short_description: As a Guildship Captain you must rely on your wits and a computer repair program to survive! Super Cubiform is a sandwich of genres, Arena Action Platformer + First Person Adventure! Enjoy arena-based platforming action as the Cubiform, and an urgent mystery as the Guildship Captain...

name: Fish Tycoon 2: Virtual Aquarium
short_description: Greetings Tycoons! Your favorite mobile game is now available on Windows & Mac! Are you as excited as we are? Happy Fishing!

name: Mirror Drop
short_description: An overwhelmingly psychedelic puzzle game full of mirrors, over-saturated colors, and infinities.

name: Destructions
short_description: Destructions – the game which gives an opportunity of complete damage at the levels which were created with an idea of destruction.

name: Sign Here: _________
short_description: $1,000,000, all just one signature away. Your job is simple; sign the contract. A job much easier said than done.

name: Color Path
short_description: Color Path is a minimal, logic puzzle game

name: As If Dreaming When You're Wide Awake
short_description: As If is a narrative game portraying issues revolving around mental health. Experience the life of Matthew as he struggles to reach his dreams and wishes. Step into his shoes. Look from his eyes. Listen to the voices. Feel his frustrations. Packaged in artistic symbolisms and realistic grit.

name: Instinct
short_description: It’s so nice to live with the person you like, to have everything necessary for a good life, to depend on yourself and have a good time. Up till recently my wonderful life of leisure in the pet store ran its natural course, when suddenly a weird bozo appeared in the house. Why did Mistress hire him?

name: Ride To Canada
short_description: Ride to Canada is an addictive action-puzzles, in which you will control the rail traffic. Plan routes by controlling the switches to unload or unhook all wagons.

name: Club Dance Party VR
short_description: - Exciting dance time for those who are tired of work! Experience the real rhythm through realistic rhythmical VR! New conceptual club dance party within your home! - Club Dance Party VR –

name: Reflected Ray
short_description: Reflected Ray - neon Arkanoid game with roguelike elements and the gameplay depends on your music! The embodiment of the most successful and brightest components of Breakout games, for more than 40-year history of the genre.

name: Make Route
short_description: Can you make a way for every car and bring it to the finish line? No accidents, the correct sequence, creative solutions!

name: Kinaman vs Gray Elephant
short_description: Hardcore platformer Kinaman vs Gray Elephant. Inspired by the stories of one blogger about childhood.

name: RESEQUENCED
short_description: While investigating the mysterious disappearance of her parents, a college student's DNA is modified. RE*SEQUENCED is an open-world adventure game, available now for Windows and macOS.

name: DiyMachinery （自定义机械）
short_description: DiyMachinery is Physics game.Build complex and interesting machines to accomplish tasks. If you like research, don't miss it.

name: Hard Work
short_description: Hard Work is a 3D factory simulation game.

name: Super Punchman
short_description: The crash ... Not the best start of the day. In any case, for those who live on this planet... The time has come to destroy the monsters and fly home.

name: God is a Cube: Programming Robot Cubes
short_description: An easy to start programming puzzle game where you design Artificial Intelligence with symbols, to control robot cubes and build space pyramids. Inspired by SpaceChem, Lightbot, Human Resource Machine and the Redstone from Minecraft. A game 99% made by one guy.

name: Waking Violet
short_description: Waking Violet is a classic 2D top-down puzzle game, but with awesome spells and a unique time rewind mechanic. Playing as Violet, a shy teen with a desire to grow up, you get trapped in a dream you just can't wake up from.

name: Disdoored
short_description: Disdoored - is the game about survival in a crazy and 100% hand-made plasticine world. Develop your farm, breed new domestic animal species, search for ancient technologies or defend your base from monsters. This world HAS to be disdoored!

name: Meteor Shower
short_description: It's time to step up and show your skills. Save your loved ones and planet earth from the evil swarm of meteors. The fate of the humanity is in your hands.

name: Super Versus
short_description: Super Versus! The ultimate multiplayer action superhero game! Compete in online super powered battles with and against your friends!

name: Rats, Bats, and Bones
short_description: The undead have awakened! You must build clever mazes of traps if you wish to defeat them in this challenging trap defense game. Travel across the land battling a host of creepy monsters, unlocking new traps and upgrades, and finally finding the source of the evil and stopping it once and for all.

name: Mushroom: The Ruckus
short_description: A 2D hack-n-slash type deal - play as a mushroom who seeks approval from a floating eyeball.

name: Russian Prison Sport: OCHKO
short_description: And what will you sacrifice in order to survive? OCHKO?

name: Don't Play With Dolls
short_description: Having made his way to the house, which seemed long ago abandoned, in order to steal from it all items of value, the main character understands that the house is not so abandoned.

name: Lighter Than AR
short_description: Lighter Than AR lets you explore the world of hot air ballooning. Slow paced and relaxing with a multitude of course combinations. The courses get more difficult as the terrain becomes more rugged. Perfect for VR demos at get-togethers with your friends or family.

name: Laser Maze
short_description: Laser Maze is a puzzle game that takes place in an abandoned space station where you solve puzzles by redirecting lasers, moving boxes, and navigating through computer terminals.

name: Gem Rush
short_description: The well-loved board game comes to Steam. This mountain is rich in mystic gems. Combine gems to open up new rooms, providing new ways to dig up gems. Race against other players or race together against the clock to dig the greatest mine in this fast-paced, easy-to-learn strategy game.

name: BlackFaith
short_description: BlackFaith a Survival horror game based on local horror stories podcast

name: Touhou: Scarlet Curiosity
short_description: The world of Touhou comes alive in this beautiful action RPG (featuring “bullet hell” elements, of course!). Infamous vampire Remilia Scarlet and her dutiful maid, Sakuya, set off to chase rumors of a massive monster, all while sending baddies flying with fluid action and signature skills!

name: Moonbreaker
short_description: Moonbreaker is a turn-based strategy, tactical skirmish game. The game is designed to be a true digital miniatures experience, set in an expansive sci-fi universe crafted by Brandon Sanderson. Direct Captain and Crew in gripping, ever-changing competition and adventure.

name: Awake: Episode One
short_description: AWAKE is an unforgettable, thought-provoking experience; seamlessly blending complex environments with photo realistic volumetric video to create a new benchmark in immersive cinema. You are a new presence in the story of Harry; a man obsessed with solving a mysterious lucid dream.

name: Brickfest
short_description: Brickfest is a colorful spin on the classic genre of brick-buster game where the more chaos that you can maintain in the game, the more you will score.

name: Clash of Magic
short_description: On the United Island of Magic, there is an Academy of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Students with magic powers, regardless of their ethnicity and background, can apply to this university. The acceptance rate is lower than Harvard.

name: Furries & Scalies & Bears OH MY!
short_description: Enter a village full of talking, anthropomorphic animals. Find out their secrets. Make friends.

name: Trivia Vault: Movie Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Movie Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer movie trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Vinnie's Diary
short_description: Vinnie' Diary is a FPP Puzzle Solving Game. The player will be the child psychologist Edward Shawn and explore what happened inside the inner world of a 6-year-old boy, Vinson Gogh. In the game, you will face puzzles in Vinson's fantasy worlds while analyzing the case as a professional psychologist.

name: Visceral Cubes
short_description: After losing contact with a space station on mars, you are sent to retrieve a high value item for the company. It didn’t take very long for our protagonist to find out that something went very very wrong in this place. Use stealth to get past your enemies or run for your life hoping that they don't catch up and explode in your face.

name: YOMOTSU
short_description: A transport that sets out at dusk and arrives at midnight. A world above. A world below. YOMOTSU is the thin line that connects the two.

name: ΔV: Rings of Saturn
short_description: A physics-based mining sim, set in the thickest debris field in Sol. Every action has a reaction, lasers are invisible without a medium, and your thrust is a potent weapon. Find trade, adapt your equipment to your playstyle, hire a crew to help. Unravel the mysteries of the rings, or just get rich.

name: Osternfield
short_description: Little point and click adventure with easter bunnys.

name: Silent Depth 3D Submarine Simulation
short_description: Submarine Simulation playing in WWII in the Pacific.

name: Where Thoughts Go
short_description: Discover the dreams, fears and secrets of other players - and leave your own for others to find. In this award-winning social experience, awake creatures to reveal the voice messages of others that have previously visited. To progress you must leave your own stories behind. What will you say?

name: The friends of Ringo Ishikawa
short_description: A highschool gang leader Ringo Ishikawa trying to live through his last autumn before graduation. With his best friends.

name: Hello Pollution!
short_description: Hello Pollution is a 2D physics puzzle game about a dysfunctional waste disposal company.

name: Guardians Of The Past
short_description: Guardians of the Past is a fast-paced arena brawler where you use gadgets to battle with or against your friends in a variety of arenas constructed by YOU! Build an array of launch-pads, fields of electrical chaos or even a sea of fire. With hundreds of combinations, every game is unique!

name: Bastard
short_description: Are you used to being a noble knight in shining armor who protects the weak and punishes the evil ones? Sure, you might answer, everybody wants to see oneself as one - especially in a game. But did you consider which price you would have to pay for it in your real life?

name: Sea Explorer
short_description: Sea explorer is a single player adventure with upgrade/RPG elements about exploration of a big blue sea...

name: Catsapults
short_description: Go on an exciting adventure with puzzle solving and kittens.

name: Twin Stick Tanks
short_description: Twin Stick Tanks is an action packed tank shooting party game where you battle to blow eachothers tops off in an explosive plume of smoke!

name: Devious
short_description: A real time first person dungeon crawler mixed with optional story-telling visual novel segments, taking place in a fragmented world on the verge of war. As countries clash and tensions rise, the traditions of the old world find themselves fighting with the ever changing culture of the new era.

name: AI Vendetta
short_description: Play as Proto the robot and use its power to transform to solve puzzles, manipulate the environment and blast your way through an exciting adventure in AI Vendetta.

name: Obliteracy
short_description: Obliteracy is a word game set in a utopian future where energy is generated from language itself. Word-warriors pilot enormous mechanized robots in a tournament to prove themselves worthy of the title of Champion—and to earn the chance to craft the future of the world.

name: OboStar
short_description: Obostar is a unique skill puzzle game. Pilot your ship and touch the colored orbs to collect them.

name: Moss
short_description: Moss is an action-adventure puzzle game from Polyarc tailor-made for the VR platform. It combines classic components of a great game—compelling characters, gripping combat, and captivating world exploration—with the exciting opportunities of VR.

name: LifeGameSimulator
short_description: How the extremely complicated universe made with simple 16 particles? This life game will be short explanation of that. Simple rule to the complicated results.

name: Cicadas - The IQA Edition
short_description: 那份因记忆的空白而生出的不安，终于在回归普通的生活中一点点淡化。 平淡岁月里，逐渐忘却的记忆，与那年的蝉鸣一起，被封存在了黑暗深处。

name: Saint Slaughter X Days
short_description: "Saint Slaughter X Days" is a visual novel produced by the Hollowings production group. The story will revolve around the conflict between the Templar and the sorcerer, the "goodness" and the "evil".

name: Lost Lands: Ice Spell Collector's Edition
short_description: Susan is back again in the middle of problems of epic proportions deep in the Lost Lands. Weather cataclysm, mythical creatures, ancient legends - these and more stands before the main hero of the Lost Lands.

name: The Legacy: Prisoner Collector's Edition
short_description: "Legacy: Prisoner" is a HO adventure game, with a huge number of exciting mini-games and puzzles, which will take you right into a maelstrom of fantastic events in a distant world!

name: De'Vine: World of Shadows
short_description: De'Vine is a classic JRPG with an engaging STORY. Explore a very large open-world, with full CARD and FARMING systems! An intense BATTLE system and vast character customization! 50+ Hours of content!

name: RUGBY 20

name: EXCHANGE

Battles upon a plethora of maps await, the weapons forged and ripe for war, classes varied to your style of play, all anticipating your exchange.

name: Arlo The Rabbit

name: Dawn of the Celestialpod
short_description: Swing through deadly spaceships as a squid on a journey to save a species from eternal enslavement! Infiltrate the fleet, take out robotic guards, and escape the self-destruct sequence as quickly as possible. Find the best way to overcome their advanced technology... or die trying!

name: Warlock: Tower Defence
short_description: Warlock: Tower Defence is a story driven tower defence game, giving players access to 6 elemental magics to face challenges spread across 5 chapters.

name: Paper Shakespeare: Stick Julius Caesar (with a dagger)
short_description: The dramatic retelling of the death of Julius Caesar, as only stick figures can. We know that we already did that joke. We don't care. We'll probably do it again. Shakespeare's classic political drama about how political violence never goes over well.

name: Scary Maze
short_description: Scary Maze is an exciting horror-action hybrid where you run through a maze killing zombies, ready to eat you as soon as they can.

name: Pamali: Indonesian Folklore Horror
short_description: A narrative horror game set in the daily lives of Indonesian society. Interact with various mystical objects as you explore haunted places, unravel their lingering mysteries, and experience how Indonesian myth, taboo and culture, combined with your choices, shape the course of your nights.

name: No Prospects Company

name: HEROES TRIALS

name: DeepLands

name: RollerCoaster Legends II: Thor's Hammer

name: Ikenfell
