short_description: Love Sudoku, but tired of default one? Try this.

name: The Rose of Segunda
short_description: In the kingdom of Segunda, the Crown Prince’s birthday celebrations are traditionally where he is expected to choose a bride. Will you act like the perfect lady and convince the King to select you as the Prince's betrothed, or show your true colours and perhaps catch another's eye?

name: Idle Heist
short_description: Idle Heist is an Idle/Clicker game where the objective is to get as much money from the bank vault before you get caught! Through the use of upgrades and skills, earn MILLIONS or even TRILLIONS of dollars. This is the perfect game to play whilst you work or do other tasks!

name: Leviathan's Sword
short_description: It's a bullet hell rogue-lite with pirates, swords and a massive amount of treasure!

name: Spoorky
short_description: Create, share and discover unlimited adventures with Spoorky! Prepare your sword to lead world tournaments and obtain rewards by defeating level creators. Join the global community and compete to be the best player or the best creator!

name: Spellcastia
short_description: Spellcastia is a magical shooter designed specifically for VR. Its main feature is the use of active gesticulation to invoke a spell, so you get a deeper dive into the virtual reality and the world where magic rules.

name: Grimshade
short_description: Grimshade is a party-based role-playing game inspired by JRPG of the 90s, featuring a tactical turn-based combat system and a grim story of war and personal choices.

name: The Last Train - Definitive Edition
short_description: As one of the last few survivors of World War II America, help the remaining survivors using your train piloting skills. During the journey you will come across many survivors and you will be rewarded generously by the rich and get the moral satisfaction of helping the poor. Who will you choose??

name: Adventures of Mike
short_description: Are you ready for adventure ??? Challenge yourself in the game Adventures of Mike !!! Your path will go through dangerous worlds and obstacles. Features of the game are many levels with unique worlds and increasing complexity when passing levels. Unlock new worlds. Get many achievements and rewards!

name: Scratch The Cat
short_description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

name: Nova Drift
short_description: Nova Drift distills the mechanical depth and strategy of an ARPG into classic arcade space combat. Control an endlessly evolving bio-mechanical ship, face legions of strange and deadly foes, and ride the wake of a dying star across the void.

name: Tainted Fate
short_description: Play as a demon in this story driven slasher horror game. Summoned from the depths of hell into our world, use your demonic abilities to gruesomely take down everything between you and your path back to the underworld. Be the horror.

name: Until You Fall
short_description: Fantasy and synthwave collide in this physically active VR sword fighting game. Grow stronger as you battle through an awesome neon environment and strike down magic-infused monstrosities in this hack-and-slash roguelite. Fight. Fall. Rise Again.

name: Itsy Blitzy
short_description: Itsy Blitzy is an arcade style bullet hell brawler. The game focuses on simple-yet-deep combat with fluid controls, and a "so hard it's meditative" difficulty level.

name: The Initiate 2: The First Interviews
short_description: Three people awake in adjacent prison cells with no recollection of how they got there. Now, they must work together in order to escape this nightmarish captivity. But can they really trust one another?

name: Expedia Cenote VR
short_description: Explore the Cenote in Expedia Labs VR. The experience takes you into the caves of similar cenotes that are found in the Yucatan Peninsula. Although a simulation of the true experience, you can learn facts and where you could find real cenotes if you wish to travel in the future.

name: Trivia Vault: Business Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Business Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer business trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value

name: Ninja Midori
short_description: Ninja Midori is 2d sidescroller. Inspired by retro old school platformers with 8 bit graphics, run jump and collect shurikens as you make your way to save the princess.

name: Skelli Tower Defense
short_description: Build towers and defend your lands from a horde of undead miscreants! Three modes of difficulty, including one made with kids in mind (age 5+), and a challenge mode where you must defend your castle while strategically placing your defenses. Do you have what it takes to defeat Red Skelli and his army?

name: Tet VR
short_description: Tet VR is a fast paced, puzzle game designed for VR touch. With multiple game types to pick from you choose how casual or hectic to make the game. Tet VR is a puzzle game that's made accessible and intuitive for all ages.

name: Rule The World
short_description: Top down shooter with tons of options like twin stick shooter controls or trigger fire, top down fixed camera or rotate, auto splitscreen for co-op as well as locked to shared camera or split. Gore, blood and enemy deaths/mutilation can be turned off as well (for younger audience).

name: Aquaculture Land: Fish Farming Simulation
short_description: Aquaculture Land is a fish farming management game. You will act as a freshwater fish farm manager to nurture different varieties of fish, produce high-quality commodities, and fulfill your customers' needs to grow your business.

name: The Last Crystal
short_description: The Last Crystal is a co-op adventure game for 1 or 2 players. Team up to explore a dangerous magic temple with its lively forest and dark caves, defeat epic foes, join helpful allies, acquire unique powers and solve enigmatic puzzles to unravel the secrets behind the last and most powerful crystal.

name: Black Paradox
short_description: Buckle up for shoot ‘em up chaos in this fast-paced and hyper-stylized roguelite. As the infamous bounty hunter Black Paradox, it’s up to you to travel through space and defeat the Hellraisers – the most dangerous criminal organization in the galaxy.

name: Gravity Circuit
short_description: Gravity Circuit is a flashy action packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Follow Kai, a lone operative war hero who harnesses the mysterious powers of the Gravity Circuit, on an adventure in a futuristic world inhabited by sentient robots.

name: Yoke Light
short_description: Time attack and collect the diamonds! Let's aim for three clear stars with good use of obstacles and dashes. More than 50 stages are waiting for you.

name: Waves of Death
short_description: Following the tragic mistake of military scientists, a new generation of a viral compound has spread through the city allowing the dead to come back to life... All the dead, but also the bloodthirsty Bosses. Jake has to cross the city to save his loved-ones.The countdown begins!

name: Scalak
short_description: Fulfilling puzzle game.

name: Crashers of Aetheria
short_description: Crashers of Aetheria is a strategy card collecting game. Players use Crashers to strategically take out their opponent in the arena online.

name: Rent-a-Vice
short_description: What doesn't kill you...kills someone else, and leads you down an ethical rabbit hole. Can you do what's right in a world where vice is a virtue?

name: Dawn of Man
short_description: Command a settlement of ancient humans, guide them through the ages in their struggle for survival. Hunt, gather, craft tools, fight, research new techs and face the challenges the environment will throw at you.

name: Tribes of Midgard
short_description: A vibrant blend of survival and action RPG for 1-10 players! Craft legendary items, grow your home base and embark on an epic journey through procedural realms to face towering creatures hel-bent on unleashing Ragnarök. Valhalla can wait, Einherjar!

name: Echoes of the Fey: The Last Sacrament
short_description: Magic meets mystery in Echoes of the Fey, a series of detective stories in a world of high fantasy. Play as Sofya Rykov, a private investigator with a secret of her own: she’s the only Human who can wield magic. Each episode is a narrative-heavy adventure game with branching story-lines and a standalone plot.

name: The Epic Bang Theory
short_description: You have only one attempt.

name: Tabletop Gods
short_description: For desktop PC (also playable in VR). Lead your troops in explosive arcade action battles that rage across tabletop battlefields. Command your troops, set fiendish traps, bolster your defenses and wield powerful magic to destroy your opponent as you compete for power in the heavens!

name: Queen of Seas 2
short_description: Queen of Seas 2 is a platform game based on elements of afro-brazilian culture. Player needs to bring hope back to the village, rescuing the villager’s lost memories in the ocean floor to make faith in Yemanjá return to the hearts of the residents.

name: Fragile Fighter
short_description: Trapped in a world of fantasy, a scared but resilient girl is challenged to confront the fragility of life, and face her ultimate fears before it's too late.

name: Flowers -Le volume sur ete-
short_description: Summer has arrived early to Saint Angraecum Academy, and with it comes change. Follow the story of Erika in the second game in the Flowers series.

name: Sumo
short_description: Sumo is a multiplayer physics-based party game for up to 4 players, featuring silly spherical characters with unique powerful abilities. Use a combination of mobility and tactics to survive the longest on Arenas which are just as much of a threat as your human or AI-controlled opponents.

name: 360 No Scope!
short_description: 360 No Scope is a fast pace shooter that requires skill and accuracy. Take the fun and chaos of insta-gib with the only way to get ammo is by doing a 360, plus ability to run on walls, ceilings, and you get a fun chaos deathmatch experience.

name: Turbo Tunnel
short_description: Avoid obstacles as you accelerate through an endless tunnel of pain and destruction. What could go wrong?

name: That Tiny Spaceship
short_description: A small retro inspired indie shmup that takes inspiration from the pixel games of yesterday and combines it with modern game engine technology.

name: 幻想三國誌5/Fantasia Sango 5
short_description: Fantasia Sango 5 is based on the post era of the Three Kingdoms. At the time, hosts like Cao Cao and Liu Bei are all gone. Cao Pi, son of Cao Cao, at the northern territory proclaims himself emperor, and uses Sima Yi to start his expansion proactively.

name: Blightmare
short_description: Blightmare is a 2D platformer that follows the journey of Blissa, a young girl struggling with the emotional and mental burdens of growing up in a difficult world. Through her dreams, Blissa confronts her demons and hopes to find the strength to overcome the darkness in her life.

name: Survival
short_description: FPS games. Players in the game as a soldier is about to enter the battlefield, there is no teammate in the battlefield, only the enemy, as soon as possible to collect surrounding materials to arm themselves, survive to the end to win!

name: Monster Castle
short_description: Simulating castle, Set up a monster army, Defend the evil empire

name: Chaos of East
short_description: 《破东荒》是一款roguelike类横版动作游戏，抛弃了传统的地牢关卡形式，糅合了大量的中国元素，简单粗暴的游戏体验以及大量的游戏内容，带给玩家易上手、趣味多的直观体验。深度研究国内玩家体验偏好，打破一些传统模式，为玩家带来新奇体验。

name: Sweeper Zero
short_description: They still come! Alien base is invaded by alien species. As the last hope of mankind, take up your arms, sweep them out !

name: 拯救大魔王重生 Falsemen: Demon Rebirth
short_description: Humanity has become the dominant force in the world, and the devils are living under the cover of their names... Are you really willing? The world is being dominated by evil human beings!

name: Seeking Dawn
short_description: Welcome to Seeking Dawn, a multiplayer survival VR adventure that takes you far beyond the solar system. Step into the shoes of a soldier discovering a hostile planet, where predators roam free and enemies are ruthless.

name: Aces of the Luftwaffe - Squadron
short_description: The Aces of the Luftwaffe have returned! Dodge a hail of bullets and face their fearsome war machines in bombastic air battles and boss fights!

name: in My MIND.
short_description: in My MIND. is a shooting game with metaphors about mind and feelings. Face 18 different negative emotions. Your goal is to overcome them without being defeated.

name: What's My Gender?
short_description: Fool yourself into learning grammatical genders with reward images, gadgets and challenges

name: Mars or Die!
short_description: Control two characters simultaneously! Survive, gather, collect upgrades, fight all sizes of one-eyed Martians, build defensible outposts and conquer Mars, in this glorious mix between roguelite and tower defense.

name: Small person
short_description: In spite of your relatively low social status, it is from you that the future of the country will depend.

name: Ace Meerkats
short_description: Search and rescue your kidnapped meerkat brothers and sisters in this brand new classic arcade game! Your long journey through the wild will lead the way to your meerkat brothers and sisters. Escape from ugly monsters (or eliminate them all), climb the highest mountains and the deepest caves to win and find all of your lost mates.

name: Vive le Roi 2
short_description: « Vive le Roi 2 » is a puzzle platform game with 36 levels taking place during the French Revolution. Can you save him and change history?

name: Escape the Grid VR
short_description: Welcome to the grid subject 8102, this is a VR simulation where you must use your physical abilities to climb, jump and boost your way through the levels to prove to the sphere you have what it takes to escape...

name: Secret Neighbor: Hello Neighbor Multiplayer
short_description: Hello Neighbor Multiplayer. Secret Neighbor is a Multiplayer Social Horror Game where a group of intruders try to rescue their friend from the Neighbor's creepy basement. Only problem is one of the intruders is the Neighbor in disguise.

name: Imperator: Rome
short_description: Dominate the classical Mediterranean in Imperator: Rome, a grand strategy game from Paradox Interactive. Navigate the dangerous waters of politics and diplomacy as you build up your provinces and conquer foreign lands. Now available with special content and the digital artbook.

name: S.T.R.E.T.C.H.
short_description: S.T.R.E.T.C.H. - addictive top down flight shooter. Hardcore and simplicity of this game drags into it.

name: Along Together
short_description: Become a kid’s imaginary friend, and work together in an epic VR puzzle-platforming adventure!

name: Discs of Steel Party
short_description: Retro gaming multiplayer party insanity !Play against up to 6 friends and/or AI opponents in 3 completely different game modes.

name: USA 2020
short_description: The year 2020 has arrived. A herd of fuckin' ugly reptilians are rushing from the outer space. Crime rate skyrocketed! United States of America is ruined! Wipe out all 12 billion of the green scum!

name: Cubelz
short_description: Cubelz is or will be a game of achieving a specific goal in a certain amount of time without being hindered by opponents

name: Don't Notice Me
short_description: Don't Notice Me is a narrative adventure game where you navigate high school politics, deceive authority figures, pick locks, break into rooms and solve murder mysteries: Typical teenage activities!

name: TripTrip
short_description: TripTrip is a challenging autorunner with color-matching and platforming mixed together. Stay on track, dodge walls, and weather hazardous conditions - all while matching The Ball's color to the floor! Master the four colors to guide The Ball through more than 8 worlds!

name: Frqncy
short_description: Select your ship, choose / stream your music and fly a level dynamically generated to the music. See where you rank in the global online leaderboards!

name: Double Head Shark Attack
short_description: Get ready for a multiplayer action-adventure shark simulator game. Play as a Predator, to swallow all the underwater species and eat all the other online players. Hunt or be hunted.

name: Cat-o-Combo!
short_description: Cat-o-Combo is a redesigned classic platformer from the 90s, where you have to take on the role of the ever cheerful tomb raider - Plexy the kitty. Solve tricky puzzles, collect the riches of an ancient feline civilization and solve the mystery of the mystical All-Stone.

name: Decks
short_description: Collect cards, build powerful decks, and embark on real-time expeditions with your friends. Play through 1-2 player quests, 4 player raids or get competitive against other deckbuilders on the PvP ladder.

name: The Enthralling Realms
short_description: Hobbit Village was once a peaceful place, but tragedy struck when a hobbit named Sam found a magical artifact. Unintentionally plunging the village into a terrible war, Sam became hated and despised by his friends and neighbors. Now the war is over, but the village still blames Sam.

name: Geocells Tricells
short_description: Tricells is a tranquil logic puzzle game and is the first game in the Geocells series.

name: Math Classroom Challenge
short_description: Math in 3 dimensions and for fun. That's the point of the Math Classroom Challenge. To design a safe and fun environment, where people of all ages can learn mathematics while enjoying a pleasant environment, with simple music, and solving configurable random problems of different complexity.

name: Eggs 1942
short_description: The Bad Eggs are mobilising their forces across the world. Join the Royal Egg Force and save the world with large scale eggy warfare.

name: Cosmic collapse
short_description: Lasers, blasters, black holes and a lot of enemies... All this is in the endless space, the expanses of which you have to clean up from enemies!

name: Into The Soup
short_description: A portal to another dimension; A world abandoned. Journey Into The Soup and uncover the mysteries of a strange new reality in this atmospheric first-person puzzle adventure game.

name: EXFIL
short_description: EXFIL delivers raw tactical FPS intensity with no distractions. No loot grinding, no gimmicks—just pure realism. From the co-designer of 'Squad,' this milsim tests your strategy, comms and teamwork in high-stakes, single-life matches. Will your squad rise to the challenge?

name: Common Hanzi Quiz - Simplified Chinese
short_description: Learn Chinese with a quiz that helps you review common Chinese characters you will come across in everyday text. By practicing and reviewing, you can learn 2,538 Hanzi, their meanings and pronunciations.

name: BULLETLINE
short_description: Welcome to a world where ninjas, spec-ops agents, chefs, cowboys, princesses, and the wretched hag do battle with automatic assault weapons and high-powered rifles - BULLETLINE is the ultimate combat-focused, team-based, local-multiplayer game-mode-royale.

name: lilGunBois: Super Team Transgender Fortress Platformer Battlegrounds
short_description: Just a lil game about some lil pixely gun bois doing lil gun boi things. Pew pew!

name: Erotic Jigsaw Challenge Vol. 1
short_description: 20 puzzles await you in Erotic Jigsaw Challenge Vol. 1! Fun puzzle solving action with beautiful artwork. Rise to the challenge!

name: D'LIRIUM: The Golden Rogue
short_description: An experimental satiric 2D-shooter game, a prequel for the original D'LIRIUM game. The Golden Rogue combines the mechanics of the original game, adding the new features, levels and enemies.

name: Return to Nangrim
short_description: Return to Nangrim is a dark first-person fantasy adventure with survival and RPG elements. Craft, explore, and survive an abandoned world. So grab your axe and shield and reclaim the mountains together with your animal companion! The epic world of Nangrim awaits you, also in VR.

name: Strike Force Remastered
short_description: As a member of Strike Force, it is your job to defeat a hostile terrorist group. In Strike Force Remastered, you will engage in 15 different missions with your own tactics, in every possible terrain. Develop your own plan to attack the terrorists!

name: Requiem
short_description: Hardcore multiplayer action game with puzzle elements. Players will have to fight on a randomly generated maze in different modes such as team battle, capture and hold the point, the Royal battle, and many others.

name: Labyrinths of Umbra
short_description: Deep beneath the mountains of Wildergrey, far to the north on the continent of Azmarin, a tangle of shadow attempts to ensnare one brave explorer.

name: Apartment 3301
short_description: Congratulations. You have found the application test. You are trapped in a lock apartment and must find clues on how to escape.

name: Mutation Mayhem
short_description: Mutation Mayhem is an evolution-based battle royale that pits you and your friends against each other in an arena full of dangerous enemies and environments. Defeat them and gain their body parts for new abilities!

name: Trivia Vault: Toy Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Toy Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer toy trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: Trivia Vault: Fashion Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Fashion Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer fashion trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value

name: Unexpected Journey 奇幻之旅
short_description: This is your first family mission, you have to arm and equip yourself and, above all, survive attacks from deadly monsters. Defeat these strong monsters, collect 4 artifacts and emerge from this hostile island as a relic hunter.

name: Burgerwise the Clown
short_description: When Burgerwise finds his home broken into, his friends murdered, weird monsters roaming the halls, and his BURGERS taken, he does what any sensible puppy-smashing clown would; he takes advantage of the situation to kill the rest of his roommates. And take their stuff!

name: Goat Life
short_description: Goat Life is an unusual 2D platformer with elements of survival in which you have to go through a variety of levels for a goat.

name: Module TD. Sci-Fi Tower Defense
short_description: This is Sci-fi Tower Defense created by gamers for gamers.

name: Fernz Gate
short_description: Travel to the other side and beyond and find a way back home in a fantasy RPG!

name: Revenant Dogma
short_description: What is the fate of those who have acquired divine power? Discover it in a fantasy RPG featuring stunning 3D battles!

name: SpellFront
short_description: SpellFront is a single-player first person shooter that takes place in the world of a medieval fantasy, experiencing the attack of the aliens. The player assumes role of an ancient sorcerer who must find a way to defeat invaders with only her might and her magic.

name: Little Nightmares II
short_description: Little Nightmares II is the second game in a series that has thrilled and captivated millions of players worldwide since 2017. Now it’s your turn to try to survive this critically acclaimed entry in the most charming horror series ever made.

name: Babycar Driver
short_description: Meet Babycar Driver!

name: Secrets of the Past: Dion
short_description: Become an archaeologist and lead an excavation at the ancient city of Dion! In this casual simulation game, your goal is to unearth and exhibit the real treasures of the Villa of Dionysus. Will you manage to do so before the heavy rain season?

name: Gremlins, Inc. – Card Game
short_description: We're building an original digital card game with intense sessions that last between 20 and 60 minutes, in single-player and multiplayer modes with peer to peer play. On the roadmap: additional cards, ranked sessions, team sessions and deck modification.

name: MissileDancer
short_description: Vertical Scroll Shooting Game with Lock-on Missile

name: Betweenside
short_description: A first-person Gothic fiction set in interwar Cornwall, where players rewrite the story as they go. The patriarch of a once-respected house is dead, survived only by his late sister's children. Left to them are his worldly and unworldly belongings, and the fate of their family.

name: KURSK
short_description: KURSK is the first ever adventure and documentary video game inspired by real events. You assume the role of a spy who finds way on the Russian nuclear submarine K-141 Kursk. While trying to complete your mission, you become witness to the dramatic events which shook the world at that time.

name: Lingotopia
short_description: Lingotopia is a language learning game about being lost in a city where you don't speak the language. Learn Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Russian, Spanish and more!

name: Drizzlepath: Deja Vu
short_description: A man embarks on a journey toward the top of a mountain, to discover the truth of his existence. Along the way, he ponders the nature of life itself. Drizzlepath: Deja Vu is a spiritual revisitation of Tonguç Bodur's very first game, Drizzlepath.

name: To Hell with Hell
short_description: In To Hell with Hell Natasias personal apocalypse has arrived as she finds herself in hell in a battle against an army of darkness. In a classic Bullet Hell rogue-like crawler she’ll survive deadly traps and fight dozens and dozens of mad demonic enemies.

name: ❂ Hexaluga ❂ Dungeons and Hunting ☠
short_description: Gather a party of heroic fighters and lead them through various dungeons to hunt dangerous monsters in this atmospheric RPG-clicker game.

name: Smile'N'Slide
short_description: A fun and colorful game about a little dude who loves to play the ape in his day-to-day life by sliding on inclined surfaces.

name: Skinscape
short_description: In this VR artwork, UK based artist Ian Truelove scales his paintings up to gargantuan proportions to show the beauty of the pixels they are made from.

name: Made to Order: The Party Game
short_description: The world's #1 food-stacking themed memory-based party game*! Strain your brain to remember peculiar orders of your patrons and deal with Difficult Customers! Enjoy Party Mode with a group of 8 friends or go for the high score in solo mode! *Maybe.

name: Adventures Of Pipi 2 Save Hype
short_description: You play for Pipi, and you need to destroy enemy aliens and collect bitcoins with spinners.

name: Meme Supreme  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
short_description: Welcome to the meme graveyard! Meme Supreme is a simple matching game with nostalgic meme references. Race against the clock to match all of the cards before the timer reaches zero! Do you have what it takes to reminisce these long-forgotten memes?

name: Suicide Guy: Sleepin' Deeply
short_description: In this new chapter of "Suicide Guy" you'll be challenged with even more insane puzzles, generated by the surreal dreams of the Guy. You'll encounter the weirdest of the living beings as you go deeper and deeper into his subconscious. This time to wake him up you'll need all your skills.

name: Bully Store
short_description: Turn bully students into model students as much as possible and get the most points! And special character teacher and puppy appear to help you. If you throw your coffee to the teacher, they turn the bad students in the cafeteria into good students and force them back !!

name: Castle: Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: Colorful and bright Castle jigsaw puzzles will strike your imagination. Do puzzle in a new way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving game play will help you to relax after a hard-working day. Castle: Jigsaw Puzzles is designed for adults and for kids.

name: Factory Town
short_description: Build, automate, and optimize a giant factory on 3D terrain using conveyor belts, trains, chutes, pipes, and airships. Sell your goods to nearby villages to expand their borders, increase happiness, and unlock even better technology!

name: Bounty Battle
short_description: Bounty Battle is the ultimate indie fighting game: a new multiplayer 2D fighter, where you can pit your favourite indie heroes against one another! Indie heroes from games like Guacamelee! and Darkest Dungeon, to Dead Cells, Owlboy & more battle it out in this fighter frenzy.

name: Hentai 3018
short_description: Hentai 3018 - is casual puzzle game. You play as a girl that need to get out of the room. Try to find the exit door and not be caught by the enemy or die in the trap.

name: A Quiet Mind
short_description: Can you get out of this world?

name: Mark of the Ninja: Remastered
short_description: In Mark of the Ninja, you'll know what it is to truly be a ninja. You must be silent, agile and clever to outwit your opponents in a world of gorgeous scenery and flowing animation.

name: N1L (No1Lives)
short_description: No1Lives, It's Your Turn to Die!

name: Chroma Shift
short_description: CHROMA SHIFT is a cooperative, side-scrolling puzzle game, where the players utilize different colours throughout the environment to solve challenging puzzles. Players must uncover the secrets of the past and find a way to restore power to their home

name: Putinization
short_description: In this game Putin smiles at you - and you smile at him!

name: Minako
short_description: Minako is kind of like a tower defense game. The goal is to defend your castle for 30 nights. To do that you need to hire local villagers and assign them jobs. The key to victory is to keep in mind each villagers stats and skills and assign them accordingly.

name: Virus
short_description: Virus is a single-player action game where players face off against increasingly difficult waves of zombies across a variety of immersive environments. Players will have numerous weapons, traps, perks, and power-ups to assist their survival.

name: Lovely Fox
short_description: Lovely Fox, a 3d adventure game about the life and times of Lovely fox and her friends. Your tasked with finding special flowers for the Flower king. Guide Lovely fox as she decides to help others or not. Take a role in the well being of her aging grandfather, who she adores very much.

name: DemonsAreCrazy
short_description: Hell's first election is upon us! Do you have what it takes to become the next Satan? Claim the throne in this epic MOBA extravaganza dripping with blood and guts. Choose FPS, hack-and-slash, third-person shooter or MMO-style demons – and reign in Hell!

name: Lonia Saga 2
short_description: You are adventurer called by the kingdom, you begin the adventure of finding the Holy Grail deep in the dungeon. Discover various skills and treasures through adventure. Gather resources to create items to challenge deeper dungeons.

name: Plutonium Pirates
short_description: In this action packed arcade adventure, pilot your trusted old chopper into enemy territory in search of nukes to abduct. Then blast your way out and mow down any enemy opposition you may encounter. You are, obviously, our last hope!

name: Argos - The most difficult VR game in the world
short_description: Argos VR, The most difficult VR game in the world. Don't play this game unless you have at least a 150 quotient.

name: Gaze At Maze
short_description: Gaze At Maze is a 2D top-down Maze game based on the story of a weird maze world which is full of weird looking creatures, powerful bots guarding the human embryos against intruders.

name: Arevoatl Seven Coins
short_description: Arevoatl Seven Coins is a first-person puzzle/hidden object game that takes place in an old estate. You receive a cryptic letter from your grandfather, when you come to him, you do not find him at home. Carefully study the letter and follow its clues. You need to collect objects and solve quests, passing room by room.

name: Paper Valley

name: NUMERIC
short_description: After a long sleep, the Model "98" finds itself in an abandoned place away from the usual house. There is little left in the memory, in addition to the memory of old friends. Where are they? What happened, why is everything so empty and lonely around?

name: Permission VR
short_description: An immersive music experience featuring an original track by the dark electronic band Spanking Machine. Walk through two worlds inspired by the music, using your controller to explore every corner and discover surprises. Fire, robots and mythic creatures await you!

name: HellCat
short_description: The protagonist is a cat. To whom nothing remains but to arm himself in the fight against the army of devilish creatures and become a HellCat.

name: Beasts&Chests

name: ULTRABUGS

name: Drops: Rhythm Garden
short_description: Drops is a gravity based musical instrument set in a serene environment and designed from the ground up for VR.

name: NIGHTSTAR: Alliance
short_description: A modern twist on arcade shooters realized in VR. SHOOT. DESTROY. EQUIP. REPEAT. Command a heavily armed battlecruiser as you forge a fleet capable of stopping the enemy A.I. that has decimated mankind. Only with this alliance can you hope to bring humanity back from the brink.

name: Frogatto & Friends
short_description: Frogatto & Friends is an action-adventure platformer game, starring a certain quixotic frog. A quiet errand run turns into a battle to fend off an invading army, and only Frogatto is foolhardy enough to sleuth out why. Can you survive the journey long enough to solve the mystery?

name: Super Bit Blaster XL
short_description: A SUPER throwback to the classic quarter eating arcade games of the 80's. Super Bit Blaster XL is an (even more) enhanced version of the retro styled, addictive, and fast paced arcade shoot 'em up!

name: Murasaki Tsurugi
short_description: Murasaki Tsurugi is an explosive puzzle game. While this is a sequel to Murasaki, you can fully enjoy the game even without having played the previous title. Compared with the last game, this one is even more refreshing and fun to play.

name: AHEGAL
short_description: You are the last man alive on the planet. Meet and UNDRESS BEAUTIFUL GIRLS to save humanity. Find that special spot to make women AHEGAO. Master your lover skills and ladies will adore you. But be careful where you touch - You might end up with a broken heart, handsome! ♥♥♥

name: 李教授的知识问答

name: Takenoko
short_description: The most-talented gardeners in Imperial Japan are competing to see who is worthy of taking care of the sacred panda. Cultivate your plots, grow bamboo and complete objectives in the official digital adaptation of the acclaimed board game.

name: Heavenly Duels

As you gain fame in your battles more will join your army. Strategize strong unit combos and join in on the action with spells and weapons.

name: Reformers Intl Ver(变革者国际版)
short_description: You may have played some classical Role-Playing Games like Cross Gate, this game, Reformers, will bring you back to childhood.

name: HotFloor
short_description: Run, Jump, Glide, Bounce and maneuver your way through unique and challenging levels. Lack of elegance, however, will get your *** in lava, and nobody wants any of that.

name: DiveReal (inactive, stopped)
short_description: What if you could join your friends and explore places you never went before? Discover and explore the world with others in streetview. Take a tour in Paris, walk on the streets of New York or dive in Copacabana!

name: Puzlogic
short_description: Unique puzzle game inspired by sudoku and kakuro (cross sums).

name: LIBRARY

name: Dubstep Abasralsa

short_description: Dive into this survival horror game where your hero kill zombies and have also to destroy the laboratory in which they are being produced. Complete tasks to move to the next level.

name: We Were Here Together
short_description: As we explore these frozen wastes, misfortune strikes once again. Through the fierce blizzard, a flare lights the sky, followed by a cry for help over the radio - broken, dying... No one else can come to their rescue. Can we make it back - together?

name: El Hincha - El Videojuego

name: Infinite World: Randomize everything

name: NoGame

name: PLAYNE : The Meditation Game
short_description: Grow a beautiful island as you build a daily habit of mindfulness and meditation. Experience relaxation and learn ways to care for your mental wellbeing.

name: Pact with a witch
short_description: -EARLY ACCES - GAME NOT FINISHED YET-Hoping to save your childhood friend from a lifetime transformed into a woman, you have agreed to have 3 dates with the witch who punished him for trying to force her.She seems honest and open, but you sense something sinister about her..

short_description: The medieval procedurally generated side-scrolling real time strategy game. Build up and command your kingdom to explore and conquer the land. Forage, chop, dig, mine, build, fish, sail, explore and strategically battle your way to greatness!

name: Tails Noir
short_description: Tails Noir is a post-noir narrative adventure. Become raccoon private eye Howard Lotor and explore dystopian Vancouver inhabited by animals as you uncover a deeply personal story of change and transformation.

name: One Hundred Times Me
short_description: Dive into abstract atmospheric world where your every move is recorded. Destroy your inner demons while your past selves try to stop you, but hurry up you only have 30 seconds. One Hundred Times Me is a game where you are your own greatest enemy.

name: Mind Your Manas
short_description: Mind Your Manas is a moddable online trading card game.

name: The Eternal Cylinder
short_description: Control a herd of charming creatures called Trebhum and explore an unforgettable alien world filled with exotic lifeforms and surreal environments. Discover dozens of mutations to overcome puzzles, explore new biomes, and survive on a dangerous planet.

name: Torn Tales: Rebound Edition
short_description: Torn Tales: Rebound Edition is a much expanded version of the original Torn Tales, based upon the classic story. Check out co-op play, more custom loot items, gem crafting, new quests and new arenas.

name: Harmony of the bravest
short_description: Harmony of the bravest is a game developed by RPG Maker MV. Fight againts strong enemies, save Armonia from a millennial prophecy and discover the truth about that! Bring your friends back with always different strategies in this turn based roleplay game!

name: Solitude - Escape of Head
short_description: It’s an adventure of young Emilie, who went to the world created by her little brother to save him. Emilie’s youngest brother, has locked himself in his mind after the accident...

name: Caffeine
short_description: Caffeine is a social broadcasting platform for gaming, entertainment, and the creative arts. With Caffeine, you can engage in real-time with the broadcaster or your viewers -- no more long delays when chatting. Welcome to the future of broadcasting.

name: Parallel Pixel
short_description: Fight forever, in Parallel Pixel and destroy everything that gets in your way.

name: Octo Gravity
short_description: Jump and run in an octagon full of obstacles and overcome your own records!

name: Psychedelica of the Black Butterfly
short_description: Awakening in a mysterious mansion, her first, frantic thoughts are: 'Where am I? And more importantly, WHO am I?'

name: Psychedelica of the Ashen Hawk
short_description: Uncover the secret – Unite the clans In a town ruled by opposing clans and overshadowed by superstition and legend, a child is born with the dreaded mark of a witch. She conceals her identity until the theft of a mysterious relic brings to light a series of staggering revelations.

name: Metempsychosis
short_description: You think you heard something? You are wrong. You can't find the way out? You've always been lost. Escape is ephemeral. Existence is temporary. Remember. The light is changing.

name: Dehumanized
short_description: DeHumanized is a Roguelite sidescroller action shooter inspired by Metroid and Binding of Isaac.The world runs on physical rules with elements interacted subtly with each other. To survive you have to take strength from beasts, and learn rules how the world works.

name: Vein Hotel
short_description: "Vein Hotel" 3D horror game, let's feel the fear! Travelling is fun. One night, when I woke up, I found myself in a strange place, it was a very different hotel, and I began to explore where I was and escaped. Why I am here? It must has some reasons .

name: SpaceTone
short_description: SpaceTone is a rhythm game combined closely with story. In the game you will play the role of Reaper who judges dying lives through music.

name: 天岚行 - Through the Mist and Sky
short_description: Between the Kingdoms of Fenn and Leceron sits the narrow neutral zone Mount Aer. With heroes, mystical beasts, and the surrounding legends, the mountain has attracted all but the most mundane, yet has veiled itself from the world, with nothing known except the countless myths.

name: BQM - BlockQuest Maker-
short_description: It is time for your childhood dream to come true - create your own game! This is not a simple puzzle builder, but rather an RPG maker. Design your own dungeons and share them with fans all over the world! In the world of BQM, you can challenge sophisticated dungeons and build your own evil ones!

name: SNK 40th ANNIVERSARY COLLECTION
short_description: SNK 40th Anniversary Collection is the ultimate collection of classic arcade games from SNK's golden age with 24 different nostalgic titles back from the 1980s, and many bells and whistles for the best game experience on Steam!!

name: BOSSGARD
short_description: WHO’S THE BOSS? It’s finally you! One big, bad, player-controlled Boss goes against a team of Vikings, each with special abilities. Enter BOSSGARD, a hectic 1v2, 1v3, up to 1v5 bossfight multiplayer game in which you get to crush your friends as THE BOSS.

name: Highway Junkie
short_description: Exciting race on the highway! A variety of modes of physics and tight traffic will not let you relax!

name: Beat Stickman: Infinity Clones
short_description: An action-packed clicker idle game with an interesting little story. The game has a very simple art style and stunning visual effect. There are 28 unique weapons for you to unlock, the last two are very satisfying.

name: Growtopia
short_description: Growtopia is a 2D sandbox game, that brings together millions of players in an expansive pixel world. Collaborate in building anything you can imagine, become anyone you want to be, and delve into numerous mini-games. Unleash your creativity and join the massive universe in Growtopia today!

name: kicker
short_description: kicker VR presents historical moments of the german football story and the possibility to change it actively ingame.

name: FlyWarzz
short_description: QuadCopter simulator/multi-player : Capture the Point , Capture the Flag Races and Co-op "Save the Babies" as a fly all while fighting off fellow flies and dangerous foes. " When the humans are away, the flies will play .........FlyWarzz!!

name: HarmonyTD
short_description: Harmony TD is a competitive multiplayer 3D Tower Defense game. You control a builder and you have to defend the city against waves of bad mana minions. Are you ready ?

name: MAGIX Video Pro X10 Steam Edition
short_description: From idea to reality: With 10 years of development, Video Pro X10 – Steam Edition and your computer work together to become one. This teamwork guarantees your films are exactly the movies you envisioned making!

name: Arise: A Simple Story
short_description: Embark on an emotional journey of losing the love of one's life. Manipulate time, solve puzzles, reshape surroundings as you push forward into the bittersweet recollections of a past life. This is a story about happiness and hardship, joy and sorrow. A story that all of us will one day experience.

name: Debris 2x1 Hentai
short_description: Debris is an indie survival pixelart game with arcade, rpg and horror elements. AND A HENTAI MODE! Set in a 2D post-apocalyptic lovecraft space scenario.

name: Irony Curtain: From Matryoshka with Love
short_description: Irony Curtain: From Matryoshka with Love is a satirical point and click inspired by the classic adventure games. It smuggles you out of your comfort zone and throws you into the middle of a Cold War spy intrigue - where there’s an even bigger game being played …

name: TimeCluster
short_description: Protect the past, save the future.TimeCluster is a first person VR shooter. In each mission you are sent back in time to protect villagers in a medieval town where the Order of the Grand Eulidians is born. In the future they govern over the known galaxy. An alien race is bent on preventing their creation.

name: Lambs on the road : The beginning
short_description: Inspired on the bestseller ”The Road” by Cormac McCarthy. Lambs on the road is a adventure platformer game with small puzzles. Help John to find her daughter in a post-apocalyptic world plenty of dangers.

name: Putin Run Away From Trump
short_description: You play for Putin, who at the time of the taxation bargained with Trump, so you have to run away from Trump and his clones, and also collect taxes (bitcoins)

name: Fatman Simulator
short_description: Fatman Simulator is a simulation game in which you can experience the life of a overweight programmer. Try your best to lose weight and earn a better life!

name: Colonumbers
short_description: Colonumbers is a new brain teaser game with numbers and colors!

name: On The Western Front
short_description: January, 1915. The Race to the Sea is over. The Great War has just begun. You are the commander of a single division in the meat grinder that is the Western Front. Lead your men over the top as you attempt to break the stalemate that is to claim the lives of millions over the course of years.

name: TANKS
short_description: TANKS is a fun game for one or two players where your goal is to protect the base and to destroy all the enemies. Beautiful pixel graphics, music and sound will let you feel the atmosphere of old school gaming.

name: AS+CEND
short_description: AS+CEND is a space shooter where you pilot powerful ships in ferocious clashes against other players. Combat with AS+CEND ships is a deliberate battle of deadly intent that can quickly become a frantic fight for your life, or resolve into a satisfying kill when all goes according to plan.

name: What Never Was
short_description: What Never Was is a short, story-driven first-person game focused on exploration and puzzle-solving about Sarah, having to shoulder the arduous task of clearing out her grandfathers attic, and soon finds that not everything about the attic is what it seems.

name: Light Rider
short_description: Outrun and out think your opponents in this color shifting top-down racer. Shift your car into different parts of the color spectrum to avoid obstacles and discover shortcuts.

name: I.E.L : Indo European Languages
short_description: IEL : Indo European Languages is an 2d educational game that teaches you French, Italian, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Danish, Dutch and many more. The game has different categories in the game that help your communication skills.

name: Space Toads Mayhem
short_description: A no nonsense, no autofire hiscore attack. A fast-paced, reflex-based topdown shoot 'em up. Like 1980s arcade-flavoured ice cream with laser blast sprinkles :)

name: !AnyWay!
short_description: Do you like parkour? Dashing retro times? AnyWay! Try yourself on an unsuccessful journey in the role of Joy, feel the burden of parkour! A small, but exciting adventure Joy will not make you relax, not for you, not for your friends!

name: Defense the Farm
short_description: Short story of the farmer Bob. As on a sunny day,at his beloved farm began to arrive alive deads. As on this day, he seriously took up the defense of his territory. Defend the farm, destroy the incoming waves of amusing zombies using dexterity, tactics, and three types of weapons (pistol, rifle, automatic rifle).

name: VR Flush
short_description: You are sitting on a toilet when you are abducted and beamed up to an alien spaceship, where you have to convince an A.I. that you really are an intelligent lifeform.

name: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster
short_description: System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster is a genre defining experience that established innovative game-play mechanics that are a staple of the FPS and RPG genre today. Survive the wretched corridors of the Von Braun. Your training has prepared you for this.

name: Echoes of the Past: Wolf Healer Collector's Edition
short_description: Warriors of darkness have just attacked your people. Now you alone can defeat them and save your fellow Healers!

name: Shiver: The Lily's Requiem Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you uncover what's causing the strange symptoms in Blackwill?

name: Off the Record: The Final Interview Collector's Edition
short_description: A man is dying, and you’re the prime suspect!

name: Love Story: The Way Home
short_description: After being passed from one orphanage to another, all Katherine wants is a family to call her own.

name: Haunted Hotel: Charles Dexter Ward Collector's Edition
short_description: Enter the abandoned hotel and find your missing twin!

name: Redemption Cemetery: Grave Testimony Collector’s Edition
short_description: Escape a cursed island of lost souls by helping three of the trapped spirits in Redemption Cemetery: Grave Testimony!

name: Spaceteam VR
short_description: A chaotic, cooperative party game! Shout technobabble at your friends until your spaceship inevitably explodes. Attempt to follow randomly generated, incorrectly assigned instructions. Work together… as a Spaceteam!

name: Sea of Lies: Tide of Treachery Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you find and catch the notorious Sea Ripper?

name: Myths of the World: Of Fiends and Fairies Collector's Edition
short_description: The rat catcher’s after more than rats this time. He’s kidnapping fairy folk!

name: The Walking Dead: The Final Season
short_description: A secluded school might finally be Clementine’s chance for a home, but protecting it will mean sacrifice.

name: Realms of Supremacy

short_description: Adventure Delivery Service is a procedurally generated roguelite action-adventure game. You play a delivery person who must retrieve packages stolen by monsters and hidden in dungeons deep underground. Beneath the game’s playful style lies a challenging difficulty curve.

name: Endless Fables 3: Dark Moor
short_description: During her new adventure, Pamela Cavendish goes to a misty and mysterious Scotland where a seemingly innocent landscape of moor quickly reveals its dark nature. Spectre from the past and ghostly sounds will force her to follow the amazing legend of the Red Moon.

name: Stones of Yalmrith

name: Lilipalace

name: WIN THE GAME: WTF!
short_description: WIN THE GAME: WTF! - is a hardcore puzzle game. Try to finish the game without spending your nerves.

name: InFlux Redux
short_description: InFlux Redux is a high-def remake of the 2013 ball-rolling puzzler InFlux, built on a new engine with improved graphics and physics. Roll through a series of beautiful environments filled with elaborate, mind-bending puzzle structures.

name: Tomb of the Overlord
short_description: Delve into the depths of the Tomb of the Overlord, a co-op action RPG where you battle relentless undead, master powerful classes, and forge your own path through multiclass progression.

name: Tilesweeper
short_description: Tilesweeper is a well-known game Minesweeper, but with amazing stylized graphics and a new game mode - arcade.

name: Songs of Conquest
short_description: Raise mighty armies, wield ancient magic and forge an empire. This turn-based strategy adventure game fuses strategic decision making, tactical combat and kingdom management.

name: Wars of Succession
short_description: Ageod’s Wars of Succession is a new game designed to cover two major wars that consumed Europe at the eve of the 18th Century.

name: Crossroads Inn Anniversary Edition
short_description: Crossroads Inn, a real-time management sim, unfolds in Delcrys' unique fantasy realm. Construct and oversee your inn, delight traveling heroes, and achieve renowned status for your services across the kingdom.

name: Up Left Out
short_description: A puzzle game about unlocking stuff.

name: Chase
short_description: You control a space ship trapped in a forcefield with 3 other players, a missile, and a tracking beacon. Be the last man standing by shooting the beacon, and sticking it onto the other players, so they die in a glorious explosion.

name: Out of Reach: Treasure Royale
short_description: Treasure Royale is a Battle Royale style game in which dozens of pirate crews face each other on the open sea, jungle islands and dark caves. Navigate your ship, bombard enemies, find gear but above all - hunt treasures!

name: Andor - Wrecking Dawn
short_description: Andor - Wrecking Dawn is a cross-platform(Pc & Mobile) multi-player online card game (CCG). The game has five factions and about 500 magic cards to choose from, filled with infinite possibilities of deep strategy combinations. Players can build their decks with their own preferences to compete with others.

name: PLANET RESERVE
short_description: new version . Better graphics, better sound, several difficulty levels.

name: Albedon Wars
short_description: Albedon Wars combines the depth of a strategic card game with the immersive enjoyment of a multiplayer role-playing game. Form a group of companions, unlock cards and abilities, build your deck and join one of two factions in a war that is ravaging the planet Krenus.

name: Daddy
short_description: You have to find your daddy.

name: Remyadry
short_description: The denizens of Touhou Project in a Dungeon Crawling RPG! Gensokyo is connected to 'a certain world' and a huge dungeon by the name of 'Mazes of the Week' appears. Create your own Touhou Characters, step up to the dungeon's challenges! An 'Authentic Style' RPG inspired by Touhou Project.

name: PHOTON CUBE
short_description: PHOTON CUBE is a unique puzzle game which utilizes the properties of light.All you need is a little bit of [knowledge about light] and your [endless imagination].A cute looking Action Puzzle Game with a hearty serving of challenge!Welcome to the intelligent and magnificent world of PHOTON CUBE!

name: Party Poopers
short_description: Tired of playing the same old boring drinking games? Then Party Poopers is for you! A quick and simple drinking game for 2-6 players where you compete in different mini games. Simple, casual and fun!

name: Honor Cry: Aftermath
short_description: A war that has lasted over 100 years is coming to an end. Guide 2 soldiers on their mission to end the long conflict and escape with their lives. Includes hundreds of items, over 20 quests to complete and professional writing and voice acting.

name: Range Ball
short_description: A puzzle in which colored blocks are pushed from above and the player has to break them with a ball. Make sure that the color of the ball and the color of the tile match.

name: Magic Flight Academy
short_description: MUST HAVE for VR arcade centers. Perfect for the first-time experience. Join the MFA and take a walk on a plank hundreds of meters above the ground, fly an enchanted broomstick around the ancient magical academy, cast spells with a magic wand and fight a fire-breathing dragon!

name: Sakura and Crit: The Mock Game
short_description: Sakura and Crit: The Mock game is an rpg action adventure created by the two main characters in the story. The game uses a custom made action battle system which sets it apart from other rpg maker games. Join Sakura and Crit as they explore their world, full of wonder and overall weirdness.

name: Office Race
short_description: Boss is out on some business trip and this means only one- it’s time to begin competition for the title of the Fastest Corporate Robot in the office! Prepare yourself for a merciless rivalization and great emotions! Race or die!

name: NYKRA: Before
short_description: A narrative-driven sci-fi platformer game, set in the first born galaxy of the Heptaverse: Nykra. You travel the ancient and abandoned planets in the hopes to find the origins of your existence.

name: Psycho Wolf
short_description: Psycho wolf is an indie stealth game, which draws inspiration for its unique graphic style from the first 3D games of mid 90's. Gameplay itself is the evolution of the best mechanics encountered in modern games.

name: The Wilting Amaranth
short_description: The Wilting Amaranth is a short yuri (GxG) romance visual novel based very loosely on a familiar fairy tale. It features 2 character routes, 13 endings, and 3 to 5 hours of gameplay.

name: Zombie Barricades
short_description: Zombie Barricades is a 3rd person, multiplayer RPG featuring customizable weapons, vehicles and physics! Work alone or as a team and mission through the wastelands and construct Barricades to protect yourself from the horde!

name: Gull Kebap VR
short_description: Hunt gulls using advanced weaponry. There are plenty of gull to shoot within the "Gull Kebap VR" universe. Take a tour and shoot some.

name: INVASION OF THE BOX PEOPLE
short_description: Destroy box shaped aliens before they can kill you! Outside of basically shooting the invading boxy aliens dead, you can also knock them into each other to create a powerful-yet-comedic “domino effect” – and when all else fails, pick up upgrades to boost your firepower.

name: The One We Found
short_description: Fear, combat, exploration, and item management: these are the four staples of any survival horror game, The One We Found captures this genre and redefines it into an immersive horrifying experience. Feel terrified as you immerse yourself in the world of Whisperwood mental institution.

name: Aeroplanoui
short_description: Take to the skies to battle enemy spaceships, tanks, drones, UFO and eventually die.

name: Gravity Jump
short_description: Gravity Jump - the meaning of the game is to control the flight of the blue cube, which continuously moves between the red cubes. When faced with them is the end of the game.

name: Turn up jeans
short_description: Turn up jeans - This game is created to improve the skills of owning a mouse and keyboard.

name: Tennis Tune-Up
short_description: Say What You See! Voice Commands!Tennis Tune-Up: Target Practice is the first step in a real world simulation of tennis action with voice commands. Real world physics and your voice commands take you to a fun practice area. Select from easy targets or hard to hit targets to practice your ball placement and spin.

name: Tales of Mahabharata
short_description: Tales of the Mahabharata is an RPG that takes you back into an age of gods and heroes. Journey through challenging levels and see the drama of history. Become an ancient Indian hero and earn favor with the different gods of India. Are you ready for one of the greatest wars of all time?

name: Remorse: The List
short_description: Remorse: The List is a classic survival horror game where the player must figure out what is happening in the little hungarian town of Hidegpuszta, and your only clue is a list that doesn't make much sense. Exploring will be the key to unveiling its secrets and get out of there alive.

name: Raiders Of The Lost Island
short_description: Raiders of the Lost Island is a LOCAL co-op party game where up to 4 players compete in looting treasures from a sinking island, while building a boat to survive the final wave.

name: Dance With Memes
short_description: Dance With Memes is very simple arcade game. Play with your favorite Twitch emotes using music/videos from internet or your hard drive. Test your skill and compare it with other players. The key is precision - smashing buttons will get you nowhere. Game supports Steam Leaderboards for Youtube videos.

name: Hallo Spaceboy
short_description: Retro space shoot'em up with nice AI, physics, story and RPG elements.

name: Aperture Hand Lab
short_description: Experience the high fidelity virtual reality of your own hands like never before.

name: Stick Spartans
short_description: Stick Spartans brings fast paced family friendly action to the living room where players poke other Spartans to eliminate them until only one remains.

name: Through The Tomb
short_description: Through The Tomb is a first-person parkour game where the player is tasked with escaping the Tomb before time runs out. Along the way you will collect Artifacts that allow you to unlock new sections of the Tomb which will test the player’s 3D platforming skills.

name: Golf Galore
short_description: Golf Galore is an online multiplayer Mini Golf game with crazy mechanics. You can teleport with portals, dodge saw blades, shoot out of cannons, and much more.

name: Battle Summoners VR Basic
short_description: "Battle Summoners" is a strategic duel card game for Virtual Reality. Feel the real scaled creatures and experience the heat of the battlefield. Discover new creatures and expand your card collection. In the basic version, only the beginner version of single mode can be played.

name: 小游戏世界(中国版)
short_description: Notice: public beta was launched in August 15th, and currently only the Chinese version and the Chinese server are available.

name: Hex Two
short_description: Journey through 80 levels in this beautiful minimalist puzzle game. Jump from tile to tile as you attempt to clear the board. In Hex Two, you'll encounter 19 different types of tiles, each of which changing the way you must approach each level. Can you clear them all?

name: Takelings House Party
