short_description: Dungeon Rush is an absolutely beautiful and colorful fantasy bow VR shooting game where you have to protect your castle from hordes of undead warriors.

name: Wild West VR
short_description: Wild West VR is a first-person shooter unfolding in a western setting. Two gamepads are used as weapons. The interface is maximum smooth. Game features have been enhanced with the introduction of the waves of attacks of various levels of difficulty.

name: Grisaia Phantom Trigger Vol.5
short_description: Murasaki's sister Yuuki has returned to Japan and begins bonding with the other members of Class A. Feeling out of place, Murasaki thinks back on when she first met Haruto. Where was the secret art Haruto sought out in her village really hidden?

name: Shepard Fairey VR - DAMAGED
short_description: Shepard Fairey's work has been transformed into a virtual reality experience for the very first time, where he will share his thoughts and methods behind his work. Experience his most ambitious show to date, aptly titled DAMAGED.

name: Curse in our heads
short_description: John Brown is a former detective, best in his staff. Has served more than 30 years and there is not a single case that he has not guessed! Retired already a year. The other day he received a letter asking him to come to the hospital for mental patients. John has yet to reveal another difficult matter.

name: Arc Savior
short_description: Discover a beautiful and brutal universe through three immersive stories. Champion blazing fast dog-fights, Out wit aggressive defense systems and overcome constant overwhelming odds. This is your goal, this is your duty, this is your way of life...

name: Achaem!
short_description: Achaem is a roguelike with an infinite and destructible world, customisable character, insane combat, and progression system!

name: Rock n' Rush: Battle Racing
short_description: Multiplayer Combat Racing Game inspired by the 90's classics like Rock n' Roll Racing and Mario Kart.

name: Cinnamon fight
short_description: Cinnamon fight is a multiplayer game, where you can fight up to three enemies. They can be your friends or random people. This game consists of more than 500 levels, more than 40 weapons and lots of obstacles which are going to have masive impact on your gameplay strategy

name: Dawngrown
short_description: A short adventure about healing people's inner worlds from corruption, and confront emotions.

name: Lovecraft's Untold Stories
short_description: Lovecraft’s Untold Stories is an action roguelite with RPG elements. Explore randomly generated levels based in Lovecraft's stories, fight cultists and all kinds of monsters from the Mythos, improve your gear, solve puzzles, and find clues and knowledge to defeat the Great Old Ones.

name: Munx VR
short_description: Munx VR is a software for building memory palaces in virtual reality. See your imagination come to life before your eyes as you create spaces, fill them with mnemonic images, and learn complex subjects with the ancient technique of the memory palace.

name: Wheelchair Simulator
short_description: Wheelchair Simulator is a comedic game about a serious issue. Learn how it feels like to ride a wheelchair through a city that’s completely ignorant to your needs. Profits go to charity!

name: Radio Commander
short_description: Use the radio to give commands to the soldiers on the battlefield. Keep track of the situation based on their voice reports only. Lead US platoons to clash with Vietcong in a realistic, innovative approach to the RTS genre. Make hard choices in a narrative driven experience, and face the outcome.

name: BMX Streets
short_description: Ready to hit the streets? BMX Streets brings the essence of BMX riding to your fingertips. Experience the next generation of BMX gaming with realistic physics, massive amounts of customization and gorgeous maps. Practice, experiment and explore to find your own unique style and master the streets.

name: Chicken Rider
short_description: In Chicken Rider you play as a polar bear who is fighting for an animal freedom. This time you have a new mission. You have to help chickens held in the chicken farm. Suit up and go! The chickens are waiting for your help!

name: Summer Memory of Bell
short_description: This is a Galgame about pure love which takes place in the summer, produced by Galgame Department of Jinan University's unnamed cartoon club in 2015 and re-optimized three years later.

name: SUPER BALL WRESTLE YES
short_description: SUPER BALL WRESTLE YES is a frantic local multiplayer and single player physics based combat game from First Place Games. Challenge your friends in 2 to 4 player matches with goofy balls, tactical power ups and deep down silliness.

name: Nurikabe
short_description: Nurikabe is a minimalist logic puzzle from Japan. Unwind as you solve these challenging puzzles.

name: Volcano Eruption
short_description: A short and sweet VR experience of seeing a underwater volcano scene turn to an island chain. No moving required just sit back and enjoy the show.

name: Asteroid RKD
short_description: Asteroid RKD is a small arcade-like game in which you have to reach as high a score and survive as long as possible against increasingly difficult waves of Asteroids. Get power ups to upgrade your ship's firepower and protect yourself from a one hit death. Survive the asteroid field.

name: TrapLand
short_description: Completely new game experience in adventure games with a unique coop-mode.

name: Galactic Dominion
short_description: Galactic Dominion is a fast paced 4x space strategy game. Explore the stars, perform research, manage your colonies, build a fleet, defend your systems, and conquer the galaxy. Play through an epic story driven campaign or alternatively customize your games for countless re-playability!

name: Ultimate Custom Night
short_description: Welcome to the ultimate FNAF mashup, featuring 50 selectable characters and custom difficulties!

name: Blackout
short_description: You will be lost in the labyrinthine house and chased by the devil in the blacked out house. You will experience tremendous fear, stress and madness playing this game and something invisible makes you get panicked and lost your mind.

name: MUTATION PHASE
short_description: MUTATION PHASE is a horror-shooter with a first-person view, which narrates the consequences of experiments with sound waves. You have to survive among hordes of mutants and get out of the danger zone.

name: Allergenium
short_description: Allergenium it’s not a typical survival game. The world created has a unique aspect which has destroyed most of the humanity. You're one of the few who survived the new face of destruction – ALLERGY!

name: Alone
short_description: Alone is a 3D Puzzle Sidescroller with heavy focus on environment puzzles. You wake up alone in your camp and find your friends gone. Set off into the seemingly nice forest to discover its secrets, but be careful not to lose yourself on the way.

name: Mad Restaurant People
short_description: Progress your career as a server by using your keen perception, your short-term memory and your ability to decide quickly. Fancy and unique places will hire you as you master challenges, unlock perks and stay calm even in the weirdest situations. A time management memory game full of fun and chaos.

name: GLADIABOTS - AI Combat Arena
short_description: Assemble your robot squad, construct their AI and send them in the battle arena to see your strategy play out. Iterate, improve and repeat until you outsmart all your opponents and friends online.

name: BrawlQuest
short_description: BrawlQuest is a game about hitting stuff, mining stuff, crafting stuff, building stuff and generally vibing. It's designed around simplicity, and doesn't bother with intrusive micro transactions or subscription models.

name: DERE EVIL EXE
short_description: DERE EVIL EXE is both a terrifying thriller with a gripping meta horror story and a retro 16-bit pixel platformer with unique puzzles and obstacles.

name: Digimon Survive
short_description: Digimon Survive presents a hybrid visual novel and tactical RPG set in a mysterious world filled with dangerous monsters and deadly battles that will test your ability to survive.

name: BattleRush 2
short_description: BattleRush 2 is a multiplayer large open-world shooter in the entourage of the Second World War with craft and total destructibility of the environment.

name: Beerd leaver
short_description: Have you ever wanted to try yourself in the role of a bird-bee? Then this is what you need. Once a small bee gathered nectar and did not notice how the evening came. In addition, the weather began to deteriorate, and it is far from home. Help the bee to get to the house, avoiding terrible predators and terrible weather conditions.

name: Hovership Havoc
short_description: Hovership Havoc is a sci-fi twin stick shooter with 3rd person boss battles. Blast through rooms of a futuristic robotic factory filled with robot enemies. Equip your Hovership with randomly dropped abilities and upgrade your stats during each playthrough.

name: Quiet as a Stone
short_description: Throw Rocks Plant Trees. Remake the world in this minimalistic slow game for casual creators. Discover a long lost history. Create your own scenes. Explore atmospheric countryside vignettes. Sit by Campfires. Relaxing soundscapes with satisfying interactions. Photography mode. Embrace impermanence.

name: Freezeer
short_description: «Freezeer» — is a love story puzzle platformer. Kiss your girlfriend but do not freeze her. To do this, you need to melt yourself on the red block. Beware of ice blocks because they can kill you.

name: Burden of Proof
short_description: Inspired by works such as Ace Attorney and Danganronpa, Burden of Proof brings a new 3D courtroom adventure to PC, Mac, and Linux! Investigate the crime scene, interrogate witnesses, gather evidence, and solve puzzles in the courtroom to present your case and uncover the mysteries.

name: The Eye Of Modern Mali
short_description: A virtual reality experience of Malick Sidibé’s solo exhibition at Red Hook Labs. Made in collaboration with OONI and sound by Jehad Nga.

name: Charm Tale
short_description: Explore a fantastic world and see an enchanting story come to life in this exceptional puzzler!

name: Rogue Company
short_description: Join 20+ million players in Rogue Company, the ultimate third-person tactical action shooter! Become an agent of Rogue Company and wield powerful weapons, high-tech gadgets, and game-changing abilities. Accept the mission and jump into a variety of 4v4 and 6v6 game modes. Play FREE today!

name: Delta-G
short_description: Tired of classical FPS? Delta-G is here for you, with its gravity bending, ultra fast-paced mechanics. At its core, freedom of movement, and unforgettable in-air gunfights.

name: Destiny of Altrais
short_description: Evil continues to roam the land of Altrais and threaten the very existence of the races. Rumors have been heard, the Evil in the East does not even control the Armor of Legend and seeks to destroy all races that may be hiding it and claim the crown of Altrais.

name: Nick Beard: The Fedora of Destiny
short_description: The fedora: a mark of a true gentleman...

name: The change
short_description: We live under the impression that we are too small to change something about the objects that surround us. Actually, we are as small as an apple compared to Earth's. But if we summarize size .... not really.

name: Grid Games: Color Coded
short_description: Grid Games: Color Coded is a progressive puzzle solving game where you have to match the tiles with the colors from the illustration shown in the level. The colors are arranged in an order of sequence making it a fun and strategic challenge to navigate your mouse across each of the tiles.

name: Wizard Street
short_description: Wizard Street is a virtual reality game to fight against dark souls.

name: Bunny Battle Arena
short_description: How about anger management treatment through stabbing humanoid bunnies with a possessed princess in love with Death? Bunny Battle Arena, the best medicine for anger issues management!

name: Zombie Killing Simulator
short_description: Kill all the damn zombies in different game modes!

name: Fruit Hoop
short_description: Oh no! Fruit is falling from the sky!!! Catch the fruit in your hoop!!

name: Banzo - Marks of Slavery
short_description: Banzo - Marks of Slavery is a turn-based strategy and resource management game. Command the Vulture's Quilombo, at Brazil imperial age, and be responsible for organizing, producing food, protecting the quilombo, attacking farms and releasing enslaved people.

name: Rise of the Titan
short_description: Rise of the Titan is fast-paced VR action adventure game about a struggling father of two who becomes a gladiator in an all bot battle arena to face off against colossal robots.

name: ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS XIV
short_description: Triumph over the land, take charge of the fate of China! Conquer territories and fly your colors!

name: rumii
short_description: Step into your virtual reality office or classroom. rumii can be used across virtual reality headsets and desktops for collaboration, classes and meetings. Great for remote teams, education and digital nomads.

name: Let's Seduce the Heroine!
short_description: A girl is reincarnated into the villainess of an otome game. In order to avoid her scripted demise, she realizes she has to seduce the heroine! A yuri visual novel with a twist.

name: Queen of the Pack
short_description: After a near-death experience, Farrah uncovers a world of half-wolves & their intricate societies. Shape her destiny in this bewitching yuri visual novel- will she choose pack life or human bonds?

name: Necro Mutex
short_description: 10,000 levels of chaotic sci-fi horror. Choose which maps you play, from super easy to practically impossible. Find the escape pods or just see how far you can get. Playable as a desktop first person shooter, or in VR on the HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and WMR.

name: Blind Souls
short_description: Blind Souls is a first-person adventure game where you can see the world through the eyes of a dead painter.

name: Urbance Clans Card Battle!
short_description: Street gangs rise up in Neo-City. Time has come to gather your own gang to take over the whole city, district after district. Takedowns will happen, show no mercy if you wanna survive.

name: Cubeology
short_description: Cubeology is a 3D picture cube matching puzzle game in which you select pairs of cubes with matching designs. When you match cubes with the same design they are removed, and you continue matching two cubes at a time until all the cubes are gone, either for points or against the clock.

name: Romans: Age of Caesar
short_description: Build Rome Together! A co-operative grand strategy MMO from a team of veteran city builders, Romans: Age of Caesar is the latest historical strategy game from Firefly Studios.

name: The Neon Boy
short_description: The Neon Boy is extremely agressive platformer in which the neon guy escapes from the captivity

name: 探灵警探
short_description: 《探灵警探》是一款像素风悬疑、解密游戏，故事以主人公从医院苏醒，通过一步步调查揭开事情的原委。游戏解密过程不算复杂，但需要多加注意游戏中的文档。

name: 创史者Hist Maker
short_description: "Hist Maker" is an element synthesis puzzle solving game with some levels which has the function of historical education. When you are in the turbulent flow of time and see for yourself that the history of humanity is torn apart, only the historical knowledge and logical ability in your mind can help us to reshape this world.

name: Project VR Wild Hunt
short_description: Welcome to the Wild Hunt Project VR - this is a 100% transfer of the hunting process in VR, with a huge variety of wildlife and a rich arsenal of hunting weapons.

name: SCP: 5K
short_description: SCP: 5K is a co-op or singleplayer tactical horror FPS project that puts players in the midst of a conspiracy where the SCP Foundation has turned on humanity. Enjoy Early Access as we continue to work towards a completed full release of the project!

name: Z Dawn
short_description: Z Dawn is a survival RPG that takes place in a post-apocalyptic world in which you get to manage a group of survivors to fight for their life, level up their skills, help fight off different breeds of zombies, build and upgrade camp, face hundreds of thrilling events and much more!

name: Jet-Story 2018
short_description: Master the acceleration and inertia of your spaceship in gravity field, use lethal firepower to eliminate any opposition and destroy all enemy bases to win the game!

name: SuperMash
short_description: New games every time you play, guaranteed! SuperMash autocreates retro games with crazy titles, mashed-up gameplay and objectives, and even authentic bugs!

name: Test your knowledge: Cities
short_description: Do you know what the most famous cities of the world look like? Moscow, Paris, Rome, Tokyo, Washington, Prague and many others. Test yourself with our interesting test

name: Guard Duty
short_description: Guard Duty is a comedy adventure about love, loss and the end of the world. Experience an unforgettable story spanning across two radically different time periods.

name: Football Manager 2019
short_description: Simulation gaming perfected. Create your unique footballing story by taking charge of the club you love. Complete control of this stunningly realistic game world is yours - every decision in your hands, or yours to delegate. Your call, your way, your story. Everything you've ever dreamed of!

name: Eleven Eleven
short_description: Their fate has been decided, but how you watch is up to you. Eleven Eleven is a groundbreaking entertainment experience that puts you in the center of the story. Follow six main characters as they count down the last 11 minutes and 11 seconds of life on the island planet of Kairos Linea.

name: Football Manager 2019 Touch
short_description: Handle only the managerial essentials in Football Manager 2019 Touch, the slick and nimble alternate to the world’s favourite football management simulation.

name: Azurael's Circle: Chapter 1
short_description: Azurael's Circle: Chapter 1 is a horror-mystery adventure game where you must find the truth about your mother's death. What evils await you in the depths of the Lancaster farmhouse? The further you go, the more strange things get.

name: Stream Games
short_description: Stream Games is a set of mini games that Twitch Streamers can play with their viewers' interaction

name: Final Missions
short_description: Final Missions is an infiltration and shooting game. Take control of your player, reach the goal without being detected by the enemies that patrol and finish with objectives to overcome missions.

name: Crescent Hollow
short_description: "As above, so below, discover the mysteries of the hollow". Step into the world of Anthropia. Will you help the empires of the world, or destroy them? 4 different classes with unique stories, & 12+ party units to summon at the barracks. (Build an Empire, Custom Party, Deep character stories)

name: NEO NEO
short_description: NEO NEO is a super fast, brutal top-down arcade game, inspired by the likes of Hotline Miami and Super Hexagon. Use a devastating teleport ability to leap from enemy to enemy, stealing weapons and killing all in one explosive move.

name: Chibisu's Costume Combat
short_description: A cute 2D TopDown local multiplayer costume Party Battle Game! Play as Chibisu in a variety of unique costumes that can be changed costumes at any time and use their abilities and map objects to defeat your friends and foes alike!

name: War of Gaia : Into the Fire
short_description: War of Gaia: Into the Fire is a Sci-Fi Survival game where you gather resources, build bases, create and join factions, go to war over scarce resources, find and salvage tech, customize your armor and weapons, and discover the hidden mysteries of the uncharted planet you are stranded on.

name: SPECKLE: Chill Puzzle Game
short_description: Speckle is a simple puzzle game, that attempts to deliver a fun and relaxing experience. However, this is a puzzle game, so ‘rage quitting’ is a possible side effect!

name: 飞跃跳台：冒险！！！ / 1000 Stages : Adventure!!!
short_description: Some people's hearts seem to have been stolen. My heart, where are you?

name: ЕСТЬ ДВА СТУЛА
short_description: Тюремные Загадки

name: Teleportals. I swear it's a nice game
short_description: I swear it's a nice puzzle game.

name: iterform
short_description: iterform is a minimalistic hardcore platformer with experimental respawn mechanic and ability to create replicas and respawn on them.

name: SurvivalZ Battlegrounds
short_description: SurvivalZ Battlegrounds is a mini Battle Royale in a cubic world!

name: The King's Request: Physiology and Anatomy Revision Game
short_description: This short adventure game uses your knowledge of the human body and concepts from science, biology, physiology, anatomy, medicine, biomed, nursing, pharmacy, health or exercise science as your weapon! There's no negative if you get a question wrong - so have a go and save the kingdom!!

name: Crimson Light
short_description: A peaceful, isolated village turns into one girl's nightmare as she awakens from her slumber to find herself separated from her beloved sister.

name: Rolled Out!
short_description: Get ready to tilt and bounce your way through Rolled Out!, a marble-rolling game with charming characters and precise controls. All you need is one joystick to roll to the goal; with over 150 hand-crafted stages to tackle, there's always a new challenge around the corner!

name: Kick Them Out!!!
short_description: Kick Them Out!!! will test your dexterity. Control a customizable cumbrous ball through 40 challenging levels that requires skill, patience and self-control to cope with failure.

name: A Typewriter’s Story
short_description: Эмили - обычная девушка, живущая в Нью-Йорке и работающая за печатной машинкой. Сможет ли она преодолеть все трудности на своем пути и стать известным писателем? Все зависит только от Вас!

name: Life's Playground
short_description: Life's Playground is the board game with a unique blend of familiar mechanics from Monopoly, Life, PayDay, combined together with a flavor all its own!

name: Color by Numbers - Flowers
short_description: Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.

name: モデルDEファイト(Model DE Fight)
short_description: "Model DE Fight" (MDF) is a classic 2D fighting game. You can play online-fighting with using informal tool. MDF is a game made for beginners.

name: Celestial Hacker Girl Jessica
short_description: A surreal 3D platformer about a marble girl named Jessica. Roll around, explore the multiverse, hack computers, dodge lasers, and eat cake!

name: The Basilisk
short_description: The Basilisk is a genre-swapping horror platformer that focuses on you, a supercomputer, as the last hope to save mankind from an unknown virus. If you suffer from mental health issues, play at your own risk.

name: Zero Sum Future
short_description: Outwit the opposition in this competitive multiplayer base-builder. Wield potent player powers, build nefarious illegal buildings, and crush the competition, all in a no-holds-barred attempt to expand across the solar system and be the last colony standing.

name: Tether: ROLL, JUMP, SWING, GLIDE!
short_description: With the Tether Tech Roller™ you can Roll, Jump, Swing and Glide seamlessly at great speeds without any injury! Earn more for a higher score in the Delivery Mode. Get your Tether Tech Roller™ today! Despite some users reporting injury we can assure you that the chances of that occurring are low.

name: 不落城-Unconquered Castle
short_description: A Visual Novel Game. The story which happens thousand years after that "God's one day world". It's a story telling two brave girls who saved their city.

name: Space Maze
short_description: Space Maze is a challenging 3D labyrinths adventure game. By controlling a drone, you will explore beautiful but dangerous Sci-fi maze, and also revealing a weird meme story of the future world.

name: Jack N' Jill DX
short_description: Will you help reunite Jack N’ Jill? 140 levels and a bunch of minigames!

name: mr.Vegan
short_description: Mr.Vegan is a game about a vegan bodybuilder flying on a chilli pepper in space... Oops spoiler... Not really, there are 3 locations: a City, a Desert, and Space. But this isn't all, whilst he's flying he only wears underpants for a... better experience... and better ventilation!

name: Paris: Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: Jigsaw Puzzles of Paris including the Eiffel Tower and other famous streets and buildings. Do puzzle in a new way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving game play will help you to relax after a hard-working day. Paris: Jigsaw Puzzles is designed for adults and for kids.

name: Pac Adventures 3D
short_description: Discover the classic retro game all over again! In the new 3D mazes, you must feel your dexterity and sharpness, avoid or hunt back the monsters, eat all dots to win!

name: Under The War
short_description: Cities are ruled by extremist organizations, and here become closed cages. As a leader of a team, you not only need to find enough materials to make your team survive, but also to be responsible for each of your choices. Under your leadership, can your team escape from the city?

name: Tranquility Base Mining Colony: The Moon - Explorer Version
short_description: Wanna' walk on the Moon? Tranquility Base Mining Colony: The Moon - Explorer Version, is a Lunar Exploration Simulator. It is an open-world area that encompasses about 17,000 sq kilometers of lunar terrain, around the Apollo 11 landing site.

name: Freebot : Battle for FreeWeb
short_description: Freebot: Battle for FreeWeb is a frenzied third-person game where you have to be fast to dodge enemy shots. Fight for the free web !

name: Cars Arena
short_description: Cars Arena is an online 2-8 player deathmatch action game.

name: Subcube
short_description: Subcube, a thoughtful brain-teasing puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours! Get ready to test your mind in a world of rotating blocks, where your only objective is to construct a cube. With challenging levels that will test your spatial reasoning skills, you'll be enlightened!

name: Truck & Logistics Simulator
short_description: Load, drive, and deliver through a huge open world with up to 24 players in cross-platform multiplayer. Join your friends in exciting heavy transport convoys. Jump into the driver's seat of more than 30 unique vehicles and carry out complex loading tasks to deliver a variety of cargo.

name: PASSAGE
short_description: PASSAGE™ is medieval mayhem in a dark twisted world that's constantly changing. Grab hold of modern artillery, magical power-ups, and your trusty old axe in this adventure to rescue twin girls taken for a truly unholy sacrifice.

name: Pop Island - Let's Code !!!
short_description: Are you the next Turing? Take your mouse and start coding! Your future thanks you.

name: Legends of Amberland: The Forgotten Crown
short_description: Legends of Amberland: The Forgotten Crown is a classic western RPG inspired by the games from the 90s. Basically, it’s the kind of game I personally find missing nowadays. Light, fairy tale, epic, heroic, slightly humorous and without the need of endless grind to progress.

name: Lost Artifacts: Golden Island
short_description: Lost Artifacts Golden Island is an exciting strategy game about the world of Atlantis. Restore Atlantis and defeat the villain!

name: ALIENS INVADED OUR PLANET
short_description: Aliens Invaded Our Planet is a Multiplayer / CO-OP (Up to 6P) FPS & Arcade Style Action game, the game is about alien invasion in 1900s Richalley Town. Shoot and run for your life against the aliens!

name: Crying Suns
short_description: Crying Suns is a tactical rogue-lite that puts you in the role of a space fleet commander as you explore a mysteriously fallen empire. In this story rich experience inspired by Dune and Foundation, each successful run will uncover the truth about the Empire... and yourself as well.

name: Panic Room 2: Hide and Seek
short_description: Trip to a abandoned mansion led to an imprisonment inside the maniac’s house

name: Virtual Families 2: Our Dream House
short_description: The sequel to the smash hit is finally here!

name: Isle of Skye
short_description: Five clans are fighting to rule over the Isle of Skye. Only the chieftain who develops the best clan territory and trades wisely will be king!

name: aMAZE Classic: Inverted
short_description: aMAZE Classic: Inverted is a straightforward and surprisingly - difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with abstraction art and calm soundtrack.

name: Lost Artifacts: Soulstone
short_description: Lost Artifacts: Soulstone is an exciting strategy game about a world of magic and myth. Stop the terracotta army

name: To the Core
short_description: To the Core is a roguelite action-platforming speedrunner. Run, jump and dash your way through levels filled with obstacles and hazards. Fight through heaps of enemies to save your father and set record times.

name: Ministry of Broadcast
short_description: Ministry of Broadcast is a narrative-driven single player cinematic platformer mixing Orwell’s 1984 with modern reality TV. A country divided by The Wall; to cross it and reach your family, you must compete on - and win - a reality TV show broadcast by the Regime.

name: Bleeding Moons
short_description: Bleedings Moons is an interactive story revolving around the themes of fate, duty and free will. Your actions and decisions will shape the story of the game, so that Ian's story will be your story, with the logical consequences of your choices.

name: Detective Failure
short_description: Have you ever imagined a puzzle, point-and-click, murder mystery game in two dimensions?! Me neither, but here it is! Detective Failure (Felix Allure) is on a hunt for a murder and he won't stop until he finds one. Multiple different endings. Can you find a way to accuse everyone?

name: Living with Jaguars
short_description: Living With Jaguars is an interactive virtual reality film documenting wild jaguars in Brazil. Users explore the complex and interconnected perspectives of four key stakeholders: jaguars, ranchers, conservation researchers, and ecotourism operators.

name: HUNTER BRICK BALL
short_description: Hunter brick ball - get a golden brick. Break the bricks that prevent you from achieving the long-awaited victory. Hundreds of stages, exciting gameplay.

name: Othello 2018
short_description: The classic version of the famous board game Othello.

name: Swipe Fruit Smash
short_description: Use the mouse to swipe through the fruits and collect all.

name: Antirocketh
short_description: Antirocketh is a fast, arcade-style game about a laser-cannon morphing swarms of missiles into improbable stuff!

name: Hum Drum Experiences
short_description: Take on the role of a person hovering between life and death. Journey through a vibrant world while collecting masks, which help you along in your adventure. Moral ambiguity, questionable ethics and fully-fleshed out characters await in this new RPG adventure.

name: The Forgotten City
short_description: The Forgotten City is a narrative-driven time loop adventure in ancient Rome. Discover the ruins of an ancient underground city, travel 2000 years into the past, and unravel the mystery of who destroyed it by cleverly exploiting the power to wind back time. The fate of the city is in your hands.

name: Sphaera
short_description: Sphaera is a game about relaxation and exploration in a huge grass field filled with animals.

name: Me And Dungeons
short_description: Me And Dungeons is a first-person action game for one player. Pass through all the dungeons to prove your courage and become a real warrior. Kill monsters, grab gains, and buy weapons. You may also create your own adventure with a simple dungeon editor.

name: Repentant
short_description: The game is a dramatic point&click adventure about a criminal who is trying to atone for the sins of his past.

name: The Battle of Polytopia
short_description: Welcome to the unique, turn-based strategy game set in the strange, flat world of the Square. Lead one of 16 distinct civilizations to victory by expanding your empire, researching technologies, and ultimately become ruler of the world! Play in single-player or multiplayer mode for up to 16 players.

name: Dinosaur Hunt Puzzle

short_description: A point & click adventure based on the legendary life of the greatest Tango singer, Carlos Gardel. With a strong grasp on Argentinean culture, it guides the player through a very charming story full of rich details of an early twentieth century Buenos Aires.

name: Faiths End - 2D Survival Horror
short_description: When Matilda Stockwood's partner is abducted her only hope is to follow the trail back to her childhood home, but the once idyllic town of Raven's Point isn't exactly how she remembers.

name: Metal Fatigue
short_description: Metal Fatigue is a real-time strategy game taking the genre to new heights - literally. Build and customize your massive Combots to dominate the three battlefield levels simultaneously - from orbit, to the surface, and even underground!

name: Railroad Tracks
short_description: Railroad tracks is a 2D exploration based adventure game about a lonely circus artist who has fallen into amnesia. As you venture through his surreal twilight world, unsettling memories start to return.

name: TREE
short_description: TREE tells a story of a relationship between a boy and his tree. What starts off as a simple connection, over time it grows into something deeper.

name: Starport Delta
short_description: Build amongst the stars in Starport Delta, a light sci-fi strategy game that focuses on survival. Station Commanders across the universe will turn to you for guidance to expand, defend, and survive. Help them build a thriving station, but watch out, there are many dangers hiding in space...

name: Quatris
short_description: Simple rules, surprising results: challenge yourself with a novel twist on a classic.

name: Space Hamster in Turmoil
short_description: Space Hamster in Turmoil is a shoot 'em up featuring a customizable ship, optional & unorthodox mechanics, 7 interesting bosses, and a short story that takes place one year after the extinction of our species.

name: PSI Magic
short_description: PSI Magic is a classic RPG made for simple fun. Join in on an RPG experience in which enemies can even 'level up' along with you or enjoy exploration in a vast game world!

name: MatchyGotchy Z
short_description: MatchyGotchy Z is a colorful digital pet game that combines idle clicker elements with a new take on pet-raising simulation: trainable personalities. All the nostalgia of those old virtual pets, fully adapted into a new desktop gaming experience.

name: Ultimate War
short_description: This game is an FPS mode, where we will start with a single game mode and we will add many more updates with fun modes.

name: Suitchi
short_description: Suitchi is a two-player co-op platformer that is all about switching. Able to switch positions and teleport to each other, Blue and Orange go on an adventure of puzzle solving to find their lost friend.

name: ZOLO - Zombies Only Live Once
short_description: A Zombie, low poly cubic style, action adventure, PC VR game.Feel the brute strength with your fist punches! Experience the fire power with a large arsenal and exotic weapons! Launch your victims into thin air and score higher!

name: World of War : Battlegrounds
short_description: World of War : Battlegrounds is a low poly shooter multiplayer game. Make alliances to conquer the enemies easier or try to win the battle alone. You can try to stand in this war without any consequences. Be brave and wise to win the battle.

name: Abunka
short_description: ABUNKA is a strategic action-packed team arena brawler. Experience the unique combination of MOBA meets RTS and challenge your friends in a fast-paced battle for survival. Think smart & act fast for you are the one to decide who wins the battle for existence!

name: Ninja SpeedRush
short_description: Simple arcade game with intuitive gameplay.

name: Yaga
short_description: Play as Ivan, a one-handed blacksmith with incredibly bad luck, who must take on the impossible tasks given to him by the tzar. All the while the mysterious witch, Baba Yaga, watches over Ivan's fate.

name: Project 59
short_description: You joined a secret agency. Someone is ordering you to carry out covert operations. There are advanced equipment and weapons at your disposal. You have to eliminate mutant creatures as you go through your mission objectives. But you realize things are not as they seem. There is something wrong in the system.

name: Forest Rabbit
short_description: A fascinating arcade capable of cheering up players of any age!

name: Zombie Head
short_description: Zombie Head is a experimental project. In a casual game, everything should be colorful and cute? No! In Zombie Head, you will play the severed head of a dead man while listening heavy metal, overcoming meat grinders, saws and other bloody traps.

name: Oligopoly: Industrial Revolution
short_description: Oligopoly is a strategy game where you have to set up the production, distribution and trade of various goods. Exploit natural resources, build factories and infrastructures, produce goods and distribute them using trucks, trains or ships.

name: Pilgrimage
short_description: Bring devoutness to a faraway place, where is the place of the Buddha,No worries, no fear, no controversy, quiet, settling down and quietly feeling the beauty of pilgrimage.Life is a spiritual practice, born in nature, and gratitude.It's a spiritual journey ...It's pilgrimage ...

name: Another Sight - Definitive Edition
short_description: A teenager who has lost her sight and a mysterious cat team up in a surreal fantasy adventure into the unexpected, weaving a tale that brings together some of the world’s greatest minds: Monet, Tesla, Edison and other historical cultural icons.

name: Lovestory
short_description: Lovestory is a hurricane shoot 'em up 3D shooter with a large range of weapons and a huge number of enemies. Help the hero to blow a path, gaining the upper hand lot of corpses and tons of twisted metal to save his love.

name: Notified
short_description: The notifications are endless! Use Airplane Mode to clear all notifications when they become overwhelming. Use Battery Drain to stop your opponent's movement. Use Quick Charge to speed up your own movement. Quick reaction times and anticipation are the key to victory!

name: Guess who ?
short_description: Guess Who ? is a quiz game, you will see 5 image of animals, 1 target and 4 options. Just select the animal of the same species with the target animals

name: Pitch Perfect Ear Training
short_description: A quiz game that tests how pitch perfect your ears are! Review notes/pitches, intervals, chords and scales. You can also try to guess the key of a musical piece created using a proprietary custom music writing algorithm. Fresh music to keep your ears fresh!

name: FortOfTheNight
short_description: In FortOfTheNight your goal is to get kills for score. Find weapons from shotguns, assault rifles, and snipers. Use them to get more score and raise your kill counter.

name: Dragonfly Chronicles
short_description: Dragonfly Chronicles is a 2D Action-Adventure game full of challenge and fun for one single player.

name: Adapt
short_description: To survive, you must guide your species through a constantly changing world. Compete with strange creatures for food and territory, and find your niche through careful evolutionary choices. The real question is not if you can survive, but for how long.

name: Sabbat of the Witch
short_description: Hoshina Shuuji has a secret: He has a mysterious power that allows him to perceive the emotions of others. However, he is soon to find out that he is not the only one who has something he doesn't want others to find out about as Ayachi Nene, a classmate, likewise has a secret.

name: S.F.77
short_description: Use your space fighter (S.F.77) to destroy enemy spaceships and collect energy from them. Use that to upgrade you speed, weapons, or improve shields which will allow you to survive even harder attack waves.

name: Wetwork
short_description: Wetwork is a stealth action game. The protagonist is an assassin and their objective is to eliminate their target as silently and cleanly as possible. The game is set in 2030s and takes place in Latvia.

name: Summer: Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: Colorful and bright Summer: Jigsaw Puzzles will strike your imagination in assorted piece counts, shapes and levels of difficulty. Dozens of Summer Jigsaw Puzzles to suit any puzzler. Whether you love puzzles with beaches, nostalgic scenes and family gatherings, great vacation destinations or hometown scenes.

name: ZYX STORY
short_description: Try to destroy the curse in this epic adventure and survive in this platform/puzzle game. Avoid death by enemies and lasers with your beautiful rifle.

name: Tano's Fate
short_description: An unknown arrival. A land disconnected from the world's society. Four heroes destined to change the past to save the future, and it's all thanks to the locked mind of one man. Jay-Cast Presents... Tano's Fate. A game built around unlocking the past to save your future.

name: MiniCar Race - 极品飞车2019 Mini
short_description: Little Cars, BIG Fun! Start your engines! The most vibrant, super racing game you’ve ever seen is here! Unlock all kinds of fun cars! Challenge multiple race tracks, multiple racing modes!

name: 雨上がりのハナビィ Ameagari no Hanaby
short_description: A 2D platforming adventure featuring fireworks

name: Open Space 2D

short_description: Deity Empires is a 4X, turn-based strategy game with a powerful “just one more turn” feel! Enter an intricate fantasy world as one of many deities posed to become ruler of the world.

name: Pythagoras' Perpetual Motion Machine
short_description: Head to the top of the tower, guided by a mysterious voice... 40 stages that should leave you with a fulfilling sense of achievement. Play with your knowledge, cunning and sparks of brilliance as your only weapon. What do the messages mean? Who am I? What purpose does this tower serve...?

name: KnifeBoy Rebooted

name: IgKnight Food Fight

name: ULTIRE: Balls Out
short_description: Roll the ball, avoid obstacles, use powerups - all that on narrow platforms that require precise ball control - one mistake and you fall! Compete against other players in the Multiplayer Elimination Arena or challenge yourself by climbing the Global (and Friends-Only!) leaderboards in the Race mode.

name: Battle Royale Builder
short_description: Battle Royale Builder lets you practice Building, Editing, and Shooting with no limits and AI to practice against! No harvesting resources, no sitting in a queue, no severs, no fall damage, just Build, Edit, and Shoot, with or without AI!

short_description: A band of survivors must cope with both an alien invasion, lack of resources and themselves

name: Loot Box Simulator
short_description: A satirical look at the current trajectory of the game industry. Open loot boxes, collect loot, equip cosmetics, face off against the dark lord, watch ads, take surveys, and slowly succumb to addiction.

name: Bonkies

name: Marginalia
short_description: Marginalia is a first-person horror game that transports you to Kestlebrook, a secluded valley where history becomes enmeshed with a strange present. Weeks ago Eric left. Days ago you got a letter telling you to come to him. Now you're here, but precisely where is here? And better yet, when?

name: Echoes World
short_description: Adventurous maze style, puzzle game. Find your way out and help Echoes world!

name: The Plant
short_description: Интерактивная история про ученого-отшельника, с которым заговорил его подопытный цветок. Настраивая характеристики выбора ответа, результат приведет вас к одной из нескольких окончаний.

A lot of different demons waits you to reclaim the power of your swords, are you ready to stop them?
