short_description: Lie and bluff your way to victory in this online multiplayer VR game inspired by the likes of Mafia and Trouble in Terrorist Town!

name: Falling Blocks
short_description: Score and survive!

name: Idle Expanse
short_description: A sci-fi themed incremental game which allows you to expand your capitalistic empire across the galaxy! Hire mercenaries to pillage alien planets for resources, with the singular goal of making as much money as possible as quickly as possible! Totally not a playful commentary on real Terran society.

name: Capsule
short_description: Capsule is a challenging VR escape game developed for the HTC Vive and Valve Index.

name: Love's Sweet Garnish
short_description: Amidst the falling cherry blossoms, Asaki wishes to revitalize his grandmother's beloved cafe. With the appearance of Rira and Richer, two girls who wish to work at the cafe, this is the start of a bittersweet story that will intertwine them all.

name: Mosaics Galore. Challenging journey
short_description: Mosaics Galore. Challenging journey. 100 magical mosaics await you!

name: Thanksgiving Day Mosaic
short_description: Pick out a turkey, decorate the house and invite people over! Thanksgiving Day Mosaic has 120 patchwork-style puzzles for all the family!

name: Pirate Mosaic Puzzle. Caribbean Treasures
short_description: Hoist the Jolly Roger and seek out the treasure of the Caribbean sea in Pirate Mosaic Puzzle. 120 new pirate mosaics!

name: Devil Engine
short_description: A last ditch effort to destroy what was once to be our savior. A final mission to eliminate a disastrous future. A single ship against Earth’s entire military. The Andraste is the only hope to defeat...the Devil Engine.

name: Astrela Starlight
short_description: Astrela Starlight is a space adventure game where you can play more than 60 quests over 40 star systems. Solve the mystery of Lystran by interacting with NPCs to complete quests, mine, build spacecraft and stations, build and move planets, and build the Ecxos planetary station.

name: King of Phoenix
short_description: King of Phoenix is a comedic adult harem dating sim set in sunny Phoenix, Arizona. Play as Dan Miller, a British journalist who is forced to take a layover in Phoenix and meets a couple of very lovely ladies there. What treasures lie in wait for him in this city? Money? Friendship? Passion? Waifus?

name: Wagers of War
short_description: Jump into a competitive battleground as you face off against your opponent in rounds of war. Based on the classic card game War, battle head-to-head as you work to anticipate your opponent’s next move while making gains to outsmart them and bring home the victory.

name: WebbVR: The James Webb Space Telescope Virtual Experience
short_description: Join the James Webb Space Telescope in orbit beyond the Moon and explore the universe from its perspective. Planetary systems are born, galaxies form, and stars emerge from within colorful nebulas—all before your eyes.

name: Train Defense
short_description: Train Tower Defense is a reverse Tower-Defense game! The thing here is, YOU would need to cross the entire map on your train and destroy the Enemies. Only 7% of the people can do this! Think YOU can do it?

name: Rusty Runner
short_description: Infinite hardcore 8-bit runner you can play with only one button.

name: Robots 2 Unknown World
short_description: You play for the robot Pip, and you need to get out of the planet Narkoland, destroy enemy robots and find your way to Kokostan

name: The Searcher Wild West Adventure
short_description: This is a Low-poly game in which you need to find all Masson Gold in the wild west. Also in the game there is a multiplayer-co-op (you can play together with a friend)

name: BARE BOOB BRAWLERZ: POWER CLAW
short_description: BBB is a SciFi Nudie Fighter. It features 2 different fighting game modes! This is causal & meant to be taken light heartedly. It's perfect for playing during that down time between your triple A FPS rounds that is causing all those problems in your life. So, take a break... have a fap, X-Migu PLAY is back!

name: ShapeSim - Construction Set
short_description: Have you ever dreamed of creating virtual worlds? But don't know where to start or overwhelmed by 3d software's screenfuls of buttons and knobs? Try ShapeSim, currently the most easy to use scene builder and world constructor. Simply grab an object/prop and place it to where you like it, and whichever direction you want it to face.
genres: Simulation;Free To Play;Animation & Modeling;Design & Illustration;Game Development

name: Powernode
short_description: A zen puzzle game but also a brainy challenge! Reach the highest score in "Powernode", a puzzle game that requires planning and organizing skills.

name: UFO Combat 2000
short_description: An arcade twin stick shooter

name: GUNGRAVE VR
short_description: GUNGRAVE is back! Undead assassin Beyond the Grave returns from a 14-year slumber ready to rumble in VR. Experience this classic series like never before as you step into Grave's boots to tackle waves of enemies and massive bosses with the gunman's legendary arsenal!

name: Infinity Heroes
short_description: Infinity Heroes is a simultaneous turn-based collectible hero card game. Features PC & Mobile crossplay, a single player Roguelike Adventure and Infinite Customization via name and card art replacement of every card with any image on your computer.

name: Dr Greenstuff
short_description: Discover the life of Dr Greenstuff, grow marijuana, coca, make meth', drugs and more to keep your legal/illegal business running.

name: 懒人修仙传
short_description: 这是一款很"休闲"的文字挂机游戏，游戏小而系统完善，玩法丰富，极其耗电，并且有大量玩家自制mod，让你玩了就停不下来。喜欢文字挂机游戏的不要错过，也仅限喜欢挂机游戏的同好，

name: Exodus: Proxima Centauri
short_description: Adapted from the original board game, Exodus: Proxima Centauri pits you against up to 5 opponents where you'll fulfill the role of explorer, colonizer, politician, and military commander. Make the best tactical decisions as there can be only 1 winner and leader of humankind!

name: TwoPlay Mahjong(双人麻将)
short_description: This is a Mahjong game from china.It is interesting that is used two players game mode.Game scoring rules are based on Chinese official scoring.

name: BVRGER VAN
short_description: BVRGER VAN is a frantic and fast-paced Virtual Reality game where you are tasked with the upkeep of your burger van business. Cook burgers, hotdogs, and much more as you journey your way to becoming the best burger van in town!

name: Fish Catcher
short_description: "Fish Catcher" is a lovely catching fishes game. Indeed, unlike “Fishing Game” you've played before, the lively fishes will jump up from the sea. There are lovely pink commonfish, haughty yellow goldenfish, of course, there are still the bombfish what you can not catch!!

name: Ludopolis
short_description: Ludopolis is a roguelike dungeon crawler, in which you have control over the type of next room you'll get into.

name: Beauty and the Beast: Hidden Objects
short_description: Step into the magical world of Beauty and the Beast! Explore stunning scenes and richly animated environments in this classic Hidden Object adventure. Help Belle overcome every challenge and discover the true power of love.

name: PaulPaul - Act 1
short_description: Paul is a VR narrative experience where players try to figure out their identity through exploring surroundings and events in a futuristic and often changing environment.

name: The Quest Giver
short_description: The Quest Giver“ is a 2D Fantasy guild manager simulation, in which you create your own quests, and then send adventurers out to do them. Experience how much effort it is to create and assign quests, gather the knowledge you need, and to make the decisions adventurers won't.

name: Mojo: Hanako
short_description: "Mojo: Hanako” is a new version of the famous game “2048”, an original approach to this well-known puzzle. Beautiful Hanako will keep you company during the game. The more points you get, the less clothes remain on the girl.

name: FAN'CIE VEER! (Fish Are Nasty, Cake Is Excellent Vektor Evading Emblazed Rapture)
short_description: Frantic action awaits you in this game all about surviving and collecting as many points and cake as you can! "FAN'CIE VEER" is a unique new high octane retro action game that will have you eating fattening cake, moving to slim down and veering to avoid all of the rocks and deadly fish!

name: Bloom
short_description: "Bloom" is an erotic yuri visual novel about a hopeless romantic who meets a jaded girl that doesn't believe in love. Will Lily adapt to this casual, no-strings-attached relationship with Eve? Or will she prove that true love isn't dead after all?

name: Seed of Evil
short_description: Seed of Evil is an epic adventure to uncover the secrets of the Water City, Somonden. Follow Anna as she explores the upper and lower parts of the city to uncover the truth of the defilement plaguing its inhabitants. You won't soon forget this amazing story filled with mystery, drama, and intrigue.

name: Sanguine Sanctum
short_description: It desires more. Feed It. Nourish It. Sanguine Sanctum is an atmospheric horror-exploration game with a low-poly, PS1 aesthetic.

name: VRITRA COMPLETE EDITION
short_description: A challenge from ancient times delivered to gamers. That excitement from the past has returned. The complete version of VRITRA, the 2D fantasy shooting game, is out now!

name: OscarWildeCard
short_description: He loves dinner parties. He doesn't love you. A most amusing card game.

name: Hot Brass
short_description: As an elite SWAT operator, think fast and put your tactics to the test to master a series of missions and save lives. Summon your team of up to four players in online and local co-op, or hone your skills solo. Don’t just be the best—be the best of the best.

name: Chocolate makes you happy 7
short_description: Casual colorful physical puzzle with sweets, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, reverse gravity, traps, treadmills, lazors and explosions.

name: Emoto
short_description: Emoto uses VR devices to quickly create 3D animation, manipulate characters to make the performance more lifelike, use SDK tools to replace your own characters, scenes, props, special effects resources, and you can export your performance story into MP4 video, share and record!

name: Space Wars
short_description: Space Wars is an exciting 2D space shooter. It has tons of powerups, tons of action, and tons of hardcore gameplay!

name: Sonar Beat
short_description: In Sonar Beat, your most valuable ally is rhythm. Your super secret nuclear submarine is under attack and only the most intense musical defense can save it! Boost your senses and launch a counter attack to the music to save yourself.

name: Dimension Of Gameth
short_description: Turn-Based RPG board-Game where you can bring varius of hero into your squad to fighting together against opponent.

name: Valheim
short_description: A brutal exploration and survival game for 1-10 players, set in a procedurally-generated purgatory inspired by viking culture. Battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage!

name: My Heart Grows Fonder
short_description: Visual novel about a couple who are reunited after a three year separation. Have the two moved on during their time apart? Or will old passions be rekindled?

name: Sable's Grimoire: A Dragon's Treasure
short_description: Sleeping with a possessive half-dragon becomes the least of Sable's worries as he tries to stay one step ahead of his domineering mother-in-law.

name: Slave's Sword
short_description: Slave's Sword is the story of Luna, a former aristocratic knight of the Empire. Now living peacefully as a mercenary, she quickly becomes involved in a scandal that results in her enslavement. Can Luna recapture her freedom and escape from her predicament?

name: Slave's Sword 2
short_description: In Slave's Sword 2, Luna, a former aristocratic knight of the Empire, returns as the main character. Now having escaped and liberated the Free City, she once again finds herself in a terrible predicament. Will she be able to escape again? Find out in this sequel to Slave's Sword!

name: Music Racer
short_description: Music Racer is a musical arcade game, where you get to race at full speed while dodging obstacles to the rhythm of the music.

name: Hasbro's BATTLESHIP
short_description: Hasbro's Battleship is the original strategic naval war game. Choose your Captain, position your ships, aim your missiles and sink the enemy's fleet! Face them in Classic mode, or step-up the stakes in the all new Commanders Mode. Ready, aim, FIRE!

name: WAyE
short_description: The day starts as always. You choose what's the most important and go fishing. You have no idea how dangerous and incredibile will be your journey. You have only yourself and you have got to survive on an open sea.

name: The End: Inari's Quest
short_description: You're a fox in a cyberpunk city full of hostile robots. You must escape while helping another fox and its cub

name: Mad Factory
short_description: WELCOME TO THE FACTORY! In Mad Factory you’re the new hire in the universe's finest cookie factory–and you’ve got orders to fill! See who can make, bake and frost the most cookies and reach the top of the leaderboard! Can you keep your cool and deliver the goods in this addictive VR experience?

name: Synthrun
short_description: Synthrun is an action-platformer where you race through an abstract world. Have you got what it takes to collect all the energy orbs?

name: Fury Strike
short_description: Fury Strike is an 80s-themed 2.5D cel-shaded fighter game created by Full Sail University students in collaboration with Rooster Teeth.

name: MYSTERY HOUSE : SECRET STEALTH
short_description: There are lots of exciting experiences and tasks waiting for you in the game. Do you like the tasks to be solved? Do you like excitement when someone is chasing you and you need to find the key to the mystery? Then this game is for you. We are continually developing and engaging in more and more puzzles and tasks.

name: Catherine Classic
short_description: Catherine: a tale of love, betrayal, and the terror of commitment. Experience the mature action-adventure-puzzle game unlike any other from the makers of the Persona series, now enhanced for PC in all its Classic glory. Is love over? Climb to the top or die trying.

name: Voxel Race
short_description: Climb aboard your vehicle and become the master of the track!

name: Malfortune
short_description: A twin-stick shooter where your actions have consequences. Engage in blood-pumping boss fights, soothing casual puzzles, and chats with quirky locals. This planet's fate lies in your capable, albeit confused, hands.

name: The Mansion
short_description: After a series of unfortunate events, you end up having to live in an assortment of hotels and B&B's. With money fast running out and with no luck renting a place, you get a mysterious phone call offering you a room...

name: Absolute Adventure
short_description: Absolute Adventure Nulla is a role playing game set in a different, yet similar, dimension. Its graphics and sound department are inspired by older games of the same genre. Your objective is to guide a wandering adventurer to its destiny: The future you'll forge during the course of the journey!

name: Meridian 59
short_description: Meridian 59 was the first 3D massively multiplayer game, released in 1996. It's back, and it's free to play!

name: Harvested
short_description: A blend of real-time strategy and top-down shooter. Build a city and defend it.

name: Life After The Living
short_description: FPS Zombie Survival Game set in a post apocalyptic world.

name: NightmareBullet
short_description: "Nightmare Bullet" is a top-down shooting game. You control a hero trapped in a world where nightmares have come true. Where's the escape? Various enemies stand in the way of the hero. Defeat them with the hero's gun and bombs! Use different firing patterns and other techniques to handle traps and obstacles in your path.

name: Salary Man Escape
short_description: Tired of work? Feeling trapped at your position with no hope of promotion? Vent out your frustrations with Salary Man Escape, a satirical and edgy physics puzzle game about helping a disgruntled Salaryman escape his miserable life. Featuring PC-exclusive levels!

name: For the Revenge
short_description: The world is filled with darkness by the devil. The last wizard left, you have to shine the light and defeat the devil to save the world. But be careful! As soon as the light is lit, a group of demons will come and attack you. Alone, you have to fight against hundreds of thousands of enemies!

name: Team A.R.G. Anthology
short_description: A PC-based time capsule of Arduino games.

name: Reign of the Succubus
short_description: Reign of the Succubus is an RPG that takes place on the Island of Eden, where it is rumored that all of one's desires shall be fulfilled. But is this true or merely a rumor? Find out in this RPG developed by TechnoBrake and published by Kagura Games!

name: Spire of Sorcery – Character Generator
short_description: Spire of Sorcery is the upcoming open world survival RPG from Alexey Bokulev (creator of Eador. Genesis and Gremlins, Inc.). This free companion tool for the game allows you to generate and edit characters (biographies, portraits) from the world of Rund, and share them with the community.

name: Short Life
short_description: Choose your hero and get to the finish without losing your head :) Avoid obstacles and try to complete the levels with all your body parts.

name: Monopolist: Technological Revolution
short_description: Imagine being a monopolist of the late 19th and early 20th centuries. In the game Monopolist: Technological revolution - wins the one who will earn the first 50000$ or eliminate other players from the game, forcing them to go bankrupt.

name: Skautfold: Into the Fray
short_description: Into the Fray is a fast action-shooter in the vein of Doom and Dark Messiah; using fast combat, reactive environments, and traps. Blast, kick, and dash your way through Rebels and Eldritch creatures to liberate the Isle of Portland; as it becomes consumed by Fog and the horrors therein.

name: Azurael's Circle: Chapter 2
short_description: Azurael's Circle: Chapter 2 is a horror-mystery adventure game where you must track down five missing teenagers in an abandoned apartment complex. There's something sinister awaiting you inside. Beware.

name: Dances with Butterflies VR
short_description: Conduct clouds of Monarch butterflies in the forests of Mexico.

name: CSI VR: Crime Scene Investigation
short_description: CSI VR: Crime Scene Investigation is the first episode and unique game of an upcoming CSI VR game series we are glad to introduce you. A realistic crime solving experience game for HTC Vive and/or Oculus. The aim is to find the murderer following the solving process.

name: Silent Night
short_description: There is a 'presence' haunting the long forgotten church of 'Northfield'. Angry spirits seek revenge for an ancient crime, from the terrible time of The Black Death. Ghost-hunter, Nigel Danvers, has been sent to investigate the case, using his kitbag of ghost-hunting gadgets, on the loneliest night of the year.

name: Project Warlock
short_description: Project Warlock is a first-person shooter that fans of Doom, Hexen, and Wolfenstein cannot miss. It serves you an exploding cocktail of bullets, spells, and monsters. Battle through 60 levels of non-stop action, packed with bloodthirsty enemies and challenging bosses.

name: Rikki & Vikki
short_description: Puzzling Action for One or Two Players.

name: Mercenary Leto
short_description: A science-fantasy action game with a strong narrative core. Come pet the fluffy dragon!

name: One Hand Clapping
short_description: One Hand Clapping is a vocal 2D platformer. Solve puzzles, by singing or humming into your microphone, and find confidence in the power of your voice as it changes the world around you.

name: Newfound Courage
short_description: You're a young man named Alex who arrives in the cliffside town of Silverpine. Explore the town's many mysteries and meet its colourful townsfolk, while you grow closer to a kind-hearted local named Jake. Can the two of you save the town from the impending doom brewing inside the mysterious Vault?

name: Chrono Project
short_description: The Chrono project is a 2.5D side scroller game, set in a fantasy world, with the magical Chrono and the technological Robo. The game features a powerful time rewinding mechanic. Use it to explore different timelines and eventually save or damn the world.

name: Roll for the Galaxy
short_description: Roll for the Galaxy is a dice game of building space empires for 2-5 players. Your dice represent your populace, whom you direct to develop new technologies, settle worlds, and ship goods. The player who best manages their workers and builds the most prosperous empire wins!

name: THE LONGING
short_description: An unusual mix of adventure and idle game. In utter loneliness deep below the surface, it's your task to wait for the awakening of your king... for 400 days.

name: Trials of Ascension: Exile
short_description: Trials of Ascension: Exile is a hardcore sandbox fantasy game where you will play as a human mastering your skills, evolve for the hunt as a Raknar, or defy all odds to grow as a powerful dragon!

name: Astral Gunners
short_description: Get ready to push your skills to the limit against an endless sea of bullets and evil robots in Astral Gunners. Choose from five different gunners to master in this horizontal shooter. With the ability to dodge, reflect, delete, and convert bullets you are more powerful than you might believe.

name: Science Simulator
short_description: Science Simulator - The Science Video Game

name: Super GMA
short_description: Super GMA is a traditional 2D fighting game where you can increase your health energy the more you fight. Every attack, technique, or even strategy that you wield will be put to the ultimate test as you fight powerful foes, face off against your friends and rivals, and earn your title as a GMA champion.

name: RUSSI.A SIMULATOR
short_description: Pitun, Vodka and Hardbass

name: Running Naked Simulator 2019
short_description: Rock out with your (8-bit) block out in Running Naked Simulator 2019! Master the gentle art of running naked for everyone to see, and streak through public parks in iconic characters! It’s totally inappropriate!

name: Night of the Blood Moon
short_description: The darkness of the blood moon is here. Rise from the nightmares and take back the dream realm! Use unique weapons, grow your power, and destroy the charming creatures of the dream realm. Develop your skills, unlock pets, and defeat bosses who will challenge your strategy along side your skill.

name: Battle Of Worldviews
short_description: Battle Of Worldviews - "real time strategy" in which you have to fight with friends or AI, while watching the resources, weather conditions and their development.

name: Death's Door
short_description: Reaping souls of the dead and punching a clock might get monotonous but it's honest work for a Crow. The job gets lively when your assigned soul is stolen and you must track down a desperate thief to a realm untouched by death - where creatures grow far past their expiry.

name: Watch
short_description: Watch is a free incremental game combined with collecting wristwatches integrated into Steam inventory.

name: Unmanned helicopter
short_description: Is a helicopter flight simulator. Control the helicopter and move along the points of your route, and then make a safe landing on the landing pad to complete the level. Prove to yourself and your friends that you are the best pilot!

name: Maze Gold Run
short_description: Embark on a Time Challenge Runner adventure with easy-to-master controls. Navigate through a dimly lit labyrinth, collecting gold to speed up your pace and brighten your path. Transition from cautious exploration to a high-speed sprint, racing against both the clock and your dwindling life force.

name: Ghostman: The Council Calamity
short_description: Ghostman: The Council Calmity is a Point and click adventure game set in space.

name: Oh Boy Cheese
short_description: Have some cheesy fun with two modes of cheesy madness. Try tojump onto scoreboard by collecting the cheese or just have some casual fun. Play one wacky mode, with trampolines, planes, presents and explosions. Whatever you choose it will be cheesetastic.

name: Blockiverse: Camouflage
short_description: Blockiverse: Camouflage combines all the great features of modern hero shooters, mixes in a lot of characters, and add a ton of environmental interaction to create an over-the-top, fun experience.

name: Beware of Trains
short_description: So you have been fired from your comfy, well paid, corporate job and now you just want to watch the world burn. Careful what you wish for! Beware of Trains is a twisted, violent puzzle sandbox unlike anything you have seen before.

name: One Hunt
short_description: Stranded in a blighted tundra with an ancient beast that is on the hunt. Keep your fingers warm and your shotgun loaded and you just might make it out alive.

name: Beat the Song
short_description: A music game, where you play songs. You play missing percussion, guitars, pianos, vocals, synthesizers, effects, strings and many more other instruments that change during the game. A total of 127 minutes of music you can play.

name: Vibur: DISINTEGRATION (Episode 1)
short_description: VIBUR Disintegration is a game guided by a dense narrative told in the Visual Novel style, complemented by combat with piloted robots (Abidis) in a turn-based strategy system. The story unfolds in the midst of a interplanetary war, in which Abidis play a pivotal role in military conflicts.

name: ActionpaintVR
short_description: A fast and powerful paint experience.

name: Exoplanet: A Project Coreward Demo
short_description: Embark on an epic journey across the stars while encountering foes, friends and forgotten stories. Build your ship. Recruit and train your crew. Exoplanet is a demo of Project Coreward, a full open world RPG.

name: Bernie’s Nightmare
short_description: Nightmares come true in Bernie's Nightmare, a first-person survival horror game developed by 15-year-old indie horror developer. As Bernie Janson, fight through this interactive horror journey inside a person's nightmare... and try to escape.....or else.

name: Duke Dashington Remastered
short_description: Hop into the shoes of Duke Dashington and save treasures from collapsing dungeons! Do you have what it takes to be the fastest treasure hunter in the world?

name: Push Blox 2
short_description: Block-pushing puzzle game with challenging high quality levels.

name: Crimson Gray: Dusk and Dawn
short_description: A slice of life visual novel with the emphasis on the slicing. Play as a mentally unstable young woman with blood on her hands trying to adapt to a normal life.

name: ShyChess
short_description: ShyChess is a puzzle game where the ShyGirls must cross through chessboards avoiding dangerous zones, marked by thechess pieces attack patterns. Go through room to room while discovering more about the ShyGirls history, escape with as many of them as you can.

name: Supaplex HARD
short_description: What can we say about Supaplex HARD in plain words? It is COMPLEXITY AND SPEED!

name: Hungry Kitty Donuts Mania
short_description: Our little kitties are under hungry to death. The most delicious food, donuts, are in font of kitty’ eyes. Find the best way to feed our hungry kitty! Hungry Kitty Donuts Mania features hours of gameplay, challenging physics-based puzzle, and lots of replay value. Each level requires logic and skill to resolve.

name: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree
short_description: ATONE is a Norse mythology-inspired, hand-drawn game that blends interactive storytelling and complex puzzles with a rhythm game combat system. Inherit the role of a young warrior named Estra as she journeys through Midgard to unveil the truth behind her father’s death.

name: Final Theory
short_description: Final Theory is a 4X-lite turn-based strategy game where you command fleets of battleships engaged in a galactic civil war. It presents an exciting experience for both veteran players and those new to the genre. It features innovative combat mechanics but also hearkens back to some of the classics.

name: The Chronicles of Noah's Ark
short_description: One of the most amazing stories in the history of mankind is presented once again in The Chronicles of Noah's Ark. Step into Noah’s shoes and build the ark in this touching story of faith, family, and the future.

name: Cosmic Ray
short_description: A game about exploring space in search of hospitable planets for colonization. Casual gameplay and short rounds make it a great option for killing a few minutes.

name: L-Way
short_description: L-Way is a minimalistic labyrinth-puzzle game.

name: Invaders! From Outer Space
short_description: What really happened in 1958? Experience a crazy alien invasion in extraordinary retro action! Can you save the earth from the apocalypse or do the aliens come in peace?

name: Trumpy Wall
short_description: Help Donald Trump to watch de wall. Thousand mexicans could enter in USA. Stop Em all!

name: Hanz Puppetguns
short_description: HANZ Puppetguns is a multiplayer top-down shooter in the setting of a puppetpocalypse. Look for the best weapons, avoid meeting zombie-wolves, act unexpectedly! Become the most plush player! Every man for himself!

name: Stalked at Night
short_description: Your name is Bill, a man that had a car accident in the countryside in West Virginia.You wake up from a car crash,not exactly knowing where you are.Before crashing you saw some big animal crossing the road and then following you for a while.Right now your priorities are to get out of this place.

name: The Cage
short_description: This is a thriller theme pixel painting style puzzle solving role-playing games. The game tells the story of the day when the protagonist's mother died.

name: Littlewood
short_description: The world has already been saved. Now it's time to rebuild your town, learn new hobbies, and forge lifelong friendships in this peaceful and relaxing RPG.

name: Evil Reap
short_description: 4-player online co-op, demon-slaying madness. Slaughter endless hordes of demons, either solo or with friends.

name: Convergence Compulsion
short_description: Escape endless waves of danger, match colors, avoid obstacles, and earn power-ups in this fast-paced, arcade spectacle!

name: My House
short_description: Build your house according to your desires in My House! Let your creativity express itself in a chill atmosphere!

name: Magical Battle Cry
short_description: English is currently not available. It may be online soon.

name: Dog Jam
short_description: Play as Bacon, participate in 48-hour Game Development Competition. Gather friends, collect cards, deploy the Conceptions and implement them to get good grades.

name: JJBoom
short_description: A party game that makes you laugh out loud, in the local or online games, raise everything up, throw them out, use your wisdom to blow your enemies up!

name: Autonomica
short_description: Autonomica is an open-world survival game inspired by solarpunk aesthetics driven by farming and automation, exploration, and futuristic tech. Build automated farms, craft advanced machinery, and explore islands filled with mysteries, ghosts, challenges and time-bending adventures.

name: Drop Up
short_description: A difficult puzzle game, where a circle, follows a line you draw, to the end of the level.

name: Majin Woman
short_description: Control a giant girl and protect the earth from invasion in this circular style side-scrolling shooter. In the name of world peace, you can use melee combat to pave a path through your foes (then devour them!) or obliterate the legions with a giant holy machine gun!

name: SWORDS of GARGANTUA
short_description: Experience Swords of Gargantua, a VR sword-action game in single-player mode or online co-op with up to 3 other players! Adventure through the Tesseract Abyss floors to beat the giant, Gargantua lying in wait on the deepest layer, Floor 101.

name: On Board Remastered
short_description: Stein bock games is always improving it's products in order to give a good gaming experience to our customer . We are always listening to our customers to find out what are their needs and wants in their game. We value their opinion since to us it is one of the most important ingredient one can use in order to make a video game.

name: Leaflet Love Story
short_description: A normal male engineering student who used to be successful, is now languishing at the bottom in his English classes. A pretty girl who is said to be unapproachable, and is very proud of herself. How will the romance between the two of them develop?

name: DollKart
short_description: Drive your ragdoll through an infinite number of difficult tracks, against time in single player, your friends in split screen and randoms online.

name: Deadside
short_description: An Open World Survival Shooter blending hardcore PVP and PVE action. Secure precious loot in safe zones or build your own fortress in the wild. With intense gunfights, stunning visuals, and performance smooth enough for any system, the challenge awaits!

name: Path of Sin: Greed
short_description: It was supposed to be a simple suicide case – a quick inspection and lots of boring paperwork. But the more you delve into this secluded island and the twisted family relations of the owners, the more complicated and unclear this case becomes.

name: From The Sky: New Horizon
short_description: From The Sky tells the adventures of two sisters Yuki and Karma, who travel through time and space through the portal. From the Jurassic world to world wars, from ocean to space. But nothing is safe, for each world there are different dangerous obstacles, let's help them overcome obstacles safely.

name: EW/WE
short_description: EWWE – is just a dream. A bad dream in which you find yourself in captivity in your own room. A bad dream, which seems more like a reality sometimes.

name: Fates of Ort
short_description: Fates of Ort is a retro fantasy RPG focused on strategic action, in a land where time is frozen when you stand still. Cast powerful spells - but beware, they will cost you your life.

name: Blow Up Pieces: Unleashed
short_description: Blow Up Pieces is a single player and multiplayer game that you can play locally. Come on this adventure and help Mike save his world by destroying the falling blocks!

name: Blinding Blade
short_description: Blinding Blade is a multiplayer indie game with that allows players to use precision and finesse to defeat opponents ● Engage in skillful swordplay ● Take manual control of your blade to execute precision attacks and block blaster shots ● Multiplayer focused

name: Total 15
short_description: Challenge your problem-solving skills in this game.

name: Yoga Lesson VR
short_description: Become a Yoga Master of an adorable girl. Become her Yoga Master to instruct yoga poses from various angles and give the right advice. You can be hard on her at times, or cheer her up with presents. Instruct her so that she can get good grades in yoga competitions and pretty yoga clothes. She will thank you in her own way.

name: Mojo
short_description: "Mojo” is a new version of the famous game “2048”, an original approach to this well-known puzzle. Several beautiful girls will keep you company during the game. The more points you get, the less clothes remain on the girls.

name: Where's Baby
short_description: Where’s Baby is an asymmetrical multiplayer game pitting a baby sitter against WHAT IS THAT. WHY IS THAT KID SO FURRY! IS THAT A WEREWOLF? SHOULDN’T THEIR PARENTS HAVE MENTIONED THIS? HE BROKE THE TABLE! HE JUST TOUCHED IT AND IT EXPLODED!

name: Spellcaster University
short_description: Develop a prestigious university of mages. Build rooms, train your students, fight orcs, slay the bureaucrats, manage your budget... a director's life is not a quiet one.

name: Save The Cookie
short_description: Save the cookie from the terrible maw of Chester, the hungry pug. He will do everything necessary to steal your cookie! Who will be faster? Your reflexes or your gluttony and tricks?

name: Armajet
short_description: Unique 2.5D multiplayer jetpack combat that unites players around the world in competition. Cross-platform so you can access your progress and play on the go with your mobile device of choice. Updated frequently with new content and features, with good developer responsiveness!

name: ELECTRONIC STOCK TRADING SYSTEM
short_description: This Stock Trading Simulator is the most comprehensive trading system created. This game is so uncomplicated that anyone can play this simulation. The game is highly recommended for the novice trader and more seasoned traders. Buy and sell over 65 different stocks in 10 different sectors.

name: GunFu Heroes
short_description: GunFu Heroes is a quick-paced, 2-4 local multiplayer party game where your goal is to be the last one standing. A variety of weapons introduce different styles of play while various fighters and maps keep the game feeling fresh.

name: The Adventures of Mr. Fluffykins
short_description: Join Mr.Fluffykins on his epic adventure to find all of King Barts lost recipes. Explore Caves, Jungles, Frozen Tundras as well as the Wild West. Throw pumpkins, solve puzzles, shoot cannons, and join our royal kitty on an epic adventure.

name: Ollie-Oop
short_description: A game about a skateboarding dog named Ollie, who goes on the adventure of his dreams! Play with your pup friends and wreak havoc in all kinds of fantastical environments.

name: Kokorogawari
short_description: Kokorogawari (Change of Heart) is a GxB otome human drama visual novel set in a grounded and authentic portrayal of modern-day Japan. While the two main themes are about love and the arts, Kokorogawari also explores the complexity and depth of familial relationships and emotions.

name: URO
short_description: There was a world where URO alone lives. However, the color and sound disappeared from the world from one day. When wearing a glowing ornament, URO is wrapped in color and music I notice that music and colors are gone from the world. To regain music and color to the world again, I started running running my music.

name: WitchAction
short_description: One day, Corona tried to invite Noah for a date, and when I went to Noah's house ... Noah was turned into a sheep! Beside that there was a figure of a mischievous witch, Grette. The place I chased after was "world of sweets" produced by Grette.

name: Project Wingman
short_description: Project Wingman is a flight action game that lets you take the seat of advanced fighter jets and become a true ace. Fight in various missions and gamemodes ranging from intense aerial dogfights to large scale ground assault in an alternate scorched earth setting.

name: GrabBag
short_description: Test your reflexes and hand-eye coordination in this fast-paced VR game! Catch items flying past you as you speed down different immersive environments. Trigger multipliers with consistent streaks for the best score. Glory goes to those who grab the most!

name: The Chaotic Workshop
short_description: Ever wanted to know what would happen if you hooked up a fire extinguisher to a crate of TNT inside a room full of pinball bouncers and proximity mines. Well now you can. Welcome to The Chaotic Workshop

name: Maze Quest 1: The Forest
short_description: Maze Quest 1: The Forest is a simple relaxing puzzle game. Play as Sylvie the Elf and find your way home through 100 forest-themed maze levels.

name: Atlantic Edge
short_description: Atlantic Edge is a strategic VR brawler for HTC VIVE in which you play a mech pilot tasked with defending a city from an endless onslaught of kaiju. Will you save the city? Or cause as much damage as the kaiju?

name: Save Them
short_description: A Minimalist horror-themed Platformer. Guide your way through increasingly twisted landscapes as the mysterious narrative unfolds. Not everything is as it seems - your journey to Save Them begins here.

name: 《古斯塔奥：帝國重生》Gustavo Kingdom Rebirth
short_description: The story is mainly about the Gustavo empire. It is an empire ruled by women. After the death of the queen of the previous generation, Princess Nali, who should have succeeded to the throne, was arrested by her sister and exiled to the border of the Gustavo Empire. The player will play the heroine Nali.

name: 水时钟-Water_Clock

name: Clockwork Ambrosia

Players pull on the boots of an airship pilot to combat an army of deadly robots and monsters. Experiment with a range of rule-breaking weapon modifications and armors to prevail through this wild adventure!

name: Fortissimo FA INTL Ver
short_description: This is the whole package! Its got everything you're looking for. Combined perfectly with music, you'll be drawn in to the depth of 'Moe' and dragged right out to a hot-blooded battle. This is a galgame made with the tears and blood of the one and only La'cryma and proudly presented by SakuraGame.

name: The Impure
short_description: They looks same, just like they see us. The coastal city was teared down by earthquake and tidal wave caused by it. A group of black square creatures, was rescuing their brothers and sisters in the ruins day and night with all their efforts, even with their lives.

short_description: When John joined the police department, his future looked bright. He had a loving family, a promising career, and a moral code that prevented him from compromising with criminals. But while John's conscience kept him on an honest path, it also made him powerful enemies.

name: Evil Bank Manager
short_description: What could be better than having a million dollars, a billion? This will not make you all powerful in the world, your goal will not only be to make lots of money, but to print money and become a Federal reserve system

name: My Fox Sister|我的妖狐妹妹
short_description: The high school student's leading role was called by a mysterious woman. Actually, she was forced to adopt a fox. What's wrong with this world? Mysterious woman, you let go of the hero and rush to me.

name: Picross Bonbon - Nonogram

name: The Grand Museum VR

name: Liquidation

name: To Leave

name: Symphonics: Make Music in VR

short_description: You are a brave space trooper. Your mission is to clean an alien sector with a huge amount of enemies. Speaking shortly, you have to kill some aliens and return alive.

name: Mayonez - Dark Comedy Slav Adventure RPG

name: Eternal Edge +

name: Lucah: Born of a Dream
short_description: FOR THE POWER AND GLORY; NOW AND FOREVER

name: Whispering Flames
short_description: Whispering Flames is a fantasy visual novel. Neoth, a young prince tired of his troublesome royal duties, meets a curious, cheerful girl. This event turns everything on its head.

name: Stay Out of the House
short_description: Can you escape the home of a cannibal serial killer? It's only a matter of time until you're dinner!

name: Haunted Halls: Revenge of Doctor Blackmore Collector's Edition

Using you wits and whatever tools you can find you must disengage the door locks to escape before your air runs out.

short_description: From the creators of Angel Beats! and CLANNAD, Key, comes their latest emotional, award-winning journey. Follow protagonist Takahara Hairi as he travels to the secluded island Torishirojima, where he rediscovers what it means to enjoy summer vacation.

name: 无法传达的话语（Words cannot convey）
short_description: When will this love be conveyed to you? In the last year of high school, I want to convey this feeling to you.

name: Hacked: Hentai prison
short_description: What happens if you spend the whole day locked up and masturbate the code? That's right, you'll go crazy! Now you see the whole world in binary code, but the only thing that connects you to the real world is hentai!

name: Coloring Pixels
short_description: A relaxing coloring by numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with differing themes, complexity, and sizes.

name: Nous
short_description: If there is a simulator, and you are trying it, there is a strong chance that it simulates you rather than you simulate it…There is also a strong chance that you are not trying it, it actually tries you...Welcome to Nous...In philosophy, Nous means the faculty of intellectual apprehension and of intuitive thought.

name: Urban Explorer Golf
short_description: Urban Explorer Golf is a unique Puzzle Game in which you need a calm hand, sharp eyes and the ability to maneuver balls into a hole. But beware, this is not the golf experience you are used to see. Play with unique physical balltypes in locations all around the city, and maybe even somewhere else...

It's up to the player to try to find a way to escape the island and defeat the dragon while using all the resources on the island at their disposal.

name: The Survivalists
short_description: A living world full of surprises, secrets and danger awaits in The Survivalists, an adventure-filled survival sandbox set in The Escapists universe. Explore, build, craft and even train monkeys with up to three friends in a desperate bid to survive. Have you got what it takes to be a Survivalist?

name: Retroids
short_description: Challenge your opponent to the ultimate space match as you destroy asteroids and collect power-ups in this classic arcade-style game.

name: Study of Unusual: Forest of Secrets
short_description: In Study of Unusual: Forest of Secrets you are secret agent which went to unusual forest. You need to find out the reason of people disappearing. During the investigation you need to unravel the mystery of the forest, collecting notes and documents of disappeared people and try to stay alive.

short_description: Waveform Wipeout combines the fast paced action of pulling off a sick combo of tricks with the novelty of rhythm games. The levels are generated based on the song you pick, so the possibilities are endless.

name: Avem888
short_description: This classic arcade style flying game takes you through a everchanging landscape of objects you should avoid.

name: Scrapland Remastered
short_description: The cult game that marked MercurySteam's origins returns; a sci-fi adventure with memorable characters, powerful ships and humor! Enjoy intense Multiplayer battles and races with ships you build.

name: Death Fungeon
short_description: A puzzle platform game, with both stealth and parkour elements. Use your wits, cunning and agility to escape this deadly prison. Take the stealthy approach, progressing slowly, hiding and staying out of sight. Or utilise your athleticism to wall jump, ledge grab and speed run your way to freedom.

name: Gun Crazy
short_description: Gun Crazy is a fast paced and hectic arcade style action shoot em’ up sporting old school pixel art and a retro sound track.

name: Selfie Games [TV]: A Multiplayer Couch Party Game

In Sketchies, the first game in the collection, you snap selfies, draw absurd drawings featuring your friends faces, write hilarious fake captions for those drawings to...

Survive by fishing, cooking and growing your own food. Be careful though, the forest is as dangerous as it is wonderful.

Despite not knowing her, Brooke has a feeling that there is more to Kendra than she's letting everyone else see and is determined to find out what it is.

name: The Occluder
short_description: Investigate and film a sinister area in The Occluder! Uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearances while navigating a dangerous zone altered by a nuclear disaster. Use your camera and flashlight to document the chilling surroundings and escape the horrors that lurk within.

name: everybody's sad

short_description: SANTICIDE is the sixth volume of the arcade series UBERMOSH. A must buy for arcade and top-down enthusiasts.

name: Outback
short_description: Tasmania is a harsh environment and to make things worse, the world is ending. Do you have what it takes to survive?

name: Dorian Morris Adventure
short_description: Will the secrets of your missing grandfather be finally discovered? Who is your friend, and who should you avoid? What is the mysterious Book of Knowledge? Do you really know who you are and what is your destination?

name: Hentai City
short_description: Hentai City is a classic sliding puzzle game with 100 levels in Tokyo city theme.

name: SceneThere
short_description: Explore the world through interactive 360-video experiences

name: Premium Bowling
short_description: Premium Bowling is as close to real bowling as you'll get without picking up a physical bowling ball. Start the game and play like you're in a real bowling alley. Experience the realism in every throw, every hit, and every strike!

name: The Shapeshifting Detective
short_description: The Shapeshifting Detective is a supernatural murder mystery FMV game where you play as a detective who can shapeshift into other characters, allowing you to unlock secret conversations and private encounters.

name: Cubicus Arcanum
short_description: Come and see Cubicus Arcanum, a world where everything is a cube. Collect gems, shields and other objects that can be useful to solve riddles, discover secret places and create the path that leads you out from the risky and knotty dungeons to finally fight the enemy.

name: JUMP AND RUN - DON'T FALL
short_description: JUMP AND RUN - DON'T FALL is a simple but challenging First-Person platformer .

name: Zombie
short_description: You are surrounded by zombies. Unlike the zombies that are out to eat your brains. You can't stay awake forever.

name: Kubifaktorium
short_description: Build, manage and grow a thriving colony in Kubifaktorium. The game features different biomes to explore, plenty of resources to exploit, complex machinery to build and interesting production chains to master.

name: Super Robot Wars 30
short_description: 30 years on, the battle for our world's future continues. Super Robot Wars is a tactical RPG that brings characters and robots from a variety of mecha anime together to battle their mutual foes.

name: Escape Game
short_description: In Escape Game you will have to solve the different puzzles hidden in the house to escape!

name: Locomotion
short_description: Locomotion is a steamy railway puzzler. An alien stole your gold, and you’ve got to chase them into space to get it back. Haul wagons, flick switches, and reclaim your lost gold, through fifty-one increasingly tricky levels from home on the range to the final frontier.

name: Constructor Plus
short_description: Constructor Plus is the definitive building simulation for the modern day tycoon. Build your dream town full of crackpot undesirables, businesses, and quirky tenants whilst fending off your rivals in the eagerly awaited sequel to Constructor HD. With almost 3 times more content, building just got bigger!

name: Merv Liberation
short_description: A mix between classic old school platforming with puzzles, gravity and construction thrown in.

name: In Your Realm
short_description: In Your Realm gives an old-school, challenging, RPG roguelike experience with randomized encounters and a unique combat system. To beat the game the player needs to plow through every weakness of their personality - represented in the game as bosses in their respective worlds.

name: Endling - Extinction is Forever
short_description: As the last mother fox on Earth, your cubs need all your care to survive in a merciless world that slowly destroys itself. You have to help them, teach them and save them. And you should never forget that extinction is forever – in the real world and in this 2023 BAFTA award winning experience.

name: DASH: Danger Action Speed Heroes
short_description: Speedrun or explore hundreds of user-generated 2D platformer levels and experience the juicy and action-packed mechanics developed and invented by the community.

name: Axis & Allies 1942 Online
short_description: Play the classic board game, Axis & Allies 1942 2nd Edition! Act as WWII powers in a turn-based strategy game that fits your screen and schedule— get notified on your turn and command armies at your own pace! Team up with friends, challenge the world’s top players, or go solo vs. A.I.

name: Pingball Ultra
short_description: Pingball Ultra is an online multiplayer action game based on popular timeless classic: Pong. Defeat your opponent by force or use strategic debuffs to flip their controls, make them smaller or blind them. Game is very simple, no learning curve. Play versus random players or challenge your friends.

name: ulxrd
short_description: An abstract game created from new ideas. Your goal is to surround more pieces than your opponent first to make their pieces into dead pieces. To win, you must make it so your opponent has 3 or fewer living pieces first.

name: The Mine
short_description: You find yourself lost in a mine, the only objective is to find a way out. But something lurks in the shadows, following. Hunting you. Good luck. It's simply a game of cat and mouse. You can run and hide, but your ultimate goal is to find the key and escape the mine. While avoiding the monsters.

name: Warlords.io
short_description: Warlords.io is a Class-Based Top-Down Shooter with MOBA elements that features 4 Player Split-Screen and Cross-Platform Multiplayer in several competitive multiplayer modes and a cooperative Survival mode!

name: Chiptune DJ
short_description: Chiptune DJ is a rythm based game where you play along catchy 8-bit chiptune music to improve your rythmic and coordination skills. Build up your combos and beat your previous scores as you get better and better.

name: Ricecakers
short_description: Ricecakers is an easy and funny fighting game, controlling the ricecaker monster with different appearances, brandishing the hands or the weapons, fighting with the robots or friends for fun.

name: SUM
short_description: Through SUM VR, try to survive on another uninhabited island. Here you can build buildings, eat food, and do whatever you want to do. Buy now and get all future updates for free.

name: 小林正雪復仇之密室重制版 Cheney Wood The Ultimate Revenge
short_description: 香港，密室逃脱，刑侦推理，解谜！ 风流倜傥略爱搞怪的刑警，屡破奇案，轻松应付着海量的案件与狡猾的罪犯，直到那件事的发生……为了逃避最不喜欢的人，他调职到这座城市。然而，等待他的将是从警以来最大的敌人和暗中策划的巨大阴谋。外表看似有些憨傻，推理却过于常人的谜样男子小林正雪，能带领刑侦组走出困境吗？

name: Voronium - Locust Sols
short_description: Voronium takes place on a planet far away. Mankind has discovered Voronium which became it's ultimate energy source. Your job is to protect the Voronium mining operation at all cost, building defensive structures and operating them simultaneously. On VR only.

name: A Piece of Wish upon the Stars
short_description: Graduated from high school, Guang gave up the opportunity to enter college and began to work, making a living for him and his little sister. However, all things seem to change in this summer. The hidden wish of Guang's little sister leads the track of their lives to meet in one midsummer day.

name: Windstorm: An Unexpected Arrival
short_description: In the official game based on the movie ’Windstorm: Ari’s Arrival’, experience the story of Ari as she arrives in the Alpine area and quickly befriends Windstorm. Together they will go on exciting horse riding adventures and discover the true meaning of friendship!

name: Fly of butterfly
short_description: Fly, butterfly, fly. Relaxing game for those who do not like stress and like when everything is simple and easy.

name: Last Stand: REBORN
short_description: Last Stand: Reborn (also known as LSR) focuses on the events after the "Project: uxUV" which takes place during the year 2029. LSR takes influence from games such as HL2 and The Hidden and Doom. There are multiple game modes which put in in either 1vX situations or against each other.

name: BlamBox
short_description: BlamBox is a unique, score chasing arcade game that's simple to learn but hard to master. Push your aiming skills to the limit as you shoot the boxes through the goals!

name: The night of fire stealing/盗火之夜
short_description: The night of fire stealing is a retro wind JRPG game made by RPGmaker MV. The game is set in China during 1920. You play as Zhou Shuren, who adventures in Shanghai with two girl administrators, Friedrich and Karl, while exploring an unknown world full of mythological and philosophical elements.

name: Iron Danger
short_description: Iron Danger is a tactical combat puzzler with a unique time manipulation mechanic. A never before seen combination that blends the tactical depth of turn-based games with the exciting action of real-time games.

name: Mendel
short_description: Mendel is a chill sandbox game about growing weird plants from alien genetics.

name: Xenon Racer
short_description: It’s the year 2030, the era of flying vehicles. A one-off championship for wheel based vehicles has been organised, with cutting-edge electric cars boosted by Xenon gas. Drift through cities like Tokyo and Dubai as fast as you can and claim eternal glory!

name: GOD EATER 3
short_description: Set in a post-apocalyptic setting, it’s up to your special team of God Eaters to take down god-like monsters devastating the world. With an epic story, unique characters, and all new God Arcs and Aragami, the latest evolution in ACTION is here!

name: Shores Unknown
short_description: A turn-based RPG with deep character-driven combat, and a story written by Final Fantasy veterans. Finding yourself on the wrong side of the Crown, you and your companions must fight or perish. Build a team of mercenaries, forge alliances, and explore distant lands.

name: Chook & Sosig: Walk the Plank
short_description: Chook & Sosig: Walk the Plank is a charming point-and-click adventure about tabletop gaming, mischievous friends, and spectral poultry.

name: Girls Dance
short_description: Girls invite you to their world, join them and admire their beautiful movements in a dance on a spectacular stage. Unlock new dances and clothes by scoring certain amounts of points.

name: Cosmi-Cave 64
short_description: You are a subterranean ore digging cosmonaut. Dive deep into procedurally generated caves and mine rare minerals for cold, hard cash that you can spend on hot, soft jet fuel (among other things!) So spelunk, upgrade, and find the fabled Atlas Globe!

name: PROTEST
short_description: Long adventure of two girls in love! Cute anime girls struggle with discrimination. Only you can help save their pure love! Exciting RPG with nice anime graphics!

name: My First Music Workshop
short_description: This game is a music workshop simulator game where you need to fix musical instruments.

name: Heliophobia
short_description: Heliophobia is a first-person horror/mystery adventure presented through a surreal, non-linear narrative. You awake on a vacant plane, given only a singular task: kill the one with the initials "J.R.".

name: So, uh... a spaceship crashed in my yard.
short_description: A spaceship named Aria crashed into your front yard! Now it's up to you to find the parts she needs to escape Earth.

name: Waifu School
short_description: A romantic & sexy school visual novel mixed with an addicting match-3 puzzle. 10 cute girls are waiting for you... (UNCENSORED VERSION)

name: Her 她
short_description: This is a antique style game with TCG & LVG ,you need to carry out the character training of Katie (heroine) in 90 days and finish all the plots. There are 21 endings.

name: Last Epoch
short_description: Uncover the Past, Reforge the Future. Ascend into one of 15 mastery classes and explore dangerous dungeons, hunt epic loot, craft legendary weapons, and wield the power of over a hundred transformative skill trees. Last Epoch is being developed by a team of passionate Action RPG enthusiasts.

name: Spaceball
short_description: Did you ever wonder what sports would be like on the moon? This dynamic multiplayer game will have you on the edge of your seat for hours to come! Mixing elements of Rugby with the low gravity of the moon, you can work as a team to score goals against your opponents.

name: 校园恋物语|Love in School
short_description: Campus love is not so much interest entanglement, only pure I love you and you love me. Love in School tells a short love story, simple and fresh.

name: The Greater Good
short_description: The Greater Good is a stylized homage to classic turn-based RPGs. Comes complete with an epic story, optional superbosses, world map, NEW GAME+, and more. Unique graphics and a kickin' soundtrack make it look and sound like no other game.

name: NEKOPARA Extra
short_description: About half a year before the opening of the patisserie, La Soleil where the catgirls work with Kashou. Back when Chocola and Vanilla were still kittens when they first arrived at the Minaduki household and before they opened up to the other catgirls.

name: LVN Fake News
short_description: LVN Fake News is an adult orientated visual novel. Nadiya, your main female character, must unravel the mystery of the LVN News program. What deep dark secrets will she discover? Are her fellow reporters all they seem to be? And whatever you do, you must not report fake news.

name: Meeple Station
short_description: Build your way to success! Trade your way to the top! Explore your way to infamy! Do it all your way!

name: ELEX II
short_description: In this sequel to the vintage Open World RPG ELEX, Jax must once again unite the free people of the Science-Fantasy world of Magalan against a new threat - the Skyands, who want to change the face of the planet forever.

name: Amber's Airline - High Hopes
short_description: Fasten your seat belt and take off with Amber Hope in a new airline game!

name: Free Throw
short_description: A simple game in which you only have to click the screen with your mouse. There are several unique levels.

name: Reventure
short_description: The one and only non-linear adventure with 100 different endings. Don't just wishlist me. I'm not that expensive... also, look at those reviews!

name: Veritas
short_description: Uncover the lies. Free your mind. Veritas is a compact narrative puzzle game that asks: what is truth, and does it even matter?

name: King-Dom
short_description: A two-player online (choose an opponent from your Steam friends list) Chess, in an edgeless landscape called "Kingland", with upgrades.

name: Terror
short_description: What happened with human, who stay in subway... on the all night?

name: Stockpile
short_description: Stockpile is an economic, stock-market themed game that's all about insider trading!

name: Indian Summer
short_description: Uwe Rosenberg's puzzle follow-up to the smash hit Cottage Garden!

name: Algae
short_description: A cute 2D puzzler where you take control of imaginatively named 'Algae' - an experimental sentient algae. Use Algae's abilities to clone and morph through mind-bending puzzles, avoiding enemies at every turn to break free from the confines of it's world...

name: Sacred Fire: A Role Playing Game
short_description: A text-based RPG full of choice and action. Fight for survival in the midst of the Roman invasion of ancient Caledonia. Strategize one dice roll at a time as emotions affect your performance. Use willpower to outsmart opponents, gain allies, wage war, or strive for peace. How will your story end?

name: Power Gunner
short_description: Gun your way towards survival in this action arcade adventure! Use your fuel supply to find upgrades to your ship and collect more fuel to keep progressing against harder and harder foes! Classic arcade action with a unique control scheme to pilot your ship.

name: Bunny Minesweeper
short_description: Multiplayer in Minesweeper? Yes! Play with your friends or random party in classic Minesweeper or try crazy challenging modes! Fun and hard simultaneously!

name: Serenade of the Sirens
short_description: Serenade of the Sirens is a retro, rogue-lite, dungeon crawler. As a mermaid named Seika, discover the hidden mystery of the underwater cave.

name: Adventure Portal
short_description: Adventure Portal is a platform that allows players to connect and run their pen and paper role playing campaigns online!

name: The Castles of Burgundy
short_description: Stefan Feld's highly decorated board game "The Castles Of Burgundy" by Ravensburger is getting its digital version on Steam! Enjoy against the challenging AI or friends a beautiful digital version of the classic board game!

name: FALL 坠落之后
short_description: 小红和小蓝是一对要好的朋友，一次意外使她们从山崖坠落。再次醒来时，周围尽是恐怖的怪物、凄凉的白骨，到处都是危险的陷阱……她们能否成功逃离？

name: Wunderwaffe
short_description: Wunderwaffe - a game of tanks with a view from above. There are three game modes (team battle for killing, each for himself for killing, capturing a flag) in this game. Also the game is on the same computer.

name: Privateers
short_description: Privateers is a roguelite set in a fantasy nautical world. Players are set free into an archipelago where they can become a heroic navy captain or an evil pirate overlord depending on the choices that they make.

name: Dead Man's Fault
short_description: A short psychological horror game about descending into a cave.

name: Soter
short_description: Play the role of a planet trying to keep the few humans who remain alive as you travel through an asteroid field in this simulator inspired by the classic Maxis game Sim Earth.

name: Turbo Cat Fight
short_description: Turbo Cat Fight is an Experimental Pixel Perfect Fighting Game. Both players get to choose their loadouts and they fight it out! Challenge your friend to an ultimate showdown of an earthshaking fist trade!

name: ABAN
short_description: Experience one of the oldest forms of gaming with this ball-and-stick multiplayer game. Can you catch ABAN?

name: Pixel Fishies
short_description: Lead a school of fish to eat food, grow, and destroy! Retro arcade action for 1-16 players.

name: Displacement Arcade Game Box
short_description: The Displacement Arcade Game Box is a collection of 10 wonderful games from multiple genres (but mostly arcade), fully set up for you to compete with your friends in Steam! Challenge your friends to beat your high score, or beat theirs!

name: AstroViking
short_description: AstroViking is a horde-survival shoot em' up with RPG elements! Forge your own superpowered Viking with 60+ upgrade nodes and take on an endless swarm of aliens!

name: Everyday Baseball VR
short_description: Everyday Baseball VR is a VR baseball game which is based in real baseball. We've been continuously mulling over how to improve convenience without losing realism so that people can easily play our game whether they are familiar with baseball or not.

name: The Last Cube
short_description: Cube puzzler and an epic adventure. Stamp stickers to the sides of your cube to imbue each surface with unique powers, which are vital to solving puzzles and finding secrets.

name: Super Zombie Arcade
short_description: Take on the zombie horde in this post apocalyptic crazy adventure. This game gets more and more difficult and crazier zombies spawn when player reach higher levels. Unlock new weapons by reaching higher levels. How many can you kill? How long will you last? watch out for the runners

name: conNEcT01
short_description: AI was built for replacing human, but as the time goes on, she was abandoned in abandoned district. Then how will she face to the life day by day?

name: The Misadventures of Denniz & Diana
short_description: The Siblings Denniz and Diana have to traverse a multitude of areas by jumping, sliding, climbing and fighting through them in this 2D-Jump'n'Run. Meanwhile, they encounter a... Mechanic-Pirate? Well, they have to stop him, whatever his plan actually is.

name: Headshot VR
short_description: Remember the days of online shooters, remember sleepless nights in computer clubs, emotions, adrenaline, rapture and rage. The multiplayer shooter HeadShotVR will immerse you in a dynamic atmosphere of virtual reality using the HTC Vive.

name: AXIOM SOCCER
short_description: Axiom Soccer is a high speed evolution of vehicular soccer combining fast-paced driving with tactical shooting mechanics for a new soccer experience. Inspired by real world ball games, go it alone or team up with friends and blast through divisions to pursue Axiom Soccer championship glory.

name: Kings
short_description: Are you a good king or a corrupt king? As a king you can choose to take matters into your own hands and become a leader, or you can choose to become a fanatic of the church and let your people go hungry!

name: BinaryBotsVR
short_description: Binary VR is a virtual reality experience of HEX WORLD, Binary leaves in HEX WORLD with his friend DIMM.

name: Beast Agenda 2030
short_description: Inspired by Escape From New York, Shadowrun SNES and Genesis, Deus Ex and H.P. Lovecraft, Beast Agenda 2030 is a Stealth, Gadgets and Hacking focused Action RPG with optional permadeath that encourages you to use your brain to complete missions in procedurally generated city districts.

name: Card Battle Spirit Link
short_description: Get ready for a new kind of digital multiplayer card game. No shuffled decks, no random card packs. In Card Battle Spirit Link, strategy is the key!

name: Cash Rush
short_description: Cash Rush is a Shop Game simulator. Create your business from scratch, use decorations to increase your margin, hire new employee and start making the billions you deserve!

name: Fairy Knights
short_description: The new dynamic puzzle RPG! Hit the road with cute heroes!

name: Drying Paint Simulator VR
short_description: After a long and cold journey, "the artist" has finally arrived at his deserted cabin in the woods. The perfect peaceful place to create his final masterpiece. The artist's Magmum Opis. Drying Paint Simulator VR is the narrated exhilarating story of an artist (you) creating their last painting. A masterpiece.

name: Tranzient
short_description: Make beats in VR. Full looping music production and sequencing environment in VR with visuals.Who made the beats? You did! This is not a rhythm game.

name: Brigador Killers
short_description: BRIGADOR KILLERS is an intense story-driven isometric action game. Can a secret hit team of Solo Nobreans get revenge on the traitors deep in enemy territory, and still get out alive? The mercenary violence of BRIGADOR (2016) spills over onto a new planet, with revised controls and an all-new storyline.

name: Last Oasis
short_description: Nomadic Survival MMO. Build wooden walking machines to travel to new lands. Create clans and fight for territory. Resources deplete fast, so take your sword and scavenge, pirate, and trade to stay alive.

name: American University Life ~Welcome Week!~
short_description: Take the role of first year student Skye in his first week of college on a remote getaway. Meet his four other roommates as they learn to live together, set boundaries, and engage in their lifestyle.

name: Defense: Abominations
short_description: Defense: Abominations is a first person tower defense game where you try to survive the abominations stored in the laboratory, as long as you can.

name: Slicer
short_description: A VR take on a bullet hell. Dodge incoming bullets or block them with a sword to earn points

name: Ashes
short_description: Ashes is a first person narrative with melee combat, puzzles and light platforming. It is a mix between games like skyrim and a walking simulator, a short experience to be enjoyed in one sitting where you can explore a dungeon and be immersed in the character's story and the adventure.

name: 40 Steps to Valhalla
short_description: Welcome to the devastated world of Path To Valhalla. You´ll help Enki, a worthy ANUNNAKI from the Sirian civilation at Mother Earth, to find Anubis´ lost child, Kalilah. They will face one main challenge ahead: to free all humans from slavery by the hands of the Warlord Khao Rá.

name: KOPICS
short_description: KOPICS is the dress-up-game generator. You can create dress-up games with sounds and motions. You can publish your games freely.

name: Initial 2 : New Stage
short_description: “Initial Ⅱ” is a fast-paced hack & slash featured Action RPG. It tells a tale of both the super-power war and the friendship. Our Heroine wields 4 types of weapons and can dynamically switch between them at will. Hope you like it!

name: My Holiday
short_description: 画风清奇的RPG作品，故事讲述的是一个小学3年僧，随父母回老家的5天假期生活。在老家的小区你会遇到一群性格各异的小盆宇，展开一张并不是很激烈的假期冒险。

name: Marbledrome: Crazy Stunt Balls
short_description: Original game system, novel, fun and different from any game of racing balls. Compete against other players from around the world to get the best time on each track.

name: Family Man
short_description: You owe us money, Joe, and we plan to collect. We don't care where it comes from, but you'd better not skip town on us. Otherwise your family will be searching the river for your body.

name: Vambrace: Cold Soul
short_description: Vambrace: Cold Soul is a story-driven roguelite set amidst a frozen landscape. Plan expeditions, then journey to the cursed city surface with your party. Wield unique powers, avoid traps, brave strange encounters, and survive deadly combat in this gothic fantasy adventure!

name: Cardpocalypse
short_description: Make friends, play cards, twist the rules, become a Mega Mutant Power Pets master, and try to save the world in this single-player RPG about being a 90's kid.

name: Fishing Simulator
short_description: Avoid the crocodile attack or angry shark while casting a fishing rod! Love building, constructing and have a hobby called fishing? Catch the best fish (marlin, shark, goldfish, catfish, salmon etc.) or an old shoe or… a mermaid!

name: Swing the cat
short_description: Have you ever wondered if your room is too small to swing a cat? Disclaimer: We have no responsibility should the answer be 'No' and you hit your controller based cat off a wall, monitor, television or significant other. Swing your cat around, build up speed and let it go! How far will it go? No one knows.

name: Type Defense
short_description: Write to fight! Desert bandits are coming, defend your castle! Everyone knows typing is the best way to use a ballista!

name: Port Valley
short_description: The (not so) classic Point & Click adventure where perspective changes everything! Witness Port Valley's Election Day from 3 points of view and find out what's really going on in this bizarre town.

name: Grompula
short_description: Grompula is a high octane wave based survival game. Fight through endless waves of Grompuloids to save the Glorkon race, and banish Grompula back to limbo, where he belongs. With tons of weapons, items, and abilities at your disposal, you might just be able to claim back what's rightfully yours.

name: ARTIFICIAL
short_description: ARTIFICIAL is a physics based first-person puzzle platformer inspired by Portal & Half-Life series. Interact with the environment, pick up and throw objects, sneak around enemies, control intricate physics-based mechanisms and learn how to survive in the underground colony of the Asteroid 2031 XT

name: Red Embrace: Hollywood
short_description: 1996—Los Angeles, CA. A young newcomer is turned into a vampire and thrust into the dark underworld of society, forced to sink or swim. You are that newcomer.

name: Erotic Jigsaw Challenge Vol 2
short_description: Answer the call and take on 20 all new sexy jigsaw puzzles! Photo Gallery unlocks with every win! New Steam Achievements!

name: Indiana Jones® and the Infernal Machine™
short_description: The year is 1947. The Nazis have been crushed, the Cold War has begun and Soviet agents are sniffing around the ruins of the fabled Tower of Babel. What are they up to? The CIA recruits renowned archeologist and adventurer, Dr. Henry "Indiana" Jones, to find out.

name: TOK
short_description: Tok is a game where you will have to solve a puzzle by connecting all dots with lines.

name: Arcade LA Deadzone
short_description: SUPPORTS TRADITIONAL ARCADE INDIVIDUAL 'POD' SETUPS AS WELL AS FREE-ROAM BACKPACK PC.

name: Small Sister
short_description: Small Sister is a game about a contest: "living in a house with strangers". The goal is to gain as many points as you can by interacting with other contestants and to be the winner at the end.

name: Dairy Farm Simulator
short_description: A 2D RPG simulation game that you can build a dairy farm, build a town, and to create and enjoy your own life by living by your rules.

name: HotHead
short_description: Play as HotHead as he rids the world of pesky monsters.

name: Down Ward
short_description: Venture into the haunted wilds with Gable, a little owl, as she sets out to rekindle the dormant relics of a land long abandoned to ruin.

name: 东方试闻广纪 ~ Perfect Memento of Touhou Question
short_description: You will face Hundreds of Touhou rumours of it's origin setting, Some of them are right, Others are totally lies. Do your best to judge them as Right or Wrong.

name: Zniw Adventure
short_description: Zniw Adventure is a hand-drawn point and click adventure game with a strong 90's vibe and cartoon animations. Play as Zniw - a yellow female dinosaur who is on a mission to find the ultimate gift for her mother's hatchday!

name: Divine Miracle Defense
short_description: Divine Miracle Defense is an tower defense game with an magic theme and few roguelike which make it very unique. You have to build an defense line with mages and upgrade them to stay alive as long as possible. when you die, you get a few special points depending on how long you survived.

name: DeepWeb
short_description: DeepWeb is a retrofuturistic platformer with a unique retrowave soundtrack where you’re trapped in a TRON-like virtual reality created by an artificial intellegence in the future. Your goal is to reach central facility of the DeepWeb network, disable it and escape the virtual world.[/b]

name: Ambition
short_description: Ambition is a 2D strategy RPG game that explores a village with teleporters to dangerous dungeons. In this strange and quirky world, battle bosses like a one-eyed turtle with a fancy tophat, a giant centipede that lurks quietly in the desert, and many more!

name: Ectolibrium
short_description: Play as an alien creature hauled from your homeworld and discarded as waste. Leap, cling and fly your way through the ruins. Spread ectoplasm. Sprout seeds to spawn alien allies and transform the environment from a wasteland to a thriving alien garden. Discover your role in a strange new world.

name: VR Jogger
short_description: Get started on the trail to a healthier you with VR Jogger today!

name: Midnight Wave
short_description: Midnight Wave is a samurai cyberpunk tactical action RPG with immense customization, narrative choice, and innovative gameplay mechanic combinations, set in a world full of katanas, mega corporations, and elemental powers.

name: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator
short_description: In the game FatEx Courier Simulator, you play as a courier for special tasks. You will have to deliver many parcels, despite all adversities.

name: 25 Cadre of Death
short_description: The dead city of Time Beach, in the American state of Misuri, generates a sense of fear and loneliness. This city and its districts are completely cut off from the real world.
