short_description: Halloween Puzzles. It‘s a clever and colorful learning experience. Puzzles are a challenging young minds, teaching and preparing them early in life some very important life skills. Halloween Puzzles will strike your imagination in assorted piece counts, shapes and levels of difficulty. Dozens of Halloween Puzzles to suit any puzzler.

name: Super Urban Wizard
short_description: The evil Sowron has stolen the one bling It’s up to Gundolf the Wizard to take the fight to Sowron, and bust a cap in the A** of Evil!

name: Angry Punisher
short_description: Sharpen your axes and put on your masks because today you are going to punish them all! After all you are a punisher! ANGRY PUNISHER!

name: Bomb N' Bats
short_description: Welcome to the world of Bomb N' Bats. Be the last Bat alive in this local multiplayer game where you can play up to 4 players.

name: ZET
short_description: One-button indie platformer adventure

name: The Warrior
short_description: After an prison outbreak has gone wrong, surviving inmate Tom Feltrod comes face to face with an inmate who considers himself a "Warrior".

name: The Kite
short_description: The Kite is a small dramatic point-and-click adventure. The game highlights the problems of a struggling family.

name: Hazelnut Bastille
short_description: Hazelnut Bastille is a topdown, Zelda-like ARPG, crafted in a 16bit character; it features action-adventure style gameplay. Players will engage with heavily tactical, real-time combat, and experience taxing lateral-thinking puzzles!

name: Worlds Collide
short_description: Worlds Collide is a real-time strategy game.In the game of Worlds Collide, you will play as a king of your empire, to build a city, expand its territory, gather enough resources, set up more production lines, eventually form your army and conquer others.

name: Blood Card 2: Dark Mist
short_description: Dark Mist is a card game that combines elements of the roguelike deckbuilder genre with enemies that appear in waves. Defeat monsters and level up during battle to keep yourself going.

name: Iron Vulture
short_description: Iron Vulture is a squad-based tactical Roguelite game where players command a team of elite soldiers in a fight for survival. Choose 4 soldiers, each with unique abilities and roles, and dive into procedurally generated maps filled with strategic challenges and fast-paced combat.

name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 7: Xtreme Legends Definitive Edition
short_description: The new modes and replay elements of "Xtreme Legends", even including downloadable content, have been packed into the thrilling one vs. one-thousand action game "DYNASTY WARRIORS 7", comprising a massive single title that is available now for a reasonable price!

name: Necro Story
short_description: Necro Story is a creature-collection RPG where you play as a (kind of) evil necromancer more into undead shenanigans than saving the world! Command quirky minions, outsmart foes, and snag their souls to power up your team. Expect strategic combat, laughs, and plenty of mischief.

name: Stormhill Mystery: Family Shadows
short_description: Stormhill Mystery: Family Shadows is a fantastic casual puzzle adventure game. This is an excellent family story with a paranormal twist! Your family’s past is more interesting than any story. And it's not over yet...

name: Defentures
short_description: Defentures - defense mid-core game. Lead your dwarves, help them to reach treasures. Choose their tiers, use magic and upgrade global skills.

name: Close To The Sun
short_description: Deep in international waters, Tesla’s Helios stands still. An unbound utopia for scientific research, Rose Archer steps aboard in search of her sister, quickly to discover not all is as it seems. A single word covers the entrance… QUARANTINE!

name: It's Not A Moon
short_description: Manage a space station, flying through a procedually generated universe, fight, build and survive in the coldness of space.

name: The Fur in Me
short_description: The Fur in Me is a 2D single-player platform adventure featuring color based mechanics, beautiful 4k visuals and rich storytelling.

name: A night with Natalie VR
short_description: Have some fun time with Natalie, the virtual lady of your dreams!

name: Sakura MMO 2
short_description: Viola’s quest in the land of Asaph continues. Supported by her party of cute girls, she tries to learn who summoned her to Asaph, and why. Will she finally uncover the truth?

name: Lumberjack's Dynasty
short_description: A unique life simulation where you are a lumberjack building up a business and founding a lasting dynasty for generations to come.

name: mikapyon
short_description: miKaPyon is a rabbit girl in a colorful 3D platformer full of fast freerunning and jump challenges, wall-jumps and sliding over hills and loops.

name: The Lost Soul
short_description: The Lost Soul is an arcade difficulty-focused platformer , made in a minimalist style. 13 different levels, each of which contain it’s own unique soundtrack, checkpoint system, as well as many secrets.

name: Tales of the Aswang VR
short_description: Tales of the Aswang is a VR game that explores the myths and the epic creatures of Filipino oral tradition compiled from books written by Maximo Ramos and stories passed on through generations of storytelling and remembrance.

name: Cult of the Glitch King
short_description: A 2D horror adventure with predominant puzzle and minor stealth and survival elements centered on mysterious occult & sci-fi themes.

name: OkunoKA Madness
short_description: Test your reflexes and coordination with more than 100 levels to complete and 3 speedrun modes. Do You have what it takes?

name: Up in the Air
short_description: Up in the Air is a zany, open-world game made by students at SMU Guildhall. You play as a balloon dog exploring a demented carnival populated by crazy children using a variety of power-ups, like water balloons and ground pound, to fend the kids off and collect carnival tickets.

name: Death Space
short_description: You play as a scientist named Elmagamed at the 69th space station and you got to escape from a monstrous mutant.

name: Siam Twinstick
short_description: A badass, adrenaline pumping twinstick-shooter!

name: Flynguin Station
short_description: Flynguin Station is a casual projectile-endless runner game with RPG elements. Save the penguins by re-discovering the secrets of flight! Fly as far as possible, level up, upgrade your penguin and customize him to your liking.

name: The Way of Wrath
short_description: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.

name: The Dungeon Paradox
short_description: A genre-defining phase-based tactical RPG - lead a team of Operators into a world of monsters, puzzles and treasures while discovering the events that lead to their new fantastic adventure

name: Hentai Memorama
short_description: Memory game with a nice challenge and a happy ending

name: Dereliction
short_description: Real time tactical combat. Play the role of the commander. take back a derelict space ship from an alien infestation.

name: Warp Glider
short_description: Pilot a gravity-defying craft at blazing speeds. Pull off aerial acrobats using stackable weapons to survive the swarming Bandits. Retro arcade action and out of this world flight control! Now with Co-op!

name: Cope Island: Adrift
short_description: Visit a paradise of self improvement. Return a better version of yourself.

name: Pattern
short_description: Sometimes art isn't the product of a grand vision but rather the process. It's hard to know what you are trying to say until you've already said it.

name: Brave Hero Yuusha EX
short_description: Familiar tales can take unfamiliar turns! And it's up to you to reconstruct the story!

name: NekoMiko
short_description: The main character is an unfortunate man who can't do anything well. One fateful day, he meets 2 cat-eared shrine maidens by the name of Ayame and Kaede at an old shrine, and ends up living with them! Set in Akihabara, enjoy this adventure game of the slightly dirty-minded and eventful cohabitation life with 2 cat-eared shrine maidens.

name: Yearning
short_description: This 2D horror game is set in Edo period of Japan. The girl notices that her old sister has disappeared. The girl will look for her and clues of her. What will the girl find in end of the story?

name: Omno
short_description: A single-player journey of discovery through an ancient world of wonders, created by solo developer Jonas Manke.

name: Car Transporter 2013
short_description: Highly polished cars are placed in front of the carshops waiting for buyers. To provide the dealers with the necessary cars you transport the vehicles under pressure to their final destination. Load trucks with the desired cars and avoid any scratches or damage during charging.

name: Woodcutter Simulator 2011
short_description: The smell of tree resin is in the air when Woodcutter Simulator 2011 is started. Here the player is the master of a modern wood processing plant and is allowed to take over pithy tasks – feel as if you were in Canada's forests yourself.

name: BattleRush: Ardennes Assault
short_description: Multiplayer action game in the entourage of the Second World War with total destruction of the environment. Complete freedom of action. Do anything and anywhere. Build defense, demolish enemy towns, control any vehicle which you will see on your way or create.

name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
short_description: Are you ready, kids? The cult classic is back, faithfully remade in spongetastic splendor! Play as SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy and show the evil Plankton that crime pays even less than Mr. Krabs.

name: Puzzles for smart: Horses
short_description: Puzzles for smart: Horses - for fans of popular puzzles of different complexity. Collect puzzle with the image of these beautiful horses.

name: Gems of Magic: Lost Family
short_description: This magical Match 3 Adventure makes you work. Simple at the start, but quite challenging when you are further in the game. Enjoy the beautiful graphics, and use the power ups sagaciously. Save the colorful creatures of the lost family in the magic forest by solving the puzzles until their freedom.

name: Psychoverse City
short_description: Dive into the trippy gravity shifted world of PSYCHOVERSE CITY and platform across the rooftops of an ever-evolving cityscape, accompanied by adrenalin-pumping beats!

name: Snares of Ruin Zero
short_description: A short prequel to Snares of Ruin, showing the infection outbreak and other harrowing events over the course of 2 weeks leading up to Hank's and Gwen's arrival in the city.

name: Trinity VR
short_description: Trinity is the pilot for the first live-action, immersive, interactive, virtual reality sci-fi experience… In a future where humans have long been extinct, the last surviving androids fight a final war for freedom against an all-powerful Singularity, their God…Who am I? What role do I play in the story?

name: Reynard
short_description: Reynard is a mixture of procedurally generated action RPG and a Tower Defense genre with roguelike elements. It has been influenced by classics such as The Legend of Zelda and an indie classic - The Binding of Isaac.

name: Hentai Plus Girl
short_description: Hentai Plus Girl - a logical game in which your task is to collect puzzles and open the pictures.

name: 3 Days in the Abyss
short_description: 3 Days in the Abyss is a Biblical based 2D Top Down Action game, where the Spirit of the Savior must traverse through Hell for three days to find the Righteous Captives.

name: Sierra Madre: The Wild West
short_description: Sierra Madre: The Wild West is a western, open world first person shooter survival game set in the 1870s. You play as a U.S. Marshall in the Wild West. Hunt outlaws, save the locals, and do whatever it takes to survive in your quest to rid the Wild West of injustice.

name: Campido
short_description: Campido is a unique card game which challenge your wits, strategy, memory and management skills. The game is set in a fantasy universe, in which humanoid mammals are replacing the regular and normal human characters you are always used to see.

name: Witoo VR photo viewer
short_description: Witoo VR is a virtual reality experience to visualize your 360° photos

name: Ancra
short_description: A narrative driven, puzzle-horror game. Solve cryptic puzzles, embrace or evade vengeful specters, decide who to trust and unravel a mystery.

name: Dr. Schplot's Nanobots
short_description: A challenging, story-driven puzzle adventure that takes place inside your intestines. Solve challenging puzzles with experimental mechanics, collect nanobots with unique abilities and discover the identity of the reclusive Dr. Schplot. The fate of humanity rests in your hands!

name: Hulì The Mage
short_description: Are you looking for a game both relaxing and adrenalinic? A weird plot with lots of NPCs and monsters to slay? Then, this is the game you are looking for. Beware! Do not get fooled by the nice and happy graphics, it is not as easy as you may think.

name: Re.poly
short_description: Build on what was once and defend it with your life. Survive the wild and defeat the evil, alone or with friends in a wonderful poly world.

name: Our Lovely Escape
short_description: Your life is a peaceful one. Each day, you work alongside your (otherwise?) all-female workforce in the pursuit of creating otome games. Will you complete your life with a cute girlfriend? Will you be doomed to a life of normalcy? Or...? Find out in this (mostly...?) normal visual novel!

name: Descent of Man
short_description: Descent of Man is a stealth, survival horror game. Experience fear, a historically inspired narrative, and puzzle solving while hunted by intelligent and nightmarish enemies. Use deception to escape and unravel the dark history of a dystopian world's past and it's horrifying present.

name: Spot The Oddity
short_description: Nowadays we look videos more than pictures. So, spot the differece's age is gone! Now is the time of Spot The Oddity!

name: Emerald Shores
short_description: Emerald Shores is a challenging SNES-inspired platformer with a bunch of twists. Level up, take on rewarding sidequests, play a variety of minigames, unlock secret levels, raise a pet monster, and more! Can you liberate the floating island world of Emerald Shores from its captors?

name: 秦殇 (Prince of Qin)
short_description: 《秦殇》（Prince of Qin）是一款由目标软件公司开发的动作角色扮演游戏，该游戏已于2002年7月6日发行。本次进行重新上架，主旨是为了曾经深爱《秦殇》这款游戏的玩家在时隔20年后，能重新追忆当年的风采，特此针对现在的系统运行环境及显示器尺寸优化了分辨率，支持窗口化及1080P分辨率。

name: 蓝宝石般的被害妄想少女/Damsel with persecutory delusion
short_description: A strange letter came to the girl's hand, pointing to a vicious robbery and murder in Qinshan Port City more than a decade ago. Li Meiyuan, a 17-year-old female high school student, lives in depression and delusion all the time. She almost excludes everything around her.

name: 黑暗料理?!
short_description: 这是一款你从未玩过的餐厅模拟游戏！高度自由的做菜玩法，创造和探索菜谱，昼夜系统结合了农场牧场的经营养成，顾客口味偏好多种多样，还有更多奇葩内容等你探索

name: STEINS;GATE: My Darling's Embrace
short_description: Fall in love with the lab members all over again in this sweet and slapstick romantic comedy!

name: CHAOS;CHILD
short_description: From the creators of the critically acclaimed STEINS;GATE comes a sensational new visual novel: CHAOS;CHILD. Set in Shibuya in 2015, a group of high school students who survived an earthquake six years ago find themselves at the center of a new series of bizarre murders in the city.

name: Cubicity: Slide puzzle
short_description: Buddy, you’re in the cubic world! It has its own laws and rules, so choose a character and start solving the puzzles!Make up a figure from the characters, leading each of them the shortest way!

name: Paranoia: Deliver Me
short_description: Based on the best seller Paranoia, the story about Lingluo's college life will bring you to a world unknown. She pursues her music dream without knowing her life is about to be turned upside down. Losing her best friend and her confidence, she plunges into the depth of despair. What will she do?

name: CHECKMATE : Battle Arenas
short_description: Checkmate! Turn Based Real Time PvP Game!Enter the hottest battlefield and compete other players all around the world.Show your divine move to beat the enemy!

name: Castle Rencounter
short_description: What? These insolent decided to defend themselves and gather an army? How? Is their army going on the offensive? Can not be! Well, in this case, act, my lord. Smash the enemies and destroy their stronghold!

name: Kolumno
short_description: Don't let yourself be fooled by its minimalist looks, Kolumno is one of the most elegant and challenging games in recent time.

name: DRAMAQUEEN
short_description: DRAMAQUEEN lets players tell their own stories, and share them with their friends, for fun, for learning or for both.

name: Ball Out
short_description: Discover a crazy Motorcycle - Football game that combines reactivity and speed! In Ball Out, get on several vehicles and compete against your friends or other online players on various tracks with one goal in mind: score as many goals as possible! Gain experience and customize your equipment to show your opponents what you are worth.

name: Khaos Wind
short_description: How long will you survive?

name: Short Circuit VR
short_description: Short Circuit VR is an electronics lab simulator in Virtual Reality. You can build your own electronic circuits with the components provided, learn basic electronics by completing challenges and just have fun while experimenting and making awesome projects!

name: Julie's Sweets
short_description: Julie's Sweets is story driven time management game featuring 60 story and 18 pure challenge levels. Delicious donuts, cupcakes and pies - make them quick and time flys.

name: Burnouts: The Igne Mori
short_description: Burnouts: The indie adventure game driven by story, humor and weed. Maneuver yourself through the recent zombie apocalypse by utilizing a combination of Stealth, Quick Reaction Time Events and Puzzles. Any moment can descend into life or death in this tale.

name: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos
short_description: Step into the wacky heroic fantasy universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Lead a team of unlikely and clumsy heroes in an epic and challenging tactical RPG. Live an adventure filled with humor, surprises and silly encounters.

name: OVERPASS™
short_description: Take control of big-name buggies and quads to negotiate scree slopes, steep inclines and various obstacles on extreme off-road and technically challenging tracks. Find the best route, and manage your acceleration, differentials and drivetrain to dominate in local or online competitions.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Legends of Mystery
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw. Legends of Mystery has 500 photos to prove the existence of magic!

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Earth Chronicles
short_description: Special edition! 1001 unique photos in a new jigsaw! The theme of this game is the world around us.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Australian Puzzles
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw World Tour: Australia. A puzzle game and tour guide!

name: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: London
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: London Puzzles – feel the spirit of London in jigsaws

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Home Sweet Home
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Home Sweet Home: brain teasers around the family hearth.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Great America
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Great America – see the heart of America in jigsaws.

name: The Unicorn Princess
short_description: Explore the world on horseback and help the inhabitants of your village. Befriend Unica the unicorn and try to save the Dream World by completing all your missions!

name: Rebel Cops
short_description: Lead a ragtag squad of cops in rebellion against their town's new criminal power and see how long you can hold out in this unforgiving turn-based spin-off game from This Is the Police. You'll be desperately short on supplies, and a single shot can cost a cop their life.

name: Crappy Tube
short_description: Crappy Tube is a classic FPS game in which you must to escape from a factory.

name: VR INTERACTIVE TRAILER: Runes
short_description: Experience this VR trailer in full immersion inside your headset and get a sneak peek of Runes, a single player, story-driven VR adventure game in which you are Leth, a renegade wizard fighting for survival in a virtual fantasy world.

name: SkateBIRD
short_description: Grind on bendy straws, kickflip over staplers, and carve killer lines through cardboard and sticky tape parks. Above all else, skate birds try their best!

name: Pipeline VR
short_description: Pipeline VR is a hectic virtual reality puzzle game, that pits you against a rising tide of torrential water. With the residents of Pipesville in desperate need for plumbers, can YOU solve their plumbing emergencies?

name: Mystery Case Files: The Countess Collector's Edition
short_description: What lies within the depths of the pitch-black mirror?

name: Dark Parables: The Match Girl's Lost Paradise Collector's Edition
short_description: A sizzling take on the classic tale of greed, yearning, and redemption.

name: Shadow Wolf Mysteries: Under the Crimson Moon Collector's Edition
short_description: Is Martha really a werewolf - or has she been wrongly accused?

name: Hidden Object: Home Makeover
short_description: Help Emma restore her grandparents' old house! Hidden Object, Match-3 and decoration all in one game.

name: Haunted Legends: The Dark Wishes Collector's Edition
short_description: Restore the threads of Fate, before they cause a disaster!

name: Forgiveness : Escape Room
short_description: "Forgiveness" is a series of 7 escape room adventures, Take the personality test and find out which sin you are guilty of - the room design, environment and the trials you’ll go through will change accordingly!

name: Anubis' Challenge
short_description: Anubis' Challenge is an action-based VR adventure game where you need to show your reaction and combat skills to withstand multiple waves of enemies.

name: B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends
short_description: B.O.T.S. and the Robofriends is a sci-fi top-down shooter rouge-lite with multiple games modes. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op choosing from 4 unique robot characters with different attributes and attacks. Defend your home, rescue the Robofriends, and find MOTHER!

name: Möbius Front '83
short_description: Defend America from an alternate-universe America using state-of-the-art 1980s military hardware in this intricate and tactical turn-based strategy game.

name: 8bit Arena
short_description: Invite and battle your friends in this retro style local multiplayer action game. Choose your character, each with a unique skillset of 4 abilities, and compete in different arenas. Enhance your skill with full controller support and a direct competitive gameplay!

name: Crystal Corruption - Reclamation
short_description: Dive into a fast-paced, stylish action roguelike metroidvania as resurrected King Cedric. Hack and slash through diverse biomes, face corrupted minibosses, and conquer epic foes. Uncover shattered truths and choose your path to redemption in this gripping tale of vengeance and power.

name: ChronoBreach
short_description: A deadly factory surrounds you. The manipulation of time is necessary to escape this underground facility. Use your wit, your laser blaster, and your time-warping abilities to face your demise head-on and triumph!

name: Rogue Monster Rush
short_description: Experience a unique blend of roguelike and tower defense in Rogue Monster Rush! Hatch, upgrade, and command an array of monster defenders, unleash powerful player abilities, and unlock tons of upgrades to defend your town from the invading robots. Every run is unique.

name: Daedalic Complex
short_description: Daedalic Complex is an adventure, RPG, dungeon-crawling game with elements of storytelling and harsh survival. In this game, a player is required to find an exit for each stage by means of meeting certain conditions while surviving unforgiving level-designs and combats with hideous monsters.

name: Bomber Arena
short_description: Bomber Arena is a 3d action adventure game where you go through several mazes in solo mode or co-op (only local) fighting enemies until you reach your goal. You can take powers to improve your character as well as mounts to help you defeat your opponents in this game.

name: Orc Towers VR
short_description: Orc Towers VR is a first person tower defense game. Build your defenses up to defend against the orc hordes. Teleport between towers to unleash different spells and combinations to defeat the orcs.

name: Robert Rodriguez’s THE LIMIT: An Immersive Cinema Experience
short_description: Enter a new world of storytelling in this “immersive cinema” experience from writer/director Robert Rodriguez.

name: Bulls town
short_description: "Bulls town" is a competitive game with a cartoon cattle theme. The game builds a lot of different BOSS functions, and carries out the fight experience while pursuing fun. It brings you an extraordinary decompression experience through the exciting battle for cattle.

name: From Beyond Prologue
short_description: In the winter of 1910, professor Crawford Tillinghast mounted an expedition into the mountains of Europe. He went searching for a lost village shrouded in the myths and rumors of a bygone era. This is his story...

name: FPS Training
short_description: FPS Training is a game designed to train your skills in FPS (First Person Shooter) games. The game includes a series of challenges that will train all of your skills, such as aiming, reflexes, recoil control and more!

name: Scary Teacher 3D
short_description: Sneak, prank, and outsmart Miss T in this suspenseful, humorous 3D puzzle-stealth game! It’s time to Scare the Scary High School Teacher !

name: Kitten Love Emulator
short_description: Come explore a disgustingly LOVE-addled world! Solve 'puzzles' in ever-changing, emotion-based, overly-hyphenated levels -- while hunting down the murderer. Experience an ever tightening knot in your stomach as you realize: "Something is terribly wrong here, and I don't want to dig any deeper".

name: Bubble Burst
short_description: Bubbles... Only you can stop them. Collect three bubbles of the same color or more to burst them. You are waiting for a lot of exciting levels. You will also receive special bubbles that will not let you be bored.

name: VoidGate
short_description: VoidGate is a third-person dungeon crawling action-RPG. It consists of randomly generated dungeons, lite survival elements, and permanent death.

name: SAMS
short_description: Classic shooter with traveling to various exotic planets.

name: Gyro Boss DX
short_description: Dodge an endless assault of weapons as you orbit around the boss on a fixed circle, it's not as easy as it looks. Can you secure bragging rights as the best space pilot to bite the dust against the alien menace?

name: Puyo Puyo Champions
short_description: Easy to learn, tough to master! Challenge friends and family in local multiplayer or compete globally via online matchmaking. Built for all ages, this puzzle game comes with a surprisingly competitive edge.

name: DragonScales 5: The Frozen Tomb
short_description: A new DragonScales journey with expanded tile-matching challenges, battles, and extra missions. Zarya's adventure comprises 200 levels, new (and weird) characters, a few tricky puzzles, and unlockable power-ups. Her ultimate goal: releasing the dragon sealed in The Frozen Tomb!

name: Failspace
short_description: Failspace is a Co-op, crisis-solving, multiplayer VR game where you have to nurture your fragile spaceship through the ever-changing dangers of space. Up to 4 people can join the mission where their skills, resilience and friendship will be tested all across the galaxy.

name: Montaro RE
short_description: The DOGE is back!

name: Cake Bash
short_description: Fight to be the tastiest cake in Cake Bash! A frantic four player party game where adorable drawn-to-life cakes beat the crumbs out of each other.

name: ALARA Prime
short_description: The groundbreaking free-to-play, 4v4v4 competitive tactical first-person shooter. Choose your class, utilize an array of gadgets, dominate the game or play the other teams against each other.

name: To Hell With Dave
short_description: 'To Hell With Dave' is a narrative-driven adventure platformer for the connoisseur of the absurd. Explore a world full of charming characters and twisted humor. If you're a fan of challenging action, wacky puzzles and foul language, this game is for you!

name: The Wizard's Tower
short_description: The Wizard's Tower is a Tower Defence game that gives you direct control over the Towers. Using three different elements to maximum effect to stop your foes from destroying your main Tower.

name: Elemental Connection
short_description: Minimalist abstract puzzle board game about making elemental connections. Match tiles to create a satisfying mosaic.

name: Tomb of Friends +
short_description: A Futurespective exploration software about life, death, and friends in a toast-apocalyptic Negaverse.... Or something.

name: Ships That Fight Underground (STFU)
short_description: Experience a 6-degrees-of-freedom ship shooter across pulse pounding single player, co-op, and PvP gameplay. Choose your class and ship then customize and upgrade with unique cosmetics, powerful mods, and class-based tech trees. Level up and light em' up!

name: Solitaire Mystery: Four Seasons
short_description: Top Rated Hidden Object and Solitaire Game Play! Great for All Ages

name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2019
short_description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2019 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite professional basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

name: Raiders! Forsaken Earth
short_description: Raiders! Forsaken Earth is a strategy/management game where you play as the leader of a merciless band of post-apocalyptic marauders. Build up your organization while extorting, kidnapping, and destroying the last remnants of civilization. The wasteland doesn't need another hero...

name: Super Captain 3D
short_description: Super Captain 3D is a shoot-em-up game where you become a Super Hero ready to fight the Pixel Invaders. It features an art style that combines 3D pre-renders with 2D pixel art. Use your Superpowers to protect the Universe!

name: Bots Rush
short_description: Bots Rush is a unique mix of Tower Defense and logistic puzzle. You will find a set of interesting and complicated game levels, original enemies. Your task is simply to build a network of roads to deliver resources to factories and ammo to towers. Sounds easy, right? Lets check this out.

name: The Witch's Love Diary
short_description: Spring is here and love awaits, an oasis just over the horizon, a beautiful story waiting to be told. Join Takumi and Alice in a tale of fleeting cherry blossoms and forgotten first love.

name: Geno The Fallen King

short_description: Angry fairies, a kidnapped herd of cows and a devastated cow queen. Play as Vilde and Grusa, throw Ms. Cowknight and solve the fairies’ tricky puzzles to save the kidnapped cows. Hyss is a lighthearted puzzle adventure with focus on platforming, puzzle solving and throwing cows.

name: 女巫与六便士 the sibyl and sixpence
short_description: It's a 15-minute experimental visual novel about a love affair as weak as tea. Story consists of two chapters, formed by a mixture of four clues. It tells a love story about the sibyl and the prince.

name: Clan N
short_description: Fight alone or with your friends, master the art of battle and bring peace back to the land in this arcade inspired epic brawler!

name: DATAFLOW
short_description: Control the network dataflow! Pass data packets, catch e-mails and bonuses, destroy spam and viruses! Earn points and buy upgrades! Show your skill to get all things done at once!

name: Space Battle VR
short_description: Space Battle VR is an action shooter set in space. It supports VR controllers to give you a real feel how it is to be a spaceship pilot. You can truly feel the cosmos with this game. Jump into an awesome adventure, help mankind, win a war, bring freedom and happiness to the universe. People need you!

name: Cop Academy
short_description: Cop Academy is a VR party game where two teams battle it out through a series of challenges. Cooperate with your teammates or ruin your opponents' game...or both! Earn the most points to prove yourself and help your team join the ranks of Otterwa's police department, the proud graduates from Cop Academy.

name: Paradise Lost
short_description: It's winter, 1980. Szymon, a boy raised in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, finds an abandoned Nazi bunker. Will he find what he’s looking for? Play Paradise Lost and explore an underground world, where Slavic mythology mixes with retrofuturistic technology. Discover the last story on Earth.

name: Puzzles for smart: Underwater Kingdom
short_description: Is a simple, educational game. Collect puzzle with the image of the Underwater Kingdom, from the individual fragments of the picture

name: Moon Tycoon
short_description: This is the original Moon Tycoon city-building game back from 2001! Remember building vast lunar colonies, then destroying them with meteors and asteroids? Blast off again with the first 3D Sim game, back to the old days on the dark side of the moon. Feeling nostalgic?

name: Cappasity Demo
short_description: Right now you can visit the NYAA Virtual Gallery, which was created on Unity with all the art pieces shot in the Cappasity 3D View format. You will be able to see how our format seamlessly merges with a real 3D environment.

name: Bomber Barn
short_description: Bomber Barn is a cute and competitive local multiplayer game, endless fun for all ages! Bomb your pals as an adorable animal with unique abilities, blasting through a variety of themed maps designed for tense battles.

name: Tess Elated
short_description: Tess Elated is an addicting Logic Puzzle game where you face off against a series of powerful female professionals. Investigate the diverse cast to discover who or what is influencing their world. Cross the line, and become... Elated!

name: HammerBorn: Tears Of Mani
short_description: A Roguelike RPG VR Experience - Craft, build, and survive in this procedurally generated land full of fantasy and wonder. Explore and unlock secrets, events, and mysterious creatures in the world of Hammerborn: Tears of Mani

name: Project Aeronaut
short_description: Project Aeronaut is a VR superhero game about taking to the skies to face down hordes of deadly robots and drones. Train to be a superhero and rain down destruction from above!

name: Muzzleloaded
short_description: Shipwrecked and alone, you find a mysterious cave full of secrets and danger. With your new muzzleloader, battle sea creatures and challenging bosses while discovering upgrades in this 2D adventure!

name: W.A.N.T.E.D - WANTED The Game
short_description: W.A.N.T.E.D - WANTED - WNTD - A Open-World Experience Action Adventure Game with a WorldWide inspired ambience.

name: Koboomballs
short_description: Kobooomballs is an arcade-style, top-down, twin-stick shooter with light RPG elements. You use your 'icetank' to clear an area by destroying enemy mazes, then use salvage to upgrade your icetank before moving on to the next area.

name: Sticky Apps :: Monitor Ping
short_description: Sticky Apps :: Monitor Ping is an application to view your network connection to multiple systems on the Internet. This is a great way to monitor your PING/network to game servers, video streaming servers, or your ISP in general.

name: Hyperborea
short_description: She wakes up alone, missing, and trapped in the frozen tundra of Hyperborea, Hypatia must use her wits and wileys if she is to escape this accursed corner of the world. the choices she makes will determine not only her future, but that of the imperial exploratory legion.

name: Walk On the Ground Simulator
short_description: Embark on a relaxing journey to find the Seven Wonders of the WorldSEED. Run, Jump, and Swim your way across a world unique to you.

name: TendyTrainer
short_description: TendyTrainer is a VR app made for goalies to refine their skills in VR space. The goal of TendyTrainer is to provide the most realistic off-ice training environment possible. It is designed to build good habits that directly translate to the ice.

name: Monster Jaunt
short_description: A minigame party for experienced players. Compete in 23 diverse minigames with high skill ceilings and low randomness. Take simultaneous turns on the board, bringing groups of monsters to see the sights on the best vacation possible. It's a party game that *won't* make you hate your friends!

name: Sakura no Mori † Dreamers 2
short_description: 《樱之杜†净梦者2》是MOONSTONE于2017年夏天发售的《樱之杜†净梦者》的正统续作。游戏剧情采用双线叙事模式，同时讲述了圆香避开杀身之祸与主人公展开恋爱发展的平行时空故事以及在前作的时空下后续发生的主人公所在的樱之杜净梦者组织所遭遇的新奇事件。是前作玩家不可错过的精彩续作。

name: Junk on Wheels
short_description: Junk on Wheels is a demolition-derby style multiplayer racing game with weapon pickups. The race course is broken up into stages, where each racer tries to eliminate or outrun the others, scoring points used to determine the overall winner.

name: Infinite Chili Sauce  无尽的辣酱
short_description: Casual and relaxed placement game, hang your time in your leisure time and build your own chili sauce empire.

name: GANUSH
short_description: This is a puzzle game that uses the addition. A tile vanishes when match it with a target. It is cleared when erase all the tiles.

name: Boobs or [redacted]
short_description: You're Amy, a simple 2D girl with a hot 3D girlfriend who has been kidnapped by an evil mastermind who has locked her in a cage and is forcing her to dance and strip, and you're running to try and save her, but you're being thwarted by the penises of death.

name: Pixel Ship Shooter
short_description: Pixel Ship Shooter is a fast-paced retro shooter game, dodge bullets and zap your friends to death!

name: Chocolate makes you happy: New Year
short_description: Casual colorful physical puzzle with sweets, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, reverse gravity, traps, treadmills, Christmas ornaments, snow globes, snowflakes and explosions.

name: Lightstep Chronicles
short_description: A routine mission fails and Cpt Cain Phoenix's squad is abducted by a mysterious spaceship. Their survival relies on his ability to communicate with the broken AI and puzzle out the grim secrets of the ship in this dark sci-fi text-based adventure.

name: Morph Pong
short_description: Morph Pong is a casual game with a twist.

name: Colourful Maze
short_description: This is a maze game. Players need to find the exit in the maze. The exit is in a light pillar. This game can exercise your memory. You need to choose a road at a fork in the road. When you can't walk, you need to go back. This requires your memory and sense of direction.

name: Waifu Hunter - Secret of Pirates
short_description: Hayate is stranded from the future to another era when brutal and full of intrigues pirates are dominant. He accidentally meets a beautiful woman pirate named Carmen who brings a secret map which leads to an immortal treasure.

name: Sea Salt
short_description: Sea Salt is a dark fantasy reverse horror action-strategy game where you play as the nightmarish force of Dagon by controlling and growing a horde of minions.

name: Car Manufacture
short_description: Car Manufacture is an automotive tycoon game. Start in the beginning of the XX century and create thriving business. Build cars, manage people, expand your plant and research new technology. Make tons of money and stay on top.

name: Astral Towers
short_description: A turn-based card game mixing strategy and puzzle elements: find approach for each of 78 missions.

name: Bizango Blast
short_description: You've played and love those other physics games and now you're over those darn birds and want something with a new perspective?

name: Tank Blazers
short_description: Tank Blazers is a fast, action-packed local multiplayer-only arcade game that brings back the joyful days of playing games together on the couch! Built entirely for local multiplayer (either split-screen or in single-view mode), you can prove once again you're the better player.

name: Burning Out
short_description: Burning Out.This is a game about a small village whose inhabitants are partially infected with an unknown infection.

name: Theseus: Journey to Athens
short_description: Adventure through Classical Antiquity as Theseus.

name: Jumper Tree
short_description: Plant trees in a grid-based map to complete each of 120 levels.

name: Pangeon
short_description: Pangeon is a single player roguelike inspired by dungeon crawler classics. Dive right into a dungeon on a suicide mission to kill all the monsters.

name: SILENT DOOM
short_description: SILENT DOOM is an atmospheric first-person survival horror adventure set in a nightmarish universe. Gameplay consists of combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving. It is designed around the idea of "being thrown into the world". Isolated and lost inside this nightmare world.

name: Chrono Ghost
short_description: You are the Chrono Ghost, you must progress through challenging levels using your newly acquired abilities. As you progress, your adventure becomes considerably more demanding. There are many secrets to discover on your journey. Go forth and find them. hurry, time is running out!

name: XSprite
short_description: XSprite is a lightweight animated desktop sprite engine that allows to put Hundreds Animated Sprites on your desktop But only use very few CPU usage.

name: Arcane Domains
short_description: Take a quick journey across the Arcane Domains; fight lizardmen, rescue wizards, and collect treasure as you cast spells and summon monsters across 22 stages in this 3d Beat-em-up.

name: RainWidget
short_description: RainWidget is a powerful widget engine based on Chrome Core that allow you create stunning smooth animations widgets using the latest web technologies(JS HTML5 CSS3) for your desktop . Choose an existing widget or create your own and share it to the Online Gallery!

name: Rogue
short_description: After lost contact from Amelia, young police officer Brian head to the Lakeside, to find her. Only a bleak silence set in the town of Lakeside, Brian must bring everything he got to solve mysteries of Lakeside.

name: Hunting Simulator VR
short_description: Get your heart racing and blood pumping for the thrill of approaching prey and pulling the trigger with perfect timing and aim. Perfect your hunting skills behind the rifle by practicing on nature's bounty in this virtual reality experience.

name: FOUNDRY
short_description: Build a sophisticated robot factory optimized to perfection in an infinite voxel world. Mine and harvest resources, automate your production lines and manage complex systems while researching your way to become the galaxy’s leading robotics megacorp.

name: Mojack - Quest of Jackal : Puzzle game
short_description: Mojack in the quest to find its precious treasures. Mojack is on the verge to travel through the adventurous world where lots of mysterious puzzled path is filled with deadly traps. The adventurous world is filled with beautiful landscape and complex architectures.

name: Space Takeover
short_description: You have to withstand intense rivalry in space exploration. Choose one of the mighty powers and develop a space program. The future is yours.

name: Haven
short_description: Two lovers gave up everything and escaped to a lost planet to be together. Glide through a mysterious landscape, explore a fragmented world and fight against what’s trying to tear them apart in this RPG adventure about love, rebellion, and freedom.

name: Euclidean Skies
short_description: Euclidean Skies combines marvelous architecture and turn-based movements to create a beautiful world with mind-bending puzzles. The game’s focus is on shifting and rotating the world to gain tactical advantage and overpower the enemies in 55 elegant, but incredibly challenging levels.

name: Steel Alcimus
short_description: Steel Alcimus is a top-down helicopter shooter. Complete various tasks with your ally aircraft; such as saving the carrier, taking down the buildings, carrying objects, etc.

name: Super Ninja Meow Cat
short_description: Challenging Awesome Action Platformer

name: Circus Interstellar
short_description: Circus Interstellar is a brutal arcade shooter featuring high-octane action, and killer music! Earth voyagers encounter a sadistic alien race with a terrifying clownish appearance and a nasty appetite. Will the survivors escape the gory circus? Or will they be assimilated like all the rest?

name: Chaos Theory
short_description: Chaos Theory is an evolving virtual world set in a fantasy based reality. The 'Butterfly Effect' gameplay gives you a blend of RPG, RTS, and city building in a vast open sandbox environment. Manage all aspects to secure the future of your civilisation. You only have one life, so use it wisely...

name: Christmas Carol
short_description: Christmas Carol is crammed full of gorgeous Hidden Object scenes and superb mini-puzzles, wrapped into a great storyline based on the famous Charles Dickens novel.

name: SYNTHETIK: Arena
short_description: Face the varied challenges of the Machine God Zir in ARENA, a standalone expansion for Synthetik: Legion Rising! Leverage the next level in gun-play and experiment with powerful tech in varied action packed Arenas!

name: Powerless
short_description: Do you think you could survive without electricity? Find out in Powerless - The Interactive Doomsday Simulator. Explore London after a catastrophic solar flare plunges the city into darkness and renders all electronic devices and transport useless.

name: Seven Chambers
short_description: Master your destiny, the influence of the planets and the mysterious paths of subconsciousness in this unique fantasy hidden object puzzle adventure game!

name: X Archetype
short_description: X Archetype is a Side Scrolling Fast Paced Shooter. Decide which stage to take down and gain its upgrades. Dash, Jump, Wall jump, High jump, Double Jump, Wall Slide, 360 Degree Aiming are what you start with, and you gain insane Upgrades Each Stage you beat.

name: School Grounds
short_description: Strange mannequins silently stalk visitors to the school grounds as they piece together the mystery of what is happening at the school.

name: Red Tractor Tycoon
short_description: This is your chance! It’s up to you and your trusty tractor to create a flourishing agricultural industry. You take the wheel in this farm simulation and determine how your farm should look. The further you progress, the more options you’ll have!

name: Tora
short_description: Save the country Tora from the evil robots that have taken over by using magic and silly antics.

name: Robozarro
short_description: Robozarro is a physics-based, 2-D action game, where robots B0-3 and 0-Ramatron embark on an epic quest through the outskirts, underbelly, and rooftops of Mech Angeles, to uncover the mystery surrounding the disappearance of Dr. Zarro.

name: Pocoman
short_description: Welcome to the world of PocoMan! A logic and strategy game featuring the clever and funny character PocoMan. A 21st century super-hero of microscopic proportions!

name: Super Crome: Bullet Purgatory
short_description: In the dark depths of space, an unknown threat called Purgatory has begun to consume colonies throughout the cosmos. Now it’s up to Crome, the Consul’s best star pilot, to travel into the unknown and put an end to Purgatory before it overcomes the entire galaxy.

name: Big Dipper
short_description: They say it's hard to find a place to call your own, but what if such a place was not uniquely yours? What if both of you were not willing to give it up? Big Dipper is a visual novel which tells a romantic story of the circumstances that brought two lovers together one fateful New Year's Eve.

name: Adventure Boy Cheapskate DX
short_description: Swap-quest adventure game, with puzzles, secrets, and humorous dialogue. A huge cast of funny, weird and thoughtful characters await, as you guide Benson, the wise-cracking teen through a journey to reclaim his stolen bike.This is the definitive version of Adventure Boy Cheapskate with new puzzles.

name: Weightless: An immersive and relaxing experience
short_description: Weightless is an immersive and relaxing experience. It is a beautiful game that is designed to clear your mind from any stress, by coloring and listening to music.

name: Hostile User Interface
short_description: Your basic get through the maze game with a twist, your controls have been designed in a way to trip you up by triggering different Windows Hotkeys such as Alt + F4 or Ctrl Alt Del.

name: HEARTBEAT
short_description: Make friends, make enemies, go fishing, collect cards, beat up sharks, beat up tigers, obtain the denim blade, train a fuzzy infantile insect for battle, and uncover ancient secrets in this monster-filled adventure.

name: Chess Sphere
short_description: Chess Sphere is multiplayer online across multiple platforms.

name: Trinoline Genesis
short_description: Trinoline Genesis continues with all new stories for the original and side heroines of the original Trinoline!

name: Mech Merc Company
short_description: Mech Merc Company is a 90s style mech combat simulator with business management elements. Buy and sell mechs, customize your mechs, hire and fire AI pilots, manage your business expenses, and complete tactical objective-based missions.

name: Renn um dein Leben
short_description: Ist ein Jump and Run Spiel Wo man auch was gewinnen kann

name: Strike of Horror
short_description: Scary game PLAY AT YOUR OWN RISK

name: Interstellar Space: Genesis
short_description: Interstellar Space: Genesis is a turn-based space 4X strategy game in which you attempt to build a thriving galactic empire. Discover mysteries among the stars, colonize worlds, and engage enemies in tactical turn-based combat on your journey to becoming the ruler of the galaxy!

name: Hentai Summer
short_description: Card matching game with relaxing music and sexy girls

name: Battles For Spain
short_description: This game represents Four Battles of the Spanish Civil War, battles of Ebro, Teruel, Guadalajara and Merida or La Serena. Players can play as Nationalists, Republican or both in player vs player game. Unit size is battalion for infantry and cavalry, company or battalion for armoured cars or tanks, batteries for artillery and squadron for...

name: MotoGP™19
short_description: Race with official 2019 Championship riders! Have fun with the new multiplayer experience and become Race Director. Challenge the new AI, take a ride through the history of the MotoGP™ and unleash your creativity with the graphic editors.

name: It'sRoachTime!
short_description: It'sRoachTime! - is a hardcore, third person 3D online pvp fighting arena game! Fight as a mutant cockroach in real time insect simulator, find your way to survive, destroy them all!

name: Automachef
short_description: Welcome to Automachef, a resource management puzzler where you design kitchens, program machinery and watch your genius come to life! It’s time to engineer tomorrow’s kitchen, today!

name: Nightmare Trails
short_description: Fight off monsters in a national park and send them back to their own dimension!

name: Magician of Fire
short_description: Burn enemies with the power of fire!

name: Tecroroid Assault
short_description: A synthetic race has come to your planet to steal your technology, And you have to fight them off. Fight off the Tecroroid invasion as they sent wave after wave of enemies to the planet.

name: The Pilgrimage I
short_description: The story about the pilgrimage and hardship of Hebrews from Egypt to Canaan. Focusing on the prophet Moses we see well know events including the tabernacle, 10 commandments, crossing of Red Sea, the 10 plagues, miracles of sim desert and the arriving to Canaan.

name: Rocket Golf
short_description: Rocket Golf is a game that brings a new dimension to the traditional game of golf. Choose a launcher instead of a club. Pull a trigger instead of taking a swing. Through the game we take you from classic courses to environments you never imagined playing golf within. Thanks for coming!

name: The Black Widow
short_description: Communicate with the dead using a spirit board to solve an actual murder case in this interactive mystery. Ask your own questions to determine whether “the Black Widow” was truly guilty … or unjustly executed.

name: Ruinic
short_description: Ruinic is a massive multiplayer adventure, with monsters to kill, quests to complete, and treasure to win. You control your own character who will improve and become more powerful the more you play. This isn't a game where everything that happens is pre-determined. What you do in the world is up to you!

name: Alien Jelly: Food For Thought!
short_description: Alien Jelly delivers on 50 levels of thoughtful puzzle design, mixed with weird and lovable characters packaged in a 50’s b-movie sci-fi environment.

name: Potion Paws
short_description: You’ve decided to take the risk and purchase a run down house in the middle of a spooky forest near a dungeon overrun with monsters.

name: Three Kingdoms：Ancient battlefield | 三国古战略
short_description: 这是一款三国开房间即时联机游戏，玩法上你可以想象以前我们所玩的《三国群英传》或其它单机攻城类三国游戏的一种联机化改编，游戏可以多人对战，混战，组队打电脑等，一局时间在10~60分钟之间，具体视不同模式而定，比如混战会久一点，因为你要打败大部分对手，争取高分，而对战就短一点，因为对方一旦弱势可能就认输了。总之这个游戏玩法经过我2年多的折腾，现在结构算比较合理，当然里面也包含了一般的养成元素，游戏免费，但充钱玩的舒服无法避免，不过我尽量控制平衡（作者提示里说的内容），总的来说游戏倾向玩家自身技术硬实力，花钱为辅助，游戏中最强的玩家一般是弱氪，但很擅研究的人，整体比例是（技术70%）（氪金30%），我不隐瞒任何收费情况，真实坦荡，所以喜欢的就请加入进来吧。

name: NPCs
short_description: Take the role of the lone player character in a land of NPCs hell bent on your destruction with this satirical take on modern culture. Click here for 10 reasons why Playable Characters are a threat to our democracy! Try out the new NPC HQ map!

name: Darkheart: Flight of the Harpies
short_description: Challenge the evil presence in this magic Hidden Object Adventure game.

name: 食用系少女 Food Girls
short_description: "If we don’t pass the upcoming evaluation in 3 months, the snack street will be sold off?!"A production of Simon Creative and Storia, Taiwanese cuisine personification visual novel!

name: Color Knight
short_description: Color Knight is a first person perspective action game with a unique color based combat system. You enter an open island in order to destroy color crystals and earn currency - color shards. Spend them on ship's upgrades, then go again on land. Every time different experience.

name: Scuba's Ocean Odyssey VR
short_description: Embark on this epic journey in virtual reality! Play as Scuba and begin your quest to rid the ocean of plastic pollution.

name: Woodfel
short_description: Welcome to Woodfel! This untamed fantasy land is yours to explore as you go forth in search of adventure. Discover treasures, fight monsters and build amazing things as you and your friends travel the landscape!

name: The Morrigan
short_description: Step into this world of beautiful stylised graphics and explore striking, handcrafted environments - torch in one hand, big axe in the other. Built exclusively for VR.

name: The Trials of Olympus
short_description: A thrilling match-3 game that tells the story of Angelo, a young god from Olympus. Banished to the mortal realm, Angelo must prove his worth to the Grecian king by building the most majestic palace. Play 79 thrilling match-3 levels in 5 unique worlds.

name: Secret Savings
short_description: Oh my god, my wife robbed my property!! She has hidden them everywhere in my house. I'll get them all back!! VR-only treasure hunting(?) adventure game.

name: Marle: The Labyrinth of the Black Sea
short_description: The discovery of ruins near the Island of Isola has caught the attention of many adventurers, including Archmage Marle. However, what she finds there is unlike anything she has seen before. A labyrinth which seals away the strength of any who may enter it...

name: Esc: From Planet
short_description: Classic style shooter with sci-fi elements and interactive environment. One level - one life. No savings. No any artificial restrictions of movement in location. Shoot or die. No script's movie scenes and slomo. Day/night cycle.

name: Terrible Laboratory
short_description: The pretty and talented scientist, Konica Yaegaki, must earn money to save her lab from competing companies and peers who seek to destroy her reputation. However, she won't go down that easily. Follow Konica in this slice-of-life RPG as she tries to save her laboratory!

name: EF Universe: Reclaiming the World
short_description: An idle game with a collectible card theme. Open booster packs, collect cards, build an elaborate stat chain, manage 6 different currencies, battle your way across 9 different regions, and reclaim the world!

name: Necken
short_description: Necken is a tilebased roguelike set in the Swedish forest. It focuses on resource management and tactical decisions, rather than deep complex game mechanics. Movement is not turn based - everything moves freely, but the modular combat is. Necken is a small, simplistic roguelike hybrid.

name: Hunter
short_description: Hunters to your rifles! Bring out your shooter skills in Hunter and his 3 different game modes!

name: Magic Mouse
short_description: Magic Mouse is an action-adventure top-down dungeon crawl set in a fantasy world where the player fights their way through dangerous enemies, overcomes powerful bosses and survives perilous traps all while honing magical powers.

name: Ultra Pig
short_description: This is a fun and mobile pixel pig platformer. The task of the pig is picking up coins at levels, passing extermination of biting dogs and trying not to fall from the ledge down.

name: Necrolepsy
short_description: Bounty hunting isn't all sweat and grit! Travel through an exotic world as Lira, platforming though obstacles, juggling enemies, surviving nightmares, and looking for a cure of her Necrolepsy!

name: The Last Aura
short_description: Journey through the dark ruins of The Last Aura. In this action puzzle game, you must traverse labyrinths laden with obstacles and traps. Set on floating ruins tainted by the dark, your only source of light in the face of obscurity is your own.

name: Space Captain McCallery - Episode 2: Pilgrims in Purple Moss
short_description: Space Pirate Captain McCallery explores a mysterious ruin in an alien swamp in search of treasure in this Low-Poly 3D Action-Adventure game.

name: Amanda's Sticker Book
short_description: Enjoy a fun match-3 puzzle game for kids and adults alike! Put your matching skills to the test as you swap stickers and use power-ups to clear each puzzle.

name: Olaguna Chronicles
short_description: In Olaguna Chronicles Every character in the game will have a profile, and some will change their lives because of the decisions you make! Their records will be different! Maybe it's a friend, maybe it's an enemy...

name: Luna and Cynthia
short_description: ルナとシンシアは成人向けのRPGです。 主人公は彼女たちとともに、逃亡の旅を続けます。 しかし、彼女たちは非常に魅力的です。旅の途中様々なエッチなイベントに巻き込まれるでしょう。 盗賊たちに追われ、時にはつかまり、村に逃げても村人あちからのセクハラからは逃げられません。 力づくでせめられることもあれば、口先でごまかされることも。 フィールドやダンジョンを巡って彼らは強くなっていきます。 レベルを上げて、装備を整え、もとの平穏な暮らしを取り戻しましょう！

name: 过关攒将
short_description: 闯关杀这是一款结合了战旗和卡牌创新策略游戏，玩家需要在棋盘中走和合适地点来选择适当卡牌打出。游戏中玩家可以选择一位主公，然后招募自己的武将一起开始闯关之旅。战斗中的各种随机元素使得游戏策略性十足。

name: Fall In Love - My Billionaire Boss
short_description: Fall In Love: My Billionaire Boss. This is NOT your average love story game.

name: Wall Street Tycoon
short_description: Wall Street Tycoon is a business simulation game where you’re the CEO of a new investment company. Your job is to grow the company, hire employees, and manage the business!

name: RUINS Survival
short_description: In the past of this world, civilization has reached a high level of social and technical development, but then the world experienced a global catastrophe, the fall of an asteroid and the subsequent extraterrestrial pandemic as a result of which civilization and most of the wealth it created were destroyed.

name: 同居指南 | Cohabitation Guide
short_description: What! My house is occupied!" Our male protagonist utters an incredible howl. He clearly lives happily in his big house. His parents can work outside all the year round, but they are occupied by three sisters in the best three bedrooms. Liao Feiluo, Xiang Yuyao and Zhu Nanjun! What are you three doing?

name: 3D Custom Lady Maker
short_description: A custom character creator with a tendency towards the titillating. Create and customize the 3D anime-style lady of your dreams!

name: Artillery Globe
short_description: Command missile strikes, strategically capture resources, conquer the globe. Outwit your opponent in one-on-one battles and lay claim to victory. Shoot cannons and missiles across the globe to hit enemy units on the opposite side of the planet.

name: Jack Axe
