Challenge the everchanging rot with 3 characters, use the gifts and powers bestowed by primal deities and show your mastery of combat by pummeling, juggling and slamming your enemies in a gorgeous 2d presentation.

name: Kingdom of Night
short_description: Hunt down nightmarish demons and save the town of Miami, AZ in this 80s-themed, isometric action-RPG. With an expansive, interconnected map and open-ended quests, explore freely while unraveling the main story. Experience a unique blend of coming-of-age drama, cosmic horror, and true love.

Shirohime, a girl who has lost her memory, and Kurofude, a mysterious boy, traverse through classic Japanese fairy tales within the land of Adabana, a realm of illustrated books. short_description: The first of low-price series of Kimidorisoft! A hard action adventure game depicting raw egg ecstasy and bravery.Aim for a frying pan that rolls past various stages with awkward music.

name: ZorroMoro
short_description: Enjoyable FPS Game, infinite stages doesnt over ZorroMoro. Different weapon types, different tactics. The biggest problem probably bullet. You have to fix it. Down the enemies. Enemies can come everywhere. You have one mission that is LIVE

name: Monsters sandbox
short_description: Multiplayer game with the ability to connect via LAN or Internet. Fight monsters alone or with friends. Find weapons and ammunition during the game or buy them in the store. Different game modes.

name: Dungeon Crusher Kiritan
short_description: It's time to crush the dungeons with Kiritan. Explore the various dungeons, dig the blocks, beat the enemies and blow up everything! Play with many cute pixel characters and explore the sandbox world!

name: Layers Of The Machine
short_description: The night is dark and full of terrors...and 46 layers below the earth's surface, it is always night. And there are plenty of terrors. Layers Of The Machine is a cyberpunk FPS, set in a dark scifi world.

name: Crush the Industry
short_description: Work your way to the top of a cutthroat game studio in this retro roguelike deckbuilder! Crush the Industry features strategic combat with a unique twist and deep replayability.

name: Matter of the Dreams
short_description: Matter of the Dreams - is a game for die-hard action fans. No exploration, no searching for keys to unlock paths – the player needs nothing more than good aim and a quick trigger finger to succeed.

name: Eormor: Shattered Lands
short_description: A hand-drawn empire building game set in a fictional medieval world. The Kingdom of Eormor has collapsed. Chaos spreads throughout the lands as the old order tries to retain control and new noble houses try to claim their piece of the world. Will your house succeed in these shattered lands?

name: Madhouse
short_description: Play an orderly in a Madhouse and experience the totally normal daily life in a Madhouse.

name: NEKOPUGI
short_description: NekoPugi is a casual endless runner game, help the cut, chubby Pugi to dodge the obstacles and catch the prey on her way

name: CHAIN SAW
short_description: CHAIN SAW is a survival game. You have to go through various tests, find the right way out, and run away from the maniac. The game will be in every way to mock you, and scare.

name: 世界尽头的蔷薇花园
short_description: 为了亲眼去看看那名孤独的女性和传说中的蔷薇花园，莉亚开启了她的旅程。

name: Escape from Chernobyl
short_description: Will take you back to 1986, to the Chernobyl nuclear power plant, located near the city of Pripyat

name: Court of Ashes
short_description: Gather your wits and enter the council chamber. The king has fallen, but the five of you remain in the fight. You can mourn the loss of his majesty later; your own survival still depends on how you respond to this war. Undoubtedly, figuring out how to respond will be easier than convincing the others to listen.

name: Cursed Roots
short_description: Cursed Roots is a fast-paced horror point & click adventure featuring retro-inspired art, difficult puzzles and monsters around every corner! Use your wits to solve puzzles, combine items and escape from a house full of monstrosities! Can you escape from your Cursed Roots?

name: Scutum Phanti
short_description: Protect your ship by constantly upgrading equipment and completing side quests in 2D shoot 'em up game. Classic arcade feel of battling space enemies combined with rpg style story.

name: The Ring of Truth
short_description: The Ring of Truth is a short walking simulator game set in an abandoned factory.

name: The Crimson Diamond
short_description: Follow amateur geologist and reluctant detective Nancy Maple to the ghost town of Crimson, Ontario to investigate the discovery of a massive diamond in this retro-inspired, EGA text parser mystery adventure!

name: Okay, Panic!
short_description: Enhanced for the Valve Index Controllers. Unlock tapes, tackle dozens of Microgames and compete in global leaderboards. It's time to panic!

name: ZACH-LIKE
short_description: ZACH-LIKE is a book of behind-the-scenes design documents from Zachtronics. The digital version of ZACH-LIKE contains the full contents of the book, a bunch of terrible games that Zach made before SpaceChem, and some prototypes and early builds of Zachtronics games, both released and... not.

name: Metro Explosion Simulator
short_description: Metro Explosion Simulator

name: Lannath
short_description: Lannath is a Horror-RPG where you accumulate insanity and watch the world plunge into madness. Generate randomized worlds with customizable features to create a totally unique experience each time you play.

name: Home Sweet Home EP2
short_description: Terror and mystery meet in Home Sweet Home Sweet Home Episode 2, the sequel to last year’s cult-hit first-person horror game, Home Sweet Home. Immerse yourself in a world where evil hides behind every corner, in a world inspired by Thai folklore and mythology.

name: ZomB
short_description: Look over town from above, relax and watch the undead chaos ensue, super chilled casual point and click zombie horde game, with charm and cute model town styled visuals.

name: Bocce VR
short_description: Bocce VR it's a fun sport game, where you can play against computer

name: Legendary gun
short_description: The background of the game is similar to the World War II. There is a small village in China which is often plundered by the enemy. In order to survive, players assume the role of a heroic warrior and fight the aggressors to defend the homeland and the people.

name: Outpost Delta
short_description: Outpost Delta is a single player, 2-D side-scrolling sci-fi shooter for PC. Take on the role of Delta, the outpost’s emergency defense, who along with her AI companion must defend the space station against alien intruders.

name: 愚者地牢-UP主的消失
short_description: It has become a habit for a streamer to update the video without time. This streamer is not enterprising every day and is addicted to entertainment. Suddenly one day, when the streamer woke up, everything around had changed, and all the sins would be liquidated at this moment.

name: 她3 : 复乐园之曦 Her3 : The Light of Paradise Regained
short_description: This is a kind of game to cultivate the plot of retro style. The protagonist needs to cultivate the attributes of the male / female protagonist (child) and the plot likability within 2 years, which ultimately determines the ending direction. There are 11 endings.

name: Battle Planet - Judgement Day
short_description: Battle Planet - Judgement Day is a planetary rogue-lite top-down shooter. You are one of the universe's 3 most wanted criminals on the run, fighting your way through hordes of aliens, military and police units. There is only one way to reclaim your freedom - destroy them all...

name: The Alien Cube
short_description: Worlds collide as your cursed inheritance throws you into the middle of a series of mysterious events. Discover terrifying secrets as you follow your uncle’s disappearance, and confront a terrible truth that will change your life forever in this cosmic horror first-person adventure.

name: A Total War Saga: TROY
short_description: Inspired by The Iliad and brought to life through the award-winning strategy game series, A Total War Saga: TROY brings a blend of grand, turn-based empire management and spectacular real-time battles to the heart of the Trojan War.

name: Rude Racers: 2D Combat Racing
short_description: Rude Racers offers exciting bike racing with crazy fighting action, mad weapons and fast gameplay! Play through a tremendous variety of innovative challenges and establish yourself as the meanest racer on the street in this smashing new pick-up-and-play racer!

name: The Endless White
short_description: The Endless White is a survival game, in which we will have to procure food, water and shelter from the freezing temperatures of the Alaska, in order to be able to repair the helicopter with which we had to perform an emergency landing following a failure to the engine.

name: The Forgotten Land
short_description: "The Forgotten Land" is a turn-based "Combat & Puzzle Match 3" with streamlined RPG and Management elements in a Dark Fantasy setting.

name: Karl BOOM
short_description: Karl BOOM is a fast-paced Bomberman-style action game with interactive maps and a coop survival mode.

name: The Curious Tale of the Stolen Pets
short_description: Help your grandfather solve the mystery of the stolen pets by solving puzzles in wonderful miniature worlds crafted for VR. Use a hairdryer to melt snow in a wintery landscape! Search the wreck of a pirate ship hidden under the surface! Every world is unique, full of interactions and colorful life.

name: Rap Simulator: The Rap Game
short_description: Rap Simulator is primarily a game with a good dose of humor. The action starts in the 1980s. The player takes on the role of a rapper who sets up their first music studio in a rented apartment.

name: HENTAI EXOTICA
short_description: Hentai Exotica is a puzzle game, swap blocks to assemble an image.

name: 3D Organon
short_description: 3D Organon is a multi-award-winning medical XR platform offering an all-in-one solution with 3D Anatomy, XR Medical Imaging, Medverse, Assessments, and the AI Study Assistant—supporting diverse teaching, learning, and training needs across healthcare education.

name: Alive 2 Survive: Tales from the Zombie Apocalypse
short_description: Zombie hordes. Hostile humans. Fight to live. You are Alive 2 Survive! Swipe your way through life or death decisions where each choice matters and can be the difference between surviving the apocalypse or joining the zombie horde. A swipe-to-survive zombie apocalypse decision making adventure.

name: Jack Move
short_description: Jack Move is a JRPG that features a unique blend of gritty cyberpunk story telling, turn based battles and beautiful modern pixel art. Take on the role of Noa, a vigilante hacker who is thrust into a world of murder, kidnapping and dark research after her father goes missing.

name: The Lattice Grimoire
short_description: The curse wove your fates together. Now their thoughts and feelings influence you and your actions determine their fates. Will you be able to break the curse? Or will their dark pasts drag you into an inescapable despair? And can a fresh start really erase the past?

name: PROTOCOL 11 - Episode 1
short_description: A sci-fi story about friendship, love and what it takes to be human. Embark on an action-packed adventure to recover what was taken from you by a strange race of invaders. Survive PROTOCOL 11.

name: Welcome to Paradise
short_description: Welcome to SEX Paradise!!! Hot girls are waiting for you!!! Experience amazing moments on the Tropical Island in the middle of the ocean. Collect magical orbs to open the portal leading to the SEXY mermaid caves.

1000$ – a first-person horror where you are supposed to rob a house. The main character is a young guy who decides to upgrade his computer due to the release of some new interesting games. However, he has to get 1,000 dollars somewhere to buy the required hardware.

name: Snowman Builder
short_description: Feel the winter spirit in the white village and create a happy snowman! Roll the snow, make big snowballs, and decorate the village with various decorations to make your own snowman. Before spring comes.

name: Whispers From The Rift
short_description: A choose-your-own-adventure novel. ​Enter the mind of a black-ops team leader heading an impossible mission in a parallel universe. Choices are remembered, story events reflect past decisions, and freely rewind time to try different paths.

name: PARADISE
short_description: "PARADISE" is a small 3D adventure game played from a third-person perspective. Take your girl friend to Paradise Resort, the largest theme park in the country.

name: Mini Tone - Minimalist Puzzle
short_description: Mini Tone is a minimalist puzzle game that combines musical notes and physical intuition. Find the perfect angle and launching point to eliminate all musical blocks from each level. Can you execute the Perfect Path?

name: 墨色三国志
short_description: 《墨色三国志》由墨色工作室精心制作的一款君主扮演的SLG游戏。考验您在乱世中的生存能力。是稳重求胜，步步为营？是孤注一掷，扭转乾坤？是求贤若渴，人才济济？还是爱民如子,执法如山？一切由你做主。 游戏特色： 游戏中更加突出武将的个人能力，每个武将都有自己独有的属性。玩家可以通过武将之间的组合，发掘特有的战术和玩法。 新颖的战斗系统，使得武将之间的能力、特点更加突出。 另外还有丰富的兵种体系、内政体系。还原一个战火纷飞的三国世界。 官方QQ讨论群：177071956

name: Iseshima mystery annai: Itsuwari no Kuro shinnjyu
short_description: 舞台は東京から伊勢志摩へ…… ファミコン風アドベンチャーゲームの完全新作！

name: Perfect
short_description: We are not perfect, but we never give up pursuing; we may have been lost, and now we will return to perfection."Perfect" is a puzzle game, which takes brains to perfect all gems.

name: Master of the Forbidden Sea
short_description: Dive for treasure in a chaotic region of the Pacific known as the Triangle of Doom. Avoid starvation, battle strange monsters, and voyage past the point of no return to the undersea.

name: Otawamure
short_description: "Otawamure" is a Japanese word meaning "to play around, to fool around or to toy with". Play with tender objects in this virtual space and experience “otawamure” for yourself.

name: Touhou Fuujinroku ~ Mountain of Faith.
short_description: 我が国には八百万の神々がいる 弾幕は八百万発程度では終わらない ノスタルジックでネイティブな弾幕シューティング原風景

name: Touhou Chireiden ~ Subterranean Animism.
short_description: 弾幕は　地獄であるほど　美しい 深ければ深いほど地底は地獄の姿を取り戻す ヘリッシュでラブリーな弾幕シューティング地獄

name: Touhou Seirensen ~ Undefined Fantastic Object.
short_description: アレは何だ？　鳥か？　妖精か？ 謎に満ちた未確認幻想物体が、君を未知の世界に誘う！ ファンタスティックでレトロな弾幕シューティング幻想

name: Double Spoiler
short_description: 天狗の取材は一方的で新聞記事は捏造ばかり。 強行取材、捏造記事の楽しさを君にも！ トラディショナルな妖怪達の本気の日常を激写せよ！

name: Yousei Daisensou ~ Touhou Sangetsusei
short_description: 飛び出そう、いつも通りの弾幕へ それが結果として世界をひっくり返す事になるだろう プリティでデュアリスチックなシューティング幻想！

name: Everybody Loves Skeletons
short_description: Everybody Loves Skeletons! Don't you?

name: Circle Empires Rivals
short_description: In this fast-paced multiplayer RTS, you and your friends will take control of your own tiny kingdoms and conquer a world made of circles. Each one is overflowing with enemies to fight, monsters to hunt and loot to hoard – but watch out... Friends can quickly become rivals!

name: The Far Rings: A Space Opera Visual Novella
short_description: Play as Doctor Athena, a passionate young woman with mixed alien heritage—and the sole survivor of refugee camp ITOH. Three days remain on the trip 'home'—with only the ship's unsettlingly polite Captain Odysseus and the cryptic alien war criminal Chiron for company. But is everything really as it seems?

name: Super Space Club
short_description: Super Space Club is a lo-fi arcade space shooter to chill to. Defend a vibrant galaxy as a club of misfit heroes and battle endless waves of spacecrafts to the tune of atmospheric beats. Outlast your enemies and vibe to the rhythm of the stars.

name: Gamedev Beatdown
short_description: Be a bastion of all that's good in the games industry or crunch like there is no tomorrow. Play as a game developer in an exciting new turn-based combat and narrative game. But beware, your colleagues will fight your decisions every step of the way.

name: Rest
short_description: Rest is a walking simulator with a dark and beautiful aesthetic where the environment tells the story. Travel to a monochrome world where you will experience an impactful narrative about guilt and loss.

name: Battle Droid T1
short_description: Terminate an alien underground base on Mars using the T1 Battle Droid in old school metroidvania style .

name: #Funtime
short_description: #Funtime is an explosive twin-stick shooter where shooting isn't your only weapon. Swap your ship's color to destroy enemies, avoid damage, and ultimately control the battlefield.

name: Slot Gun
short_description: Slot Gun is a satisfying deckbuilding slot-machine game where you face off against several opponents to control the board. It is a blend of luck and skill where timing is key and dopamine is everywhere.

name: Commandos 2 - HD Remaster
short_description: Relive the real-time tactics masterpiece that defined the genre like no other: Commandos 2 - HD Remaster is a true homage to one of gaming’s most celebrated masterpieces.

name: Praetorians - HD Remaster
short_description: Relive the celebrated real-time strategy classic Praetorians, re-imagined in high definition. Praetorians is set amidst the political machinations of an emerging Roman Empire.

name: Spirit Hunter: NG
short_description: Beware the Creeping Horror... Face nightmares you thought were merely urban legends. Uncover a dark mystery, making deadly decisions just to survive. Play this chilling companion story to the award-winning Spirit Hunter: Death Mark game and bring the terror home.

name: Last Contingency
short_description: Last Contingency is a survival game blending intense gunplay, crafting, and farming. Battle for resources, build your base, and adapt to a harsh environment. Developed by a small team, this evolving low-budget project offers ongoing updates and community-driven improvements

name: Diamonds
short_description: Assault Rifle, Shotgun and Grenades. Collect Diamonds scattered around the map to build your power ups as you engage in intriguing battles, beat the enemy and collect their diamonds. Customize your character & enjoy the journey of unlocking maps and competing globally or with friends for high scores

name: Drones
short_description: Blast your way through hordes of enemies in the progressive wave mode to defeat the overseer, or test your skills with the endless survival mode to become the greatest warrior on the leaderboard.

name: Football Manager 2020
short_description: Run your football club, your way. Every decision counts in Football Manager 2020 with new features and polished game mechanics rewarding planning and progression like never before, empowering managers to develop and refine both your club’s and your own unique identity.

name: Football Manager 2020 Touch
short_description: Quick-paced football management for bosses pursuing the fast track to success and footballing glory. FM20 Touch is the slick alternate to the world’s favourite football management game, focusing only on the managerial essentials… tactics and transfers.

name: I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 2 (Adult Version)
short_description: Yuusuke and Mitsuki race to the town hall, but what they find there might not be everything they hoped for. Can Dr. Makiura save Mitsuki's little brother? Will the promised rescue ever come?

name: Everyone Goes Home
short_description: A time attacking, puzzle-platforming, psychedelic adventure.

name: Voxel Printer
short_description: Make your own voxel art masterpiece in this colorful game.

name: Battle Siege Royale
short_description: A new way to experience the battle royale genre! Choose a siege weapon, defend your castle, outwit and out-survive! In a death match elimination. After all enemies have fallen, if you're still alive, you win!

name: Artifact Adventure Gaiden DX
short_description: Those tones, those colors... Featuring a uniquely Game Boy-like design and all-new adventures and tales.

name: GhostCry Hill
short_description: The story follows Liang Suxian, a female university student, who inadvertently becomes entangled in an urban legend. An ancient book transports her back to the campus of the 1950s. Suxian's fate seems inextricably linked to the death of a mysterious girl from the same school.

name: DrumMasterVR
short_description: Enter the virtual world, experience the joy of hitting jazz drums with drumsticks, and wave your hands to play the rhythm that belongs to you.

name: Legioncraft
short_description: Loslan needs you! The Legion is waiting for your call! Gather your strength, prepare your food, contribute your love, and pull out your gold coin!

name: Aimbeast
short_description: The ultimate training and warmup solution for FPS/TPS players: Aimbeast combines human-like AI and lot of useful scenarios to make you better at all types of shooters in a fast and efficient way. Are you ready to become an Aimbeast?

name: Nubla
short_description: A point'n'click adventure that will take you through the fantastic world of Nubla, full of puzzles and forgotten places. A journey of self-discovery, looking for your personal identity and place in the world.

name: Noara: The Conspiracy
short_description: Since the tragedy of the Last Moon, the Lands of Noara are once again under threat. Take up arms and dive into this competitive turn-based game, build your army, react in real time to your opponent's actions and try to win the game!

name: Celestial
short_description: “You are Celest, a young innocent creature. Celest awakens, no memories, no notion of the change that is happening around her. She is simply alone. The one thing that drives her forward, is to find the answer; “What am I?”

name: Lumen
short_description: From the Ruby Forest to the fortified city of Bromure, from Baccus Farm to the snowy village of Kaldinger, meet unforgettable characters and live your adventure, discovering the multiple facets of Lumen's gameplay!

name: Hidden
short_description: Two orphans twin sisters, Yuna and Luna, were caught and placed separately in an unknown facility. The elder sister, Yuna tries to find Luna in the facility and rescue her. They aim to escape from the facility which is surrounded by a strange and mysterious atmosphere.

name: Chaos Dream: Retribution
short_description: Join young Grigori on a mission of discovery, betrayal and honor. Travel through forests, swamps and deserts in search of truth and peace.

name: Gunsmith Simulator
short_description: Become a Gunsmith and unveil the great pleasure of working in your own workshop! Repair, restore and personalize guns to make unique pieces that every firearm lover will appreciate.

name: My Typing Skill
short_description: You say you're a confirmed typist? You're going to have to prove it....

name: Fishing Adventure
short_description: Fishing Adventure is a typical fishing game, where the player can (drums) catch different fish species! Fish in USA, Hawaii and other unique fisheries.

name: Mage Mania
short_description: Grab your hats and your food, it's time for a mage battle! Dive in a world where magic makes everyone crazy for power and food. Choose your special mage and combine your magic towards victory!

name: EverStopped
short_description: STAND UP SOLDIER! Resume training! Become the best on this FPS Runner game demanding reflexes and precision!

name: Dungeon Defenders: Awakened
short_description: Dungeon Defenders: Awakened is co-op Tower Defense combined with epic Action RPG combat. You’re able to join forces with up to four players to take on a never-ending army of orcs, demons, and dragons! Are your defenses strong enough to save the world of Etheria?

name: After The Suns
short_description: Venture into the depths of the jungle and survive the war totems in a frantic hack and slash. Discover the memories of Fhavin in the Monoliths of the Serpent, where you can use her past as a resource to fight and, where possible, reserve them for the final fight.

name: Anticorps VR
short_description: Fantasy & unreal universe for a fun and spectacular strategy game. Miniaturized in a sick body use the field to create colonies, collect resources and make fixed defenses to protect the antibody. Disinfect all !!

name: FURRY GIRL PUZZLE
short_description: FURRY GIRL PUZZLE - a logical game in which your task is to collect puzzles and open the pictures with furry girls.

name: Anime Artist
short_description: Anime Artist is a casual-puzzle game that will allow you to Sketch, Color and Collect anime artworks. Are you ready? This is your best chance to become the ultimate Anime Artist.

name: 0Gravity
short_description: 0Gravity is a game whose action takes place in zero gravity (predictably). Confuse your opponents and anticipate their actions to win in pixel 2D levels. There can be only one space marine!

name: Vengeful Heart
short_description: Betrayed by the calculated cruelty of an evil corporation, Josephine finds herself homeless, jobless and without a heart. With nothing to lose, she joins a ragtag group of rebels seeking vengeance. Choose a love interest and let them guide Josephine's heart in this capitalist hellscape.

name: World's Nicht
short_description: World's Nicht is a casual indie platformer designed with short levels (on average it will take 5-10 minutes per stage to clear with a total of 20 stages).

name: Fighting Frenzy: Swole Simulator
short_description: Do your friends and family make fun of you for not being swole enough? Play Swole Simulator! Try it out, It's worth a goof and a gaff. Disclaimer: The only muscle mass you may gain from playing this game is in your fingers.

name: Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break
short_description: Competitive tower defense meets arcade action and gets rolled up with ACE Team's quirky, Monty Python-esque humor into one giant, creative game for the ages. This time around, you can even make your own levels!

name: Wind Runners
short_description: Wind Runners is a roguelike side-scroller with intense aerial combat. Take on the role of a rebellious Ishma pilot, battling against the oppressive forces of the Realm in the Zerah Igna System. With challenging bosses, ever-changing maps, and fast-paced gameplay, every run is a fight for freedom.

name: Rune Knights
short_description: Rune Knights is a cooperative action RPG focused on customization, crafting, and combat. Customize your character's aesthetics, stats, gameplay, and gear as you battle through procedurally generated and hand-crafted levels with your allies.

name: Dragon Call
short_description: "Dragon Call" is a non P2W card game. In the ancient war, the demigods expelled the Dragon Legion, but the effects of the war will never disappear. For thousands of years, intruders often ravaged the land. Now the summoners rise, they can use the energy of the earth to summon various helpers.

name: Miss Neko
short_description: Together the full picture of all the lovely beast ladies with your own hands, play Yakyuken with them, collect their portraits. Hope you have a relaxing and enjoyable game time:)

name: Turn Me On
short_description: Race through neon tracks in VR but, plot twist, you'll need to hit lamps to turn the track on. Turn Me On is an arcade style racing game for Vive, make it to the end of the track and try to beat your high score.

name: Edge of Time: Rise of the Aeus
short_description: War between humans and immortals rage upon every corner of the world. Threatening humanity into extinction; an outlaw, a former soldier and a pacifist, embarks on a mission to find the mysterious 'shard' that's said to be the only key to humanity's salvation.

name: Cliper: A clipboard enhancement tool
short_description: Cliper provides you with the Windows clipboard enhancement functions, complements some of the inconvenience of original clipboard inconvenience to improve your daily operation efficiency and convenience.

name: Spooky Starlets: Movie Monsters
short_description: A card-based porn simulator that tasks you with producing hardcore monstergirl smut! Play your cards right and uncover the intimate escapades of the underworld!

name: Deichgraf
short_description: Deichgraf is a small, calm, but sometimes intense building game. Build your own village and protect it against water caused by floods and heavy rain!

name: A maze in Citadel
short_description: A maze in Citadel is a subtle blend of action and exploration with a touch of infiltration. Evolve in fully 3D environments with simple and effective gameplay. Monsters, traps, enigmas... Will you dare to face the citadel?

name: Cooking Trip: Back on the road
short_description: Cooking Trip: Back on the Road — show the world you’re the best. Discover new culinary secrets!

name: ARISEN - Chronicles of Var'Nagal
short_description: ARISEN is a narrative card game where you use your emotions to create your own story in a dark fantasy universe.

name: EZ360 VR player
short_description: EZ360 makes distributing and playing VR content easy. Upload your content in the online portal and push to multiple VR headsets. The headsets automatically download the content from the internet. With EZ360 you can conveniently distribute new content to headsets all over the world.

name: CRAZY DRIVER
short_description: The craziest driver simulator!

name: Ancient Knowledge
short_description: Ancient knowledge adventure game in which you have to solve the mystery of the ancient Indian city

name: Bakery Biz Tycoon
short_description: In Bakery Biz Tycoon you create your own way to the top of the cooked dough empire! Start with a small family bakery, expand your delights offer, create unique recipes, win Bakery Regional contests and make everyone talk about your legendary products. Your hands are full enough of flour?

name: War Mongrels
short_description: War Mongrels is an isometric real-time tactics game that takes place on the eastern front of World War II. Dynamic and tactical gameplay with stealth elements, tightly packed into a dark, fascinating story! Play on your own or in online co-op (PC).

name: 10mg: Always Down
short_description: 10mg is a collection of 10 minute long games. Always Down is about going away.

name: reD:起始的旋转之音(The beginning of the Melody)
short_description: The main character, Mika, in order to recall her parents’ self-consciousness, signed in a project called reD. The reD official claimed that completing the tasks assigned by the organization could realize her dreams. But the detailed tasks were fairly questionable.

name: Monsters of Little Haven
short_description: At the heart of the action are a twelve-year-old Kenneth and his younger sister Esme, children of the Murphy family, who hit the trail of a mysterious monster following series of entangled events.

name: Victorian Mysteries: Woman in White
short_description: Discover the secret of the mysterious woman in white in this hidden object adventure. Based on the 1860 novel by Wilkie Collins, the game takes you into the pompous world of ancient British nobility!

name: WREN
short_description: Cycle. Run. Walk. Step. The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single stride. Step forth and defend the realm!

name: 白石洲往事

Build up your café by filling it with cute furniture, fun decorations, yummy pastries, and get it bustling with animals again!

short_description: Steel Rain is dynamic and realistic real time strategy, based in World War II era. Developed with passion as the ultimate wargaming sandbox with unlimited modding possibilties. Features unparalleled combination of gameplay fun and realism, with focus on community and modding.

name: The Ancient Labyrinth
short_description: The Ancient Labyrinth is a psychological horror game set in a mysterious labyrinth which hides a terrible secret. Play as a man who has lost his memory, trapped for some strange reason and stalked by a frightening monster that will hunt him the whole time.

name: Junk
short_description: Manage a community consisting of the craziest scum left on Earth after it was totally flooded. Expand your town, research craziest new technology, send expeditions to gather materials but whatever you do don’t let any of the groups living in your town gain more power than the others...

name: Aliens: Dark Descent
short_description: Drop into the gripping journey of Aliens: Dark Descent, a squad-based, single-player action game in the iconic Alien franchise. Lead your soldiers in real-time to stop a new and terrifying kind of Xenomorph outbreak on Planet Lethe.

name: Summer Paws
short_description: Summer days, warm rain, magical nights! Sleeping kittens are hidden well. Can you find them?

name: Micro Car Crash Online Le Go!
short_description: You are given complete freedom of action on an absolutely destructible toy car! Perform insane stunts on ramps and jumps! Take part in crazy car battles!

name: Voidspace
short_description: A highly experimental SCIFI sandbox MMORPG. Using only 2D, top-down visuals, we're attempting to push the limits of the MMO genre to create a game world that is similar in some ways to Ready Player One. Featuring perma-death, and player societies. Every man-made object is crafted by a real player.

name: Wizard with a Gun
short_description: Wizard with a Gun is an online sandbox survival game for 1 - 4 players set in a magical wilderness wrought with dangerous creatures and arcane mysteries. Embark on a journey alone or with a friend to collect, craft, and outfit your wizard however you see fit as you explore the unknown.

name: Offcoast
short_description: The rogue-like strategy game Offcoast takes place in a subterranean, underwater landscape.

name: Winter Polaris
short_description: A mysterious global pandemic is making people disappear into thin air. A mysterious glass object carried by a girl found adrift at sea. Two stories that set two pairs of protagonists off on separate journeys around the world. What does it mean to live, make mistakes, and live again?

name: History Warriors
short_description: Eight historic figures, together for the first time, combined in an exciting 2D Fighter.

name: City Gangs War in Miami
short_description: Join City Gangs Miami in 30 action well packed missions in his never-ending quest to defeat The BigBoss. City Gangs Miami is a third person shooter where you have to eliminate all opponents, use grenades, rifles, rocket launchers, tanks, helicopter to defeat the enemy.

name: Bed Lying Simulator 2020
short_description: Simulator of lying on a bed. Or lying to a bed. Or maybe the bed is lying. Is your bed lying to you?

name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist : Link Evolution
short_description: Build your Deck from over 10,000 cards and take on the most iconic Duelists from the Yu-Gi-Oh! universe. Relive the stories from the original Yu-Gi-Oh! animated series through Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS!

name: War Theatre: Blood of Winter
short_description: From the developers of War Theatre comes the next series installment, Blood of Winter. In this free-to-start turn-based strategy RPG, return to Kasalli, where the Endless War continues to rage and powerful new forces converge to determine the fate of the world.

name: Sorcerer Lord
short_description: The Shadowlord, the evil sorcerer who rules the Northern Shadowlands, has invaded the ancient lands of Galanor. In this fantasy wargame simulation, you must gather the free forces of Galanor and stem the advancing might of the Shadowland.

name: OMORI
short_description: Explore a strange world full of colorful friends and foes. When the time comes, the path you’ve chosen will determine your fate... and perhaps the fate of others as well.

name: Dark Arena
short_description: It's humans versus genetically engineered monsters in Dark Arena, a futuristic first-person shooter that combines run-and-gun gameplay with strategic play and puzzle solving.

name: Monster Girl Club Bifrost
short_description: Pay back your debt to the Grim Reaper in this management simulation game! You're a monster trainer in an up-and-coming nightclub where the lovely ladies of the night are enslaved monster girls trained by you. Win your freedom back no matter what it takes!

name: Island SAGA
short_description: It's time for an adventure!! Legends have it that there are mythical treasures lying deep within Valentine Island. Together with your four beautiful and well-stacked companions, will you be able to find it in this lighthearted and sometimes heart-pounding RPG?!

name: Gloomwood
short_description: Trapped in a dark, Victorian city consumed by an ancient curse, you must plan your survival and daring escape using nothing but stealth, an arsenal of eccentric weapons, and your wit in this haunting adventure inspired by the immersive sims and survival horror greats of the late 90s and early 2000s.

name: GraFi 4
short_description: GraFi 4 - casual, colorful,minimalist, physical puzzle with traps and changing gravity.

name: Breeza Budgie Bill
short_description: Breeza Budgie Bill is Part 3d Platformer, and Part 3rd Person Shooter. inspired by early 3d games of the mid 90's, Budgie Bill is a definitive assault parakeet!!!, on a mission to defeat all who oppose him, with the Help of Pumpkin Dog, Budgie Bill has a boost ability that can be turned on and off.

name: Slime Slam
short_description: A classic take on match 4 puzzle games from the 90's. With 4 gameplay modes and local multiplayer, this fast-paced challenging puzzler will keep you on your toes! Highly customizable options for any style of play.

name: Delphyq
short_description: Delphyq offers a unique Real-time Strategy & Tactics experience, that puts you in the seat of the "Mastermind.” It requires you to analyze the current situation, evaluate available resources and choose the missions wisely, before planning and executing game-altering attacks.

name: The Bunker 69
short_description: After 20 years of living in a terrible post-apocalyptic world, you find yourself in a miraculously undiscovered bunker, which... is filled with food and beautiful girls. It seems that your life will now go according to a completely different script, but...

name: EAGLETALON vs. HORDE OF THE FLIES
short_description: The Eagle Talon is Super hard! Freakin' hard! And now in Puzzle Action form! You become the fighting leader of Eagle Talon, collecting artifacts and friends, and prevent Horde of the Flies' aspirations of world dominance! This game will require you to use your head!

name: Book of Beasts — The Collectible Card Game CCG
short_description: Book of Beasts is a strategic collectible card game, with cards representing the eponymous beasts, inspired by myths from around the world. In the game, two beast summoners compete against each other with their decks of cards and try to outwit each other.

name: Timelie
short_description: Timelie is a stealth puzzle adventure, where you control time like a media player. Perceive future events to plan your escape strategy from the past, sneak an enemy, and manipulate time through this companionship journey of a mysterious cat and a little girl with a precognitive power.

name: Cemetery Warrior 4
short_description: Cemetery Warrior 4: Play as Zexus, a demon seeking revenge. Fight diverse monsters, use powerful weapons and supernatural abilities. Stunning graphics, intense gameplay, multiple difficulty levels. Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping demon-slaying adventure!

name: Golf Gang
short_description: Golf Gang is a racing game. It’s a party game. It’s the fastest game of minigolf you'll ever play! Blend precision with speed to dominate in 8-player online mayhem or your solo speed runs.

name: Before Arriving at the Terminal
short_description: A horror visual novel set in a suburban city.

name: Legend of Keepers: Prologue
short_description: You have been hired as a dungeon master by the Dungeons Company. Your job is simple: Protect their dungeons! Legend of Keepers: Prologue is a playable alpha that will help you get familiar with the game mechanics.

name: Easter Egg
short_description: Easter Egg is a multiplayer online arcade-style capture the flag game about the adventures of squirrel and rabbit who are living peacefully in the Easter forest.

name: Hamster Scramble
short_description: Help twins Kaden and Quinn rescue their hamster pals in this wholesome puzzle adventure. Enjoy a cast of colorful characters, mess with your friends in competitive mode, and have hours of fun with delightful platform-hopping, bubble-popping action!

name: Arrest of a stone Buddha
short_description: Hitman is searching for an answer in France 70-s.

name: Dark Chess
short_description: THIS IS NOT CLASSIC CHESS! Dark Chess is a twist on chess with fog of war, a story-driven campaign, and plenty of challenges, traps, and puzzles. Fight your way through the campaign against legendary Kings and Queens of the past, who don't like to play by the rules!

name: Chaos Theory Pirates
short_description: Set in an evolving virtual sandbox pirate world you can collect resources, build a base, manage your crew and defeat enemy raiders. We have created a unique blend of real-time-strategy and a role-play-game to provide an immersive intractable environment.

name: Super Cucho
short_description: Caution! Fierce hardcore about the toad. Only for those with nerves of steel. Help the toad feed his cat!

name: Just Drift It !
short_description: Select a car, select a track and Just Drift It. Enjoy the nice drift mechanics and reach the top of the leaderboards.

name: Horror Story: Hallowseed
short_description: Horror Story: Hallowseed is a story-driven psychological horror game. An obscure event causes two of your friends to disappear while you were camping in the woods. Left alone and stranded in an unknown place, you need to seek the answers about what happened, face the horror and find your friends.

name: Lumbermill
short_description: Build, Manage and Maintain a Lumber Mill deep in the Forest!

name: Blackbeard the Cursed Jungle
short_description: Blackbeard is a brave man who fight for honer no matter what the cost. Help him on his adventure to stand against evil. If you love classic platform games or jungle adventure games, or would you like to return to your childhood memory? Our game Blackbeard the Cursed Jungle is the best choice for you.

name: Netsoccer
short_description: Netsoccer 2 is a multiplayer online soccer game and it's free to play. Each gamer controls a player, not a team as is common in most soccer games. You can join different teams and have matches against other teams or you can just have a practice match online.

name: Raven's Point
short_description: TBA...

name: Fallout 76
short_description: Bethesda Game Studios welcome you to Fallout 76. Twenty-five years after the bombs fall, you and your fellow Vault Dwellers emerge into post-nuclear America. Explore a vast wasteland in this open-world multiplayer addition to the Fallout story.

name: Night Guardian
short_description: You are a Teddy Bear tasked with keeping the creatures of the night away from your owner's bed.

name: Cowboy Life Simulator
short_description: Cowboy Life Simulator is an immersive, relaxing, single-player Wild West ranching simulator. Grab your tools, your revolver, buy a goat, and start your adventure! Yee haw!

name: Putin Life
short_description: Putin Life - a game that allows you to feel not only the leader of the Russian Federation, but perhaps the Lord of the world.Rob, steal, enslave.

name: Furious Goal
short_description: Welcome to the soccer game "Furious Goal".

name: LoveSick Darlings
short_description: TRY THE FREE DEMO! Make impossible decisions, romance girls, break each others hearts, and form unique bonds through your choices in this immersive game and story! Who will YOU go with to the end-of-year dance?

name: Magnia
short_description: A game with unique gameplay based on working with gravity and magnetism. Players will work with broken objects in zero gravity, build improvised towers, balance scales, destroy ensembles and use real-world physics to solve complicated puzzles.

name: Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth
short_description: Haku has sacrificed a lot to inherit a mask. With his natural wiles and the reputation of his departed friend, he strikes out on the path to a new future. The curtains rise on an era of strife that will shake Yamato to its very foundations.

name: Utawarerumono: Prelude to the Fallen
short_description: The first game in the Utawarerumono trilogy of story-rich tactics RPGs. Into a world filled with verdant nature, populated by folk with fluffy ears and fuzzy tails, awakens Hakuowlo, a man of masked mien and missing memory.

name: Obligation
short_description: "Obligation" is a decryption game made by RPGMaker. The player learns what happened to the character by switching the character personality. Different personalities have different ideas and operations on the same item.

name: fight wisdom
short_description: You can't miss the new game, you will regret for life

name: Synthetic Lover
short_description: In the future a biot working as a companion and without free will, encounters a device that makes him feel human. Self-discovery, hardships, and romance may follow. A BL/Yaoi visual novel.

name: Quaterneon
short_description: A simple running game. Dodge rotating objects, while trying to capture orange cubes for a score.

name: ED-IT
short_description: You are a robot named Ed with the ability to dream. Use your abilities to platform through levels and dream your way around obstacles.

name: 1984 Rewired
short_description: Year 1984, the society is controlled by the Great Warden. You must hack your way through the Cyber Reality to expose the truth behind his power. Run, jump, and avoid traps before the security system detects you.

name: Chernobyl: Road of Death
short_description: Chernobyl: Road of Death - 2d shooter with elements of survival and rogue-like. The game takes place on the territory of Chernobyl after the explosion of the nuclear power plant. In addition to monsters and military - you have to face a more dangerous and invisible enemy-radiation.

name: 活下去
short_description: 当前游戏无法正常游玩，正在和steam以及Bluestacks蓝叠的工作人员确认后续该如何操作，详情请见游戏公告。

name: 磨难之间 SUFFERING: Reincarnation of Sins
short_description: SUFFERING is a 2D souls-lite turn-based RPG. It obsessed with building dark suffering experience, hardcore settings, unique mechanics, endless expansion. It breaks the "New Game+" and adds the "Multiple reincarnations" to the traditional turn-based mechanism.

name: House of 1000 Doors: Family Secrets
short_description: Guide Kate Reed as she solves four mind-bending mysteries that take her to worlds she's never imagined!

name: Horizon Zero Dawn™ Complete Edition
short_description: Experience Aloy’s legendary quest to unravel the mysteries of a future Earth ruled by Machines. Use devastating tactical attacks against your prey and explore a majestic open world in this award-winning action RPG!

name: Shard
short_description: Gather the Shards, Open the Portals! Shard is a beautiful, short and challenging platformer game.

name: EEP  16 Expert Eisenbahn Aufbau- und Steuerungssimulation
short_description: EEP 16 ExpertThe Leading Railway Construction and Control SimulationDiscover the latest innovations in the most realistic railway construction game ever developed: EEP 16 Expert. This new version includes many additional features, both technical and functional

name: Galactic Rangers VR
short_description: Galactic Rangers VR is a first-person space action VR game, deeply immersive, just as arcade shooter should be. Grab your pair of blasters and fight through endless waves of enemies for as long as you can!

name: Scp: Resonance
short_description: The game takes place today, in the multifaceted universe of SCP. The main character is Galen, a simple scientist in Site 13. Recently, Galen graduated from the Faculty of Psychology and was recruited to work with SCP objects. But is everything so simple here?

name: Prison Princess
short_description: Lead two captured princesses to solve puzzles and escape the Demon King's castle. Your actions alone as a hero will decide their fates, and your own! A ghostly sliver of your former self, can you rescue the princesses? A new escape game experience, with cute girls, puzzles, and 'special' events.

name: mmmmm donuts arhhh......
short_description: Simple puzzle game. Your goal help yellow circle get to sweet donut

name: Dragon Slayer
short_description: In order to avenge her mother, Seraphine set out to kill the dragon named Xutaduss. Here she met people of the same purpose with her as Jennet and Elissa. But she encountered the protests of the creatures here, all of them standing up to fight to protect Xutaduss.

name: Sir'HaXXX
short_description: You created a program to turn hacking into a game, you called it Sir'HaXXX. Take control of your cursor, destroy the threats and enjoy the gallery in this challenging 2D adult shooter.

name: Last Chance VR
short_description: This is a very simple and easy VR game. Just enjoy yourself inside the VR world!

name: WASarD
short_description: WASarD is a rogue-lite single stick shooter. Maneuver your auto-casting wizard between dangerous enemies and hundreds of projectiles. Purchase passive charms, unlock permanent wards, and use powerful relics to give yourself an edge in each new randomly generated dungeon.

name: Those Chosen By God
short_description: Those Chosen By God Is a story driven, text heavy rpg that's more story than gameplay. It follows the life of Aden. (Pronounced in game as /ah, den/ ) Born into an appalling void known as the world. Aden must fight both mentally and physically If he wishes to survive the cruelty thrown at him.

name: Color Defense
short_description: Color Defense is an idle/clicker game with a tower defense theme. You can choose between different towers and upgrades to survive as long as you can.....

name: Buissons
short_description: Take control of a bush and challenge your friends in a hide and seek game up to 4 players. Move at night and use the day as an opportunity to observe and beat your opponents. Use the secrets of nature to trap them. Get ready to laugh!

name: Super Minesweeper attACK
short_description: You can play minesweeper, but you can have custom skins, campaign puzzles and your very own pet who evolves as you play. You can create your own skins and your own campaigns.

name: Commanders of Valor
short_description: A tabletop RPG strategy game set two centuries before common era

name: Magnet Fishing Simulator
short_description: Magnet Fishing Simulator is a relaxing and immersive treasure-hunting adventure where you fish for sunken relics with powerful magnets, restore them to glory, and upgrade your gear to unlock deeper, more mysterious waters.

name: Slip 'n Slime
short_description: Slip 'n slide around this casual puzzle adventure! Be a cute slime and explore a magical world. Only stop sliding when you run into something -- SPLAT! Perfect to pick up 'n play for a minute or binge in a weekend.

name: Psihanul
short_description: PSIHANUL- you will take revenge on the bosses and colleagues for the fact that you were fired, shoot and break everything around you, do not leave anything behind you, destroy this office and no one will help you in this, so good luck and don't freak out.

name: Return Of The Zombie King
short_description: Return of the Zombie King is a 2D-RUNNER, with a 1-BUTTON control system. Start with a dead king who can't jump, see, or hear anything. COLLECT as much gold as you can and UPGRADE him by buying back all his body parts. Then buy magic upgrades such as double jump and protection spells

name: Dark Romance: The Ethereal Gardens Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you defeat an evil fairy queen to avenge your father?

name: Sword of the Slayer
short_description: Fight monsters and free the ancient city with your enchanted talking sword!

name: Elmarion: Dragon time
short_description: “Elmarion: Time of the Dragon” is an RPG game, the main character of which is the dragon! The player will find many adventures and tasks, controlling not a human character, as in most RPGs, but a flying fire-breathing dragon. Aim of the game: to repel the invasion of the undead.

name: Taimanin Asagi 1: Trial
short_description: The long-running visual novel franchise is on Steam, complete with official English translation! After her final mission to protect the mankind from invasive forces of the dark, the former anti-demon ninja Igawa Asagi faces the treacherous debauchery that awaits her in the darkest depth of Tokyo.

name: Bowsette
short_description: Bowsette, the monster queen in the forest, found that her men were beginning to rebel. Bowset decided to teach them a lesson and let them know who was the real owner.

name: Lighted Knights
short_description: Engage in a pure RPG experience in this new world permeating with magic and fantastic creatures. Battle through haunted forests, crawl through deadly dungeons and explore caves for hidden treasures in order to reveal the secrets of the Lighted Knights.

name: Might is Right
short_description: Might is Right is an old-school turn-based strategy game, it has simple controls and deep complex mechanics.

name: Furry Shakespeare: Love's Lizards Lost
short_description: You've just landed in a new world, set to discover new mysteries and solve great conflicts. You're also a small reptile.

name: Furry Shakespeare: Dashing Dinosaurs & Sexy Centaurs: Winter's Tale
short_description: Do you like sappy holiday movies? Well, now you're in one. Save the day with your band of holiday elves.

name: The Void of Desires
short_description: The is space filled with rumours of the temple, in which any desire can be fulfilled. Many tried to find it, but only two space refugees managed to discover it, whose planet was destroyed by the halfgod Constructor. Now they have a long path ahead - straight to the wishgranter.

name: Demonarch
short_description: A first-person strategy game about summoning demons and herding them around like terrible cats to topple a civilization one castle at a time and finally become the new king, all on the orders of the guy who already did that and now spends his time making the people learn his tale.

name: ESCAPE FROM VOYNA: ALIENS FROM ARENA 51
short_description: Escape from Voyna: AFA is an action packed realistic single player shooter set in the era of the Cold War on russian soil. After many nuclear tests the land is devastated and apocalypse spreading. You, a secret agent stranded on an island try to escape without getting caught by enemy soldiers.

name: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk DX
short_description: "The promise begins." The "Dusk" series, a trilogy of RPG titles from Gust's popular Atelier series, tells the story of a world on the verge ruin, told from the perspective of its unique characters. The 1st title in the series "Atelier Ayesha" is now available as a deluxe version.

name: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky DX
short_description: "The promise is entrusted to two alchemists..." The "Dusk" series, a trilogy of RPG titles from Gust's popular Atelier series, tells the story of a world on the verge ruin, told from the perspective of its unique characters.

name: Atelier Shallie: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea DX
short_description: "A story of two girls fulfilling their wishes." The "Dusk" series, a trilogy of RPG titles from Gust's popular Atelier series, tells the story of a world on the verge ruin, told from the perspective of its unique characters. The 3rd title in the series "Atelier Shallie" is now available as a deluxe version.

name: The Adventures of Looppy
short_description: More than a platformer![/]

name: Book of Travels
short_description: Ready your pack, grab your walking stick and step into a world of mystery. Craft your character and immerse yourself in the enchanted lands of Braided Shore. Set your own goals and adventure alone or together with Travellers you meet on the road in this serene TMORPG.

name: CLIMB OUT!
short_description: You have fallen and you must CLIMB OUT!

name: Theology - Religion Creator
short_description: Create your very own religion and make history by dominating the whole wide world! Define your dogmas and wage holy wars on land, sea, and in the sky. Convert as many as you can to your belief system!

name: Karate Cat
short_description: Break, hit, meow! Play for the best karate cats in the world! Their paws are not the softest.

name: Heraldry Studio
short_description: Tool for making your own coat of arms is here! Heraldry Studio allows user to create and export a unique coat of arms, according to the rules of heraldry.

name: Party Pumper
short_description: Born in the vibrations of music, Party Pumper is a game about parties and for parties! Player's goal is to entertain the audience by mixing a music samples. Combine this with a dance movements and fun party gadgets action, interact with partygoers crowd and pump the party!

name: Creeps Creeps? Creeps!
short_description: A game whose goal is to pump the main character and defeat the boss. To do this, you need to earn gold by killing creeps in the forest. Lots of creeps. A lot of creeps.

name: Death To The Dragon Lord
short_description: For over a millennia the land of Aforn has been under the tyrannical rule of the Dragon Lord. All attempts to overthrow him have led to near genocide, but the Dragon Lord's cruelty is so great that despite the consequences another revolt is brewing.

name: Shark Castle
short_description: An atmospheric adventure featuring a sentient shark. Your castle is overrun with pollution, endangering you and your friends! Navigate toxic pipes, avoid robot minions, and save your home.

name: Who Is You
short_description: Who is You is a game in which you have to help the main character figure out himself. Create a character, make the right choice from the proposed ones, control your budget, take care of your health, take a rest in time and return to the painted world.

name: Timmy's adventures : VerbMon
short_description: Timmy's Adventures VerbMon is an adventure game, fun, educational for kids or parents to learn english irregular verbs ! Capture "VerbMons" using irregular verbs. Catch them all!

name: Ann Achronist: Many Happy Returns
short_description: Rewrite history in this charming time-travelling tale by diving into Regency England, rescuing your ancestor and changing both your lives for the better - one timeline at a time!

name: PixelForces.io
short_description: PixelForces.io is a challenging 3D shooting online game.

name: Snake: The Elder Forest
short_description: The Elder Forest is a special world with ancient forest that is in danger. To save this world the Snake was called from another one. So before the danger is coming, you should become more powerful to be ready to repel the Elder Forest!

name: Orbital Shipyards
short_description: Build, Explore, Fight. Build a ship of your imagination, explore the vast cosmos, and fight for your stake in the galaxy.

name: Operation: Cheek Clapper
short_description: Storm the base and clap alien cheeks in this fast-paced action game. Instant, quick, no fuss, alien fun!

name: Gridcannon Evolution
short_description: Gridcannon is a tactical solitaire card game where the player attempts to eliminate all royal cards (Jack, Queen, King) by strategically placing number cards on a grid.

name: The Inn Between: Prologue
short_description: A dark and atmospheric third person RPG with turn-based combat, puzzles, and a focus on exploration. Acquire party members and make choices that shape the world around you. Discover secrets lurking behind every corner!

name: The House In The Hollow
short_description: With graphics inspired by the 1920's Art Deco period, and a chilling soundtrack, the "House In The Hollow" will take you on a journey filled with mystery, horror, and magic, where you are the master of your own fate.

name: Asterminer
short_description: Dive into a serene, atmospheric journey in space. Control a mining ship, train, and operator on distant planets and asteroids. Gather resources for your loved ones in this immersive, slow-paced, grounded sci-fi adventure.

name: 四季 The Four Seasons
short_description: 春天般青涩、单纯的腼腆少年,夏日般阳光、善良的漂亮少女,秋风般飒爽、不羁的神秘少年,冬霜般凄冷、悲凉的阴郁少女,四个性格迥异的人,四段各自的成长,在如诗如歌的年华里交织在一起,汇成了一首四季交响曲。请用心聆听,这四时变化带来的奇妙旋律。

name: Buggy Bump
short_description: Welcome to the Buggy Bump festival. Buggy Bump is a racing experience like no other. Offering moment-to-moment racing in VR or on the screen.{headset not required for screen play}. Race through the desert festival setting by day and night, Every bump counts as you have to watch out for not just the other drivers but the track itself.

name: Love with Kadyrov
short_description: Spend an unforgettable evening with the cutest, smartest, handsome, strong, courageous, gentle, sensitive man in Russia and the World. Use gems to melt Ramzan’s heart.

name: Everslash
short_description: Everslash is an action platformer game where you have to move quickly and attack with your scythe. Use your Slash Attack move to dodge and strike your foes at the same time; defeat the monsters infesting the lab and find your way out.

name: BounceBall3D
short_description: Bouncing Ball has come 3D!

name: Little Red Riding Hood
short_description: 小红帽一个人，前往住在森林里的外婆家。 去的路上，在花田里做了小小的花束。 一路上，小红帽没有遇到大灰狼。然后就到了外婆家。 没有遇到大灰狼。 难道是我路上耽搁得不好吗？——小红帽她不明白。 那为什么 外婆，被杀掉了呢？

name: The Delirium Vacation
short_description: The Delirium Vacation is a surreal first person puzzle game from Ex Conspectu. Delve deep into the expanse of your own mind and experience the internal war between your inner Demons and your inner...hedgehogs.

name: KMP
short_description: "KMP" is a Computer game live broadcasting aids, combined with live software, can better interact with netizens, enhance the live experience!

name: Bloxicus
short_description: Bloxicus is a puzzle game in which you have to move colored blocks to help a hungry little dragon to collect all the tasty sweets along the way. You will have to travel throughout the islands, discover new worlds, collect candies!

name: N.a.N Industry VR
short_description: N⸱a⸱N Industry is a VR puzzle game where you build a "factory" by placing action blocks in space, arranged so that the inputs move towards the expected output location—their blocks possibly modified, split or combined along the way.

name: Trails of the Black Sun
short_description: Trails of the Black Sun is a first-person shooter and platformer hybrid, set in a digital simulation, where you, an Initiate, will have to find hidden artifacts and forbidden meanings. Use your acrobatic skills and defeat the Templars, fulfilling your Ultimate Quest 🔥

name: Blackberry

name: Queeny Army

Help Hugh to fit in and learn what human life is like by manually moving his head, arms and legs as you work together to explore an array of fun and wacky jobs in the pursuit of helping Hugh to fit in and be accepted by all!

name: Survived
short_description: First Person Shooter tower defensive strategy game, gather materials, build, and see how long you can survive!

name: Easy Bug Manager
short_description: Easy Bug Manager is a tool for bug management.If you're developing a software, web page, or game, Easy Bug Manager is your best choice to help you manage bugs in your project.If you're not a developer, Easy Bug Manager helps you record and manage what you need to do.

name: 单词训练营 | Word Training Camp
short_description: This is a fun game to teach, you can shoot, experience the fun of the game, while reciting words. We have many modes, such as practice, challenge, translation and so on. Each mode has a shooting range, so that you can learn English without being bored.

name: 群星战纪: 遗失的星辰 - STARS ERA: LOST STARS
short_description: 在可怕的噩梦中苏醒，岁月发现自己已沉睡了数万年。 自己曾经效忠的庞大帝国，因为突然爆发的“深渊侵蚀”，只剩下寥寥数人与最珍贵的“心智模型”。 面对外部极其相近的“类人类文明”与卷土重来的“深渊”，背负着仇恨与责任的岁月，又该如何抉择……

name: Vecter
short_description: Vecter is a fast-paced runner and shooter game where your goal is to survive by the skin of your teeth and raise hell in your path. You get in your ship, you push the throttle on max and then try to survive for as long as possible by annihilating anything that gets in your way.

name: Incredible Dracula: Vargosi Returns
short_description: It's time for the lady of the castle to take charge in this thrilling adventure featuring a role-reversal twist no one saw coming! Break from the ordinary and "unlive" a little!

name: House of 1000 Doors: The Palm of Zoroaster
short_description: Guide Kate Reed as she searches for the artifacts that can break the power of a cursed gem, solves clever puzzles and finds ingeniously hidden objects.

name: Incredible Dracula: The Ice Kingdom
short_description: Join Dracula on his most "chilling" adventure yet as he tries to stop the Ice Queen from turning the world into a giant snowball! It's the most fun you can have at subzero temperatures!

name: 妈妈，别走
short_description: 一款有人味的情感养成类游戏，教会你如何带给父母健康、快乐的晚年，也希望你的孩子学会如何关爱慢慢老去的你~ 毕竟，我们终将老去，我们终将成为步履蹒跚的他们，她们…很多事情就像时间~去了，就不再回来~

name: Natsuki Chronicles
short_description: New dramatic horizontal shoot ’em up that takes place in the same setting as Ginga Force. An immersive story that follows protagonist Natsuki. Discover the story of her past as a rookie pilot up to present day with events that are parallel to those in Ginga Force.

name: Forbidden Ingress

name: Eternal Kingdom Battle Peak

PVP is also possible on the field! Establish a legion and join a "Siege" where up to 200 players battle!!

short_description: RPG

name: Finders Reapers
short_description: Finders Reapers is an inventive third-person shooter. Experience items raining from the sky, collect them, sell them and discover a whole new concept where cash is ammo.Take on missions, fight it out online or battle against bots in custom skirmish mode.It’s time to prove you’re the best.

name: 黑暗之岛
short_description: Board the dark island, bravely explore the whole island, collect new CARDS to form their own deck, use CARDS and props to bravely defeat different enemies, finally eliminate the dragon, out of the darkness. Every time you explore a new island, your enemies, CARDS, stores, etc., are different.

name: Troll Control
short_description: Troll Control is an Action-Adventure RPG with procedurally generated environments set in the bizarre high-fantasy world of Anachronia. It is a top-down dungeon crawling experience to play solo or up to 4 players in true couch co-op style!

name: Archer: The Witch's Wrath
short_description: Become an ace archer! Use various arrows to hunt down monstrous enemies. Make fast, tactical decisions and dominate the battlefield. Demonstrate your skills with advanced firing modes. Wander in a beautiful environment, make meaningful choices, and prove your mastery of the bow!

name: Doomsday Hunters
short_description: Shoot stuff in a perfect pixel world, combine items, build guns, die every time! Roguelite twin-stick shooter where magic and post-apocalyptic future technologies collide. Defeat evil lord Dracula and save everyone!

name: Peer Gynt the Game
short_description: Norwegian dramatist Henrik Ibsen's undying play Peer Gynt has been recreated as an interactive game for children. The game takes you through the adventures of Norwegian peasant and anti-hero Peer. A new way to experience Ibsen's tale is here.

name: Ultimate Live Wallpaper

name: The Dreamwalkers
short_description: Take control of Morgan's destiny as his world is turned upside down. Explore the world of Dreams, where mythological creatures and Nightmares are real. A story-heavy adventure game with multiple endings, romance options and a symphonic music! Inspired by Neil Gaiman and Inception.

name: Imbroglio
short_description: Imbroglio is a smart and comfortably challenging puzzle game.

short_description: The Rogue-Lite shooter where you CRASH-KILL comical abominations! ​Pilot your spaceship as Swagthulhu in this original and wacky "Lovecraftian Parody"!

name: Shine's Adventures 6 (Go! Girls)

name: Shadowrain
short_description: In complete darkness, all memories faded into obscurity, you wake up in a small apartment. Looking through the windows of Neo-Tokyo’s Highrise E5671, you see the city. The city, fallen completely silent. You are not alone. It’s getting closer. hide

name: Cerberus: Orbital watch

While Rebels argue that elections are rigged, Forces hold the power. Engage in the battle to contribute to the storyline of the Cyberless game series!

name: Vector Light

Pilot your ship through meteor showers, giant factories, and more, as you reach for your dreams in a dangerous universe.

name: MyStar

Deep mastery for spectacular eSports. Jump into couch parties & zen puzzles. Hone skills for team battles & speedrun leaderboards!

This decision-making game is based on a combination of talented and professional pathways, there are over dozens of career paths to advance and over 50...

short_description: An alien invasion has fractured humanity into seven ideological factions each with a unique vision for the future. Lead your chosen faction to take control of Earth’s nations, expand across the Solar System, and battle enemy fleets in tactical combat.

short_description: The little girl comes to the City of Time, this place has the magic of making time back, you can use the magic of time backward to make time interlaced to help the little girl through difficulties.

short_description: The Orphan is filled with emotional story of Sarah, the orphan girl who mysteriously disappeared with her family. You as Sarah’s cousin has lost your memory and has to find out the clues with the help of an unknown spirit while saving yourself from another ghost in an abandoned house.

short_description: "Houston, we have a hole in one!" You've been sent to the moon to conduct scientific mini-golf experiments. This is important work considering the gravity of the situation... It's one small putt for the moon, one giant leap for moonkind!

name: Music Club Manager

Want to spend hours flipping a switch and accomplishing nothing? This game is for you! As an added bonus, the box will tell you stories as well as reveal unlocks!

short_description: Build your own airships by snaping engines, envelops, fins and gondolas together. Then fly it freely or watch it blow up in the sandbox!

Play together with friends and family to help Rocky, Tiny, Mazu and Bill save the day – before dino-dashing to the next zone. Dinosaurs have never had such giant fun!

As he ebbs, Wyatt's only desire is to be free, forever.

name: Shantae and the Seven Sirens
short_description: Shantae is back in an all-new tropical adventure! In her fifth outing, the Half-Genie hero gains new Fusion Magic abilities to explore a vast sunken city, makes new Half-Genie friends, and battles the Seven Sirens in her biggest, most thrilling quest yet!

name: Time Travel Trainer

name: Rebel Transmute

But life is not easy, with many monsters that eager to have both you and your hog's meat in their stomach, can you survive without superpower or magical skill?

name: 混世萌王喵霸霸 Cute Chaos Demon Nyanbaba
short_description: The super cute villain Nyanbaba is back again! This time, meow bully invaded 10 new scenes, found all the strange hidden points and cracked the magic of cat ear Nyanbaba! Contains jump out shock (cute)! And super cute Chinese dubbing! More scenes, more voice, more joy!
