short_description: The GoD Unit is a first-person physics-based puzzle game set in a near pre-apocalyptic future, featuring the mass manipulation ability and other familiar and beloved puzzle mechanics.

name: Space Elite Force II
short_description: Space Elite Force II is a frenetic space-shooter with weapon customization and insane bosses battles. Embark in your ship and fight for the survival of the human race!

name: Candera: The Forgotten Realm
short_description: Follow the story of Zaelor, a Guardian of Candera, as he embarks to take down the corruption in his land. Meet companions, delve through dungeons, craft equipment, find secrets, and travel the world to see his quest through! Use each party member's abilities strategically to take down difficult challenges.

name: 武儒绘卷 - 启示录
short_description: "Wu Confucian Painting Volume-Apocalypse" is a three-country background development game. Players can formulate their own development routes in the game, or assist the emperor as a counselor, or assist the emperor to seek the Quartet as a military commander, and he can be the monarch himself

name: Super Domino Effect 3D
short_description: Super Domino Effect 3D! is the last challenging Domino Effect Simulator. Your only goal is to create incredible, compelling and endless chain effects, using domino bricks, slides, platforms, "animated" games and everything your imagination suggests.

name: Cold wires
short_description: Cold wires-is a 2D arcade game with a side view, the essence of which is to clean the playing field and charge with the battery.

name: Pictassembler
short_description: Engineer a production line to build pixel art images one at a time. Get your timing and placement right to match the solution image and finish the level!

name: Kamtris
short_description: KamTris is a small game that combines the Kama Sutra and Tetris.

name: Photos
short_description: 这是一款把绘图和拼图相结合的新颖小游戏。

name: First Contact
short_description: Strange radio bursts have been detected! Embark on an immersive adventure as you analyze radio signals coming from space, decipher hidden messages, symbols, sounds, and translate alien languages. Follow an engaging story with countless dialogues and game-changing choices.

name: Firefight!
short_description: Put out the fires and rescue the hostages in this fast-paced arcade game!

name: Pirates Treasure II - Steam Edition
short_description: Pirates Treasure II is a 5 reel, 25 payline slot machine (pokie) with a Pirate theme, oriented from left to right. For Amusement Only

name: Better Boyfriend
short_description: Improve your boyfriend so he’s better than all the rest! Nag and encourage your boyfriend to level him up… If you are vigilant, your boyfriend will learn to complete tasks without you reminding him, and will start proactively doing nice things for you!

name: Talshard
short_description: You awaken in a mysterious world plagued with strange portals. Embark on a journey in this turn-based adventure RPG as you unravel the story and explore themes of fear and self-doubt.

name: DEAD FURY
short_description: Welcome to "Dead Fury," a zombie shooter set amidst the breathtaking landscape of New Zealand's South Island. But don't be fooled by the beautiful scenery — a deadly zombie virus has emerged from the permafrost, threatening to eradicate humanity and turn the world into a desolate wasteland.

name: Pangea Survival
short_description: Adapt. Survive. Thrive. In a world of ancient, prehistoric wonders you will have to learn to rely on your instincts as dinosaurs and poachers compete to SURVIVE PANGEA!

name: Void Breach
short_description: Void Breach is a low-res, retro point-and-click adventure game where an experiment has gone unpredictably wrong. Your daughter is whooshed through a tear in space! Embrace the void and follow her. The only way to bring her back.

name: Yang2020 Path To Presidency
short_description: Andrew Yang is unstoppable on his path to presidency! Play through all of the ups and downs of his campaign journey as you battle the other candidates, the naysayers and of course President Trump!

name: How Stories Die
short_description: Time travel, assassins and one magical gangster rabbit! The demon king threatens your kingdom and it's up to you, the prince, to find a suitable hero to fight it. Not an easy task, as it will require you to shed a lot of blood and maybe even die. But at least you will save everyone... right?

name: Swing & Miss
short_description: Swing & Miss is an adult visual novel, or eroge. It is a mostly linear story centered around themes such as swinging, netorare (or netorase), moral degeneration, and female domination.

name: James Town Courier Frog MD
short_description: Welcome to James Town! The Jungle driver is on drugs and is leaving packages in the wrong locations! It is up to Courier Frog MD to fix it. Using your Medical Degree, you must find the lost packages and deliver them!

name: Hotaru
short_description: Hotaru is a difficult space style shoot 'em up with different waves of enemies, bosses and power-ups.

name: Protagonism
short_description: You are the narrator of this game. Morgan is the protagonist, who knows about your existence. Narrate his life and talk to him. Make or break his life. Or something in between. Just remember things aren't always what they seem and consequences aren't always predictable.

name: Spacebase19
short_description: Defend Spacebase 19 from the asteroids swarming down on the station! Shoot down waves of stones and equip different powerful weapons. How many waves can you last? A simple nostalgic retro arcade turret defense shooter.

name: Tunnel Vision
short_description: Tunnel Vision is a Retro Space shooter that harkens back to the early 80s Arcades. Fun simple addictive gameplay.

name: GeoWar 2
short_description: GeoWar is a simple real-time strategy game where you have to capture all the bases from the enemies.

name: REFUGE
short_description: The third-person singleplayer rogue-like adventure - REFUGE, with an massive, handcrafted open-world and hardcore challenging action. Choose your fighting way through hordes of monsters. Unlock new loot, and find a way to survive and finish that path.

name: Bionic Hunter VR
short_description: Hunt down Monsters in a Sci-Fi Horror Survival Shooter and test your Skills among other players! Live an immersive experience with latest generation graphics.

name: Wings VR
short_description: Spread your wings and fly in this open world, casual multiplayer VR experience. Powered by WRLD3D maps, the world is yours to explore!

name: Music Visualizer Engine PC Live Wallpaper
short_description: Interactive 3D wallpaper that reacts on any sound. Play your music on YouTube, Spotify etc. and enjoy the spectacle.

name: Hop Step Sing! Astral Piece
short_description: In its fifth installment, Hop Step Sing!'s VR Music Video series takes interactivity to the next level. Join Niina Nijikawa as she dazzles you with her singing and dancing with her classmates after school hours.

name: Shot in the Dark
short_description: Armed with nothing but a six gun the lone bandit will need a quick hand and a sharp eye to fend off the nightmares lurking in the dark.

name: Cecil Run
short_description: Arrows fall randomly on Cecil as he continues to run away from danger avoiding pits and gaps while collecting meat and treasure. Survive long enough and the dentist will become agitated, get into his B-52 and bomb Cecil like the Dresden Cathedral. Once Cecil collects 10 pieces of meat, the hamburger will drop.

name: Hell Pub
short_description: 这是一款独一无二的策略rpg游戏，难度和标题都是地狱级的。 您需要组织一支4人战队，去通过冥王试炼。您的对手实力恐怖是不会让您失望的。 从来没有人类能走到最后，这次轮到您上场了。来接受一次终极考验吧。 当您击败血量 伤害都是几倍于您的对手，您会爱上这款游戏的。

name: Milkcraft
short_description: Milkcraft is a multiplayer RPG social sandbox game. In this mysterious world of Norse mythology, you can freely build your own territory and village, or start a survival adventure to challenge the dark dragon. Come with Us!

name: TriangleWingXXXX
short_description: A STG game. To prove your strength to the strange sound, you must defeat your campanions who have fought together with you.

name: Jack troubles
short_description: This is a first person shooter game,The player is a shooter with multiple weapons,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Enemies are scattered around the player and inside buildings,Players can kill enemies or avoid enemy attacks and maintain health,Players can also grab enemy weapons.

name: Not Your Eyes
short_description: Your eyes cannot be trusted. A girl finds herself questioned by a twisted psychiatrist, helping a fallen angel, and followed by a bizarre stalker, descending to a beautiful, terrible world where nothing is as it seems.

name: Granny: Chapter Two
short_description: You have to escape Granny and Grandpa...You have five days...

name: Rock, Paper, Scissors Simulator
short_description: First person view "Rock, Paper, Scissors" game

name: Dark Gravity
short_description: Shoot, destroy, collect, craft and destroy even more! "Dark Gravity" is a fast-paced, low poly vertical shoot'em up game that features non-linear campaign mode with lots of enemies and bosses. Craft new weapons, upgrade your fighter and build an ultimate aerial war machine!

name: Kika & Daigo: A Curious Tale
short_description: Kika & Daigo: A Curious Tale is a local splitscreen co-op game where you go on an adventure to find your lost grandpa. Use your unique abilities to work together to solve the mystery of grandpa's disappearance. Can you find back grandpa?

name: Calamari Clash
short_description: Calamari Clash is a multiplayer versus game which takes you into the role of a Calamartian who crashed on an unknown planet along with its companions. Dash it out against each other to charge the spaceship’s battery and escape. Only one can escape… who will it be?

name: Decadent Thinking
short_description: Over 100 short stories told by a mysterious girl. A "read" prescription for those of you who are tired of living.

name: Super Magbot
short_description: A precise 2D platformer with a twist. NO JUMPING. Master your magnetic powers to beat each level with speed and skill. Enjoy classic 16-bit gaming vibes, tackle challenging achievements and compete for global leaderboard supremacy along the way.

name: Tentacle Girl
short_description: Aoi and Sally, a treasure hunter, found a cave during the expedition. They foresee a treasure in it. So I decided to go in and take a look. Unexpectedly, this is a tentacled cave.

name: Toy Killer
short_description: Zombies take the island. You! Come to the city, find new weapons, and kill a maximum of them to get the higher score.

name: Defeated Girl
short_description: Defeated Girl is a jigsaw puzzle.

name: Magin: The Rat Project Stories
short_description: Magin is an exciting combination of a narrative-driven adventure game with a deck-building card battler. The branching plot, comic book aesthetic, full voice-over, and game mechanics are tightly intertwined in a unique, dark fantasy world.

name: Counter-Fall
short_description: Dash as fast as you can! Dodge the oncoming walls and obstacles and don't forget power ups!

name: Dissection Simulator: Dogfish Edition
short_description: VictoryXR’s virtual shark dissection software is a hands-on opportunity experienced through the power of VR. Join Wendy Martin, national award-winning science teacher, to guide you through a virtual reality shark dissection.

name: Birth to Death
short_description: Embark on the wonderful adventure that is life. Form meaningful connections with the people around you. Be comforted by material wealth. Experience a vast array of achievements… Unless you screw it up and die before doing anything.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online - Greymoor
short_description: Join over 18 million players in the award-winning online multiplayer RPG. Explore the frozen tundra and snowy mountains of Western Skyrim and stop a powerful Vampire Lord from enslaving Tamriel in The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor, part of the year-long gothic adventure The Dark Heart of Skyrim.

name: Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion
short_description: Play as an adorable yet trouble-making turnip. Avoid paying taxes, solve plantastic puzzles, harvest crops and battle massive beasts all in a journey to tear down a corrupt vegetable government!

name: Monster Jam Steel Titans 2
short_description: More Trucks! New Worlds! Monster Jam Steel Titans 2! Monster Jam Steel Titans 2 features more fan-favorite trucks in brand new Monster Jam worlds!

name: Pentiment
short_description: Step into a living illustrated world in a time when Europe is at a crossroads of great religious and political change. Walk in the footsteps of Andreas Maler, a master artist who finds himself in the middle of murders, scandals, and intrigue in the Bavarian Alps.

name: Shmup Arena
short_description: Take on intense challenges and waves of enemies in this frenetic arena shooter that demands quick reflexes and nonstop action. Survive the onslaught and defeat powerful bosses while staying in motion, mastering arenas designed for those who crave adrenaline and intense combat.

name: Taimanin Yukikaze 1: Trial
short_description: The long-running visual novel Taimanin saga continues! Mizuki Yukikaze and her senior Akiyama Rinko volunteers in an infiltration mission in order to rescue her long-lost mother. From the depth of the underground city awaits a trail of incidents full of suspense, betrayal, and debauchery.

name: Adventures of Ruby Rabbit
short_description: "The Adventure of Ruby Rabbit" is a light action shooter adventure game. In the game, you can control Ruby the cute bunny, fight the bunny balls, and grow as she grows.

name: Palace of sky
short_description: 突如其来的变故打破了山村的宁静， 一名不速之客的到来，造成相依为命的爷爷亡故。 为此，一名原本应该平凡的少年，为了替爷爷报仇，踏上了修行之路。 随着对事情的调查深入，他逐渐解除到了传送中的东西——九霄仙阙。

name: Clones Run
short_description: A puzzle action game where Clone humans race through stages aiming for the goal! Move blocks that are impossible to handle alone by teaming up with everyone! Bring as many clones as possible to the goal!

name: BREAK THROUGH
short_description: Breakthrough" is an action game in which you fight giant enemy robots. Equip weapons that fall on six floating bits and destroy the enemy's parts. Enemies can be won by destroying their cores, which are located somewhere on their body. Manipulate the six bits to eliminate all enemies.

name: i Have Powers!
short_description: SuperHeroic SuperHero Arcade Fighting Game, make a Superhero using the classic 4 color costume design of comic-book Heroes. See how powerful you can make your character, see how long they can survive. Choose lots of different SuperPowers, and stop crime by any means!

name: WOLFHOUND
short_description: Infiltrate a mysterious Axis base in the Bermuda Triangle as one-man army Capt. Chuck “WOLFHOUND” Rossetti. Explore the deadly island and uncover the Nazi's twisted scientific pursuits while wreaking havoc on their forces and horrific creations in this sci-fi WWII Metroidvania!

name: Game of the Year
short_description: A rhythm arcade about the lifestyle of ordinary teenagers in a mysterious primitive world.

name: Defending Frontiers
short_description: Defending Frontiers is a city defense, 2D graphics with a side view, a memorable and atmospheric soundtrack, colorful and beautiful graphics and unforgettable experiences.

name: Hexon
short_description: Just a nice puzzle, which you can spend a couple of hours.

name: Alwa's Legacy
short_description: Alwa’s Legacy is a modern retro game full of dangerous dungeons, mystic items and ancient secrets. Upgrade your magic and choose your own path in this non-linear adventure game brimming with exploration.

name: Seeds of Chaos
short_description: Not your average visual novel, Seeds of Chaos is a sexy dark fantasy tale with RPG & Strategy elements. Become an active participant in the story, making choices which impact your experience and shape the direction of the narrative.

name: My Cute Fuhrer
short_description: A small satiric anti-war game with a cute Fuhrer as the lead character. She dreams of love and world domination. Can you melt her heart with charm and match-3 skills?

name: MX vs ATV Legends
short_description: Race your way to victory on bikes, ATVs and UTVs in MX vs ATV Legends! Featuring massive new open environments, plus a career mode that lets you experience all the risks and rewards of becoming a world-famous professional rider. Become an off-road racing legend in your own right! Your time is now!

name: Hockeysplit

name: DonDon Busters!!

name: Justice Strikes

name: Rhythm of the Gods
short_description: Join the strongest mortal warrior, Lyrik, and slide, jump & slash to the beat to please the Gods of Rhythm! Solve the problems that the mortal realm faces in this auto-running, Greek-inspired rhythm game. Keep in time and reveal each gods’ true tune with unique beatmaps.

name: Sea King
short_description: Fast-paced naval combat party game.

name: Happy Game
short_description: A little boy falls asleep to a horrible nightmare. Can you make him happy again?

name: Phonopolis
short_description: Phonopolis is a story-driven puzzle adventure set in a hand-painted 3D world made of cardboard. Solve a wide variety of playful puzzles and help Felix end the Leader's oppressive influence in a resonant dystopian city inspired by avant-garde art.

name: Zombie World Coronavirus Apocalypse VR
short_description: Welcome to the world of the apocalyptic future, where in the laboratories the best scientists tried to create a cure for all known diseases, but the test led to terrible consequences that you will have to find out!

name: BORE DOME
short_description: In the near future, human life is perfect. BORE DOME is a magical pill solution from the future that lets you experience moments of human imperfection and mediocrity. Equip your senses and get ready to confront all kinds of situations and unhinged characters.

name: Frontline: The Great Patriotic War
short_description: A tactical scale strategy game that invites the players to take command of the URSS forces in an epic struggle for the control of Russia during World War Two.

name: Frog struggles
short_description: A fast and difficult action game in which lots of insects fight for control over the pond.

name: Position
short_description: Welcome to meditative story adventure about worlds, fantasies and eternal reasoning of mankind. Do not get lost.

name: Kart kids
short_description: A chaotic racing game in which up to 60 tiny karts race each other in the hood.

name: Talvisota - Winter War
short_description: Talvisota for Rising Storm 2 brings players from the steaming jungles of Vietnam to the frozen forests of Finland, during the Soviet-Finnish Winter War of the late 1930s.

name: Pilfer
short_description: A stealth game in which the player explores a small town, breaks into houses, and steals silverware.

name: Wrecker
short_description: Wrecker is an 2D arcade game set in space. In it you will fight off an endless horde of aliens in waves using your special issue high powered missile turret.

name: Thunderflash
short_description: Thunderflash is a "love letter" to the arcade games of the 80s. It is a Run 'n Gun game inspired by gems like Ikari Warriors, Commando and Heavy Barrel.

name: Goblin Summer Camp
short_description: The one true multiplayer goblin simulator. Play Goblin Tag and acquire power ups that let you leap across the entire map. Play Hide and Seek and annoy your friends with ‘REEEES’ when they cant find you. Stay alive in Death Run without being trapped. Be a goblin and do goblin things!

name: Tranject
short_description: Tranject is a 2D-space-shooter with a complex story about cleaning space and collecting green essence. The base game as well as a possible expansion is developed by Jadon-K. Fischer.

name: Primitive Survival
short_description: Conquer the stone age! Primitive Survival is a skill-based survival RPG. You begin as a primitive human and progress through the first steps toward civilization. Become a hunter/gatherer in a primitive world. Avoid dangerous predators as you learn the skills needed to overcome all obstacles.

name: JORRY
short_description: JORRY is a horror point & click game inspired by the classics of the 90's, including an survival horror game play.

name: Tin & Kuna
short_description: Spin and smash through the colorful, chaotic worlds of Tin & Kuna. Explore levels filled with puzzles and peril.

name: Kristala
short_description: Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG featuring challenging combat, fluid parkour, and deep exploration. Master the ancient magic of the Sacred Six Kristals and uncover the source of a mysterious curse in a thrilling, story-driven adventure.

name: The Unfinished Swan
short_description: From the creators of What Remains of Edith Finch. Enter the surreal world of The Unfinished Swan and explore a mysterious, hidden kingdom by splatting paint to reveal the world around you.

name: Suspicious Slide
short_description: Suspicious Slide takes the "ice slide" puzzle to the next level.

name: Swordsman VR
short_description: Swordsman is a realistic sword-fighting game. Customize your warrior, battle different factions in epic arenas, and defeat powerful enemies to unlock their special boss weapons on your journey to save the world from evil.

name: Ultimate Disc Golf
short_description: Disc Golf is a fun and easy to pick up sport that involves taking a disc and throwing it into a metal basket with chains on it. UDG is a disc golf video game with a unique take on "golf" style games. Featuring a character creator with real DG brands and explore-able courses. Come and play a round.

short_description: WorldBox is the ULTIMATE god simulator and sandbox game. A petri dish for your fantasy civilizations. Create your own world or destroy it using many powers. Watch civilizations grow, form kingdoms, colonize new lands, sail to far continents, wars to ignite, empires to fall and towns to burn!

short_description: This is a challenging action adventure game. Freud said: dreams are the way to the heart. The magician Black Crow, has closed his heart. You will play his good friend, the Witch Niche, to explore in the dream of the Black Crow, smash the nightmare and finally face the Black Crow's heart to save him.

short_description: Alchemelee is a potion-brewing party game that can be played with up to 4 players. Grow ingredients, make potions, and use them to affect the actions of other players, or be the first to make all three of your designated potions to win

name: Almighty: Kill Your Gods
short_description: Hunt demons, monsters, and gods solo or online with friends in this action RPG. Run, leap and fly across islands, ripping your foes to pieces, and rebuilding your home with their remains. Bring low the oppressive false gods, protect your kindred and become Almighty.

name: Rubber Bandits
short_description: Rubber Bandits is a criminally fun multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. With 8 action-packed game modes, players steal, brawl, and dash to the finish line with the most loot to win!

name: Soul Axiom Rebooted
short_description: The new enhanced edition of Soul Axiom - a first-person story-driven adventure puzzle game, set in the beautiful, haunting cyber-world of Elysia. Collect unique hand powers, discover multiple endings and choose your own destiny as you unravel the mystery of your digital afterlife.

name: Monster Capture King
short_description: A monster taming game that's good enough to share with your dad! Start off with a little Doggy and tame more monsters to become the Monster Capture King!

name: Drive 4 Survival

name: ВЗЛОМ ЖОПЫ
short_description: GOTY

name: Infinite Dronin
short_description: Your challenge: defeat waves of enemies, level your drone and survive as long as you can. Infinite Dronin is a roguelike hack-and-slash arena fighter with a Twitch twist.

name: Wamu Wamu 2
short_description: A cute short experimental game about cleaning fruits that are infested by big worms.

name: Lost Roads
short_description: Lost Roads is a psychological horror game in a world where undecipherable mysteries hide, are you ready to start the game?

name: Owata's Action ONLINE

name: Pinball universe
short_description: Pinball universe is an arcade game in which the player collects game points by manipulating the ball on the playing field. The goal of the game is to score as many game points as possible. Two playing fields are available.

name: Physical Glitch
short_description: Physical Glitch - this is a casual game using physics. Pink squares accidentally appear on the playing field, and your task is to collect them as much as possible and not touch the red objects. How many squares can you collect?

name: Bizarre Barber
short_description: Grab your VR controllers, and get ready to snip away! Bizarre Barber is a surreal, fun & fast-moving haircutting game set on a subway platform.

name: FLYING SHOT

name: Malediction

name: Flight League Series
short_description: FLS is a Scifi Sandbox Racing game.

name: Agent Emerson
short_description: In this immersive 360 degree first-person POV VR film, the viewer is dropped into a visceral, action-packed 3D cinematic experience usually seen in movie theaters, only this time YOU are the action hero.

name: Project Stocks
short_description: A darkly humorous and wacky trading simulator. Engage in market manipulation, insider trading, and ruthless deal-making as you battle AI tycoons and human traders. Short, speculate, form alliances, betray, and bend the rules to build your fortune.

name: Many Faces
short_description: Many Faces is a classic, retro arcade shooter from the 90s. Blast your way through randomly generated levels to confront the Many Face King!

name: The foreigner
short_description: 一件往事，一次邂逅，一段旅程，一丝乡愁，还有埋藏在砂尘的异国他乡的追忆

name: Seduce Me: The Complete Story
short_description: Introducing the COMPLETE STORY of "Seduce Me", the popular English Dating Sim where you get to tell your story with a family of five demon brothers. This Complete Story includes both main games, 13 mini-episodes, and both Audio Otome CDs as well as a basic compendium for lore comprehension!

name: FlickerMAZE
short_description: In this game You have to get through several levels of mazes by controlling a bouncy ball by shooting it.

name: Gizmos: Steampunk Nonograms
short_description: Solve challenging nonograms (also known as picross, griddlers, etc.) to decipher a message from a distant planet!

name: Gray Zone
short_description: Gray Zone is best described as Men of War meets Commandos in a futuristic coat. It's an odyssey of a slave who turned against his masters. Use stealth or direct combat in a squad-based encounters. Expect memorable characters, fun dialogues and lots of action!

name: Medieval Frontiers
short_description: Medieval Frontiers is a first-person village builder set in a wild and untamed medieval world. Establish your frontier settlement, manage resources, plant crops, craft items and guide your people through hard times and harsh conditions.

name: Primitive Hunter
short_description: In „Primitive Hunter” game you are moving to the old times and become a trapper who deals with hunting by using ancient technics of creating weapon and hunting tools like: spear, stone or arc and learning how to trucking animals by searching their traces.

name: Adventure Boy Jailbreak
short_description: Puzzle your way through the small town of Estivale, brought to life with a range of characters who all have a problem to solve. With each person you help, Benson gets one stop closer to breaking his friend Mike out of the county jail.

name: Klym
short_description: A 3D-Platformer about climbing buildings and finding ducklings.

name: Chico
short_description: Chico, an epic tail of survival on a peak in the middle of nowhere. Customize your screensaver and help Chico make his life comfortable.

name: Pupper park

name: Coffee Break

name: Aigor Escape from Bishop
short_description: Relive the taste of the 90's point and click with stunning graphics! Help Aigor, a scoundrel zombie, to escape from the secret crypts of the perfidious Bishop Antoine Santolamazza. Explore the dungeons of the cathedral and solve the many riddles!

name: Puzzle Frame
short_description: Enter a quiet place where you can relax and solve sliding puzzles. There's no tracking scores, no hidden doors, and no plot twist, just a zen place for your mind to wander.

name: Suzerain
short_description: Assume the role of President Anton Rayne and guide the nation of Sordland. Amidst brewing international conflicts, need for reform, deep-seated corruption, and economic recession, you must make the decisions in this political drama. How will you lead?

name: My Work Is Not Yet Done
short_description: My Work Is Not Yet Done is a narrative-driven investigative horror game, combining elements of the survival/simulation genres with a dense, nonlinear plot exploring the imbrication and dissolution of human identities/meanings within uncanny wilderness.

name: Infinite Beyond The Mind
short_description: Infinite - Beyond the mind is a slick 2D action-platformer where you take on evil Queen Evangelyn Bramann, ruler of The Beljantaur Kingdom as she works towards her dream of world domination.

name: Planet Bounce
short_description: Planet Bounce is an action packed arcade-style space game. Navigate solar systems, fire unique weapons, unlock powerful new ships in your quest to conquer the galaxy.

name: Wish
short_description: Soma, driven by destiny, begins his quest to save his home, Israfil Continent, which trembles in fear of an evil empress… Elf Pontifex, princess knight, the first vampire, etc , with the many beautiful women waiting for their stories to unravel, what will happen in the end of this adventure...?

name: Mix-Sign: Girl with 3 Signs
short_description: Mix-Sign: Girl with 3 Signs is an RPG game with a mix of adventure and thriller. It's the story of a girl named Luna. She woke up in the park and discovered that she's gained the powers of the signs.

name: Dimensions: Story Mode
short_description: Dimensions Story Mode is the stories from the Dimensions universe, without the gameplay from Dimensions VIP. If you are playing Dimensions VIP for the stories, then Dimensions Story Mode is your perfect companion.

name: ExtraGalactica
short_description: Slow time to a crawl as you pilot your super charged space craft through randomly generated waves of enemies, defeat huge bosses, and explore a cyberpunk planet with a flunking college football captain and his team's feline mascot Nova!

name: Project RTD: Random Tower Defense PvP
short_description: Project RTD is a Random Tower Defense PVP Game. Players will compete against each other, defending with randomly built towers or attacking other players by summoning monsters to become the “Final Winner”. The thrill of randomness and Strategic Tech Tree. Experience both in one game!

name: Brick Blaster
short_description: Brick Blaster is a classic brick breaking game with 100 levels to complete, power-ups to grab, and bosses to defeat!

name: Nasty Rogue
short_description: Mysterious Dungeon Exploration, Secret Items and Powerful Bosses, Fluid Movement Upgrades. Unique Enemies dropping Epic Loot. Level up your Stats, Enchant your weapons and Armor pieces.

name: Let's Learn Japanese! Vocabulary
short_description: Learn over 200 Japanese words by completing fun challenges. Unlock mini-games, art and music.

name: Axiel
short_description: Axiel is a casual puzzle game. No timers, no scoreboards, no rush. Take your time.

name: Shine's Adventures 3 (Sea Fight)
short_description: You can control Shine to fight the enemy again. This time you will meet large robots who dominate the ocean. But I want to say: 'Let them know how powerful we are and see whose firing fiercer. ' This time survival mode is very interesting, don't miss it.

name: Cable Guardian
short_description: Prevent cable twisting effortlessly! Cable Guardian keeps track of your rotation in VR and lets you know when to turn the other way. Forget the cable and focus on the fun!

name: Herbalist Simulator
short_description: Become a herbalist in a small village. Treat various diseases using natural methods. Prepare healing mixtures. Travel to search for better ingredients. Do not wait. Find your vocation to heal people…

name: Prometheus Wept
short_description: Prometheus Wept is a turn-based, party-based RPG set on a post digital apocalypse Earth. The game offers squad-level combat, branching dialogue with consequential choices, simultaneous battles between cyberspace and the physical world, along with deep character progression and crafting systems.

name: Hentai Like a Boss 2
short_description: Hentai Like a Boss 2 is a Memory Clicker game

name: Adventures in Space
short_description: The learning adventures in this science curriculum unit include the opportunity to pilot a spaceship, as well as a Mars Rover while learning some of the most important lessons about the Universe.

name: Samurai Simulator
short_description: Venture on the way of the samurai! Fight epic battles, serve your Daimyo, defend your honour. and train followers in the Samurai Simulator – first ever feudal Japan life simulation game on Steam.

name: Wooden Nickel
short_description: Step inside the curiosities of an Old West newspaper to explore a frontier town. Meet the locals, wander the desert, make choices that shape each morning's paper in a growing spread of possibilities.

name: Escape from Life Inc
short_description: Escape from Life Inc is a quirky story-driven puzzle platformer, where you switch between three animals: a walking fish, an arrogant eagle and a stuttering reindeer. Together with plenty of wacky characters, help these three unlikely friends escape the alien lab!

name: Reach Coin
short_description: Sometimes I'm hungry, I put a coin in that kind of machine but the candy just won't get out. What happens with my coin in there?

name: Hentai Vs Furries
short_description: Hentai VS Furries offers colorful gunshots. Skins, special angles for your enjoyment. And a "Pleasure" mode without a fight if you want to enjoy calm.

name: RC Service Simulator
short_description: Accept service orders or build your own unique RC Model. Manage your time and finances. Buy only the best parts on the market and bring your RC dream model to life. Compare its capabilities on the race track, sell it for money or put it on display with a certificate to earn bragging rights.

name: Idle Space
short_description: Your cursor won't linger in Idle Space as you play this exciting and fast-paced clicker. You will work to defeat an encroaching fleet, with every explosion collect metal to create, produce and upgrade factories to keep you in the fight.

name: DUMB Infernal
short_description: Enter the infernal hellscape as a lone warrior fending off an army of monsters in arcade style combat.

name: PhyxBox
short_description: PhyxBox is a physics based sandbox in VR, construct anything you can imagine!

name: Deserted
short_description: Deserted is a stylized 3D action adventure with light RPG and narrative elements. Inspired by the alien atmosphere of Out Of This World, Deserted combines narrative storytelling with survival and fast paced strategic combat to deliver a thrilling adventure.

name: Path
short_description: In the world of lightness and darkness, Let's make a Path by connect the dots.

name: Small War
short_description: You need to choose your camp and build the building! Build combat units through barracks and factories, and then manipulate combat units to destroy enemy bases!

name: The War Enders Evolution
short_description: The War Enders Evolution is an arcade style single-stage bullet hell game. Beat the game with the choice from three different fighters and two different styles.

name: Super Crystal Hunter
short_description: Enter this Arcade-RPG adventure incarnating the young thief Slade. Go through multiple places to loot in the Eastern Lands, visit special zones, face several bosses and discover various mini-games and additional extras.

name: Foxfall
short_description: Welcome to FoxFall! Super Satisfying Adventures waiting to you!

name: TAXIDERMY
short_description: An 80's VHS style first person horror experience, in this game you are locked in a house of a mad taxidermist and surviving is up to you!

name: Former Future
short_description: Vaporize evil robots and reclaim Saturn’s cities in this strategic shooter. The path you choose shapes the enemy's strength, the tools at your disposal, and the final stand you'll face. Overcome adaptive AI in solo or co-op play where distinct characters and synergistic abilities reward teamwork.

name: Kingdom Warrior
short_description: 在一个王国里 你即将成为新国王， 但是你会遇到各种各样的困难。

name: The Alchemist's House
short_description: An invitation from a stranger... There's something evil in this house... Will you survive?

name: DanielX.net Paint Composer
short_description: Create beautiful music simply and easily! Save your compositions and share them with friends and the world. Interesting characters are fun for both kids and adults. The musical staff is welcoming, you can leverage your existing knowledge of music or expand it through experimentation. Enjoy!

name: Hiro's Escape
short_description: Help Hiro sneak past Yamana clan mercenaries during the Onin War of 1467 feudal Japan and reunite with his scattered family in this refugee tale.

name: Red Rush
short_description: Take care of restoring the economy and the status of a superpower of a once great country in one of the most difficult times for Russia.

name: Temple Of Snek
short_description: A snaky tile-based puzzle dungeon adventure. Defend the temple, monch the infidels, and grow and grow ...and grow?

name: Bunny Park
short_description: Manage your own bunny park! Give snacks and toys to your bunnies. Improve and decorate your park to increase its popularity and collect all the bunnies!

name: SUPER 3-D CRUNK BROS.
short_description: SUPER 3-D CRUNK BROS. is an action-adventure platformer which tells the tale of a hash brown named Crunk, his "brother" Paco, and their journey to thwart the plans of a nefarious corporation bent on taking over the world.

name: YANCY
short_description: YANCY is an NES style action adventure that follows a small protagonist in a vast world full of danger, swords and rewards. Lead your own adventure in a non-linear game world, explore hand-crafted dungeons, forge magical weapons, battle challenging bosses and unearth ancient secrets!

name: Ailuri
short_description: A hand-drawn, 2D platformer following the breathtaking story of an endangered red panda, named Ailuri. Climb, explore and survive the intricate levels while trying to defeat enemies to restore balance of life in the world.

name: View From Below
short_description: An emotional, story-driven, turn-based RPG about a sad kid put through hell. Literally! Escape a nightmare world, to save your own.

name: Saber Fight VR
short_description: A VR game focused on laser sword fighting. Cut your enemies and environment to pieces in a physics-based world. Use your powers to pull and push any object! Deflect enemy projectiles with your blade! Rebuild your destroyed temple! Train and become a master!

name: Green: An Orc's Life
short_description: A life-simulation card-swiper. Grow an orc. Pilot it through a life of pillage, plunder and gluttony. Build up your horde, become filthy-rich with loot, even become a god!

name: Oil Wars
short_description: Strategy and simulation game where you will be faced to enemies for control of oil refinery and strategic resource locations.

name: FireTry
short_description: FireTry is a 2D overhead co-op tank game. Steer your tank with your keyboard, gamepad or your own codes. Design levels, defeat your enemies and push the limits. Play now for an immersive tank experience!

name: Kanojo x Switch
short_description: Switch around puzzle pieces to complete images.

name: The Blackbird of Amor
short_description: When there is an unsolved mystery, Stein can't let it go, he must pursue it till the end. In Amor there is a certain woman that interests him, she is rumored to have eternal youth. To solve the mystery of this woman he must tear heaven from earth. His journey will take him far beyond the world he has known.

name: FLAGFIGHTS
short_description: FLAGFIGHTS is an online action shooter in which you can choose where you want to fight and the side to play for. The goal of the game is to capture the flag as long as possible against the other team and at the same time shoot as many opponents as possible.

name: Civlands
short_description: Civlands combines elements from legendary RTS titles with epic turn-based strategy to provide a unique hybrid of tactical, real time strategy, with the grandeur, minutia, and depth of turn-based gameplay. Will you be the number one Civ?

name: BomberX
short_description: Take control of atypical characters and blow up as many enemies as possible. Single player or multiplayer, fight for wealth and get equipment that shows your power!

name: Real Orchestra
short_description: Real Orchestra is a VR experience as a orchestra conductor. Become a conductor and direct your orchestra.

name: Freight Simulator
short_description: Manage your transport company! Be a transportation entrepreneur, with control over everything in your business. Work, earn, invest and expand!

name: BlazeSky
short_description: BlazeSky is a space opera action RPG that tells the story of one person changing the fate of an entire galaxy. Explore stunning hand-crafted star systems, fight against strange alien races, and negotiate with key allies in this fully voice acted epic adventure.

name: romantic player
short_description: 这是一款敏捷+AVG类型的游戏，故事讲述了刀客聂关西年轻时的江湖风流趣事。用刀来卸下女侠们的层层防御并收集她们的闺房密事吧！

name: Cowboy
short_description: This is a third person role-playing game，Players have swords, bows and arrows, and guns（You need to be on a horse to use it）,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Players must maintain health，Players can kill nearby monsters or dodge attacks from monsters.

name: Defense and Revenge
short_description: Defense and Revenge is a turn-based strategy set in fantasy universe. You have to lead orcs tribe, provide defense and take revenge on enemies invading your land.

name: Peace Data
short_description: Peace Data — hard "Roguelike" game, in which you have to play for Bitard, saving Rusland from the tyranny of the authorities that destroyed the opposition and led the country to ruin, making slaves of citizens.

name: The Square Game
short_description: The Square Game is an insanely hard 2D action platformer with 24 short action packed levels.

name: 匿名信：失心者 / Stayer
short_description: Anonymous letter: the loss of heart is the beginning of the series of anonymous letter puzzle game, mainly tells about the intern detective man because of receiving an anonymous letter and broke the original quiet, when the letter instructions came to the abandoned 13 high school, found that everything has changed, is the trap?

name: Steamliner
short_description: Welcome aboard the Steamliner! As a carriage tester, you will experience anything from classic escape rooms to physics-defying surrealistic scenarios. Try to solve brain-melting puzzles inside a Victorian railway traveling through space!

name: Mompreneur: Pizza Cooking Life Sim
short_description: Live the life of a new mom in this story-driven cooking game.

name: Sakura Knight
short_description: Sakura Knight is a comedic yuri visual novel set in a fantasy world. Adventurous young Estelle dreams of becoming a knight, just like her famous mother, Cressida – but her journey is far more difficult than she ever anticipated!

name: Monster Truck Championship
short_description: A true Monster Truck simulation! A unique and challenging motor racing experience where local or online victory depends solely on your driving skills. 16 customizable trucks, 25 arenas and 3 leagues to win to become champion!

name: King of Seas
short_description: King of Seas is an ARPG adventure game set in a nautical pirate world. Embark on an epic adventure across the seven seas where you’ll discover lost islands and treasures, fight rival pirates and menacing monsters, and become the most legendary pirate of all time!

name: Spartrack VR - Firos
short_description: Mission Firos est un jeu multijoueur en réalité virtuelle, en déplacement libre, mélangeant énigmes et jeu de tir dans un environnement futuriste.

name: Dungeon Cards
short_description: Simple fast-paced card crawler with roguelike elements and addictive gameplay

name: capy hoky
short_description: Sokpop S04: capy hoky - capybara ice-hockey! Control a cast of wacky animals in this funny sports game. Play your real or AI friends in versus mode, or team up to compete in the Capy Cup and unlock new animals!

name: Potion Commotion
short_description: Live the CRAZY life of a Wizard’s assistant in this hilarious Clicker game! You’ll be in charge of making wacky and wonderful Potions, using ingredients produced in your garden. With plenty of twists and turns along the way, the fun never stops! Do you have what it takes?

name: Exit the Gungeon
short_description: Exit the Gungeon is a small, spin-off 'dungeon climber' immediately following the adventures of the misfit Gungeoneers.

name: Hand In Hand
short_description: An atmospheric platformer with puzzle elements and split screen, where the player takes control of two characters at once. Immerse yourself in the ethnic world of two heroes, solve puzzles and overcome obstacles together, explore the fairy forest and other locations, help each other.

name: Smart Moves
short_description: "Smart Moves" is a puzzle with a turn-based mechanics. . Different worlds with levels of increasing difficulty, sneaky monsters, unexpected obstacles and great treasures await you. Smart moves are the key to survival!

name: Cosmos
short_description: Cosmos is a rogue-lite shoot-em-up bullet-hell, in which you pilot the last hope for humanity in an attempt to save the world, pitching your augmented Starship against infused cosmic horrors. Can you close the Cosmic Rifts before The Singularity reaches your star system?

name: Virtually Real Life
short_description: "Reality. A term concocted by creatures to give worth to their version of reality..." What happens if a 2D being is dragged into a 3D realm? Follow the "hero" through a world he/she barely understands and survive the demonic beings who brought our hero into this realm.

name: The Island Story
short_description: The Island Story is leisure simulation game. Players can change the appearance of the island by placing different animals, plants and decorative items freely. Plants and animals also produce fruit and dust resources for further exploration and play.

name: Machina of the Planet Tree -Unity Unions-
short_description: From the developer of Machina of the Planet Tree -Planet Ruler-, comes the next installment in the series, Unity Unions! A young jewelmancer must stop the reawakening of a great evil and discover the truth behind her powers.

name: Coloniam
short_description: Colonize islands and grow your population. Manage trade routes and resources to meet the ever increasing needs of your colonist.

name: FlowState
short_description: This simulator is a true FPV Drone Racing simulator. The goal is to make it look and feel as similar to a standard racing drone as possible. As such, the goal is not to make the most HD/GoPro-esque visuals. Instead the focus is on simulating what pilots see through the goggles, static and all!

name: Aloe and Cal
short_description: Dive into the world of Aloe and Cal and experience a gently paced visual novel about the importance of food. With thousands of fun choices to make, over 100 CGs to look at, and 7 colorful characters to meet, you will undoubtedly walk away satisfied!

name: 子夜之章:历史的终局～MidNights of Desperado～
short_description: The protagonist of this lonely life is you. You leave your hometown and come to a strange world. The world is prosperous and cold, strange but real. You may like it or wish you could tear it to pieces. The good news is, you have the choice!

name: 郡主别怕
short_description: 《郡主别怕》是一款以刺客和锦衣卫明争暗斗为背景的全新社交推理游戏，玩家将分为锦衣卫与刺客两大阵营，扮演郡主及护卫展开一场权谋大战！

name: Cyndaria
short_description: 3D RPG COOP ROGUELIKE Explore the mysterious Crypt of Cyndaria and unearth its secrets. A plethora of traps to avoid, puzzles to solve and devious creatures are waiting for you to step into this ever-changing dungeon, with lan and online support.

name: BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre Demo
short_description: BDSM is the first satirical action RPG where you get to play Lou, Satan’s son! Get some booze, kill the traitors, save Hell and rescue the hottest demoness from the clutches of those nasty people and mega-corporations!

name: The Gladhollow Nasties
short_description: A beast stalks the forest by night. It will take cunning, stealth, and strategy to survive long enough to untangle a mystery through one wooded village and many despicable generations. Discover the stories of the sinful, pernicious, malicious morsels themselves: The Gladhollow Nasties.

name: Britannic
short_description: Welcome aboard the HMHS Britannic, the sister ship to the RMS Titanic. Experience first-hand how the biggest ship in the world met its demise in 1916 after striking a mine during World War 1.

name: Race Condition
short_description: Set in a modern low-poly arcade world, players of Race Condition find themselves as a rookie in a highly competitive open-wheel racing league. A rivalry with one suspiciously good opponent complicates things further.

name: POLITICAL KOMBAT
short_description: Classical fighting game featuring characters like Nikola Tesla, Putin, Trump, Hitler, Napoleon, Stalin, etc

name: Blind Descent
short_description: Immerse yourself in a new Martian underground adventure with Blind Descent, an open-world survival craft game that unveils the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends as you search for the missing team. Adapt and mutate to survive in this bizarre alien world.

name: CaveBugBoy
short_description: CaveBugBoy embarks on an epic adventure through dark and mysterious underground caves in search of a better life. The journey will encounter evil floating and screaming skulls, flying dead ants and flies, falling lava rocks, and collect bugs body parts.

name: 烈山海一(BMS1)
short_description: 《烈山海》是一款以中国神话为背景的RPG游戏，内容精彩让人欲罢不能！

name: sok-stories
short_description: A simple game making tool. Draw objects, drag them onto a canvas, and make rules to make a game! Easily upload your stories and share them anywhere, with anyone. What will you make?

name: 노베나 디아볼로스
short_description: Novena diabolos is an Ocult mystery adventure game. The main character, Park Joon-sung, has to find a single human woman who doesn't know who she is and get out of town safely.

name: Submersed
short_description: Rediscover the meaning of terror with Submersed. Are you afraid of depths? You will be.

name: Midnight Ride
short_description: Can you get her home unmolested?

name: Ageless
short_description: Ageless is a story driven puzzle platformer where you must alter the age of animals and plant life around you to progress. Play as Kiara, a young girl who braves through heartache and loss as she journeys across a mysterious world to discovers its secrets and herself.

name: Circle
short_description: This is the game that nurtures “Circle” and adventures in the "Outside" of the room.

name: Suits: Absolute Power
short_description: A business planet full of mystery, relics of power, dangerous jobs and terrifying monstrosities. Will your company defy the toxicity of this environment or will you find yourselves courting the power of corruption itself, in absolution.

name: Island Saver
short_description: A group of amazing islands need your help! Horrid plastic waste has washed up and you need to sort it out with your trusty Trash Blaster! But look out for the Litterbugs. They love mess and they’re out to muck things up.

name: Purgatory Overkill
short_description: "Purgatory Overkill" is a VR shooter and a VR tower defense when you can build turrets and walls to help you fight endless hordes of monsters while you actively participate in the fight with loads of guns.

name: Potion Craft: Alchemist Simulator
short_description: Potion Craft is an alchemist simulator where you physically interact with your tools and ingredients to brew potions. You're in full control of the whole shop: invent new recipes, attract customers and experiment to your heart's content. Just remember: the whole town is counting on you.

name: Thunder Kid II: Null Mission
short_description: Thunder Kid, come in. The Robot Empire is back, and they're kidnapping all the humans! Run 'n' gun through colorful environments, dodge bullets, blast enemies, and face off with challenging bosses in this engaging, 3D action platformer. Do you have what it takes to save humanity?

name: Breakneck City
short_description: Old school 3D Beat-Em-Up Action! Use your wits, reflexes and environment to take on the ruthless gangs of Breakneck City!

name: Bingo VR
short_description: It is unheard of that a casual BINGO! game is a weapon of choice which drives aliens to their homeworld and defeats them forevermore. Yet, it is based on a true story.

name: The Adventures of Bluke Bifton: Chapter 1
short_description: The Adventures of Bluke Bifton is a hand-drawn, episodic adventure game set in a world of absolute absurdity. Ally (or make enemies) with a cast of strange characters, and make choices that determine your fate.

name: YesterMorrow
short_description: YesterMorrow is a single-player time travelling 2D platformer, mixing action sequences with puzzle elements. Follow the engaging story of Yui, who travels back into the past to save her family and the remnants of a world now trapped in Never-ending Night.

name: Art Heist
short_description: Get past the guards, get the prized artwork and get out! You have a silenced pistol for this mission, use it if needed...

name: TCM RACING 2
short_description: A car sandbox game with no true goals laid out. It's up for you to decide what you want to do!

name: Hohokum
short_description: Take on the role of a curious flying kite-like being and travel to colorful, curious worlds waiting to be discovered.

name: Rocket Ghost Aidan
short_description: Ever want to experience a game that makes you want to play Rocket Ghost Aidan 2? Just play this! Its completely inferior to RGA 2.

name: Pipeline Of Emperor Yu
short_description: "Pipeline of Emperor Yu" is a puzzle game combining historical legends with classic water pipe gameplay! Facing all kinds of obstructions of the heavenly visions and unsuccessful grievances of three people, you need your wisdom to solve all these problems. Various elements such as sky mine, ground motion, fog, ice skating, etc.

name: Lithium City
short_description: Lithium City is a stylized isometric action game set in a neon-drenched world of electricity and violence.

name: lil' Sherman
short_description: lil' Sherman is a 3rd person action tower defense RPG that takes place in a stylized WW2/Alt-Universe.

name: XYLITH - Hostile Planet
short_description: In the vast subterranean world of Eldriss recently discovered monoliths are fueling more than just the humans fears. Sent by Nimbus you must investigate the mysterious Xylith and use any means necessary to quell an alien uprising.

name: ESCAPE ROOM VR
short_description: This game is a VR escape game. Solve the mysteries in each stage and uncover the hidden truth.

name: Daemonic Runner
short_description: Grab a rusty sword, gain some momentum, and send everyone flying in this aggressive joust. Sweep your foes away like a hurricane and cross bottomless chasms with giant leaps.

name: Silent World
short_description: A post nuclear apocalyptic world that has lost light. Survive by escaping from mutants that roam the city!

name: 封神纪传奇
short_description: 这个世界需要真正的大佬

name: Skull Rogue
short_description: Skull Rogue is an RPG in the classic rogue-like style. You have to pump your ordinary skeleton to an incredible level from scratch.

name: Lumin's Path
short_description: Lumin's Path is an atmospheric 3D platformer using light and darkness to impact the world in mysterious ways.

name: Flatspace
short_description: Flatspace is a top-down space trading game with the emphasis on freedom and exploration. You become captain of a spaceship in a living simulation of a distant galaxy. As a space pilot, you decide how to earn a living; command your crew, buy new and better ships and equipment, and explore.

name: RC Plane VR
short_description: RC Plane VR is a fully immersive RC flying VR experience with free flight and plenty of games and races.

name: Rum & Gun
short_description: Rum & Gun combines fast-paced shooter action with ARPG loot and character building. Journey across the Indian Ocean, uncover the secrets of the Drunken God, and become a legendary pirate captain. You're not on the Caribbean anymore...

name: labyrinth
short_description: A relaxing labyrinth game.

name: Super Kickers League
short_description: The best alternative to conventional football games is here!

name: Dusk Warlocks
short_description: Ever wished to fight using large scale spells? Dusk Warlocks is an online multiplayer spellcasting game in which up to 4 players compete in a tactical battle.

name: Night Of The Living Dead VR
short_description: NOTD VR is an exploratory experience that captures the original spirit of the film in black and white, immersing users in a 3D recreation of the film’s farmhouse set. Exclusive interviews with film experts and original cast and crew enrich the experience with insights into the horror classic.

name: PARANOID
short_description: You play as Michael, you will have to escape from a strange world where monstrous creatures want you dead. You will have to figure out how you came in this world through your past.

name: AIR WARS
short_description: AIR WARS is flight simulation game created with the history of air war. Board the aircraft that was actually used and feel the excitement of becoming a hero in history!

name: Matrix Brain Twister
short_description: A brain twisting puzzle game, where you have to fill the whole matrix with the same color to solve the riddle. Only recommended for clever people and those who like to suffer from difficult riddles.

name: Carpet Bombing
short_description: Carpet Bombing is a retro-style, 2D aircraft arcade game. Fly a jet fighter and engage enemy at land, sea and air! Choose from different aircrafts - each with their own unique flying profile. Arm yourself to the teeth and get ready for some serious action!

name: Wobbly Life
short_description: Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

name: Once More
short_description: Write the ending you've always deserved in life.

name: Ephemera
short_description: Guide your character through it all, from their birth to their last breath. Make sure they remember you.

name: Universe Quiz
short_description: The quiz game about astronomy.

name: Petal Crash
short_description: Crash blocks together into huge chain reactions in this frantic arcade action puzzler! Pick your favorite character and experience their tale in the Story Mode, solve tricky brain teasers and make your own in Puzzle Mode, shoot for high scores in Solo Play, or go head to head in Versus Mode!

name: WuJiDaoRen
short_description: WuJiDaoRen is a physics-based fighting game, that can put you back into the classic Kung Fu films. Play as a mighty hero to challenge the most dangerous villains in the world and bring peace to the people.

name: Catch Your Kitty
short_description: Catch kitties that are thrown down by birds.

name: Town of Machine

name: Encore Classic Puzzle & Board Games
