name: Cloudscape
short_description: You wake up on an uninhabited island. Gather resources and craft tools to help you survive. Find a way off of the island to discover new lands filled with new resources, villagers and much more! Can you solve the mystery of the monsters, uncover your past and transform your island into a paradise?

name: Evil Cult
short_description: This is a strategy board game of Lovecraftian macabre. Gain resources, grow your cult, stay hidden from the world, and when the stars are finally right summon the Elder God you worship. Alternatively, just eliminate the competition in an invisible war.

name: Rocket Shipment
short_description: A tricky physics based rocketship delivery game with an integrated level editor.

name: Sonic Frontiers
short_description: Experience Sonic like never before!

name: GraFi Valentine
short_description: GraFi Valentine - casual, colorful, minimalist, physical puzzle with traps, treadmills, portals, hearts and changing gravity.

name: The Watcher's Pursuit
short_description: You’ve uncovered dangerous secrets, and now the corporation you work for is hunting you down. Survive the night, monitor camera's and find a solution to the problem. Trust no one. Stay sharp. Your life depends on it.

name: VE GSIM Crane Simulator
short_description: Crane Simulator. Experience the challenge of controlling an overhang crane and tower crane in VR. Take the crane through an obstacle course.

name: Phoenix Strike
short_description: In a casual game with a top view, you have to control military equipment from a Quad bike to a tank (only 4 types). During the passage of the location, you need to break enemy ambushes, but also collect keys to get to the boss. Defeating the boss will open access to the next level.

name: Isle Of Spirits
short_description: Isle of spirits is a chill and casual survival game taking place on a mysterious desert isle. Build your home, survive, and fight against microclimates or supernatural phenomenons. The isle will be your home and your enemy: it offers all resources to live, but it is also full of terrible dangers.

name: Redneck Ed: Astro Monsters Show
short_description: Crisp combat mechanics, challenging arenas, hilarious storyline, and totally addictive and painfully familiar spot-on gameplay. Experience the thrills of fighting your way through the most bizarre villains in the Galaxy and defend the honor of Earth in the space arena!

name: Dr Livingstone, I Presume? Reversed Escape Room
short_description: Experience the reversed escape room game. Solve many different types of puzzles and venture deeper and deeper into the mansion's heart. Investigate what lies behind the mysterious letter from your dearest friend.

name: Kinky Fight Club
short_description: Kinky Fight Club is a real-time 3D adult RPG about competitive sex fights. Become champion of the KYFC ring or sit back and watch the kinkiest fights! Customize every aspect of the match to create sexy experiences that match your mood and fantasies.

name: Ultimate MMA
short_description: Ultimate MMA is a mixed martial art fighting game. Fight in the tournament, unlock new moves, create unique fighters and play with friends.

name: Great Alhcemist
short_description: Great Alchemist is a classic 3-in-a-row puzzle game.

name: Hot steel
short_description: Take on the role of a monster hunter who has occupied independent lands.

name: Samozbor ID:HEAVEN
short_description: Breach enemy stronghold in dread Siberian wastelands before insurgents can open gates to Samozbor dimension.

name: Attack of the alien thingies from lava!
short_description: Try to survive the increasing waves of alien thingies! Unlock and upgrade guns, pickup power-ups, get Steam achievements. Have fun with this brainless shooter game!

name: The Catch: Carp & Coarse Fishing
short_description: Take on the hunt of a lifetime as you target and pursue monster-sized fish around the world. You’re set, waiting…. The line tightens, your alarm screams, the fish is on and the battle commences!

name: 终回〇Murder Reservation
short_description: 契约达成，限制少女的枷锁被打碎，终回的物语已然展开。 一起，跨越界限吧—— 在此宝贵的一日里，因果的天秤由你掌控。 要探寻那份隐于其中的缘由吗？还是简单快捷地达成她的心愿？

name: Anti Air
short_description: Are you the new recruit? Well, grab your weapons and descent into battle on distant planets. There you will combat the Alien invasion called the Cubicon Conjunction. Waves will hit you so you better blast these invaders from the sky before they crash onto your base.How many will you take down?

name: HVOR
short_description: HVOR [/] - a dynamic top-down shooter, which takes place in the world,affected by an unknown infection.Kill the infected - and try not to join him.

name: Building the Universe: The Beginning of Time
short_description: Building the Universe is a time travel and building game that starts at the Big Bang and progresses through time as players recreate the conditions that resulted in the very fire atoms being created.

name: Catlateral Damage: Remeowstered
short_description: The premier first-person destructive house cat simulator is back with a vengeance! Play as a mischievous cat, swat your human's possessions onto the floor, scratch up curtains, smash precious keepsakes, and show your owner who's boss.

name: The Trud
short_description: The Trud is a horror game that combines exploration with stealth gameplay, here you'll need to find your way out and discover what's happening in the school while monsters are trying to catch you.

name: AREA MAN LIVES
short_description: AREA MAN LIVES. Or does he? A quirky radio drama unfolds around you in VR while you do your best to keep the radio station humming along as its new DJ. You record commercials, interview callers and try your best to piece together how your actions inside the station impact your listening audience.

name: Fields of Glory
short_description: Return to a true wargame based on Napoleon's Waterloo campaign! Become a General in control of huge armies in this classic, historic-themed RTS!

name: Tower Blitz
short_description: Tower Blitz is a fun and challenging Tower Defence game with over 10 levels

name: Blood Relation Part1.
short_description: Proceed with tools, notes, etc. in a closed building. Overcome various fears and complete tasks. Unlock secrets hidden in the building.

name: Boss Rush: Mythology
short_description: Boss Rush: Mythology - This is an action game in which you have to fight various creatures and gods from Greek, Scandinavian, Slavic and Egyptian mythologies.

name: Red Town
short_description: Welcome to Red Town! This is an old small village in which the villagers live calmly, contacting with environment very seldom. But despite this they are very glad to tourists! Be sure: the locals are eager to help you!

name: Goomanuvr
short_description: In this hilarious and procedurally generated challenging platformer, swing and jump your way though to the goal. Put your skills to the test in Single or Multiplayer.

name: Legion's Crawl 2
short_description: Legion's Crawl 2 is a classic turn-based, grid-based, roguelike dungeon crawler! Build your character, pick up and enhance your gear, defeat enemies with a minimum loss, eat to survive, and conquer the randomly generated dungeons!

name: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II
short_description: Be the hero in the ultimate STAR WARS™ battle fantasy with STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II: Celebration Edition!

name: Titanfall® 2
short_description: Respawn Entertainment gives you the most advanced titan technology in its new, single player campaign & multiplayer experience. Combine & conquer with new titans & pilots, deadlier weapons, & customization and progression systems that help you and your titan flow as one unstoppable killing force.

name: STAR WARS™ Battlefront
short_description: The STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ Ultimate Edition includes the STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ Deluxe Edition as well as the STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ Season Pass.

name: Mass Effect™: Andromeda Deluxe Edition
short_description: Return to the Mass Effect universe & lead the first humans in Andromeda on a desperate search for our new home.

name: Mass Effect™ 3 N7 Digital Deluxe Edition (2012)
short_description: Earth is burning. The Reapers have taken over and other civilizations are falling like dominoes. Lead the final fight to save humanity and take back Earth from these terrifying machines, Commander Shepard.

name: Dragon Age II: Ultimate Edition
short_description: You are Hawke, a refugee seeking to escape the darkspawn-plagued land of Ferelden and become Champion of Kirkwall. Rise to power and fight epic battles while making decisions that determine the course of civilization.

name: Dead Space™ 3
short_description: Journey across space to the icy planet of Tau Volantis with Isaac Clarke and Sgt. John Carver to discover and destroy the source of the Necromorph outbreak.

name: Burnout™ Paradise Remastered
short_description: Burnout Paradise Remastered provides the ultimate driving playground for you and your friends to play online. This remaster includes all add-ons from the Year of Paradise, including the Big Surf Island update, meticulously recreated and ready to wreck in 4K.

name: 禁忌
short_description: 在广阔的艾尔德林大陆做出你的选择，完成你的使命。在千千万万繁琐细碎的线索中找到事情的真相

name: My Universe - School Teacher
short_description: Play as a young teacher with a mission: bringing your new school back to the top! Motivate your pupils, improve their results and organize school contests and festivals.

name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
short_description: You play as an ant queen, growing an ant colony. Ants cannot be controlled directly. But you can spawn needed types of ants; upgrade them; make raids and most importantly - dig and build a dungeon! The goal of each location is to destroy all enemy bases. If the queen dies - the game ends.

name: UNNAMED
short_description: You - an UNNAMED suicide with a question mark instead of a face. But it looks like dying won't be so easy.

name: Cave Game
short_description: A simple concept with infinite possibilites. A procedurally generated 2D platformer.

name: 100 Doors Game - Escape from School
short_description: A girl named Mia is locked inside a school. Help her escape by solving puzzles and riddles, as well as finding hidden objects along the way that open the doors of every single room she finds herself trapped in.

name: Frontline: Panzer Blitzkrieg!
short_description: Fight your way through 35 Unique WW2 battles - Aim your targets carefully, counter-attack, and strategically coordinate your Squads. The study of enemy tactics and the use of Special abilities will lead to victory!

name: Terra Lander II - Rockslide Rescue
short_description: Terra Lander II - Rockslide Resuce is a sequel to Terra Lander, a homage to the classic early days of arcade retro, but this time you will need to rescue the humanoids of the landing pads from the planet through ten levels of increasing difficulty.

name: Into A Dream
short_description: You are his last hope. The only one who can rescue him. Delve deep into the dreams of Luke Williams, a man diagnosed with depression, unfold the heartbreaking story of his life and prevent him from... fading away.

name: This Dead Winter
short_description: Immerse yourself in the role of a Fox in this captivating dark fantasy adventure. Your cub has been spirited away into the heart of a mysterious valley gripped by an enduring winter. Get her back, no matter the cost.

name: Never Date Werewolves
short_description: Dating a werewolf means you’re left with a litter of kids who turn into cubs when they get upset. You’ve got the silver out of the house, meat in the fridge – but contrary to your ex, you can’t turn into a wolf when the cubs decide to do a runner!

name: Interference: Dead Air
short_description: All hell's breaking loose in a mysterious research facility and the only person who can save the day is the night shift security guard in the booth outside. Remotely control systems, guide scientists to safety or just… goof off? You’re not in danger. Yet.

name: McSpace Colosseum
short_description: McSpace Colosseum is a dungeon crawler fully packed with action and roguelite elements. Discover all kind of worlds, collect crazy gadgets &relics, and face blood-lusting bosses with up to 4 friends. Will you rise as the strongest gladiator in this whacky and limitless reality show?

name: MoonRun
short_description: Fight incoming waves in this classic pixel-art arcade game! Put your top-tier aiming skills to the test, get rewarded, and trade up your ammo to defeat the final boss.

name: Dandelions in the Sky
short_description: A new student with a mysterious past, and a girl isolated and bullied by her peers. What secrets are they hiding?

name: Simple LOTO Simulator
short_description: This Simple LOTO Simulator was developed to provide employers of any size, with a cost effective method to verify their employees' understanding of the Energy Control Procedure usually required under OSHA's Lockout/Tagout Standard.

name: Peg Solitaire Adventure
short_description: This game is an implementation of the board game Peg Solitaire. The objective is, making valid moves, to empty the entire board except for a solitary peg in the central hole. Seven types of game layouts.

name: FatCat with Hat - Reload the Powergun
short_description: FatCat's life is relaxed. But one day his great love Mrs.Cat is kidnapped by the nasty FatDog. FatCat immediately sets out to save his beloved, but the cunning FatDog is prepared. He sends his henchmen to take out the unloved adversary.

name: Truck Parking Simulator
short_description: Discover your skills to park a trailer.

name: Amairo Chocolate
short_description: Autumn. With the leaves just starting to change color, a boy arrives at Yunagi Village. The first person he meets is a girl handing out flyers -- a cute, cat-eared waitress.

name: Wonderland Nights: White Rabbit's Diary
short_description: Play as the White Rabbit in a schedule-based visual novel game set in the world of Alice in Wonderland.

name: Wandering Through The Vines
short_description: You find yourself in a strange land, by shooting and melee defeat your foes and journey to the end...

name: Flowers -Le volume sur automne-
short_description: As the summer heat fades, Suoh Shirahane is just one step away from unraveling the mystery of why her beloved Amitie partner left in the spring.

name: Shark In Aquarium
short_description: Shark in Aquarium is an arcade-style game. Your job is to grow your fish business and fight off threats to your aquarium. The game is designed to be cute and funny. It will be a great choice to relax after a stressful study or workday.

name: Battlefield™ V
short_description: This is the ultimate Battlefield V experience. Enter mankind’s greatest conflict with the complete arsenal of weapons, vehicles, and gadgets plus the best customization content of Year 1 and 2.

name: Battlefield 3™
short_description: Enjoy total freedom to fight the way you want. Explore 29 massive multiplayer maps and use loads of vehicles, weapons, and gadgets to help you turn up the heat. Every second of battle gets you closer to unlocking tons of extras and moving up in the Ranks. So get in the action.

name: Battlefield™ 1
short_description: Battlefield™ 1 takes you back to The Great War, WW1, where new technology and worldwide conflict changed the face of warfare forever.

name: Battlefield 4™
short_description: Embrace unrivaled destruction in Battlefield 4™. Revel in the glorious chaos of all-out war packed with rewarding, tactical challenges in an interactive environment.

name: Battlefield™ Hardline
short_description: Strategy. Speed. Story. These are the core pillars of Battlefield™ Hardline, a cops vs. criminals experience unlike any other.

name: Future Fragments
short_description: Travel to a threatening future and seek the fragments of a powerful weapon to defend your kingdom. Future Fragments is an adults-only, modern take on a platformer with genre-mixing gameplay, English voicework and a branching storyline with choices that actually matter.

name: The Songbird Guild
short_description: The Songbird Guild is a Yuri RPG/Visual Novel hybrid about magical girls falling in love. Investigate the secrets of a corrupt fantasy world and fight creepy (yet somehow adorable?) monsters in turn-based battles, all to pay the bills in this world where being a magical girl is a regular 9-5 job.

name: Sudd City Adventures
short_description: Sudd City Adventures is a lighthearted point-and-click 2D narrative game set in a world of ordinary superheroes.

name: Pancake House
short_description: Pancake House is a VR first-person shooting game. If you want to survive and save the world, you must defeat zombies.

name: Fractured Core
short_description: Lead a team of mercenaries in a cyberpunk world where elemental powers and corporate conspiracies collide. Take on high-risk missions, engage in strategic turn-based combat, and uncover the truth lurking beneath the surface.

name: Relentless
short_description: In this simulation, discover the impact of market finance on real economy. Take the lead of a trading desk and challenge your financial skills and instincts to earn as much money as possible!

name: TOGETHER BnB
short_description: Through the development of the plot in the game, you will gradually cultivate feelings and trust with female tenants, and gradually develop a deeper and intimate romantic relationship, but the crisis behind will also emerge gradually...

name: Seven Dunes: Curse on the Golden Sand
short_description: Seven Dunes: Curse on the Golden Sand is a game about an operation for rescuing a princess kidnapped by monsters in a fantasy desert kingdom. The hero (user) must solve numerous puzzles and deal with countless monsters to complete the operation. It combines adventure puzzles with RPG elements.

name: Mists of Aiden
short_description: Mists of Aiden is a first-person story driven horror game. You play as a thief trapped in an eerie mansion. Each choice can open a new mystery of the house and lead to a unique walkthrough and ending. Uncover final secret of the house. Uncover your own secrets.

name: Door Kickers 2: Task Force North
short_description: Command military Special Ops Teams in gripping tactical combat against a Middle East-based terrorist network. Sequel to RockPaperShotgun's "Best Tactics Game of 2014".

name: Pyro the Exterminator
short_description: A post-apocalypse story of exterminator with contract to clear a military depot

name: Cube
short_description: Cube is an adventurer who does not rule out challenges.

name: AZ: Oath of Brotherhood Prologue 1
short_description: This game intends to create a simple gameplay and story-heavy experience. Players will help a teenage boy go through a tough time in his life. A story that shows how friendship works when we need it the most.

name: Barro F
short_description: Faster and funnier!

name: Yoren
short_description: Yoren is the first cutting-edge realistic VR magic game. Cast spells by drawing rune gestures, explore the openworld collecting crafting ingredients for potions and battle the numerous bosses of fallen kingdoms in the world of Yoren.

name: Black Box Map Maker
short_description: Revolutionize your RPG campaigns! Black Box is the state-of-the-art AI-powered animated map generator developed through the latest gaming technology. Create unique and ultra-realistic 3D maps with the largest variety of themes, scenarios, and objects. It's immersive, user-friendly, fun and fast!

name: Gravewood High
short_description: An infinitely replayable stealth horror game set in high school. Try to escape alone or with up to five friends as you navigate destructible environments and randomized level layouts. Face off against a smart AI opponent that develops new abilities the more you play.

name: Animal Shelter
short_description: In Animal Shelter, your main target is to make your four-legged friends happy. Pet them, hand out treats, play with toys - and they will pay you back with great trust. Get to know the animals well enough to find them the best home! Don't wait any longer, open your animal shelter now!

name: Genokids
short_description: A bizarre music band named Genokids is rocking one of their best concerts to date when The Infinite Empire of Zenodia decides to invade Earth and assimilate mankind, landing right on top of the band and ruining both their concert and mood.

name: Death courier
short_description: In 2340. Earth ravaged, nearly destroyed. The last cities try to keep themselves alive and not starve. Hard times ahead. The roads to the other cities are destroyed, devastated or besieged by bandits.

name: Raid
short_description: Raid is a detective visual novel with choices and consequences, unfolding in a cold, slow-paced, lost-in-time way of the scandinavian tv-shows.

name: LOVE - A Puzzle Box Filled with Stories
short_description: Every life has a story. Every story has regret. But what if you could change the past? LOVE is a puzzle game about finding the things we’ve lost in ourselves and the people who help us find them.

name: Fap Simulator
short_description: Fap Simulator 2020 - is a classic game styled like Memory where you have to find paired pictures as quick as you can. After finding all similar pictures on the level you will be able to enjoy the opened image.

name: T.A.R.S
short_description: It is the year 2051, a disease has swept across the planet infecting over 90% of the population. You will take on the role of Samantha in this 3rd person horror shooter. Can you survive?

name: Pathseeker
short_description: Pathseeker is an open world role-playing game filled with compelling stories and dilemmas. In this massive world to explore, choose the path to your desired end, be it peace, love, glory, or destruction.

name: Formula Retro Racing
short_description: Formula Retro Racing is a retro style arcade racing game that’s influenced by the classic arcade racing games of the early 90’s.

name: Retrowave
short_description: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, '80s supercars speeding down an endless highway... Welcome to the world of Retrowave!

name: Draco VR Dragon Sim
short_description: Vr Physics sandbox Demo. Very Early access to support the game.

name: Pallas of Vines
short_description: A revolutionary musical adventure and an epic journey of myth and magic into the heart of a resonant musical world. Learn to play melodies and manipulate the sounds of nature and ancient relics. A unique experience where you have to trust your ears to discover a way through this strange reality

name: Up on the Rooftop
short_description: Santa's elves have revolted! Christmas is falling apart, but reindeer are on the case! Knock sense into the elves and ensure Santa can make his delivery on time! Avoid Bears! Make deliveries along the way! They must save Christmas; they will save Christmas!

name: Up on the Rooftop Soundtrack
short_description: Rock around the Christmas tree to these festive songs from Up on the Rooftop!Features remixes of popular holiday tunes!

name: Cannon Jump
short_description: "Don't forget to bring your cannon! Shoot down and jump up, it will help you,” said the old pirate. Legend has it that countless treasures are kept up there. In this game, you have to jump and climb up using the classic "rocket jump" technique.

name: Memory Player
short_description: A memory training game that let you memorize the order of one shuffled deck of 52 playing cards in minutes.

name: Infection Point
short_description: Infection Point is a quarter view Hack and slash zombie hunting game.A gas leak occurs in the city.The main character arrives at a skyscraper that reads "The One" to determine the cause of the accident.What happened in this building?

name: Xyla and the 'Shrooms of Doom
short_description: Xyla is a pink haired hero who was raised as an elite Forest Agent. She realised early on in her life that dedication to her jumping and shooting skills would lead her to success. Work with Xyla as she navigates the unpredictable terrain of the forest.

name: Turtoa: Global Rhythm
short_description: Feel the rhythm of exotic cultures and amazing instruments in this beautiful aquatic world music game.

name: Greed: Abandoned Dogs
short_description: GREED: Abandoned Dogs is a competitive “PvEvP” Third-Person Shooter. Travel back in time to ancient civilizations where your sole goal is to survive, loot treasures and escape. Be the last one standing to sell stolen relics and become rich.

name: Astronaut: The Best
short_description: Astronaut: The Best is an occult management adventure where people aren't just numbers: they're screwups. You must run a proper space academy using lies, witchcraft, and/or hard work. Guide cadets through a roguelite web of scandals and challenges, or the government will have you killed.

name: The Yolk Street
short_description: Evil boss oppresses his employees to make money again! How do you go about your life when you have financial pressure and want to have a girlfriend? ?！ 「The Yolk Street」will satisfy you all!

name: Luciform
short_description: Luciform is a color-based precision platformer that demands quick reflexes and nerves of steel. Can you help “Luci” navigate a dangerous forest to save its people from the nasty Red-Eyed Gorilla?

name: Dantes Bullet Inferno
short_description: Dantes Bullet Inferno is a shoot-em-up where the player fights against hell as Dante. This top down shooter includes a speedrun mode called time-dilation.

name: SokoBunny
short_description: SokoBunny is new fully 3d look at classic sokoban. Play alone or with your friend online, kick the cargo in the warehouse labyrinth.

name: Pendragon: Narrative Tactics
short_description: AD 673. Camelot has fallen. The Round Table must rally to save King Arthur. Narrative strategy game from the creators of 80 DAYS, with elegant tactics and a unique, dynamic story every time you replay.

name: A Highland Song
short_description: Moira McKinnon is running away. A wild adventure through the Scottish Highlands, with open platforming and dynamic storytelling, maps and music. From the creators of Heaven's Vault and 80 Days.

name: Typical Cliche
short_description: So obvious and typical story, just puzzle and dodge traps. (English version will be provided soon.)

name: Dashing Fire
short_description: DASH between tiny, monster-infested planets on your journey to becoming the next Sun!

name: Unlord
short_description: Lords of the Damned Land - a text quest, a book-playing in the genre of gloomy fantasy, mixed with jokes on the verge of madness. 80,000 words, 1000 pages, 3 win endings and lots of other endings.

name: KOROMU Auto Battler⭐202020
short_description: MBTI Empowers You to Fight💪! Get Ready to Embark on an Epic Journey Across the Galaxy Empire🚀!

name: Rocket Panda Panic
short_description: It's a Panda-emic! Spreading across the globe causing panic and fear. Only one hero has the courage, power and cuteness to save us all. Join Pandy and his jetpack as they travel the world, protecting us from the critter panda plague.

name: There Is No Game: Wrong Dimension
short_description: There is no game. So don't go messing things up by clicking everywhere. You don’t want to be kicked out of your video game world, do you? Of course not!

name: Eternal Fighters
short_description: Dive into Eternal Fighters, a fast-paced 2D fighting game that blends classic arcade action with modern dynamics. Choose from a roster of ninjas and warriors, each with unique abilities, and master modes like Arcade, VS, and Online. Prove your skills and become the ultimate Eternal Champion!

name: Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing
short_description: Jump into a 900 horsepower Sprint Car for some Saturday night dirt racing action! Feel the rush as you slide through the turns to take the checkered flag!

name: Legendary Knight
short_description: The enemy is invading our territory, and the king leads his men to resist. The king takes on the responsibility of defending his homeland. Vowing to expel tons of enemy forces away from our country, and guard the sacred statues that symbolize our ruling power.

name: The Botanist
short_description: The Botanist is 3D platformer featuring magical world of Bob’s dreams and nightmares full of exciting adventures and dangerous creatures. Enter his mind to go through the Dark Forbidden Forest and Broken Land.

name: Infestation: Battle Royale
short_description: Infestation: Battle Royale is a free-to-play, zombie-infested Battle Royale game. Fight in groups of 3 or solo until only one team remains standing. Discover a wide selection of maps, guns and customizations. Join in and let the good memories come back in this massively revamped all-time classic!

name: Galactic Center VR
short_description: Explore the center of the Milky Way like never before!

name: Shell Corp
short_description: Shell Corp is a 1-8 local multiplayer, physics based egg-centric, party game where you control, paint, and crack eggs! Using simple controls and wobbly eggs, play against your friends, or AI, in a series frantic mini-games. Will you take home the Egg Cup?

name: Halo Infinite
short_description: From one of gaming's most iconic sagas, Halo is bigger than ever. Featuring an expansive open-world campaign and a dynamic free to play multiplayer experience.

name: Garden Witch Life
short_description: Experience a cute, cozy witch life! After losing your job your life just took a whimsical turn. You're now on a quest to create a magical food forest and make it a home for all kinds of adorable creatures!

name: TechnoTsunami
short_description: Solve puzzles to uncover the mysteries of a space cruise ship. Fight or work together with robots which are remotely controlled by humans on Earth. Collect the technology coming from the future which might cause an apocalypse. Save the future and the past before it’s too late.

name: -The Sacrificial Girl of the Fantasy 3 Kingdoms-
short_description: 游戏《花园魔三国》是以萌娘化历史上著名的三国人物为特色的剧情冒险战斗的角色扮演游戏。 玩家和刘封、刘禅姐妹在神州大陆上与各个英雄人物交互。 游戏可以选择非常简单或者较为困难的战斗，大量的探索要素将会构筑一个精密细致的幻想世界。

name: Witch and Spirit
short_description: Play Hide and Seek in the Mistery Land with friends in Compete Mode or Collaborate Mode.

name: Dungeon Warriors
short_description: Dungeon Warriors is a random dungeon barrage game that we use to polish our lives

name: Until the Last Plane
short_description: Until the Last Plane is an airfield management game during WW2. Send pilots on mission. Craft spare parts. Repair your planes. Face your enemy and resist.

name: Sir Whoopass™: Immortal Death
short_description: WARNING: This game contains puns, dad jokes, flappy-bird-like-arcade-minigames, breaking of the 4th wall and jabs directed at tryhard-overly-serious-RPGS. Do not play if you hate FUN or would not like to strap in for a Hilarious quest for The Legendary Villain-Beating Artifact™.

name: Beach anime day
short_description: Beach anime day– a game that is a puzzle. The task of the game is to add up and get a whole picture, from the pieces into which it is cut.

name: Chicken Hero in Wulin
short_description: All Creatures will be uphold justice and "chivalrous".In the familiar world of martial arts,I regenerate a chicken.As a chicken, can you change your life against the weather and create miracles!Become an unprecedented and fantastic Great Xia! Everything is about to start!

name: kosmickop
short_description: In a post apocalyptic wasteland a jerboa is impersonating a police officer, much to the chagrin of a shadowy evil organisation.

name: Hex of Steel
short_description: Hex of Steel is a refreshing WWII wargame covering all fronts featuring a certain amount of original mechanics. Fight in solo against finally a decent AI throughout Europe, Africa or the Pacific, or against a friend in the cross-platform PBEM or real time multiplayer. Coop is also an option!

name: Hades Ultimate Fighting Ball
short_description: Hades Ultimate Fighting Ball is a multiplayer sports game of ball and fighting.

name: PIVO
short_description: PIVO is a game that solves puzzles between 2D space and 3D space. Experience transcending space with a cute corgi.

name: Dark Room
short_description: You woke up in a Mysterious place you have never seen before. Can you Find a way out? Solve Puzzles and find Hidden objects to uncover the Dark Story of the place you are trapped in.

name: Scorched Islands
short_description: Move to one of islands and fight with AI or other players at the keyboard. Set shooting angles and power and destroy enemy tanks.5 islands with different conditions and environmentVarious weather effects affecting the battleFull ballistics physicsSurprises to discover

name: Legacy of Sin: The Father Sacrifice
short_description: Welcome to the original Legacy of Sin game! The Father's Sacrifice is a route defense combined with an epic fantasy storyline straight out of a 90s TV serial. Face an orcish army in a fantasy take on early modern warfare! Deploy your men, hold the line, and defend the kingdom!

name: 잭과 콩나무: 숨겨진 이야기
short_description: 원작 동화 '잭과 콩나무' 를 모티브로 한 게임. 전쟁으로 황폐해진 마을에 살고 있는 잭은, 어느 날 한 마녀로부터 알 수 없는 콩을 받는다. 다음 날, 잭은 마당에 자란 콩나무 줄기를 타고 올라가게 되는데.. 잭은 그곳에서 신비로운 콩나무 성을 탐험하게 된다.

name: Shadow Puppets & Beijing opera
short_description: The work is composed of a total of 4 acts with about 15 minutes. The images and characters of this work are based on one of China’s intangible cultural heritage: Shadow Puppets, and the story and music of the game are based on another China’s intangible cultural heritage: Beijing Opera .

name: Seek Girl 2
short_description: That's hot Strip Escape Game!

name: 已下架
short_description: 《神鬼降世》是一款即时战斗类MMORPG网页游戏游戏 游戏整体上延用了经典的战士、法师、牧师三种职业，同时为玩家提供了三大职业神翼、十二星座守护灵兽、四大上古骑宠等玩法 。 是一款娱乐性，互动性都比较强的网页游戏，虽然画面较为简单，但游戏的PK方面还是做得很到位的。 一键精准敌人锁定击杀，满屏热血攻沙精彩，满足你的传奇体验。 复古写实的游戏画风，经典的传奇游戏玩法，带你重回记忆中的热血岁月。

name: Idle Warrior
short_description: Idle Warrior is a little idle/clicker game in which you play an warrior who has to fight against an unlimited number of enemies.

name: Jetpack Stadium
short_description: Jetpack Stadium is a hilarious VR sports game that will have you flying around a virtual stadium. Use your head to hit a massive soccer ball into your opponent's goal using two hand-mounted rockets. Duke it out against other players in a soccer-like competition!

name: Deep Despair
short_description: Deep Despair is a Minecraft-style survival sandbox. Travel, collect resources, craft items, dig, build, grow crops and survive. Freedom of action is limited only by your imagination!

name: SaveKunkun
short_description: Dive into horror-comedy with SaveKunkun. Play as an IKUN fan stuck in a time loop, remembering each reset. When a prank injures your friend, prevent their fall using over 100 methods. Explore time's mysteries, uncover friend's intentions, and save them.

name: POLYGON
short_description: POLYGON is a tactical multiplayer team 1st person shooter. Using various weapons, you will battle with up to 32 players on large-scale maps. Properly managing your arsenal and skills, you will lead your team to victory!

name: ANARCHY
short_description: ANARCHY is an escape / survivor games. Horde of robots, climbing, traps and many other things will try to kill you. It is one of the toughest games on steam right now.

name: Return to Sender
short_description: Return to Sender is a bullet-frenzy and rogue-like shooter. Killing each enemy returns a portion of your ammo, resulting in a fluid and chaotic run with nonstop shooting. Fight your way through enemies all while collecting new weapons and upgrades.

name: 降神战役 -A Story of the usurpers-
short_description: Because of an accident, the war once again descended on this land where peace has been welcomed for less than 10 years. Rebels swarming up, weak religious orders, hostile neighbors in the north. Where will the fate of the country go?

name: Hack or Die!
short_description: The Hacky-Sack Platformer! Keep the ball air-born while you kick your way through sprawling levels. Use unique kicking mechanics to rescue your best friend Kevin the dog. Just DONT DROP IT!!!

name: Notera
short_description: Notera is created for anyone trying to learn or play the harmonica better. It allows for both composing and step by step instructions for playing your songs through a virtual harmonica and a comprehensive interface!

name: FierceWind Decay
short_description: Endless guidance, endless reincarnation

name: Reborn: in the Android Womb
short_description: You are a Sperm Cell that wants to be reborn. Kill other players, destroy viruses and become the first to conquer the Egg Cell! Use thousands of combinations of abilities, many costumes and drones, buy and sell at auction.

name: HAUNTED SPACE
short_description: Experience the next generation of space combat in HAUNTED SPACE. Sci-fi blends with horror elements in a story-rich adventure based on exploration, fast-paced dogfighting, trading and ship crafting, with customisable flight simulation and intense multi-stage boss battles.

name: Bomb Fight
short_description: Bomb Fight is a local-multiplayer action party game. Destroy your friends or cooperate with them in a frenzy of bombs without destroying your self.

name: Dirty Harry's Thunder Drive
short_description: Rip up the streets of Neon City as a One-Car Thunderstorm. Your mission is to cause as much destruction as possible on the city's busiest highway. Your weapons? Wrecking Balls, Dynamite, and the pure speed of your prized Red Stallion.

name: The Test
short_description: You will answer a series of questions that will reveal truths from deep within. These questions may make you uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Test, and if you do, are you sure you want the answers you seek?

name: The Horrorscope
short_description: You will answer a series of questions that will reveal your potential fate. These questions may make you uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Horrorscope, and if you do, are you sure you want the answers you seek?

name: Celestial Reactors
short_description: A virtual reality experience where you explore mysterious landscapes and meet the entities inhabiting it.

name: TAG.IO
short_description: Join in the biggest game of Tag in the world!

name: Super Console Kid
short_description: Glitch out of reality! Master rocket-powered jumps, dashes, and rolls to save your town from pixelized foes bursting from busted game consoles in this bonkers 2D action adventure!

name: Fatal Wings
short_description: Fatal wings is a classic top down space shoot ‘em. Playing as the last resistance fighters from the similian colony in planet Lithios against a brutal attack led by vernor’s forces

name: There Is No Game: Jam Edition 2015
short_description: A little game that’s not a game, winner of an old game jam that nobody’s ever heard of. So DON'T INSTALL IT!

name: Energy Island Corp.
short_description: Build and manage an electric grid ! At the start of the day, build new infrastructure and plan your day. Once ready, start the day then watch electricity production / consumption in real time to adjust your buildings settings. The growth of the islands depends on you !

name: ENDURE
short_description: ENDURE is a randomly generated psychological horror experience, focusing on individual phobias to create the most terrifying experience possible.

name: Black Cat Adventures
short_description: Black Cat Adventures is a 2d casual platformer. Explore the levels, capture the creatures with magic, eat vegetables for health, pick up hats and potions to gain magic energy. Portals transfer you between levels. Unlimited randomly generated levels available.

name: CatDog Puzzle
short_description: CatDog Puzzle - slide puzzle game. You need solve the puzzle as fast as you can.

name: Bowmen
short_description: Lord Pain has risen once more to threaten the land of the living. As the last of an elite race known only as the Bowmen, you must gather your courage and slay his armies once again. Fight off hordes of enemies, equip unique items, and see how long you can survive in our debut title: Bowmen!

name: Get Good
short_description: A tough, skill based precision 2.5D platformer that will push you to your limits. Can you get good?

name: Victory and Glory: The American Civil War
short_description: Victory and Glory: The American Civil War is a game of grand strategy and fast-play tactical battles where you take the role of either the Union or the Confederates and attempt to win.

name: Warzone 2100
short_description: In the late 21st century, the world's civilizations are wiped out by a series of nuclear strikes, seemingly caused by a massive malfunction of the new NASDA (North American Strategic Defense Agency) strategic defense system.

name: Skid Cities
short_description: A Cyberpunk City Building Game. Define the city of a twisted, dark, utopian, or dystopian future. Build it in the sky, underground, on the ground. Navigate evil corporations, the Yakuza, android revolts, and unrest. Or embrace them - your choice.

name: RollingSky
short_description: Rolling Sky is a ball running game that combines rhythm and fun.

name: Simplode Suite
short_description: Simplode Suite is a toolset which does all kinds of things. You can dynamically balance microphone and speaker volume, force borderless fullscreen, optimize your CPU power settings, take partial screenshots, create click through borderless/windowed mode overlays, and so much more.

name: 双子树 TwinTrees
short_description: Live Danmaku interactive game.

name: Tower of the Approval
short_description: New feeling! Roguelike action!Do you know such a story? ?When you reach the top floor, you will be recognized as a single person ApplivarA story about a craftsman who starts to yearn for such a tower and aims for the top floor.

name: GirLand
short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

name: Dry Visit - Virtual Underwater Visit - iMARECulture
short_description: Thanks to the iMARECULTURE project, you can virtually dive into the 3D reconstructions of 3 of the most beautiful UW archaeological sites of the Mediterranean Sea: the UW Archaeological Park of Baiae (Naples, Italy), the Phoenician shipwreck of Xlendi (Gozo, Malta) and the Mazotos Shipwreck (Cyprus)

name: The House in the Forest
short_description: The House in the Forest is a short, first-person exploration game about a family who moved out to go live a lonely life. You'll play as a person who got lost on the way back to his house ends up discovering clean but an abandoned house.

name: GUN LADY
short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

name: KeyWe
short_description: KeyWe is a cute, co-operative postal puzzler starring Jeff and Debra, two small kiwi birds working in a whimsical post office. They must jump, flap, peck and butt-slam their way across an interactive landscape of levers, bells and buttons to get those messages delivered on time!

name: James Peris: No license nor control - Definitive edition
short_description: Graphic adventure with lots of extras and mini-games. Two difficulty levels and a clue system for those who may get stuck at some point even in the easy mode.

name: Send them to the sky
short_description: Use your magic cell keeping those funny villagers in the sky and don't let them down!

name: Pixel Pileup Party
short_description: A green on green 4-in-1 game collection styled after the most popular 90's handheld ever!

name: Ostrova Koshki
short_description: Action platformer about the lifestyle of ordinary teenagers in a mysterious primitive world

name: Infiniball
short_description: Infiniball is a simple yet addictive marble based game.

name: Galaxy Warfighter
short_description: Taking its roots from the classic games in the shoot'em up genre, «Galaxy Warfighter» conveys the old ideas in a new way. Piloting your fighter ship, you have to fight hordes of enemies with unpredictable strategies and attack schemes.

name: Nimbatus - Drone Creator
short_description: Use the Nimbatus Drone Creator to construct physically simulated drones and try them out in a virtual testing environment. Do you have what it takes to become a drone engineer?

name: Hellpoint: The Thespian Feast
short_description: This is a standalone story in Hellpoint universe, a dark and challenging action RPG set in the world where the line between science and occultism is blurred. The Thespian Feast tells the story of an investigator arriving at Irid Novo station 50 years after the Hellpoint events.

name: Mr Maker 3D Level Editor
short_description: Mr Maker 3D Level Editor is a platform game, with a level maker. Inspired by the games of the 90s, but with a touch of modernity.

name: The Galactic Junkers
short_description: Become the space captain you always wanted to be. There are just a few problems, your ship needs work, there’s a price on your head, and your crew are idiots. Seek your fortune and the truth in The Galactic Junkers, a comedic space combat adventure game.

name: STUFFED
short_description: A spooky teddy bear first-person shooter where you defend your owner from waves of her nightmares. Play solo or join your friends in up to 4 player online co-op.

name: Picklock
short_description: Join exciting adventure of escaping from cops. Be tricky and use your skills to complete your missions in green town. If you’re successful, you can enjoy well-deserved vacation at the seaside.

name: Season Match 4
short_description: Try out a challenging mix of match3, puzzles and quests in the breathtaking game Season Match 4! Enjoy nice characters, an amazing plot full of unexpected twists and lots of thrilling match-3 quests.

name: Mossen Seikkailut
short_description: Mossen Seikkailut is an indie RPG adventure where you solve puzzles as a dog and face real-time fights on your way to glory. Gain respect by helping others and learn new fighting techniques to defeat those who oppose you. Experience all of this in magnificent 640x480 resolution!

name: K'nife Fight
short_description: An exciting party brawler that encourages you to play with your food!

name: Turret
short_description: When Artificial Intelligence goes to war it won’t sound like a war. It will sound like a harmony of reason and logic... Mankind will shut it’s eyes in total agreement.

name: War for Magincia
short_description: In this prequel to Swamp Castle and the Great Tournament, lead a medieval faction as it attempts to secure the Kingdom of Magincia. Deal with other hostile factions and fight off barbarians to secure your rule.

name: Sigma Draconis
short_description: A group of colonists from a distant world have arrived at their new home. Equipped with advanced technology but limited resources, they must build to survive. Sigma Draconis is a colony simulation game which focuses on building and resource management.

name: RUBICON
short_description: RUBICON is a local multiplayer split-screen party shooter inside an omnidirectional puzzle cube, an action-packed PvP game show where every round has a powerful new weapon and each battle adds a zany new twist.

name: The Adventures of Spunk Dodgers and Splat
short_description: Spunk Dodgers and his sidekick Splat are ambushed by a group of space pirates and crash land on a mysterious asteroid! As Splat, dodge wacky space monsters through hazardous terrain on your adventure to help Spunk Dodgers fix your ship!

name: Sanguine Rose
short_description: Sanguine Rose is an erotic visual novel set in a gritty fantasy world. Follow a team of mercenaries as they find themselves trapped during a mission gone awry. Intrigue and debauchery await as a devious plot is set into motion!

name: Detectives United III: Timeless Voyage Collector's Edition
short_description: Detectives United is out of options and working for the villains!

name: KUR
short_description: Destroy drones, ravage robots and stomp some skull-bearing spiderdroids in a dark-humor drenched take on the classic 90’s shooter.

name: Tobari 2: Dream Ocean
short_description: Tobari is back in the latest action platformer from indie developer, desunoya. Use that staff and smack around your enemies for their magic as you traverse the Dream Ocean. Seek out the mysterious voice that calls to you from beyond the sea as you journey with Tobari into this unknown new world.

name: SilkRoad Project
short_description: SilkRoad Project is a 3rd person Character Action Game All sprinkled with some Inn Management mechanics that take place in a unique universe. The game is largely inspired by ultra-nervous Japanese action games, punctuated by moments of calm, serene relaxation.

name: Vaporwave World
short_description: "Vaporwave World" is a simple and casual buiding game that has three art packs (Egypt, Roman, 1980s). You can customize the lights in the game, and you will automatically get various types of buiding items over time.

name: Stalker
short_description: The background story of "Stalker" is that a teenager encounters various events on the road following a young girl. The teenager(player) can selectively interact and give repairs / help due to these events. How you will lead to different ending. The game was developed during the Global Game Jam 2020.

name: Entelechy
short_description: Entelechy - захватывающее приключение в альтернативной вселенной, где развитие технологий привело к возможности отделить душу человека от его тела. На что способна душа без тела? Вам предстоит ответить на этот вопрос!

name: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.8 Matsuribayashi
short_description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.

name: Gods Will Fall
short_description: The gods’ torturous rule over humanity has lasted for millennia. Bent on cruelty and suffering, they demand to be served with blind worship through an oath of fealty pledged from every man, woman and child. To those who don't submit to the gods’ will; a slow and merciless death awaits.

name: 长安夜明
short_description: 《长安夜明》是一款魔幻现实主义像素剧情RPG，基于玄奘历史故事，融入中国传统神话。 从长安到西域，一路风霜险阻，一路万里…… 而这一路上，没有孙悟空，没有猪八戒，没有沙和尚，甚至连白龙马亦不在身边。 这一路，只你一人，孤独而壮烈地启程。 杀，或赎，尽在你一念之间。

name: Sea Fishing Simulator
short_description: Go fishing in the North Sea!

name: Heart Star
short_description: Heart Star is an adorable puzzle platformer where you guide two little friends through two parallel worlds. Swap between the worlds to solve unique puzzles. Overcome all obstacles with the power of teamwork!

name: NYC Bungee
short_description: Take the elevator right to the famous torch of the Statue of Liberty before soaking up the scenery and finally jumping off in this dare devil challenge which is certainly not for the faint of heart!

name: Overcooked! All You Can Eat
short_description: Experience all the Onion Kingdom has to offer, Overcooked! 1 & 2 infused with 4k goodness running at a smooth 60 FPS. Fully remastered and cooked up from scratch. Enjoy 200+ levels (22 new) and 80+ chefs (3 new), this is the ultimate Overcooked! experience.

name: This Bed We Made
short_description: This Bed We Made is a third-person mystery game in which you play as a maid in a 1950s hotel and snoop around strangers' rooms to uncover their deadly secrets. Discover what links guests together in this tale of love, heartbreak and murder!

name: Evil Inside
short_description: Evil Inside is a first-person psychological horror game. After the death of his mother and the arrest of his father for it, Mark decides to contact her using the Spiritual board. But it fades away, and here is when all begins... Mark will face his greatest fears to discover the truth.

name: Sword of the Necromancer
short_description: Help Tama to save Koko using the powers of the forbidden Sword of the Necromancer. Turn your foes into allies and reach the depths of the Necromancer's dungeon. Defeat the guardians to gain enough soul power to bring Koko back from the dead, no matter the cost.

name: Climb the Tower
short_description: Challenging 3D platformer with a fantasy theme. Climb the tower and all defeat all its challenges.

name: Clipped
short_description: The simple life of a duck may not be so simple after all.. Something terrible has happened and it is up to YOU to figure out what's wrong, but what lies ahead will be a serious challenge, the tiniest mistakes can be your biggest accidents.

name: Unspottable
short_description: Now Online! Unspottable is a competitive party game. Blend in the crowd of AI characters, hunt down the other players and use the many different environment specific rules to win the game. Walk like a robot and punch like a human!

name: Crocotile 3D
short_description: Crocotile 3D is a tile-based 3d modeling application. A great tool for creating lowpoly models and scenes with pixel-art textures. Select tiles directly from tilesets and place them into a scene to give them a third dimension. Use various tools to edit your tiles and shape your models.

name: Realm Hacker
short_description: Realm Hacker is a game based on cyber worlds and hackers, allowing you to manipulate characters while building blocks, while using dexterous movement to pass the game level.

name: Sea of Stars
short_description: Sea of Stars is a turn-based RPG inspired by the classics. It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer.

name: Bulk Dominoes VR: Kinetic Rush
short_description: Build and create domino chain reactions, knock them down, then push 1 button to set them back up again. It’s fun and easy! Plus you will not have to worry about accidentally knocking them down while you're building.

name: Secrets of Moon Island
short_description: An indie (solo dev) Action Adventure RPG with Swordplay. Fight monsters in the game's own, non target based combat system. Become stronger by leveling up and collecting / looting items and equipment. Explore and discover the islands mysteries and secrets. What will you find?

name: Maze Burrow
short_description: An echidna wakes up one day to find its cozy burrow turned into a giant maze by an evil mole gang! Solve puzzles to progress through the burrow, defeat the mole gang, and escape to freedom in this Sokoban-inspired puzzler.

name: Fragile Box
short_description: Fragile Box - this is a physics game in which you play as a ball. Your task is to break the orange cubes and get points for it. You need to avoid red objects that are trying to reach you. If this happens, you will lose. How many points can you get?

name: The Fairy's Song
short_description: A yuri / lesbian visual novel set in the UK. Marnie, a bored goth girl, accidentally stumbles upon a sleeping female knight in the forest. Together, the pair must work to break a centuries-old curse, while romantic feelings between them begin to grow.

name: The Astro Parcel Service
short_description: Deliver packages as fast as you can while surviving the hazards of space and the crippling pressure of your employer, The Astro Parcel Service.

name: Electronic Squash
short_description: ‘Electronic Squash VR’ is a game of breaking walls by hitting the ball. ‘Electronic Squash VR’ does not apply actual squash game rules but offers similar sport experience with better visual appearance. Try our futuristic Sport Game in Virtual Reality!

name: Pirates? Pirates!
short_description: Pirates? Pirates! is a Reigns-inspired pirate survival RPG. You are a pirate captain in charge of your ship and crew on the most dangerous adventure of all seas. Fight your way ahead, sort out emergencies, and discover legendary treasures!

name: My Little Cloud - Rain and Thunder Sounds
short_description: A thunder and rain relaxation/ study app for Windows PC with high quality sounds and graphics. Thunder and rain sounds recorded by Emmy-winner and nature recording genius Gordon Hempton.

name: Cloud Miners
short_description: 2D couch co-op space mining, adventure and puzzle platformer set in the distant future

name: MoghVR
short_description: Mages are as powerful as their imagination.

name: Jurassic World Evolution 2
short_description: Jurassic World Evolution 2 is the much-anticipated sequel to Frontier’s highly successful Jurassic World Evolution. This bold new era in the Jurassic World Evolution game franchise builds upon the ground-breaking and immersive 2018 management simulation.

name: OneJump
short_description: OneJump is a minimalistic highscore based jump game. The challenging factor: you only have one chance to jump. You can play in singleplayer and local multiplayer.

name: 2D Baseball Duel
short_description: Enter the battle of Pitcher vs. Batter! Challenge the single player teams to unlock their unique pitches, then battle your friends with the fast paced competitive gameplay!

name: Betelgeuse
short_description: Betelgeuse is a mind-bending puzzle game where simple rules create complicated puzzles. At the beginning it should be easy for everyone, but later on it's getting really challenging. It consists of six chapters where rules are completely different.

name: Let's Drive - learn driving simulator
short_description: There are 1.3 billion cars in the world. But how many good drivers are there? Is every one of them trained and competent? Find out while playing Let's Drive, a driving school simulator that shows you hazardous situations on the road and puts you right in them.

name: Beach Games - holidays flirt game - find love or have fun
short_description: Your life is like a fairy tale... You worked hard on your internet startup for the last few years. The dating site you created turned out to be a spectacular success, and you became a millionaire youngster...

name: Psycho Simulator
short_description: 30% of our society suffers from psychological problems. Many famous people throughout the history and pop culture were troubled this way and required professional help.

name: House Builder
short_description: Become a one-man construction crew! Travel around the world and through the ages to build iconic designs! Beware of unpleasant temperatures and dangerous fauna!

name: Beautiful Girl Fight School
short_description: This is a beautiful girl fighting game. Players control characters to fight with beautiful girls and experience various interesting stories in the Academy. It's a game that you can't miss for those who like the role of beautiful girl or the fighting game!

name: LilyDeux - Black Lily Warning
short_description: Lily is girls with the ability. They fight again. This game is a simulation RPG that you can play with no stress. It is a system that has a deep strategic approach.

name: Terraformers
short_description: Terraform Mars in this turn-based colony builder and resource management game with roguelike elements. Explore the planet, develop spectacular cities, spread life and turn the Red Planet into a green one!

name: Conflict: Europe
short_description: The threat of nuclear war has receded and the balance of fear that entrapped humanity has loosened it's grip. Conflict: Europe shows why the nightmare must never become reality.

name: Witch College 2
short_description: Sam suddenly disappeared, leaving just a strange symbol behind! What could that mean?

name: Sunburnt
short_description: Sunburnt is a short, arcade-style game following a rather unfortunate fellow, seeking shelter from the sun in a desert oasis. How long will you survive?

name: My Supermarket
short_description: Manage your own supermarket, serving different types of customers and making the most profit you can! 🛒 Order products, restock shelves, play with your friends in co-op mode, chase thieves, hire employees, and grow your empire!

name: Mask of the Plague Doctor
short_description: Stop a deadly plague in a medieval fantasy tale of swords and surgery! Unearth medical knowledge, prevent the town’s purge, or plot your own escape.

name: Battletoads
short_description: • Over-the-top combat with combos and hard-hitting morph attacks • Wild, varied gameplay sequences for all types of gamers • Hand-drawn animation feels like playing a cartoon • Drop-in couch co-op for three players

name: Moonlight Mansion
short_description: A mother and her son uncover the mystery shrouding the manor in which they are imprisoned. To escape, they need to cooperate without letting panic take over, while the manor – or what haunts it – tries to separate them. In this suspenseful game, will you be able to accept the truths revealed to you?

name: Poly Duels
short_description: Fight your friends in this fast paced, easy to learn, hard to master fantasy brawler! Dodge, block, parry, and jump over attacks! Confuse your enemy by varying the tempo and types of your combos!

name: Somny & Yawn: Dream Detectives
short_description: Both players play as Somny & Yawn, two detectives who investigate the nightmare that invades the Islands of Dreams. With his sharp eyesight, Somny can find clues spread across the islands, while Yawn, thanks to her exceptional social skills, can discover the secrets of the inhabitants.

name: Mutated Muter's Invasion
short_description: A fun platformer adventure game about a music note fighting mobs and collecting power-ups and other items (with a couple side-scrolling shooter levels). Neutralize the evil Mutated Muter, a magical monster from the outer space who wants to steal all the music from the world!

name: Teacher Lady
short_description: The game is a classic puzzle with three levels of difficulty.

name: SideTracked!
short_description: An online co-op and pvp adventure action RPG focused around community, socializing, and adventure. In a world infested with a mysterious fog, turn yourself into a hero!

name: F-117A Stealth Fighter (NES edition)
short_description: Strap yourself into the cockpit of the world's most elite fighting weapon!

name: Serial Lover
short_description: A dating sim rhythm game where you seduce serial killers!

name: Thrive: Heavy Lies The Crown
short_description: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown is a complex city builder, where the fate of your kingdom hinges on your every decision. Explore this medieval land alone or with friends, make tough moral choices and conquer your foes in RTS combat. Will you struggle to survive, or find the strength to Thrive?

name: Battle for Iwo Jima

short_description: お嬢様刑事とうらぶれ探偵が挑む１７の事件！　池袋を舞台に男女コンビが大活躍！元ギャング執事に天才高校生ハッカーなど個性あふれるキャラクター達と力を合わせて、サスペンスにコメディ、オカルトなど多彩な事件に挑もう！

name: Chronicle of Daneya
short_description: Chronicle of Daneya - is a medieval fantasy where player has to write the history of the realm, make difficult and sometimes deadly decisions and put his signature under every word he wrote.

name: Bigwig Flint
short_description: Bigwig Flint is a challenging, thrilling, and hilarious top down shooter. A soulfully crafted game with emphasis on perfect classic retro gameplay. Waldemar, the circumcised square, must fight against Bigwig Flint and his many allies. At stake is not only the Universe, but also your sanity.

name: Hentai Amazon Girls
short_description: A third-person girl named Yuki has to rescue her friends from the enemies.

name: ISOLAND3: Dust of the Universe
short_description: A sequel to the ISOLAND series, where you continue your journey to explore the story of the universe on this island.

name: American Arcadia
short_description: American Arcadia is a cinematic puzzle game that combines a 2.5D platformer and first-person game to tell the tale of a thrilling escape. Experience the extraordinary story of Trevor, an average man escaping from the world's most popular reality tv show.

name: MyCompany996
short_description: 在《我的公司996》中，你会遇到各种典型职场人物和职场事件，公司危机四伏，如果想要保住饭碗，你需要“机灵点”，与同事维护好关系，哄的老板心花怒放，更快升职、加薪。当然，游戏里可以自由选择，你可以另辟蹊径，制霸职场…… 20余种迥异的大结局，近百种成就，等待你来解锁。

name: AeternoBlade II: Infinity
short_description: AeternoBlade II: Infinity, new patch in 4K is a hardcore action-puzzle game of Time-Manipulation Combat. Control the flow of time, amend the past, foresee the future, convolute with alternate timelines to fight otherwise undefeatable foes and circumvent the impossible.

name: Lynn , The Girl Drawn On Puzzles
short_description: [ Lynn ] In this Oriental Painting, there are many mazes and monsters created by the Nine-tailed Fox.Let's safely guide Lynn back home by moving the puzzle pieces drawn on top of the Oriental Painting.

name: Skully
short_description: On a mysterious remote island, a skull washes up on shore and is reawakened by an enigmatic deity. Dubbed Skully, the newly reanimated being has been summoned to intervene in a war between the deity’s three siblings, whose quarrel jeopardizes the island they call home.

name: Hero of the Kingdom: The Lost Tales 1
short_description: Lovely adventuring RPG series. Casual, story-driven journey and quests. People live in fear of the dragon. Embark with your friend Brent on a dangerous quest to kill the dragon and become a hero.

name: Daedaluz
short_description: Daedaluz is a game about maneuverability and obstacle avoidance where your ship breaks apart as you collide with them. Try to reach the end in consecutive increasingly difficult levels or try infinity mode and see how long you can survive.

name: Mine Dungeon
short_description: A Minesweeper game with a cute character, the control like a action game, and there have barrier objects and enemies.

name: The Trivial Dead
short_description: Grab some friends to help you fend off a horde of brain eating zombies by answering 1000’s of trivia questions! Earn killstreaks by answering multiple questions in a row. Choose your difficulty and how many waves you can survive against, or even try our survival endless mode.

name: Birth ME Code
short_description: The second entry of the Abime Series. Play as the mastermind in a death game where you must find the traitor while concealing your identity. Six hours, one school, six deaths. Nine participants fight for survival: it's kill or be killed, trust or deceive, escape or die.

name: Physics Based Golf
short_description: Physics Based Golf is an indie physics-based golf simulator that covers ALL aspects of the real sport. Drive your golf cart to your ball and use your rangefinder to gain information. From there it's up to you to choose the right club and execute the perfect swing. Play with 4 people online!

name: The Curse of Zigoris
short_description: The Curse Of Zigoris is an action adventure pixel art platformer game with a story about a girl who tries to lift the curse from her village.

name: The Indifferent Wonder of an Edible Place
short_description: The Indifferent Wonder of an Edible Place is a story about a building eater consuming a tower in a town condemned to be removed from history. It ponders the violence of erasure and the profound grief of surviving at the edge of despotism, when places of entangled heritage are willfully effaced.

name: Tales in the TAXI
short_description: 『Tales in the TAXI』 is a multi-ending adventure game in which the story diverges by driving a taxi and talking with passengers.

name: Summon Masks
short_description: A Shaman gives life to Masks just to play with them. Take a side and show to the Shaman which is the best Mask.

name: Bloodwych
short_description: A dark fantasy role play adventure that pits your strategic thinking against an insane ruler and his mystical forces.

name: Steampunk Genius
short_description: Create futuristic designs in the fantastic world of Steampunk.

name: Sarawak
short_description: A short literary mystery game set in Oxford and Borneo

name: Ex-Zodiac
short_description: A fast-paced low-poly 3D rail shooter heavily inspired by classics of the early 90's. Join protagonist Kyuu as she fights to free the worlds of the Sanzaru Star System, overrun by the intergalactic terrorist organization known as Zodiac.

name: Botty: Paper tales
short_description: Botty: Paper tales is an atmospheric adventure made entirely of paper. Botty's little robot faces a different illusion to get out of the paper world.

name: Apprehend;Girlfriend
short_description: Apprehend;Girlfriend is a Yuri Visual Novel about two young women living together under the same roof.

name: Hnefatafl
short_description: The ancient boardgame of the Vikings. Thousands of variants, offline and online cross-platform play with leaderboards and tournaments. Are you ready for the challenge? Prepared to earn your way to Valhalla?

name: Adventures of JQ Jones: "Isle of the Serpent Empress"
short_description: An action, adventure, stealth, VR maze crawler game. Explore and help JQ Jones collect gems, Serpent's eggs, hidden door knobs and keys to open gates. Battle against the enemies to pass through each levels by using your longbow, sword and Shuriken blade.

name: Transfer Of Essence
short_description: A fantasy tactical rpg /dungeon crawler where you decide how to spend action points to proceed. Play through each character's experience of the events to find out the mystery behind what happened.

name: Ninshi Masuta
short_description: Ninshi Masuta is a 2D action game where you are a ninja and have to save the city from the chaos caused by criminals.

name: Warspace
short_description: Warspace is a arcade space shooter game.

name: Spacewalk Defender
short_description: Dual-wield high tech weapons to fight off endless and increasingly difficult waves of enemies in this sci-fi VR shooter. Give it your best in an attempt to climb the leaderboards by reaching the highest score out of all players.

name: Carnival Games
short_description: Carnival Games offers fun for everyone and can be played alone or with up to three others. Hit home runs, pile the highest stack of cakes, and take your horse to the finish line. 20 total mini-games will have you and your friends stepping right up to win again and again!

name: Touch Typing Home Row Speed Grinder
short_description: An Onscreen Keyboard that is compatible with many programs, it allows you to take your Typing Training Everywhere You go! It also has Onboard Grinding Games that can be played offline allowing you to learn how to type using the "Key Rollover Method".

name: Iron Disco
short_description: A parody of 80s' action films. The game is set on a tropical island. Captain Juan and Dr. Lee challenge the Dark Lord and plan to take over the planet with their army of soldiers, zombies, robots, and creepy monsters.

name: Xuan-Yuan Sword VII
short_description: Xuan-Yuan Sword VII is an ARPG rooted in Chinese history and mythology. Players take on the role of Taishi Zhao, a calm and reliable swordsman who was accidentally involved in a tragic fate. To protect his beloved family, he starts a journey in this chaotic realm to find the truth.

name: Crush Zone: Demolition Derby
short_description: Enter the arena and experience fast-paced, arcade-style vehicular combat. Wield powerful weapons, use the environment to your advantage, or simply smash your way to victory in Crush Zone—where only the strongest survive.

name: King of Vikings
short_description: King of Vikings is an adventure visual novel set in a Viking fantasy land. You play as a Viking noble summoned by Queen Mathilde to defeat a tentacled menace by assembling an elite unit of warriors.

name: Tiny Bunny: Prologue
short_description: Tiny Bunny: Prologue is a non-linear horror visual novel. Those, who have heard the voice of the forest, are beyond help.

name: Survival Denied
short_description: Survival Denied is a casual zombie shooter, made primarily with VR in mind. Wide choice of weapons, perks and power-ups make the game interesting. Dive in and try to survive as long as you can!

name: Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown
short_description: TDUSC is a lifestyle and social experience that redefines what an open-world racing game can be. Explore a fully recreated Hong Kong Island. Take to the road behind the wheel of exceptional cars and live the ultimate life of luxury.

name: 愛神餐館MAX
short_description: Love, restaurant, and RPG adventure all in one, the origin of the "Cupid Bistro!!" series is here! As the main protagonist Rato Coriander, you need to run a bistro as part of your final year assignment. In one year's time, you are the one to decide all different endings with 13 beautiful girls!

name: Ourea
short_description: Ourea is a Cinematic Puzzle game about discovering the harrowing past of a long-forgotten world. Play as the last of the Oreads and unravel the mysterious history of your people.​

name: PASVAN
short_description: You can't get away from 'GAMAN' !

name: 法利恩戰記（Furion Chronicles）
short_description: The emergence of the Empire's flying city has no surprise decided the direction of the whole war. In order to avoid defeat, the countries and counties in the southern mainland signed a peace agreement with the Empire. At this time, the southern continent of farien, the city-state union of caldis, was attacked like a tide of demons

name: Curtains
short_description: Customize your Windows 10 desktop with new high-DPI supported styles along the lines of Light and Dark mode! Using Curtains, you can create and share your own styles, or choose from several modern or classic styles that look like Windows XP or other alternative operating systems.

name: Housebreaker
short_description: A break-in action simulator in which methods used plays an essential role. Use reliable equipment for an effective burglary into different locations and complete assignments there, from minor robberies and petty thefts to international jumps.

name: Space Station Manager
short_description: Space Station Manager is an exciting game where you own a space company, your main goal is to build a space station, make profit, grow your business, build an economical network, and expand beyond the solar system.

name: Swamp Castle
short_description: You are a newly appointed Lord in charge of a small castle. Manage your castle's finances, hire troops, resolve conflicts among the peasants, and bring order to the realm. Expand your power through war, diplomacy, or stealth. Whether you rise or fall is up to you in Swamp Castle.

name: Spellbind Tactics
short_description: Spellbind Tactics is a turn-based online competitive multiplayer game, where you control a small team of unique characters. Synergies and strategies are key in order to achieve victory. The game is still early in development so stay tuned for news.

name: Fire Safety Lab VR
short_description: Learn how to use fire extinguishers of different types, how to protect yourself from smoke and high temperatures, what to do in the event of a fire alarm and how to find an emergency exit from the building. Fire Safety Lab VR gives you an immersive experience of being in emergency.

name: Runaway Demon Bride
short_description: Summoned to another world by the cutest Demon in all the realms, you set off to end the war between Demon and Humankind so you can run away with your demon bride and enjoy a life of wedded bliss!

name: Cyber Battle 69
short_description: Cyber Battle 69 is a VR cooperative multiplayer action title set in the distant future on a moon orbiting a gas giant located on the outskirts of the Milky Way. Fight against other players and hordes of infected alike to get rich and make a name for yourself.

name: Fallen Region
short_description: Fallen Region is a third-person survival sandbox game in an open, post-apocalyptic world.

name: NAMCO MUSEUM ARCHIVES Vol 1
short_description: Take a trip down memory lane and relive the magical times of the Nintendo Entertainment System with a collection of Namco’s hits and long-lost treasures in Namco Museum Archives Volume 1.

name: Quarter Dollar
short_description: A wild west sci-fi RPG set in an apocalyptic world, without any means of defense other than talking.

name: Laser Heck
short_description: Laser Heck is an arcade-style space shooter that could be described as "Bullet-Heck Asteroids". Defend a space station against an invading fleet by yourself or with 4 Player Split-Screen Coop, or have some fun with your friends by playing the Deathmatch, Keep Away, and Racing mini-games.

name: Путешествие паладина
short_description: Non-linear dramatic story about a paladin that left his home monastery for the first time to go on quest. The quest appeared harder that paladin throught: she is haunted by demons now, and the only people who coul help her - ancient rivals of paladins, the Duids.

name: You are next
short_description: "You are next" is a murder mystery for Virtual Reality. Gather your detective instinct and identify the killer!

name: Orders of Magnitude
short_description: Have you ever wondered what the whole Universe looks like? With the myriad Galaxies, each containing billions of Stars, including our Solar System? Have you seen a Human Brain and its Neurons? DNA? What about the Electrons surrounding the tiny Atomic Nucleus? And what lies at even smaller scales?

name: Rhyme Storm
short_description: Rhyme Storm is the world's first freestyle rapping rhythm game! It's packed with awesome beats, hilarious topics, and mind blowing visuals that dance and pulse to your performance. You won't be asking if you can freestyle rap -- you'll be wondering how fast you can go!

name: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) 40th Anniversary Edition
short_description: From gliders and helicopters to wide-body jets, fly highly detailed and accurate aircraft in the Microsoft Flight Simulator 40th Anniversary Edition. The world is at your fingertips.

name: Star Seeker
short_description: Star Seeker パズル+ロールプレイング+トレーディングカードゲーム

name: Garlic
short_description: You are Garlic, an onion-headed boy and you want to climb the Sacred Tower to meet the Cyber Goddess to seduce her...

name: Retro Vaders: Reloaded
short_description: The original Retro Vaders game rebuilt from the ground up with a brand new engine, complete graphics overhaul and a heap of new content.

name: 2 Times Circles
short_description: 2 Times Circles is a game about controlling 2 circles moving horizontally and vertically in the two split screen at the same time.

name: Love Spell: Written In The Stars - a magical romantic-comedy otome
short_description: After saving the life of a mysterious old woman, a young girl is gifted a magical spell book with the power to make anyone whose name she writes inside of it fall madly in love with her until the next full moon. "Love Spell" is a romantic-comedy otome game full of magic, laughs & cute penguins!

name: Chess Sudoku
short_description: How does Chess Sudoku work? Well we’ve taken the classic sudoku game everyone knows and loves and created puzzles with chess-related twists! There are three different types of puzzles in the game: Knight Sudoku; King Sudoku and Queen Sudoku.

name: ESCAPE POINT
short_description: “Players are not the only ones that are after you.” Out-Break in the prison turned the guards and the prisoners into ZOMBIES. You must save yourself from various zombies coming for you.

name: Flash Snooker Game
short_description: Play the best Online Snooker Game, with Rankings, Stats, Tournaments every few hours, Game bets and Cue Upgrades. Practice or Play other Snooker players from all over the world. Quick and easy game play with realistic physics.

name: Recolit
