short_description: In SpellPunk you will unleash extraordinary powers and turn into a mighty magician who will cast spells by drawing magical symbols in the air with his/hers own hands. And yes, you will be immersed in a stunning, abstract world, experiencing fast-paced magical duels.

name: Rushberry Mercs
short_description: 4 player fast paced mining game. Mine and convey berrydium to your base or destroy your opponents to ensure your lead.

name: Damascus
short_description: Damascus is a pixel-art MMORPG created by two guys. Create a unique character and explore the strange and fantastic world that is before you. Train any of your 19 different skills. Chat and trade with other players. Make friends and slay all sorts of Dragons!

name: Capybara Carbonara
short_description: Trapped in a Zoo which cooks and prepares its own animals to serve up, Capy the mischievous Capybara is ready to cause mayhem and destruction to take the Zoo down in this wacky adventure!

name: Under Shelter

short_description: Cauldrons of War Barbarossa is the turn-based strategic wargame you will launch whenever you want your WW2 shot but don't have time for a monster strategy game.From June 1941 until the Battle of Moscow, play the USSR or the Axis forces in one of the largest and bloodiest operations in history.

name: Engine Evolution 2020
short_description: Engine Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses similar principles as World of Tanks. With each PvP race against 11 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your bike or unlock the next bike.

name: Space Foes
short_description: A space shooter inspired by old school games. You set the order of the levels, get new weapons and upgrades. Each stage has a boss and a sub-boss with unique skills and challenges.

name: Madness Fantasy
short_description: What happens when you mix south park and GTA? Five friends leave for a crazy weekend, but end up arrested. Now they will be forced by police to infiltrate a dangerous criminal organization and take on crazy missions. Will you succeed in take them out of this mess?

name: The 99
short_description: The 99 - An Action-Quiz Don't just answer the same stupid questions! At The 99 there are randomized quiz, memorie and puzzle elements in one little game.

name: Broll
short_description: Broll is a 3D ragdoll-based platformer, explore open levels, use the ragdoll to interact with the world, and solve awesome challenges!

name: Evade
short_description: Evade is a fast paced bullet hell shooter focused on dodging attack patterns made of hundreds, even thousands of bullets. Shoot your way through over 30 different bosses, and recruit defeated enemies as powerful assists.

name: 3D Hentai Blackjack
short_description: Check your luck in the blackjack card game, in order to win, you need to score more points than your opponent, but less than 21. The reward will be - nude images.

name: Natural Habitat
short_description: Fight against corporate invaders in challenging match-3 fights that combine turn-based strategy with deck building and an engaging story campaign. Build your deck from over 500 cards and 100 items, plan your strategy and help the locals to reclaim their Natural Habitat!

name: Computer Physics Simulator 2020
short_description: Computer Physics Simulator 2020 - A Message Beyond the Pixels. Over time, few players have fully grasped the subtle message woven—intentionally or not—into this game fabric. Beneath its minimalist surface a bit other, introspective story about persistence and the strange, often weight of struggles.

name: Nova
short_description: Combine the elements of Fire, Frost, Nature, Shadow, and Storm to form a powerful Duality. Harvest, craft, and engage in combat with creatures and enemy players to accumulate unprecedented power during the day and unleash your might at night.

name: Fire Guild
short_description: The world is in danger! Flying islands of your homeland is on fire , and only you, a graduate of the fire Academy, can handle this disaster! Control a special air balloon to put out the fire!

name: Defenders: Survival and Tower Defense
short_description: Defenders: Survival and Tower Defense is a Cooperative First Person Shooter that redefines the tower defense genre. Team up with friends, drop in to a variety of diverse maps, and defend The Core from waves of hostiles with a unique arsenal of upgradable weapons and towers!

name: Mystiqa
short_description: A traditional non-linear zelda-like action-adventure with built-in randomizers, local and online multiplayer.

name: Machinist
short_description: A game production platform based on 3D physics engine and building block logic programming. Players who like creating games and assembling machinery can design a rich variety of custom games without having to learn and memorize complex commands and gain profit through the in-app purchase system.

name: Survive 2 Thrive
short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world, you awake inside of a dark bunker. The bunker has kept you safe for many months, however, rations are running low and systems are failing. Exploration of once familiar world remains your only chance for survival.

name: Death Match Love Comedy!
short_description: Afflicted by a crazy curse that causes strange phenomena including being attacked by women, you must avoid being confessed to in order to survive! From the creators of “Raging Loop” comes a wild ride of a visual novel, full of romance, comedy, and explosions!

name: Miden Tower
short_description: Miden Tower is a fantasy RPG with a compelling and dramatic story. After Miden Tower is invaded by the Alroval Empire, the mages who call it home find themselves cornered on its upper floors. This sets in motion a series of tragic events that lead to take back the tower.

name: The Drained Goddess
short_description: The Drained Goddess is a first-person survival horror game focused on combat system and side story exploration. You will need to fight with many unique enemies and investigate the twisted fate of our main character. Finally you can put different endings to the story.

name: One More Shot
short_description: One More Shot is a VR shooting game, where participants attempt to break clay targets. Play against other players, your friends or IA. Try the single player mode where you´ll get coins that will help you win. Become the next great skeet shooter and get a place in the leaderboards.

name: Detective March Forward - The Missing Will
short_description: Milly’s deceased grandfather, Mr. Peter, has left behind a will that has gone missing. It’s up to aspiring detective March Forward to solve the puzzles and unravel the truth in this handcrafted point-and-click adventure game. Are you ready to solve this case?

name: Horse Riding Deluxe 2
short_description: Horse Riding Deluxe 2 is almost all about horses. You can buy, tame, train, feed, and personalize horses. A number of quests and racetracks await you in the huge open world.

name: RICO: London
short_description: RICO London is a gang-busting, name-taking, explosive co-op shooter. Battle your way up the high-rise tower stacked with East End gangsters solo or with a partner. Crash through doors, dodge bullets and turn the weapons of the fallen into your personal arsenal. Do whatever it takes reach the top.

name: TUNNEL BIRD
short_description: Flying with you,Look at your global ranking!（Version new function: leaderboard）

name: The Lord of the Rings: Gollum™
short_description: Play as Gollum on his quest to retrieve his Precious. You will need to climb the mountains of Mordor, sneak around Mirkwood and make difficult choices. Who will gain the upper hand: the cunning Gollum or the innocent Smeagol?

name: Hubris
short_description: Hubris is a VR action-adventure game set in a unique and colourful Sci-Fi universe, with immersive movement options, including swimming, climbing, and jumping. Players will have to gather resources, craft food and upgrade their weapons to fight off alien wildlife, droids, and humanoid enemies.

name: Spacen: The Beginning
short_description: As Gary Rogers, the player battles through hordes of enemy spaceships in several missions, evading projectiles, asteroids and defeating powerful bosses. Gary collects debris from destroyed enemies and exchanges them at the home base for ship and weapon upgrades.

name: Fights in Tight Spaces
short_description: A stylish blend of deck-building, turn-based tactics, and thrilling animated fight sequences in classic action-movie settings. Learn to balance your hand, momentum, and positioning to overcome the odds to defeat your adversaries. Build your deck, control the space and live to fight another day.

name: Chatventures

name: Cave Digger
short_description: Cave Digger is a mining game in an alternative western setting. Gear up with numerous unique tools and explore the town and the depths of the mountain. Discover secrets, easter eggs and multiple endings.

name: Life is Strange Remastered

name: Life is Strange: Before the Storm Remastered
short_description: Life is Strange: Before the Storm returns with remastered visuals across characters & environments.

name: Kongfusion

name: Dark City: Dublin Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you catch a magical culprit behind a string of strange robberies?

name: QUIZ PRO! - General Knowledge
short_description: Train your brain and improve your IQ today being playing this fun general knowledge quiz! How smart are you? Learn some new facts today! No matter if you’re alone or playing with friends or family, you’ll will have a lot of fun with this QUIZ game!

name: The Pale Beyond
short_description: You didn’t ask to lead this expedition, but here you are. Stuck in the ice, Captain missing, miles from civilisation. Someone has to take charge. Manage your meagre resources, balance safety and morale, make the hard calls, and head in the only direction you can - through The Pale Beyond.

name: Pixel Fixer
short_description: Restore 100 pictures, which were accidentally shredded. Click and drag the rows, and the will be glued when you release them so that they fit together. You can zoom the pixels to see how they fit, and you can choose 7 difficulty levels to find the best amusing challenge.

name: Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse

name: Smashing Healthy VR

name: Succubus Domination

name: Through the Nightmares

name: Death end re;Quest 2

name: SGS Afrika Korps
short_description: The game recreates the campaigns and battles of Erwin ‘Desert Fox’ Rommel’s legendary Afrika Korps, in Libya between 1941 and 1942. Play the Axis forces to conquer the most valuable prize of all: the Suez Canal. Or command the 8th Army soldiers, the famous Desert Rats, to repel the invaders.

In the game you will drive a hover taxi to avoid obstacles and pick up passengers, and continuously accumulate higher scores.

Experience the swinging ‘60s in all its chemical-induced glory and take revenge on the KGB for blowing up your mothership. You’ll have to form alliances with members of the very species you came to enslave.

short_description: Experience the sequel of the traditional roguelike dungeon-crawling classic. Enjoy unlimited replayability through endless procedurally generated dungeons, countless monsters, grafting, crafting and a vast amount of skill trees. Journey into the ever changing depths of the Caverns of Chaos.

name: The Last Stand: Aftermath
short_description: From the creators of The Last Stand: Union City and Dead Zone comes an all-new singleplayer rogue-lite action adventure. After you become infected by the zombie virus, you set out to explore the post-apocalypse and find hope for your fellow survivors. You can still make a difference. Don't give up.

name: Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift
short_description: Dive into a top-down, turn-based strategy game with 80's sci-fi flair. Command elite soldiers in multiplayer duels on 24 maps, local hot-seat mode, or a thrilling singleplayer campaign. Master teleportation and gridless movement on the mysterious planet Anthracite.

name: Operation DogFight
short_description: Operation DogFight is a free local multiplayer airplane combat game where all the pilots are Dogs. Make use of dog-themed weapons to take down your friends across multiple maps.

short_description: Assemble your way through the murky portraits of Dark Fantasy Epic!

name: Monorail Stories
short_description: Monorail Stories is an adventure game focusing on extraordinary things happening to ordinary people. Board the monorail and experience a special story about humanity, friendships, and intertwined destinies manifesting during the everyday commute.

name: Sapper
short_description: In Sapper, you play a small anti-pirate. mine-sapper unit. Cleanse local home vessels and exotic alien craft of enemies, mines, and watch vast ships ride to safety as you collect your bounty.

name: Mystic Isles
short_description: Mystic Isles is an online multiplayer strategy board game with 2-6 friends.

name: Field of Heroes
short_description: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your orc players in Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Conquer existing fields or create your own – but do it as a team. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

name: [Chilla's Art] Onryo | 怨霊

short_description: Test of Courage is a horror game where you have to explore an abandoned school in search of your two friends. The only hint you have is the "Courage Test" in which you have to find 10 objects around the academy while maintaining your sanity.

name: Kurogane of the sky
short_description: A game where you control a fleet-scale airship and fight enemy flying battleships. I think it's more like a simulation or a strategy than an action.

Discover how much stardust you have inherited from T-Rex. Find the hidden treasure. Interact with dinosaurs. Escape from Earth before the meteor seals your fate.

Expand hub, build shops, take care of everyone's needs. Increase profits, change taxes. But beware: dangerous diseases and asteroids may alter your plans!

name: Linda & Joan Prologue: “Four Months Earlier”

Based on a true story. “Four Months Earlier” is part one of the Linda & Joan story.

This is a feature-rich, idle/incremental game combining a distinctly familiar feel with a fresh gameplay experience. Maxing 20+ skills has never been more zen.

name: Pistol Dancer
short_description: Twos hands two guns! Shoot'em up style rhythmic FPS. Press the trigger alongside music beats to unleash devastating power to the enemies Your enemies are little virus bits trying to reach the heart, and you are the last line of defence!

name: Pancake Sailor
short_description: Relaxing sailing experience. Discover Akalana Islands.

name: Armageddon Onslaught
short_description: In 2060 the end of the world has arrived, and humanity is on the brink of extinction. In a desperate struggle against the army of hell, some humans discover to be Demi-Angels gifted with unimaginable powers. They will have to face horrors of all kinds and fulfill the darkest of the prophecies.

name: Autopanic
short_description: Autopanic is a minimalist twinstick shooter with rogue-like elements. Also a game about acknowledging player action.

name: Escape from GULAG
short_description: "Escape from GULAG" is the maze game that increases difficulty as you progress through the levels.

name: The Sickle Upon Sekigahara
short_description: The Sickle Upon Sekigahara is a short Visual Novel that puts the player in the role of Kobayakawa Hideaki in the most tumultuous period of his life.

name: Like old times
short_description: A top-down looter shooter set in a post-apocalyptic, nuclear war-torn world where humans, mutants and aggressive new flora and fauna battle for dominance over the wasteland.

name: Active Neurons 2
short_description: Active Neurons 2 is a puzzle game in which you have to discover 12 greatest inventions of humanity and reflect on the power of human thought

name: Planet 2000
short_description: Experience futuristic vehicular combat in this fast paced strategy game. Assemble your team from a crew of fully realized AI companions as you take part in epic land battles.

name: Strip 'Em
short_description: Strip 'Em, is not just a poker game, it's a Fuck 'Em poker game, one where you get sexy ladies to play with you and, should you win, strip for you and even more.

name: Game Overlay Pro
short_description: Game Overlay Pro is a software that lets you add custom made or premade overlays to any Directx game.

name: ZEROED
short_description: Soar across vast landscapes and battle opponents with a unique take on flight combat racing. Get ready to break the sound barrier in this deceptively simple game that will always be a challenge, so buckle up and get ZEROED!

name: Rogue Party 2
short_description: Explore dungeons, defeat bosses and earn epic rewards with up to three other friends (and occasionally hit them with potions) in this playful Rogue-Like adventure.

name: Living Art
short_description: Somewhere in a museum stands a strange, clay, pot-like figure on its pedestal, viewed by hundreds each day, motionless. One fateful day the spark of life strikes, and it awakens! Now is your time to start the adventure and escape! Your journey will take you far. Will you find a place to call home?

name: The King's Magic
short_description: Take control of the tiny yet tenacious King's magical button as he avoids the castle's enemies and traps on his journey back to the King. Using only the ability to move, you must time your movements correctly and think quickly in order to make it through all 20 levels of ever increasing difficulty.

name: Farm Builder
short_description: Farm Builder is strategy puzzle board game in which you build farms, roads and surround windmills and water-towers in order to score points. The game is online multiplayer and in each room can play between 2 and 5 people together.

name: A Buttload of Free Games
short_description: A collection of over one hundred completely free small games wrapped into one convenient launcher! Slash slimes, shoot lemons, blow kisses, take blood, and so much more in these wacky, weird, and wild games!

name: Aquadine
short_description: "Welcome to Aquadine! My name is Ciel, and I'll be your tour guide for today!" A young gondolier works part-time to save money for his mother's hospital bills, but he has a secret. Follow Ciel as he tours people around the beautiful town of Aquadine, where his family and friends bond with him.

name: Hunter X - Begin
short_description: Stylish action game using the sword

name: Inside The Mirror
short_description: Yumi was just another normal girl living happily together with her family. Now, her family has fallen apart, and Yumi finds it difficult to stay motivated in her day-to-day life, crushed by a growing well of darkness, slowly consuming her from the inside out.

name: Cross Soul
short_description: A girl who is "one person in two bodies" challenging a mystery dungeon. Items that can be transmigrated to change their form as well as spirit weapons. The story of a soul that spans the ages. And... tasty bananas.

name: Strato'S Sylph Asterism
short_description: Strato's Sylph is an air battle action STG based on the motif of fighter planes and beautiful girls. Set on the earth-like planet "Strange Sphere", the girls who wear weapons and run in the sky "Sylph" and The game depicts a battle with MARXII, a monster in the shape of a bee.

name: Pandoria
short_description: Adventure, creation, and joy in this wonderful world of Pandora

name: Trump and Virus
short_description: At the beginning of a disaster, those seemingly unimportant warnings will always be felt that this is not serious, such as the invasion of viruses.

name: This will not go well
short_description: Avoid all the missiles as long as you can!

name: Dream Catcher
short_description: A lonely guy meets a lot of strange girls in his dream. Let's solve the puzzle to see the girls more clearly.

name: 炽焰帝国:十字军东征
short_description: 《炽焰帝国：十字军东征》Kingdom Under Fire The Crusaders是一款结合了动作与策略的经典游戏，以中古幻想为背景，玩家将展开颇具震撼的大规模战斗，现在官方中文高清版正式登陆PC平台。

name: Be Coronavirus
short_description: A viral strategy game: You take the role of Coronavirus. With no interference from you, it will spread around the world, infect new places, evolve, mutate, and reshape the landscape of humanity… that is, it would, if it weren’t for other viruses, and medical interference, waiting to stop it.

name: Viking Heroes
short_description: Scale new heights of adventure as brothers Everand and Boromere and sisters Helga and Brunnhilde band together for the first time to pursue an evil sorcerer who has unleashed a flurry of devastating storms on Midgard!

name: Ninja Kiwi Archive
short_description: Enjoy some of the best loved Flash games of the past in this awesome time capsule of over 60 Ninja Kiwi classics. Experience a piece of history and play the original Flash games that spawned the worldwide phenomenon of Bloons TD.

name: Sharded World
short_description: Sharded World is a reversed bullet hell, rogue-lite, ARPG game combining simple gameplay and great rpg progression. Each level has its own unique features and challenges. Upgradable characters, weapons and orbs. Challenges, daily quests, and leaderboards. Fight, get stronger and defeat the Lich!

name: City Destructor
short_description: Welcome to City Destructor, the demolition puzzle game! Sit back and relax while at the same time you demolish cities, unlock bombs and create a whole bunch of chaos!

name: Only One Rectangle
short_description: Platformer with a variety of disorienting gameplay for an interesting gaming experience. A lot of colors, invisible painted platforms, traps, various puzzles.

name: A letter to you!
short_description: A psychological horror game where fear and paranoia merge into a terrifying story!

name: Martial Arts Brutality Premium
short_description: In this turn based tactical card fighter, you will learn the secrets of Kung Fu, master control of your formidable Chi Energy and perfect the legendary Dim Mak death touch.

name: Choco Pixel 4
short_description: Choco Pixel 4 is a minimalist colorful puzzle which goal is to get the toy car to the finish using 4 directions in space and avoiding traps.

name: Go Kart Run!
short_description: Aim for 1st place! Collect and customize 20 drivers, race to increase your rank, make a comeback with food items and go insanely fast with 5 engine options!

name: Arctic Awakening
short_description: A first-person narrative adventure set in the unforgiving Arctic. Your plane crashed in a storm, leaving only your court-mandated therapy bot for company as you journey to find your co-pilot and uncover the mysteries buried beneath the ice.

name: Dieselpunk Wars Prologue
short_description: Dieselpunk Wars: Prologue is a free version of an epic vehicle building game, focused on combat with advanced physics and damage simulation. Use over 140 elements to build an awesome war machine. Build vehicles that ride on the ground, soar through the skies, or dive underwater. Prepare for combat!

name: Kevin's Path to Wizdom
short_description: You play as Kevin, the most handsome wizard in school — until your face gets stolen! Learn gesture-based spellcasting as you beat challenging enemies through mind-boggling mazes in this turn-based tactics game. Can you catch the thief and save face?

name: Grappling Hook Ball Tournament
short_description: Grappling Hook Ball Tournament is a shooting game, players against players. Play with friends, up to 8 players. Welcome to the arena!

name: Drug Dealer Simulator: Free Sample
short_description: Drug Dealer Simulator: Free Sample is an introduction to the dark alleys of the ghetto, where you can start to expand your own crime empire! Get in touch with your contact and take your first steps in drug dealing business! 8 levels of dope business deals and constant adrenaline!

name: Coloring Game 3
short_description: Coloring Game 3 is a new paint-by-number game which has already won hearts of numerous players. Now the game offers new difficulty modes.

name: Sanity of Morris
short_description: Sanity of Morris: a psychological horror adventure game. Your flashlight reveals the clues you need to stay sane in the search for your father. Discover the truth. Could aliens be real?

name: Outcore: Desktop Adventure
short_description: All you wanted was a nice game. But now you find yourself opening Windows apps like Paint & Notepad to solve puzzles, and searching for files on your computers that you didn't put there... Who is she? Why did she appear on your desktop? Let's dive into her memories and find out.

name: Street Power Football
short_description: Sick style and high-energy action come together in this arcade-style football experience. Face off against street football legends or friends in a variety of over-the-top game modes and playgrounds, unleashing tricks and crushing Super Powers as you grow your status to become Street King.

name: The Narrator is a DICK : Longer, Harder, and Uncut
short_description: In this narrated unfair platformer there's one man who's always out to get you... The Narrator. He's a real jerk, but with determination and a lot of skill MAYBE you can make it through this crazy adventure. Remastered with new Online Co-Op and Extended gameplay!

name: Space Otter Charlie
short_description: Adorable characters? Check! Makeshift weapons? Check! Otter dressed in a foam shark suit. Umm. Check? Join Charlie and his ragtag team of sea mammals as they jump, float, and rocket through Otter Space in this Zero-G Puzzle Platformer!

name: Stan Lee's Verticus
short_description: You are Verticus, a superhero equipped with a high tech, heat-resistant jump suit who must prevent the Earth’s destruction at the hands of an evil alien race known as The Obliterators!

name: Frog Space
short_description: Frog Space is a game about the adventures of frog 'Froxy' that avoids obstacles such as animals, vehicles, and terrain. Since only the skills and senses of the player are the only ways to clear this game, it requires a high level of concentration, equanimity, and a challenging spirit.

name: Kick the VIRUS
short_description: Kick the VIRUS It's a game that helps when your anger reaches its maximum.

name: WWII Zombies
short_description: Spring of 1945. The Third Reich is on the verge of defeat, the regime of the Fuhrer at death. Scientists from Anenerbe freeze Adolf Hitler in a secret cryolaboratory. After 75 years, on his birthday, he awakens and goes to the past to save the world from disaster ...

name: Baldi's Basics Plus
short_description: Baldi's Basics® Plus is an active stealth roguelike that parodies cheap '90s edutainment with a subtle horror twist! Play Hide & Seek with Baldi as he chases you through procedurally generated levels while using your surroundings, items, and game knowledge to shift chaos in your favor.

name: Blured Angel
short_description: Blured Angel is a kind of somatosensory game that uses a camera on a Windows host to capture and interact with each other. It weaves a heaven I see from the spiritual world of the Bible from the perspective of a not so smart but persistent angel "Mehoo".

name: Digital Dungeon Tiles
short_description: An extremely quick to use dungeon tile-based mapping tool to build battle maps for “Screen In Table” and "Print" (or Online) based play! Fully orthographic so you can play as if your Miniatures are in the map.

name: Probe
short_description: A challenging 2D block breaker featuring arcade elements and a modern spin on the popular retro games. Destroy data blocks and galactic enemies using only your probe, bullets and power ups but don't lose your ball to the void. Do you have what it takes to reach the end of the universe?

name: Mini Words: Top Movies
short_description: The Top 100 Movies. You know them and you love them. Test your knowledge about the highest-grossing films of all time in “Mini Words: Top Movies”, a unique mix of logic puzzle, word search and trivia.

name: Fingertips  mountain  sea
short_description: Fingertips mountain sea: everyone's heart longing for the peach garden

name: Manufactoria 2022
short_description: Manufactoria 2022 is a constructive puzzle game about pushing robots around. (It's okay, they don't complain.) Use simple parts to engineer solutions to open-ended problems, then rebuild 'em better! Take a company from your backyard to the soaring heights of success! How hard could it be?

name: Creator Adventure Legend
short_description: This is a fantasy world, and you are a creator who will be punished into the reincarnation because of misplacement and experience the punishment of the 99th century,So you plan to build a village to protect you for every life

name: Clay Game
short_description: Explore a world handcrafted from clay. Make dumb jokes with your Foxcat friend. Use magic to solve puzzles. Can you solve the mystery at the Wizard Tower?

name: Twilight Struggle: Red Sea
short_description: Answer the summons of the trumpets and bear the burden of the Twilight Struggle. Set during the ideological tension of the Cold War, Twilight Struggle: Red Sea places the United States and the Soviet Union at odds in the Horn of Africa. Every choice you make will impact the balance of power.

name: NuclearRifle
short_description: 《NuclearRifle》 is an FPS shooting game. The protagonist wakes up from a small town house, only to find that the doors are locked. From time to time, strange sounds of biting came from nearby houses, and the exit of the town were sealed. What happened to the town? Can the protagonist escape?

name: Pandemic Panic!
short_description: We're in lockdown and you're our only hope! Grab your blaster, ready the cure and prepare to face the virus head on in this frantic, wacky and wild hospital. Don't be fooled, this is a task for only the best out there. Think you have what it takes?

name: PST VR (Primary Surgical Treatment)
short_description: “Primary surgical treatment” is a virtual simulator, designed for education purposes. By immersing yourself with your pair of Oculus VR Headsets, you can experience the task of treating a wound with many available surgical instruments and help the patient to begin the recovery.

name: Zerowood
short_description: Special action games

name: Naught
short_description: Test your skills, take control of the environment, and guide Naught through a dark underground world full of mystery. A platform videogame with a unique control that will immerse you in deep labyrinths in search of the light.

name: Flying Soldiers
short_description: Get ready to command an odd squad of fun birds and devise a plan to bring them safe and sound to the end of the battlefield. An outlandish puzzle game that will challenge your mind to make these greenhorn recruits into brave soldiers.

name: evolution for beginners
short_description: Evolution For Beginners is an evolution simulation where you can create and cultivate your own species by only using evolutionary mechanics. Watch your creatures multiply like microorganisms in a primeval ocean while only the fittest survive.

name: Elva the Eco Dragon
short_description: "Elva, the Eco Dragon" is a 3D game in third view where you must control Elva, a small dragon whose mission is to cleanse the planet: land, sea and even space. Help Elva and you will help humanity to create a better world for everyone.

name: Bloons TD Battles 2
short_description: From the creators of Bloons TD6... Bloons TD Battles 2 is a brand new installment of the top-rated head-to-head tower defense game. Gather your Hero, choose your team of powerful Monkey Towers, and prepare to battle one on one against other players and relentless waves of Bloons!

name: Sheltering With You
short_description: A difficult journey to the East awaits Helena, an orphan, and Aya, a former brothel worker. At the same time, a certain Monster attacks the villages, and Helena sees strange dreams. Will Helena respond to the call of her dreams, or will she find happiness in big love?

name: MEGALAN 11
short_description: This is a exploration-puzzle game. Explore the science station and help the bad luck rescuers get out from the forgotten planet in 11 days.

name: Modest Hero
short_description: The violent clashes in the suburbs ended as a result of the military's harsh interventions. During the clashes, a general was killed brutally by a group of rebels. Seven people suspected of killing the general were arrested in next morning.

name: Arctic Anxiety
short_description: Survival simulator in extreme conditions. The game takes place in the Arctic ocean. The pilot of a cargo plane makes a hard landing on the water. To survive, the player will have to search for a cargo washed up on the shore.

name: Cascading Failure
short_description: Lead your troops into battle first hand in an intense Sci-Fi world. Construct bases, build defences, construct bigger bases, build way too many defences and take the map with overwhelming amounts of infantry, mechs and firepower.

name: Human Farm
short_description: Welcome to Human Farm🐽 – an alternate, Orwellian world where Pigs became the dominant species. Humans are degraded to farmed meat. Create and develop your own slaughterhouse. Your goal: conquer and dominate the human meat industry. Millions of hungry snouts are waiting to be fed!

name: An Interesting Journey of Monsieur PAF
short_description: An Interesting Journey of Monsieur PAF is a platform / isometric puzzle game. Sharing similar mechanics with the Sokoban, Monsieur PAF attempts to revisit the genre using 3D verticality in magnificent homemade, two-dimensional environments.

name: Persian Nights 2: The Moonlight Veil
short_description: Travel to the magical land of Persian Nights and save your sister from a dire fate. Feel the taste of orient in this sumptuous and beguiling hidden object adventure.

name: Faefever
short_description: Faefever tells the story of a troubled journalist trying to uncover the mystery of a missing brother and sister in the small town of Glenroch, where not all things are as they seem.

name: Oddest Sea
short_description: Traverse an ominous ocean while evading monsters to reach the refuge of a distant lighthouse.

name: The Chronicles of Robin Hood - The King of Thieves
short_description: Join forces with Robin Hood in this thrilling match3 game...! Help Robin Hood and the Merry Men in their quest to take down the Sheriff of Nottingham!

name: My Cute Roommate
short_description: Your high school years are over, and now it’s time to think about the future. You need to pick a good college, find yourself a girlfriend, and start thinking about a job. That’s when your life changes; you’re diagnosed with a mysterious illness and there’s only one way to cure it.

name: Tinkertown
short_description: Gather your friends and come to Tinkertown - A refreshing new Multiplayer Sandbox Experience! Explore magical places filled with loot, danger, and creativity.

name: Kira and the Life Stone
short_description: This the journey of Kira a lost soul in the state of limbo trying to get back to life and find out why is he dead. Follow him in his journey of getting back to life and get new powers, fight different enemies and find hidden secrets.

name: Cosmotic Blast
short_description: Cosmotic Blast is an asteroid game in an immersive experience. Stand amongst a swirling cluster of asteroids in space as you pilot a ship. Blast and destroy wave after wave of asteroids and collect the Cosmotic energy to enhance your ship, making it faster, stronger and more resilient.

name: Witching Tower: Heroes
short_description: Fight the undead with four sets of weapons. Beat the bosses to save the kingdom from enemies. Relentless arcade action suitable even for people new to VR! Breathtaking visuals and dark fantasy environments are waiting for you!

name: Protodroid DeLTA
short_description: Reach your potential in a fast and fluid 3D action-platformer set in a beautiful and hopeful Solarpunk world. Take on challenging bosses, upgrade your systems, and show humanity the promise of AI.

name: Negative Nancy
short_description: Negative Nancy is a choose your “no” adventure for people who have had enough. An interactive sitcom where you can only say “no” (or nothing at all). Your choices control the story.

name: DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS
short_description: DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS is an online asymmetrical action game where a team of 7 ordinary citizens tries to survive the Raider (a classic DRAGON BALL rival such as Cell, Frieza, and Buu), who will hunt and evolve into an unstoppable force!

name: Ruined King: A League of Legends Story™
short_description: Rise Against Ruin - Unite a party of League of Legends Champions, explore Bilgewater and set sail for the Shadow Isles to uncover the secrets of the deadly Black Mist in this immersive turn-based RPG.

name: CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story™
short_description: Traverse the sprawling city of Zaun as Ekko, a young inventor with a device to manipulate time, in this story-driven action platformer. Collect parts, craft gadgets, and unlock abilities—then rewind time to adapt your approach to every new challenge.

name: The Outbound Ghost
short_description: The Outbound Ghost is an adventure RPG about helping ghosts ascend to the afterlife. Battle the past using figments of your personality. Craft badges to earn abilities. Explore a town of troubled spooks and discover life can be tough, even when you're dead.

name: Space War Machine
short_description: In Space War Machine you warp to a new star for each battle, in a never-ending fight for dominance. Pause and slow time at will, control a vast armada of ships with powers! Explore and Terra-form planets. Warp to your far off opponents. Unleash your Ultimate units for total destruction! And more!!!

name: Kane's Shadow
short_description: Kane's Shadow is an alternative rhythm game inspired by trauma release exercises. Guide Kane through his re-discovery of a traumatic memory and assist him in releasing his inner demons once and for all. =

name: The Lilliputian Runner
short_description: Skill-based platformer where color matters!

name: Toilet Paper Crisis Simulator 2020
short_description: Take control of the typical toilet paper panic buyer. Help us to understand this strange phenomenon by gathering as much Toilet Paper as you can.

name: Dungeon & Derision
short_description: Dungeon & Derision is a tactical turn-based game with some gameplay elements taken from the rogue-like genre ! Create your team to explore a mysterious island run by a powerful king !

name: Deathbound
short_description: Deathbound is a unique Soulslike. Build a party of four characters and instantly morph between them in and out of combat. Combine their abilities to pull off devastating attacks and slay those who stand before you.

name: Underwater Wars
short_description: Underwater Wars is a tactical turn-based strategy game that takes place in the depths of the ocean. Two powerful factions of people are fighting a war for territory and resources, but everything changes when mysterious "Aliens" enter the conflict.

name: Aquarium Life
short_description: Nurture a small aquarium. A place you can return to for a moment of peace and quiet whenever you need it.

name: How To Make A Killing
short_description: An indie action RPG about assassins, necromancers, and mysterious rabbits. In an open world where your choices have permanent consequences, do you do the job or do you forge your own path as you meet new characters, battle a slew of enemies, and explore expansive dungeons and locations?

name: Beautiful Feet Cabin
short_description: The player plays a masseuse in the game and runs a beautiful foot cabin. Receive all kinds of city beauties every day, massage their feet and legs. Relieve pressure for her and satisfy self little hobbies at the same time.

name: Crying Pony
short_description: Crying Pony is a 2D side-scrolling horror game where the protagonist, Michael, is hunted by the lurking evil in his nightmares. As the nightmare's corruption seeps into reality and even pulls Michael's daughter into its grasp, will he be able to lead them both to escape from the nightmare?

name: C-TAS: A Virtual Chinese Learning Game
short_description: This game is intended to teach the user Chinese in a VR environment.

name: Cryptic Rooms
short_description: A series of 3 VR escape rooms, Eye Eaters Basement, Dungeon of Demise, and Inescapable Hypercube. You must navigate through and solve puzzles, each room with its own unique theme and hidden relics that can be found and collected.

name: Saving You From Yourself
short_description: You are a transgender therapist. The patients you encounter might regret transitioning. Your job is to protect them from that.

name: FirstQueen1 NEXT
short_description: Battlefield with Many Enemies and Allies. Your soldiers will fight or retreat in battle using their own discretion. You watch over the actions of your troops and can either move characters that are in danger to safety or send a strong character to help defeat enemies and lead your army to victory.

name: Sunset fighter
short_description: 这是一款竞速逃生类飞行游戏，有多种道具可供拾取，游戏节奏非常紧张，玩家的目标就是生存尽可能多的时间。

name: 异界大陆
short_description: 这是一款RPGmakermv制作出来的RPG游戏，一个现代人穿越到异世界的故事，所用的素材都是自带素材，只是一款娱乐作品

name: Death World
short_description: After a long night you wake up alone in the bunker as a bunker security guard. Hunt, kill, gather. Do anything to survive.

name: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin
short_description: A new adventure awaits you in this second installment of the turn-based RPG series set in the world of Monster Hunter! Become a Rider and form bonds with friendly monsters known as Monsties to fight alongside them as you take part in an epic story.

name: The Shepherd
short_description: After finding an old picture of your grandfather on a camel, you decide to leave the city and set off into the serenity of the desert. In order to become a great rider, just like he was. Train your herd, befriend desert-folk, fight predators, and navigate the mysteries of the desert.

name: Skeletal Avenger
short_description: Embark on a bone-chilling quest for vengeance as a skull-hurling skeletal warrior in Skeletal Avenger! This captivating roguelite dungeon crawler melds hack'n'slash mayhem with endlessly replayable gameplay, offering a thrilling, ever-evolving experience that keeps you coming back for more.

name: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- The Prophecy of the Throne
short_description: Enjoy a new Re:ZERO storyline, fully supervised by the series author Tappei Nagatsuki! Featuring brand new characters designed by the original artist Shinichirou Otsuka as well as your favorites from the series!

name: Traffic Storm
short_description: Became the master of traffic. Control cars and avoid accidents. Get ready to fight the Traffic Storm!

name: BLACK STIGMA
short_description: BLACK STIGMA is a hero shooter game with a diverse cast of characters. You can choose and customize a handgun of your preference and upgrade your character's abilities in different ways. Play as your ideal killer character, from long-range precision shots to close-range brawls.

name: Move with AI
short_description: This is a motion sensing game made with artificial intelligence (AI) technology. It doesn't need any sense of body equipment, just turn on the camera of the computer, and you can play happily.

name: Space Lint
short_description: Inventory management game set in space. Loot items, craft and repair to survive!

name: Pixel Fight
short_description: Pixel up for Fight!

name: Deadsigns
short_description: DeadSigns is a first person action game with survival and tower defense features. Go through many nights and beat a lot of monsters with style and get the best score !

name: VisualHacker
short_description: Set in a world of Magic, Hacking and Augmentations, rescue your newborn baby from the evil clutches of the Hospital Corporation. "They send you a enormous bill for her surgery". Will you pay or will you fight your way up the 4 floors of the hospital and fight to save your baby?

name: RoboDo
short_description: RoboDo is a singleplayer/multiplayer VR puzzle game with plenty exciting features. Bunch of levels for you to complete, some are fast, reaction based and others will make you concentrate and think. Beat levels alone or join your friend for some Co-Op action!

name: Dustoff Z
short_description: Get those blades spinning and load up on guns and ammo, the time has come to rebuild humanity! Dustoff Z is a game about maneuvering combat-helicopters in one of the harshest weather conditions possible – A Zombie Apocalypse.

name: SUPER UFO FIGHTER
short_description: The space sport "SUPER UFO FIGHTER" is all the rage in the galaxy. And UFO pilots, known as Shwoopers, are battling it out today!

name: The Adventures of Kincaid
short_description: Kincaid is a lewd platforming adventure with a sci-fi theme. Kincaid is an archeologist, exploring uncharted planets and their wild life! Join our playful and naughty wolf girl Kincaid, as she sexplores flora & fauna and meets new friends (with benefits~) and adversaries!

name: Ethyrial: Echoes of Yore
short_description: A F2P 'Open Alpha' MMORPG! 23 Unique Classes - Charming Quests & Story - 100s of Monsters - 18 Professions - 8+ Dungeons - 4 World Bosses - 1 Pinnacle Boss - Total Level, Skill, & XP Rankings - Active and Friendly Devs... & Much More!

name: Riddle Joker
short_description: For decades, superpowers and psychic abilities were thought to be mere science fiction, but the discovery of a certain particle called the "Astron" at the end of the 20th century proved to the world that these wondrous phenomena were real.

name: Kinkoi: Golden Loveriche
short_description: Kinkoi: Golden Loveriche is a Japanese-style visual novel produced by Saga Planets, a Japanese developer of romance VNs. The game won numerous awards in the year of its release in Japan for its art, music, characters, and story.

name: Heart's Medicine - Season One
short_description: Can you be counted on in an emergency? 🚑

name: I'mitation The Eight Suicide Note
short_description: A first-person search-type horror game developed for developers. Use the night vision, rean, slide and other actions to find eight items in the facility. Content that can be gameplayed in a short time.

name: HistoryMaker VR
short_description: Perform as a U.S. historical character in an immersive, virtual reality environment. Create your scene, pick your props, read your script, and export your performance in this VR content creation tool.

name: Storynth

name: Wasted World
short_description: The apocalypse has come, brought by pollution, wars and disease! Your mission is to save your land... or what’s left of it. Alone or with your friends gather, recycle, craft, build, plant, explore, fight & help survivors.

name: Good Knight
short_description: Embark on an exhilarating journey through the depths of Filipino mythology in this Buttclenching One-Button Bullet-Hell. Test yourself through a relentless onslaught of bullets and beautiful patterns. Experience the intense action and headbanging soundtrack in this must-play game for all indie fans!

name: DOM RUSALOK
short_description: Russia in the ‘90s. A provincial town at the edge of the crumbling Soviet Empire. A group of kids faces the disturbing horror they are unable to comprehend – the DØM RUSALOK. This is a place where the worst nightmares come true.

name: Chessсakе
short_description: Classic board game in a computer version. A variant of English drafts. The goal of the game is to collect all enemy checkers.

name: Epica
short_description: Journey into the fairy lands of Epica, a saga awaits.

name: The Night is Grey
short_description: Graham’s alone in a forest filled with strange wolves. While he’s fleeing for his life he finds a lost girl in an abandoned lodge that won’t survive without his help. Try to find their way to safety in this slow-burning cinematic thriller filled with puzzles, hand-drawn animation and lots of mystery

name: Kirakira stars idol project Nagisa
short_description: "You're the idol you used to sing to on stage? " After their first live performance, Nobuyuki and Ai have a fateful encounter with the top idol, Nagisa Yukihiro. While getting involved with Nagisa through joint lessons, it is decided that an idol festival - DivaFes - will be held, but...

name: God-Machine - Shogun CyberMetal Arena
short_description: Prepare for a mix of endurance-combat and arcade shooting game. Play against dangerous robots, cyborgs, and mutants, in rogue-like arenas that evolves as you fight. Are you brave and skilled enough to endure?

name: Bird Missions
short_description: Live the life of your bird reigning in the air! Find one by one all the hidden pieces on each map and unlock new territories!

name: Beyond Solar
short_description: Embark on a thrilling bullet hell/SHMUP journey in Beyond Solar. As "Gravity," a space pilot from the colony ARD, defend humanity's last sanctuary amid Earth's impending doom. Brace yourself for intense pixel art action in a desperate fight for survival.

name: Oh Frog
short_description: Oh Frog is a loopy 2D action adventure game set in the mysterious, fairy tale-esque lands of the Frog Kingdom. Play as Lif, the Frog Kingdom’s bravest frog, as you travel through gorgeous, lovingly hand-drawn landscapes and animated worlds, on your quest to recover the stolen Crowns of Power!

name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: House of Ashes
short_description: At the close of the Iraq War, Special Forces hunting for weapons of mass destruction unearth something far deadlier – a buried Sumerian temple containing a nest of unearthly creatures. To survive the night below, they must forge a brotherhood with their enemies from the world above.

name: Zen Universe
short_description: Explore а bundle of 4 real-life and legendary locations - shot, scanned, and hand-polished into realistic interactive environments. Early Access includes 2 experiences and 2 more will be updated for free.

name: Anno 1404 - History Edition
short_description: Relive the captivating gameplay of a true city-building classic with Anno® 1404 History Edition.

name: Medic: Pacific War
short_description: Become a Medic - a true war hero. Survive the horror of the Pacific Front where bombs fall from the sky and rifle bullets cut the air. You are the last hope of your wounded companions. Your decisions will change the course of the battle, but not all of them will be easy to make!

name: Woody Chopper
short_description: In Woody Chopper you help Woody chop down the endless tree on his way to becoming a lumberjack millionaire. Whether in spring, summer, autumn or winter, it's the perfect casual game for in-between. Now with Achievements! Play Woody Chopper today and help Woody get the legendary axe.

name: The Dead of Winter
short_description: Build, gather and defend against relentless hordes of undead as you lead your villagers to safety and battle for survival in a world plunged into a seemingly endless winter

name: SHEEPO
short_description: Explore a strange planet, collect the creatures you find, and then shape-shift into them to expand your world. Build your own path, chat with the locals, and discover the planets sprawling secrets in this quirky metroidvania platformer.

name: Samsara Room
short_description: You woke up in a mysterious room you have never seen before. Can you find another way out? Samsara Room is a remake of the praised predecessor of the Rusty Lake & Cube Escape series.

name: Reflections of Life: Utopia Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you escape a utopian toy world before it’s too late?

name: Project Canopy
short_description: Harvest, Build, Craft and Explore the different biomes among massive trees, plants, and hostile creatures to survive and unlock the mysteries of an alien jungle in a first person sci-fi survival adventure.

name: Frogsong
short_description: A heartfelt adventure in a fantasy world of frogs! Talk to weird and wonderful characters, fight vicious bugs, and explore a vibrant world in this charming action RPG.

name: Defective Holiday
short_description: Memories of a new place

name: Iron Reckoning
short_description: Become a warrior in this sci-fi/fantasy adventure! Iron Reckoning showcases a unique movement mechanic that will test your skill in preserving airborne momentum. Wield a variety of powers and master the combat to defeat your enemies, as you uncover the mystery behind a deadly machine threat!

name: Catovania
short_description: This is a game about a cat who fights with enemies. 2D platformer is made in a retro style.

name: CoronaFighter
short_description: A coronavirus-themed shoot-em-up in the classic arcade tradition.

name: Saint Lary's Hospital - Ay Corona!
short_description: Play as saint Lary as you battle an outbreak at St. Lary's hospital. Be careful though as patients are always trying to get your attention by coughing at you. The more unruly patients have also been hiding toilet paper around the hospital.

name: Apocalypse Survivor
short_description: Apocalypse Survivor is a challenging first-person shooter (FPS), set after a nuclear war.

name: Rust Raiders
short_description: Become a robot pirate captain in this roguelike deckbuilding game and defeat the evil Captain LeCrank. Forge cards to improve their power, augment your ship with gadgets and build your own Deck! Experience the unique card system crafted exclusively for Rust Raiders.

name: Chang'an: The capital of Tang Dynasty
short_description: It is a city building game of Chang'an, the capital city of Tang dynasty in 8th century AD. Players will build the ancient city in an 1:1 proportion sandbox. Based on researches of history and ancient architecture, you will see a Chang'an city reconstructed in reality.

name: Tree Simulator 2021
short_description: Wood you like marginally improved graphics? Do you like leafing it all behind and taking root in some random field? If so, you are a tree, be the best tree you can be. Prepare for a deeper and more detailed understanding of what it is to be a tree. A true work of art.

name: REMNANT II®
short_description: REMNANT II® pits survivors of humanity against new deadly creatures and god-like bosses across terrifying worlds. Play solo or co-op with two other friends to explore the depths of the unknown to stop an evil from destroying reality itself.

name: Escape Initiative
short_description: Run, jump, and shoot lasers in this difficult and aesthetic action precision platformer. Built for fast play but not required, you will enjoy hand built levels with an immense variety of challenges. Customize your colors and realize your initiative. ESCAPE.

name: A Rabbit and the Mystic Fog
short_description: "A Rabbit and the Mystic Fog" is a virtual reality adventure in which you go on a search for the inhabitants of the valley, who have disappeared since a mysterious fog appeared in their homeland. Help the little rabbit by completing the story around the charismatic characters of the valley.

name: Fires At Midnight
short_description: In a world where making love without being in love makes you spontaneously combust, the person you love most may be the one who burns you in Fires at Midnight – a cinematic and interactive visual novel about a couple who struggles to stay together.

name: SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake
short_description: Wish-granting Mermaid’s Tears in the hands of SpongeBob and Patrick… What could go wrong? Sure, the very fabric holding the universe together could come undone, opening portals into wild Wishworlds. But that’s nothing our favorite sponge can’t handle- with the right cosmic costume!

name: Drawing Machine
short_description: Drawing Machine is an implementation of Durer's drawing machine that helps a non-artist draw pictures. In turn, these pictures can be used to create any type of graphic, web, video, or gaming application. "Divide and Conquer" applied to drawing.
genres: Web Publishing;Animation & Modeling;Design & Illustration;Video Production;Utilities;Game Development

name: The Test: Hypothesis Rising
short_description: The second chapter in The Test trilogy. Answer a series of in-depth questions to reveal hidden truths about yourself and unlock secrets to discover how your life can change drastically with just a few, slight modifications. ...But are you sure you want the answers you seek?

name: DEEMO -Reborn-
short_description: DEEMO -Reborn- is Rayark's classic game DEEMO, reborn in a whole new way on Steam. The fully 3D immersive journey will intoxicate you with the elegant sounds produced by you on the piano, as well as with the adventures you discover in this fairytale world.

name: Scooty Shooty
short_description: Retro 3D hover tank maze combat with friends and bots

name: 泡泡三国
short_description: 《泡泡三国》是一款基于三国题材的2D消除类游戏，游戏包含多个关卡。卡通的游戏画面设计，动态的视觉效果和丰富的技能选择，让玩家体验一种不一样的消除游戏。

name: Strinova
short_description: Strinova is an anime-style third-person tactical competitive shooter. Switch freely between three-dimensional and two-dimensional forms in this one-of-a-kind game that offers a unique tactical shooting system for an unparalleled experience.

name: Stilstand
short_description: A dark, whimsical, and absurd interactive comic by artist Ida Hartmann, exploring the despair and loneliness of a young woman living alone through a long summer in Copenhagen.

name: Escape From Island
short_description: After a helicopter crash on a mysterious island, your mission is to survive and escape before the island’s dark forces consume you. Explore, gather resources, and face dangerous enemies as you navigate the island’s open world. Can you escape before it's too late?

name: GraFi Easter
short_description: GraFi Easter - casual, colorful, minimalist, physical puzzle with traps, treadmills, portals, easter eggs and changing gravity.

name: Come Bye: A Sheepdog Simulator
short_description: Whistle commands to your faithful sheepdog, and work together to herd your flock through obstacles, compete in trials, and avoid danger. Quirky, and charming, this Sheepdog Simulator's casual gameplay lets you use the same commands that real shepherds use.

name: Fast Gear
short_description: Fast Gear is a high-intensity 3D car racing game built for PC, offering both thrilling single-player challenges and competitive online multiplayer PvP action.

name: Hard West 2
short_description: Hard West 2 is a journey to the heart of darkness in the American West. Take control of a supernatural posse and catch the mysterious Ghost Train. Outsmart, outcheat and outgun your enemies in this turn-based tactics game set in a Wild West world where nothing is as it seems.

name: 三生之树3ZENTREE - 3D NODE BASED INFORMATION SYSTEM
short_description: 3ZENTREE is a 3d interactive node based information system. It could help you collect ideas, build a global map between information, trigger more creatives.

name: Prisme 7
short_description: The first video game on modern and contemporary art. Produced by Centre Pompidou.

name: Cards & Crystals
short_description: Match3 meets Trading Card Game! Collect cards, level up your heroes, and build decks to defeat your foes in this fast-paced puzzle/strategy game.

name: Tales of Kongfu
short_description: 游戏题材来源于中国武侠，采用类似杀戮尖塔的卡组构建玩法，并从格斗游戏当中获取灵感，游戏每张卡牌都代表一个招式，每个招式又分解为多个动作，这部分我是基于现实格斗当中，游戏采用一个动作一结算的方式，只有当你的招式完全行动完成后才会拥有使用下一张牌的机会。招式的动作分为四种攻击防御破绽警惕。游戏采用灵活的连招系统，只要两个招式间首尾有重叠，则可以省略前一个招式的重叠部分。玩家需要利用这项设定让自己的破绽尽量小，并且尽量利用对手的破绽。

name: Hunter of the Disowned
short_description: Hunter Of The Disowned is a procedural dungeon adventure video game in which you embody a tragic hero who must fight against destiny in a world ruled by Gods of nature an slaved animals.

name: Train Sim World® 2
short_description: The evolution of train simulation! Master iconic locomotives on high-speed services, long freight hauls or precise commuter traffic, and get creative with customisation tools in this advanced sequel. Climb into the cab in Train Sim World 2.

name: BitBattle
short_description: BitBattle is a 2D multiplayer action shooter. Zero Aim, 100% Bullet Hell! Collect Weapons and Items and fight against friends or other players. You also can race in our FunRun Mode. But be carefull, its not easy!

name: YouCanDoIt?
short_description: Try to clear the game How to play is simple. You can move the chicken to the target point. Drag with the mouse to jump the chicken. Feel the annoyance starting from scratch Sometimes you can get angry while playing this game.

name: 180 Files: The Aegis Project
short_description: Uncover a web of evil as a superspy! Break rules, break hearts–don't break cover.

name: The Most Beautiful Room in the World
short_description: Virtual world that reenacts through interactive animations the content painted by Andrea Mantegna in the Saint Giorgio Castle in Mantua, Italy. Virtual Reality interactive animated environment. For artists and scholars.

name: Crysis® 3
short_description: The fate of the world is in your hands. New and old enemies threaten the peace you worked so hard to achieve 24 years ago. Your search for the Alpha Ceph continues, but this time you'll also need to expose the truth behind the C.E.L.L. corporation.

name: Woodsalt
short_description: "Woodsalt" is an adventure game set on the planet of Nu-Terra, 1000 years after Earth was evacuated during chaotic natural disasters and an attack by giant creatures.

name: Sakura Stars
short_description: When hordes of Youkai threaten the world, the Tanukis send a messenger to choose human girls to receive magical powers to defend humanity. They are known as SAKURA STARS. This is a horizontal shmup made on Pico-8, a retro fantasy console with purposeful limitations to simulate an 8-bit era console.

name: Swords of Time
short_description: A colorful fantasy world threatened by dark forces is in danger. Help defeat the threat with your allies and companions who join you on the way. This game allows deep character development that progresses with classes, skills, permanent huntings stats, equipment and more.

name: Loop Hero
short_description: The Lich has thrown the world into a timeless loop and plunged its inhabitants into never ending chaos. Wield an expanding deck of mystical cards to place enemies, buildings, and terrain along each unique expedition loop for the brave hero.

name: CNDL
short_description: CNDL is an IES lighting creation toolset. Create custom IES files for your renders and video games in minutes.

name: Mad Streets
short_description: Mad Streets is a hilarious multiplayer party game with an emphasis on brutal yet comical fist fighting throughout a multitude of modes, local and online, where players battle it out in wild physics driven chaos to determine who is the baddest player in town!

name: Virtual Presenter Pro
short_description: Virtual Presenter Pro is a VR game designed to make you a better public speaker without leaving your home. Hone your speaking skills by using our in-depth analysis to incrementally improve your presentations.

name: Battle for the Kingdom
short_description: Top down card based medieval strategy game about map control.

name: Haunted by Evil
short_description: Creepy nightmares becoming a reality and making Patrick’s life (a usual IT-developer) full of trials. What’s that: creepy horror or usual schizophrenia? You have to solve the mystery and make a move to unravel the mysterious events and issues surrounding Patrick’s life.

name: PUZZL
short_description: PUZZL is a puzzle game with simple gameplay and increasing difficulty. With a minimalist and pleasant look, have fun solving it's 50 levels.

name: Space Mouse 2
short_description: In 1981, Geimu Kyoujin's masterpiece "Space Mouse" was released. 39 years later, a sequel has arrived. In "Space Mouse 2", you'll enter a perilous underground labyrinth. This is a roguelike dot-eater designed to appeal to players of all skill levels.

name: Bacon Quest - Lovers' Beef Special Edition
short_description: Bacon Quest: Lovers' Beef is a light-hearted dungeon crawler featuring Syren a sexy succubus and her cute friend Aoi. Battle through each stage finding hidden gallery images, loot and hentai scenes.

name: The Roaring Empire
short_description: How about entering an epic and fantastic medieval world than you've ever seen before. In the legendary world of The Roaring Empire, you can talk to dragons, charm and guide your adventure with countless characters. Add a new color of RPG with this game.

name: Hi-Score Boi
short_description: This is a clicking journey where you, the gamer set out to achieve the highest score and become the ultimate gamer!

name: Furry Shakespeare: Emperor Penguin Lear
short_description: Rewrite Shakespeare's King Lear. But with animals and dinosaurs and stuff.

name: 3D Jigsaw Puzzle Simulator
short_description: A demo game about assembling puzzles in 3D space. You can load any picture for assembly from your computer and select any level from the pause menu.

name: LowPolis
short_description: Build, advance, reshape! For all those who have missed relaxing strategy classics. LowPolis is a friendly-paced city builder game where you become the ruler of a rising community. Begin with a handful of resources and pave your way to a truly majestic kingdom!

name: Start Heart Thief | 出发吧！偷心盗贼 | 出撃 ルビー | 出擊 偷心盜賊
short_description: Our heroine ruby is an orphan, Every morning, she goes out to explore the secret island of God Every night, she put on her nightdress

name: Micro Platformer
short_description: A minimalistic platformer with a 1x1 tileset. No enemies, no bullets, no lasers. Just sheer platforming.

name: Burn Me Twice
short_description: A narrative adventure that combines the exploration and investigation of the enigmatic town of Düstenburg and its people, with trials that test your knowledge about the case.

name: ROBALL
short_description: Space shooter on your own drone. Various types of weapons. Every man for himself.

name: Neighbours back From Hell
short_description: There goes the neighborhood! Play the star of a cheeky TV Show who taking revenge on his horrible neighbor by constantly pranking him at home and around the world in the most creative and ludicrous ways.

name: 渡劫 x 魔女 ~ Team up with A Magician！
short_description: The orc magician who came down from the sky ended my lonely life. However, my peaceful daily life was also disturbed.

name: Devolverland Expo
short_description: Devolverland Expo is a first-person 'marketing simulator' set within an abandoned convention center after the annual Devolver Digital game expo was mysteriously canceled.

name: Autopsy Simulator
short_description: Autopsy Simulator is a first-person horror-sim hybrid where players take on the role of a practice pathologist and study case files, created in collaboration with real-world forensic doctors, to help guide their dissection of anatomically accurate bodies to determine each subject’s cause of death.

name: Center2048
short_description: The game needs to be rebuilt and will be temporarily removed. It will be relaunched in about a year. Thank you for your attention.

name: Audio Party Pack
short_description: A party game designed around sound. Includes 3 mini-games featuring "sound" focused gameplay!This party game is designed with visual impairments in mind as it relies strongly on sound. There are three mini-games, each focusing on a different challenge.

name: Coof Attack
short_description: Defend your toilet paper from an ever-growing angry mob! Even the odds by teaming up with friends in up to 4-player co-op. Customise your character's appearance and skills to fit your play-style. Discover more as you progress and unlock even cooler stuff.

name: 胆小鬼 Coward
short_description: A man desperate for life, choose to jump to end his life. The soul of suicide is imprisoned in the dark house. He has to escape from the devil and save the souls of other suicides in order to survive for 5 days.

name: Insexsity
short_description: Following her dreams, a young girl moves to a big city.

name: My Sail And My Sea
short_description: Half sandbox navigation game, including construction, exploration, trade, operation and other elements, combined with instant combat and round game.In addition, the game also has a built-in blueprint editor, which can use cubes to stack everything and share with each other.

short_description: Turn into a raging force of destruction or a super speedy gnome to overcome Geki Yaba's ultimate challenge. Do you have what it takes to save the princess in peril?

name: A Painter's Tale: Curon, 1950
short_description: “A Painter's Tale” is an adventure game that tells the story of the tiny Südtirol village of Curon Venosta by mixing reality and fiction. The old Curon was flooded by the waters of Lake Reschen in 1950 due to the construction of a dam. What lies beneath the bell tower still emerging from the lake?

name: SpinZap
short_description: SpinZap is a challenging game in classic arcade style. Use your reflexes, dexterity and boss skills to conquer 81 levels of circle zapping madness.

name: Steelrising
short_description: Paris, 1789. The French Revolution has been suppressed with bloodshed by Louis XVI and his merciless mechanical army. Aegis, a mysterious automaton masterpiece, must confront the king's army alone to save history in this challenging action-RPG.

name: Tails of Iron
short_description: Tails of Iron is an epic RPG Adventure with punishingly brutal combat. As Redgi, heir to the throne, you must embark on a perilous quest to reclaim your Kingdom. Explore a deceivingly charming world. Assemble a band of brave companions. Banish the merciless Frog clan!

name: Fighting Fiends
short_description: Fighting Fiends is a top-down fighting game. Play it 1 on 1 for intense matches or with up to 4 players for chaotic fun, both locally and online.

name: VBOX Sim
short_description: Analyze race data and video from your favourite racing game using Circuit Tools - the tool of choice for professional racing drivers in the real world!

name: soundStrider
short_description: Enter a synthesized reality. Explore endless worlds. Play an instrument. Save bookmarks. A psychedelic audio exploration game, walking simulator, music generator, and relaxation tool best experienced with headphones.

name: Euphoria: Supreme Mechanics
short_description: The ability to discern hidden connections is both a gift and a curse. The covert mechanisms of reality do not reveal themselves to any and all, and there is a price to pay for this knowledge…

name: The Odd Neon Void
short_description: The Odd Neon Void is an experimental Adventure/RPG game where you become Jack, a man stuck in a strange and unfamiliar place called the neon void. Don't be too sad.

name: Rotatex 3
short_description: Solve puzzles, rotate the level and guide the Cat to the teleport.

name: Minimalist Space War
short_description: A minimalist retro space shooter. Challenging, fast, and fun game play

name: Azure
short_description: A final project of my college freshman year. Just jump and dash and have fun.

name: Run!!!
short_description: This game is cool! You can parkour while you run from enemy, and if you escape, you win.

name: Frog Bath
short_description: Bathe your Frog King by jumping, hopping and tonguing yourself around maps in Frog Bath with the goal of beating your friends at giving His Cleanliness a bath! Spit and steal bath items from your friends to give the best bath possible to the Frog King.

name: Legends of the Brawl
short_description: Beat up some baddies, grab loot and occasionally punch your buddies in quick co-op mission games with classic action platforming gameplay. Complete quests to collect rewards and materials, upgrade your legends, and create new strategies to battle nightmares all over the world.

name: Game-Kun: Input Challenge
short_description: Game-Kun: Input Challenge is a reaction-based hiscore mini game. Test your reflexes and input skills with your gamepad. Unlock skins and other characters to enhance the fun! Can you reach the final level and compete for the ultimate hiscore?

name: Captive
short_description: You wake up in a bright, but mysterious room. You don't know what is happening or how you got there.

name: Music is the Language
short_description: Music is The Language is a VR music video featuring a new song by DJ Dani Magnani. Explore a mystical planet, following the surround beat of trumpets, voice, and guitars, in this surreal experience.

name: SUPERVIVE
short_description: THE ACTION BATTLE ROYALE WITH ENDLESS PLAYSTYLES. Slam into all-out, multi-squad teamfights in this lethal, fast-paced brawl in the sky. Unlock gear, theorycraft builds, and bring your gamebreaking loadout into every match.

name: Cube Miners
short_description: Kill enemies while trying to earn cash!

name: Dangerous Lands 2 - Evil Ascension
short_description: In this action game, you join the dark side to bring prosperity in the evil ascension.

name: COVID-19 (CORONA VIRUS)
short_description: Do you have what it takes to perform everyday tasks and curve balls life gives you to survive this quarantine? If you do you will get out this quarantine successfully and life will go back to normal.

name: Grey Skies: A War of the Worlds Story
short_description: Based on the great work of H.G. Wells, explore the English countryside and encounter iconic concepts such as Black Smoke, Red Weed and of course the almighty Fighting Machine and it's Heat Ray!

name: The Employee
short_description: You are the employee. You applied for a job offer as a web developer in a big company. What could go wrong? Do you think you would make a good employee? Not ready to work and show motivation? Then you can stay unemployed, punk!

name: The Legend of Cesar
short_description: A super fun game made by just one person, your goal is to kill as many zombies as you can and try to survive in the forest that surrounds you.

name: Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn
short_description: Embark on a perilous journey to find your missing friends while battling multiple unknown threats as Thedo, as well as enroll in an elitist school dedicated to Raiken slaying as you try and find your way back home as Aionis.

name: Epic Dumpster Bear 2: He Who Bears Wins
short_description: His forest was destroyed by corporate greed, now it's Dumpster Bear's turn for vengeance. Epic Dumpster Bear 2 is an action packed platformer with gameplay that harkens back to the glory days of 16-bit platformers.

name: IMPACT
short_description: Venture through a visually striking world filled with darkness, danger, and surprises around every corner. You take on the role of a loader robot in a long abandoned factory who is awakened by chance. Make your way through series of puzzles and platforms in a world now covered in darkness.

name: MaryPark St.
short_description: MaryPark St. is a short story telling indie game, set in a black and white dream-like world. Featuring two interpretations of the same story, The Dream & The Nightmare.

name: Super Bounce Ball
short_description: Bounce balls and collect star on the platform, easy in early levels, but gets harder. There will be rotating saws that move which you must avoid. Shooting turrets that fire bullets that you need to dodge.

name: pilapa BOOM
short_description: Pilapa BOOM is an extremely lightweight mini game. Players can shoot bullets to detonate the bombs and trigger a chain of explosions to open the path to the end. There is almost no learning cost, and you can play it right away.

name: Suspicious Spaceroads
short_description: Inspired heavily by the classic "Skyroads", partake in a platforming romp through a series of increasingly suspicious space roads, engage in futile questions like why are these roads hanging in space? Who built them? Why am I platforming here?

name: Second Star
short_description: Embark on an interstellar role-playing adventure 200 years in the future as you follow the footsteps of a missing ship and her crew.

name: Advanced creator of labyrinths
short_description: This game creates several types of 3D mazes. They are random and never repeat.

name: 东方幻灵录 ~ Touhou Hakanai Cards
short_description: Touhou Hakanai Cards is an autochess-like leisure game, includes different styles and distinct characteristics roles, you can use these distinctive characters to organize your own team. Structure you battle economics and use the varied and graceful character cards to fight!

name: YoloMouse - Game Cursor Changer
short_description: Use YoloMouse to change those obscure game cursors. Never lose your cursor in a heated battle again!

name: Retro Ride
short_description: A musically interwoven driving arcade game. Fast paced Audio visualization YouTube integration Beat songs to compete on leaderboards and earn credit to buy new cars.

name: Dissection
short_description: I don’t remember how I got into this house. I only know that I need to quickly find a way out. Something terrible is walking around the house and looking for me.

name: Legion Gold
short_description: Well-received by gamers and critics alike, Legion Gold is the expanded and improved version of its predecessor, Legion, and includes not only the original Legion game but a hefty expansion pack too.

name: Chariots of War
short_description: Chariots of War is an operational real-time game where you can play one of 58 different nations on a huge historically accurate and beautiful map covering the entire Middle East! Build up your cities and keep their inhabitants happy.

name: HookShotVR
short_description: In the "HookShotVR", let's fly around 3D space with fictional movement item "HookShot". Challenge that how fast you can clear the stages.

name: Amy's Greenmart
short_description: Diving into the story of Amy’s Greenmart, you are to open the network of eco-friendly shops! Amy’s Greenmart is a time management game that gives you a chance to feel the atmosphere of eco-friendly shops network. Become a part of the story of Amy and Napoleon The Cat.

name: Sclash
