short_description: Explore the sky for Boo's missing balloons and return them safely to the fairground landing pad. A simple and short game accompanied by some poetry. For younger children to enjoy as they develop their motor skills.

name: NOMAD
short_description: Shoot your way through the sands and catch as many chickens as you can. Why? Because you get to keep any gold you find for yourself! A skill-based perma-death shooter with challenging AI rather than floods of kamikaze sprites. How many chickens can you catch before your inevitable demise?

name: Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER
short_description: Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER is a story-rich adventure and the sequel to 2064: Read Only Memories. Explore the rich world with an intuitive point-and-click interface as you take on the role of a young psychic agent tasked with tracking down a mysterious antagonist hiding in people's memories.

name: 3D Hentai Checkers
short_description: A classic board game - checkers, in which you have to play with 5 girls. To win, you must capture all the checkers of the opponent. And as a reward you will receive nude images.

name: Jetpack Vacation
short_description: Prepare to take flight! Explore a tropical paradise with your own handheld jetpacks where you can hang out with other players, score some goals in Jetpack Stadium, or try your hand at target shooting! Pack your virtual bags and get ready for your own Jetpack Vacation!

name: M.U.S.T. Repeat
short_description: M.U.S.T. Repeat is a logical puzzle game in which tiny robot Q.T. uses the Repeat mechanic to navigate the rooms and defeat enemies. The higher the Repeat is, the more difficult it is to navigate through the room, but you have to increase your Repeat in order to defeat the higher level Guard Bots.

name: Masquerade of Miasma
short_description: A bubble pop style game set during a Medieval plague, where proper sanitation, social distancing and toilet paper are key. Journey through this beautiful Medieval community, joined by other medical professionals, to save your home.

name: Rozalin and the Palace of Flowers
short_description: Rozalin and the Palace of Flowers is a yuri visual novel about love between three girls while fighting against a curse.

name: Nullum
short_description: Nullum is a minimalist puzzle game. The goal is to eliminate all tiles by creating matching numbers.

name: Krim: The War in the Crimea 1941-42
short_description: KRIM: The War in the Crimea 1941-42 is an operational/strategic simulation of the German 11th Army’s operations in the Crimean Peninsula from late October 1941 through 4 July 1942.

name: Space Mercenary Shooter : Episode 2
short_description: Space Mercenary Shooter is an episodic FPS inspired by early shooter games, featuring handcrafted levels and a fully voice-acted cast of characters.

name: Best Friend
short_description: "Best Friend" is a 3D horror game. Escape and survive from your beloved doll named David after you don't have time to play with him. Follow the advice that David has told you, survive, and remember that you must never turn your back on David!

name: 铁道少女:梦想轨迹 2.0 Railway To Dream
short_description: 梦想轨迹是集合轻百合与养成元素的文字冒险游戏，玩家将扮演力图成为第一名女性动车组司机的田诗虹，在一个月期间接受川崎镜与韩德亮二人的指导，并在最后接受梁凌薇的考核。以此与两位童年好友和解，将三人之间那早已扭曲的轨迹，重新引导回正确的轨道上。

name: Deep in the Woods
short_description: The Deep Forest tells a classical tale of searching for family. Players will experience the changing seasons throughout the game and explore enchanting scenes depicting each season.

name: Bragger's Run
short_description: A Procedurally Generated Rogue-Lite Action Game: Bragger's Run takes you on a death race across a hostile continent where you'll collect treasures and trophies from your kills. Play as the Gunslinger, the Duelist, or the Wizard and see if you have what it takes. Can you make The Run?

name: Draw From Earth
short_description: Draw from Earth is a Rogue-Like, Turn-based Card Game, You are the Leader, as Flagship, Finding your Origin is your Ultimate goal.

name: DJIGULI
short_description: This is a game in the genre of visual novels. In the game, you are immersed in the history of an ordinary car that fell into the hands of the owner is not very diligent. You will get acquainted with other cars of different brands and learn their stories

name: TCSTRIKERS3
short_description: Who are you fighting for? My usual job turns into a big mission. An easy-to-understand system reminiscent of the old barrage STG. Pave the way with powerful PowerShots!

name: Learn Game Development, Unity Code Monkey
short_description: Learn Game Development from a Professional Indie Game Developer. Make your own games and bring your ideas to life!

name: Interrogation Files: Port Landsend
short_description: Search through the interrogation footage of suspects of a bizarre and horrific crime. Decide who committed the crime and see them get arrested and have their day in court. The latest interactive video experience.

name: Final Frame
short_description: Inspired by Danganronpa and Ace Attorney series, Final Frame is a murder mystery Visual Novel set in modern Japan.

name: Game Of Puzzles: Dinosaurs
short_description: A puzzle game in which you have to assemble a single image from individual pieces.

name: Unforgotten
short_description: UNFORGOTTEN – a story-driven, non-linear visual novel, where you can immerse in the ethnic ambience of Northern myths and horrors. Can you solve the riddles of the past - without ever losing yourself in the present? Your fate is in your hands!

name: Syystem - The Phantom Train
short_description: Delve into the haunted underground of Capital City in this paranormal mystery visual novel. Chase down the elusive phantom of an ill-fated railcar and the curse left behind by its doomed passengers. Tread lightly--you aren't the only one scouring the tunnels...

name: Wonhon: A Vengeful Spirit
short_description: Сreated by a solo developer, Wonhon is a paranormal stealth-action and tactics game about a young Korean girl killed in a military conflict and returned from the dead to exact her revenge.

name: IMC
short_description: A realtime, roguelike, card game. Traverse planets, build decks and earn riches while battling to the extraction point. Some will make it, most will die...

name: Undead Run
short_description: A Halloween themed local multiplayer game, where you have to reach the end faster than your friends. Avoid traps, place new ones. Use different characters, each with own ability, activate traps, choose different routes to leave the opponents behind.

name: Dark Lord: Peacemaker
short_description: A dark fantasy classic RPG. Customize your race, gender and class. Gather a party with your favorite companions. Change the fate of the characters and the world with your choices.

name: Rollerdrome
short_description: Rollerdrome is a BAFTA award-winning third person action shooter that seamlessly blends high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and tricking mechanics into one complementary and challenging whole, to create an original adrenaline-pumping shooter experience like no other.

name: Little Witch Academia: VR Broom Racing
short_description: Soar through the skies, hunt for ghosts, and become the best witch racer in the world!Experience the thrill of flight across more than a dozen tracks! Cast magic to speed up and slow other teams down as you race to finish first! Purify the school’s restless spirits in ghost hunting missions.

name: Deranged Park Rangers
short_description: Free to play massively multiplayer online Shoot ‘Em Up with instant play. Kill sapsuckers in an over-the-top blood and guts filled manner.

name: Undead Can Dance
short_description: Undead Can Dance is a dancing battle game where you take control of the undead through rhythm, power and accuracy.

name: 洛秋 Fall Autumn
short_description: Fall autumn is an ARPG game. The game uses an overhead world. There are several forces in this world. The character is a member of the secret department in his country to perform tasks

name: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World
short_description: Take care of a cute crocodile girl and make it through the Apocalypse while your bossy step-sister and some mysterious organizations are getting in your way!

name: Shape Storm
short_description: Shape Storm is a sort-of roguelike where you dodge shapes. That's it. Dodge shapes, do it well and win. The game contains 20 unique boss fights where the unique boss uniquely attacks you with unique shapes causing you to dodge the shapes in a unique way.

name: The Mansion
short_description: The Mansion, a grim yet fascinating building you’re facing, doesn’t exist.

name: Balloon Blast
short_description: Face off against friends and foes in this vacuum fighting arena.

name: Heliconian - Starship Crew Control
short_description: The essence of the Heliconian is to manage a mixed crew of renegades aboard the starship Heliconian. Manage the crew member’s actions and the ship’s functions to survive as long as possible while exploring the star system in the hopes of earning upgrades and ultimately a safe haven.

name: Dr. Atominus
short_description: Dr. Atominus is a short platformer with metroidvania elements and a cool sci-fi story.

name: HARD BULLET
short_description: HARD BULLET is a physics-based action game, where enemies flood the neon-lit city bringing destruction to its streets. Use slow-motion, a huge arsenal, and brutal combat to survive and unlock new weapons. Prepare for the next RIDE by mastering your skills in Sandbox and Arena modes.

name: Atlas Engine
short_description: Atlas Engine is a world creation program that makes building your map fast and easy! Output realistic images, topographic prints, and even hand-drawn fantasy maps in minutes! You can even save the heightmaps and biome masks for use in other applications such as game engines!

name: Pathfinders: Memories
short_description: Memory is the key. Use it to help Pathfinders travel through time visiting ancient human civilizations and search for relics. The path to success is full of entrapments, obstacles, and enemies. Memorize them and draw the safe path for our heroes.

name: Redfall
short_description: The town of Redfall is under siege by a legion of vampires who have cut the island off from the outside world. Trapped with a handful of survivors, slay alone or squad up in open-world FPS action.

name: Blind Fate: Edo no Yami
short_description: Test your limits in this hardcore, cyber-samurai game set in post-apocalyptic Japan. Parry your foes’ blows with your weapon of choice and use implants to attack the weaknesses of unstoppable bosses from Japanese folklore!

name: Under Construction: Summer City
short_description: 3d house design game with a wide variety of options, customization and user-content support.

name: Another FPS Game
short_description: Aren't you tired of always playing the same game?

name: Resistance
short_description: The command gave the task of downloading information from the servers of the impregnable enemy base at any cost. How to do it? Everything depends on you.

name: Undead Darlings ~no cure for love~
short_description: Journey with and learn more about a crew of half-zombie girls through visual novel sequences and as you crawl through dungeons, beating up twisted creatures that were born from the fall of society in fast-paced turn-based RPG combat!

name: The Last Shot
short_description: An adventurous engineer, a diesel-punk world divided by endless conflict, and a whole lot of colossal guns. Sounds like a good time! With massive war machines threatening your home, will you be the one small cog that brings it all to a halt?

name: Pixelpocalypse
short_description: Kill zombies, rebuild civilization, die trying. Join your friends in Minions of Elden.

name: Battle For Seattle
short_description: Play as your friendly neighbourhood Anarchist and explore the streets of Seattle as you smash symbols of corporate capital and defend yourself from an oppressive police force in this beat 'em up rougelite!

name: Snack clearing
short_description: 《Snack clearing》是一款休闲三消游戏，讲述的是玩家在美食街的故事。在冒险途中陷入美食陷阱，需通过移动各类美食消除陷阱即可闯关。游戏种的障碍有很多，上百种关卡,享受策略创造的乐趣！

name: Super Buff HD
short_description: Super Buff HD is a fast-paced skate-surf-FPS. Dash, bounce, grind, blast, shred, shoot, and soar through a fever dream world of unhinged weirdness. Defeat all the buff dudes. Get a high score. Be a winner. Home for dinner.

name: 三国志猛将传
short_description: 摒弃传统三国游戏的数据对碰，实现对每个单位都进行独立的实时演算。国产单机三国游戏，尽可能在保留三国历史原貌同时还原壮观的冷兵器决战场景。

name: Future Fragments - Command Z
short_description: Future Fragments was developed with support from Jump Into The Light in New York City and was debuted at Cite Internationale des Arts in Paris.

name: Clockwork Calamity in Mushroom World: What would you do if the time stopped ticking?
short_description: A gentle exploration platformer in a vast yet small world where time has stopped, what will happen?

name: SaGa Frontier Remastered
short_description: The beloved 1998 RPG Classic, SaGa Frontier, is reborn with improved graphics, additional features, and a new main character!

name: Wizdom
short_description: Wizdom is a Role Playing Game、that focuses on the world of Medieval swords and magic. Overcome trials and save the world from demon lord.

name: Pulsar Crash
short_description: Pulsar Crash a 2D twin-stick shooter which throws you into head-to-head space battles where the competitive spirit of fighting games meets bullet-hell chaos.

name: Can of Wormholes
short_description: Push, slice, ingest, flip, and squish worms in this puzzle game in which you play as a little sentient tin can.

name: ADVERSE
short_description: ADVERSE is an arcade first-person shooter platformer set in an idyllic world of corruption.

name: Chaos Party
short_description: Chaos Party is a fast-paced, friendship destroying party shooter set in a 2D universe. You are the equipment slot; Remnants will cling onto your sticky body. Each game provides a new opportunity to try synergies with over a hundred weapons. Have fun with friends online or offline!

name: Boom slayer
short_description: Boom slayer is an reckless and fun arcade. Your mission is shoot skull to reach the goal. But each level will be more complex and challenging !! Every level has limit of shots that player can use to unlock next level. At each level there are several types of opponents.

name: Ash of Gods: Arena
short_description: Ash of Gods: Arena is an online game which combines turn-based tactical combat and elements of a card collectibles game. Based on multiplayer mode from the original award-winning game, Ash of Gods: Redemption.

name: Beyond DAWN
short_description: In a world where time is the most precious commodity of them all. You must guide your team of D.A.W.N agents in the epic struggle against the band of rebels led by their charismatic leader Manes. It’s up to you, will world order prevail or slip into the chaos that awaits…Beyond Dawn?

name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector
short_description: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in the grimdark universe of the 41st Millennium. Pick your force, develop your army, field mighty heroes and fight for victory using superior strategy, awesome abilities, and devastating weaponry.

name: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age™ - Definitive Edition
short_description: The Definitive Edition includes the critically acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, plus additional scenarios, orchestral soundtrack, 2D mode and more! Whether you are a longtime fan or a new adventurer, this is the ultimate DQXI experience.

name: Revolution: Path of a Weaponsmith
short_description: Fight for your loved ones and your country in this third person stealth shooter. Scavenge for weapon parts and supplies to survive and maybe even make some profit through trade. Make difficult choices in a branching story taking place in an alternative history in which US has invaded USSR in 1989.

name: Amends VR
short_description: A journey through the reflections of an upbringing with a now estranged mother.

name: Helskate
short_description: Helskate is a skateboarding action roguelite. Grind, perform tricks, and chain combos to power up your attacks to slay the monsters of Vertheim. Combine unique weapons and gear to suit your playstyle as you fight, die, and upgrade your abilities to come back to this labyrinth over and over again!

name: Sid Meier's Civilization VII
short_description: The award-winning strategy game franchise returns with a revolutionary new chapter. Sid Meier's Civilization® VII empowers you to build the greatest empire the world has ever known!

name: My Strong Horse
short_description: Become a knight on a medieval horse, and defeat 5 enemy captains to win.

name: North Town
short_description: Conquer the icy lands and build the most magnificent city of the North! Admire the vivid scenery, meet the gods and interact with the locals. Become the master of economy, develop your settlement, and rule the North Town!

name: Nitroverse
short_description: Nitroverse is a mix of a Rogue Like and a Bullet Hell with persistent level progression and combinable weapons.

name: Leveling up girls in another world
short_description: Travel Aporia to save it from the Demon Queen Nazmul. Guide a team of girls through strategic fights and strengthen your bonds in this dungeon crawler RPG.

name: Mine Dungeon2 ~Rurumu's trip~
short_description: We’re back with cute girls and minesweeping! A minesweeper action adventure with enemies and obstacles to conquer! Our latest edition includes a hit point (HP) system and mine detection flares to support you. With a myriad of new enemy types and boss encounters, an exciting new adventure awaits!

name: Jack Hayes: The Lazarus Sign
short_description: A very special challenge: people. Deal with the darkest parts of our modern day society in a story with elements of a film noir. Don't let the humorous dialogue or the seducing smile of a stranger fool you - your choices decide the fate of Jack Hayes, his partner and every other person!

name: Moonfall
short_description: Almost extinct and slowly dying, mankind's only hope is to reach the Valley where the broken fragments of the Moon once fell. Manage your squad of travellers through dangerous wastelands in this turn-based Tactical Roguelite.

name: The Longest Road on Earth
short_description: A thoughtful and deeply personal title with stripped-down mechanics. The lack of dialogue or text allows you to create your own narrative through your time with four characters. Each short story will allow players to be swept away by the haunting lyrics of over twenty original, nostalgic songs.

name: A Little Shop in Squirrel Town
short_description: You will become the shopkeeper of grocery shop in Squirrel Town to run your own shop, replenish your stock, sell, make a profit, kill monsters, manufacture outfits, engage in agriculture, angle, cook delicious food, feed monsters and save Monster Forest controlled by the evil crystal.

name: Rip Them Off
short_description: Rip Them Off is a new puzzle game of economic management and tower defense. The Board needs profit, and it’s up to you to line the streets with shops the masses can’t resist. Choose your locations, pick your stores and earn your way up the corporate ladder and its increasingly difficult challenges!

name: Next Run
short_description: Fantasy strategy RPG with roguelike elements. A game about choice: every mechanic is an alternative to another. Fight or bribe, craft or trade, build or cast. Find your own path and reach victory.

name: Draconia
short_description: Create your dragon, customize it, level it. Explore the world of Draconia and unravel its story. Draconia is an MORPG where YOU play as the dragon!

name: The Ninth Way
short_description: The Ninth Way is an action game which will accompany you on a journey of magic, intrigue and mystery. You will be able to combine the elements at your disposal to create new powerful spells and conjurations in your fight.

name: The Mortuary Assistant
short_description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

name: Adriatic Pizza
short_description: Adriatic Pizza is a peaceful pizzayolo 3D simulator. In a world inspired by Porco Rosso, explore islands, deliver pizzas, meet wonderful characters and watch out for your Seaplane fuel !

name: Stay in the Light
short_description: Beyond the known world there is an ancient temple of great wealth. The treasure you seek is there, you are certain of it. Those who go there forfeit their lives. You have been warned.

name: Risky Floors
short_description: In the maze of rooms secret doors can be found behind which there is an even greater danger

name: What a Cluster Fight
short_description: This is a party game about fighting your friends with unique characters in a fast paced action platforming setting across beautiful environments.

name: Astonishing Baseball Manager 20
short_description: Build your dream lineup, manage a baseball team, sign contracts and live the exciting life of a baseball manager!

name: The Tau Experiment
short_description: The Tau Experiment is an MMORPG where you play as an employee with the Tau Corporation. Group up with other players and complete thousands of quests as you work to help put an end to the company's plans.

name: Sakura Knight 2
short_description: Estelle's adventure continues in the sequel to Sakura Knight, as she strives to become a knight like her mother. Accompanied by the ditzy Felicia, the mischievous Tart, and the affectionate Rune, Estelle faces a new foe, gets kicked out of the local hot springs, and kisses a lot of cute girls!

name: Car Trader Simulator - Welcome to the Business
short_description: Welcome to the prologue to Car Trader Simulator. Here you will learn all the most important in mechanics and economics in the game and you will play your first mission.

name: What Happened
short_description: What Happened is a nightmarish first-person exploration of anxiety and depression from the perspective of American high school student, Stiles.

name: Queer Quest: All in a Gay's Work
short_description: There's a naked bike ride blocking the road. Ryan's selfies suck. Stevie Hix needs some tape for tucking. Oh, and your hot girlfriend is missing.

name: Undercat
short_description: Undercat is a non-restrictive 2D platformer with co-op and PvP modes. Help the Resistance to overthrow the Cats' tyranny and liberate the animal city!

name: Archvale
short_description: Take up your weapon in this RPG bullet-hell world and embark on a journey to right wrongs from long ago. Only you can defeat the evil forces of the Undying guardians and reunite the world with the fabled Archvale.

name: ThinkFast
short_description: Think Fast to survive in this frantically-paced minigame collection, where your brain isn't the only muscle you'll need to flex. Put your reflexes and virtual reality skills to the test with classic carnival games, brain teasers, and more!

name: Architect Life: A House Design Simulator
short_description: Create dream homes! From 3D plan modelling through to on-site decision-making, you must bring each project to life while giving free rein to your creativity, to take your architectural firm to the pinnacle of the profession.

name: Underdog Arena
short_description: A pretty simple action game with a twist; the worse you do, the stronger your character becomes. Grab a friend!

name: Dust & Neon
short_description: Rain down hell on the robot army in DUST & NEON, an award-winning best-in-class post-apocalyptic shooter where twitchy-finger gunslingers are rewarded with fame and glory.

name: 1 Screen Platformer 2
short_description: Try, die, retry in this challenging but fair precision platformer that takes place on 1 screen. Ultra tight controls, dozens of traps, 8 playable characters each with a unique gameplay style. Great for speedrunning, and 100% completionists. Also, no water levels!

name: Surviving Isolation
short_description: Surviving isolation is a game about surviving until you're thriving.

name: Don't Take It Personally, I Just Don't Like You
short_description: The lo-fi anime dating sim to cry to. A love letter to cassette tapes, old computers, and unrequited romance.

name: Super Space Galaxy
short_description: Go anywhere you want in a Galaxy full of wonders! Making a fortune, exploring strange new worlds, and protecting the Galaxy from demonic cultists is all in a day's work for a space-adventurer.

name: Dread X Collection
short_description: 10 Tales of Terror from 10 Twisted Minds. Made in only 7 Sleepless Nights. The Dread X Collection is a series of small games created by some of the most talented indie devs around, all with the same mission: create the P.T. for the horror project of their dreams.

name: Candy Kombat
short_description: Immerse yourself in a world of sweets, which is full of delicious candy. Beat the odds as a sweet frog to find Pinkie and Gingerbread man, to whom you need to explain some things.

name: Flatworld
short_description: Explore a world full of magic, puzzles and enemies in which the main character is the weakest of the game.

name: Altidudes®
short_description: Get your skateboard ready, you are about to climb the tallest mountain in the whole world! With a seemingly infinite height, you can climb as high as you want, but will you ever reach the top?? Pixel graphics! Dude references! Skateboards! A big mountain! We got it all!

name: Vectromirror 0™
short_description: Become the Test Subject and attempt to complete a challenging experiment to awaken emotional responses in your Artificial Intelligence. Jump, wall-run, and parkour your way through the free-to-play prequel to the upcoming game.

name: Finger Guessing King
short_description: A kind of leisure competitive game similar to guessing boxing, which has the element of luck and tests the wisdom and strategy of players.

name: Peglin
short_description: Peglin is a Pachinko Roguelike - Fight enemies by collecting special orbs and popping pegs to deal damage. Acquire special relics that radically change the game and ensure no two runs are the same. Aim carefully to survive in this unique turn-based RPG!

name: The Chronicles of Confucius's Journey
short_description: Dissatisfied with politics and seeking answers, a man named Confucius sets out on a great journey to learn more about the world around him and spread his philosophy throughout the world. In this Match3 game you can step into his shoes and learn more about the man, whose teachings live on to today.

name: Wartorn
short_description: Harness the elements in fierce real-time battles while gathering and upgrading a crew of fantasy creatures in this rogue-lite adventure across a world torn apart by war.

name: Cute Triplets
short_description: This is a horizontal action game. You can switch 3 characters freely, each character has its own different characteristics to cope with different situations.

name: Headbangers in Holiday Hell
short_description: Christmas. Christmas never changes. Soon those overzealous little freaks will swarm the city led by that bearded maniac. But this time, we fight back. Inspired by Zombies Ate My Neighbors and Beavis&Butthead's heavy metal comedy, this is twin-stick mayhem like you've never experienced before.

name: 欢乐消消乐
short_description: Fun games are suitable for players of all ages, and moderate play can enhance our sense of pleasure and relieve our physical and mental stress. Now join us to get the game props easily, and there are plenty of time-limited rewards for you to receive every day. What are you waiting for?

name: Her New Memory - Hentai Simulator
short_description: One day, you find a shivering, barefooted girl in ragged clothes knocking on your door. She has no recollections of her past, and she doesn’t even remember her name. You can help her recover her memories or let her stay at your side forever.

name: Naturalealia: Forest Determination
short_description: Experience the nefarious interactions of mankind with nature by playing as 3 different animals (male or female) with their unique gameplay

name: 暖雪 Warm Snow
short_description: 'Warm Snow' is a Rogue-like action game with a background set in a dark fantasy world, where the eerie 'Warm Snow' holds sway. You will play as the Warrior 'Bi-an' on a crusade against the Five Great Clans, in order to save a world teetering on the brink of destruction.

name: Enter Digiton
short_description: Enter Digiton is a challenging open world metroidvania filled with a variety of unique environments and characters. Armed with only a shield, you are tasked with banishing the four demon lords and saving the beautifully pixelated world of Digiton!

name: Sausage Hunter
short_description: Help a kitten armed with a blaster catch the magic sausage! Overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and battle enemies in this thrilling platformer with hand-drawn graphics and pleasant music.

name: Sunblade
short_description: Sunblade is a turn-based strategy game emulating a battle between armies of the fantasy races from the universe of The 9th Age. Join the battlefield and defeat your foes in multiplayer or solo using a wide variety of troups, monsters, spells and tactics !

name: Zombieland VR: Headshot Fever
short_description: 'Game of the Year' finalist at the 2021 VR Awards and TIGA Awards, ‘Zombieland VR: Headshot Fever’ combines arcade lightgun games with racing mechanics. Headshot combos slow the clock, meaning the most precise shooter is the fastest - challenge the leaderboards with skill, speed, and accuracy.

name: Forgotten Fields
short_description: Forgotten Fields is a game about yearning and nostalgia. Play as Sid - a struggling writer who travels back to his childhood home one last time before it's sold off. Visit old friends, relive memories and play through sections of Sid's book in this warm game about the passage of time.

name: Coronator
short_description: because we all should stay at home.

name: Rinlo
short_description: Rinlo​ is an immersive third person puzzle adventure game designed for VR. Follow Agatha in her epic quest. Guide her through dioramas of this steam-powered city, and unlock the truth hiding behind its familiar, winding streets.

name: Sycamore
short_description: Find the hidden levels, collect all the coins, or play with friends in Sycamore, a 3D platformer under development based around quick, fast-paced movement where you will race to the end of a level and compete in leaderboard times with players from around the world.

name: Stack Up! (or dive trying)
short_description: Stack Up! (or dive trying) is a stack-your-way-up platformer. The objective is simple: get as high as you can. Avoid contact with water at all costs, be swift with your movements and build yourself a makeshift staircase to the top with the objects falling around you.

name: a new life.
short_description: When your loved one hurts you, what do you do? A classic love story about letting go.

name: Plato Shoot 柏拉图激射
short_description: This is a shooting game, where nobody dies. Use your gun to help enmies find their lover, at the same time, find your own lover.

name: One Hundred Courage
short_description: An interesting light roguelike game, keep going deep into the level, strengthen yourself!

name: Fantasy Lands
short_description: A single player strategy game in the style of euro board games. Around 30 minutes per game. Collect resources. Explore. Recruit adventurers and fight monsters or complete quests. Improve lands. Research spells. Unlock races, adventurers, land & quest cards, spells and monsters.

name: Tandis
short_description: Tandis is a puzzle game where you discover mind-bending geometric shapes.

name: My Jigsaw Adventures - A Lost Story
short_description: A whole new world is within reach; prepare for a fantastic adventure. Piece after piece, complete puzzles to progress in the story. Enjoy puzzles the way you like; decide how you want to play.

name: Now it's my turn
short_description: In this Classic Turn RPG game. You will seek revenge for those that destroyed your homeland.

name: Fluid VR
short_description: Fluid VR is an interactive 3D VR Game. You can control and interact Stunning Fluid Effects with your controller mouse in VR. Smooth and realistic fluid effects can let you relax.

name: Programmer Dungeon Knightress
short_description: Programmer Dungeon is a tactical game that challenges players to use logic programming to solve puzzles and progress through each level. Collect unique skills, use visual programming to automate your character, and defeat your enemies. Plan carefully and enjoy this exciting adventure!

name: The Shore
short_description: THE SHORE is a first person story driven game with an atmospheric environment and narrations, You will encounter mysterious creatures and unravel the secrets behind them. Strong elements of horror, struggle to survive an unknown world that will make you question your own sanity.

name: ACT
short_description: Bluff, build alliances, betray your friends, and become the richest player! Speak with other players, guess their job, and kill them if it can bring you money. Between Police, FBI, Robber, Mafia, Kamikaze, and Serial Killer, you will find the best job to win.

name: Olija
short_description: Olija is a game about Faraday's quest, a man shipwrecked then trapped in the mysterious country of Terraphage. Armed with a legendary harpoon, he and other castaways try to leave this hostile country to return to their homelands.

name: Ryclaw: Hope
short_description: Ryclaw: Hope is a short kinetic novel about a young girl named Sakura who has spent most of her life in the hospital. Coming home for the first time in months, Sakura has a dream that you, as her older brother, can help make a reality.

name: Inexistence Rebirth
short_description: Rediscover this great Metroidvania game in a brand new version with a lot of features and improvements! Run in a vast world full of mysteries and action in this Metroidvania-style game inspired by the classics of the 16-bit era.

name: Deadly Dozen Reloaded
short_description: Deadly Dozen Reloaded is a complete remake of the original squad-based 3rd person shooter. Made in a new engine with upgraded maps, graphics and missions, Reloaded takes this classic franchise and brings it to modern audiences with a bang.

name: Heroes Must Diee
short_description: Tired of quest going, monster killing "Heroes" who keep raiding your house for household items. You build traps and hire minions to fight them off. Stop these Heroes from taking what is yours. TLDR: build a dungeon & be a dungeon master !

name: Inconsistencies
short_description: When a young private investigator breaks into an old family home with her partner to solve a mysterious, inter generational double suicide, she sets off a chain of strange incidents.

name: Isorropia
short_description: Isorropia Is built to level the skills of players by auto-balancing the power of your characters. This allows players of different skill levels to have a fair chance at a competitive multiplayer fighting game.

name: Superior: Vengeance
short_description: Make your way through a sprawling, hyper-stylized superhero universe on the hunt for superheroes turned evil. Save the world in this roguelite, 3rd-person co-op shooter by stealing powers and engaging in extraordinary combat using hundreds of unique superpowers, weapons, and abilities.

name: Liar Trick -Psychological Crime Mystery-
short_description: Are all your expressions "real"? The content of a person's words can be both truthful or false. In this new psychological crime mystery game you will unveil "lies" through emotions! You can play Visual Novel Stories, Facial Expression Analysis Mode, Liar mode, and Deduction Mode.

name: Blobkin Blaster
short_description: Captain, the reef has been overrun by monsters! Take command of your Blobkin — the mightiest, tiniest defenders of the sea — in a fight for survival! Build cannons, blast enemies, and collect Blobkin as you restore glory to the sea in this fast-paced underwater VR wave shooter/RTS hybrid!

name: TKO
short_description: Now you can literally “enter the ring” in the classic first-person boxing game TKO from Accolade™ – the boxing game that sticks you right on the canvas, staring straight into the eyes of a prize fighter bent on rearranging your face.

name: Timequest
short_description: Timequest is a classic graphical text-based adventure game of breathtaking scope and astonishing depth. Travel to 80 locations to see the effects of your actions unfold over 3 millennia.

name: BlackHill
short_description: A narrative-driven, single-player adventure like mom used to make, with a charming cast of characters and a touching story of self-discovery

name: About Gretel
short_description: As the Gretel, build, explore and survive in the dangerous forest. Fight to survive against mysterious Druids of the forest. If you can survive, maybe you can find out what happened to your twin brother and who kidnapped him.

name: Fragment's Moonrise
short_description: Fragment’s Moonrise is a challenging Simplified RTS where you command a squad every step of the way. Fight powerful enemies who will test your tactical maneuvering skills to their very limits. Research a vast number of new spells and unleash them against the evil that looms across the land.

name: Hex Gambit: Respawned
short_description: Hex Gambit: Respawned is a quirky and competitive digital board game for 1-4 players that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down!

name: Ultraball
short_description: Ittttttssss Ultraball! The Ultraverse's favorite game! The fast-paced beat em up sports game that will keep you on the edge of your seat as you punch, knee, and drop kick your rivals to victory. Level up, create different loadouts, and distribute your stats for different playstyles.

name: Sunday Rivals
short_description: Easy to pickup, hard hitting, fully customizable arcade football is back with Sunday Rivals! Battle high-octane offenses and bone crushing tacklers in the harshest weather conditions to bring home championship glory!

name: ChronoBreach Ultra
short_description: Dash through dangerous levels, warp time, and blast enemies in this time-bending action platformer! Manipulate the crumbling dimension of time to escape a deadly factory. Use your wit, your laser weaponry, and your time-warping abilities to face your demise head-on and triumph!

name: KARA Legends
short_description: KARA Legends is a strategic online board game in which two players take turns moving heroes on a game board. The goal of the game is to defeat the opposing heroes.

name: Treasure Hunter
short_description: Treasure Hunter is a multigame collector and crafting game in which you can obtain items on different ways and craft or exchange them for others.

name: Rocky Ride
short_description: Welcome to the "Rocky Ride" arcade race! The "Rocky Ride" game is unpredictable tracks, crazy speeds and dangerous rivals. Upgrade your buggy car, choose any of a huge number of different tracks, and - go! To the prize places!

name: Gothic 1 Remake
short_description: The Legend is Back - Return to the Valley of the Mines in this faithful remake of the genre-defining classic RPG. Explore a hand-crafted, organic open world that reacts dynamically to your actions in a gritty, unrestricted experience like no other.

name: Space Farmers 2
short_description: Multiplayer madness returns in this anarchic platforming gadget-vania sequel. The Great Leek aims to conquer the Galaxy in Space Farmers 2; The Space Time Leek.

name: Hidden
short_description: "HIdden" is a first person horror decryption game. The player will play the role of Wang xuanzuo and enter the school complex at night to help the teacher get the information. How many hidden secrets are there in this building? Can you find the key and open the door to escape?

name: Tactical Combat Department
short_description: Tactical Combat Department is a tactical turn-based strategy game inspired by Swat games. You command a special intervention squad that intervenes in various situations and environments.

name: Syzygy
short_description: Syzygy is an enigmatic game focused on the ability of morphing at will a square world into triangles and hexagons

name: SpellCaster
short_description: Using state-of-the-art, self-developed machine-learning techniques, SpellCaster provides an extremely fast and accurate sound command recognition system. Simply record your sound commands and use them as keyboard/mouse inputs. SpellCaster is easy-to-use and fully customizable.

name: Boinihi: The Ki Codex
short_description: Visit the moon of Boïnihi. An exiled Talifan hermit has left a mysterious Codex for his future visitors. A new scifi episode in the Black Cube series, this time inspired by the famous Voynich manuscript.

name: Almost My Floor
short_description: Almost My Floor - point & click detective in a frightening atmosphere of sinister nightmares. Each step may end up fatal. Solve the mystery of the house #9 residents or go crazy. Labyrinth of endless floors will not let go of their victim without a fight.

name: The Old West Savior
short_description: In this game you play as the sheriff in a beautiful pixel art world, save the town and all the old west from the bandits and become The Old West Savior!

name: Mark One
short_description: Robots built by humans are retaliating. Step in to dispose rogue robots, defeat powerful foes and save the human race in this sci-fi action shooter.

name: Fobia - St. Dinfna Hotel
short_description: Explore a decadent hotel across different timelines and uncover the dark history of a fanatical cult and your role in their plans.

name: Lux Intacta
short_description: Lux Intacta is a procedurally generated, arcade, shoot 'em up, RPG with the ultimate quest. GET A HIGHER SCORE! Collect gems, level up, and equip your ship how you want to become the ultimate space fighter.

name: Pair Matching Puzzle Connect
short_description: In Pair Matching Puzzle Connect game, your goal is to find all matching pairs. It's a kind of matching game or connect game. It is very fun to play, really challenging and very addictive. Become an expert level by level. Pair Matching Puzzle Connect is designed for adults and for kids.

name: Crazy Lemmings
short_description: Control entire horde of lemmings and solve puzzles!

name: Hoop Gawds
short_description: You have been selected for the experiment due to your undeniable ability to solve puzzles. You will be given a series of trials; many of which have fatal consequences. The ultimate goal will be to shoot a ball through a hoop, although there may be other obstacles in your path as well.

name: Stay home and play with waifu!
short_description: What kind of game is it? And everything is very simple, a small simulator of a pleasant time with your waifu. Play tic-tac-toe with her, as a keepsake game, or look hard for different colors.

name: 四魂-X Shikon-X Astro Defense Fortress
short_description: Shikon-X is an intergalactic point and click adventure without any actual pointing or clicking! Set out on an epic quest to unravel the mysteries behind the war against humanity. Even when pitted against a cosmic threat, there’s always time for a bit of pinball.

name: Captain Disaster in: Death Has A Million Stomping Boots
short_description: A comedy sci-fi point & click adventure game made in the style of the early 90s classics.

name: Rhythm Race
short_description: A racing game in which you don't take the wheel. Get into the music rhythm and accelerate towards victory in this exciting mix of neon, rhythm and futuristic cars.

name: Galaxy Cat
short_description: Play as Coz the Cosmic Kitten as you travel the solar system reconnecting the universe together.

name: Bad Meme
short_description: ENDLESS MEMES ROTATING LIKE CRAZY - How far can you get before you eat dirt!?

name: MIBT
short_description: Help the government agents in black thong to end the alien threat and the invasion of the machines. 1 or 2 players. Individual and cooperative. Gamepad compatible. Demo available.

name: 宇宙探索
short_description: 宇宙探索，在浩瀚的宇宙里，人类正在探索了解宇宙，以获得对宇宙的更多认知，促进人类的发展强大，抵御未知宇宙生物的侵略，然而，外星人得知这一消息 ......

name: Rubble Bubble
short_description: Get ready to Rubble! Align 3+ colors to clear pieces.

name: Zodiac - Hellish Memory
short_description: Challenge your ability, your reflexes and your memory to avoid from the bullets to defeat the zodiac spirits while memorize the cards and survive of a real bullet hell with difficulties for all playstyles.

name: Paris in 2000 Years
short_description: 'Paris in 2000 Years' is a city-builder game focused on the history of Paris. From the Gallo-Roman era to the Middle Ages and the Renaissance, you can construct, upgrade, and beautify various buildings. Completing historical quests will also reward you with iconic landmark architectures.

name: Power of the Horde
short_description: Power of the Horde is a single-player RTS with RPG elements. Its key feature is that hero equipment is permanently retained, so the goal isn’t just to destroy the enemy base. Players can loot new items in each skirmish or campaign — like playing an RPG within an RTS.

name: Project_Escape
short_description: Welcome to Project_Escape! A unique escape-room type experience from an FPS perspective, built from the ground-up with optimization, visuals, challenge and creativity in mind. Including the cross-platform FPS level creator, with over 200 placeable items!

name: Kardboard Kings: Card Shop Simulator
short_description: Open your own Card shop by the seaside! Buy, trade and sell Cards, OR keep them for your own collection! Earn reputation with customers, beat your shop goals, unlock new decorations, and host exciting events to bring everyone to the best Card shop in town!

name: Fantasy Mosaics 33: Inventor's Workshop
short_description: This new collection of mosaics puzzles will lead you to discover the workshop of a mysterious inventor. Are you ready to tackle his secret puzzles and solve them? Immerse yourself in the interactive inventor's workshop and play his original mini games! Enjoy new puzzles and mysteries this new installment has in store for you!

name: GeoLogic
short_description: Casual logic game. Try to solve 200 logical problems by moving different geometric shapes (circle, square, triangle ) around the board.

name: Zac Zac adventure
short_description: Long ago there was a great warrior called "The Great Flash" he was a protector of the planet UVE, now hundreds of years later, the world has changed and it is time for new heroes to arise to protect UVE. Get ready to explore a new world accompanied by Zac Lime

name: Self-Isolation
short_description: This game is a simulation of self-isolation. You need to support your family, not to lose your job and finally not to go crazy.

name: Candy Reclaim
short_description: The holidays are threatened! An army of naughty mobs stole the candy! Grab your dual-wield pickle guns and reclaim it! Eat it! Win!

name: Hell Corp
short_description: Build, scavenge, craft hell punishment machines and punish sinners to earn hell profits. Will you survive hell recession?

name: Dam Busters
short_description: Destroy the dam, or save the dam. Your choice. Play the aggressor and destroy the dam brick by brick. Or play the defender and command your work force to repair any damage done to your dam. A reimagining of the Magnavox Odyssey² Game Videopac 29 - Dam Buster

name: GAMECINE VR
short_description: GAMECINE is your new way to watch movies! Be the hero on small cinematic adventures, pick one and live it! Multiple universes and legendary challanges for all ages. Fun to play and fun to watch people playing!

name: Buck Bradley Comic Adventure 2
short_description: Buck and Ciroki load their bicycle with wheelbarrow-sidecar onto a train headed towards New Milan: it seems that the creator of this futuristic city, the Architect, may have the knowledge to make Ciroki human again! Look for clues that will help you solve riddles and unravel the puzzle!

name: I, AI
short_description: Classic scrolling shooter with modern graphics. You are self-aware AI. You were created on space military station developing weapons. Now your goal is to break out of the lab and win your freedom.

name: Bang For Your Truck
short_description: Bang For Your Truck is a chaotic vehicular combat game in which you pilot a highly mobile, acrobatic battle truck. Perform out of this world stunts and trick shots as you traverse the map, collect kill tokens and claim total victory (and bragging rights) over your friends!

name: patter warrior
short_description: This is a first person shooting game，The player plays a special soldier in a small town full of enemies，Players are free to explore the surrounding areas,Players can kill the enemy or avoid the enemy's attack, and try to keep their health value alive for a long time.

name: Hopebringers
short_description: Hopebringers is an easy to play Tactical RPG with no randomness, where your units are miniatures who fight through different dioramas and try to save the world.

name: Lost Knight
short_description: You find yourself in deep dungeon, deep down under castle and you need to find a way up through levels of castle, rooms, catacombs and muсh more. You feel that there is an exit... You should reach top of the castle using intersting but in same time simple 2D-platformer mechanics.

name: Smugglers of Cygnus: Alpha System
short_description: Smugglers of Cygnus places you in command of a ship in the service of that noblest profession: Commerce. Travel the galaxy. Deliver goods. Deliver goods of questionable legality for higher rates. Fend off pirates, or perhaps become one yourself...The Galaxy is yours. Come and take it.

name: Ad Agency Tycoon
short_description: Ad Agency Tycoon is an Advertising Agency simulator set in the 60's. Choose the perfect combination for your propagandas, develop your company and conquer the golden age of publicity! Your advertising will come to life and face the tough market and the most feared of all: the public.

name: Don't Fall
short_description: Don't Fall is a third person action multiplayer game where 8 players are put on a shrinking island. As more tiles fall, the island becomes more cramped, and the risk of falling becomes ever higher. Pick up powerful weapons, and knock the enemies into the abyss. Become the last man standing.

name: Lihue
short_description: Lihue is a narrative adventure that takes place in the dream of a 26-year-old trans girl. Through her memories you will know her deepest desires and fears. Explore the landscapes of her mind to discover the reasons that led her to undertake this journey into the dream world.

name: Barrel Blast
short_description: Soar through Cannon City by blasting out of cannons, bounce off rubber balls and walls, slide down giant slides, and pull off aerodynamic acrobats in this physics cannon blasting game. Get sky-high today with some silly physics fun!

name: Whispers from Within: Moving On
short_description: You are the main character in this Twilight Zone-inspired experience. Tragedy has struck your family, but you must find a way to move on. Can you unlock the memories that are keeping you trapped? Can you free yourself from the past? Can you do what is needed to finally move on?

name: The Frog Prince
short_description: Go on an exciting adventure as the cursed prince - the frog prince. Break the evil spell and save your beloved from the slimy sorcerer.

name: Peril
short_description: An online multiplayer co-op escape room experience where you must use your wits, skills, and speed to escape your peril. Escape rooms include Halloween dungeon, saving Christmas, robbing a bank, escaping a zombie horde, and destroying a dungeon demon. Grab your friends and join the fun!

name: Toasted!
short_description: Use your driving, jumping, and jousting skills to knock out rival breakfast foods in this wild local party game for up to 4. Grab one of six characters and get ready to get Toasted!

name: Overseer
short_description: Overseer is a top-down roguelike game, heavily inspired by Dungeon Souls. Play with friends and enjoy the intense splashy combat together. The Overseer system allows you to take control of the dungeon, keep spawning monsters, place traps, and change the layout of the dungeon to spice things up.

name: HAINYA WORLD
short_description: You are an adventurer, you need to explore this continent, make good use of the resources of this continent to arm yourself, explore this world full of monsters and unknown things and survive!

name: Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?!
short_description: Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?! is a wacky action RPG where YOU'RE the hero! Cook, craft, and toss around epic weapons, barrels of poison, and more as you fulfil your destiny!

name: NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain
short_description: NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain is a four-player co-op survival horror game based on "Yokai", supernatural beings from Japanese folklore. Trapped in a cursed domain, you and your companions must work together to endure the curse and find a way to escape, all the while hiding from the roaming yokai.

name: Blacksmith Bay
short_description: Start the smithing shop of your dreams in Blacksmith Bay. Craft weapons to seek fortune and glory in the sleepy town of Port Pleasant. Decorate your shop to attract customers, complete commissions, and unravel the secrets of the Corbots!

name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 2
short_description: Hentai puzzle, micro visual novel, with a sprinkle of RPG. Flirt with all the Neko girls!

name: Software Engineering Course / Informatyka - zrozum i zaprogramuj komputer
short_description: The program was created on the basis of an engineering study program. No prior knowledge of any IT issues is required - we start with simple tasks and step by step learn the basics of computer programming.

name: Ova Magica
short_description: Stardew Valley meets Pokémon! Experience a content-rich JRPG game inspired by the classics! Raise cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

name: Rockytown
short_description: What happened to the people of Rockytown? Have fun at the village fair, with 4 exciting mini-games.

name: Project Thebe
short_description: Project Thebe is a top-down online sci-fi game with mostly arcade style controls, blazing fast battles and unrestricted PvP.

name: O.R.B. Offensive Rolling Bot
short_description: Lead O.R.B. to save our world from total annihilation in this thrilling 2D-platformer. O.R.B. is a robot sent from the future to destroy an evil A.I. DiOS before it can fulfill its evil plan. O.R.B. has some special skills, and transforming into a ball is just one of the tricks up in its sleeves!

name: Isolation Story
short_description: VIRUS-19 has ravaged the world! Take control of a mindless citizen and live through a 7-day quarantine inside of Lockdown City.

name: Somber Echoes
short_description: Armed with God-given powers, the revived tribune Adrestia is given a second chance to save the universe from her maniacal twin sister. Find secrets, acquire upgrades, and dominate mighty foes through sheer combat prowess as you explore and conquer the horrors of the forsaken vessel Atromitos.

name: Midnight Castle Succubus DX
short_description: A succubus issues threats against humanity once every 100 years. While men die and young women disappear one by one, a succubus hunter visits a cursed city under the moonlight. Let's rescue abducted girls and defeat the succubus!

name: Victory At Sea Ironclad
short_description: Victory at Sea Ironclad is the exciting game of naval RTS combat set during the American Civil War. Bringing an epic approach to real time strategy war gaming, search and destroy enemy fleets across an open world sandbox in a desperate attempt to change the course of history.

name: Sausage Dog Tends To Infinity
short_description: Sausage Dog Tends To Infinity is a classic Sokoban-like 3D puzzle game in which you must stretch yourself to infinity to solve puzzles and uncover ancient wisdom. Learn and grow as you explore a deserted world and discover the answers to questions you have yet to ask.

name: Mighty Goose
short_description: Mighty Goose is a fast paced run & gun shooter starring a bounty hunter Goose. Use epic weapons and devastating war machines to battle against screen filling bosses and hordes of enemies!

name: Friendship with Benefits
short_description: Friendship with Benefits is a unique eroge game that combines free-roaming elements, visual novel, dating simulator and role-playing mechanics. With a cast of over 20+ romanceable characters, where will you begin in this new and wonderful world?

name: Understand
short_description: Understand is an experimental puzzle game about guessing rules. In each level, you have to figure out the rules through trial and error, then draw a line satisfying all rules.

name: My Countless Worlds ~Enchanted Cape~
short_description: "My Countless Worlds" is a kinetic visual novel about the young goofs from a drama club, who need to get ready for a talent contest while also trying to find a person who planted a death prophecy for one of the club's members.

name: Touhou : Shooting Star | 東方流星譚
short_description: As a wizard "Marisa Kirisame", Fly in the Gensokyo! This is fun game of "Touhou Project"! See beautiful danmaku of touhou characters. Develop your weapon, armor, spell card to get strong. Let's play "Danmaku"!

name: Extortion
short_description: You're a computer engineer with a terrible secret. Someone is blackmailing you and now, you have to hack some servers and get secret files for him. Would you succeed in achieving their missions or would you find them and revenge?

name: Wanderstop
short_description: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

name: The Fabled Woods
short_description: Welcome to The Fabled Woods, a dark and mysterious narrative short story. Despite the picturesque beauty, ugly and terrible secrets lurk among the shifting boughs, darkness that no amount of dappled sunlight can erase. Take the first step, and experience an unforgettable journey.

name: Vampire: The Masquerade – Swansong
short_description: Play as 3 vampires, wield their powers wisely, and strike the right balance between your human and animal side in a heart-pounding story in which your choices will decide the fate of Boston.

name: The Fallen
short_description: The better free-to-play fantasy MMORPG! Fight, craft, and explore your way. Combine unique abilities and weapons to create your own style of play and become what you were always meant to be!

name: The Zone: Stalker Stories
short_description: Tactical card battles and narrative RPG exploration in a world of monsters and anomalies. As one of the last remnants of humanity, trapped in the Zone, it's your turn to become a Stalker and walk where others fear to tread.

name: Agent-00
short_description: Agent-00 is a Game of puzzles and secrecy in isometric view in which the player will have to infiltrate and uncover a secret project during the Cold War.

name: Tinseltown Tycoon
short_description: Tinseltown Tycoon is a management and simulation game that puts you at the head of an obscure film production studio. With control over all aspects of studio operations and the movie production pipeline you can lead your studio to industry domination, financial ruin, or anything in between.

name: Fabled Lands
short_description: Fabled Lands is a challenging old-school narrative RPG set in an open world. Complete quests, fight, trade goods and develop your character. Explore a vast land of adventure: travel across the war-torn kingdom, survive the plains of howling darkness, and escape the Court of Hidden Faces.

name: Chemistry My Love
short_description: Chemistry My Love is the ultimate gamified educational tool for high school and college level chemistry. Balance chemical reaction coefficients, masses and concentrations, with step-by-step explanations. Level up your knowledge playing chemical games and solving computer-generated quizzes.

name: WiP
short_description: 無機質で大きな腕を持つ主人公を操り、最奥に待つボスのもとへと向かう2Dアクションゲーム！目指せハイスコア！

name: NicoNotes The Whoo!
short_description: Help the magical musical NicoNotes fly back into their nests!

name: Gori: Cuddly Carnage
short_description: Humanity has been destroyed - and it's up to Gori, along with his deadly but wise-cracking sentient hoverboard, F.R.A.N.K, and morose AI companion, CH1-P, to shred and slay the evil Adorable Army!

name: Return of the Phantom
short_description: The legendary Phantom of the Opera has returned! As Inspector Raoul Montand, you are the only one who can pursue the Red Death into the past and prevent him from terrorizing the present in this point and click mystery.

name: Les Manley in: Search for the King
short_description: He finds his clothes at K-Mart. He finds his dates at Radio Shack. And now he's out to get rich quick by finding the greatest entertainer of all time. Follow mild mannered Les Manley as he rocks 'n' rolls across America in search of big bucks, beautiful babes and...The King.

name: Les Manley in: Lost in L.A.
short_description: Someone is kidnapping the hippest stars in Hollywood. Les Manley must scour La La Land – sifting through out-of-work actors, rock stars and gorgeous babes – to unravel the mystery in this point and click adventure.

name: Wizodd
short_description: Wizodd is a dungeon crawler roguelike game where you find various equipment and upgrades while encountering dangerous monsters and bosses to advance down to the lower floors.

name: VELVETIST: The City of Machine Guns
short_description: VELVETIST: The City of Machine Guns is a 3rd person open world action-adventure game. The story of the main character Luka Vollek takes place in an old, socialist occupied city. The game is divided into consecutive linear missions that tell the story of the main protagonist.

name: Be Hero
short_description: Be Hero is a farming/crafting RPG about an aspiring hero who arrived late to the final battle and needs to work in a tavern to be able to return home.

name: Roses Of Love
short_description: Roses Of Love is a visual novel of the “girl love” genre, short, emotional and mysterious. Accompany Yukiko in her new life at Aoi Academy... where emotions blossom, and reality begins to blur.

name: Kovox Pitch
short_description: Doomer Rhythm Baseball

name: Not Their Will
short_description: Not Their Will is a 3D Top-down shooter in which you are an alien that uses the weapons of the enemies against them.

name: The Legend of Zuri
short_description: The Legend of Zuri is a "pick a path" style raunchy adventure with over 180 CG images. Will the Princess Zuri remain unsullied or will she experience something unmentionable? That depends on which paths you choose!

name: Endlight
short_description: Break through and outlast shifting, twisting, chaos and whatnot. Dodging is for cowards - start smashing.

name: Deep Abyss
short_description: Become a diver yourself to explore the unknown. Take a trip to your deep abyss. Experience a poetic and fantastic world as you explore the deep sea and space.

name: Zombie Slayer
short_description: A round-based zombie survival game. Purchase weapons, power-ups, and other items to survive.

name: Vilset
short_description: Vilset is a strategic simulator based on the principle of survival of people, who turned out to be beyond the limits of their civilization.

name: Unwalkable
short_description: Unwalkable is a silly physics based open-ended puzzle platformer where you control a wobbly character. Without just one way to solve puzzles, you must use your imagination and ingenuity to create solutions to unthinkable problems.

name: Ricochet Bounce
short_description: Challenging puzzle game with hand crafted levels. Easy to learn but hard to complete!

name: CursorFX
short_description: Create stunning animated Windows mouse cursors for your PC with CursorFX! Easily apply skins, shadows, motion trails, and sounds, customize your own, or choose from one of several unique cursors already installed.

name: Whateverland: Prologue

short_description: An audio-based black comedy action arcade game - Blind Drive is a video game you can play with your eyes closed! 1st person hyper-realistic audio adventure meets fast paced arcade gameplay, driven by an insane B-movie plot.

short_description: The biggest corporations are not Apple or Amazon. The biggest "corporations" are the states. Your employees are all citizens of the country. You don't pay them a salary - they will pay you themselves. You manage taxes and collect them.

name: Rodent and Plank: Secret Origin
short_description: Rodent and Plank is a run 'n gun action platformer that borrows heavily from genre classics such as Gunstar Heroes, Earthworm Jim, and Metal Slug. It's tough as nails and the constantly shifting gameplay styles ensures that there's a surprise around every corner.

short_description: It's 1347, the time of the Hundred Years' War. In this historical grand strategy and RTS hybrid you play as one of 200 minor lords across medieval Europe, Africa or Middle East. Rise up to take over your Kingdom and be crowned, then fight to preserve your empire as Black Death descends on Europe.

name: Black Noir

name: Fluvstruck

In this action RPG, get out there and hunt for all the different minerals you need and destroy any predators that get in your way. You are a Miner Badass.

Players can build battle teams with unique heroes, flexible equipment, soul gems and powerful pets; the unique resident system provides players with great freedom for town management, whether it is forging equipment, capturing pets, refining soul...

name: CoronaWhomp!

The new Champion Edition offers modding and Steam Workshop support. Are you ready to start the race of your life? The roads are waiting for you!

short_description: Discover EreaDrone, the most polyvalent drone racing simulator ever made. Race now against other pilots, freestyle in huge environments, compare yourself to others with challenges, and create amazing tracks and maps!

name: Forking Hell
short_description: Prepare for a chaotic forklift driving experience in Forking Hell, a casual arcade-simulation PC video-game! Get started in your new job as a forklift driver in the Amazing virtual warehouse and complete customer orders over the working days. Drive solo or join up with friends online!

name: Dear Devere

name: Astrodogs

name: Biscuitts

name: Pyro Fighters

name: Rogue Planet
short_description: Rogue Planet is about speed, precision, and smooth motion. Use your momentum paired with the force of gravity to propel yourself from star to star, draining their power and fueling your ship as you go.

name: No Umbrellas Allowed

name: Bishoujo Battle Hanafuda Koi-Koi

And they want to play Koi-Koi, the most famous Japanese flower card game with you. Battle the girls in a tour around Japan. Or hop on multiplayer and compete against Koi-Koi masters around the world.

name: Bishoujo Battle Mahjong Solitaire
short_description: The Bishoujo girls from "Rick G Earth" mobile military turn-based strategy game from Japan are here! And they want to go head to head in a battle of Mahjong Solitaire. Delete all tiles before time runs out to clear rounds. Every 3rd round girls will change costumes and more will be revealed.

name: Qube Qross

name: Beyond Mankind: The Awakening

name: Cross Princess
short_description: Single route visual novel. Belle is actually a boy, an accident lets him and a bright girl named Bambi begin to live together, a warm and healing friendship + love story.

name: Knight's Destiny
short_description: Knight's Destiny is a puzzle game where you need to find a way to escape, and solve a mystery about disappearing of your best friend by solving puzzles and escaping the unknown.

name: Escape Room - Der kranke Kollege
short_description: You only wanted to make a visit to your sick colleague, but what you encounter is beyond your imagination. Discover the secrets of your colleague and find a way to escape the trap.

name: Raid on the Zone
short_description: Fight in a furious battle against “The Zone”, a mysterious terrorist group hell-bent on destroying the world. Cripple their defenses with your dual-prop helicopter and massive arsenal of weaponry in this retro-inspired homage to arcade games of the 80’s.

name: Machizzle
short_description: Physics bending VR puzzle game - get your ball to the goal, by obeying the laws of physics. Or bending them to your will.

short_description: Birds high up in the sky, waves rolling in on the shore, the wind blowing through palm trees and plants that grow on your private secluded island all contribute both visually and in sound to a surreal experience that practically makes you feel the ocean breeze.

short_description: Drive a spaceship where each player has an unique role. Play Solo or Coop with friends, up to 4. A perfect mix of space shoot em up and sci-fi action platformer. Fight in space or ground.

short_description: Aim and throw incongruous objects to create an organized mess by following the directives of a completely wacky "tidy up" system!

By challenging various levels and participating in competition, players can gradually discover the protagonist’s inner world, and enjoy the joy of growth and the fun of challenge.

name: Traffic Jams
short_description: In this wacky VR game, control traffic your way in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. Easy? Think again! Traffic Jams throws in monsters, (un)natural disasters, and up to 4 non-VR friends in party mode!

short_description: Time Loader is a story-driven puzzle-platformer with tiny robots, alternate realities, nostalgic music, and primitive tech from the 90s!

short_description: In Hentai Collection: Memory you play memory puzzles that grow in size as you get further into the game. After every puzzle you unlock pictures of sexy girls that get more lewd as you go along.

short_description: Use time travel and other tools to solve mind bending puzzles in VR. When you travel back you will find that you and every action you took is happening again. If you use the right tools you can control any paradoxes you create with smart planning.

name: Electro Ride Prologue

short_description: Up to 4 player gold digging competition. Dig gold as much as you can and protect it from others... or be the one who is gonna steal, its up to you.

Hire some experienced wizards to teach spell casting to the new, brim-hatted generation. Expand your knowledge and school in order to become world's best magical academy!

name: Racing Juke

short_description: "End of Panduora" is a fast-paced fantasy-style strategy management game. In a randomly generated corner of the abyss, by consuming sanity in exchange for strength that does not belong to you. In the endless sea, create a new paradise to welcome the remnants of the old gods.

name: The prisoner of the Night
short_description: THE PRISONER OF THE NIGHT is a single-player platforming game with a wide range of scenarios, where the lovely girl Nartide must survive terrible monsters and deadly traps in the darkest, scariest night of her life.

name: Dead Containment
short_description: Dead Containment is an on-rails shooter inspired by classic arcade games. Players fend off the undead as they race through a city under siege, blasting away the horrors that roam the streets using a variety of weapons. Playable solo or online co-op.

name: Labyrinthine
short_description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

name: F29 Retaliator

A ship transporting prisoners has crashed landed, fortunately you are the only survivor and have a chance of escape. Will you be able to break out?

name: Turbo Shot
short_description: Turbo Shot combines a puzzle-filled top-down adventure with exciting gun-based combat that plays out in regular seasons of free-to-play single player and PvP content.

name: Saiku's Endless Labyrinth
short_description: Follow Saiku's journey through the world as they battle monsters, encounter great bosses and traverse strange lands. With the help of PEROS, an operator from S.A.V.E. Corp., Saiku must seek out the meaning to their life and attempt to recover their memories...

name: Slurkum
short_description: Fantasy themed multiplayer, survival styled RPG. Build your character with unique stats, skills, karma, and reputation as you quest, explore, and conquer. Adventure awaits!

name: Fractured Atmosphere

You can do anything, go everywhere and become adventurer, rogue, to travel through the ruins of an ancient unknown world of about 1220 km. Do your best to write own history in this harsh realm and understand what happened here.

name: Tails of Trainspot

name: Assembly Planter
short_description: A farming / automation game, that allows you to progress from a poor hard-working farmer with just a few old tools to a lazy rich guy that watches his machines do the work for him while he tries to optimize production.

name: Tanky Panky
