short_description: MARDEK is a fantasy/sci-fi/retro Flash RPG from 2007-2010, which blends parody with a deeper story. It offers solid turn-based RPG combat and dozens of hours of gameplay.

name: Proxy Air Force
short_description: Proxy Air Force is a 2D Arcade Shoot Them Up game based on the story of the world war which broke out between the US and CES countries in 2020.

name: Vincemus - Air Combat
short_description: Fly through the theaters of World War II with fighters planes from across the world. Intercept, Raid, Defend, Survive in theatres of World War II. Vincemus is an arcade semi-realistic air combat shooter, The game is avalable on WindowsOS and MacOS.

name: Ruggnar
short_description: Ruggnar is a platformer without enemies, but many traps are hidden in the darkness. Help Ruggnar explore gloomy places with his bag and a few candles as his sole equipment.

name: Doctor Simulator
short_description: If you have ever thought of becoming a doctor – here is your chance! Arm yourself in a stethoscope and do a ward round to keep up to date with your patients’ condition. They may complain and question your authority but remember – you’re the doctor!

name: Windfallers
short_description: Become a Windfaller. From heists, to deliveries and other more... sinister contracts, there's no job too big or small for your scrappy crew.

name: Escape Game Fort Boyard
short_description: Beat all the trials to escape the Fort with the treasure!

name: Dig Bombers
short_description: It's a real time multiplayer with fast-paced battles. Dig, blast and become the sole owner of a dungeon full of treasures. Everything needed to win is buried in the mine. Dig up weapons and get rid of your opponents.

name: MelDEV Power Boat Racing
short_description: Real ocean physics. Power Boat Racing at its edge for PC.

name: Small Ball
short_description: This is a casual game,control small ball arrive at the destination,include 4 mini games

name: Drift Racing Rally
short_description: Grip the wheel, pull the handbrake and drift like a maniac, Making donuts drifts like a champion.

name: Ungeon
short_description: Fight your way through a cursed dungeon filled to the brim with undead enemies in hopes of finding your lost father, or at least your way out. Ungeon is a randomly generated dungeon crawler with a large focus on combat and exploration.

name: Dirt Bike Motocross Stunts
short_description: Go ahead and live out your bike stunt racing dreams with Dirt Bike MotoCross Stunts.

name: Rocky Mayhem
short_description: Systems are down and require time to repair, leaving you with a basic gunship with no hopes of escaping an aggressive asteroid event. Will you be able to survive the increasingly difficult 8 minutes to repair the ship's functions and escape?

name: A Lot of Universes
short_description: Jump from world to world searching for an interdimensional fugitive. Collect items and use them to resolve tricky situations that threaten to delay your progress.

name: screamdown
short_description: Scream through your mic at opponents to send them flying into the void in this PvP horror game.

name: Whisker Squadron: Untitled Space Game
short_description: The second title in the Whisker Squadron universe takes the fight to the cosmos! A free roaming roguelike featuring tense battles in open space, sprawling Swarm factories, remote stations with quests and shops, moons infested with bosses, and a fantastically colorful vision of outer space.

name: CAMEO: CCTV Detective
short_description: Play as CCTV Detective Lopez as he solves crimes through the ever faithful lens of a security camera. The crime rate in the small City of ChurchView is rising, and it is up to Lopez to lower it.

name: Noise Hunters
short_description: Noise Hunters is an action stealth video game where noise is your tool, but also your enemy. Don't let them hear you, HUNT or be HUNTED.

name: LeftWay 2
short_description: Nampung encounters the nightmare again and this time also includes her relative people.

name: Pandemia
short_description: Choose who lives and who dies in a small peripheral hospital in a pandemic situation.

name: Radio Viscera
short_description: Radio Viscera is a fast-paced top down shooter without bullets. Hurl enemies into brutal traps and blast your way through walls with your air cannon, in this bloody, arcade action game.

name: runflexio
short_description: This is a narrative runner about the fate of a little jackal, who decided to leave his home and go to another place more pleasant for him. During his trip, the hero of the game reflects on the past, reflects on actions and emotions, as well as whether he made the right decision.

name: Dura Vita Online
short_description: Dura Vita Online is a multiplayer RPG in a medieval fantasy setting. You are an ordinary citizen living your life when The Occurrence happens. Now evil has started to spread across the land and you have no choice but to take up arms and destroy it!

name: Creep
short_description: Experimental dark platform game that takes place inside a struggled man's inner world represented as the worm world. You control the worm form of this man as he shows why this world exists and how it's like to live there. You also visit past memories/analogies and gain new abilities.

name: Rachael Savage
short_description: Play as a fearsome bounty hunter in this adventure game about hunting down an unbeatable threat! Turn invisible to sneak past enemies, slash with your sword, and use other unique items you find along the way to help acquire new bounties across the land.

name: Parabolus Two
short_description: Shoot your way across the galaxy in this thrilling adventure! It’s the sci-fi shooter which blends old school game mechanics with modern story driven cinematic experiences. Unlock the mystery of strange events all over the Milky Way and find out who (or what) is behind them.

name: Geometric Sniper
short_description: Immerse yourself in Andrew's story and feel the pressure of being a sniper. Find and eliminate the target in the crowd before he runs away.In living environments, designed exclusively for this fantastic game, you will not have a second chance, precision is everything!

name: WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES
short_description: Welcome to WORLD OF ART - Learn with JIGSAW PUZZLES! Explore over 1600+ artworks, solve puzzles, test your knowledge with quizzes, and enhance your mind while enjoying classical music. New paintings added for free regularly!

name: Alien Egg: Ascent
short_description: Jump your way into outer space to help a lost alien egg find its way back to its homeworld!

name: Charge Blade Hero
short_description: A fast paced 2D hack and slash, adventure game. Attack, Dodge, and Charge Up to maintain your weapon's durability as you take on waves of enemies.

name: Love n Dream
short_description: 《Love n Dream》 is a puzzle game with many kawaii girls. You will be transformed into multiple roles to approach all of our girls. Your job is to unlock their desired, characteristic, favorite, hate by using your skill to solve all the puzzles and understand more about them.

name: Knife Quest
short_description: Knife Quest is a platform videogame where the character will have to find 3 coins that will allow him to open a new portal to go to the next level.

name: Beware of the Blob
short_description: Eat people and craft limbs in this third-person puzzle exploration game. You'll need brains, arms, lungs, and more to escape from Black Hawk Industries HQ in one piece.

name: Aim Master H
short_description: Aim Master H is the first 2D Aim Game on Steam, designed to warmup and boost your aim quickly and easily.

name: Alchemic Beasts
short_description: Alchemic Beasts is a monster taming RPG adventure where you breed and transmute creatures using alchemy to forge powerful monsters. Join Zeig, a thrill seeking daredevil, as he harnesses his alchemic beasts to defeat the creature known as the legendary Demon King.

name: Polter Pals
short_description: Make ghost friends by steering the living into deadly hazards to release their souls. Puzzle through diorama-style levels and make as many friends as possible using comically fatal accidents. Keep up with the latest memes by getting popular on the afterlife's hottest social media app, LiveBurial.

name: Mischance
short_description: Mischance is a game about surviving as long as possible with a curse that guarantees an imminent death. Everything in your day-to-day life is now much more likely to kill you. Your objective is to make smart choices and hope that the most simplest of activities don't end up taking your life.

name: SkunkHunter 101
short_description: 2020 port of the 2009 title. Grow and sell weed.

name: Faraway Lands: Rise of Yokai
short_description: Faraway Lands: Rise of Yokai is an immersive base-building survival strategy game set in mystical Feudal Japan. Build and fortify your town, gather resources, explore new lands, trade with other cities and defend your town against the risen Yokai threat!

name: Toodee and Topdee
short_description: A cosmic turbulence caused the 2D Platformer and the Top-Down Puzzler dimensions to merge! Switch between Toodee and Topdee and their unique perspectives to overcome hard-as-nails challenges, solve mind-melting puzzles and defeat huge bosses.

name: Mini Motor Racing X
short_description: Welcome to the world of Mini Motor Racing X! Strap yourself in, or strap on your VR headset, and jump into a nitro fueled world where little cars mean BIG fun!

name: Training Lab
short_description: A laboratory simulator to do virtual experiments in a simulated laboratory for training

name: Extra Terrestrial Nation
short_description: In the year 2045 scientists discover a new planet that has extraterrestrial life on it, which they brought back to Earth to study. It wasn't long before they mutated and escaped into the city. The only safe place left is on the outskirts of town, can Nicole and Rocky make it safely out of town?

name: Cannibal Crossing
short_description: Cannibal Crossing is an action-survival game where you explore the randomly generated town of Earlsboro while scavenging, fighting hordes of enemies, building a base, and searching for a way to escape! Meet survivors with new abilities and lots of cannibals. Includes a co-op mode for 1-4 players!

name: The Adventures of Fatman: Intergalactic Indigestion
short_description: Emerge from the Fat-cave once more and help Fatman defeat the Intergalactic Indigestion! A cheap and cheerful continuation to The Adventures of Fatman series, by Mike Doak.

name: Color Game
short_description: Color Game is a puzzle game about getting to the end. Change your color, unlock the path to the exit and avoid enemies along the way.

name: ReRoad
short_description: ReRoad is a Tower Defense game with a brand new concept where the players dig their own paths. You need to consider the locations of the randomly placed towers of the stages as well as the towers you will build and strategically create a path. Stop the enemy through a path you have created!

name: Spellbearers
short_description: Spellbearers is a top-down, 2D, twin stick shooter inspired by "Super Smash TV". Battle against hordes of magical enemies to liberate the rulers of three kingdoms that have been overtaken by dark forces. With staff in hand, do you have what it takes to uphold the title of The Spellbearer?

name: Drifter King Online
short_description: Precision drift racing solo or against friends.

name: The End of Labyronia: Nerubis
short_description: Travel through time and the four seasons to avert the apocalypse in the last part of the popular Labyronia saga.

name: Elementallis
short_description: Top-down action adventure with elemental magic gameplay. Guilt pushes you on a journey to restore the elements in a pre-apocalyptic world. Use and combine your elemental powers to fight and solve puzzles across the temples.

name: Call of Corona: Micro Warfare
short_description: A dangerous mission to travel into the human body and meet the Corona virus face to face and send it back to microscopic hell.

name: Fantasy Mosaics 34: Zen Garden
short_description: The penguin family discovered a "Zen" way to play multi-color mosaic puzzles also known as picross,nonogram,griddlers hanjie!

name: Ace of Space
short_description: You and your spaceship versus thousands of aliens! Blast through waves of aliens with upgradable spaceships in this sci-fi shoot ’em up game and become the Ace of Space!

name: 重装无限·Metal Infinite
short_description: 或许在某个时空里他已经战败了 但是在这里或许可以改写一切，传说最强的赏金猎人！ 那段未完的故事 将如何开始又如何结束...

name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 4
short_description: Cross is Super Again! The official videogame of the Monster Energy AMA Supercross Championship is back with its fourth edition, the most extreme ever!

name: Urge
short_description: Fight, build, explore, survive, while the dynamic player-caused hazardous fog is slowly changing the rules of the world around you.

name: Dumb Roguelike-like RPG
short_description: Venture into a forbidden cursed city in the hopes of rescuing your sister!

name: Covid Tale: Ignorance
short_description: Discover the truths about COVID19... according to the internet. And the internet never lies, right? Play a witty story of how it all may or may not happened.

name: The End of Dyeus
short_description: Go in a quest for Dyeus in a primitive and cryptic open world ! Face mysterious assailants in intense and fast paced sword fights, and survive against a carnivorous fauna. Will you uncover the truth about Dyeus?

name: Super Cable Boy
short_description: Super Cable Boy is a retro inspired platformer, where you are playing a living handheld gaming system with a power cord. Collect game cartridges to become more powerful and take on your quest to defeat "the Glitch", an entity that 1▧01☠01௹1‱☣∰0␢⌀▧ ..

name: Viking Frontiers
short_description: Survival of your people - that's the only thing that matters. Become the leader of a newly founded Viking settlement and lead it to safety and glory. Gather, build, craft, hunt, raid and follow your Gods to endure hardships of nature and save your clan from violent destruction.

name: 降妖神兵
short_description: 《降妖神兵》是一款以刷装备刷宝为核心玩法的古装单机游戏，并辅以经营元素如种菜、挖矿等，敌人和宝箱可以无限重置，打败boss获得不同品质的装备，从一无所有到战力巅峰，成为村民敬仰的大侠！

name: Worlds Builder
short_description: WORLDS Builder is game about alchemy, controlling forces of nature, creating worlds, building, researching and trading! Create new lands, mountains and forests, build houses, farms and workshops, discover new technologies. Start with a small mining village and grow it into a rich city!

name: SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox
short_description: You are a leader of Foxtrot Unit 1 "Nine-Tailed Fox", a highly trained force tasked with re-containing a multitude of terrifying anomalous monsters that have broken loose inside of a top-secret research facility.

name: Phogbound
short_description: The story about hungry creatures, who are living in the Fog.

name: Sling-A-Thing
short_description: Sling-A-Thing is a comedy action puzzler, where you throw and transform into lots of different cartoon characters and objects to find your way to the exit in lots of creative ways - in over 150 levels! Transform into a bat, an anvil, a baseball, a bomb, an UFO, a rubber duck and many more!

name: Progressbar95
short_description: Progressbar95 is a unique indie game with a strong nostalgic vibe. It turns vintage GUI elements like panels, buttons and icons into game elements! Simple and addictive gameplay based on dozens of mini-games and puzzles. The game will make you smile!

name: Stolen Recovery
short_description: Locate lost cars, smash groups of criminals and explore thieves hideouts in a realistic simulator of a stolen vehicle hunter.

name: Big Tiddy Goth GF Simulator
short_description: Explore the college campus, and work your way up to telling the goth girl you have a crush on how you REALLY feel. Solve puzzles, buy food, and explore a eerily empty dorm.

name: Lab Rat
short_description: A metrics-obsessed AI will monitor, profile, and entertain you as you progress through over a hundred genre-bending puzzles in this delightfully satirical adventure.

name: The Insider – interactive movie
short_description: The Insider is an interactive film where a viewer’s choices decide how the story goes. It has five different endings and her fate depends entirely on your choice.

name: Related
short_description: Waking up from a nightmare, Jessica finds confirmation to her suspicions. To figure out her past, she goes to an orphanage, where she hopes to find answers to questions that she tried so hard to forget.

name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms: Demo (Prologue)
short_description: Embark on a perilous journey across a realm forsaken by the gods and devastated by an arcane cataclysm. Accompanied by a hardy crew, you must trade, fight, and explore your way to success as the leader of a traveling company in Vagrus, an award-winning turn-based post-apocalyptic fantasy RPG.

name: Voidigo
short_description: A vividly animated action roguelite focused on boss hunting. Unleash an array of diverse weapons and powerups to combat the corruption of the Void.

name: Push Your Family
short_description: Push Your Family is a physics-based party game with wacky family members and slapstick humor. Push each other in one of the interactive battlegrounds and be the last to survive or work together as only a family can!

name: The Magister
short_description: The Magister is a murder-mystery card-battler RPG. Build and customise your deck to fight in battles, or use ‘Tactical Diplomacy’ to pacify those who stand in your way. Gather clues and discover motives as you investigate the death of your predecessor and unmask the guilty culprit.

name: Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition
short_description: Nongunz is a roguelite action-platformer. Battle grotesque creatures, kill quickly to maintain your combo meter, and rescue worshipers to become part of your idle army to buy upgrades.

name: 罗马之链
short_description: This is a text adventure game, your identity is a general Cicero from the Roman Empire, through the choice of words, you will walk into several battles experienced by the three giants of Rome, see the glory and achievements of ancient Rome, and realize the true meaning of life and freedom.

name: FOREST OF THE DEAD
short_description: In FOREST OF THE DEAD you must survive huge waves of undead. You are stranded in the middle of the forest. No help, no hope. Your only chance is to defend yourself with the available weapons against the approaching find and stay alive as long as possible.

name: HANI
short_description: HANI is a Roguelike game that explores dungeons by combining various skills and artifacts.

name: Gravity Well
short_description: Save stranded astronaut, don't let him crash to the planet surface or suffocate in endless space! Fun and brain-teasing puzzle game will challenge you with lots of levels from easy to super tricky problems for you to solve.

name: Motel Murder
short_description: Your sister calls you for help. You go to the Motel where she's staying at only to find horror, Mannequins have come to life and are killing! Using the knife you find, you search for answers to find your sister before it's too late. Welcome to Motel Murder.

name: My Hidden Things
short_description: In the beginning there was nothing, only a chaos of dreams, out of which came Xary. He tried to understand people's nature and help them. Yet he is too young. And here you are. Together, you need to figure this all out…

name: The Outlast Trials
short_description: Red Barrels invites you to experience mind-numbing terror, this time with friends. Whether you go through the trials alone or in teams, if you survive long enough and complete the therapy, Murkoff will happily let you leave… but will you be the same?

name: Lightless
short_description: Lightless: The 21st Sacrifice is the first episode of an atmospheric horror game series set in 2018 Iran, Saqqez that tells the story of Navid, a writer who finally comes home, only to find himself strangled by a dark past that will not let go.

name: Virus Blast
short_description: What if you could use yourself as a bullet? Virus Blast is Fast paced Shooter where YOU are the bullet, try to steal as much data as you can while climbing an endless procedural generated matrix! All of this while the firewall is stepping on your toes trying to stop you!

name: GearBlocks
short_description: Explore a world of creative building, interactive machines, and gears - lots of gears. Build all things mechanical: cars, trucks, cranes, tanks, gearboxes, engines, clocks, anything you can think of. Test your creations to destruction in challenging scenarios, and share them in the workshop!

name: UniDuni
short_description: Inspired by the classics, UniDuni is a lighthearted puzzle platformer adventure which celebrates the bonds of friendship. Invite a friend to work together across hand-crafted levels or challenge yourself and prove your skills!

name: Game Director Story
short_description: Game Director Story is an unflinching and satirical look behind-the-scenes at how big-budget AAA games are made. Based on first-hand accounts by industry veterans, Players experience the emotional roller coaster of guiding a team through the agonizing decisions and compromises needed to ship a game.

name: Aria: Dragon Eater
short_description: "Aria: Dragon Eater" is a fantasy action top-down shooter game set in a magical era. Begin your journey to unravel the mystery surrounding the death of the dragon!

name: Zomcade
short_description: Zomcade is a challenging action-horror arcade style game for Steam VR. Immerse yourself in over 15 different ways to play.

name: Grand Theft Rome
short_description: Lead roman, greek, chinese, egyptian, or knights into battle against other factions. Win by giving specific commands like box, circle lined formations and fighting alongside your troops in this ancient battle simulator.

name: SteamDolls - Order Of Chaos
short_description: Enter the world of Steamdolls in this narrative-driven stealth-meets-action adventure. Step into the blood-drenched shoes of The Whisper, played by David Hayter, and entrench yourself in the shadows of a labyrinthine city gone mad. You will know 4 words: ACTION, EXPLORATION, STEALTH, AND BLOOD.

name: My Train World
short_description: Take playing with toy trains into the virtual world with ‘My Train World’! Master a variety of puzzles at different difficulty levels in Puzzle Mode. Let your imagination flow in the Sandbox Mode and build the train-set of your dreams. (Note: Saving layouts is disabled in demo)

name: RavenHeart Hospital: A Medical Visual Novel
short_description: RavenHeart Hospital: A Medical Visual Novel is a surgery simulation visual novel. Take on the role of an ace surgeon in training at the world's greatest hospital. Operate on patients with a variety of conditions. Befriend and romance a colorful cast of doctors. Save lives and melt hearts.

name: Love Love School Days
short_description: The protagonist is trapped in the world of a love game. Can you return to the real world again...? Try to escape while running away from the gal game heroine A love simulation-style survival horror game!

name: Drox Operative 2
short_description: Drox Operative 2 is a starship action RPG with warring alien races, fierce space battles, a dynamic, evolving galaxy, and co-op multiplayer for Windows and Linux.

name: Belongings
short_description: Belongings is a Point & Click adventure game. Dispose of the belongings of Jennifers late spouse Marion. Jennifer must contend with her own memories, and have to face hard truths she might not want to know. Do you wish to step into the bitter future, or stay in the sweet past?

name: C-4
short_description: Waiting for a match? C-4. Improve your gaming skills while you wait. Mini-games used by professional players to improve the brain response. Your spare time will never be the same with C-4! Runs on top of anything. Explode your PC.

name: Pandemia: Virus Outbreak
short_description: 2 in 1, Swipe cards to face the deadly virus threat in this story driven strategy game. Step into the world in which you will face the decisions that world leaders make in the event of a deadly virus threat. Every decision have consequences. Create Vaccine in special Arcade mode.

name: VR Fitness Gym (Cycling, Marathon, Football, etc)
short_description: VR Immersive Fitness Gym: 6 New VR Exercises You Never Experienced.Bored with exercise? Virtual reality, immersive fitness might help you.1) VR Football Battle; 2) VR Immersive Cycling; 3) VR Immersive Running & Marathon; 4) VR Apple Games; 5) VR Immersive Shooting; 6) VR Yoga (Coming)

name: Gel-Tank
short_description: Casual but profound! Simple, authentic 16-bit 2D style that will satisfy everyone from beginners to experts The action shooter is here! Dive into the soft and hard world of the ultimate 16-bit world, down to the resolution! Ugh!

name: Agrou
short_description: Your new favorite Werewolf game! Seat around the fire with friends, play a villager, a werewolf or another type of character and use strategy to win!

name: Crystal Valley
short_description: In Crystal Valley they explore alien landscapes mine raw materials and build new tools and fight against a large number of enemies.

name: Death Tales
short_description: Play as a new reaper, completing quests, collecting spells, and gathering equipment to fight through hordes of enemies in this grim but whimsical 2D adventure!

name: 16bit vs Reality
short_description: Retro-style platformer inspired by the 16bit classics. Jump and shoot your way through challenging levels. Watch two distinct visual styles collide. Enjoy the awesome rocking music. In the name of all that is childhood!

name: TOWER
short_description: The Tower continues to stifle the darkness at the world end. Waiting for the rapture time that has erased all the darkness. Collect pastel colored cubes, Defeat enemies more faster and more accurately, And protect your TOWER.

name: Up until the end - Otome/Visual Novel
short_description: This was supposed to be an ordinary day, in an ordinary life. But it isn't. You were in the town library, reading a good book when…You don't really remember. You know you passed out. When you wake up, you are surrounded by flames !

name: Captain Disaster in: The Dark Side of the Moon
short_description: A comedy scif-fi point & click adventure game with several odd characters (all voiced by the same person) and multiple strange inventory objects to try out! References to classic sci-fi and point & clicks abound.

name: Piroku
short_description: The demo contains 3 levels and basic combat mechanics, and also allows you to evaluate the visual style of the game and animation. The game is in the early stages of development and the final version may differ significantly from the demo

name: Rusty Gun
short_description: Nothing could ruin a sunny day, but the universe had its own plans. The invasion of Earth by hordes of mutants and robots, capturing the mind of living creatures, could not leave aside our hero.

name: BRAVE PINBALL
short_description: The world has been changed into pinball by the Demon King? A unique RPG-style pinball game has appeared!

name: Wibbly Witches
short_description: Wibbly Witches is a fast and frantic couch competition for 2-4 players. Navigate evolving arenas and use magic spells to outsmart your opponents in a wyrd and wobbly battle to the death! Only one witch can claim the tiny crown...

name: Cosmodome
short_description: Cosmodome: a wrestling inspired, intergalactic, arena-based, ship combat game where the audience decides who wins or loses. Fight with 4 different characters each wielding their own unique ships and weapons.

name: Beyond Hope
short_description: Beyond Hope gives you and your friends one epic space journey! Your mission alone or with friends is to save yourself from getting pulled into the hot Sun. Gather debris, scavenge asteroids and build your own space station. Reach for the stars and survive when all odds are against you!

name: Remedy
short_description: Remedy is a first person puzzle adventure game where the player awakens in a world of darkness. Solve puzzles to unlock new abilities, areas of the map and guide the orb back to paradise. Use the power of dissolve to transform the plagued world of darkness back to beauty.

name: アルティメットダンジョン「紅」
short_description: Form a party with your favorite Touhou characters and challenge the dungeon! Characters from "紅魔郷" to "輝針城" are lined up! Are there anyone who will walk through the ultimate dungeon of all 51 areas !?

name: Delores: A Thimbleweed Park Mini-Adventure
short_description: Delores is back home and working as a photographer for the Nickel News. Thimbleweed Park hasn’t changed at all in the year she’s been away… or has it? Sample Ron Gilbert’s new adventure game engine in this free prototype that uses “found art” from the award-winning Thimbleweed Park.

name: Way To Yaatra
short_description: Get aboard on a thrilling voyage in search of the truth after the desolation of your village, using spears to climb a huge mountain while you walk the way to Yaatra.

name: Succubus Throne
short_description: Exciting magic duels in the form of an addictive puzzle game. Have fun stripping lovely succubus!

name: Battle Barn: Tactics
short_description: A roguelite tactics game about liberating cute mother fluffers from a farm animal fight club...IN SPACE! Capture enemies to fight for you, upgrade and genetically alter critters for combat, and take out an evil space clown overlord while you're at it!

name: Lunar Axe
short_description: After a big earthquake in the city, ruins of an old building collapse and you end up trapped inside an abandoned house. Find a way out and unravel the mystery of inexplicable tremors, revealing ancient secrets and a mystical artifact, before the city is destroyed.

name: Apparitions: Kotsmine Hills
short_description: Team up with the Peter Wren Agency to find hidden clues and investigate paranormal activity in the town of Kotsmine Hills.

name: GunGuru
short_description: A game made by a real world US Marine Veteran Machine-gunner. Explore the ever evolving jungle of GunGuru, an ancient procedurally generated environment, full of magic and mystery. Unlock the secret of the Runes and find out what is hidden beneath.

name: Ambush: Convoy Strike
short_description: Deploy unique and powerful unmanned military turrets and stop the advancing enemy convoys!

name: 武林桃源乡 The Arcadia Of Wulin
short_description: 《武林桃源乡》是一款轻松休闲的建造经营主题的个人独立游戏。在游戏中您将从一无所有开始打造一座美丽繁华的世外桃源。精心规划每一座建筑，使建筑产生天地灵犀，让生活在这里的居民领悟绝世武功。这里有世外的高人，这里有归隐的侠客，正所谓良辰美景真乃人间仙境，赏心乐事恍如化外洞天。

name: 不二臣The Only  Master
short_description: “你应该吝啬你每一次说‘爱’这个字的机会。而不是对着我这种老男人练习。” 现代恋爱耽美游戏——《不二臣》，以王寅视角代入，触发狗血盖顶事情真相 ，又或是遍地暴雷的恩怨情仇...

name: elphame
