name: Infinity Imperium
short_description: Choose your civ, expand your empire, fight for the supremacy, travel through time to change the course of history, discover what’s happened to the Infinitians before the end in this new space RTS!

name: Last Gang Standing
short_description: Gather up a gang of your friends, build a base, add a factory, add some turrets, add teleporters, doors, foxholes and decorations. Arm yourselves to the teeth and go forth to raze, loot and t-bag all who stand against you. Be the Last Gang Standing

name: MODERN NAVAL COMBAT
short_description: This game is a simulation real-time strategy game with the theme of modern naval warfare. Players can control all kinds of active naval equipment of the three camps, and use the common tactics and tactics of the navy in reality to start a fierce confrontation with the computer.

name: Remains
short_description: Remains - survival in outer space orbiting the planet. Explore the area. Find a way to restore oxygen. Create tools for your needs. Beware of the dangers of outer space. Build your shelter in orbit and try not to die!

name: Into the TIMEVERSE
short_description: Into the TIMEVERSE is a hard non forgiving action platformer game. Into the TIMEVERSE is a constant"runner" game that you need to match your color to the appropriate color of the enemy platforms. Expect to die a lot in this game.

name: Family Mysteries 3: Criminal Mindset
short_description: Take on a role of a famous scientist drawn into a dangerous game, where the goal is to save the mankind and uncover family secret. Get ready for a pulse-pounding adventure in the world of experiments, mysteries and espionage!

name: Decently Bad Tower Defense
short_description: This is a bad short Tower Defense game made from scratch as a new game developer. This game does all the basic things you expect from a tower defense. We have 3 types of enemies and 3 types of tower to destroy them with. Strategic placement of the towers will make your victory certain.

name: logiCally
short_description: Test your skills in this challenging game of logic, observation and mental calculation. Solve problems of increasing difficulty and exceed your limits. How far can you get?

name: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 10
short_description: Enjoy a beautiful collection of Hidden Object Scenes and puzzles set in the great outdoors. Tidy up the Park and do your bit for the environment by collecting all the bonus trash items to Recycle. Earn extra bonuses for finding all the Lost & Found items scattered around the Park

name: Lorera
short_description: Hook your way through the colorful world of Lorera and solve its biggest mystery. From a little flower to a vicious warrior, Lorera is all about growth and persevering your way through obstacles.

name: Children of the Sun
short_description: On a deadly road trip into darkness, control the path of a single bullet and unleash a fury of vengeance on the sinister cult that ruined your life in this tactical puzzle-shooter.

name: Space Probes
short_description: Space Probes is a Shoot Em Up (SHMUP) inspired by productions from the 90s released on SNES, MEGADRIVE, NEO-GEO, PC-ENGINE etc.

name: Creature Lab
short_description: Become a mad scientist! Conduct crazy experiments, mix mutagens, breed abominable creatures, and attach monstrous body parts to them. Manage your inventory, expand your lab, and make sure your hideout is safe. Send your creations into the city to obtain salvage and test subjects!

name: Video Editor Tycoon
short_description: based on tycoon games, this one provides a way for you to manage a video publishing company, where your mission is to maintain a financial balance in the face of monthly payments and also a professional balance for employees who are not fired

name: Finding Fido: The Journey
short_description: Join the quest to find your dog! Featuring fun environments to explore, strange characters, and riddle to solve.

name: Elliot
short_description: Elliot is a colourful 2D platformer inspired by 16-bit classics, with a touch of hardcore. Don't be misled by appearances: it's a colorful game, but really it's technicolor hell!

name: Uranus
short_description: Uranus is a short visual novel for adults only.

name: OMICRON: Coronavirus Battlegrounds
short_description: The first coronavirus online game. Run away from sources of infection to win, or infect healthy people to prevent them from breaking ahead!

name: Cyber Seraph
short_description: The alien invaders have launched their final offensive on an already crippled Terra. Only one brave pilot can turn the tide of war. Cyber Seraph is a boss focused vertical shoot 'em up with unlockable abilities.

name: Chromalition
short_description: Chromalition is a third-person skating platformer where you play as a graffiti artist who can become graffiti and bring graffiti to life. Find and complete graffiti murals around the city, unlock new abilities, and take down Company Corp!

name: Goodbye Volcano High
short_description: Goodbye Volcano High is a cinematic narrative adventure about love, change, and the end of the world. Guide Fang through their final year of high school as they try to make things right before time is up.

name: Loco Road
short_description: Have you ever dreamt of participating in a deathrace where everbody blows up??! Me neither! But thanks to the sick minds of our Game Design students now you can do it! In this frenetic game you have to avoid beeing last in each lap or you will die and look bad doing it!

name: Mine Trap Reborn
short_description: An arcade-style PvE platformer, with 130 differing levels. Dig, trap, and fill blobs to drop them to their doom, and to take you onward to victory!

name: Alone in the Dark
short_description: Return to Derceto Manor in this reimagination of Alone in the Dark, a love letter to the 90’s cult classic horror game.

name: Tankfight
short_description: Put down all the enemy tanks coming towards you! Collect points. A tank game that won't tire you on quarantine days.

name: Jumperbird
short_description: The boxes you do not crash will earn you points. Each score you earn will prove how good your reflexes are. You have to go through the space between the boxes.

name: Haymaker
short_description: Haymaker is an 80s boxing game that takes place in the blue-collar rustbelt town of Kint. You play as Jackie Elliot, a 21-year-old who's impressionable life is swaying between corruption and commitment; the path to becoming a great boxer, or the path of crime. Your choice, your story.

name: Handy Harry's Haunted House Services
short_description: Team up with up to 8 friends online to explore the haunted, randomly generated depths of these dusty attics. Find and repair the objectives, flip the master switch and escape before the ghastly ghoul that lurks in the darkness catches up to you. Play through the career mode or explore free play!

name: Tank Battle
short_description: Drive a tank, destroy enemy, defend your homeland. Act alone or co-op with a friend and have fun!

name: The Sight in a mirror
short_description: 'The Sight in a mirror' is a game that collects items and escapes from the monster's house. Find the location of the monster with a mirror at home and find a way to escape!

name: Hedera
short_description: HEDERA is a story-driven 2D horror game about dealing with trauma through dreams and videogames.

name: disc party
short_description: Disc Party is an online multiplayer disc golf arcade game. Compete with your friends on windy, procedurally generated islands and find out who's the best disc golfer!

name: MORTARMEN
short_description: MORTARMEN is a strategic multiplayer PvP first and third person shooter, pitting the New American Coalition versus United Communist Front in a battle for control of Arakousa, a Mediterranean paradise, where soldiers traverse via sliding, rolling, climbing, and HALO drops.

name: Valiantia
short_description: Valiantia is a role-playing game. Solve the puzzles. Altis, a female knight, and you, Leonale as her confidant, were ordered to do missions. You can help her ease the problems, making the decision, or make them more complicated. Her fate depends on you.

name: The Adventures of Eggbert
short_description: Help Eggbert grab eggs, dodge foxes, and hatch chicks in this retro arcade challenge!

name: 动绘（Drawing）
short_description: Drawing is a brand new video puzzle game, where you can experience the excitement and happiness brought by artworks.

name: Image To Normal Map
short_description: A convenient tool for game design, which can convert 2D plate into normal map of picture, and display tool of WYSIWYG

name: Sexual Void
short_description: Nothing in here, except Vicky, sexy outfits and a JOI game

name: DRazor
short_description: Defend the energy planet from the orbs. An easy to play but difficult to master casual game.

name: RussianPunk 2007
short_description: The factory worker, like everyone else, thought that 2007 would never return. However, on his way home, he stumbled upon some magical mushrooms.

name: Bishojo Mangekyo Kotowari to Meikyu no Shojo
short_description: 玩家将和故事中性格各异的角色一起，解开神秘超自然事件的真相。并逐步了解贯穿整部游戏的核心——万华镜，及其持有者莲华的秘密。

name: Greak: Memories of Azur
short_description: Greak: Memories of Azur is a single-player puzzle platformer adventure. Azur is under threat from an enemy attack who have control of strange creatures infecting the land. Take on the role of three siblings: Greak, Adara and Raydel and utilize their unique abilities to escape the invasion together.

name: Dark Existence
short_description: Dark Existence is an upcoming multiplayer atmospheric horror game. You will be able to walk the halls of horror alongside your friends and share the horrifying experience together.

name: Slime Climb
short_description: A terrible storm has compromised the alchemist's tower. This is your chance! Jump, glide, and bounce your way through 20+ stages to get out at the top! The other slimes got stuck though, so don't leave them behind!

name: Long Car Journey - A road trip game
short_description: Traverse the never-ending desert searching for provisions. Look for fuel, fix the engine, pay attention to the battery, change the turbo charger! Explore abandoned buildings, sell the objects you find, check the condition of your car. Collect provisions and hide them at home!

name: Apollon 88
short_description: Apollon 88 is a 2D Top-Down, survival, shooter game. You play as 88, where your goals are to survive by destroying the one who hunts you.

name: Hentai Monster Quiz
short_description: This is a quiz game in which you can meet the beautiful 10 ladies.

name: Virus Madness - Dungeons of your Body
short_description: Fight your way through vicious viruses, bacterias to save all humanity in this cute shooter game. Advance through dungeons of your body and destroy them all

name: Johann Weiss
short_description: Caught off guard, Johann Weiss had his sister kidnapped by the LaVey Order, a satanic cult led by Behemoth LaVey who's going to sacrifice her to Satan to summon Hell on Earth. In this take on Metroidvania and early Duke Nukem games, you must help Johann save his sister Joanna from LaVey.

name: Heretic's Lot
short_description: What will you get out of mixing puzzle, RPG and roguelike? Correct - HERETIC’S LOT! Make your way through cursed lands to repent your sins. Learn perks, collect battle spells, solve puzzles, discover magic auras, fight bosses, find what cursed lands are hiding.

name: Don't Be Afraid - The First Toy
short_description: Don't Be Afraid - The First Toy, is an introduction to the dramatic story of a boy kidnapped by a psychopath. Exploring the giant house of your torturer you will soon discover things worse than your childish nightmares. Take on the role of Jamie and see what phrase “The First Toy” actually means.

name: HIVE
short_description: Take on the role of a man forced to take down the Hive-mind that has taken over the world - One monster at a time.

name: Escape from the hospital
short_description: Escape from the hospital is a small quest puzzle. You find yourself in an abandoned hospital for unknown reasons and you have no choice but to start looking for a way out. On your way you will meet various monsters and not difficult puzzles. The playing time is about 30-40 minutes.

name: Their Radiance
short_description: Their Radiance is an unconventional walking simulator about love.

name: Arena Experiment
short_description: Arena Experiment puts you in the role of a participant in a reality show, where your only task is to survive in a closed zones called Arenas for as long as you can.

name: 看白海豚的好日子 A Perfect Day for White Dolphin
short_description: 改編自乾綠郎的小說《完美的蛇頸龍之日》。 在這個時代，人們可以透過SC裝置和植物人進行感應。 感應淺者知道自己正在虛擬世界之中；感應深者，則會分不清虛幻與現實。 即使如此，黃芷欣還是決定和植物人弟弟芷樂進行感應，她必須找出芷樂自殺的原因。

name: Lost Alone
short_description: Wander a dense, eerie forest collecting scattered machine parts to escape—but beware. A relentless monster hunts you, stalking through the shadows. Stay quiet, stay hidden, and gather what you need before it finds you first. Every step could be your last.

name: Embracelet
short_description: Travel to northern Norway, solve puzzles using a mysterious, magical bracelet and make new friends on your journey to discover the past - and yourself!

name: The Wake: Mourning Father, Mourning Mother
short_description: The Wake is a record of past wounds opened at a three-day funeral. The journal is encoded with a simple substitution cipher that the player must break in order to reveal the writer’s psyche and discover the contradictions that define him.

name: Drone Zone
short_description: Multiplayer team-based tactical shooter in a postapocaliptic world. Create modules and use them for assembling battle drones. Fight for resources in a world full of hostile anomalies. Use active skills and get advantage depending on which enemy module you have destroyed.

name: Desecrators
short_description: Desecrators is a retro FPS inspired by '90s six-degrees-of-freedom shooters. Plunder your way through the galaxy to destructive weapons and technology powerful enough to take on the ultimate heist: The legendary vaults of the Galactic Treasury.

name: The Hunter's Journals - Red Ripper
short_description: A diplomatic mission...with a lethal twist!

name: Swarm
short_description: The Network has been infested. Face a giant creature ruled by music to cleanse it. Fight while switching between 2 complementary Game Modes!

name: Helwyr
short_description: Embark on an adventure traversing the town of Nevstell and its surrounding areas to uncover the dark secrets behind this world and uncover the truth behind your past.

name: Friendly Fire
short_description: Can you save the world from an unknown destiny?

name: The Forsaken Ruins
short_description: The Forsaken Ruins is a first-person atmospheric horror game. As prisoner of Ever-Bleed Keep, your chance to escape has come. Delve deep into the ruins and try to survive long enough to unravel its dark history and your true identity.

name: Bubble Tea : game for thinking and imagination
short_description: Let's find legendary bubble tea to cure grandpa! This is a puzzle RPG Maker game that take you on an adventurous journey across the world, through various dangers to find legendary treasures according to Grandpa's orders.

name: 汉武大帝传-经典策略战棋
short_description: Classic single player game

name: Somber
short_description: Somber is an atmospheric action-platformer that takes place in the semi-open world of Gloom. A hand-painted game filled with stunning environments, Somber demands absolute precision from players who wish to unlock its many secrets.

name: Boreal Tenebrae Act I: “I Stand Before You,  A Form Undone”
short_description: Delve into the dream of a dying town in 'Boreal Tenebrae' , a retro-style adventure with horror elements.

name: Zoo World VR
short_description: Intentio Education Game Studios gives you a passport to all parts of our vibrant planet. As you crisscross the globe you’ll be able to study and learn about the native species while you help out your new four-legged friends through a series of challenging, environmental-themed quests.

name: Jackalope
short_description: Jackalope - is a psychological horror, with supernatural elements. You have to survive in a dangerous forest and not go crazy, defend yourself from monsters, solve puzzles and be prepared for the worst. You can play Jackalope alone or with your friends (up to 4 people).

name: Beodara
short_description: You and your opponent will control a character who will be able to gather resources with different aims : build your village, hire peasants as well as knights and many other soldiers.

name: Music Ball
short_description: The "MusicBall" game, fun music arcade game with many levels. Thanks to carefully selected music and addictive gameplay, the developers managed to achieve an incredible experience for the players!

name: Robot Invasion
short_description: Robot Invasion is a game set in the near future when robots have invaded Earth. There are robots everywhere and they are deadly. Avoid them at all costs.

name: Couple in Trouble
short_description: Challenge yourself in a world of obstacles and dangers, test your skills in a fun and challenging game.

name: Little Terror
short_description: Little Terror is an interactive exploration Horror simulator. Interrogate every detail of a seemingly normal house to discover the story of the people who live there.

name: Wrap It!
short_description: Beat your high score by traversing a genitalia through a wave of STDs.

name: Return to Sector 9
short_description: Spread across a campaign mode and 8 mini games, take on a variety of missions from bug hunts, protection detail, desperate last stands and rescue missions!

name: Zero-G Gunfight
short_description: Battle 1-3 friends in the fast-paced & frantic arenas of Zero-G Gunfight. Pickup different guns that change how you move & fight. Dodge enemy bullets & avoid unique hazards as you strive to be the last one standing!

name: Pink Island
short_description: Pink Island is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty.

name: Guardians
short_description: Guardians, an extraordinary action role-playing game that transports you to a captivating universe teeming with danger, discovery, and heroism. Immerse yourself in a sprawling, post-apocalyptic world where chaos-infected creatures roam, and the fate of civilization rests on your shoulders.

name: Astro Dash
short_description: A colourful retro physics game for causal and pro gamers alike. Whizzing round the cosmos in your flying saucer dodging asteroids, black holes, cannon fire & assorted obstacles picking up crystals. Thrusting, dodging & speeding through the 30 obstacle filled levels.

name: Cruel Galaxy: Discordia
short_description: Cruel Galaxy: Discordia is a turn-based role-playing game, including tactical space combat, strategic elements and original story, filled by despair.

name: Autumn-Chess
short_description: The single player self-propelled chess game template and experimental works made by myself contain the basic elements of self-propelled chess game. However, due to the lack of funds, the monster setting and ending screen were not done.

name: Shop Tycoon
short_description: Shop Tycoon lets you build, furnish and run your own shop. Hire employees, order goods and face various challenges on the way to success! Develop your business, discover new districts and try to meet the expectations of new customers.

name: Rubikingdom
short_description: Run your very own kingdom on a rubik's cube. Collect resources to develop your kingdom. Fight off raiders. Face events like famine, disease, and corruption of the land. Buy a favor from your god, pay tribute, or ignore them and feel their wrath. How long will you reign?

name: ODIA
short_description: Slaughter the defenders of this dark land to claim the Cathedral. Utilize arcane weapons and dark magic to smite your enemies in this hardcore retro FPS inspired by early first-person shooter games.

name: The Passage Of Time
short_description: Challenge the passage of time and try to survive in dark dungeons while fighting with their inhabitants. Create unique weapons, develop skills and explore caves. But be careful - time is running out ...

name: PengoRoyale
short_description: PengoRoyale is a fun, colorful, competitive, couch-brawling, battle royale! Be the last penguin standing as you fight for dominance on the ice. Grab the many power-ups and bring the smack down to 11 of your friends. Try it today!

name: Golden Moon
short_description: Golden Moon is an old school, 3D Third-Person puzzle platformer game about finding treasure and working your way past ancient robots, booby-traps, and other menaces.

name: Paper Shakespeare: Very Naked Hamlet
short_description: So, like, either know Shakespeare's Hamlet, or don't get laid. That's it. That's the game.

name: The United SPACE of America
short_description: The United SPACE of America is a high action, arcade style, run-n-gun bullet hell, twin stick shooter that allows you to absorb enemy bullets with your Proton Sabre while you blast through countless enemies with your shoulder cannon. It takes a bit of hectic coordination. Can you master it?

name: Eternity Convergence
short_description: Eternity Convergence is a Sci-fi RPG. The player begins their journey as a pilot in the human controlled galaxy of Ennae. After building up a crew and a small fleet of ships the player can explore hundreds of planets and a number of galaxies to uncover a plot that is preparing to consume all life.

name: Hyde and Zeke
short_description: Hyde and Zeke is a stealth game about a boy using light magic to escape a dark castle. The stakes are higher though as a cloaked figure chases him through the castle.

name: Ratico Puzzle Adventure
short_description: Embark on an epic puzzle adventure as a clever rat, navigating intricate mazes, aiming to reach the coveted cheese in 90 levels. With limitless retries and intuitive controls, Ratico Puzzle Adventure offers a delightful journey filled with surprises, all while unraveling the thrilling adventure

name: Spooky Spins Deluxe Steam Edition
short_description: Spooky Spins Deluxe is a 4x5 reel, 40 payline slot machine (pokie) with a Spooky theme oriented from left to right.

name: OMG: One Million Guns
short_description: OMG: One Million Guns is a fast-paced, 2D, top-down, twin-stick shooter set in space, with LOTS of guns. Blast your way through waves of enemies with a multitude of weapons at your disposal. Full controller support included.

name: ハンターハーツ Hunter Hearts
short_description: Have you ever had that feeling of looking back in the past? Well, Hunter Hearts is about the past of the protagonist, before the tragedy happend. Find out in this visual novel what he's been going through.

name: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child
short_description: Become a mother and experience the best of maternity. The game is for future mothers, so they know what to expect, and also for their partners, so they can experience things their women do. The adventure begins just as you see the pregnancy test is positive.

name: Schlag den Star - Das 2. Spiel
short_description: SCHLAG DEN STAR is finally going to the next round. ELTON and the studio shine in a completely new graphic design and are therefore more beautiful and realistic than ever.

name: Dreams Keeper Solitaire
short_description: Rescue children from nightmares! Classic Solitaire set in the dream dimension! Choose the abilities that suit you, literally!

name: Rainbow Hills
short_description: An old school platformer inspired by the greats of the 80s. Rainbow Hills focuses on a tight controls, smart level design, good game feel, and bubbles!

name: Rompe
short_description: Rompe! is a platform game where everything you touch breaks! destroy and rebuild the world around you to escape the dungeon!

name: Deep Dark Forest
short_description: You will have to lead the civilization, develop the economy, enhance the technology, stabilize the people and colonize new galaxies; when encountering unknown civilizations, will you hide yourself or communicate with them in a friendly way? In this "dark forest", every decision will be crucial.

name: World End Echo
short_description: A visual novel in the world of post-apocalypse with match 3 games, in which you meet beautiful girls for every taste and get to know them better by beating the levels.

name: Epic Chef
short_description: Get ready to embark on a comedic culinary quest unlike any other as you take on the role of Zest in this story-driven adventure game; from humble beginnings you will build a farm, grow delectable ingredients, craft machinery and cook your way to becoming the most Epic Chef in Ambrosia!

name: Awkward Girls
short_description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

name: Cute Lady
short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

name: WWII: Rising
short_description: Become a hero during WWII in an Epic Online Multiplayer battles. Play up to 4 different maps with 4 game modes. You can choose to support your teammates with the support class or either fight off the enemy from a long distance with the Recon. The battle has started, come and fight for your country.

name: Sky Beneath
short_description: This narratively driven puzzle platformer puts you in the role of Cassie, an intrepid scavenger seeking salvage in abandoned mining facilities. Embark on an adventure with your inventor friend Annie, take control of the gravity, and solve challenging puzzles in a mysterious sci-fi setting.

name: Cannonship
short_description: Cannonship is an action-packed shootout in which your plane must fight a horde of enemies. You can fight your opponents alone or with another player. Upgrade your ship and tip the balance of victory to your side! Will you accept the challenge?

name: Cult of the Lamb
short_description: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

name: Enchantress
short_description: Enchantress - A Psychological Thriller Game. Play as Megan Sterling in her journey to discover the secrecy hidden within the walls of WhiteRose Orphanage. Lose yourself with different discoveries and beware you don't meet a similar fate.

name: Explode On Contact
short_description: Ventur through the levels with a robot character. But be careful, your robot buddy will explode if they hit those spikes.

name: Nimoyd - Survival Sandbox
short_description: You’ve crash-landed on Earth in 2702. Craft, dig, fight through a vast and colorful post-apocalyptic open world full of wonder, generated cities, dungeons, aliens, mechs, and an underworld. Find love. Or beat the ultimate Underlord!

name: Beautiful Light
short_description: Beautiful Light, a PvPvPvE tactical first-person extraction shooter where 6 squads of 3 operators are tasked with entering, securing, and extracting an artifact in a hostile, horrific environment. Face other operators and player-controlled anomalies, but beware: mistakes can risk your life and gear.

name: Let Them Trade
short_description: Build a network of cities that produce and trade resources, upgrade your castle, and protect the cities from cheeky bandits. Tinker with the economy at your own pace, and watch the charming wooden world grow into a lively and thriving kingdom.

name: Election Year Knockout
short_description: Become President in this hilarious Punch-Out-inspired political sim where all laws have been replaced with boxing! Each opponent has unique tactics and special moves to test your skill and strategy on your way to the White House! Form your own third party and hit the campaign trail. Literally.

name: HEDE Game Engine
short_description: Play games, create games. HEDE Game Engine - this is a set of tools that allows you to create small simple games and share them with other players on the incentive, we can also publish your game if it turns out to be interesting, and you get a percentage of sales.

name: Epocria
short_description: An infinite open world survival game for 1-8 players to explore. Journey into the deepest caves, enter alternate dimensions, and release an ancient evil's grasp on the world of Epocria.

name: Living Legends Remastered: Ice Rose Collector's Edition
short_description: Return to Rosemount to stop the Ice Queen this updated classic!

name: Underfire
short_description: Underfire is a dynamic multiplayer team war game. You have to fight on stragic maps using various weapons up to 8 players. By correctly managing your current arsenal and skills, you must lead your team to victory!

name: Einsteins Riddle
short_description: A pure, simple game of logic and deduction. Random generated puzzles enables unlimited replay. Custom board layouts let you adjust the difficulty and time needed to solve a puzzle.

name: Really Trash Game
short_description: The Mafia wages war on you! Cut your way through cohorts of gangs and dirty cops in this bloody battle. Grab the guns, use the med kits to heal your wounds, and try to survive.

name: Slimes
short_description: A game about two guys that hate each other.

name: FM
short_description: A mysterious radio announcer describes a recent murder-suicide as the unknown protagonist navigates through an ever-shifting environment.

name: CryptoClickers: Crypto Idle Game
short_description: CryptoClickers is a complex Incremental Game revolved around Cryptocurrencies that's full of unique game modes, upgrades, challenges, events, and a double layer prestige system!

name: Aternia: Deep
short_description: Aternia: Deep – a successor to immortal genres of roguelike and hack & slash. Take on a role of the Protagonist, imprisoned in an ancient dungeon’s Depths. Bring down throngs of enemies to finally reach the surface and your homeland, Aternia.

name: Pursuit of Redemption
short_description: Join the journey of S, a drawing boy searching for his creator and help him find his painter. Unfold the memories of your maker to uncover the mystery behind his vanishing, find your way out of a confusing maze, and ascend through the darkness in an emotional Hand-Drawn platformer puzzle adventure.

name: The Lost Marble
short_description: The Lost Marble is a platformer in which the player controls an intrepid marble. Roll fast, hop gaps, push cubes, explore and avoid enemies to find the goal of each level. Create and share levels too! Includes 20 hand-made levels, unlockable marbles, and an in-game level editor.

name: COVID Kawaii!
short_description: COVID Kawaii! is the cutest pandemic tower defense this side of the partition glass. Using the power of common sense and cleaning products, defend your personal space from the oncoming virus hoard. Can you go the social distance?

name: Hunt In Town
short_description: Gather 6 to 20 players around a campfire and depending on your role in the game, hunt down werewolves that have infiltrated the group, devour innocent villagers, or even end up as the only survivor to win the game.

name: Her Lie I Tried To Believe - Extended Edition
short_description: Her Lie I Tried To Believe follows the unhealthy relationship of a man and a woman who, through a series of fateful encounters, become deeply entangled with one another all the while still being haunted by their pasts.

name: EA SPORTS™ FIFA 21
short_description: Football is back with EA SPORTS™ FIFA 21, featuring more ways to team up on the street or in the stadium to enjoy even bigger victories with friends.

name: Orc's Civil War
short_description: It's a RTS + TD game like Warcraft3 and Starcraft.

name: Test Tube Titans: Taster Trial
short_description: Take on your friends in a chaotic physics-based wrestling match using giant monsters that have been procedurally mutated to be unique every time you play. Or, craft a custom titan and take it for a walk through the neighbourhood, tearing up everything as you go!

name: My Holiday 2
short_description: This is the second part of the long holiday of labor and capital! It tells the story of the protagonist's return to his hometown in the summer vacation three years after his previous work, but he is invaded by the meow man.

name: Detonation Sauce University
short_description: This is a checkpoint game, you always encounter things on the way to school delay, to the school and was scolded by the teacher, also often encounter campus bullying, can not go on like this, take up arms for their own honor fight, remove all obstacles chasing their own life!

name: PlanetariumVR
short_description: Planetarium for VR to learn about the stars, constellations, and deep sky objects from the Messier, Caldwell, Herschel400, NGC, IC, Sharpless, and Arp catalogs. Learn the positions of stars and the Messier objects; play the minesweeper in VR in a polyhedron.

name: Achilles: Legends Untold
short_description: Rewrite fate with every strike. Face gods, mythic heroes, and legendary beasts in this souls-like Action RPG set in ancient Greece. Master brutal combat, unlock divine skills, and shape Achilles into the warrior only you can become.

name: 深入敵境 Behind Enemy Line
short_description: In the game, a large number of enemy troops will continue to hunt you down !! you have only one purpose!! kill all the enemies !! Now !! Be mentally prepared !! You are about to land on the battlefield !!

name: Wteruna
short_description: It's been a long day, without you my friend. And I'll tell you all about when I see you again.

name: City Sniper
short_description: This is a first person shooting game. The player plays a soldier,Players are surrounded by enemies, and they are free to explore the surrounding areas,Players can dodge the enemy's attack, or kill the enemy to survive as much as possible.

name: TramSim Vienna - The Tram Simulator
short_description: Experience with TramSim the most modern tram simulator, which impresses with photo-realistic graphics and as first location the Austrian capital Vienna in a virtual reality that has never been seen before.

name: dungeon & heros
short_description: Dungeon Heroes is an srpg and roguelite game that I personally developed, recruit and develop your team of heroes, in the randomly generated map to explore,collect equipment and soul skills,in the infinite reincarnation to build the strongest team.

name: Treasure Islands
short_description: Take to the seas with Nick and Pippa on an exciting isle hopping adventure, as you search for new exhibits for their old Museum!

name: Battle Dawn 2: Terra Reborn
short_description: Place your colony, find an alliance of like-minded players and triumph over thousands of other players to conquer the world through strategy, tactics, diplomacy and skill in the biggest social-interaction based MMO of all time. Upgrade your colony, collect items for your Avatar and become a legend!

name: Adventure mosaics. Small Islanders
short_description: 200 colorful nonograms, just the way you like it! Choose your favorite island!

name: How To Punish A Witch
short_description: "Witches tortured me in the past... now I have returned to seek revenge." Not only there are witches and warlocks in the world, they blend into the human society and live with us. Are you one of them?

name: Flying Hero VR
short_description: Evil unicorns conquered Meow York City! It's about time to unleash your true hero skill and get some revenge! Save all the cute kitten in this thriving city on a beautiful island and upgrade your gear to fly faster than any other hero ever!

name: Rugby Union Team Manager 3
short_description: The third instalment of “The Number 1 Rugby Union Management Game”. Rugby Union Team Manager 3 gives you full control of managing your own Rugby Union team. Training schedules, coaches, physios, scouting, finances, sponsors, facilities and more. MUCH MORE!

name: Flicker of Hope
short_description: Flicker of Hope is a suspense thriller where you play as a small candle in the ruins of a dark cathedral. Though the halls are littered with victims of a mysterious plague, you are not the only soul left. Use the properties of a candle, and a trusty douter to prevent yourself from being discovered.

name: Don Flatus: Poop Hunter
short_description: After years of sending probes to Uranus, all the debris is now orbiting the planet as a ring of junk. The interplanetary commission has now sent a crack cleanup crew to clean the ring around Uranus. The team arrive at the planet and find that Uranus has been invaded by an alien presence!

name: Improbable Soccer
short_description: Dive into a soccer game that’s as unpredictable as it is fun. With simple controls and intense gameplay, it’s perfect for friends to enjoy together. Up to 6 players can join in, making it ideal for both casual and competitive play.

name: Feylin
short_description: Feylin - this is a pixel slasher where you play as a small knight who needs to fight off endless waves of completely different enemies. You need to destroy the crowds of enemies and try to survive as long as possible. Can you beat them all?

name: X-Fitness
short_description: X-Fitness is a fun and innovative way to enjoy an intensive VR full-body workout! Stand and fight off the pounds in the virtual arena. Punch, cut, block, and dodge your way to a slimmer you! Start burning those calories with handcrafted tracks or your own MP3 files.

name: The Rogue Cavern
short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated cavern and find items in this roguevania-esque platformer.

name: Coronavirus Quarantine Simulator
short_description: Coronavirus Quarantine Simulator is a short experience that will help you train all your pandemic survival day-to-day skills while you have a good time with ridiculous situations. Now you can safely play coronavirus quarantine simulator while you safely stay at home during coronavirus quarantine.

name: Aristocunts
short_description: Waking up in an Otome Game? Not ideal but... thankfully you've cleared this game before and know the story inside and out, so its time to avoid a bad end by reforming the evil duchess, and her daughter, with something that transcends class and creed, your dick!

name: Minesweeper X
short_description: Minesweeper X is a new redefined experience based on the classic video game Minesweeper. A thrilling game where you are always at the edge of your seat.

name: Defensive Attacks
short_description: Every tower is a decision. Every enemy is a test. Build your defense line and survive with your tactical intelligence.

name: StreamTeam
short_description: StreamTeam is an upcoming squad-based strategic multiplayer game where you take part in an “away-team" fighting your enemies in space. Learn teamwork to defend your base from attackers, or leave your opponents in rubble. Get creative and become the best squad this side of the galaxy!

name: Three Kingdom: The Journey
short_description: Craft a legendary deck and lead your troops to protect the Kingdom for the glory of the Han Dynasty in this fast-paced deck-building strategy roguelike. The Kingdom is on the verge of disaster against the Yellow Turbans rebellion, and only you – and your skills as a general – stand in their way!

name: RealFlight Trainer Edition
short_description: RealFlight Trainer Edition is the perfect way to learn radio control flying on your PC. With 8 aircraft from Horizon Hobby (more are unlockable) and flying lessons from experienced RC pilots, you'll be ready to solo in no time. When you're ready, an upgrade to RealFlight Evolution is also available.

name: encrypt.
short_description: "encrypt." is a competitive platformer! Build your own stages or play stages from the community and compete with other players! "encrypt." brings back Retro-Game feelings with modern Pixel-Graphics. We can promise you, this Game will offer you a lot of fun and a nostalgic atmosphere!

name: KITT.IO
short_description: Can you gain the biggest kitten following?

name: Shoo, Box!
short_description: Shoo, Box! is a silly sneaker adventure, where you play as a shoe box who comes to life with a pair of human legs. Use the shoes you collect to solve exciting stealth puzzles, explore the world in search of your owner, and ruin a bunch of peoples' days!

name: Speed Swing
short_description: Speed Swing is a challenging level based grappling hook game, where the objective is to reach the end of each level as fast as possible.

name: Galactic Solo Command
short_description: In Galactic Solo Command you experience the atmosphere of running a spaceship while trying to return home after the crew has mysteriously disappeared. It's a very dangerous trip, with every jump presenting a challenge with life or death decisions. Prepare your ship!

name: Mealmates
short_description: Get your friends together or play by yourself. It's a minigame mayhem!

name: VACUULUS
short_description: In a small remote town, the decades-old legend of The Vacuum Man seems like nothing more than a silly hoax. But one messy, unruly young boy is about to learn the true horror that defined the legend. Experience playing as the boy, sneaking for your survival as the Vacuum Man tries to take you away.

name: My UnReal Pet
short_description: My Unreal Pet is an experience game that temporarily protects abandoned dogs for 7 days. Challenge yourself if you can keep a dog!

name: Vaccine19
short_description: 100% Free 'Hip-Fire' Arcade Shooter! Instead of using crosshairs or sights on gun, Vaccine19 has the player visualize shot trajectory. Don't Get Infected!

name: Jumping Jax
short_description: Exploit interesting movement mechanics to chase after your teleporting cyber-corgi!

name: Field Hospital: Dr. Taylor's Story
short_description: Field Hospital is a text-based bureaucratic detective game about hard decisions. Decide who to treat and whom to refuse. Face consequences. Study patients’ info and read their stories. Investigate the tangled case of Dr. Taylor.

name: 不返
short_description: 不返是一款画风可可爱爱的寻物小游戏，游戏时长较短，是为了讲述主角在寻找哥哥的探险路途中发生的故事。 它的主题是成长与欺骗。 以哥哥的失踪为引子，重重迷踪终将水落石出，你准备好了吗？

name: 鸢之歌-Singing Iris
short_description: 《鸢之歌》是一款涵盖末日元素的养成类视觉小说游戏，讲述了一名感染者与一名人造天才科学家以及一名背叛人类的少女之间发生的故事；在这个时代什么是正确的事情？拯救世界？亦或者不惜代价的活下去？我们都将在一次又一次的选择里见证这一切。

name: Spark in the Dark
short_description: The hardcore dark fantasy Dungeon Crawler where you will go to the endless depths of a mysterious grim Dungeon.

name: Kingdom Under Fire: Heroes
short_description: The cult hit Kingdom Under Fire saga continues on PC in glorious HD. Control seven new heroes across fifty brutal missions of hybrid hack n’ slash action and strategy. Crush your foes, hoard their treasure, and upgrade your forces for the next battle.

name: Ikai
short_description: Fear and anxiety prevail after the darkest tales from Japanese folklore come to life in this first-person psychological horror game. Set in a feudal era, Ikai revolves around the priestess of a shrine struggling to defeat the spirits of her past and her present.

name: Memory Illusions
short_description: Memory Illusions is a single player VR looter shooter featuring realistic weapons, upgrades, attachments, randomize options, and player progression in fast paced action environments.

name: Blackstorm
short_description: Born as an university project, Blackstorm is an online multiplayer Battle Royale where players form crews of three pirates and face each other in deadly combat. Sail with your spaceship in a three-dimensional environment with total freedom of movement and rotation.

name: Escape from the Cosmic Abyss
short_description: Shoot, Dash and Jetpack for your life to escape the Guardian of the Abyss while taking the Orb of Knowledge with you in this mix of casual and arcade gameplay!

name: PEE WAR！
short_description: Play pee Superman and destroy the city and the forest! Destroy everything in your sight and avoid the human army attack!

name: The Necromancer's Tale
short_description: A story-rich gothic RPG. Master the rituals of an ancient spellbook. Raise an undead army to march against your enemies. Commune with the realm of the dead & struggle with your descent into madness. Progress through secrecy, diplomacy, blackmail, coercion & seduction until ready to reveal yourself.

name: Crazy Jump
short_description: "Crazy Jump" is a 2D jumping game. Players will play as spheres, go through various levels set by the Demon King, and finally save the world. In the game, the Demon King will challenge your reaction speed, control ability, and adaptability!

name: Way Far Home
short_description: Join the Hardcore adventure with little Fox. Travel through lands and sky, discover the secret of the Jungle. Overcome the suffering of exhaustion, painfulness, lost in fear. Find true love.

name: Mini Maker: Make A Thing
short_description: A hero thing, a monster thing, a robo thing… in Mini Maker, you can make any ‘thing’! Use an arsenal of plastic limbs, wonky tools, rainbow stickers and googly eyes to assemble creations, please demanding clients, and laugh in the face of perfectionism.

name: Source of Madness
short_description: Source of Madness is a side-scrolling dark action roguelite set in a twisted Lovecraftian inspired world powered by procedural generation and AI machine learning. Take on the role of a new Acolyte as they embark on a nightmarish odyssey.

name: EndlessShinyBlues
short_description: 在一个平平无奇的春日午后，叛逆的少年闯入了繁忙城市中某个安宁的角落。仿佛是飞鸟从无数的海砂中拾起一粒那样——翘课的少年与翘班的大姐姐相遇了。

name: RUN OR FIGHT
short_description: RUN OR FIGHT - it's an action filled game in which you will try to survive in dangerous environment filled with deadly traps, landmines, scorching fires and evil aliens!

name: Auto Kitchen
short_description: Build and run your own automated kitchen to turn ingredients into delicious meals!

name: Sausage Fest
short_description: Sausage Fest is an online top-down shooter where 2-10 meat rods fight for dominance. Step into the dangerous world of Sausages as you battle other wieners in different game modes and maps to grow as big as you can and crush your enemies. Grow quick and pound hard! Lest you be pounded yourself...

name: Asteroids 44 (For Four)
short_description: Remake of one of the oldest arcade classics. Challenge yourself and advance through the levels filled with asteroids, power-ups and virtual bitcoins, that you can spend in the shop to get ready for what's coming. Get your friends and share the adventure together in co-op mode!

name: Men Bang
short_description: It’s time to let your imagination run wild with the steamiest Dating Sim/ Clicker on this side of town! With scenarios so mouth-watering, a wide variety of unique hunks, and a fantastic retro artwork and atmosphere, Men Bang has everything you need to fulfill your deepest and wildest desires!

name: Move 'n' Bloom
short_description: A simple but also challenging puzzle game about moving, pushing and matching colors.

name: The Great Art Heist
short_description: You play as Jack a kid who loves art ever since he could remember. His parents took him to many museums when he was younger, ever since he has wanted to collect art pieces. Take on contracts or collect for yourself.

name: UNITED COMMAND ®
short_description: UNITED COMMAND is a military base building real time strategy game with a 2 player co-op campaign. Drop into a mission and fight side by side with a friend against the enemy AI. Use your dozer to build out your base and gather resources to fund the construction of your tanks, infantry, and aircraft.

name: Supermarket Maker
short_description: Build and manage your very own Supermarket and make it success, with good offers and best selected products. Attract more customers with an aggressive strategy and grow to become the best Supermarket in town.

name: Work And Girls
short_description: This is the puzzle with a several levels of difficulty and beautiful artbook. All characters appearing in this game are over 18 years of age.

name: Big City Rigs: Garbage Truck Driver
short_description: Whoever said collecting trash won't pay the bills? Hop in the seat of your very own garbage truck and clean up and collect the trash as you manage your own waste utilization company.

name: 3d Maze In Space
short_description: 3d labyrinth with procedurally generated levels. Character wakes up in an incomprehensible place and gradually remembers what happened, while making his assumptions about where he got into.

name: Bop'N Wrestle
short_description: Grapple your way to the top as Gorgeous Greg in this colorful classic, hailed as one of the first great pro wrestling games. BOP'N WRESTLE puts you in the ring with 10 of the meanest, baddest, biggest, toughest, ugliest pro wrestlers ever to fly off a turnbuckle!

name: The Train: Escape to Normandy
short_description: On the outskirts of Metz, a heavily armed train of the Third Reich sits ready to smuggle plundered artifacts to Berlin. You are a leader in the French Resistance. Your mission: capture the armored "war train" and successfully commandeer it through enemy lines for a rendezvous with the Allies.

name: Gravity Oddity
short_description: Embark on a one-man rescue mission across the galaxy to bring back your kidnapped roommate in this roguelike space action-adventure.

name: Tin Can
short_description: You've barely managed to escape your exploding spaceship. Now in an old escape pod, you hurtle through space at the mercy of the cosmos. With no knowledge of the pod’s complex systems, your life depends on a technical manual and your own wits. How long can you survive?

name: Honor and Duty: D-Day
short_description: Honor and Duty: D-Day is an online PVP shooter set during the D-Day invasion of World War II. Players compete in Team Death Match, Domination, and Free For All matches or in a separate Battle Royale mode. Online games put 32 players in a fast paced environment which also includes vehicle combat.

name: Rainy City: Pandemic
short_description: Explore the cyberpunk metropolis of Rainy City while delivering pizzas, meeting the locals and saving your sister!

name: Smelted Kin
short_description: Science fiction 2D shooter with platformer and metroidvania elements. Players will have to explore a huge research complex consisting of nonlinear levels, which is crowded with robots

name: Oval RaceCar Builder
short_description: This is the first-ever dedicated game to the UK Short Ovals made for PC! This first game in our Oval Racer Series is all about building that Oval RaceCar

name: The Village Story
short_description: This is the story of a kid name Jorah and his adventures throughout the beautiful pixel art towns. It has been foretold that anybody who does good deeds will be granted access to the Village of Gods. Fulfill Jorah's quest by visiting beautiful pixel art towns like Christmas,Snowtown,Waterworld etc.

name: IVAN POE
short_description: Ivan Poe is a third person find-your-way puzzle adventure following this cuboid character as they keep truckin' on through the Cosmic Soup.

name: M.E.A.T. RPG
short_description: M.E.A.T. is a pixel art RPG game in a horror sci-fi setting, with renowned fight, movement and character development systems. Unravel the mystery of a sinister substance and become the hero of a small Canadian city during the Gold Rush era.

name: House Sitter
short_description: ​Explore the wacky world of House Sitter, and discover what secrets lie in wait. Meet new friends! Choose their fate!... Uncover who you truly are. But most importantly, get those chores done before Mom comes home.

name: Rock Star Simulator
short_description: Taste the life of a famous musician, go on the live tour across the USA and have fun just like a real star - welcome to the rock and roll heaven!

name: Force of Nature 2: Ghost Keeper
short_description: Force of Nature 2: Ghost Keeper offers incredible adventures full of mystery, danger, exploration and magic. This game combines the genres of Survival, Sandbox, Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy and Resource Management

name: Tekling 2: Overdrive
short_description: Suit up and Boot up! Tekling is back in an all new adventure as you battle your way to defeat robots from taking over the world! Wear new suits and use new abilities to stop the robot uprising once and for all!

name: We Die
short_description: As a Reaper Class 4, Unit 82 (R482), your current job is to collect the remaining souls from a previous reaper's attempt. Your outcome is determined by your exploration, your reaping, and your attitude towards the many lost souls. You only get one chance to make an impression.

name: WAVE RIDER
short_description: WAVE RIDER is a fast racing game where gravity-defying machines meet at the finish line to return control to a virtual world. Race through many bending roads, make waves with your machine to gain power, and boost to the end before the timer reaches zero.

name: Quarantine Cutz
short_description: A hilarious cartoon simulation where you're absolutely terrible at cutting hair. Can you overcome your nerves and total pop culture ignorance to give your family a haircut that won't crush their dreams? Probably not, but you're gonna give it your best shot!

name: GraeHart
short_description: GraeHart is an immersive 16-bit medieval fantasy RPG where players take on the role of Percival, a lone hunter drawn into a battle to protect his village while uncovering the forgotten legacy of his bloodline.

name: Thermo Sudoku
short_description: How does Thermo Sudoku work? Each sudoku grid contains thermometer shapes (often drawn to create themes) and digits on thermometers must increase as one moves further from the bulb end.

name: Lonefarm
short_description: Lonefarm is a farming and driving simulation game. Harvest a wide variety of crops, care for and feed your animals, decorate your cabin with furniture and drive your old Van all over the island in the middle of the South Pacific.

name: Bounty
short_description: Bounty is a fast-paced and brutal top-down action MMORPG set in a post-apocalyptic world populated by humanoid blobs. As a fresh spawn, all you know about the world around you is what was pre-programmed at your creation. It's up to you to find your way (and your meaning) in this strange world.

name: Flain - Tao force & Cubes
short_description: Pair and collect the floating cubes using Tao force. It may be a very hard game. Check your progress step by step and eventually reach the wisdom of Tao force.

name: Buster's TD
short_description: A fun physics-based tower defense game where you build your own base and maze. Featuring a very cute dog named Buster and his evil twin named busteR.

name: Otaku's Rage: Waifu Strikes Back
short_description: What if this whole world of humiliation and suffering was just a nightmare? And instead, you are the Hero of the World of Waifu.

name: Operation Covid-19
short_description: An endless first person shooter in which you CAN destroy viruses with TP rolls. Earn points, level up, get upgrades and shoot the new normal in the face.

name: Ironsmith Medieval Simulator: Prologue
short_description: Ironsmith: Medieval Simulator - Prologue allows you to become the local blacksmith in medieval reality. Master your skills by ceaselessly crafting tools and weapons for various social classes.

name: VLADiK BRUTAL
short_description: Fight under the onslaught of mutated monsters, obsessed soldiers and even darker bosses. Just try to survive and find out what to do next in this life, simultaneously tearing your enemies to pieces.

name: Escape from Kyoto House
short_description: Your party finds themselves trapped in a Japanese-themed room. Solve puzzles, crack riddles and discover hidden secrets in your adventure to Escape from Kyoto House!

name: THE 8IGHT
short_description: Max, who suffers from schizophrenia due to childhood trauma, decides to break free from the endless torment of hallucinations and delusions.

name: Extreme Escape
short_description: Extreme Escape is an escape-room puzzle game with an action component. It combines realistic graphics with challenges at high altitudes. The player must find his way out of a critical situation by facing difficult weather conditions, technical problems and the fear of heights.

name: Suicide Guy VR
short_description: Experience Suicide Guy now in Virtual Reality for the greatest, most immersive snooze! These surreal dreams have never been so chaotic and frantic. If you're faint of heart, do not play this game.

name: Sol 705
short_description: A hilarious point and click graphic adventure in the best spirit of the '90s where you play as a young man and his friends in a personal quest that will turn their passion for progressive rock and UFOs into a real intergalactic mess... If they manage to survive school !

name: Destropolis
short_description: Destropolis is a top-down shooter game with a fully destructible environment, hundreds of enemies and nuclear explosions. Fight a countless swarm of enemies. Tear them to pieces with bullets, lasers and explosions. Destroy as many of them as you can before they overwhelm you...

name: Simply Puzzles: Codewords
short_description: 100 handcrafted codewords designed to help you relax. Solve the code and reveal the answers.

name: Primordials: Battle of Gods
short_description: Primordials: Battle of Gods is a pure 1vs1 strategy game where players rule kingdoms and build armies to war for ever greater power. One Will Rise, Many Will Fall.

name: Super Monkey Ball Banana Mania
short_description: Go Bananas with your favorite monkey gang in the ultimate Super Monkey Ball adventure!

name: VE FPSO TOUR in VR
short_description: FPSO Tour. Live some of the everyday scenarios offshore workers must face.

name: 遗落幻境
short_description: Oblivion is a first-person 3D survive-building game with a super-core gameplay experience and rich content that brings endless possibilities!

name: 77p egg: Eggwife
short_description: After a sexual mishap, our hero 77p egg finds itself on a quest to find a new wife while the world is overrun by sentient sewage and a milk-obsessed cult. A dumb and crass FPS inspired by the likes of Postal 2, Duke 3D, and Goat Simulator.

name: Shape Shooter
short_description: Shape Shooter is an action-packed, colorful, and hectic roguelike game. Survive increasingly harder random generated stages and collect relics, weapons, and active items to help you on your way. How long can you survive?

name: Yuri Ogibalov's Bizarre Adventure
short_description: Yuri Ogibalov's Bizarre Adventure is top-down action rpg, focused on exploration, characters and fights. Explore the dangerous and not so friendly environment of the russian province. Fight enemies in turn based battle system with tons different weapons and items.

name: Charge Knight: A Duck's Tale
short_description: In this casual mechanics game, use continuous movement to overcome challenges. The unstoppable knight Dundee must be strategically driven on his journey, defeating enemies, solving puzzles and mechanics while using the scenery to his advantage.

name: Walthros: Renewal
short_description: Make some friends, eat some burgers, and unearth terrible secrets from the depths of space. Frog and Toad Meet Cosmic Horror. A turn-based RPG with a kind-hearted doofus trying to make tough times a little easier.

name: The Machine's Garden
short_description: ​Use the intelligence of a decommissioned military supercomputer to solve puzzles and guide the lives of humble villagers.​

name: Dicking Around
short_description: Welcome to our game, Dicking Around. Go find some money. Throw some dildos. Shoot some guns. Blow stuff up. Have some fun. Dick around!

name: Lucidscape
short_description: Lucidscape is a 2D puzzle platformer with elements of exploration and combat. Jump in and conquer the nightmares as you explore fear-centric environments!

name: Big City Rigs: Bus Driver
short_description: You've got one job — drive a bus! Get behind the wheel of one of the 8 bus models and master the city streets as you transport passengers and increase your cash flow!

name: Martian Potato
short_description: Galactic farmer - it sounds proud! Do you have a farm on the Red Planet?

name: Eternal Dreamers
short_description: Eternal Dreamers is a battle-focused RPG offering deep tactical combat action. With a wide selection of classes and equipment pieces, the game puts much emphasis on customizability and player choice.

name: HTD
short_description: HTD is a mix of classic party-based RPG and fast-paced real-time action. Control a party consisting of healer, tank and damage dealer, each immensely powerful in their specific role, and use their strengths to take down horrific enemies while journeying through a dark story of mystery and madness.

name: King, Witch and Dragon
short_description: In the game where avatar become weaker and weaker, the player has to become stronger to reach the end.

name: Fractal Alchemist
short_description: Fractal Alchemist is a tool for creating and exploring 3D Fractal Worlds. For this you do not need knowledge of mathematics and programming - the Alchemist will do everything for you.

name: LIMEN: MoonCity
short_description: LIMEN: MoonCity is an atmospheric episodic adventure game that allows the player to traverse between memories using a system called Observe OS.

name: Vertigo Remastered
short_description: An immersive story-driven shooter incorporating the cutting edge of VR gameplay, Vertigo Remastered is a complete overhaul and occasional reimagining of the 2016 original.

name: Party Mashup
short_description: Play Eleven action packed mini-games; Perfect for any party! (With more to come!) Bring the Party to you!

name: Robin Hood: Winds of Freedom
short_description: Help Robin Hood and his merry men rescue King Richard from a cunning kidnapper! With its cast of timeless characters, rollicking story of heroism and addictive gameplay, Robin Hood: Winds of Freedom can turn hours of idle time into a quest for fun!

name: Beautiful Model2
short_description: ·This is a simulation rope art photography game. Players in the game play a rope master, through the cooperation with beautiful models to shoot beautiful photography.

name: PhotoStage
short_description: PhotoStage is an all-in-one slideshow creator loaded with tools and features. Easily drag and drop your pictures, videos, and audio files into the program. Enhance your photos and videos like crop, fade, and zoom, or more detailed changes by editing the brightness, saturation, and more.

name: WiccAtriX
short_description: Wiccatrix is an ARPG with a spellcrafting system that allows the player to create custom spells to use in combat and to solve puzzles. The elemental balance or the world of Terra has been disturbed. Your goal is to explore the lands of Terra and help restore the elemental order back to harmony.

name: Gladiators Manager
short_description: Gladiators Manager puts you in the position of a lanista responsible for training and managing gladiators. Participating in brutal arena fights and cruel intrigues will grant you riches and glory in the ancient Roman Empire.

name: Dancing Angel
short_description: Dancing Angel is a place where you can select a cute anime character. Lets dance along to hot songs, find your couple and celebrate weddings.

name: Shields of Loyalty
short_description: Experience tactically challenging turn-based strategy in the hostile island world of Mantaria. Command a dynamic army of various unit types and classes to slay a dark and possessed undead army. Train forces into powerful warriors and fight fervently until the snake's head is at your feet!

name: HUNKER DOWN
short_description: How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources.

name: OverShoot Battle Race
short_description: Combat racing game inspired by the classic console arcade games, you can make drifts, upgrade your vehicle and buy many weapons to fight for first place in an insane journey facing the most amazing racers in the galaxy.

name: Summer in Mara Prologue
short_description: A demo of Summer in Mara. Discover the beginning of this adventure and take care of your island by harvesting your crops, fishing on your pond, and cooking. Enjoy the opening act to this farming adventure.

name: Spunky: Gangster Simulator
