short_description: Old-school FPS in a neon package with lasers and robots! Fast paced action, bunny hopping and rocket jumping.

name: Chess Knights: Viking Lands
short_description: Help the Knights to rescue their Kings and Queens in the beautiful and dangerous Vikings Lands. An innovative game concept inspired by chess: infiltrate mindfully, rescue quickly, and get out alive if you can.

name: Aquarium Designer
short_description: Aquarium Designer gives you an opportunity to create the aquarium of your dreams! Become a professional whose job is to design it, build it, and fill it with the various underwater wildlife! All types, all sizes - your creativity is your only limit!

name: Final Hope: The Plot
short_description: Final Hope: The Plot is a turn-based Tactical RPG with a medieval theme. Create your hero and embark on the odyssey of Uthread, a young adventurer who was born predestined to change the history of his world.

name: Neon Fusion
short_description: Venture out on a machine-packed rescue mission in a 2D platform game, action, shooting and lots of Neon!

name: Mean-While
short_description: Two rivaling megalomaniacs are forced to work together in hopes to survive each other's fortresses. Join Skeleman, and his rival, Dr. Dangerous, in the thrilling comedic adventure title: Meanwhile.

name: Xoo: Xeno Xafari
short_description: Xoo: Xeno Xafari is a new style of collecting RPG. Wander a beautiful, deserted island and search for alien creatures!

name: Dimension Shift
short_description: Get ready for a challenge! Dimension Shift is a hardcore game for hardcore gamers. Avoid the spikes. Reach the end. It's that simple. Or is it...?

name: Matt's Project Zombies: Open World
short_description: Take place on a Deserted Island in the middle of the ocean with very few landmarks left in sight being overrun with the Undead. Face an intense open world while you Craft equipment, Craft shelter and out-smart wildlife, bandits, and online players all while trying to survive!

name: 末代侠客
short_description: 个人独立开发的像素武侠风横版动作游戏，以电子游戏的形式为大家展示在南宋末年蒙古入侵中原、江湖没落、大侠绝迹的背景下，怀有侠义之心的剑客贯彻心中理念的故事。

name: ZONEX
short_description: ZONEX is a 3D realtime dynamic effects showcase with both PC and VR support.

name: Solitaire 3D
short_description: Enjoy over 100 different solitaire games (including all your favorites: Spider, Pyramid, Klondike etc.), in-game tutorials, multiple card decks (including the unique 4 color card deck), a wide range of backgrounds, online high scores, statistics, and much more.

name: Samurai Cooking
short_description: The rules are simple. Just cut the food.

name: The Unbeatable Path
short_description: In this realistic and immersive first-person horror adventure, you have to beat riddles and puzzles in a hellish environment. While doing so you will unveil the story of Mia and find out why she was finally driven to taking her own life. Will you change her story for the better?

name: Soulace
short_description: Soulace takes you on an audio-visual journey through the afterlife. Inspired by the Tibetan Book of the Dead, it provokes reflection on the mystery of dying. Immerse yourself in magical worlds and uniquely sculpted meditative environments!

name: MV Mazes
short_description: MV Mazes - A 2D game, where you need to find a way out of the mazes.

name: Kabukicho Story
short_description: An emotional story about relationship between poor village girl and a boy from a noble family. Can the loving ones from different social strata find happiness in they live?

name: 雾之本境S Conspiracy Field: Fog Shadow
short_description: 终年雾气笼罩的山区，封闭化管理的神秘高中，张泊岩作为转校生来到这个世界。凶案发生，自称雾之境主的凶手游荡在校园中。死亡步步逼近，反抗还是逃离？您将通过主角张泊岩的视角，最终揭示真相。

name: Tommy's Tragedy
short_description: By the will of fate, Tommy finds an erotic magazine, but the owner of shameful images immediately finds out about it. Such a lot of trouble for such a little boy...

name: Choco Pixel 6
short_description: Choco Pixel 6 is a minimalist colorful puzzle which goal is to get the toy car to the finish using 4 directions in space and avoiding traps.

name: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter: Prologue
short_description: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter is a story telling simulator where you play as a paleontologist, exploring different lands and searching for dinosaur fossils. The Prologue tells a story about a young Paleontology enthusiast and his passionate pursuit of success and self-determination.

name: American Camper Simulator
short_description: Refurbish an old camper. Give it a spin on a selected stretch along the Route 66. Show off your camper to other tourists during your camping holiday, to sell it at a profit. Expand the business and earn money; have crazy and sometimes dangerous adventures in the USA in your subsequent camper.

name: The Fall of Eskaria
short_description: "The Fall of Eskaria" is an old school game in the finest tradition of action platformers with unique jazzy music and cartoon art style.

name: Alien Cat 3
short_description: Having found his home on one of the distant planets, the space cat decides to settle down on it. But the local creatures did not appreciate this choice and decide to drive away the furry alien. Our task is very simple, to protect yourself and your shelter from the attacks of unfriendly monsters.

name: Count of Hatchet
short_description: In a crumbling empire, you are the Regent of Hatchet, facing dwindling resources and advancing enemies. Forge alliances or stand alone, navigate political intrigue, and make choices that shape your realm. Will you defend your legacy or succumb? Your decisions dictate Hatchet's fate.

name: Fox! Hen! Bag!
short_description: In this short first-person adventure game, you have to bring your friends over to the other mountain by using a tramway car. But beware! Each friend has their own agenda. You have to talk to them to decide which order they should be moved in. Based on a classic riddle.

name: Dextrissimi
short_description: With multiple character archetypes to choose from, beautifully crafted 2D art, and a simplified attack system, Dextrissimi allows beginners to face-off against veteran fighters on an even playing field in a true test of instinct and skill!

name: Action SuperCross
short_description: The grandfather of all physics-based motorbike simulation games. This retro gem is the predecessor of Elasto Mania, a truly unique and challenging experience. Try this piece of gaming history yourself!

name: The Ice Caves
short_description: Welcome to Death Mountain, stranger! So you want to be the new Herald of The Mountain, huh? Well, if you're any good at 2D jumpin', gun-slingin', and puzzle-solvin', maybe you should give the The Ice Caves a run for its money.

name: CHV: VR Trunk Escape
short_description: VR Hacking themed escape room challenge

name: Treasure of Cutuma 3rd
short_description: A simple TPS game. Video distributor "Cutuma 3rd"s fan game. Get all the 5 treasure cards. Visit the fascinating sights of the Cutuma Tower, Gamegulland, etc in the Cutuma Republic.

name: Home: A Quarantine Story
short_description: A narrative adventure game about being trapped at home during the COVID-19 pandemic. For fans of To the Moon, Gone Home, and Night in the Woods.

name: Battleground
short_description: Battleground - A game in the genre of last man standing or royal battle. Fly to the island, find the weapon, get ahead of the enemies and win the round!

name: Seeker 2
short_description: Help Alfie and Elfie in an all-new adventure.

name: Flowers Garden Solitaire
short_description: In this Solitaire card game, we invite you to find yourself in the world of flowers and gardens. Play 120 unique levels, discover 12 fantastic gardens and enjoy the beautiful graphics.

name: Karting Grand Prix Minigame
short_description: Karting Grand Prix of Minigame is a 3D kart racing game where you can have fun and you will have to overcome mini-games

name: Lumione
short_description: Lumione is a platformer game set in a deep-sea universe. Join the protagonist Glimmer on a journey in search of the Light as you put your wit to the test in solving challenging puzzle-like levels. Learn from your failures and restore the Light of Hope to the seabed.

name: The Last Saviour
short_description: A first-person shooter in the style of survival and science fiction. Before you stretches a huge unexplored forest. Which is beautiful during the day and very scary at night. But be careful! At every step you can expect a werewolf who can take over your mind.

name: Hentai Milf Quiz
short_description: You must remember the school curriculum and answer the most interesting questions on the topic of the lesson, just remember that it is not so simple, because after the correct answer your game teacher will remove one piece of clothing from himself.

name: BOT.vinnik Chess: Combination Lessons
short_description: Nowadays everyone is a self-proclaimed chess player! Quite different from the soviet kids back in the old days. Maybe you are not so lazy and really want to improve your chess knowledge. Surprise me!

name: Freedom: How I Escaped
short_description: This is your chance. The time has come to put oppression in your past. The escape plan is ready, but you must avoid all surveillance and run undetected. Its time to make your own path. To make your own future. Its now or never.

name: Blu : Chronicles of Talpa
short_description: Play as a ninja and explore a fantasy world filled with deadly creatures to save your kingdom from corrupt Guardians. Play in local co-op to give your opponents no rest!

name: Aster Fpv Drone Simulator
short_description: Aster Fpv is the Fpv Drone simulator including fps mode, play in multiplayer or alone. Sneak between moving construction cranes. Practice chasing cars. Race single or multiplayer between buildings and natural obstacles.

name: Hand Shadow
short_description: Challenge your mind with puzzles that are based on optical illusions. Find the perfect position and angle by rotating the hands until order is restored, and discover a story of protagonist Morgan with professional voicing.

name: Bunny Memory
short_description: Train your memory in a 3D game with the bunnies alone or together with a friend. Collect memory points to unlock fragments of memories.

name: IxSHE Tell
short_description: At long last - we, the student council, have won you your freedom to love! The moment I declare these words, my classmates come surging forward, surrounding me in a circle of cheers that echo across the entire campus.

name: Aokana - Four Rhythms Across the Blue - EXTRA1
short_description: Aokana - EXTRA1 is the official Mashiro afterstory for Aokana.Experience even more Aokana in 1440p!

name: Sherwood Extreme
short_description: A co-op Crossbow Shooter with Bullet-Time Parkour! Race through levels and horde mode, chaining combos of slow-mo sniping and destruction to climb the leaderboards. Build maps in the Level Editor.

name: Inspector Javert and the Oath of Blood
short_description: An adventure mystery game set in the world of Victor Hugo’s Les Misérables.A game for people who:Like to solve mysteriesEnjoy exploring beautiful pixel art environmentsWant their dialogue choices and moral decisions to matterAre fans of Les Mis!

name: MORTE
short_description: En MORTE experimentarás el terror más grande de tu vida, necesitarás una mente fuerte para no enloquecer y salir con vida, ¿crees que tus habilidades de rescate son lo suficientemente buenas? Averígualo

name: Labyrinth of the Chaka King
short_description: Take on the role of Tokiko the archaeologist as you make your way through the ancient Labyrinth of the Chaka King. 2D platforming fun for the whole family!

name: Crazy Kung Fu
short_description: Are you ready to start your KUNG FU FITNESS journey today? With a focused mind and a strong body, embark on the challenge to become the greatest Kung Fu master of all time! Join Crazy Kung Fu to start your training, improve your reflexes, get fit, and become the ultimate Kung Fu force!

name: Nine Lives
short_description: To earn its nine lives a cat must survive the nine trials by solving increasingly intricate puzzles, that might require it to die a few times.

name: Master vs Slave
short_description: Play as master or slave in a RPG fantasy setting, where your choices determine the ending.

name: 牝静的开端
short_description: 嘿，你知道吗， 总会有些寻常的人， 背后隐藏着一些不可思议的事呢？ 在某个特别的日子里， 似乎有人曾这么对我说； 在那很久之后， 我才想起， 这句话本身的含义。

name: Polycalypse: Last bit of Hope
short_description: Survive the zombie apocalypse by yourself or with your friends in this low poly post apocalyptic world. Survive, build your base and fight the zombies. But beware, you aren't the only one trying to survive. There are other survivors in proceduraly generated bases that will shoot you on sight!

name: Kitori Academy
short_description: Kitori Academy is a life simulator where you live the adventures of a wizard apprentice with your spirit companion. Train your magical skills and learn how to brew potions, grow vegetables and catch spells to challenge the curse that lurks in the world.

name: Solitaire. Elemental Wizards
short_description: Classic Solitaire in a fantasy setting! Help Archmage Gideon regain his former glory!

name: Carnage
short_description: Carnage is a multiplayer vehicle creation/destruction-based game where players must try to dominate an arena with their personalised carnage vehicle. With an array of weapons to suite any playstyle, only your enemies can stop you now.

name: Slime Up
short_description: Slime Up is an infinite jumper where you jump around the city spraying mucus out of your nostrils and sliming people who get in your way. Rise to the top taking powerful powerups. Just be careful not to fall in the river of slime beneath you...

name: Lost
short_description: Lost is a with Chinese style mysterious unreal story is setting, contain all sorts of Chinese style ghost legend and content card card player of Rougelike adventure game ACTS the vagabonder that loses memory, set foot on unknown journey.

name: Wait! Life is Beautiful! Prologue
short_description: W!LiB! Prologue allows you to try and live one day of Will's life in trying to save people on the legendary Suicide Bridge. Would you be able to find the right words? How many souls could you save in one day? And how would you feel if you're not good enough?..

name: The Cosmic Wheel Sisterhood
short_description: Immerse yourself in an enchanting narrative experience as Fortuna, a fortune-teller Witch condemned to exile on her asteroid home. Craft your own Tarot deck, regain your freedom, and shape the fate of the cosmic Witch society.

name: Demon Tamer
short_description: Tame beasts and demons, use them to fight other demons, train them, and win back your country.

name: Little Fire Girl
short_description: Relaxing puzzle games to keep you in a good mood

name: Chroma
short_description: Zombies, medieval combat armor, sharp and pointy weapons... what's not to love? Chroma is based in Medieval Europe with one unique twist: the continent is overrun by the undead and you've been tasked with repelling The Horde. You're not the only one on the case though.

name: Mr. Prepper: Prologue
short_description: Mr. Prepper: Prologue is a free standalone version of the game Mr. Prepper, featuring an essential part of the story.

name: Chimeras: Cherished Serpent Collector's Edition
short_description: A series of deaths plague a small town, but who or what caused them?

name: Golf On Mars
short_description: For centuries, philosophers and mathematicians have gazed up at the night sky and wondered: "Is there Golf On Mars?"

name: Ecchi Jack
short_description: Welcome to the Casino XXX! Cute girls are ready to serve you. You can play blackjack, chat with girls, or even undress them. Search for the key to get intimate with a girl. Or just stare at her chest.

name: HORROR TALES: The Wine
short_description: Explore a post-pandemic fictional Mediterranean island and confront your fears! Immerse yourself in a seemingly abandoned city and struggle to find a precious Banydebosc red wine bottle to cure your loved ones. But be aware; your Nemesis is hunting you. Indie Jumpscares included! :D

name: Mythos Party
short_description: Hack, slash, punch and slap your opponents for the glory of the gods and be rewarded with their divine power! Become a champion in Mythos Party, a free-to-play brawling party game set in a light-hearted mythological universe for up to 8 opponents.

name: State of Decay 3
short_description: Unite to survive: push back the blood plague to reclaim the land's resources and carve out a life in the zombie apocalypse.

name: Oath
short_description: Take the Oath, overcome the Trials, and discover the truth of the Heart in this original indie RPG.

name: Kawaii Memory
short_description: Repeat the light sequence to pass to the next level! - Come and train your memory in a relaxing way!

name: Tusk of Spirit
short_description: A plot driven 2D RPG about a young girl uncovering a deceptive government plot while attempting to fulfill her master's dying wishes

name: Artifacts
short_description: Become Strong And Reclaim What You Lost! Artifacts is a 2D adventure platformer set in an ancient interconnected kingdom littered with powerful relics. Collect synergistic artifacts to challenge the mighty, corrupted foes that lurk beneath the ground.

name: The Night Fisherman
short_description: A short, twisted tale about a smuggler and a late night encounter in the English Channel. Control the camera and make tough choices, will you escape with your life?

name: Wreck the Insects
short_description: Wreck the Insects - An arcade-style shootem' up with a floral twist!

name: 韦弗利山 - Waverly Hills
short_description: A real-time exploration horror game. You will explore an abandoned hospital in the game and search for key items to escape from birth. Please beware of those fears from darkness and unknown.

name: 灰烬行星与填鸭少女
short_description: 在河北省，核大战后孤独的世界末日，机器人守卫在尘封的考场。 长久的等待之后，全国最后一名考生探出了路口。 再过一年的六月六，高考结束之后，在这个一片荒芜的世界，两人又该何去何从……

name: Limiter!
short_description: Go on a tile-hopping journey with Limiter, an AI programmed to see the world in puzzles. Master bouncing 2 spaces at a time through 7 challenging chapters, restore power to every tile and bring the ARCANE system back online in this addictive and challenging puzzle game by Alex Knowles.

name: Calorie Defenders
short_description: Join the Calorie Defenders, brave veggies defending inside the body against the Candy Army using tower defense combat and Metroidvania-style exploration. Strategically place defenses to defeat enemies and unlock new powers. For fans of action defense games like Orcs Must Die and Dungeon Defenders.

name: From The Grave
short_description: Zombie Survival Game

name: Piggy Gambit
short_description: Piggy Gambit is a game that harmoniously combines the elements of chess, box puzzles, and flow control into a coherent puzzle game about a piggy searching for the meaning to his life.

name: Do Noob Corporate-slave Dream of Boss's Ass?
short_description: Swipe the card, make a decision, and accept the verdict in the career!

name: Pop-It! Or Don't..
short_description: Pop-It! Or Don't.. Is an apathetic, fast paced, physics based, balloon popping click-fest! Keep popping balloons until the timer runs out to advance to the next round! Or don't.. See if I care.

name: Rise of the Ronin
short_description: Embark on an epic journey across war-torn 19th-century Japan in this open-world action RPG from Team NINJA, the veteran studio behind "Nioh" and "NINJA GAIDEN."

name: BALAN WONDERWORLD
short_description: Welcome to BALAN WONDERWORLD—a wondrous all-action show, the likes of which has never been seen before! Over 80 different costumes give you all the action that you could possibly imagine!

name: Marie Antoinette's Solitaire
short_description: In this historical Solitaire game you have been invited to take a peek into the life of queen Marie Antoinette. Earn beautiful trophies and help Marie pick the accessories for her signature hairdo – all by playing the classic game of solitaire.

name: Space Castle
short_description: Space Strategy. A mix of tower hold games and role-playing action.

name: Demonic Blade
short_description: A boy. A demon. A pizza delivery girl. Sometimes all you need is to be in the wrong place at the wrong time. Everything is different than it seems to be.

name: Oops! Zombie Swarm
short_description: An unknown virus has turned most people into zombies. In this disaster, you unexpectedly discover a mysterious dragon egg, which seems to grant you immunity to the virus. Now, your mission is to protect this precious dragon egg and ensure it is not destroyed by hordes of zombies.

name: Enoma: A New Beginning
short_description: Enoma: A New Beginning is a casual simulation game with a touch of puzzle. A group of survivors arrives on the mysterious island of Enoma. Help them stay alive while discovering the island's many mysteries. Build, farm, grow, solve puzzles and be dazzled by this beautiful and relaxing island.

name: Infinite Tournament Paintball
short_description: Infinite is a modern era paintball game that aims to capture the real world aspects of tournament style paintball. Featuring X-Ball format of up to 10V10, Online and Offline Play, markers set to 10.5 ramping, slide or dive into your bunker and engage in competitive matches

name: Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism
short_description: Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism is a (hi)story-driven turn-based strategy set in the WW2 period. It offers refined wargame mechanics, story-rich gameplay, and modern 3D graphics. Lead the USSR Armed forces staging the world Communist revolution. For Stalin! For the Motherland!

name: Furry Nya
short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 9 Empires
short_description: A new release in the Empires series, featuring a mix of thrilling action and country capturing simulation. Experience the human drama of the Three Kingdoms in a way only Empires can provide. Fight exciting Castle Sieges and manipulate the country's Politics. Welcome to the Empires experience!

name: Afterinfection
short_description: Afterinfection is a brand new zombie survival game designed in Unreal 4 and being developed by a small team from Thailand. After creating your survivor, you’ll start with nothing and have to make your way across a large island searching for food, water, weapons, and crafting supplies.

name: BlackJack Math
short_description: BlackJack Math is a game about mixing the cards to match the correct formula in order to get 21 as a result. Swap the cards in order to find the correct order to solve the puzzles.

name: The Great Adventures of Hemeko & CH0_CH0
short_description: I am wandering through Hemeko, Cho_cho, and P-hole through which I travel through the endless universe using P-hole, and I am seeing and feeling a lot of things. Where else will I start my adventure this time?

name: Reiterland - Meine Rennpferde
short_description: Reiterland: Meine Rennpferde is a horse racing game. Select your horse and equipment for the race and beat the time or complete missions. Control the horse with the keyboard in three difficulty levels. Compete against up to 7 other players via the internet on different tracks in all four seasons.

name: Die drei Freunde von der Reitschule
short_description: Real estate sharks are targeting Laura's uncle's beautifully located riding school. To save the indebted riding school, Uncle Arthur needs a lot of money, which his son Christian wants to win by winning the big horse show. However, a mysterious accident prevents him from doing so.

name: Notre-Dame de Paris: Journey Back in Time
short_description: Ubisoft proposes a Virtual Reality visit of Notre-Dame de Paris in real time, based on the XVIIIth century reconstitution from the videogame Assassin’s Creed : Unity.

name: We Were Here Forever
short_description: You both awaken imprisoned inside the sinister Castle Rock - were you betrayed, or simply not that clever? Find out in the greatest co-op puzzle adventure in the We Were Here Series! Do you and your partner have what it takes to face the dark forces of this realm or will you be trapped… forever?

name: Cocaine Dealer
short_description: A clicker/management drug dealing simulator. Get your product cut and wrapped quickly and out on the streets. Build your crew, expand your operation, and climb the supply chain. Stay ahead of the cops, keep your crew in line, or pay the price.

name: Space Pioneer
short_description: The shooter game to give aliens a taste of space justice throughout the galaxy.

name: Gatewalkers (Alpha)
short_description: Gatewalkers is a cooperative action RPG game with survival elements, where players travel across different worlds in order to save their own. Explore procedurally generated worlds, face hostile inhabitants, face challenges like extreme weather conditions, toxic atmosphere, lack of water and more.

name: Contact Spotted
short_description: Contact Spotted is a tactical 5 vs 5 first-person shooter where you will have to rely on your teammates to complete your task. You will be deployed on a map as a law-enforcement officer or a terrorist and engage in different gamemodes, everything from bomb defusal to zone defending.

name: Oniria Crimes
short_description: Oniria Crimes is an interactive noir novel with point & click mechanics. Explore crime scenes in a dreamlike world where objects are the only witnesses. Six cases, a hidden conspiracy. Only you can uncover the truth behind the crimes of Oniria.

name: Inexplicable Deaths In Damipolis: Inner Thoughts
short_description: One tragic night, the power dome of Damipolis died during dinner under strange circumstances... What were they doing there? What really happened that night? And... who is the culprit? Solve the mystery in this first-person 3D graphic adventure, inspired by classic film noir.

name: World Process
short_description: The world is roughly a futuristic game in which you play as a "human will" rather than God. The main description of the game is an uncertain fate, macro diversity of the future world.

name: Yolo Space Hacker
short_description: Welcome to our ethical hacker's organisation: we will teach you how to use actual hacker tools (terminal, proxy, reverse shells...) to scan the network, crack passwords, bypass server security and solve the mystery of the Bikini-72 space station.

name: Touhou DollDraft
short_description: Touhou DollDraft is a game in which you form teams comprising “dollified” Touhou Project characters and send them into battle against each other.

name: 4ife
short_description: You have to overcome the challenging tasks you have to do in order to return from the parallel universe you are sent to to your own universe. But remember this: Returning home will not be as easy as you think. Find the portals and collect ancient coins.

name: Hellsweeper VR
short_description: DARE TO DESCEND INTO HELL? Hellsweeper VR is an intense first-person action-combat VR experience. Traverse the underworld where every step brings a challenge or a chance. Gain mastery of your weapons and elemental magic, or fall to the unrelenting onslaught of hell's twisted souls.

name: The Haunted Exmone Theatre
short_description: The Haunted Exmone Theatre is a 2D Survival Horror Game based on the story of a paranormal investigator called Omar, who got an urgent call from the owner of the Exmone Theatre to investigate the building for the paranormal evidence.

name: PORN Handyman VR
short_description: Become a Handyman go fix the faults, take your payment ... Adventure known from porn movies - now on VR.

name: DoHots
short_description: A game from the devs of AChat, which is a kind of stripped-down offline version, where is a large number of sex poses and the ability to try different clothes. More than 10 sexy virtual partners, more than 250 hot animations in more than 20 detailed sex positions and 3 lifelike rooms.

name: ANCIENT EVIL
short_description: ANCIENT EVIL is a real-time tactical puzzle game where you need to pass severe tests and win the final battle with the enemy.

name: Go, Go Cowboy
short_description: Fast and hurricane Top-Down-Shooter where you act as a Sheriff in the Wild West and must quickly deal with all the bandits in the area, arm yourself with your trusty revolver and go on a dangerous journey!

name: Hard Driver
short_description: Incredibly beautiful and dynamic Side-Scroller, where you control a car that flew into the air with a super-cool driver must Dodge obstacles, flying past clouds, shooting off flying debris and collecting various Goodies on the way home!

name: Hard Driver 2
short_description: A new part of the hurricane runner, where you act as an unlucky driver who tries to get to his home, can you Dodge obstacles, jump over cliffs, collect coins and improve your car to help the driver in his difficult game of survival?

name: ClickMonster
short_description: An incredibly colorful and dynamic clicker in which you will plunge into the world of unique monsters, visit amazing worlds and acquire new improvements over time.

name: Nightmare Zone
short_description: Nightmare Zone is an indie horror game made by two people. Run away from your nightmares, explore all areas of the dream world and find 5 doors in a row to escape. Will you be able to wake up? Something is looking for you and if you get caught you'll have to restart.

name: Alt254
short_description: Alt254 is a minimalistic open-world action-adventure game. Explore a map full of surprises, evade traps and hazards and fight enemies as ■, set on a journey of exploration and self-discovery, trying to understand the world around you in order to overcome its many dangers.

name: Askold: Path of the Shadow
short_description: Askold: Path of the Shadow is a stealth game with exciting story. Investigate extensive levels from a cosy small village to the shadowy hostile swamp. Beat your enemies and complete the mission in the most unexpected ways. Inquire the complicated storyline and determine the fate of the Kingdom.

name: Solus Sector: Tactics
short_description: A single-player turn-based strategy with simple mechanics. Control spacecrafts, pick skills, and build bases to reach the center of the galaxy. Each sector presents a new tactical challenge and unfolds the story-line.

name: Super Huey™ III
short_description: Super Huey™ III is a direct sequel to the PC’s first helicopter simulation, featuring tense combat and daring rescues in over 35 dramatic missions! This revamped version of the 2003 classic enhances the original while still packing all the high-flying and explosive action you remember.

name: As Dusk Falls
short_description: Explore the entangled lives of two families across thirty years in an original interactive drama from INTERIOR/NIGHT. Starting in 1998 with a robbery-gone-wrong, the character's lives depend on the choices you make.

name: Steel Thunder
short_description: Lead an elite tank crew in one of four frontline U.S. tanks of the Cold War era, including the M60A3, M48A5 Patton, M3 Bradley CFV, and the devastating M1A1 Abrams. Assume the roles of Commander, Driver, and Gunner in an indomitable war machine that rolls out of the west like steel thunder.

name: Corridor 7: Alien Invasion
short_description: This terrifying 1990s sci-fi first-person shooter from Capstone Software has you venturing deep into the dark and twisting test chambers of Corridor 7 to combat a hostile takeover of Earth.

name: Castle on the Coast
short_description: A hand-drawn, retro 3D collectathon. Parkour through a magic castle as George the Giraffe! String together sweet moves to explore crystal caverns, stone laden halls, and trippy alternate dimensions.

name: Furry Woof
short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

name: Fuhrer in LA - Special Edition
short_description: Fuhrer in a LA is a grindhouse-styled top-down action-adventure game which takes place around 1947, unraveling the truth about the demise of the Fuhrer post World War 2.

name: Coronavirus - Nano Force
short_description: A fast-paced arcade shooter where you pilot a nano-ship in the fight against the Coronavirus. Grab powerups to upgrade your weapons and eliminate the virus infection.

name: Detour Bus
short_description: Build ridiculous highways to guide the Flowers family on a psychedelic road trip across post-infrastructure America.

name: Sylphy and the Sleepless Island
short_description: One day, professional thief Sylphy learns of the mystical and valuable artifact of the Kingdom of Diezel, but the mission goes sideways and she ends up robbing the island of its night! She has one week to right her wrongs in this action-filled RPG!

name: Lisa and the Grimoire
short_description: Hoping to hit a big payday and pull herself from a life of poverty, Lisa heads to a town with a rumored demonic artifact. But upon arriving, she quickly realizes she has gotten herself into a dangerous situation.

name: The Dead End
short_description: An ancient witch, a living dungeon, an undead curse, and a lost Holy Maiden. Greater men than you have fallen in the cursed dungeon of Witchhome. What awaits you in the depths? Fame? Or infamy?

name: The Triumphant Return of Diabolos
short_description: Many years after humanity came together to defeat the Demon Lord, a young man trained to become an imperial knight. One day, however, he was confronted by a mysterious figure who said, "We have been looking for you, Demon Lord Diabolos."

name: The Maiden, the Butler, and the Witch
short_description: Irina must leave home and complete her pilgrimage to become a full-fledged witch. However, the Demon Lord has built a castle on the island and summoned monsters threatening its citizens and her coming-of-age journey.

name: PRIMITIVE HEARTS
short_description: A voice calls out and four heroes hear its call. Can they rise to the challenge? Or will the Empire capture the land's Crystals and achieve their evil goals?

name: Evening Starter
short_description: A classic dungeon crawler RPG. When Ren Nosogi gets caught up in an incident that puts her in massive debt, she must use her skills as a Sweeper to take down an evil cult in order to pay it off.

name: Mage of the Olekta Desert
short_description: Aisha takes on a mission to deliver a letter to a mage living in the Olekta Desert. To her dismay, she must traverse the dangerous ruins and defeat the bandits and cultists that roam inside... or somehow get through unnoticed.

name: Castaway of the Ardusta Sea
short_description: Going on another solo adventure, Aisha sets off by ship. Unfortunately, a sudden storm and the incursion of a giant sea monster hinders her path. Through the turmoil, she is thrown overboard and wakes up on an unknown island. Aisha must find her way home and survive the pirates and monsters that lurk both above ground and in the deep.

name: Riders 2491
short_description: Riders 2491 is an action shoot'em up game that pays homage to the classics of 90’s arcades with modern visuals.

name: The Cabbage Effect
short_description: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter on procedurally generated stages that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

name: Bugz!
short_description: Venture into the world Bugz to capture, research and compete with your team of Bugz!

name: Jurassic Fantasy
short_description: Follow a young wizard in his path to find the Magical Stones and himself in this Jurassic Fantasy!

name: GUNBARICH
short_description: Shoot back the enemy bullets! The breakout-like shooter with a variety of items and gimmicks! With online rankings!

name: ZERO GUNNER 2-
short_description: Go through the 360 degree siege! The top-down shooter to operate a attack helicopter. And with online rankings.

name: SAMURAI SHODOWN
short_description: SAMURAI REBOOT! A brand new SAMURAI SHODOWN game takes aim for the world stage!

name: Nofrills Solitaire
short_description: A fresh take on Solitaire Klondike with no distractions.

name: Himeko Maid
short_description: Join Suzuka as she enters the first Himeko Maid contest! Choose your maid, complete the events, and become an expert in Night Service Training!

name: Mad Games Tycoon 2
short_description: Start your own game development studio in 1976. Build your own offices, production facilities and server rooms. Develop the games of your dreams and produce the next next-gen console. Rise from a small garage company to a huge corporation.

name: MadGuns
short_description: Multiplayer free-to-play first-person shooter. Crazy weapons, battle strategy, dynamic gameplay. Win the battle for territory with your team.

name: Everlasting Guilt
short_description: if you’re into Doom, Furi \ Titan Souls, this game will fulfill your needs with its FPS, fast-paced gameplay that heavily focuses on Boss fights, each with a unique approach that has its own mechanics, and a load of enemies to unleash your anger and test your arsenal upon.

name: Burning Lands
short_description: A tactical multiplayer first-person shooter in the Vietnam war era. It will be, what we coined, an “accessible tactical simulation” (ATS) - striking the best possible balance between realism and accessibility,

name: [TDA02] Muv-Luv Unlimited: THE DAY AFTER - Episode 02 REMASTERED
short_description: Muv Luv Unlimited: The Day After continues! The Shogun has come to Seattle, and with her, an installation that might solve the ongoing food crisis. But tensions simmer beneath the surface, as an unseen enemy waits for its chance to strike.

name: Hard Night VR
short_description: Post-apocalyptic zombie shooter. Survive.

name: Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion
short_description: Feel the exhilaration of fast-paced combat in your fully customized armored suit as you freely explore a deadly and dangerous world on land or in the air. Take on titanic boss battles with alone or with up to two other friends in online co-op!

name: Psyber
short_description: Psyber is an educational game that teaches players the fundamentals of Computer Science. Explore an alternate reality world of robots filled with fun interactive puzzles and dangerous traps while learning the fundamentals of programming.

name: Bad Apples
short_description: Bad Apples is an online multiplayer survival action game featuring fruits that ripen as they ripen over time. Change your or your opponent's stats according to the degree of ripening (if the fruit ripens too much, it rots) and use weapons and special moves to win the battle!

name: Orb and the Stars
short_description: This stellar story will require reflexion and dexterity! In the spirit of vintage marble board games with puzzles and mazes, use gears and gizmos to lead an orb trough constellations and rekindle all the stars!

name: Dolphin Trainer VR
short_description: Become a dolphin trainer. Start training, complete all tasks, obtain certificates and start working in the Dolphinarium. Work, train and play with the dolphins, love them ... but also try to free them.

name: Hyperspace Harvest
short_description: The whale is sick, dear child. Grow crops on its skin. Fight cells in its flesh. This is your purpose in this world. For the whale is god and it is sick and you are the remedy.​

name: Oneons: Prisoners
short_description: Oneons is a hard coffee-break roguelite. Explore 12 floors. Uncover dangerous enemies, each with unique abilities. Turn-based combat: fight or use your skills to blast enemies or heal. Balance exploration, energy, and combat. Die. Get stronger. Retry. Turn-based and easy to play, difficult to master

name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest
short_description: Explore the myths and monsters of Europe’s last primeval wilderness. Play as Maia, who arrives at the ancient Białowieża Forest looking to explore her family history. Discover Rage in an adventure game inspired by the experience of the legendary tabletop roleplaying game Werewolf: The Apocalypse.

name: Rappelz
short_description: Everyone can kill monsters, but have you tried to be friends with them? In this world, any monster can be tamed and made your ally. He will help both in PvP and PvE and grow with you! Choose a class and become the hero of this world in an absolutely free classic MMORPG!

name: Relic Guardians: Complete
short_description: Rock, paper, scissors meet anime turn-based fights and time travel!

name: Cobots
short_description: Manipulate time and cooperate with yourself to solve challenging puzzles! Delve into a colorful world filled with a variety of dangers and unique mind-bending puzzle mechanics.

name: Radiolight
short_description: Ashwood Creek, 1985. A child disappears without a trace. A local policeman is drawn into a national park, seeking the truth. Mysterious radio signals beckon him further and further. Investigate, survive and face the unknown in Radiolight— an '80s thriller by solo dev Krystof Knesl.

name: Truzzle
short_description: Take the ball to the end, without interruptions.

name: Moose Life
short_description: Moose Life is a trippy, psychedelic trance shooter. Created in the style of a 1980s arcade game, Moose Life offers you an exhilarating ride into the trance zone. Spectacular shooty action and a top techno soundtrack will raise your mood. If you have VR, immerse yourself for greater satisfaction.

name: Forsaken Barn
short_description: Psychological horror game focused on finding items and solving puzzles while you are being haunted by a demon.

name: 逃出囚笼 Rush Out Of The Room
short_description: This is a casual puzzle game. Games are pixelated. You need to pave the way by placing items on the left side and avoiding obstacles to reach your final destination. Please use your talents to overcome the obstacles.

name: GangV | VR & PC Battle Royale
short_description: Made for PC and VR featuring an Online Open World. A Battle Royale unlike any other with traffic, crowds, and law enforcement! Steal money, equipment, and vehicles and face the consequences. Hide among civilians to kill your opponents.

name: United Assault - Normandy '44
short_description: An open world rogue lite FPS set in 1944's depiction of Normandy. Unlock authentic weapons and command a captured Panzer III.

name: Bright Days in Quarantine
short_description: In a world where you need to stay at home to curb a virus pandemic, get your act together by revisiting old hobbies and find joy in the small things in this intense shelter game. Otherwise, you go insane!

name: Who Needs a Hero?
short_description: A stick and a dream: that's all you need in an RPG. Make choices that shape your destiny, build relationships, face epic monsters, and choose between being a feared villain or a legend.

name: Basketing
short_description: Basketing is the youngest sibling of Volleying! Thus, as another physics-based game, it also gives the players more control over their moves, delivering unique matches each round. Invite your friends over or play remotely and enjoy this predictably unpredictable experience!

name: Winter's Trumpet
short_description: A short interactive love story set against the backdrop of an 1918 flu inspired epidemic.

name: Hecatomb
short_description: A new old first person shooter. Shoot cultists and escape from their compound before they summon a demon that ends the world.

name: Antimatter
short_description: Antimatter is a sandbox strategy game, colonise planets, build your city on the surface or the underground. Build your spacestation or control your own spaceships to explore a huge and living galaxy !

name: Blocky Ball
short_description: Blocky Ball is a brand new take on a classic concept! Take on your friends in a 1v1 or 2v2 to fly through the sky and and score points against each other! This soccer style online multiplayer game provides quick effortless matches from random opponents or your friends!

name: Duality of Doodles
short_description: Duality of Doodles is an epic, side-scrolling platformer where you can draw your own protagonist, weapons and world items! Use your signature weapon, the pixelpen, to define your hero, defeat the evil stick-tator, help (or harm) the populace, and bring some much needed creativity back to the realm!

name: Big Cock Simulator
short_description: An ultimate chicken-male specimen simulator. Destroy the city, kill enemies, fight gigantic bosses

name: Call to Arms: Panzer Elite
short_description: Lead a platoon of WWII tanks in this immersive TPP and FPP game. Engage in realistic, tactical combat across historic battlefields. Play through campaign or challenge yourself in skirmish mode as either German or US forces.

name: Kiara And My Ara Ara Adventure
short_description: Meet Kiara. She's your new catgirl servant! She is a catgirl with an ara ara onee-san personality and a pretty peculiar gift... Learn about the world you have found yourself in and the pleasures that Kiara has to offer in this ara ara adventure!

name: Life of Food
short_description: Play through a campaign with multiple levels, or fight against or with your friends in the arena. Play as four different types of characters, plus a secret character unlocked by finishing the campaign. Each character has a unique set of skills and animations.

name: Realms of Eternity
short_description: Inspired by Thief Series, Dark messiah and Blade of Darkness. Psychics based combat, exotic weapons and mechanics.

name: Choices That Matter: And The Sun Went Out
short_description: Take part in one of the most complex interactive adventure stories ever written! What if the sun inexplicably vanished only to return hours later? Investigate with your AI companion, Moti. Uncover conspiracies. Discover ancient religions. Travel the globe.

name: Florida Simulator 1986
short_description: Play as Kevin the gator' hunter during the hot Florida summer of 86' in this super immersive s i m u l a t i o n 😎.

name: LINGERING
short_description: An LGBTQ+ Mystery Visual Novel with comic panel style aesthetics and pixel styled backgrounds. Join The Heart Breachers operatives as they navigate the world of desire, treachery, and emotional turmoil while learning to understand lofty concepts such as friendship, hope, and belief in oneself.

name: RainyCloud
short_description: Experimental game where you control a cloud and try to turn the floor to water. If you rank top your steam name will be shown and influence the game of all other players too.

name: Thymesia
short_description: Thymesia is a gruelling action-RPG with fast-paced combat and an intricate plague weapon system. In a kingdom where death spreads, play as a mysterious character known by the code name "Corvus". Prey upon your enemies, wield the power of disease and find the truth in your own memories.

name: I dream of you and ice cream
short_description: A sinister creature has enslaved mankind. Solve puzzles, gather components for a machine you are building, find comfort in your dreams.

name: Space Wave Race
short_description: Only the true heroes of space can become champions of Space Wave Race: the intergalactic championship that will take you to challenge the best pilots in the galaxy!

name: Xendless
short_description: What is Xendless? Xendless is a fast FPS mini-game that u can play alone or Co-op with friends

name: HORROR TALES: The Beggar
short_description: Control space-time to fight an evil monster in this terror and science fiction journey set in a shattered but beautiful world. Bend physics, the sky and the earth itself in engaging boss-fight encounters with the full power of Unreal Engine 5 and Nvidia DLSS.

name: Old School RuneScape
short_description: The best retro fantasy MMORPG on the planet. Old School is RuneScape but… older! This is the open world you know and love, but as it was in 2007. Saying that, it’s even better than that – Old School is shaped by you, its players, with regular new content, fixes and expansions voted for by the fans!

name: Detective Boiled-Hard / Case File - Death of the Space Dino Hunter
short_description: A dialogue focused comedy point and click adventure game

name: RuneScape ®
short_description: RuneScape is a high fantasy open world MMORPG. Explore an ever changing and evolving living world where new challenges, skills, and quests await. Featuring unprecedented player freedom, you choose how to play, adventure, and grow.

name: Yes Brother
short_description: 'Yes, Brother' is a short JRPG about a young gay priest trying to save a village from a demon who has been possessing its naughty inhabitants. Make choices, Perform sacred confessions, Lead people to Cher's Heaven, Walk on a gay priest student's shoes playing a JRPG with an elemental system.

name: Whiskers & Tail
short_description: Two cute mice are taking the laboratory by storm. Test your reflexes, memory and problem-solving skills by taking on a wide variety of puzzle-based tasks.

name: Selenwald
short_description: Selenwald is an action roguelike RPG that combines challenging combat with strategy and resource management. Take control of random adventurers to fight and sneak your way through eldritch horrors roaming the ever changing halls of Selenwald university.

name: Flow Gear Racing
short_description: Challenge your friends or compete against the computer in fast immersive Virtual Reality Space Races. Fly 16 tracks of varying difficulty and explore your self-built tracks together. Master the extra VR designed flight control system and cross the finish line first. Try the demo!

name: Karakia Shooter
short_description: Fast Paced, Bullet Hell Retro Shooter! Shoot down enemies and dodge everything. Fight through 17 intense levels with 6 insane boss fights. Do you have what it takes to beat the game?

name: Survival: Lost Way
short_description: Survival: Lost Way - is a sandbox game survival in an open post-apocalyptic world.

name: Conflict Area
short_description: Conflict Area is both a singleplayer and multiplayer game made by 2 developers.

name: Scary Hospital Horror Game
short_description: Get ready to escape from your fear. First Person Survival Horror Game And Escape Game.

name: Polyville Canyon
short_description: Polyville Canyon is a laid-back city builder where nothing bad ever happens! Relax while you build an entire city for your Neighbors piece by piece! Attract Neighbors and increase Ticket Prices by expanding your town and watch your profits soar!

name: True Detective Solitaire
short_description: How do you solve true detective's case? It's elementary! Complete 120 unique solitaire levels! Choose your settings and play!

name: Dealer's Life 2
short_description: Your favorite pawn shop experience is finally getting a sequel! Haggle like your life depends on it in this funny tycoon game. You never know WHAT is gonna stumble through that door!

name: 1001 Jigsaw: Earth Chronicles 2
short_description: The chronicles of planet earth in 1001 photos! Continue your unbelievable journey to study our world with Earth Chronicles 2!

name: Santa's Toy Factory Nonograms
short_description: Get into the spirit of the holiday with 120 exciting nonograms! Stop by and visit Father Christmas!

name: Break Space: Out of Bounds
short_description: Break Space: out of bounds is a game that will bring 80's nostalgia to today's modernity! Control a spaceship and prevent the Terran nation from being enslaved by the Marthians

name: The Last Braincell
short_description: Do you ever want to revisit the good old days of bouncing screen savers? Well not only can you do that you can also add whatever images you'd like to it, customize its background to whatever you'd want it to be, and even play around with them as you brain blast your last few brain cells!

name: Z-Race
short_description: Z-Race is a fun arcade hand-racing VR game. Control futuristic ships designed in the style of your favourite VR creators with their voice acting. Fly at super-fast speeds on chic sci-fi tracks, collecting nitro boosts and coins, avoiding energy traps and obstacles to become the first!

name: Fallen Hero: Retribution
short_description: So you're a villain now? Let's see if you survive the experience.

name: DR MILOS REVENGE
short_description: Tread lightly in the ice cold heart of fear. DR MILOS REVENGE is a challenging horror experience with suspenseful stealth gameplay, light puzzle solving and minimal hand-holding. Unlock Nightmare Mode after beating the game, a much more challenging and definitive way to experience the game.

name: Afraid Of The Night
short_description: Afraid of the Night is a psychedelic first-person horror game with a strong focus on story and exploration. Players control a young man in despair over a deeply traumatic event.

name: Mighty Fling
short_description: Take control of a mighty ball and fling with great precision towards the top of the Tower. Jump through aesthetically pleasing environments filled with intriguing creatures and encounters. Falling is part of the journey, so just keep going. Can you reach the end?

name: Subell's Abyss
short_description: Subell's Abyss is a sandbox looter shooter where everything is an item. Capture any enemy you like and summon it in combat, or steal the magic missiles it shoots and fire them from your gatling gun. Experience near infinite character-building potential in a mysterious world.

name: The Running Man
short_description: If you want to relax, this game is not for you, this game is made to make you rage. go through challenging and hard levels and run to the finish line. will you take the challenge?

name: Dooria
short_description: An intricate hardcore puzzle game within a world that feels both familiar and foreign, allowing you to lust for the solution or meander without aim for a journey entirely your own.

name: Trollhunters: Defenders of Arcadia
short_description: Explore the Trollhunters universe and save the world as Jim Lake Jr. in this action-packed game!

name: The Elf's Lewd Training
short_description: In this game, players subject the elf queen Elfin to lewd sexual training.

name: Bistro Days
short_description: Eat, drink, and fall in love at Bellflower Bistro. Bistro Days is a fun, over-the-top romantic story with choice-driven plots and multiple endings.

name: Viking Chronicles: Tale of the lost Queen
short_description: Join the adventure! Help the brave Vikings save their Queen and bring down the evil Ruans. In this great time management game!

name: Sudden Way
short_description: It's a fun and unusual platformer with modern pixel-art graphics and simple controls. Take the hero through an unknown and dangerous world full of mysteries and dangerous traps.

name: Mysteries Of Darkness
short_description: A roguelike single-player card game where you battle fierce creatures in turn-based combat. Win battles to improve your cards, and build a powerful deck capable of defeating the demon that opened the portal to hell.

name: GALSAD - Galactic Salvage and Disposal
short_description: Space-based 3D flight arcade game. Blast planetary debris and mine asteroids on your way to high mission scores. Climb the leaderboard. Solo developed indie game.

name: SUCCUBUS: Prologue
short_description: Become a demonic priestess of lust and use her unique skills to take revenge on your enemies. Regain your kingdom making hell tremble under your hooves! Leave no one alive if they won't bend the knee.

name: Teodoro and the Evil Machines
short_description: TEODORO 's home has been attacked by monsters who are stealing the VITAL ENERGY from his world to feed his evil machines with which they are going to steal from other worlds. Recover stolen VITAL ENERGY and restore balance to your world.

name: Kosta Projekt
short_description: -------The English version is now available ! :) ------

name: Spaceflux
short_description: An FPS arena shooter with mind-bending fractal maps! Fight in an impossible battle arena where the map contains itself in a never-ending loop. With online/splitscreen multiplayer deathmatches and a single player horde mode. 1.0 LAUNCHING ON JUNE 11 FOR $4.99!

name: Black Smith2
short_description: You are a blacksmith in a small rural village. You steadfastly earn your living by hammering out products daily, but at night, you take your earnings and go to town to seek out innocent and cute girls. Continue improving your experience and skills, so that you can raise the price of your products.

name: Apprentice Arriving
short_description: An atmospheric Fantasy RPG with fast-paced combat that include tactical elements. You dive into the role of Prince Landon, a young man with incredible strength who is send out on a mystical quest to unleash his slumbering powers.

name: vrkshop
short_description: vrkshop is a VR woodworking game. You are challenged to build projects with hand tools without snap-to-guides or limits on how to cut or fasten the lumber. The precision of your project is left entirely up to you. Have fun. Be productive.

name: Warspace 2
short_description: Warspace 2 is a 1-4 player CO-OP space shooter with RPG elements, open-world and procedurally-generated galaxy. You can trade, craft, and fight your way through a universe, either solo or with friends.

name: 300k - The Game
short_description: ...a funny implementation of the cellular automaton theory.

name: Retrowave Hexon
short_description: RETROWAVE style puzzle, hexagons, complex tasks, great music, lots of levels. There is something to think about.

name: Substantia Cana
short_description: Substantia Cana is an indie, puzzle-platform game with rich story. The game takes place in a stylized, abstract environment.

name: Crypt of the Gods
short_description: Play through a procedurally generated dungeon as a wizard trying to obtain more power to free themselves as well as people like you. Overcome the dungeon gaining power, new abilities, and new magic as you transverse through the dark depths.

name: Evolution adventure
short_description: "Evolution Adventure" is an adventure game with elements of deck-building, idle mechanics, and the creation of your own unique monsters. Discover unique combinations and crossbreed creatures in the evolution chamber. Unravel all the mysteries and find all the monsters.

name: FOOTSIES Rollback Edition
short_description: FOOTSIES is a simple 2D ground-based fighting game that both new and experienced players can pick up and enjoy right away. Featuring online battle mode with rollback netcode, implemented using GGPO open-source codes.

name: Throwing Stone
short_description: Throw your stone, and you are forced to move to the point where it stops. The rule is as the same as golf.

name: Unsung Kingdom
short_description: This is the Story of the once glorious Kingdom of Bellion. Ann, a time traveler from the future, fights to save the King from his fate to die.

name: Twin-Turbo Supercharged Nitro-Fueled Papamobile
short_description: Cyber-noir platformer in which you steer high-performance papamobile through a future city in order to deliver a cure that could save humanity.

name: Homeland: Lay to Rest
short_description: Homeland: Lay to Rest is a third person action-adventure game about a monk in training who fights corrupted guardians with a thrown homing weapon to redeem their overrun childhood home.

name: Stargaze
short_description: Gaze into the stars as a curious astronomer in this VR adventure of magic & science. Manipulate a strangely powerful telescope and influence a galaxy of planets and their inhabitants for the better. Take photos and conduct intricate research to uncover the deepest cosmic secrets.

name: AKER FERN - Visual Novel
short_description: Polish Visual Novel game with Polish Voice Acting for 6-8 hours of fun.

name: Thrust Legend
short_description: There are a lot of bad thrust clones out there... This is not one of them.

name: Finders, Keepers
short_description: A hike above ancient woodland on summer solstice.

name: GOD GAME
short_description: traditional jump climbing game this game uses only the left mouse button auto-save function available 概要 伝統的なジャンプクライミングゲームです。 プレイヤーはジャンプによって段差を上っていきます。 プレイヤー操作は全てマウスで行います。 ジャンプボタンのクリック保持時間によってジャンプ力が変化いたします。

name: OMG - One More Goal!
short_description: OMG - One More Goal! is an arcade / fighting game with soccer dynamics. Team play is essential: you win together, you lose together!

name: MagVigor
short_description: Fantasy Magic third-person MO Action RPG. Confrontations of magicians and knights on separate arenas in PvP and PvE. Fight! 🐺 Or run!

name: Lone King
short_description: An experimental game. Simultaneous turn-based sci-fi combat. Simple controls, deep gameplay inspired by chess. Designed for randomised, 10 minute, low-stress, tactical matches to make you think. Play the first chapters and the arcade mode for free. Support development with feedback.

name: Castle Heck
short_description: Castle Heck is a procedurally generated dungeon crawler that combines elements you love from Metroidvania with the chaos of Enter the Gungeon.

name: GUNPIG: Firepower For Hire
short_description: Sci-fi top-down twin-stick shooter with 9 weapons, 3 alts and secret hidden collectibles!

name: Zefyr: A Thief's Melody
short_description: In a colorful archipelago, play as a young thief studying at the Guild. Investigate kidnappings, steer clear of roaming pirates or fight them. Sail the ocean on a cute turtle and climb every island. Cure sick animals, and find the truth during this feel-good journey. Made by a dreamer solo dev.

name: Bomber Games
short_description: Bomber Games is a fun arcade game for up to 8 players. Do you like to EXPLODE your friends, laugh together in a couch? Battle in arenas and explode them in this bomberman-inspired game with unseen bomb types and original abilities. Want more? Create and share your own levels. BOOM!

name: Girabox
short_description: A minimalist puzzle game in which you rotate the world instead of controlling the player. Play through the many level packs and compare your score to others in the leaderboards.

name: Wotheguel
short_description: Do the tasks given in the tropical forest and get all the magic diamonds. Kill the resulting creatures and continue your mission. Protect yourself in the open world and remember that you are alone.

name: 12 Hours to Die
short_description: A mystery visual novel about six students forced to play a 12-hour long killing game.

name: CreepWars TD
short_description: Summon units in to defend key positions. Defeat waves of creeps to earn gold to upgrade your defenders. Adjust your defense to the enemies’ armor type by choosing the right type of damage. Select different upgrade paths and be aware that some creeps have special abilities.

name: Claw Crane Company
short_description: Claw crane store management game. Make machines, arrange the prizes well, and aim for the world's best claw crane store. It's not only manage, you can also play, and must play yourself on the machines!! You can also create original prizes and publish them at the workshop.

name: Mushroom Challenge
short_description: A mushroom hunter simulator. Here you can walk around the forest and enjoy the nature, meet different animals and, of course, gather mushrooms.

name: NO MAN IS AN ISLAND
short_description: Zombie virus swept the world, the infected people were isolated to some closed islands. Some organizations hold zombie hunting competitions. In a hunting, you're infected with the virus and abandoned on an island. The hunt is not over and you've gone from hunter to prey.

name: Super Psy Penguin
short_description: Super Psy Penguin is a Cyber Penguin Hero Simulator in which you play a realistic Cyber Penguin, giving you the power to save the galaxy! The game is inspired by Parodius and Xenon-II and many other Shmups from our childhoods.

name: Pokie The Stickfigure
short_description: Pokie The Stickfigure is a 2D platformer in which you play as the immortal Pokie himself. Jump and shoot through hordes of evil stickmen, demon sticks, and robots, until you reach the very end. Do you have what it takes?

name: LiveOnIdol

short_description: Travel around a fully-explorable, post-apocalyptic version of Earth and find the source of a mysterious radio signal. Collect supplies along the way to stay alive. Is there anyone out there?

name: Messy Room Simulator
short_description: Attention! This game IS NOT a training software that helps you organize your room better. On the contrary, it may in turn affect you in reality in some way. The room, whether the result is good or bad, the author of this game WILL NOT be responsible for it!

name: Park Beyond
short_description: Park Beyond is a theme park simulation game that gives you the freedom to create and manage the Parks of your Dreams! Whether you love to manage finances and visitor experience, or just create fun and cozy parks, the game has something in store just for you!

name: Heart Of Muriet
short_description: Explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate in Heart of Muriet! This real-time 4X strategy game immerses you in a vibrant voxel fantasy world fractured by conflict. As a powerful wizard, build your domain, research potent spells, and guide your forces to victory in a quest to reunite the realm.

name: Wildekin
short_description: You've fallen out of the sky with nothing but your wits, fists, and an overwhelming urge to redecorate. Explore and survive in a perilous wilderness, construct your town, and befriend lost Wildekin in a 1-4 player online multiplayer adventure.

name: Patient Zero
short_description: Patient Zero is a randomly generated twin-stick shooter game with great emphasis on its roguelike elements. it takes its inspiration from 80s sci-fi and action movies. You play as one of the hazmat crew enlisted in a top-secret adventure to find Patient Zero and stop another deadly virus.

name: Isle of the Crown
short_description: From a simple home to a mighty kingdom; explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate your opponent in this strategic pixel-art chess-like hex game using cards as your pieces and their abilities as your tools. As many games before it, and as the saying goes; easy to learn, hard to master.

name: Dark Farm
short_description: "Dark Farm" is an RPG raid game. You have to take care of your garden, which wants to kill you. Grow killer vegetables. Water your garden beds. Defend yourself.

name: VR Marco Polo's Travelling in Medieval Asia (The Far East, Chinese, Japanese, Shogun, Khitan...revisit A.D. 1290)
short_description: Visit ancient Far East scenes and ancient asian beauties, experience hunting, fishing and free creation (painting and writing, etc.), experience ancient life and enjou the fun like Marco Polo.

name: Beneath a Steel Sky (1994)
short_description: After being abducted by brutal soldiers and his kinfolk butchered, Robert Foster finds himself in Union City - a vast metropolis under the tyranny of a fascist AI. Alone, save for the circuit board of his best friend, Foster must discover the sinister truth - and why they specifically came for him.

name: Instability
short_description: A cross-platform competitive multiplayer real time strategy game. Build your base to destroy your enemy!

name: Pombero - The Lord of the Night
short_description: Overcome fear, solve the mystery behind the story, in this psychological horror game

name: PSYCRON
short_description: A fast-paced 2D handcrafted metroidvania with strange sci-fi environments. Something is roaming the halls, watching your every move.

name: Sokodice
short_description: Sokodice is a puzzle game where you must navigate dice through mind boggling levels to match the number of the dice with the number on a designated tile.

name: Voidwalkers - Astora's Darkness
short_description: You are the chosen, free of all, but in order to transcend, you must be the servant of many. For in order to gain the weak, ye must become the weak. Enter the Void, and walk the path of the Enigma. For many chase a corruptible crown, and you must prove that you are incorruptible.

name: Dead Horizon
short_description: An adventure game that mixes rail shooter elements into a world of sand, dust, and blood. You play Bonnie Star, former murderous gunslinger now turned carnival sideshow act, as she tries to find redemption at the end of a gun.

name: Rogue Randy
short_description: This game is a TOP-DOWN, horror RPG. Visibility is very limited... everything else pretty much isn't. Explore the map, collect power-ups, and see how high your score can get before you beat the game.

name: Play with Me 2: On the other side
short_description: It is the sequel to the game Play with Me: Escape room. Use again the available objects in your room, outwit tricky illusions and optical puzzles and above all, answer the question – will you Play with Me TOO?

name: Healing Movement
short_description: Gentle stepping and posturing movements are done to help you feel calm and aware of how your body works.

name: CustomCross
short_description: CustomCross is a utility that enables you to display an image anywhere on your windows desktop, overlaying any windowed or borderless applications. Use it to add a custom crosshair to your favorite FPS or to add custom visual elements to your screen!

name: Black Knight - Milena
short_description: A gifted rookie Black Knight Milena is making her great debut!! …Or at least that was her goal before she messed up on her mission because of her inexperience. And so began her training to become a better Black Knight with Master Celia! If only her behavior could also be improved…

name: Beach Volleyball Competition
short_description: Beach volleyball fun game. x2 game modes, 3D or 2.5D isometric projection. Easy game play controls. Realistic ball physics and speed. Several levels, with several music. Story mode have progress for increasing team skills. Match mode vs AI of other real users. Also can be available for mobile

name: 蛊婆-东海地宫 Lady in tomb -Beneath the ocean
short_description: A first-person adventure game. The Story continues from Lady in Tomb. Gu Jiuxun became the new Gulady. But since then, she has stepped into the curse of "die before 30 years old". In order to save her, Hu Nian determined to find the immortal medicine in the undersea tomb where Xu Fu is buried.

name: Cage(囚岛)
short_description: Cage is an independent story RPG. Players play the role of the young people who are immersed in their own spiritual world, wandering in the spiritual space, looking for the chapter of spiritual home. Spiritual space self dialogue, to find their own reasons for existence.

name: Jigsaw Puzzles: Master Artists of Old
short_description: Jigsaw Puzzles depicting the beautiful paintings of the old master artists!Immerse yourself in the stories that these master artists weave in their paintings! Witness their incredible skill and knowledge of light, form, shadows, and colour!

name: The Line
short_description: The line, is a game with puzzles integrated into the narrative. The story takes place in a dystopian future, where the sea level rose so much that it flooded most of the planet, thus collapsing societies.

name: The Mikado Birdgirl in Taichung
short_description: Wang Cheng-En escaped the Miaoli emperor's clutches with Pisuka. This time, they follow Mika to a holy city Taichung State. What awaits him? Will he eat lead, end up being buried as a bloated corpse in a ditch in the middle of Taiwan, or lead an ordinary daily life together with young girls?

name: RollerCoaster Tycoon® 3: Complete Edition
short_description: Build the park of a lifetime and rediscover the critically acclaimed rollercoaster simulation bestseller. Feel the thrill of a genre-defining classic, complete with two huge expansion packs.

name: 回纹战棋
short_description: There are 11 classes in the war board game. Each class has 4 skills, one passive, and 24 equipment (8 equipment have active skills). You can switch to the third-person perspective when fighting.

name: Cursed Treasure 2 Ultimate Edition - Tower Defense
short_description: Why be good when you can be... bad? Cursed Treasure 2 is a classic tower-defense game, remastered and carefully re-balanced. Build towers of powerful orcs, demons, and undead, and master powerful spells, to protect your precious hoard from all manner of no-good do-gooders.

name: Hong Kong Obscure
short_description: The year was 1999. Something happened that shook the world and it all ended up in the 2nd Dust district of Hong Kong. Big Pharma, Influential Political figures, OP-SEC Corporations, webs of spies with absence of allegiance. The truth is there, its all documented. Just have to connect the dots...

name: VTuber Maker
short_description: VTuber Maker is the #1 free, simplistic, and 3D Tool for VTuber Content Production, just with a webcam.

name: Fishing Sim World: Bass Pro Shops Edition
short_description: Fully endorsed by Bass Pro Shops and featuring an array of your favourite Bass Pro Shops equipment. Choose from 8 glorious US locations from Fishing Sim World and compete in career mode or play your way in multiplayer. An underwater camera will allow you to see the moment the fish strikes lure!

name: Rover Mechanic Challenge - ERC Competition

name: Speechless
short_description: Speechless is an "escape the loop" experience.

name: Combat Mission Shock Force 2
short_description: The latest title in the famous Combat Mission franchise of wargames, now on Steam. Shock Force 2 brings you to a hypothetical conflict in Syria between the forces of NATO and the Syrian Army. Play either on WeGo or Real Time in an incredibly detailed and realistic 1:1 tactical simulation.

name: Tome Rush
short_description: Manage and grow a team of wizards to explore magical mission sites of increasing difficulty! Building a well balanced and cooperative team is imperative as you defeat enemies, collect artifacts, and protect the world from a looming threat.

name: Croppy Boy

name: Dream Stone 2

name: Millville
short_description: Build a small village from the grounds up, meet and interact with its people and try to bring all different Villagers into your little town!

name: The Light of the Darkness: Renascence
short_description: Embark on a riveting journey in The Light of the Darkness: Renascence, a Metroidvania game with modern 3D AAA visuals. Explore the cursed Lands of Oblivion as the unique hybrid, facing ancient foes amidst a rich narrative. Unveil secrets through sophisticated cutscenes and challenging gameplay.

name: Pincremental
short_description: Become the Pinball Wizard you were destined to be! Master the pinball machine, cash out for powerful upgrades and automation, and climb the corporate ladder in this Pinball Incremental.

name: GNOMONIC
short_description: GNOMONIC - The Art RPG! In this ART-PG, walk through watercolor paintings, fight in real-time projectile battles, solve puzzles with shadows, meet friends with creative talents in worlds themed by artistic mediums, and discover a story about how we experience art... and how art experiences us.

name: Patagon
short_description: Patagon is a first person open world VR Steam Punk adventure shooter. It's fun and easy to play. The game takes place in an alternate steampunk reality where the British empire has never ended. Battle giant monsters and dinosaurs while you explore Sand Dollar island.

name: Strangeland
short_description: You wake in a surreal carnival, where a woman cries out to you before leaping to her death. Can either of you be saved? The denizens and devices of Strangeland answer with riddles, puzzles, and warnings of a Dark Thing lurking at the park’s peak. A new adventure from the creators of Primordia.

name: Obsolete
short_description: Obsolete is a short 2D platformer with a calm atmosphere in a very strange world where everything is deteriorating quickly. Cross the abandoned caves of this fallen world in search of an answer.

name: Spirit Messages
short_description: Type your question for the Spirit World to answer, then click the start button. Whatever the letters, numbers, and shapes remind you of, is the answer.

name: Being Mindful
short_description: In this awareness game you try to maintain awareness of aspects of your body for as long as you can. Body awareness is practiced sitting, standing, doing yoga, simple tai chi and other exercises.

name: Wacky Cartoon Racers
short_description: Play with a bunch of fun cartoon characters in a racing event for the Grand Prize of all Cartoon Land.

name: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights
short_description: ENDER LILIES is a dark fantasy 2D action RPG about unraveling the mysteries of a destroyed kingdom. On this sorrowful journey, encounter horrific enemies against whom a moment of inattention could be fatal. Overcome these hardships and seek the truth with the help of fallen knights.

name: Motor Town: Behind The Wheel
short_description: Enjoy realistic driving in the open world. Relaxing cargo deliveries or driving buses and taxis will give you enough money to buy new cars and parts. You can test your driving skills at the race track. It's all about pure driving pleasure!

Messengers with these letters travel the land and can be lost or intercepted. Generals execute orders upon receipt and send you reports the same dangerous way.

name: Solar Expanse
short_description: Explore the Solar System. Mine and drop asteroids. Colonize and terraform. Lead the space race and compete with other corporations on your way to profit. Watch the expansion of human race over the centuries. Then go beyond and conquer the galaxy!

name: Innchanted
short_description: Run a Magical Inn with friends! Yarrul’s family Inn has been stolen by an evil wizard landlord! Team up with friends to reclaim your family's legacy. Manage your inn, brew potions, fish, cook, and fight in this hectic & heartfelt magical adventure. Play solo or co-op for 1-4 players.

name: Citizens Unite!: Earth x Space

name: Dragon Lapis
short_description: The dawn of a new hero! A tale spanning a thousand years now begins to unfold!

short_description: Opus Ludum is a game of wit and skill, where you will have to overcome various challenges that will test your razor-sharp intellect at every step. Opus Ludum will give you a break from daily stress, although it might just break your head.

short_description: Swim ashore to 22 challenging levels, finding the most streamlined way of collapsing every building on each island. Navigating your way through Hard Hitting Tanks, Turn Tracing Jet Missiles, and Tazer Death Rays to destroy them all for trying to keep you from fulfilling your passion of DESTRUCTION!

name: 亡命尸潮惊魂夜 Escape Zombies At Night
