Interact with unique glitch mechanics, unlock 20 different Guises with battle and field abilities, solve puzzles, craft, fish, and more!

name: Abyss The Forgotten Past
short_description: Play as Leonnor who sets out on a journey to discover everything about his past and his world, things are not always what they seem! Learn special abilities, battle monsters and encounter celestial beings as you explore this beautifically crafted pixel world.

name: DEEP STATES STORY
short_description: This is a stand-alone boxing game, you need to choose the right time to punch in order to cause harm to the opponent. Straight punches are fast, and swing punches are strong. You can try to hit a combination punch with more damage.You may discover new things while playing.

name: Max and the Book of Chaos
short_description: “Max and the book of chaos” is and arcade 2D action game with elements of run and gun and shoot ´em up classic games with a strong arcade feeling. A kid who will have the destiny of the world in his hands. Will have to face this wave of disasters, save the world and free your buddies.

name: Underlings
short_description: Become one of the "evil" creatures and try to survive a world where everything wants you dead, gather resources, craft them into powerful items, build a base to protect yourself from everlasting raids or challenge your bosses to be more than an underling.

name: Trek to Yomi
short_description: As a vow to his dying Master, the young swordsman Hiroki is sworn to protect his town and the people he loves against all threats. Faced with tragedy and bound to duty, the lone samurai must voyage beyond life and death to confront himself and decide his path forward.

short_description: 加入琪露诺拯救妖精的冒险！《琪露诺的信仰之战》是一款轻量级的回合制游戏，操作琪露诺调查妖精力量衰退后的真相，运用策略逐步解开被封锁的场景，并迎击所有阻扰在你面前的敌人！

short_description: Sarab 2: Thalj Mountains is a JRPG-styled game which focuses on story-telling, exploration and turn-based battling. Each main character has its own mysterious story. Furthermore, the game has a unique atmosphere which absolutely makes it a different experience in comparison to other JRPG games.

name: Rezzil Index / Lite
short_description: Rezzil Index Lite is built on the same soccer simulation technology being used today in soccer clubs around the world to coach elite Premier League level players. Step onto the pitch and give it your best shot in Rezzil Index Lite's drills and challenges - VR soccer just got real.

name: Kao the Kangaroo
short_description: Inspired by the golden age of 3D Platformers, Kao The Kangaroo returns in a whole new adventure! Embark on an epic journey, master magical gloves, explore lush environments and take Kao through his most grand tale yet!

short_description: If you want to feel like an attentive owner of a restless cat, then this game will be to your taste!

short_description: Lands of Sorcery is a strategy RPG featuring turn-based combat, set in a time of savagery, mysticism and beauty. Equip and upgrade a roster of adventurers and travel the word in search for glory. A tongue in cheek love letter to classic sword and sorcery literature and movies.

short_description: Offroad Horizons dares you to drive the perfect line through a selection of epic trails and stunning environments, in an exciting selection of powerful offroad vehicles, aware that any miscalculations could end your climb.

name: Sir Squire

short_description: You've done something really bad, and the cops are hot on your tail trying to capture you for it. See how long you can evade capture in this fast paced action packed game!

short_description: A cyberpunk interactive narrative about finding purpose before the end of the world. Experience the last three days over and over, each attempt from new perspectives as you find your story in an infinite pre-apocalypse.

name: LA ULTIMA COMIDA
short_description: Zombies are everywhere and have been determined to make you their LAST FOOD. There are so many that you don't know if the slow steps and moans you hear come from the end of the hall or from the next corner.

name: Anetona
short_description: Embark on a quest across a multi-era world against humans, creatures and machines in order to rescue the princess from the evil red dragon.

name: Cuba2077
short_description: Game Created By The Reparteros.inc

name: Beat Flip
short_description: A fast paced casual game that will test your reflexes and mind.

name: Vessels
short_description: Quarantined inside an airlock. No memories. No way out. The remaining crew thinks there’s something wrong with you, but the Voice says it’ll help you escape. Navigate volatile conversations & unravel mysteries in this narrative adventure about trust, self-destruction, & shifting identities.

name: The Wicked Sorceress
short_description: Enter the Wicked Sorceress's lair! Fight your way using magic through waves of enemies and confront the Sorceress in an epic duel. Defeated by her new master, she lets you have your way with her.

name: Solenars Edge II: Champions
short_description: Create your character, pick your ally and assemble a powerful team of over 70 champions. Fight your way through the VR Arena and become the greatest champion of the entire universe.

name: Space Soldier
short_description: Space Soldier is a single-player adventure game, you will play the role of a Protagonist to clear the enemy in the level

name: Alien Cat 7
short_description: All cats are crazy about boxes! Except for this game, because boxes fall down your head!

name: Ant Force
short_description: Playing ant you will have an unbelievable fight with AI.

name: Cargo Company
short_description: Cargo Company is a transport simulation tycoon game where you make money by transporting passengers, wood, steel, goods, cars, tanks and more - using trains, trucks, busses, and even rockets between planets.

name: This Game Might Improve Your Memory
short_description: A short, experimental point-and-click adventure game with crass humor and horror. Also designed to teaches memory techniques.

name: Red Colony Uncensored
short_description: Red Colony is a 2D Ecchi Horror Game filled with drama, mystery, zombies and gore. Help Maria find her daughter and get revenge on her cheating Husband, whilst uncovering the truths of the origins of the virus.

name: Spartoi Meadow
short_description: Monster named "Meadowman" appears in a peaceful and boring villages. What is the fate of Mischa, a villager who ends up fighting them?

name: Flight Catastrophe
short_description: Flight Catastrophe gives you a unique opportunity to become a crisis management specialist aboard the passenger plane. You are the only one who can handle dangerous situations occurring during the flight! Command the crew, identify the threats, make difficult choices - many lives are on the line!

name: DarKnot
short_description: In DarKnot, you’ll get to explore the streets of a foggy city, and exterminate the monsters within. Insidious opponents, dynamic battles, and challenging puzzles are waiting for you! Your fate is in your hands, the way you approach those challenges is up to you…

name: A Fox Tale
short_description: She's the last of her kind. Join Eva in a quest to uncover her mysterious past in this captivating pixel art precision platformer. Run, jump, dash and climb your way across treacherous landscapes. Learn and master the ever changing terrain through hundreds of handcrafted challenges.

name: Myth of Empires
short_description: Myth of Empires is a multiplayer war sandbox game featuring a high degree of freedom and multiple civilizations. Players must survive, craft, create, and lead troops in their quest to conquer PVE or PVP territory and build their own empire. Xizhou Civilization Pack is now officially released!

name: Star Puzzle
short_description: A beautiful puzzle game in which you collect pieces into a whole picture, choosing between difficulty levels and dozens of levels, improving your skills, limited time and lives.

name: Apple Hopper
short_description: Apple Hopper Is a 2D akrad with a side view, the task is to jump on platforms as long as possible and not fall.

name: Clash Memory Game
short_description: An exciting game "Find a Pair", the game is not only entertaining, but also developing, helping to develop skills such as reaction, visual memory and accuracy. Search for pairs, open levels and look at pictures that the game will reward you for passing the level.

name: Incremental Adventures
short_description: Lead your heroes in their neverending adventures! A minimalistic Idle game where combat is fully automated. It's up to you to make the most of that automation to reach extremely high numbers!

name: Amira
short_description: A girl living happily in a middle eastern fantasy world, only to find out she is caged with no free will by the occupiers of her home, and her own family after her mother's death so she fights for her freedom, as she looks for love and acceptance.

name: Time For You - Chapter 01
short_description: A story-driven adult dating sim / visual novel with a detective style twist!

name: GRAVEN
short_description: Action, mystery, and a chance for redemption await you in the gritty first-person action-adventure GRAVEN. Explore a dark fantasy world as a wrongly convicted man of faith. Battle the horrors of humanity, the wilds, and beyond using armaments, magic, and the environment.

name: Divinest Light
short_description: Divinest Light is an atmospheric puzzle-platformer set in the mysterious and dark world with a unique shadow-avoidance mechanic.

name: Rogue Aces Deluxe
short_description: Rogue Aces Deluxe - the definitive 2D aerial combat roguelike. Explosive single player balletic chaos with sophisticated flight controls. With 1-4 player Dogfight Deathmatch modes and unlockable bonus games. Fly with panache and maintain your moustache!

name: Card Shark
short_description: Card Shark is an adventure game full of cunning, intrigue, and delectable deceit. Enter a world where you’ll need to play your opponents better than you play your cards.

name: A Little Bird
short_description: The A Little Bird contains 50 different puzzles and beautiful illustrations. Break the puzzle and complete the fairy tale book of the princess through dialogue with important characters!

name: Caste - The Secret Of Devon
short_description: In "Caste - The Secret Of Devon" you play an aspirant of the Water Caste, who was sent to live in Devon, a town of the Earth Caste, for at least one year. There you have to proove that you are willing to join the Water Caste.

name: T-Minus 30
short_description: Plan a city and build a space fleet to escape a dying Earth before time runs out. You have 30 minutes to scavenge a post-apocalyptic environment to build infrastructure, grow crops, generate power, and assemble rockets to save as many people as you can.

name: Birthright
short_description: Try to rise for power in a light fantasy medieval sandbox world. Where Lords and Families battle each other for the ultimate power. Become your own Lord, Merchant or Adventurer getting entangled in the lands history. Dedicated Server support.

name: Dust to Dusk
short_description: An occult mystery ADV set in a modern Japanese office. No chased elements, no surprise images, no game over, and an easy to play horror atmosphere.

name: Dungeons & Cocks
short_description: The plot of the game is dedicated to the life story of Matthew Delaney, an elderly Bon vivant who was forced to leave his country, after it had been captured. He reaches the shores of the New World, but the unknown land does not welcome old Delaney as warmly as he planned...

name: The Evil in the Forest
short_description: «The Evil in the Forest» is a 3rd-person fantasy horror adventure game. The game tells you the dark story of a man named Derek Bain - a single father who, being a researcher in the field of natural resources, arrives with his daughter Kate in a mystical forest...

name: My Nuclear Octopus
short_description: My Nuclear Octopus is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters that takes two minutes to learn and hours to master! It's an overload of sight and sound for you to lose yourself in. Can you make it to the top of the leaderboard?

name: Bamerang: Warm-Up Duel
short_description: Warm up your boomerang throwing skills in the free duel mode of Bämeräng, the fast paced boomerang fighting game. Fight for the favor of the goddess in an outlandish, colorful world in this local multiplayer game.

name: Space Cube Racers
short_description: Space racing game for up to 4 players (local, split-screen). It uses newtownian mechanics but with an easily to pilot control scheme where your ship will always thrust along your line of sight.

name: Solar Echoes: The Star Legation
short_description: Solar Echoes: The Star Legation is a choice-driven cinematic Sci-Fi Visual Novel game with RPG elements. Journey through space to gather and manage an alien crew, visit new worlds, negotiate with alien leaders, and even risk romance across the stars!

name: KYOKI
short_description: Kyoki takes the concept of original goal board games and makes it more fun to play every day. Kyoki is a three mode board sport. In Kyoki the aim of the game is to clear the play area of all the coloured tiles.

name: Worlds Align: Deadly Dream Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you and your friends save all the worlds in time?

name: Family Quiz
short_description: Running out of questions to use during your weekly family video chat quiz night? Look no further...Family Quiz does exactly what name suggests....a quiz for all the family.

name: Milo's Quest
short_description: A mini zelda-like 2D top-down puzzle/adventure game about a dog, bones and a lot of ghosts!

name: No Rest for the Wicked
short_description: From Moon Studios, the award-winning developers of Ori and the Blind Forest and Ori and the Will of the Wisps comes No Rest for the Wicked, a visceral, precision Action RPG set to reinvent the genre.

name: Flowstone Saga
short_description: Master a totally unique puzzle-battle system in this 16-bit, JRPG-inspired adventure featuring an epic story, charming characters, stunning pixel art, and epic music. Follow a grand story set in the mysterious Ocean's End islands full of lost memories, ancient ruins, pirates, treasures, and frogs.

name: Cube Shifter
short_description: Move left and right to dodge obstacles. Attempt to beat levels or try and get the highest score.

name: Hentai Cyberpunk
short_description: Fight against robotic enemies ! In a sexy and futuristic Wave Based Game !

name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R
short_description: Hirohiko Araki's masterpiece, brought to life as a fighting game! Battle with 50 colorful characters, wielding Stands, Hamon, and more! See how characters who could never meet in the story interact when they come face to face!

name: VR Time Machine Travelling in history: Medieval Castle, Fort, and Village Life in 1071-1453 Europe
short_description: European castles are known for their mysterious brilliance. Many castle owners are either kings, nobles, ministers, or princesses. Each has its own ancient legend about them.

name: Fish Game
short_description: Fish Game is a detailed and highly “sofishticated” freshwater aquarium simulator, lovingly crafted *by* enthusiasts *for* enthusiasts! Featuring fish with personalities and dynamic relationships, water quality modeling, and so much more! Made with support from our friends at Smarter Every Day!

name: The Call Of Paper Plane
short_description: Welcome to the relaxing adventure game paper airplane. Move the paper plane up and down to avoid obstacles, leap over fields, towns, forests, and many other scenes. Listening to the music, let us go on a fantasy journey with the paper plane.

name: Dap
short_description: Dap is a horror-action-adventure about gathering and protecting a pack of fragile creatures called Daps. Lead your Daps to safety through an eerily beautiful world, fighting off threats, solving puzzles, and avoiding the infection that twists your companions into something alien and terrifying…

name: Watch Your Helmet
short_description: A simulator of a space suit with a jetpack in worlds with real physics, zero gravity and gravitational anomalies. Your main enemy is Newton's first law.

name: Boxfight
short_description: Boxfight is a local PvP game playable from 2 to 4 players. Build, Edits and use your weapons to defeat your opponents ! One of the most competitive games to do with your friends !

name: MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA
short_description: This is the latest addition to the series of 2D fighting games based on TYPE-MOON's visual novel, Tsukihime. The curtain rises once more on dramatic battles played out with familiar characters from Tsukihime: A Piece of Blue Glass Moon.

name: Iwaihime
short_description: From hit writer Ryukishi07, the creator of When They Cry, comes a story on the theme of “curses.” Strike down the dark riddle of dolls and soot in this supernatural horror visual novel.

name: Love Mystery Club
short_description: This game is based on the theme of love & light reasoning. Even if you choose the wrong option, it will not lead to game over. It is very suitable for casual players who like love reasoning but don't want to waste their brain cells.

name: Cloud Gardens
short_description: A chill game about using plants to overgrow abandoned wasteland dioramas

name: SkyLife: VoxelSurvival
short_description: An open world FPS game in voxel world. Use the items to go back and forth between the islands and aim to escape!

name: Last of Ass
short_description: LAST OF ASS - is a horror game in which the protagonist survives horrible events by just turning the wrong way on the highway.

name: CYNOROID GAIDEN
short_description: Free aiming plat-former!

name: Cosmic Disco
short_description: Feel the beat! A VR rhythm shooter where you kill enemies in beat, as they fly towards you, alternating pistols hand to hand, surrounded by beautiful skies with musical visualization. Created by a solo developer.

name: Desecration~褻渎
short_description: Desecration is a turn based strategy roguelike, where you have just sold your soul to conquer the kingdom. Build a small army, learn spells, and find artifacts through a randomly generated map. Each play through will provide the player a unique and challenging experience filled with glory or defeat!

name: Spells and Fellas
short_description: Spells and Fellas is an action-packed survival game with magic-based combat. Bring your enemies to their knees and receive more powerful spells and equipment as loot. Recruit allies to fight alongside you to increase your chances of surviving all 100 waves of enemies.

name: Iron Reich
short_description: Exterminate fascist robots in a Half-Like style mediterranean dystopia. Cut off their power, sever their communications, and eradicate their human pet collaborators. We shall be feared, for we are infiltrated among them, ready to strike! ONWARD TO VICTORY! - The Partisan Command

name: AaaaaAAaaaAAAaaAAAAaAAAAA!!! Remastered
short_description: You're a skydiving, video-streaming guerilla artist in the floating city of Boston High. Your job is to leap from buildings, cause mischief, and not get caught.

name: Quantum Derelict
short_description: "Quantum Derelict" is a rogue-lite survival horror game set in a chilling Lovecraftian inspired narrative. In the uncharted vastness of space, outwit the sinister cult of VUGSHERYOG and the lurking horrors as you strive to retain your sanity, find rescue, and survive against all odds.

name: Shots
short_description: Shots is a PvP action multiplayer shooter game with a lots of weapons!

name: Fly Corp
short_description: Develop your own transport network in different regions and cities: open new routes, buy and upgrade new planes, and increase airport capacity!

name: The Nightmare
short_description: The Nightmare is a first-person horror game. Dive into the nightmare and try to get rid of that nightmare...

name: Olympic Basketball
short_description: Dribble, slam, dunk, score and win the Olympics!

name: Domino House
short_description: Domino House is a fun, spooky, point-and-click puzzle game where you search for items and cleverly crafted clues to help you escape the creepy house in which you are trapped.

name: Whizz Ball
short_description: Whizz Ball is a high speed cross between Pong, Breakout and Pinball. Play against your friends with 4 player local support, or play single player against the computer.

name: Candle In Darkness
short_description: People by nature are afraid of darkness, see it as danger. Monsters are lurking. Are they just a fiction or more? Darkness challenges your survival...

name: Demons Ate My Neighbors!
short_description: Demons terrorize the neighborhood in this reimagined nostalgia nightmare! DAMN! is a manic adventure roguelite shooter, & funky spin on co-op arcade classics. Find & exorcise neighbors from hell with upgrades, holy squirt guns & household weapons!

name: An Amazing Wizard
short_description: An Amazing Wizard is a 2D fast-paced metroidvania-inspired spell-slinging roguelike where you'll create spells. Master 7 elements and merge 120 unique spells in any order to create endless possibilities. Choose from 250+ perks and 200 artifacts. Collect your lost memories and reclaim true name!
Life is short. Time is precious. Can you discover and solve the mysterious sequence of puzzles that will save the world before you are... eighty-sixed?

name: Off The Chains Disc Golf
short_description: Off The Chains is a lighthearted Disc Golf simulation you can play with friends! Unlock new discs with unique stats and customize your own collection. Enjoy a casual game or challenge others to a match.

name: Phaseshift
short_description: Brace yourself for a face-peeling blast through cyberpunk styled locales! Engage in frantic vehicular combat with over 16 highly explosive abilities and weapons. Inspired by Extreme-G, Rollcage, Wipeout and other 90s/00s combat racers.

name: Gloom and Doom
short_description: Gloom and Doom is a visual novel throwback to 90s slacker movies - complete with the solitude and sarcastic retorts - but with a supernatural twist. Push a powerful but unmotivated wraith to complete his stagnated quest to enter heaven, while trying to kill the suicidal but unkillable Doom Bringer.

name: Teamfight Manager
short_description: Teamfight Manager is a simulation game where you are the coach of an e-sports team. You must manage players to set them up for matches. Make the best of pick & ban by evaluating the characteristics of the champions/players! A smart strategy can make up for a lack of individual player skills.

name: Skyseeker
short_description: Skyseeker is a monster-collecting metroidvania where every enemy is catchable. Enter a world where ancient creatures thrive in a world lost to time. As a Skyseeker, join the legendary explorers who tame these monsters and attempt to reach the fabled summit of the sky.

name: Fantasy Tavern Sextet -Vol.1 New World Days-
short_description: It is an adventure game where you can enjoy a slapstick love harem play with laughter, tears, and a little H in a bar in a fantasy world.

name: Curling On Line
short_description: Realistic Single Player, Local Multiplayer, On Line Multiplayer Curling Game

name: game
short_description: d

name: Project Crimson
short_description: Project Crimson is a 2D action-arcade clicker where your movement is restricted to a straight line in front of you. Use objects to manipulate your movement and, with some luck and good timing, fly through 75 levels of fun and satisfying challenges. No advertisements, no microtransactions.

name: Behind Closed Doors: A Developer's Tale
short_description: In Behind Closed Doors, you plays as Ethan, who works for a small indie company, trying to support his pregnant wife. He gets an unexpected phone call during the middle of the night, and is teleports to another dimension, where he has to face a series of challenges to get back to the real world.

name: PBA Basketball Slam: Arcade Edition
short_description: PBA Basketball Slam: Arcade Edition! This zany and quirky arcade-style basketball features epic moves, high-flying dunks, and witty commentary that will keep you at the end of your seats. It’s basketball stripped down to its most fun and basic components which makes it easy to pick-up and enjoy.

name: Fox's Holiday / 狐の假期
short_description: Fox vacation is a lighthearted nostalgia game. In the game, the player arranges all the journey of the fox through the plan, and at the same time, we can find our lost childhood. 32 weeks to complete the content of the week. Let's have a good holiday!

name: Twin Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Adventure
short_description: Twin Breaker is a story-driven brick breaking game molded in the style of ‘80s arcade classics like Arkanoid and Breakout.

name: Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall
short_description: Rule your crumbling kingdom as you try to satisfy the petty needs of your people in this cinematic kingdom management RPG. Balance your resources, collect taxes, hire agents and make difficult decisions to see your kingdom prosper or fail.

name: VR Museum
short_description: VR Museum - a virtual exhibition of historic machines, flying, would-be flying, and wannabe-flying. Walk as close as you want and DO touch the exhibits!

name: Reflect Horizons
short_description: Reflect Horizons is a VR immersive art installation that explores the idea of reality within a virtual world. It borrows from familiar real-world installations, that abstract and manipulate reality, to see what happens when what's being abstracted is not actually real.

name: Slimesphere
short_description: Slimesphere is an isometric turn-based tactics game, where the goal is to kill the enemy slimes within 3 rounds. Its deterministic mechanics make the levels feel like puzzles, and you have to figure out the best strategy to win!

name: The Sea Hotel☆Umineko Tei
short_description: 『海洋ホテル☆海猫亭』は五つ星ホテルを目指す経営シミュレーションゲームです。プレイヤーはホテル『海猫亭』の看板娘『イヴ』となり、お店を切り盛りすることになります。

name: Portals World
short_description: A sci-fi action strategy tower defense digging 2D top down game, Dig, explore, build production and defensive facilities, take care of robot's battery and manage power wisely..

name: Cube Raiders
short_description: Cube Raiders is a fun puzzle game for one or two players where you have to combine groups of dice using the energy of MagnetoGloves. Thanks to this power, it is possible to push or rotate the dice to solve the levels while trying to avoid the traps of each temple.

name: Lonely Birds
short_description: A puzzler where you reunite separated PEARakeets with their match by clicking on pairs of animals to make them move towards each other. It starts simple but grows challenging quickly over the many available levels, all in a pretty, cozy and cute setting.

name: Obsidian Prince
short_description: Fight through dungeons in a tactical, turn-based roguelike where choices have real consequences. Craft your backstory & inspiration decks & combine classes, skills & gear to create truly powerful heroes. Explore & rebuild Emalon in the campaign or top the highscore in a challenging roguelike mode.

name: Offroad Racing On Line
short_description: Drift, slide, skid! Offroad Racing Online is the isometric 3D perspective car racing game that makes racing funnier than ever.

name: OUBEY VR - Samurai
short_description: Inside the art - Oubey Samurai In this VR you’re in a tight space surrounded by the deep red of the painting. Discover “the picture behind the picture” whilst also leaving your own tracks in the painting.

name: I'a I'a Cofflhu Fhtagnyaa
short_description: "I'a'Ia Cofflhu Fhtagnyaa" is a Galgame with Cthulhu mythology, with three female (xie) masters (shen) who can be attacked, 8-10 hours of game time. Working in a coffee shop, I accidentally discovered the indescribable secret of this shop...

name: Phobos
short_description: Discover an expansive online multiplayer world of battle, stories, and intrigue. Wield great weapons or conjure terrifying magics. Explore the world, solve quests, and slay great beasts and players alike.

name: Building 847
short_description: New Mexico, 1986. You're a private detective, investigating a bizarre incident that occurred inside a building in a small town. Find clues, visualize past events and learn about this alternate-reality.

name: Kapow Pets
short_description: Play Kapow Pets using physics-based blasts to strategically move your pet through a variety of levels full of dangerous traps and hazards. Collect treats and treasure! Unlock new pets to complete the ultimate collection of Kapow Pets!

name: Shutterbug Stud
short_description: Welcome to Morlock Lake! The Demanding Mayor May has invited you, Doug ‘Shutterbug’, here to take pictures of local girls for a Calendar, but from Shy Waitresses to Daring Heiresses, a camera roll full of Tricky Tasks await!

name: Data mining X
short_description: Data mining X - casual colorful minimalist puzzle in which you have to collect all the files that are not corrupted to exit the closed circle.

name: Dead or Mad
short_description: In the depth of swamps there is a small village in which one by one the villagers began to go missing and go mad, while others had died of disease. You'll have to go through many dangers and find the cause of all these ills.

name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice
short_description: No obstacle will keep me away from my beloved, my Faith, not even the wild and untamed islands of Kalau’a. Those lovely island ladies can only distract me for so long as my heart’s compass only points in one direction - Faith!

name: Picross for a Cause
short_description: Picross for a Cause is a puzzle game where you reveal pictures by using logic to fill in pixels. All proceeds are donated to the NAACP Legal Defense and Education Fund, Inc.

name: Misplaced
short_description: Test your skills in a rogue-like FPS survival game, upgrade your arsenal and survive as long as you can!

name: Crown Legion
short_description: This is a war strategy game where players need to arrange formations and tactics, use equipment and skills, collect rare relics, and lead their loyal team to reclaim the throne.

name: Magical Strings
short_description: Intense multiplayer rhythm-projectile-fighting game set in ancient China!

name: Mist of the Undead
short_description: Mist of the Undead is the perfect laid back shoot em up zombies game. Fight off endless rounds of zombies meanwhile upgrading your weapons to do serious damage. Speed around the map with the speed boost and super jump. Purchase armor, or don't, can you survive?

name: BloodRayne: Terminal Cut
short_description: Enhanced and updated for modern systems, this is the definitive edition of the action horror game that unleashed the red-headed dhampir on the world. In a story spanning five years, Rayne must stop a madman bent on using occult relics to bring about a new age of domination for the Third Reich.

name: Militsioner
short_description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

name: BloodRayne 2: Terminal Cut
short_description: Enhanced and updated for modern systems, this is the definitive edition of Rayne’s second adventure: a blood-soaked rampage of vengeance against the Cult of Kagan, a group led by Rayne's half-siblings that seek to carry out their father Kagan's legacy by creating a new era of vampire supremacy.

name: Super Chopper
short_description: Climb into the cockpit of a military attack helicopter and take on five life or death scenarios, or make your own missions in the included level editor! Use your arsenal of weapons, speed and superior maneuverability to take down enemy tanks, helicopters and missile platforms.

name: Bor
short_description: Play with Bor the Viking through 4 worlds! Unlock all the secret levels and save his 60 (60!!!!) wives in this colorful old-school platform.

name: Day of the Dead: Solitaire Collection
short_description: Dive into this chilling Solitaire adventure and experience the vibrant Dia de los Muertos as you decorate a cemetery to welcome souls from the Land of the Dead.

name: Depersonated
short_description: An interactive steampunk-inspired adventure filled with a noir atmosphere. Сhoose your path as a young girl named Molly and unravel the mysteries of RainWood town.

name: Ragnar's Chinese Memory Game
short_description: Increase your Chinese vocabulary with this classic and fun memory game. Learn to read either Simplified or Traditional characters, and listen to the pronunciation of each word to help you towards fluency.

name: The Roy Game
short_description: A game where puking zombies try to puke over your trashcans, you have to defend your trashcans by placing automatic puking robots. Meanwhile you have to attack the zombie-printing machines.

name: Small Iron
short_description: Jump and shoot your way across six unique levels to recover six unique weapons in your fight against the McCoy gang. Fight against rampaging wildlife in exotic locales across the territory to restore peace and order to the town of Little Brick. Every boss has a weakness. Can you figure them all out?

name: Barry the Bunny
short_description: A 2D platformer with short challenging levels about a bunny who builds bridges.

name: Mina & Michi
short_description: A 2D top-down puzzle/adventure game about friendship featuring 2 players local co-op.

name: Prehistoric Dude
short_description: A retro style mini metroidvania game about a caveman who loves ham!

name: Super Box Land Demake
short_description: A 2D top-down puzzle game featuring 2 players local co-op. It's a Demake version of "Sokoban Land DX", featuring Completely new graphics, new Bonus Levels and other improvements.

name: Super Wiloo Demake
short_description: A 2D platformer featuring colorful 8-bit style graphics and 5 different worlds! It's a Demake version of "WILOO", featuring Completely new graphics, new Power-ups and other improvements.

name: Sea Legends
short_description: The year is 1667, and the sea is a dangerous place. In this picturesque game combining role-playing adventure, fleet-building strategy, swashbuckling action, and naval combat, you'll need keen planning and swordsmanship to reach the story's end – or turn pirate to lead your fleet to infamy.

name: Bakery Magnate: Beginning
short_description: Bakery Magnate is a game with a small plot in which you have to solve economic problems to keep the store afloat. At the same time, you intend to provide for your son, who constantly gets into trouble.

name: Orlando Theme Park VR - Roller Coaster and Rides
short_description: Welcome to Orlando Theme Park VR! Are your palms sweaty already? Are you brave enough to face all toys and rides? Yes, this is a VR experience like you have never seen before!

name: MindWorks
short_description: MindWorks is a VR kaleidoscopic audio visualizer. Create share and enjoy audio visual experiences with your friends in VR.

name: SPL: Skilled Pilots Live
short_description: SPL is a genre mix of fast paced looter shooter, souls-like and 3D space sim, with realistic physics dogfights.

name: SKIN
short_description: SKIN is an otherworldly stealth game where you hunt monsters in a nightmare forest. You are Artemis, and you will summon an Eternal Night.

name: Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1
short_description: Alpha 1 of Hello Neighbor 2 is back! It is a Stealth Horror Game where you’re being stalked by a mysterious creature as you try to track down Mr. Peterson who has disappeared after the events of the first game. Play against an advanced, self-learning AI that adapts to your every move.

name: Fight N' Fall
short_description: Battle it out with 3 other friends in colorful fully destructive arenas. Select a character - or assemble your own - with a roster of unique and powerful spells. Last one standing wins!

name: Anvil Empires
short_description: Anvil is a massively multiplayer game where thousands of players work together to build empires, wage war, and conquer in a persistent online world. March alongside armies of players in massive melee battles and large scale sieges.

name: Sword Rogue
short_description: A simple rogue like action game. Use WASD to move, use the mouse to control the player character's direction, use the left mouse button to attack and right mouse button to use skill. Also supports keyboard only mode, see details in the ingame guide.

name: Dino Nest
short_description: Dinosaur survival management game. Lead your own pack of dinos and feed to grow bigger. Can you survive or will you become extinct?

short_description: The second work following [Monads], released in 2019.This is a puzzle-tactics game without RNGs, so you can revert your action anytime. Find your own solution of prepared stages, following the story of 6 protagonists.

name: A Dark Ice Saga: The Rescue
short_description: A simplistic-platformer created by 13 & 7 year-old kids and their parents.

name: B67
short_description: B67 is a top-down roguelite shooter that finds the player struggling to descend through 67 sub-levels of ever changing chaos. Manage your ammunition as much as your fears as you descend further into the unknown.

name: Zodiakalik
short_description: Welcome to the journey of the planets! An RPG like no other! Enemies visible on the battlefield with the EDD system.

name: cyan
short_description: Incarnate as Xiaoqing, head to Jinshan base alone to find her sister. In the process, it is necessary to resist the attacks of mutants, solve the mystery of the mechanism, and discover the secrets and conspiracy behind the Jinshan base.

name: How to Win: Season One
short_description: How to Win is an anarchic adventure/gaming experiment where players decide the rules. Whatever you decide, that’s what happens next in our story. No matter what chaos it creates. Play through all 5 chapters of Season 1, then send us your ideas for Season 2!

name: Attic
short_description: An adventure game. Help a boy named Theo start a new life and find good friends.

name: VR Travelling in the Roman Empire (VR Rome Time machine travel in history)
short_description: According to historical records, from the establishment of the city in the 8th century BC to the 2nd century AD, it took more than 1,000 years for ancient Rome to rise to dominate Europe, Asia, and Africa, but it quickly collapsed and declined in less than 200 years.

name: Outpost: Vikings
short_description: Finally in a new land you must find a way to survive. Hunt, gather, produce & build to grow your new settlement. Manage your allies & enemies & help your people prosper and conquer this new land.

name: Fancy Skiing Ⅲ Pro
short_description: Fancy Skiing Ⅲ Pro is the third generation of the famous VR franchise Fancy Skiing. In this new build, you will not only be able to compete with friends in three kinds of maps: Classic, City and Trail, but also give the best of yourself in one of the three modes: Single Player, Speed and Battle.

name: Anuchard
short_description: Anuchard has fallen. Generations after the fall, its surviving descendants have chosen you as the Bellwielder of the magical Audros Bell. Go forth, battle monsters, solve puzzles, and restore Anuchard to its former glory: A paradise in the skies!

name: Shujinkou
short_description: Shujinkou is a story-driven, turn-based dungeon crawler that provides players with the option to learn Japanese as they play. Play through an enthralling 80-hour story campaign as Shu, Jin, and Kou in a fight to save the world from the Akuma.

name: ZCREW
short_description: Zcrew is a roguelike game that supports up to 4 players playing co-op online. In the latest “Full Frontal Fire” update, you‘ll be able to utilize the new automatic firing system to reign the battlefield with lightning and missiles. Collect resources, modify your weapon，and dominate the battlefield.

name: Rain Leak Life -  雨漏り人生
short_description: A simple VR action game where you endure long periods of leaking rain in a leaky quadrant! Put on the VR HMD and you're in a nostalgic Japanese four-and-a-half-mat apartment. If you leave the rain leaking, you'll get yelled at by the residents on the floor below!

name: Venkazoid Blast
short_description: You are Vakimoh. They are the Venkazoids. Fight for your life in this quick and brutal arcade-style shooter. Can you escape your cage?

name: The HeartBeat
short_description: The Heartbeat is a lightweight political simulation game that incorporates rhythmic, text-oriented options. All the player has to do in the game is keep himself and the city alive as much as possible.

name: Domynyo
short_description: Post-apocalyptic and Abandonment are the protagonists of the 1st Season. Dark locations and abandoned places in a 4k world. The day-night cycle and climate conditions will influence the game to the point that you could find yourself in the dark seeking for a torch and praying for the storm to end.

name: Wordle 2
short_description: Wordle 2 is a challenging and addictive word game that will put your vocabulary and spelling skills to the test with exciting new levels and hidden bonus words.

name: Spindle
short_description: SPINDLE is an Old-school Action-Adventure about death and the many ways we choose to deal with it. With your trusty Pig by your side, you form a most curious team, embarking on a quest to learn what it truly means to be Death.

name: Blip (Open Alpha)
short_description: Blip is a platform where players and creators come together to build, play, and share unique gaming experiences. An open-source alternative to Roblox.

name: City of Gangsters
short_description: In this management tycoon game, you’ll start a criminal operation from nothing and grow it into a well-oiled money machine! Build speakeasies and illegal distilleries. Manage production chains and resource distribution. Leverage favors, chase down debtors, and bribe the police to look the other way.

name: Gordian Rooms: A curious heritage Prologue
short_description: Gordian Rooms: A Curious Heritage is a Victorian escape game, where you solve various puzzles in your late uncle’s mansion in the hope of obtaining his legacy. In the prologue you can play through the first level of the game.

name: Man in gravity

name: Daffodil Yellow: A few poems from an insect collector
short_description: You are an insect collector. Wander through old summer memories looking for colors.

name: Wraith: The Oblivion - Afterlife
short_description: You died in a mysterious seance and have become a Wraith, one of the restless undead. In this VR horror game, use your supernatural abilities to solve the mystery behind your death. But beware of the sinister Spectres lurking in the shadows...

name: Hyper Dash
short_description: Hyper Dash is a free VR multiplayer team based shooter. Make smart use of Dashing, Sprinting, Walking and Rail Grinding to get around the arenas and win in a variety of gamemodes like; Payload, Domination, Control Point, (Team) Deathmatch, Capture The Flag, Elimination & Ball.

name: Observer: System Redux
short_description: The year is 2084. In a dark cyberpunk world shattered by plagues and wars, become a neural police detective and hack into the jagged minds of others. Make use of anything they felt, thought, or remembered to solve the case and catch the elusive killer.

name: サチ江 -死道-/Sachie -Death Road-

name: UEBERNATURAL: The Video Game - Prologue

name: Heavy Metal Babes

name: PANIC STATION
short_description: After exploring the new planet, the space crew became infected with an unknown virus. After a long epidemic, the space station plunged into chaos. Various mutations took place with the crew of the ship, which clouded their minds. Make your way to the rescue shuttle through the mysterious danger.

name: Vectromirror™

name: Island of the Lost
short_description: A relaxing first-person exploration game. Journey through eight unique environments as you collect treasures, unlock secrets and search for a way off the island.

name: Kings Town

name: Sly Slime

name: Capture the Flag - CTF 1

name: E.X.P.L.O.R.™: A New World

short_description: 你还在怀念儿时第一次看宇宙骑士、太空堡垒时那种热血沸腾的感受吗？《缄默星空》是一款画面怀旧，玩法创新的星战RPG冒险游戏。多线叙事，多种结局，驾驶你的飞船，重温儿时的感动吧。

name: Serious Fun Football
short_description: SERIOUS realism with advanced ball physics and freedom of player movement, FUN casual dynamic gameplay, online or in single-player. This is Serious Fun Football. It's play ball time!

name: Dream Knights
short_description: Dive into colourful and surreal dreamscapes in a traditional 2D side-scrolling platformer. Master different skills to help you traverse and battle your way through a horde of strange enemies.

name: VIETNAM WAR PLATOON 越战排 (AI WAR Game)
short_description: This game is a new concept card and flag game with the theme of Vietnam War. It is a light snack game prepared for the leisure transition of players who are tired of playing large-scale games like me and hand injured players. 2020.8.10

name: Kazakh Drive
short_description: You're a simple Kazakh driver. Take a trip along the highway that cuts through the gloomy landscapes of Central Asia full of Eastern wisdom. And be careful.

name: BLASTRONAUT
short_description: BLASTRONAUT is a mining game in a procedural alien world. Explore, extract and profit.

name: Ice star Chapter 2
short_description: Action shooter with story elements.

name: Unbeliever
short_description: Traverse through a broken world and recall your memories. With each step you take you regain your lost powers. Develop your character however you like and find your true self.

name: Gravitational
short_description: Gravitational is a VR experience that takes place in an upward future, where gravitational technology is being discovered. Experience Sebastian, a scientist in the apex of collapse inside Gravicorp’s facilities, overcoming not only challenges on your way but also your traumas.

name: AGOS - A Game Of Space
short_description: Explore unique star systems in AGOS: A Game of Space! Scavenge resources, face the danger of space and save humankind.

name: Lost Patrol
short_description: "We’re fit, we’re alive, but we’re not back home" In this classic multi-genre DOS game, take command of the seven survivors of a U.S. helicopter crash in Vietnam, desperately trekking across 57 miles of harsh terrain infested with booby traps and enemy soldiers.

name: Furry Heroes
short_description: Unscramble the tiles to release a unique hero, Follow the magic patterns To Remove their Body Curses before time's up, and Perform a "magical extraction". But DON'T FORGET! To be sure the curse was completely removed, you need to check their "natural bodies". Enjoy fully animated heroes.

name: Practical Shooting Simulator
short_description: Practical Shooting Simulator contains a wide variety of features for creating stages, exercise planning, and testing abilities in practical shooting. Not just a game, but a unique tool for organizers, competitors, and all enthusiasts of Practical shooting.

name: The Companion
short_description: A cinematic gaming experience. Play as an animal in the spiritual realm. Explore a magical world. Collect Essence and find Artifacts. Journey across seven majestic landscapes and witness the emotional story of a family as they tackle the challenges ahead of them.

name: Asteroids... But Roguelite
short_description: Start off as a weak ship with a simple attack and fight through waves of enemies, earning currency in order to purchase upgrades for your ship. The never ending waves of enemies grow in number, power, and variety as you progress. Purchase upgrades to keep pace with them.

name: Milk inside a bag of milk inside a bag of milk
short_description: A short story about what sort of challenges everyday little things can be. Help the girl buy milk, be the first not to disappoint her.

name: Little Nightmares III
short_description: Little Nightmares III is an atmospheric adventure game in which you follow the journey of Low and Alone, two best friends in search of a way out of the Nowhere. In 2 players online cooperation or solo with an A.I., work together to solve puzzles and survive in this nightmarish world.

name: Day of the Worms
short_description: What starts as a day of part-time agricultural endeavour, quickly turns to terror in this hand-drawn, point-and-click adventure with interactive fiction elements. Rake leaves, pick fruit, and fight for your life.

name: STORY OF SEASONS: Pioneers of Olive Town
short_description: Welcome to Olive Town, a peaceful community established by your trailblazing grandfather and his friends. Now that you've taken over his farm, it's your job to carry on his legacy. Plant crops, raise animals, build relationships, and get to know the residents of your new home!

name: Leif's Adventure: Netherworld Hero
short_description: Join Leif and his loyal sidekick Ghost as they combine their strengths to overcome the sinister forces of the Netherworld. In this story-driven, co-op action-adventure inspired by Nordic folklore, friendship proves to be the greatest power of all.

name: Festoon Player
short_description: Watch back your fulldome/360 degree or flat screen media in a virtual environment. Choose from 4 environments including, tilted dome, flat dome, equirectangular and cinema. Full VR and None VR is supported.

name: Labyrinths of the World: Hearts of the Planet Collector's Edition
short_description: A geological adventure into a secret world inside our planet!

name: Block Arena
short_description: Block Arena is an exciting online game where you try to stay alive on a constantly breaking map!

name: Get Out! Snakes!
short_description: Inspired by the success of the 90s, Get out! Snakes! Make the famous Snake from old cell phones your enemy, save your friends green apples in 5 different worlds, or lute against a friend in the multiplayer arena! Ah! And don't take your eyes off the snake, after all, you're also hunting now!

name: Dashie's Puh-ranormal Activity
short_description: Dashie's Puh-ranormal Activity is a 3D comedy/horror game developed for the YouTuber Dashie. (YouTube: DashieGames, DashieXP, DashieXP2). The game features various references to Dashie's skits and videos. In this game, Dashie is being haunted by the ghost of his ex and former skit characters.

name: Electrify
short_description: A game axed on imagination, creativity and community. Logic, attention and perseverance are needed. It is a ludic circuits simulator with a game approch. Convinient and intuitive, it will accompany you in your electronic learning quest. Electrify is here.

name: 12 bananas
short_description: Leap over treacherous chasms, navigate past a sea of hazards, and locate all 12 bananas as you embark on an epic quest and travel the patience-testing path that lies ahead in this infuriatingly challenging, unforgiving, puzzling, memey platformer.

name: Space Hole 2020
short_description: In 2020, The origin of time, life, and civilization lurks inside a deep cosmic shaft known as the "Space Hole." Various beings explore the holes, and inside find commonalities in the systems and games. You gotta go in the Space Hole!

name: Keyword: A Spider's Thread
short_description: Become an investigator in Keyword, a narrative thriller where you’ll depend on skills of logical deduction, hacking, and social engineering to solve challenging puzzles as the only means of finding your missing daughter.

name: Battle Hunters
short_description: BATTLE HUNTERS is a classic-style RPG adventure with an original, tactical real-time combat system and 28 unique heroes to discover and recruit - all with unique abilities and powerful special moves. Over 15 hours of gameplay, across 5 regions of the kingdom, with a huge array of enemies to battle.

name: Swaying Girl
short_description: 这是一个交互性小说的游戏，包含多个独立的小故事。画面精美，操作简单。

name: Onder
short_description: Alone and underground.

name: Actraiser Renaissance
short_description: Heaven, earth and mankind - Create and destroy everything according to your will! Experience the revival of the '90s classic hit "Actraiser"

name: Reverse Defenders
short_description: Reverse Defenders is flipping the world of tower defense games on its head. Finding out your favorite builds of classes, skills, and abilities is only half the fun, because on the Flipside await new possibilities. Unlock the true secrets of this world and challenge yourself to get that perfect run!

name: Seek Girl V
short_description: This is a Sokoban casual game. Players need to fill the holes in the ground with cubes to rescue the trapped girl.

name: TOKOYO: The Tower of Perpetuity
short_description: You find yourself trapped in a mysterious tower – one that transforms its very structure every 24 hours, where you must surpass countless poor fallen souls and make your way to the heretofore unseen top!

name: Banality Wars Carridin
short_description: Discover the secrets of Project Carridin in this deep tactical turn based strategy game inspired by Advanced Wars Days Of Ruin.

name: Hillside

name: Mythicard
short_description: Mythicard is an Online Auto Battler game based on Mythology. 6 players fight to be the last one standing, in order to win, each player has to create an army of cards and make it better every round. Winners get affinity points for the kind they played the most and can use it to modify their game!

name: Union
short_description: Union is a minimal puzzle game.

name: CheeseCube
short_description: Embark on an epic journey as a cube, mastering platformer puzzle challenges with humor and style. Glitch through platforms, uncover hidden paths, and find the quickest solution to each level. Put your skills to the test and compete globally as you aim to reach the top of the leaderboard.

name: Time Break Chronicles
short_description: Time Break Chronicles is a fusion of classic JRPGs and modern Roguelites, with a cast of 100 playable classes to find and unlock. Build your team, customize their abilities, and venture into a procedurally generated adventure through space-time and beyond!

name: サブリミナルレジオン
short_description: The first game of Sorcerer’s Records Series Season 3 is here! Check out the story of Sorcerer's Records, which is more mature than ever! This game is a standard lower window novel game for men of all ages.

name: Self gunsbase 2D History Shooter
short_description: Solve the terrible mystery of the anomalous forest.

name: Superbugs: Awaken
short_description: A Communication-Based, Co-Op game for 2P. Play either as the Scientist or the Hunter with communication as your only weapon to save your precious cat, Mimi, from deadly Superbugs!

name: The Amulet of AmunRun
short_description: Dive into AmunRun's pyramid in this cooperative escape room game to recover the pharaoh's amulet. Collaborate & communicate to work out the ancient enigmas that will lead you to the funeral chamber, and avoid falling into the pyramid's many deadly traps along the way.

name: CLASSIC TANKS 2020
short_description: Classic Tanks - a pleasant game in the classic style of retro tanks in a new comprehension. Capture bases, complete levels and destroy enemies. The game has more than 20 missions, several types of enemies and bonuses.

name: Sand Witch Adventures
short_description: Sand Witch Adventures is a roguelike game with bullet-hell elements. Cursed lands full of undead are fraught with wealth and knowledge for the young witches.

name: XGAMEX
short_description: 被困于像素拼筑的迷梦中，少女探寻着游戏唯一的出口。在《XGAMEX》里，你将与她携手同行，建立独特的羁绊，探索XGAMEX造设出的虚拟场景。拨开迷雾，寻找真相，打破通向世界彼侧的屏障。这款meta式探索解谜RPG游戏，欢迎您的加入~！

name: Home Designer - Living Room
short_description: In this classic hidden object game, Hazel wants to help her aunt with home refurbishment. Sell off the old stuff and renovate the empty living room with real world furniture and design the room of your dreams!

name: BlockBustersVR
short_description: Overview: With simple controls and familiar mechanics, this casual fun game will get everyone in your family to enjoy it within minutes. Complete the lines by yourself or with a friend in LAN co-op mode and work towards higher points and better combos!

name: Los Cops
short_description: Become a detective in a multi-genre non-linear TV series. Uncover mystery secrets using acting and hot temper. Choose who will be your friend or foe - do everything you can to restore order in Los Angeles.

name: Supreme Fighters
short_description: Supreme Fighters is a beat ‘em up combo style fighting game set in an urban fantasy environment. With enough playable characters you are guaranteed to find your own preferred fighting style and become The Supreme Fighter!

name: WAVER: A Typing Adventure
short_description: WAVER is the world's greatest typing adventure game. Control a passionate crowd of 26 characters as they follow their favourite sports team around the world. Love your keyboard.

name: Vincula
short_description: Discover, battle and explore this vast world of single player adventure. Make use of unique powers weapons and abilities and meet the charismatic characters that live in each biome. Will you be able to discover the great secret that Vincula holds?

name: Ocean's Heart
short_description: Ocean’s Heart is an epic top-down action RPG in which you explore a beautiful archipelago as a young woman named Tilia. Take on contracts to fight monsters, descend deep into ancient dungeons, defeat menacing foes, and unravel the mystery of Ocean’s Heart. All done in beautiful, bright pixel art.

name: Fury Knight
short_description: This game is a fantasy platformer presenting adventures of a little knight committed to get bad creatures out of the magic world with the help of a sword and magic.

name: OVR Locomotion Effect : Anti-VR Sickness
short_description: "OVR Locomotion Effect" is an overlay tool that aims to reduce VR sickness. It displays anti-sickness effect to HMD by controller input. You can use this tool on any SteamVR games since the effect is displayed as an overlay in front of the game.

name: Loofy
short_description: Loofy is a puzzle game. The task of which is to calculate the trajectory of the ball in such a way that it touches each of the green lines.

name: Surabaya Inferno
short_description: Freedom or Death! Surabaya Inferno is a real-time tactics game based on the battle of Surabaya which occured at November 10th, 1945. Play as Surabayans fighting against the forces of Britain, Netherlands, and Japan in order to defend their independence in Indonesia!

name: Prodigal
short_description: Prodigal is a story-rich action-adventure where you journey through a vibrant world fighting vicious monsters, exploring puzzling dungeons, and collecting magical artifacts. Unravel the mysteries of Vann's Point and bond with all of its curious townsfolk!

name: INFLUXIS
short_description: Explore a mesmerizing alien world, filled with deep bioluminescent wonders and horrors alike. Old alien artefacts await uncovering, in your search for the lost crew of Lazarus, in the search for your family in the depths of planet Eo-III.

name: Outer Frontier
short_description: Grow crops and fight giant birds, mine precious materials while avoiding sink holes. Keep your societies needs met before unrest breaks out. And finally end the war by tracking down the enemy leader.

name: Jolly Good: Cakes and Ale
short_description: Get yourself into and out of another fine mess! Win glory, renown, and much-needed money through cunning schemes that will seem like good ideas at the time.

name: REM Cycles
short_description: One night, ten people fall asleep...and find themselves in someone else’s dream. Guide these unlikely heroes as they traverse strange lands filled with enemies and memories. Confront a mysterious antagonist and witness chats between battles while you search for reason in sleep.

short_description: Take control of a futuristic assault tank, dropped by Helicarrier right into the action! With multiple camera views and an array of weaponry, this much-loved ‘command’ game focuses more on outright fighting than the strategic elements of similar retro titles.

name: My Jigsaw Adventures - The Source of Power
short_description: Find the pieces to discover and to travel in the Solar System! 45 jigsaw puzzles and in game achievements for an adventure in the middle of the stars!

short_description: Flixy Cats is a 3D platform where you can control Max and his entire cat crew as they defend themselves by hitting the rats with marshmallow mallets. You can explore different worlds, discover new power ups to help in the journey, team up with another cat to assist you and much more.

name: Viking Idle
short_description: Breathtaking Dual Prestige System Idle Clicker of Doom and Darkness!

name: Brock Crocodile
short_description: Take on the role of the rad red croc Brock in this 2D action platformer. Equiped with his trusty whip and fruitgun, blast and swing your way through an adventure inspired by the 90s, taking on giant bee mechas, mad ducktors and more as you try to stop the wicked Wize and his legion of minions!

name: Power of Ten - Demo
short_description: Demo for Power of Ten, a single star fighter trying to save as many civilians as possible before they are overrun by a marauder armada. You'll need to gather new weapons, upgrade your ship, find resources, trade with other ships and more to overcome the challenge before you.

name: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. - An Apocalyptic Tale

short_description: A fresh take on Roguelike Deckbuilders that lets you fine-tune your decks before each run to adapt your strategy on your way to victory. Over 1,200 cards to choose from, ten characters with their own set of unique skills, and dozens of items and missions to evolve your tactics.

name: You Can Pet The Dog VR
short_description: Fulfill the ultimate fantasy: going outside and petting a dog. In You Can Pet The Dog VR, players can pet and play with an adorable dog in a beautiful environment inspired by the upcoming game DOGGONE.

name: Official Wicked Vixen Silicone Scramble
short_description: Official Wicked Vixen Silicone Scramble is a mini Virtual Reality experience. You've been abducted and find yourself in an alien spacecraft! Your alien captors are about to subject you to an Interstellar IQ test (IIQ). Pass the test and go home. Or don't...

name: Strike VR
short_description: A fast action arcade game revamped into Virtual Reality. Shoot with your weapon, dodge bullets with your body, deflect bullets with your swords, and launch missiles and ultimate skills!

name: VirtuaCreature
short_description: The ultimate monster simulation! Train, feed, and battle with your own personal creature - Treat it well, and you'll see it evolve!

name: Ryewood Town
short_description: Ryewood Town is a relaxing, RPG-Style farming adventure. Grow your land, tame wild animals, fight monsters, craft new items, and personalize your home!

name: SCP: Escape Together
short_description: In the midst of a site-wide containment breach, you must team up with other Class-D personnel to escape the underground, isolated facility while evading the dangerous anomalies that have breached containment.

name: Magic Trick
short_description: Magic Trick is a magical skateboarding adventure game about community! As the new WizKid in town, perform spells using rad skating combos, explore the whimsical Sunset Isles, and socialize with adorable townsfolk who could use more magic in their lives!

name: 乱世奇谋Stratagem in troubled times

name: DreamDasher
short_description: The Dreamworld has been infected! It is up to you to explore the Dreamworld as the DreamDasher, discover its secrets, and defeat the Nightmare.

name: Super Symbol Boys

name: GAME OVER
short_description: the story will be told from the perspective of a game developer throughout the Great Depression from its beginning to its end, and how it affected him personally.

name: RXC - Rally Cross Challenge
short_description: Battle the world in reckless races as you bash, slide, and jump your way to the checkered flag. This isn't just another top-down arcade racing game. Made by two brothers, RXC is a physics heavy racing game with a traction and handling model that challenges sim racers and is still fun for newcomers.

name: Umami Grove

name: Rocco's Island: Ring to End the Pain

Interact with fantastic characters to learn past secrets and transform the Four Elements’ kingdoms, leading up to an epic finale with shocking reveals.

name: Path to Prosperity

Design and build your base, let your workers collect resources and produce goods, and raise armies to fight your competitors. Re-invest your coin wisely and send enough back home to win.

name: Niko and the Cubic Curse
short_description: Niko and the Cubic Curse is a 2D Platformer where you have to jump, fight, and collect to uncover the mystery of everyone's new shape-like appearances!

name: Tales From The Under-Realm: Hazel
short_description: In this dark visual novel, discover what led the apprentice witch, Hazel, to her untimely demise. There is, however, a chance for her to cheat death. Can you find her happy ending with one of two love interests - Tori the tough paladin, or Sasha the deceiving assassin?

short_description: Pass to Hell is a game where your choices lead to consequences. You will become Death and you will decide who is worthy to go to Heaven and who is to Hell.

name: 鹿易想要活到世界尽头

name: Dark Room VR

Attend classes, fight gangsters, work various part-time jobs, and cause all manner of mischief however you choose in this gorgeous 2D action RPG!

short_description: In this game, you play as 15-year-old Cole Andrews on a journey through a Virtual World his machine generated. Using Perspective, you'll have to help Cole get through every Altitude in the world, and reach the exit. Remember, "Everything is not what it seems..."

Navigate the mansion, solve the puzzles and evade the horrors that lurk.

name: Takorita Meets Fries
short_description: Deep under the sea, there is a princess who didn't know anything about french fries. This is her story, Princess Takorita's fated encounter with the french fries.

name: Block Dungeon
short_description: Block Dungeon is a sandbox-style roguelike game. You have to go through dungeons full of unique enemies and bonuses. Collect sets of armor and weapons, defeat enemies who become stronger and stronger each time. Random level generation and constant pumping your character.

name: Mahjong World Contest 2

short_description: Help the countess find unique masks! What hides behind the Mahjong tiles? Find the rarest masks by visiting carnivals around the world!

name: Rebirth:Mr Wang

name: Colossus Down
short_description: Join forces with Nika, MechaNika, Agatha and the Great Bleeding Pig in this peculiar and crazy mission of destruction of everything that isn't cool.

name: LOCIS

name: Wild Baffo

name: Heart of Summer

name: Egypt Picross Pharaohs Riddles
short_description: Solve the secret of the pharaoh and find pyramids’ treasure in Pharaoh's Riddles! New egyptian riddles await you!

name: Magic Griddlers

name: Picross Beach Paradise

name: Kathy Rain: Director's Cut

name: CyberThreat

name: The Disaster
short_description: Defend, survive, unlock, interact, upgrade and eliminate all zombies. A first person shooter game against zombies.

name: At Eve’s Wake Definitive Edition
short_description: An interactive Lovecraftian horror story about surviving a family you never knew and their servitude to a dark patron. True to the genre, you retain all knowledge from every play-through. Shape your fate and that of the family. Will you embrace this gift or rid humanity of their taint?

name: Stones of the Revenant
short_description: Retro-Arcade style platformer with six unique playable characters. Team up with local co-op or try to defeat the Revenant and his minions solo in this challenging quest to save the realm of the living!

Expend your coin in efforts to fend off your attackers while preparing for the final wave before you can move onto the next plot of land.

name: Almost My Floor: Prologue

Alex is a real fan of creepy stuff and horror movies, but he never expected to experience it himself just by taking the elevator back home! Can he avoid the madness and deal with the evil he's up against?

name: Haiki

name: Venture Valley
